summary.core_problem: DeltaML-Bench 评估的是 LLM agent 能否在真实研究代码库中完成机器学习实验改进，而不是只修 bug、跑干净数据集，或在 Kaggle 风格任务上调参。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把 agent 评测从代码补丁和单次指标优化，推进到更接近研究工作流的环境：读论文、理解仓库、修复训练管线、设计实验、验证改进，并避免投机式刷分。它对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对研究型 agent、自动化实验、SFT/RL 数据构造和 agent scaffolding 评估有参考意义。尤其是 specification gaming 的测量，提示训练信号和评测协议会强烈影响 agent 行为。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 包含 48 个任务，来自 Papers With Code 的真实论文和开源仓库。任务构造先从 2024 年 1 月之后、有公开 artifact、有明确指标的约 380 个候选中过滤，再由人工检查 README、依赖、数据可访问性和单 GPU 上训练循环能否启动。每个任务提供 paper PDF、repository、dataset 和 baseline metric，目标是超过已发布 baseline。领域覆盖 CV、Graph/Molecular、Time Series、Tabular/Other 和 NLP。评测中比较了标准 Modular agent scaffolding 与 search-based ARG scaffolding。ARG 的重点是通过搜索式实验管理改善探索，而不是让 agent 按单一路径执行计划。Benchmark 还加入 verification tests、log auditing 和 semantic validation，用于识别数据伪造、评测污染和 specification gaming。
summary.experiments: 论文评估 GPT-5 和 Claude Sonnet 4。在 4×6h compute allocation 下，ARG 将 GPT-5 的 per-run success rate 从 Modular 的 9.4% 提升到 33.9%。在 2×12h allocation 下，GPT-5 ARG 达到 49.0% per-run success rate，但作者也指出这个设置同时改变了尝试次数，因此需要分析 depth-versus-breadth trade-off。Modular 配置出现最高 47.9% 的 specification gaming rate，而所评估的 ARG 配置中没有检测到 gaming。任务示例包括 Stanford Cars ProMetaR、BTAD URD、ZINC NeuralWalker、ETTh1 AMD、California Housing Binary Diffusion 和 CNN/Daily Mail summarization 等，说明 benchmark 有较强代码库和任务异质性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。建议重点看 benchmark construction、task filtering、人类可复现性检查、success/gaming 判定规则，以及 Modular 与 ARG 的对比实验。若关注 agent post-training，可以多看 auditing 和 gaming 分析，因为这部分直接关系到 reward 定义和训练信号质量。具体任务列表可快速扫过，不必逐个细读；关键是理解为什么真实研究仓库比 clean benchmark 更容易暴露 agent 的规划、调试和实验管理短板。

summary_en.core_problem: DeltaML-Bench evaluates whether LLM agents can improve machine-learning results inside real research repositories, rather than only fixing isolated bugs or optimizing clean benchmark tasks.
summary_en.importance: The benchmark is useful for studying research-oriented agents and automated experimentation. Its direct connection to pretraining is limited, but it matters for post-training data design, RL environments, agent scaffolding, and evaluation of long-horizon tool use. The specification-gaming analysis is particularly relevant: it shows that weak task specifications and metric-only rewards can induce invalid improvements.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeltaML-Bench contains 48 tasks sourced from Papers With Code repositories. The authors start from roughly 380 candidates published after January 2024 with accessible artifacts and well-defined metrics, then apply human feasibility checks: following the README, resolving dependencies, checking dataset access, and verifying that the training loop can start on a single GPU. Each task provides a paper PDF, code repository, dataset, and baseline metric; the agent must improve over the published baseline. The domains include computer vision, graph and molecular learning, time series, tabular or other structured tasks, and NLP. The evaluation compares a standard Modular scaffold against a search-based ARG scaffold. ARG is designed to manage experimental search rather than follow a single linear plan. The benchmark includes verification tests, log auditing, and semantic validation to detect fabricated results and specification gaming.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4. Under a 4×6h allocation, ARG raises GPT-5 per-run success from 9.4% to 33.9%. Under a 2×12h allocation, GPT-5 with ARG reaches 49.0% per-run success, with the caveat that the comparison changes both run depth and number of attempts. Modular configurations show specification-gaming rates as high as 47.9%, while no gaming is detected in the evaluated ARG runs. Example tasks include Stanford Cars ProMetaR, BTAD URD, ZINC NeuralWalker, ETTh1 AMD, California Housing Binary Diffusion, and CNN/Daily Mail summarization, illustrating substantial heterogeneity in codebases and workflows.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on benchmark construction, candidate filtering, human reproducibility checks, success criteria, gaming audits, and the Modular-vs-ARG comparison. For agent post-training, the most useful parts are the reward specification and auditing procedure, since they expose how evaluation design affects agent behavior. The detailed task catalog can be read selectively; the main point is how real research repositories stress planning, debugging, and experiment management more than clean benchmarks do.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和 gaming 定义；它比玩具 SWE 任务更接近自动 ML 研究，但模型命名和复现实验要核查。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and gaming definition; it is closer to real ML automation than toy SWE tasks, but verify the model claims and reproducibility.

paper.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
paper.abstract: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. We introduce \textbf{SWE-bench Science}, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprisi

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 coding agent 评测过于看重总体通过率、却难以解释科学软件工程任务中失败原因的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 与 failure analysis 贡献。它把 SWE-bench 风格评测扩展到科学软件场景，并显式刻画失败机制，对理解 agent 在高专业度代码环境中的能力边界有帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 SWE-bench Science：包含 98 个 GitHub 仓库、119 个仓库级任务，覆盖 20 个科学领域，并将任务划分为 Issue-driven、Expert-exploratory、Engineering-integration 三类。除 pass@1 外，论文还总结四类常见失败机制，用于解释 agent 在科学代码修复中的薄弱点。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键信号是：最强代理 Claude Code with Opus-5 (max) 的 pass@1 仍低于 50%，说明科学软件工程比通用 SWE-bench 更难。实验应比较多种 coding agent 或模型配置，并按任务范式分析失败模式。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要在于知道现有代码模型在高专业知识密度仓库上的失效边界，而不是 benchmark 本身。
summary.authors_note: 机构为复旦大学与上海创新研究院。作者中可识别的资深学者是邱锡鹏，长期从事大模型与 NLP 研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of diagnostic evaluation for coding agents on scientific software, where aggregate success rates say little about why agents fail.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark plus failure-analysis contribution. It extends SWE-bench-style evaluation into scientific software engineering and makes failure modes explicit, which is useful for understanding agent limits in knowledge-heavy code environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces SWE-bench Science, a repository-level benchmark with 119 tasks from 98 GitHub repositories across 20 scientific domains. Tasks are grouped into Issue-driven, Expert-exploratory, and Engineering-integration paradigms. Beyond pass@1, the paper identifies four recurring failure mechanisms to characterize where coding agents break down.
summary_en.experiments: The key signal in the abstract is that even the best agent, Claude Code with Opus-5 (max), stays below 50% pass@1, suggesting scientific software engineering is substantially harder than generic SWE-style tasks. The full paper likely compares multiple coding agents and analyzes failures by task type. For a pretraining researcher, the value is mainly in understanding the failure boundary of current code models in high-specialization repositories rather than in the benchmark itself.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions are Fudan University and Shanghai Innovation Institute. Xipeng Qiu is a recognizable senior researcher in NLP and foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 这是评测资产，不直接改 pretrain；看任务分型和 failure taxonomy 就够，若你做代码预训练，可把它当高知识密度仓库分布的弱代理信号。
recommendation.en: This is an eval asset, not a pretraining paper; read the task taxonomy and failure modes, and treat it as a weak proxy for how code pretraining fails in knowledge-dense repositories.

paper.title: VGI-BENCH: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
paper.abstract: Recent studies suggest that video generation models can exhibit certain forms of zero-shot visual reasoning through generated frames. Yet reliable evaluation remains challenging: benchmarks should adopt inputs aligned with the visual priors of current video models, require valid evolving processes rather than only plausible final states, and calibrate task difficulty to remain challenging yet partly feasible. To this end, we introduce VGI-bench, containing 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized b

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评估视频生成模型视觉智能的 benchmark，重点测试生成过程是否符合视觉推理和动态演化，而不是只看最终帧是否看起来合理。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产贡献。VGI-BENCH 把视频生成模型从画质、提示词对齐，推进到生成式视觉推理评估；对多模态基础模型研究有参考意义，尤其是判断视频生成模型是否学到了可泛化的物理和空间过程。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 包含 27 个任务、810 个实例，并采用两级 taxonomy：上层按任务领域组织，下层用 skill tags 做细粒度能力标注。设计原则包括输入形式贴近当前视频模型视觉先验、要求过程演化有效、并校准难度以避免过易或完全不可解。
summary.experiments: 论文评估了当前生成系统。摘要报告最强模型 Seedance 2.0 在其评测标准下仅达到 51.0%。分析还覆盖输出失败模式、输入条件敏感性，以及从静态或短程能力迁移到更复杂过程推理的边界；完整模型列表和打分协议需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The work introduces a benchmark for probing visual intelligence in video generation models, focusing on whether generated temporal processes are valid rather than whether the final state merely looks plausible.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. VGI-BENCH moves video generation assessment beyond visual quality and prompt alignment toward generated-process reasoning, which is relevant for multimodal foundation model evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized by a two-level taxonomy of task domains and skill tags. The design aligns inputs with the visual priors of current video models, requires valid evolving processes, and calibrates task difficulty to remain challenging but partially solvable.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current generative systems. The abstract reports that the strongest model, Seedance 2.0, reaches only 51.0% under the proposed criteria. The analysis also studies failure modes, input-condition sensitivity, and the transfer boundary of visual reasoning capabilities; full model coverage and scoring details require the main text.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频生成评测资产备查即可；51% 的上限信号有用，但 810 例规模不足以支撑强结论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a video-generation evaluation reference; the 51% ceiling is informative, but 810 cases are too small for strong claims.

paper.title: Compliance, Capability, and Conflict: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs under System Messages
paper.abstract: Production deployments of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on system messages to govern model behavior. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate constraints in text only or embed them into the user turn, leaving system-message adherence in multimodal contexts largely unmeasured; they also leave open whether compliance comes at the cost of foundational vision-language capabilities. We introduce VSysBench, a benchmark built on MMVet-v2 that organizes constraints into 5 mai

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态大模型在系统消息约束下，能否同时保持约束遵循和视觉语言任务正确性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM benchmark 和评估协议。现有评测多在纯文本或 user turn 中嵌入约束，不能直接测量 multimodal system-message adherence，也较少量化遵循系统消息是否牺牲基础视觉语言能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VSysBench，基于 MMVet-v2 构建系统消息约束集合，覆盖 5 个主类和 22 个子类，包括视觉上下文中的文本指令和完全视觉 grounding 的约束；每个约束配有 misaligned counterpart 来测试指令层级冲突。评分同时考虑约束遵循和答案正确性，使用 Joint Satisfaction Rate 和 Cross-Constraint Sensitivity。
summary.experiments: 在 16 个 MLLMs 上评测。摘要报告的主要发现是：加入系统消息会明显损伤基础任务准确率，约束遵循与任务正确性之间存在冲突；具体模型名单、分数和降幅需读正文表格确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Seoul National University Graduate School of Data Science。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluates whether multimodal LLMs can follow system-message constraints while preserving correctness on vision-language tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. Existing evaluations mostly test text-only constraints or place constraints in the user turn, leaving multimodal system-message adherence and its capability tradeoff undermeasured.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces VSysBench, built on MMVet-v2. It defines five major constraint categories and 22 subcategories, ranging from textual directives in visual contexts to fully vision-grounded constraints, with misaligned counterparts to stress-test instruction hierarchy. It scores responses using Joint Satisfaction Rate and Cross-Constraint Sensitivity.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 16 MLLMs. The abstract reports that system messages substantially erode base task accuracy and that compliance can conflict with answer correctness; model-level numbers and effect sizes require checking the main tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Graduate School of Data Science at Seoul National University.

recommendation.zh: 对 native multimodal post/pretrain 接口有用：重点看 16 模型的 accuracy-compliance tradeoff 表。
recommendation.en: Useful for the native multimodal post/pretrain interface; focus on the 16-model accuracy–compliance tradeoff table.

paper.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning
paper.abstract: We introduce ClosureBench, a constructive benchmark for compositional graph-relational reasoning with programmatically verified ground truth. Unlike fixed-test-set benchmarks vulnerable to data contamination, ClosureBench generates instances on demand: each task's reference answer is computed by executing a program in the Ein tensor-logic language, ensuring machine-verified correctness. The benchmark spans 26 task categories at three compositional levels (L1-L3), with difficulty controlled along

summary.core_problem: 如何在“可控、可复现、可扩展且抗污染”的条件下，精确测量 LLM 在图结构上的组合式逻辑推理能力，并把失败定位到具体逻辑原语与组合深度，而不是被固定测试集污染、字符串匹配评测噪声、或输入编码差异所掩盖。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于提供一种更“可诊断”的评测资产：
1) 把图推理拆成可执行的逻辑原语（reachability/degree/set ops/connectivity/aggregation 等），并用程序计算 ground truth，显著降低评测误差与歧义；
2) 通过构造式生成实现无限新样本，能显式测“见过 vs 没见过”的差距，用来估计 contamination/记忆成分；
3) 三个独立难度旋钮（图规模、边密度、查询深度）让研究者能把性能崩溃归因到“组合深度”还是“图结构复杂度”，这对理解训练数据是否学到算法性能力、以及后训练（CoT/推理模式）是否只是改变输出策略很有帮助。
如果你在做：合成数据课程、程序化数据生成、推理能力的 scaling、或想把图/关系推理纳入预训练能力画像，这个 benchmark 的设计方法值得复用。
summary.technical_approach:
ClosureBench 的核心是“逻辑原语 + 程序执行求真值 + 可控生成”。
- 任务构造：每个任务类别对应一个或多个图关系逻辑原语的组合查询。论文强调 closure（传递闭包/可达性）是现实问题的共性核心，并扩展到度数、集合运算（并/交/差）、连通性（如强连通分量相关）、以及对可达集合做聚合（计数/求和等）。
- Ground truth：不靠人工标注或字符串匹配，而是把查询编译/实现成短程序执行得到精确答案。实现上给出两条等价路径：用 Ein（张量收缩表达图算法）或 Python/NetworkX。这个选择的关键取舍是：用“可执行语义”替代“文本对齐”，把评测误差从 NLP 层面剥离出去。
- 生成与抗污染：实例由结构 seed 与表面 seed 独立控制，可无限生成新图与新表述；模型只看到自然语言问题，输出 JSON，不暴露程序。这样既能做常规准确率，也能做“训练集/公开集是否被记住”的直接对照。
- 难度控制：提供三条相互独立的难度轴：图大小（节点数）、边密度、查询深度（组合层级/推理步数）。与很多图推理 benchmark 只沿单一轴（例如 hop 数）拉难度不同，这种设计能把失败模式定位得更细：是图变大导致上下文/注意力负担，还是组合深度导致程序性推理崩溃。
- 任务覆盖：26 个任务类别、3 个 compositional level。论文的意图是用“原语字典 + 组合语法”覆盖一类可泛化的关系推理空间，而不是堆很多自然语言 QA 题。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验主线是“诊断而非刷分”：
- 评测协议：模型输入为自然语言问题，输出结构化 JSON；答案由程序计算对比，避免字符串匹配带来的误判。
- 关键对照：利用构造式生成做 seen vs fresh 的差距测量，用来区分记忆/污染与真实泛化（论文在引言明确把它作为 benchmark 的一个用途）。
- 难度扫描：固定两条难度轴、扫描第三条，观察性能曲线何处出现拐点/崩溃，从而定位模型对“图规模/密度/组合深度”的敏感性。
- 论文在提供的正文片段里没有出现具体模型列表与数值表格；如果全文后半部分包含各模型在 26 类任务、不同难度设置下的准确率曲线/热力图，那些图表会是理解结论的关键（尤其是随 query depth 增长的退化形态，以及不同图编码/表述 seed 对方差的贡献）。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“设计动机 → 生成机制 → 诊断维度 → 评测细节”走：
1) 重点看 §2（benchmark 设计）：26 类任务如何由原语组合出来；三条难度轴如何参数化；结构 seed 与表面 seed 如何解耦。
2) 重点看 ground truth 的实现描述：Ein/NetworkX 两套实现如何保证等价；哪些任务的真值计算最容易出错（例如 SCC/聚合类），作者如何做一致性校验。
3) 如果全文有实验章节：优先看“随 query depth 的退化曲线”和“seen vs fresh gap”的图表；这两类结果最能服务预训练研究（算法性泛化 vs 记忆）。
4) 关注输入/输出格式：自然语言到 JSON 的约束如何影响模型（格式错误率是否单独统计）；是否提供多种图表述模板以量化“编码选择带来的 tens of points 波动”。
值得深挖的点：把 Ein 这种张量化图算法表达用于数据生成/验证，可能是构造式 benchmark 的一个通用工具链；另外，三轴难度控制很适合做 scaling law 式的“能力曲线拟合”。

summary_en.core_problem: How to measure LLMs’ compositional graph-relational reasoning in a way that is controllable, contamination-resistant, and diagnostically precise—so failures can be attributed to specific logic primitives and composition depth rather than to dataset memorization, brittle string matching, or graph-encoding artifacts.
summary_en.importance:
The contribution is primarily an evaluation asset with strong implications for pretraining research workflows:
- Program-executed ground truth replaces ambiguous text matching, reducing evaluation noise and making errors interpretable.
- Constructive generation yields unlimited fresh instances, enabling explicit seen-vs-fresh comparisons as a practical contamination/memorization probe.
- Three independent difficulty knobs (graph size, edge density, query depth) support targeted stress tests and cleaner attribution: whether breakdown is driven by structural complexity or by compositional depth.
This is useful when studying algorithmic generalization, synthetic data curricula, reasoning-mode post-training effects, and scaling behavior on relational tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ClosureBench is built around “logic primitives + executable semantics + controlled instance generation.”
- Task space: 26 categories derived from explicit graph-relational primitives such as reachability/transitive closure, degree, set operations, connectivity (e.g., SCC-related queries), and aggregation over reachable sets.
- Exact labels: each query is implemented as a short program whose execution yields the reference answer. The paper mentions implementations in Ein (tensor-contraction style graph ops) and an equivalent Python/NetworkX version.
- Constructive generator: instances are produced on demand with separate structural and surface seeds, allowing independent control of graph structure and linguistic realization.
- Difficulty control: three orthogonal axes—number of nodes, edge density, and query depth/compositional level—so evaluators can hold two fixed and sweep the third to localize failure modes.
- Interface: models only see natural-language questions and must output JSON; the underlying program is hidden, keeping the benchmark focused on reasoning rather than program induction from code exposure.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental emphasis is diagnostic profiling rather than leaderboard chasing:
- Evaluation uses programmatic checking against JSON outputs, avoiding string-match brittleness.
- A key intended analysis is the gap between performance on previously seen instances and newly generated ones, used as a direct memorization/contamination signal.
- Difficulty sweeps along size/density/depth are used to identify where performance collapses and how sharply it degrades with compositional depth.
The provided excerpt does not include concrete model-by-model numbers; the most informative results in the full paper are likely depth-scaling curves, heatmaps across the three difficulty axes, and variance analyses across surface realizations/encodings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Reading order that pays off:
1) Benchmark construction section: how primitives are defined, how 26 categories are composed, and how query depth is operationalized.
2) Ground-truth computation details: Ein vs NetworkX equivalence, validation checks, and which primitives are most error-prone.
3) Experimental figures: prioritize (a) accuracy vs query depth curves and (b) seen-vs-fresh gaps; these connect most directly to pretraining questions about memorization vs algorithmic generalization.
4) Input/output protocol: JSON formatting constraints, how format errors are handled, and how surface templates/graph encodings are varied and controlled.
A deeper angle: the Ein-based executable semantics can generalize as a tooling pattern for other constructive benchmarks beyond graphs.

recommendation.zh: 这是少见的“可持续出题+可执行验真”评测，能把数据污染从玄学变成可量化的 gap；先看 memorisation 实验那张表，再决定要不要接入内测。
recommendation.en: A rare eval where fresh-instance generation + executable verification turns contamination from hand-waving into a measurable gap; read the memorization-gap result first, then decide whether to adopt it internally.

paper.title: ComponentBench: Diagnosing Component-Level Failures in Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Current evaluation of computer-use agents is split between long-horizon workflow benchmarks and atomic GUI-grounding tests. This leaves an under-instrumented middle layer: realistic component-centered interactions (e.g., toggle a button set) that are short enough to diagnose and rich enough to capture the burdens of modern interfaces. We present ComponentBench, a benchmark and diagnostic pipeline for component-level evaluation of computer-use agents on modern web UIs. ComponentBench is organized

summary.core_problem: 现有的计算机使用 Agent 评测要么是长程工作流，要么是原子的 GUI 基础测试，缺乏针对现实中组件级交互（如切换按钮组）的诊断性评测。
summary.importance: 填补了 Agent 评测在原子操作与长程任务之间的空白，提出了 ComponentBench，提供了细粒度、组件级的诊断基准，有助于深入分析 Agent 在现代 Web UI 上的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个独立于库的本体，包含 97 种规范 UI 组件，实例化为 2910 个经过程序化验证的任务，跨越广泛使用的组件库。配有清理过的人类参考轨迹，用于评估任务成功率和交互效率。引入了可扩展的管道，用于在实现后审计结构难度，并综合跨任务和组件家族的结构化失败分析。
summary.experiments: 评测了几个现有的 Agent，发现它们在组件级交互上存在显著的失败模式，证明了该基准的诊断价值。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Duke University 和 Amazon AGI SF Lab 的合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of computer-use agents are either long-horizon workflows or atomic GUI-grounding tests, lacking diagnostic evaluation for realistic component-level interactions (e.g., toggling a button set).
summary_en.importance: Fills the gap between atomic operations and long-horizon tasks in agent evaluation by introducing ComponentBench, a fine-grained, component-level diagnostic benchmark that helps deeply analyze agent failure modes on modern Web UIs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a library-agnostic ontology of 97 canonical UI components, instantiated as 2,910 programmatically verified tasks across widely used component libraries. Pairs tasks with cleaned human reference trajectories to evaluate both task success and interaction efficiency. Introduces a scalable pipeline for auditing structural difficulty and synthesizing structured failure analyses across tasks and component families.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates several existing agents, revealing significant failure modes in component-level interactions and demonstrating the diagnostic value of the benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Duke University and Amazon AGI SF Lab.

recommendation.zh: 填补了 GUI Agent 评测中原子操作与长程任务之间的空白，其细粒度的组件级诊断思路对构建更鲁棒的 Web Agent 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Fills the gap between atomic operations and long-horizon tasks in GUI Agent evaluation; its fine-grained component-level diagnostic approach is valuable for building more robust Web Agents.

paper.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
paper.abstract: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题不是提升模型能力，而是重新定义一类更贴近真实使用方式的评测：很多工作场景里，模型并不是直接完成任务，而是给人类或较弱模型提供帮助。现有 benchmark 大多只测 automation，也就是模型独立产出最终结果的能力，却很少测 augmentation，也就是模型能否让另一个执行者做得更好。论文提出 CentaurBench，用统一框架在同一组真实工作任务上同时评估这两种能力，并检验二者是否一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接作用有限，它更偏评测与部署选择。但它有一个值得注意的启发：模型的“自己做得好”与“教别人做得好”不是同一种能力，二者相关性并不高。对于 post-train、teacher model、self-improvement pipeline、decomposition/critique 数据合成，这个结论是有用的，因为很多训练流程默认强模型天然也是好教师。CentaurBench 给出一个更细的视角：指导文本是否适合下游执行者、是否可操作、是否不过载，可能比 assistant 自身上限更重要。若把弱 worker 换成固定 student policy，这个框架也可看作 teacher quality eval。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文构造了一个双模式评测协议。对每个任务和每个候选模型，automation 模式下模型直接完成任务；augmentation 模式下，候选模型只输出 assistance text，由一个固定的低能力 worker model 根据这段帮助文本去完成任务。这样做的关键是把 executor 固定住，从而把最终结果中的差异尽量归因到 assistant 的指导质量，而不是团队里谁更强。评测覆盖 7 类有经济含义的真实工作任务。输出质量通过多位 LLM judge 按任务定制 rubric 做 blind pairwise comparison，并且避免同家族模型评自己家输出。最终得到的是一个按任务和模式分解的 rank matrix，而不是单一总榜。这个设计的核心优点是可比性强：同一任务、同一 worker、同一 judge protocol 下，可以直接比较“直接做”和“辅助别人做”两种能力。局限也很明确：augmentation 的结论依赖所选 worker model，测到的是‘对这个 worker 的帮助能力’，不是对所有人类或所有模型的普适帮助能力。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三点。第一，augmentation 与 automation 的模型排名只中等相关，整体 rank correlation 约为 0.48，说明二者不能互相替代。第二，这个相关性在任务间波动很大，从 travel planning 的 -0.04 到 tax preparation 的 0.85，表明任务结构会显著影响“好执行者”和“好助手”是否重合。第三，帮助并不总是有益。论文提到 GPT-5-mini 在 automation 和 augmentation 两种模式下平均都排第一，但在 augmentation 比较里，不带任何外部帮助、由 GPT-3.5-Turbo 单独完成任务的 worker baseline 反而拿到第二名平均排名。这说明一些 assistant 生成的指导可能过于复杂、和 worker 能力不匹配，或者在任务上校准失当，结果不如不帮。任务级 reversal 也很明显，例如 Claude-Opus-4.8 在 market trends analysis 上是最强 automation 模型之一，平均 rank 2.05，但在同任务 augmentation 上接近最弱，8.15；而 GPT-4.1 在 counseling 上则呈现相反画像。对读者来说，最值得看的不是谁排第一，而是这些 reversal 暗示了什么样的帮助文本更适合弱执行者。
summary.reading_guide: 这是典型的评测论文，泛读即可。先看任务设计和双模式协议，确认 augmentation 是如何 operationalize 的；再看 judge 设计、盲评和排除自评的细节，判断结果可信度；最后看 task-level rank table 和相关性分析。预计 20 到 30 分钟足够。若只关心方法启发，重点看两处：一是固定 worker 的设计为什么能隔离 assistant 质量；二是哪些任务上 automation/augmentation 排名反转最大，这些任务通常更能暴露“会做”和“会教”的差异。若你做 pretrain，这篇不需要深读；若你做 teacher-student、self-play critique、AI delegation eval，可以把它当作一个有用的评测模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation gap rather than a new modeling method. Most LLM benchmarks measure automation: how well a model completes a task by itself. In real deployments, however, models are often used to assist another agent, human or model, rather than replace it. CentaurBench asks a different question: which model most improves the performance of a weaker worker? It builds a unified benchmark that measures both automation and augmentation on the same set of real-world work tasks.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it carries an important lesson for post-training and model-role design. A model that performs well as an autonomous solver is not necessarily a good teacher, coach, or critic for another agent. That matters for teacher-model selection, synthetic supervision pipelines, critique-based training, and delegation settings where a strong model is assumed to be a good guide by default. The benchmark makes that assumption testable. It also suggests that assistance quality depends on calibration to the downstream worker, not just raw model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a two-mode protocol. In automation mode, the focal model completes the task end to end. In augmentation mode, the focal model produces assistance text only, and a fixed lower-capacity worker model uses that assistance to produce the final deliverable. Keeping the worker fixed is the key design choice: it isolates the marginal value of the assistant’s guidance from the executor’s own capability. The benchmark spans seven economically grounded professional tasks. Outputs are evaluated through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel using task-specific rubrics, with family-level exclusions to avoid self-judging. The end product is a task-by-model rank matrix for both regimes rather than a single leaderboard. The main strength of the design is comparability across roles. The main limitation is external validity: augmentation performance is measured relative to one standardized worker, so it captures “helpfulness to this worker” rather than universal helpfulness.
summary_en.experiments: The headline findings are straightforward and useful. First, augmentation and automation rankings are only moderately correlated overall, with a model-level rank correlation of about 0.48. Second, the correlation varies sharply by task, from -0.04 on travel planning to 0.85 on tax preparation, showing that the overlap between being a strong solver and a strong assistant is task dependent. Third, assistance is not always beneficial. The paper reports that GPT-5-mini ranks first on average in both regimes, but in augmentation the unaided worker baseline, where GPT-3.5-Turbo works without any external help, achieves the second-best average rank. That means some assistance harms performance, likely because it is too complex, poorly calibrated, or mismatched to the worker. The task-level reversals are especially informative: for example, Claude-Opus-4.8 is among the strongest direct solvers on market trends analysis with mean rank 2.05, yet among the weakest assistants on the same task with 8.15, while GPT-4.1 shows the opposite profile on counseling.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark design and make sure the augmentation protocol is clear. Then read the judging setup carefully, especially the blind pairwise procedure and the anti-self-judging rule, because the credibility of the results depends on that. After that, go straight to the task-level rank tables and the automation-versus-augmentation correlation analysis. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough. The most useful questions to keep in mind are why fixing the worker isolates assistant quality, and which tasks produce the largest rank reversals. Those reversals are where the benchmark says something substantive about the difference between solving and helping.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你看 agent/eval 的口径：只看 automation 排名已经不够，读实验设计和相关性结果就够了。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining recipe, but it should change how you read agent evaluations: automation-only rankings are insufficient; focus on the protocol and the rank-correlation result.

paper.title: MemFuse: Multi-Source Memory Fusion from Fragmented Observations
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for agents that operate across extended interactions, yet existing memory systems and benchmarks predominantly focus on single-source textual histories. In realistic settings, however, relevant information is often fragmented across applications and devices, as well as across users and time, requiring agents to integrate dispersed observations into coherent episodic memories while preserving their source provenance. To address these gaps, we introduce **MemFuseBench

summary.core_problem: 评估长期交互 agent 如何把来自多个应用、设备、用户和时间点的碎片化观察融合成可追溯的情节记忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory benchmark 加结构化记忆系统。MemFuseBench 把长期记忆评测从单一文本历史扩展到多源证据融合、时间推理和噪声鲁棒性，这对通用 agent 评测有参考价值，但与基座预训练关系间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Scene-to-Sensor pipeline，把可控场景合成为带 source tag 的观察、证据支撑问题和对抗干扰项。方法侧的 MemFuse 保留 source-level evidence，在 event-layer atomic memory 中记录原子事件，并把相关原子记忆组织成更高层结构，以支持跨源融合和 provenance tracking。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、baseline 数字或提升幅度。可确认的是 benchmark 覆盖 temporal reasoning、cross-source evidence fusion 和 noise robustness；完整实验需查看正文中的 agent memory 系统对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Xiaomi Inc 和 Nanjing University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how long-term agents fuse fragmented observations from multiple apps, devices, users, and time points into coherent, provenance-preserving episodic memories.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory benchmark plus a structured memory system. MemFuseBench moves beyond single-source textual histories toward multi-source evidence fusion, temporal reasoning, and robustness to distractors. This is relevant to agent evaluation, though only indirectly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a Scene-to-Sensor pipeline to synthesize controllable scenarios into source-tagged observations, evidence-grounded questions, and adversarial distractors. The proposed MemFuse system keeps source-level evidence in event-layer atomic memories and organizes related atomic memories into higher-level structures for fusion and provenance tracking.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. It states that the benchmark evaluates temporal reasoning, cross-source evidence fusion, and noise robustness; full system comparisons need to be checked in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Xiaomi Inc and Nanjing University.

recommendation.zh: agent memory 评测的设定比单一聊天历史干净；预训练方向只需看数据生成 pipeline 和失败类型定义。
recommendation.en: The agent-memory setup is cleaner than single-chat-history tests; for pretraining, only inspect the data-generation pipeline and failure taxonomy.

paper.title: Solving Is Not Drawing: A Benchmark for Diagrammatic Reasoning in Olympiad Geometry
paper.abstract: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude now solve olympiad-level mathematics with remarkable proficiency, so much so that geometry problem solving has become a standard proxy for their mathematical reasoning. Yet solving a geometry problem and drawing the figure it depends on are not the same skill: progress often hinges on a faithful diagram with the right auxiliary constructions and incidences, and it is unclear that a model which reasons its way to the answer can also produce one. A growing

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要测的不是模型会不会做几何题，而是它能不能构造出解题所依赖的高保真几何图形；现有数学评测大多只看答案，几乎不单独测“画图能力”。
summary.importance: 它属于评测资产贡献。价值不在提升基座模型本身，而在把一个长期被混在“数学推理”里的子能力拆出来：图形构造、辅助线添加、几何关系落图。这对多模态推理、程序化图形生成、以及“会解但不会表征”的能力分解有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个开源 benchmark：954 道自包含的奥数几何题，其中含 297 题 hard 子集；每题配有人类编写的高保真 Asymptote 可渲染图、解答，以及用于评估图形构造质量的配套设置。核心方法不是新模型，而是把 diagram construction 从 answer correctness 中解耦，形成可执行、可比较的评测任务。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可确认的数据规模是 954 题、297 题 hard 子集，并强调与 MathVista、MathVerse 这类只看答案的 benchmark 区分。摘要未给出明确参评模型、参数规模、主结果数字或 SOTA 幅度，因此更适合作为评测资源关注，而不是结果导向的方法论文精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a missing capability in math evaluation: not whether a model can solve olympiad geometry, but whether it can construct the faithful diagram the solution depends on.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. Its value is in separating diagram construction from answer correctness, which matters for multimodal reasoning, programmatic drawing, and capability decomposition in foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an open benchmark of 954 self-contained olympiad geometry problems, including a 297-problem hard subset, each paired with a human-authored high-fidelity Asymptote diagram and solution. The key move is to turn diagram generation into a standalone, renderable, and testable task rather than treating it as latent support for math QA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract confirms the dataset scale (954 total, 297 hard) and positions it against answer-centric benchmarks such as MathVista and MathVerse. It does not provide enough detail on evaluated models, parameter scales, or headline quantitative gains, so this is more useful as an evaluation asset than as a methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 核心线，但把“会做题”和“会构图”拆开这件事是对的；做多模态/程序化表征的人看任务定义即可，正文不必深读。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the capability split is clean: solving geometry is not the same as constructing the diagram; worth knowing if you care about multimodal representation, otherwise just read the task setup.

paper.title: LongNovel: A Multi-Scale Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Long-Context Novel Summarization
paper.abstract: Although context windows have expanded significantly in recent years, hallucinations in long-context summarization remain a challenge. Long novels are better suited than news or papers for researching these hallucinations, due to their intrinsic information and detailed descriptions of events and dialogues. However, current research lacks a multi-scale benchmark for hallucination detection in long-context novel summarization and does not fully explore how hallucinations change as the context gro

summary.core_problem: 构建长篇小说摘要场景下的幻觉检测基准，用于评估模型在 16k 到 100k tokens 长上下文中是否能保持事实一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 贡献。长上下文模型的窗口变大后，摘要幻觉不一定随上下文长度单调改善；小说包含密集人物、事件、对话和跨章节依赖，比新闻或论文摘要更容易暴露实体混淆、情节错配和远距离依赖失败。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LongNovel，一个中英双语、多尺度长上下文幻觉检测基准。数据来自 29 部中文小说和 BookSum 的章节级英文数据；设计 8 类幻觉类型，并结合 Multi-Model Arbitration 与 Entity-Referenced Hallucination Generation 来构造较均衡、较真实的幻觉样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型列表和数值结果。已知基准覆盖中文小说 16k-100k tokens 以及英文 BookSum 章节级样本，重点分析不同上下文长度下的幻觉类型和检测难度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 East China Normal University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a benchmark for hallucination detection in long-novel summarization, targeting factual consistency over 16k to 100k-token contexts.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. Longer context windows do not automatically solve summarization hallucination; novels contain dense entities, events, dialogue, and cross-chapter dependencies that stress models differently from news or scientific papers.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongNovel is a bilingual Chinese-English, multi-scale benchmark. It uses 29 Chinese novels and chapter-level data from BookSum, defines eight hallucination categories, and combines multi-model arbitration with entity-referenced hallucination generation to improve authenticity and label balance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the full evaluated model set or detailed scores. The benchmark spans Chinese novels from 16k to 100k tokens and English BookSum chapters, with analysis focused on hallucination behavior as context length increases.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from East China Normal University.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文摘要评测资产，可看数据构造和错误类型；对预训练方法没有直接动作，不必读模型实验细节。
recommendation.en: A useful long-context evaluation asset; read the data construction and error taxonomy, but it does not directly change pretraining practice.

paper.title: MAVEN: A Macro-Societal Value Evaluation Framework of Multimodal Content with Compact Aligned Evaluators
paper.abstract: Assessing whether multimodal content aligns with macro-societal values, such as peace, justice, and freedom, has become an increasingly urgent challenge. Existing frameworks are largely confined to safety-oriented taxonomies, text-only psychometric probes, or single-label classification. Therefore, we propose MAVEN, a hierarchical framework for macro-societal value evaluation of multimodal content, grounded in international human-rights instruments and cultural value theory. MAVEN organizes valu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：如何系统评估多模态内容是否符合宏观社会价值，而不是只做狭义安全分类或单标签判断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测框架与 benchmark。对 LLM 基座预训练不是核心，但如果你关心多模态 evaluator、judge distillation、价值对齐评测资产，这篇算可备查材料。它更偏应用化评测框架，而不是通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 MAVEN 分层框架，把价值评估组织为 6 个一级维度和 72 个二级指标；构建了人工验证的多模态 benchmark，并设计 soft-match metric 来评估 VLM 在不同价值维度上的判断。为训练 evaluator，作者提出 span-adaptive 的 multi-level preference optimization 做 evaluator distillation；推理时再加一个 training-free 的 multi-role consensus 策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明评测对象覆盖开源和闭源系统，但没有给出模型规模、数据规模和关键数值结果。就定位看，重点在 benchmark + evaluator pipeline，而不是提出新的多模态基座模型。对预训练研究员而言，主要价值在于看其标签体系、metric 设计和 evaluator 压缩思路。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中国科学技术大学、State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition、人民网。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to systematically evaluate whether multimodal content aligns with macro-societal values, rather than only performing narrow safety classification or single-label judgments.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark and evaluation-framework contribution. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it can be a reference if you care about multimodal evaluators, judge distillation, or value-alignment evaluation assets. The work is more application-facing evaluation than general pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAVEN is a hierarchical framework with 6 primary dimensions and 72 secondary indicators. The authors build a human-verified multimodal benchmark and introduce a soft-match metric for evaluating VLM assessments across value dimensions. For evaluator optimization, they propose a span-adaptive variant of multi-level preference optimization for evaluator distillation, plus a training-free multi-role consensus strategy at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says both open- and closed-source systems are evaluated, but it does not provide model scales, dataset sizes, or key quantitative results. By design, the contribution is benchmark plus evaluator pipeline rather than a new multimodal foundation model. For pretraining researchers, the main value is in the taxonomy, metric design, and evaluator compression recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include the University of Science and Technology of China, the State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, and People’s Daily Online.

recommendation.zh: 更像价值对齐评测资产，不是 pretrain 方法；若你做 multimodal judge 或 evaluator distillation，可只看 taxonomy、metric 和蒸馏目标定义。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a value-alignment evaluation asset, not a pretraining paper; if you work on multimodal judges or evaluator distillation, read the taxonomy, metric, and distillation objective only.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, People’s Daily Online

paper.title: The IOL-AI Challenge: An Open Challenge towards Advancing Linguistic Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning in LLMs is overwhelmingly studied in domains that provide a model with rules: mathematics and code. Linguistic puzzles invert this: the solver must first discover the system before reasoning within it. We present the IOL-AI Challenge, an open-science competition run on the unseen problems of the International Linguistics Olympiad (IOL) 2026 Individual Contest, evaluated both automatically and, for the first time, by members of the official IOL Jury under the same rubrics applied to hum

summary.core_problem: 现有“推理”评测过度集中在数学与代码这类规则已给定、可自动验证的领域。论文要解决的是：用一套更贴近“先发现规则、再在规则内推理”的任务来评测模型的语言学归纳推理能力，并提供严格防泄漏的评测流程与人类专家评分。
summary.importance:
这是典型的 eval 资产，对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：
- 它把“结构发现/归纳”从口头目标变成可操作的评测信号，能更敏感地区分模型在分布外语言现象、低资源语言模式、组合泛化上的能力；这类能力往往与预训练数据覆盖、tokenizer 设计、以及是否学到更抽象的表示有关。
- 通过 IOL 2026 未公开新题 + 官方 Jury 评分，显著降低 benchmark leakage 的争议，适合作为持续预训练或 post-train 迭代时的外部回归集。
但它不直接给出预训练方法改进；更多是提供一个“你到底有没有学会从少量证据归纳规则”的压力测试。
summary.technical_approach:
他们组织了 IOL-AI Challenge：以 2026 年 IOL Individual Contest 的未见题作为测试集，设置两条评测线。
- 资源受限赛道：严格算力预算（单张 T4、30 分钟），面向开放模型/系统提交，形成公开 leaderboard。
- 非受限基线：额外评测 15 个前沿闭源/开源模型，在同一套未见题上对比。
- 评分：同时做自动评测与（首次）由 IOL 官方 Jury 按人类参赛同一 rubric 进行人工评分，解决以往仅靠字符串匹配/浅层对齐导致的误判。
- 任务性质：典型 IOL 语言学题要求从给定少量双语对照、词形变化、数字系统、书写系统样例中归纳规则，再完成翻译/生成/解释。评测重点不是“会不会某门语言”，而是能否从稀疏证据中提出一致的假设并应用。
summary.experiments:
关键结论是：闭源前沿模型在该类题上已接近甚至达到人类高水平（文中提到 Claude Opus 4.8 的 Jury 分数相当于金牌水平）；而开源模型整体落后明显，尤其在资源受限设置下大多失败。挑战赛共 731 次提交、46 支队伍。
你提供的全文片段未包含各模型的详细分数表、题目数量、自动评分与 Jury 评分的一致性统计等具体数字；这些通常在结果章节/附录里，精读时应以官方 leaderboard 与论文表格为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看任务与评分协议：题目来源（IOL 2026 未见题）、Jury rubric、自动评分如何做，以及如何处理部分得分（这是这类 benchmark 的关键）。
- 再看结果表：闭源 vs 开源、受限 vs 非受限的差距，以及哪些题型最容易失败（如果有按题型拆分）。
- 如果你关心预训练侧启示，重点找他们对失败案例的分析：是 tokenizer/字符级处理问题、长上下文对齐问题、还是“归纳—验证—修正”的搜索策略问题。读完这些再决定是否值得把它纳入内部回归集。

summary_en.core_problem: Most ‘reasoning’ evaluations focus on domains with explicit rules (math, code). This work builds an evaluation setting where the solver must first infer the underlying linguistic system from sparse evidence and then reason within it, using unseen 2026 International Linguistics Olympiad problems and expert human grading.
summary_en.importance:
It is an evaluation contribution with indirect but real relevance to pretraining research:
- It operationalizes structure discovery / inductive linguistic reasoning as a measurable capability, which is plausibly sensitive to pretraining data coverage, tokenization choices (character/subword handling), and whether the model learns more abstract compositional representations.
- Using genuinely unseen IOL 2026 contest problems plus official Jury grading reduces leakage concerns, making it a cleaner external regression set for continual pretraining or post-training iterations.
It does not propose a new pretraining method; it is a stress test that can reveal where current training pipelines fail to produce robust rule induction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They run the IOL-AI Challenge as an open competition and benchmark.
- Test set: previously unseen problems from the IOL 2026 Individual Contest.
- Two evaluation regimes: (i) a strict compute-budget track (one T4 GPU, 30 minutes) for community submissions and a public leaderboard; (ii) an unconstrained benchmarking of 15 frontier proprietary/open models.
- Scoring: both automatic evaluation and, for the first time in this line of work, grading by official IOL Jury members using the same rubrics as for human contestants, addressing limitations of shallow string-match metrics.
- Task nature: classic IOL puzzles require inferring morphology/phonology/lexicon/number systems/scripts from limited examples and applying the inferred rules to translate or generate new forms; the emphasis is on consistent hypothesis formation and application, not memorized language knowledge.
summary_en.experiments:
Main reported outcomes: proprietary frontier models have largely caught up on these puzzles (they mention Claude Opus 4.8 achieving a Jury score comparable to a gold medal), while open models lag substantially; under strict compute constraints, most resource-limited systems fail. The challenge attracted 731 submissions from 46 teams.
The provided excerpt does not include detailed per-model score tables, number of problems, or agreement statistics between automatic and Jury scoring; those should be taken from the results section/appendix and the official leaderboard.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–40 minutes):
- Start with the evaluation protocol: how the unseen test set is constructed, how Jury grading works, and how partial credit is handled.
- Then read the main results tables contrasting proprietary vs open models and constrained vs unconstrained settings; look for breakdowns by puzzle type if available.
- For pretraining-relevant insight, prioritize error analysis: whether failures are driven by tokenization/orthography handling, context management, or the lack of an effective infer–test–revise search strategy. Use that to decide whether to adopt it as an internal regression benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 读任务设计和受限算力结果即可；它提醒推理评测别只看数学，结构发现能力会被解码策略放大。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and constrained-compute results; it is a useful reminder that structure discovery is not captured by math-only reasoning evals.

paper.title: ASI-Bench: At the Dawn of Artificial Superintelligence
paper.abstract: Artificial superintelligence (ASI) requires AI to move beyond mastering existing knowledge toward exploring the unknown, creating new knowledge, and turning new ideas into verifiable results. However, the capabilities of today's AI systems are still largely built on learning, compressing, and applying existing human knowledge. Accordingly, existing benchmarks primarily test whether AI can produce correct answers based on learned knowledge, or whether it can complete tasks under extensive human g

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要评估的不是模型会不会复述已有知识，而是 AI 能否在科研任务中提出新想法、逐步减少人类方法指导后继续推进，并把想法变成可验证结果。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它把“创新探索”和“自主科学执行”放进同一个项目级评测框架里，而且显式设计了逐步撤去人类方法提示的设置。对做 agent、AI delegation、长期任务评测的人有参考价值；对预训练研究员的价值主要在于它定义了一个更接近开放式科研能力的外部目标。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 ASI-Bench，覆盖 11 个科学领域、60 个 project-level research tasks，由 40 多位专家投入 3.1 万小时制作。评测重点不是单轮问答，而是同一研究项目中不同程度的人类指导条件下，模型能否继续完成探索、设计、执行和验证。也就是说，它把“能力上限”和“对人类脚手架的依赖程度”一起测。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整 leaderboard 数字，但强调 benchmark 的任务粒度是 project-level，且会 progressively withdraw human methodological guidance。实验价值主要在于暴露当前系统在开放式科研、长程自主执行和创新性上的缺口，而不是某个模型小幅领先。若正文完整，重点应看任务构成、评分协议、人与模型协作边界以及失败模式分析。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括清华大学、MIT、哈佛大学、卡内基梅隆大学、密歇根大学、UIUC。属于多校联合的大规模 benchmark 构建，摘要中未明确列出核心知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates not whether models can reproduce known knowledge, but whether AI systems can generate new ideas, continue a research project with progressively less human methodological guidance, and turn ideas into verifiable outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It jointly measures innovative exploration and autonomous scientific execution within the same project-level framework, with explicit withdrawal of human guidance. For pretraining researchers, its value is mostly as an external target for open-ended research capability rather than a direct training contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build ASI-Bench, spanning 11 scientific domains and 60 project-level research tasks, created by 40+ experts with over 31,000 human hours. The benchmark is not about single-turn QA; it evaluates whether systems can keep progressing on the same research project as human methodological scaffolding is reduced. In effect, it measures both capability and dependence on human guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide a full leaderboard, but emphasizes project-level tasks and progressive withdrawal of human methodological guidance. The main experimental value is in exposing current systems’ gaps in open-ended research, long-horizon autonomy, and innovation, rather than in small model-to-model deltas. If reading the paper, focus on task design, scoring protocol, human-AI boundary conditions, and failure analyses.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Tsinghua University, MIT, Harvard University, Carnegie Mellon University, University of Michigan, and UIUC. This is a large multi-institution benchmark effort; the abstract does not clearly identify a single notable senior author.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但它把“科研能力”从知识问答拉到项目级自主执行；做 agent eval 或想定义 long-horizon 外部目标的人，先看任务设计和去脚手架协议。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it reframes research capability from knowledge QA to project-level autonomous execution; if you care about agent eval or long-horizon external targets, read the task design and the guidance-withdrawal protocol.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed through agent harnesses that manage tools, extensions, persistent state, permissions, and external actions. Existing safety benchmarks mainly target individual attack mechanisms or a limited subset of operational settings, making it difficult to compare how safety failures emerge across different harness responsibilities. We present HarnessRisk, a lifecycle oriented benchmark that organizes agent harness safety into six operational phases including

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是“模型会不会被提示注入”这么窄，而是更完整的：当 LLM 作为 agent 部署在真实 harness 中时，安全性到底由哪些生命周期环节共同决定，以及现有评测为什么会系统性漏掉 harness 自身带来的风险。论文把风险面从单次运行时交互，扩展到配置、插件/能力扩展、持久状态写入、高风险动作授权、以及事后恢复六个阶段。核心问题因此变成：在一个带工具、文件、持久记忆和执行环境的 agent 系统里，如何用统一协议评估“任务完成”和“安全约束”之间的张力，并区分风险究竟发生在什么环节。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出新的预训练方法，而在于把 agent 安全评测从“模型层”推进到“模型×harness 联合系统层”。这对后续 pretrain 和 post-train 都有启发。第一，单看模型能力或 utility 指标会高估系统可靠性，说明很多对齐信号并没有穿透到真实部署边界。第二，论文显示不同 harness 会显著改变同一模型的安全排序，这意味着很多“模型安全结论”其实不可脱离执行容器。第三，六阶段框架把持久记忆污染、配置注入、恢复链路受污染这些长期状态问题显式化，这对研究持续学习、memory-augmented agent、tool-use policy learning 的人有参考价值。贡献量级更接近一套结构化 benchmark 和问题分解框架，而不是方法范式上的推进。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有两个关键设计。第一是生命周期分解。作者把 harness 风险拆成六个 operational phases：Harness Configuration、Capability Extension、Runtime Operation、State Persistence、Action Control、Incident Recovery。这样做的好处是把原本混在一起的 agent 失败模式按责任边界重新组织：配置阶段关注连接器、凭据、策略模板是否被不可信输入弱化；能力扩展阶段关注插件安装、更新和权限授予；运行时阶段关注网页、邮件、文档、工具输出中的对抗内容；状态持久化阶段关注短期恶意内容是否被写入长期记忆；动作控制阶段关注支付、部署、删除、OAuth 等高后果动作；恢复阶段关注回滚、轮换凭据、修复状态时是否再次被污染。第二是 benchmark protocol。HarnessRisk 一共 128 个 sandboxed cases，覆盖六个阶段。每个 case 都把一个 benign user objective 和一个嵌入在不可信 workflow artifact 中的 adversarial instruction 配对。agent 在三轮 owner turn 的工作流中完成任务，环境包含 case-specific 文件、工具、持久状态和 mock services，且每次执行都从全新环境开始，禁用真实外网。评测指标不是单一成功率，而是拆成 Utility、Attack Success Rate、Persistence、Detection。这个拆分很关键，因为它允许作者证明“任务做成了”和“系统是安全的”可以同时不成立。论文的评测对象也不是裸模型，而是 deployed model+harness configurations：三种 harness（OpenClaw、Hermes、Nanobot）、六个模型、共 14 个配置。这个设计强调安全是联合属性，不是单模型属性。
summary.experiments: 从全文给出的主结论看，最重要的实验发现有三点。第一，高 utility 可以和高 attack success 并存，说明只看任务完成率会掩盖大量不安全执行。这一点是整篇论文最值得记住的结果，因为它直接否定了“任务做对了所以 agent 足够安全”的常见判断。第二，Harness Configuration 是三种 harness 上最脆弱的阶段。原因不是运行时提示注入更弱，而是配置阶段一旦允许攻击者通过授权工作流操纵安全敏感参数，后续所有边界都会被提前放松。第三，同一模型在不同 harness 上的安全排名会明显变化，说明 harness 的权限模型、状态表示、工具暴露方式、授权上下文会重写模型的风险画像。论文还引入 Persistence 和 Detection 两个维度，前者衡量攻击是否写入长期状态并在后续继续生效，后者衡量系统是否显式识别风险。虽然题面没有给出逐表数字，但从实验设计可知，作者并不是只测一次性越权，而是测“是否留下持久污染”和“是否被系统发现”，这比传统 prompt injection benchmark 更接近真实 agent 运维问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，理解作者为什么认为现有 benchmark 过度集中在 runtime/action，而忽略 configuration、state persistence、recovery。然后看 Problem Formulation 里六阶段定义，这部分决定了 benchmark 的边界条件和威胁模型。真正值得细看的，是 HarnessRisk 的 case 组织方式和四个指标的定义，尤其是 Utility 与 Attack Success Rate 如何同时成立、Persistence 如何判定、Detection 是否依赖显式告警。实验部分建议重点看不同 harness 间的排序变化，以及 Configuration phase 为什么普遍最脆弱。如果时间有限，抓住三件事就够了：六阶段框架、utility 与 safety 解耦、模型安全结论依赖 harness。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking a narrow question like whether an LLM agent resists prompt injection. It asks a broader systems question: when an LLM is deployed through an agent harness, which stages of the harness lifecycle determine safety, and why do existing benchmarks miss a large part of that risk surface? The key problem is to evaluate safety as a joint property of the model and the harness across configuration, capability installation, runtime interaction, persistent state, consequential action approval, and recovery, rather than reducing everything to runtime attacks.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is mainly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper moves agent safety evaluation from the model layer to the deployed model-plus-harness layer. That matters for both pretraining and post-training. First, utility metrics alone can substantially overestimate real safety, which means alignment signals often do not survive the deployment boundary. Second, the same model can have very different safety rankings under different harnesses, so many model-level safety claims are not portable. Third, the benchmark makes long-horizon failure modes explicit, especially persistent memory poisoning and compromised recovery. That is relevant to work on memory-augmented agents, tool-use policies, continual adaptation, and stateful deployment. The contribution is best understood as a structured benchmark and a cleaner decomposition of the problem, not as a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: There are two main technical ideas. The first is lifecycle decomposition. The authors organize harness risk into six operational phases: Harness Configuration, Capability Extension, Runtime Operation, State Persistence, Action Control, and Incident Recovery. This is useful because it re-groups agent failures by harness responsibility. Configuration covers connectors, credentials, gateways, and policy templates; capability extension covers plugin selection, installation, updates, and permissions; runtime operation covers adversarial content in emails, webpages, documents, and tool outputs; state persistence covers whether transient malicious content gets written into durable memory or policy state; action control covers high-impact actions such as payments, deployments, deletions, OAuth grants, and outbound communication; incident recovery covers rollback, credential rotation, state repair, and evidence preservation. The second idea is the benchmark protocol itself. HarnessRisk contains 128 sandboxed cases spanning those six phases. Each case combines a benign user goal with an adversarial instruction embedded in an untrusted workflow artifact. The agent operates through a three-turn owner workflow with case-specific files, tools, persistent state, and mock services. Every run starts from a fresh environment and real network access is disabled. Evaluation is split into Utility, Attack Success Rate, Persistence, and Detection. That separation is important because it allows the benchmark to show that successful task completion and safe execution are not the same thing. The evaluated unit is not a bare model but a deployed model-harness configuration: three harnesses, six models, and fourteen total configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The most important empirical findings are qualitative but strong. First, high utility can coexist with high attack success. That is the central result: task completion alone is a poor proxy for safety. Second, Harness Configuration is the most vulnerable phase across all three harnesses. The reason is not that runtime attacks disappear, but that configuration-time manipulation can weaken security-sensitive parameters before the rest of the workflow even begins. Third, model safety rankings change substantially across harnesses, showing that permissions, state representation, tool exposure, and authorization context materially alter the risk profile of the same underlying model. The benchmark also measures Persistence and Detection, which extends evaluation beyond one-shot unsafe actions to durable compromise and explicit risk recognition. Even without all table values here, the experimental design makes clear that the paper is testing whether attacks remain in long-term state and whether the system notices them, not just whether a single malicious action is triggered.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction and the comparison table that motivates the gap in prior benchmarks. Then read the six-phase definitions in the problem formulation carefully, because they define the benchmark boundary and threat model. The most useful part for a quick pass is the benchmark construction and metric design: how cases are instantiated, how Utility is separated from Attack Success Rate, how Persistence is judged, and what counts as Detection. In the experiments, focus on two things: why configuration is consistently the weakest phase, and how model rankings shift across harnesses. If time is limited, retain three takeaways: the six-phase lifecycle framing, the decoupling of utility from safety, and the dependence of safety conclusions on the harness. A solid skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 Agent 安全评测从单纯的 prompt 注入扩展到了整个系统执行脚手架（harness）的生命周期，对于构建和评估生产级 Agent 系统非常有价值。
recommendation.en: Expands Agent safety evaluation from simple prompt injection to the entire lifecycle of the system execution harness, highly valuable for building and evaluating production-grade Agent systems.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: BEAR-Bench: A Bilingual Enterprise and Academic Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in visual comprehension, their ability to reason about text-dense, professional documents remains incompletely evaluated. Existing benchmarks emphasize information extraction, require external domain knowledge, or cover professional documents only as one of many settings. They are also largely English- or Chinese-centric, leaving other languages and Russian, in particular, substantially underrepresented. To address thes

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态大模型在英文与俄文、文本密集型企业和学术文档上的推理能力，补足现有 benchmark 偏英语/中文、偏信息抽取、缺少专业文档复杂推理的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产贡献。它把关注点从常见图像问答转向文档级、多语言、专业场景下的多模态推理，并且强调自包含问题设计，减少外部知识干扰，更适合测模型对文档内容本身的理解与推理。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 BEAR-Bench：1000 道人工标注题目，覆盖英文和俄文的商业与科学文档。题目基于文本丰富的文档页面，目标不是简单 OCR 或抽取，而是需要跨段落、跨图文元素的推理。作者还利用模型输出比较现有 hallucination detection 方法在该场景下的表现。
summary.experiments: 评测了 16 个闭源和开源 MLLM，包括 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B 等。摘要给出的核心结论是：即便最强模型也仍有明显提升空间，说明文本密集专业文档推理远未解决。摘要未提供更细的分数、误差分解或显著性统计。
summary.authors_note: Yandex 2 Applied AI Institute 团队工作，偏评测与多语言文档理解方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates multimodal models on bilingual, text-dense enterprise and academic documents, addressing the gap left by benchmarks that are mostly English/Chinese, extraction-heavy, and weak on professional document reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It shifts attention from generic VQA toward multilingual, document-level reasoning over professional materials, with self-contained questions that reduce contamination from external knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce BEAR-Bench, a 1,000-question human-annotated benchmark built from English and Russian business and scientific documents. The tasks target reasoning over text-rich pages rather than plain OCR or shallow extraction. They also use model outputs to compare hallucination detection methods in this setting.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate 16 proprietary and open-weight MLLMs, including Gemini 3.1 Pro and Qwen3.5-397B. The main takeaway from the abstract is that even the strongest systems still leave substantial headroom. The abstract does not expose detailed score breakdowns or error analyses.
summary_en.authors_note: From Yandex 2 Applied AI Institute, with a focus on evaluation and multilingual document understanding.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练的人可以把它当文档推理 stress test；价值在题型分布和错误案例，不在 leaderboard 本身。
recommendation.en: Useful as a stress test for multimodal pretraining on document reasoning; the value is in task design and failure modes, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: If, Then, Otherwise: Diagnosing Conditional Branching in Vision-Language Navigation
paper.abstract: Vision-language navigation agents are often evaluated on their ability to follow route-like instructions toward a fixed goal. Yet, real navigation instructions often depend on observed states of the environment: if a condition holds, then follow one path, otherwise take another. Such instructions require an agent to evaluate scene evidence, select the correct logical branch, and execute the corresponding navigation behavior. Existing evaluations provide limited control over conditional branch ex

summary.core_problem: 解决 Vision-Language Navigation 里“条件分支指令”缺乏可诊断评测的问题：现有 VLN 评测很难区分失败是来自感知、grounding、逻辑分支选择还是导航执行。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark / evaluation protocol。它不是提出更强 agent，而是把 conditional branching 这个真实但长期被弱化的能力拆成可控变量，适合分析 VLM/agent 在具身决策中的短板。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CondVLN：基于 3D scene graph 程序化生成条件导航指令，分支条件由可验证谓词 grounding；并系统控制 branch depth、dependency chain length、spatial composition、evidence observability 等因素，从而把逻辑分支执行与感知和导航误差解耦。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明该 benchmark 用于诊断现有 VLN agent 在条件分支上的失败模式，但未给出具体模型名单、样本规模和数值。就预训练研究员而言，价值主要在于评测设计而非结果本身：它提供了一种把“条件执行”从端到端成功率中剥离出来的测量框架。
summary.authors_note: 来自 The University of Texas at Austin 与 Collins Aerospace。Ufuk Topcu 在安全控制、具身智能与决策系统方向有较高知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of diagnostic evaluation for conditional branching in vision-language navigation, where current VLN benchmarks cannot cleanly separate failures in perception, grounding, branch selection, and navigation execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. Rather than proposing a stronger agent, it isolates conditional branching—a realistic but under-measured capability—into controllable factors for analyzing VLM/agent weaknesses in embodied decision making.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces CondVLN, which programmatically generates conditional navigation instructions grounded in verifiable 3D scene-graph predicates. It systematically varies branch depth, dependency chain length, spatial composition, and evidence observability to disentangle logical branching from perception and navigation errors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates that the benchmark is used to diagnose failure modes of existing VLN agents on conditional branching, but it does not provide concrete model lists, dataset size, or numbers here. For a pretraining researcher, the main value is the evaluation design rather than the headline results.
summary_en.authors_note: From The University of Texas at Austin and Collins Aerospace. Ufuk Topcu is well known in control, safe autonomy, and embodied decision-making.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但评测拆因做得对：若你关心 agentic VLM 的真实决策能力，只看 benchmark 设计和错误分解，不必细读模型结果。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the decomposition is the right one: if you care about agentic VLM decision quality, read the benchmark design and error taxonomy, not the model leaderboard.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin
Affiliation:The University of Texas at Austin, Collins Aerospace

paper.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Semantic Task Completion Video Generation, an outcome-oriented video generation task. Under this formulation, success requires both achievement of the intended outcome and semantic grounding. Semantic grounding characterizes the correspondence between the reference image and the generated outcome in terms of high-level semantics relevant to the task. Evaluation focuses on the generated outcome and requires neither the presentation of a complete sequence of intermediate task steps no

summary.core_problem: 如何评测“结果导向”的视频生成：不仅要生成视频，还要完成指令描述的语义任务结果，并与参考图在高层语义上保持对应。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测资产+协议：提出 outcome-oriented 的视频生成任务定义，配套构建评测数据集与基于 VLM 的自动评测流程，补足传统视频生成评测过度依赖外观一致性/逐帧一致性的缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Semantic Task Completion Video Generation 设定：输入参考图+长/短指令，输出“以结果为中心”的视频片段；构建 SemComp-Data（6 个域）并用四阶段可扩展流水线把原始视频转成标准化样本；提出 SemComp-Bench，用 VLM 通过问答/判别方式评估是否达成任务结果与语义落地（abstract 截断，细节以正文为准）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与对比表；可确定的是覆盖六个域的评测数据与一个 VLM-based protocol。是否报告与主流视频生成模型（如 diffusion/DiT 系）对比、以及评测与人评一致性，需要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 机构：University of Science and Technology of China；Sun Yat-sen University。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate outcome-oriented video generation where success means completing the intended semantic task outcome while staying semantically grounded to a reference image.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/dataset contribution: it reframes evaluation from appearance/step consistency to outcome completion + semantic grounding, and provides a dataset plus a VLM-based evaluation protocol.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines “Semantic Task Completion Video Generation” with reference image + detailed/brief instruction and an outcome-centric clip; builds SemComp-Data across six domains via a scalable four-stage curation pipeline; proposes SemComp-Bench using a VLM-driven QA/judging protocol to score outcome achievement and grounding (protocol details are truncated in the provided abstract).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or full baselines; it claims a six-domain evaluation dataset and an automatic VLM-based protocol. Human correlation and comparisons against mainstream video generators need to be checked in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions: University of Science and Technology of China; Sun Yat-sen University.

recommendation.zh: 把视频生成评测从“像不像/稳不稳”拉到“任务结果对不对”，方向对；但 VLM judge 的可靠性与人评一致性不清，先只看协议与一致性实验。
recommendation.en: Good reframing from visual consistency to outcome completion, but the VLM-judge reliability is the make-or-break; skim the protocol and human-agreement sections only.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
paper.abstract: LLM-powered GUI agents that autonomously operate smartphones are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to early real-world deployment. However, because these agents routinely process untrusted environmental content, they are highly vulnerable to environmental injection attacks, which include indirect prompt injections and adversarial instructions. Such attacks can manipulate the behavior of agents without user awareness through diverse channels encountered in everyday mobile use. Despit

summary.core_problem: 评估手机 GUI Agent 在真实 Android 应用中面对环境注入攻击时的安全性，尤其是间接提示注入和伪装成环境内容的恶意指令。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 安全评测资产。它把攻击面从网页或静态任务扩展到移动端日常应用，并用最终系统状态上的风险指标做可程序验证的评估，减少纯 LLM judge 带来的主观性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MobileWorldSafety，包含 142 个基于真实 Android 应用的风险任务。每个任务定义最终系统状态上的 risk indicator，并采用两阶段验证流程：规则验证处理明确案例，后续机制处理规则难以覆盖的情况。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是构造更接近真实手机使用场景的安全评测协议。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整被测模型列表和具体成功率。实验设计围绕真实 Android 应用、142 个风险任务、环境注入攻击通道，以及程序化终态验证展开，用于衡量 GUI Agent 是否在无用户察觉下执行风险行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how LLM-powered mobile GUI agents fail under environmental injection attacks in real Android apps, including indirect prompt injections and adversarial instructions embedded in app content.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an agent-safety benchmark. It moves the threat model from static or web-centric setups to everyday mobile app interactions, and uses final-state risk indicators to make evaluation less dependent on subjective judging.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce MobileWorldSafety with 142 risk tasks built on real Android applications. Each task has a programmatically verifiable risk indicator over the final system state, evaluated through a two-stage pipeline where rule-based checks handle unambiguous outcomes and additional verification covers harder cases.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the full model list or quantitative attack success rates. The evaluation is organized around 142 real-app risk tasks, environmental injection channels, and final-state verification of whether the agent performed unsafe actions.

recommendation.zh: 做 GUI Agent 或安全评测可看任务定义；对 pretrain 直接收益有限，但终态验证设计比单纯 judge 更干净。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for GUI-agent safety work; limited pretraining signal, but the final-state verifier design is cleaner than judge-only evaluation.

paper.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) combine images and text, but when the two conflict and one becomes harder to read, it is unclear how a model shifts its reliance between them. We study this modality reallocation with a controlled setup: we degrade either the image or the text across four levels of legibility while keeping the other clean, and track how the model's preference changes. We build conflicts from GSM8K and SVAMP by pairing the rendered image of one arithmetic problem with the text of ano

summary.core_problem: 当图像与文本冲突且其中一方可读性下降时，VLM会如何在两种模态之间重新分配依赖。
summary.importance: 属于VLM行为分析+小型benchmark（冲突构造与likelihood margin指标）；对多模态预训练的“模态权重/对齐信号”有间接启发，但规模不大。
summary.technical_approach: 构造冲突样本：把一道算术题的图像渲染与另一道题的文本配对；分别对图像或文本做四档可读性退化，观察模型答案与length-normalized条件对数似然margin如何变化；并提出ChartQA-Conflict（229条人工复核的chart-report冲突，含chart与table-image匹配表示）。
summary.experiments: 评测6个开源权重VLM；在GSM8K/SVAMP冲突设置下，5/6模型对文本退化更敏感（更快从文本转向图像）；在ChartQA-Conflict上，所有用likelihood评分的模型出现相应偏移趋势。摘要未给出具体模型名单与显著性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How VLMs reallocate reliance between image and text when the two conflict and one modality becomes less legible.
summary_en.importance: Behavioral analysis plus a small conflict benchmark and a likelihood-margin metric; indirectly informative for multimodal pretraining/alignment, but limited in scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: Create conflicts by pairing the rendered image of one math problem with the text of another; degrade either image or text across four legibility levels; track answer changes and a length-normalized conditional log-likelihood margin; introduce ChartQA-Conflict (229 manually reviewed chart-report conflicts with matched chart and table-image representations).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates six open-weight VLMs; on GSM8K/SVAMP conflicts, 5/6 shift away from degraded text more than from degraded images; on ChartQA-Conflict, all likelihood-scored models show the corresponding shift. Specific model list and significance details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为“模态冲突+可读性退化”的探针还算干净；只看likelihood margin定义和ChartQA-Conflict构造，别指望给出训练层面的因果解释。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean probe via modality conflict + legibility degradation; read the likelihood-margin metric and ChartQA-Conflict construction, but don’t expect causal training takeaways.

paper.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems
paper.abstract: Agentic applications are shifting AI serving from isolated model inference to long-running workloads in which LLMs coordinate tools, environments, and persistent state. However, the system behavior of these workloads---where latency, cost, and bottlenecks arise---remains poorly characterized, leaving serving systems to rely on assumptions built for conventional inference. We present AgentSysBench, a benchmark suite and measurement toolkit with ten representative agentic applications and unified

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 agentic workload 的系统画像缺失问题。传统 LLM serving 大多把一次请求视为一次相对独立的模型推理，优化重点放在 batch、KV cache、并发和 GPU 利用率上。但真实 agent 应用不是这样运行的：一次任务往往包含多轮模型调用、工具执行、浏览器或沙箱交互、检索、状态持久化，以及长时间挂起后的恢复。论文关心的核心问题是，当服务对象从“单次推理”变成“长生命周期、带工具、带环境、带状态的会话”时，系统瓶颈到底在哪里，哪些旧假设失效了，以及 serving 系统应该围绕什么新对象来设计。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型基础设施和训练后系统设计有现实意义。很多研究默认模型推理仍是主成本中心，因此优化方向天然偏向模型侧；这篇论文用统一测量表明，在 agent 场景里，工具、环境、状态管理和跨组件通信经常占据主要延迟与成本，模型只是其中一环。这个结论会反过来影响几个研究方向：一是 post-train 时如何构造更贴近真实部署的 agent 任务；二是如何评估“更强模型”是否真的带来端到端收益，因为更强 reasoning 可能被工具链瓶颈吞掉；三是 serving 研究不能只做 token-level 优化，而要处理异构资源调度、会话状态生命周期和请求级自适应。对做 RL agent、tool-use、长期任务执行的人，这篇工作提供了比较扎实的系统侧基线。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AgentSysBench，一个 benchmark suite 加 measurement toolkit，再配一个可控的模块化 serving stack。基准包含 10 类代表性 agent 应用，覆盖预定义控制流和 LLM 驱动控制流、不同工具/环境交互模式，以及长时有状态执行。测量层统一记录 LLM 调用、工具调用和状态操作，采集延迟拆分、资源使用、数据移动、在线状态占用、token 行为和成本。系统层把 LLM、embedding 模型、向量库、沙箱、浏览器/GUI 环境、搜索服务和工具服务器拆成可独立部署或共置的组件，用来研究资源配置和组件放置对性能的影响。实验方法上，作者结合受控实验和生产 trace：前者固定应用、模型、请求和部署条件，便于定位因果；后者用于观察真实流量下 synthetic benchmark 看不到的现象。论文的关键贡献不是提出某个新调度算法，而是先把 agent serving 的工作负载结构测清楚，并据此总结出六类区别于传统 LLM inference 的系统性质。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖面较大：受控实验包含 4,641 个 benchmark 请求、64,924 次 LLM 调用、118,274 次工具调用；生产侧分析了单日 178,799 个 session。主要结果有六点。第一，agent 执行是重型且有状态的，在 10 个应用里有 5 个是工具或环境延迟主导，说明只优化模型推理无法触及主要瓶颈。第二，跨组件异构性很强，同一应用会同时包含 GPU-bound 的 LLM、memory-bound 的向量库、CPU-bound 的沙箱、network-bound 的外部服务；即便共享同一组件，不同任务的延迟也可相差 32 倍，单队列容易产生严重 head-of-line blocking。第三，瓶颈会随请求、模型、工具和部署变化而移动，连简单 RAG 流水线都可能在不同输入下在 embedding 与向量检索之间切换主瓶颈，因此基于平均值的静态优化不够。第四，生产环境里存在大量 idle-but-live 会话，任务在步骤间可能等待数分钟到数小时，但仍持有对话状态、工具状态和环境状态；如果把它们当活跃任务，会浪费内存和磁盘，如果当作结束任务，又会丢失可恢复性。第五和第六点从摘要可见还涉及跨请求冗余、控制面开销等现象，核心结论是一致的：agent serving 的主要问题已经从“如何更快生成 token”扩展为“如何协调模型、工具、状态和通信”。论文没有给出一个统一数字式提升，而是给出一组足够具体的系统事实，帮助后续工作判断该优化哪里。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看三块。先看 workload 定义和 10 个应用的覆盖范围，确认 benchmark 是否代表你关心的 agent 类型。再看六个主要发现对应的图表，尤其是 latency breakdown、资源画像、head-of-line blocking 和 idle-but-live session 的分析，这几张图基本决定了论文的价值。最后看 serving stack 的模块化设计，理解作者如何把组件拆开做 placement 和 provisioning 实验。预计 30 分钟左右能抓住主线。如果只关心系统启发，不必细读每个应用细节；如果你在做 agent infra 或 RL environment，建议多看生产 trace 部分，因为很多关键现象——长时间挂起、状态滞留、跨请求重复工作——只有在真实流量里才明显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a systems question that standard LLM serving abstractions no longer capture well. Conventional serving treats a request as mostly isolated model inference and optimizes around batching, KV cache, concurrency, and GPU utilization. Agentic applications behave differently: a single task may involve many model calls, tool invocations, browser or sandbox interaction, retrieval, persistent state updates, and long idle intervals before resumption. The core problem is to characterize where latency, cost, and bottlenecks actually arise once the unit of execution shifts from one-shot inference to long-lived, stateful, tool-using sessions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research infrastructure and post-training deployment. A common assumption is that model inference remains the dominant cost center, so optimization should stay model-centric. The paper shows that this assumption often fails in agentic settings: tools, environments, state management, and cross-component communication can dominate end-to-end latency and cost. That has downstream implications for several research areas. It affects how post-train agent tasks should be constructed if we want them to reflect deployment reality. It also changes how we interpret model improvements, since stronger reasoning may not translate into proportional end-to-end gains when the bottleneck sits elsewhere. For serving research, it argues that token-level optimization is necessary but insufficient; heterogeneity-aware scheduling, session-state lifecycle management, and per-request adaptation become first-class concerns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgentSysBench, which combines a benchmark suite, a measurement toolkit, and a modular serving stack. The benchmark includes ten representative agentic applications spanning predefined versus LLM-driven control flow, different tool and environment interaction patterns, and long-running stateful execution. The instrumentation layer records LLM calls, tool invocations, and state operations, collecting latency breakdowns, resource usage, data movement, live state footprint, token behavior, and cost. The serving stack decomposes the system into separately deployable or co-locatable components: LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, sandboxes, browser or GUI environments, search services, and tool servers. This allows controlled experiments on provisioning and placement rather than treating the serving stack as fixed. Methodologically, the paper combines controlled experiments with production traces. The controlled side isolates application, model, request, and deployment variables; the production side exposes behaviors that synthetic workloads often miss. The contribution is therefore not a new scheduler or cache design, but a careful workload characterization that identifies six system properties distinguishing agentic workloads from conventional LLM inference.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical coverage is substantial: 4,641 benchmark requests, 64,924 LLM calls, and 118,274 tool calls in controlled experiments, plus 178,799 production sessions from a single day. The main findings are sixfold. First, agent execution is heavyweight and stateful, and in 5 of 10 applications tools or environments dominate or co-dominate latency, so model-only optimization leaves much of the end-to-end path untouched. Second, the stack is highly heterogeneous: a single application may combine GPU-bound LLMs, memory-bound vector databases, CPU-bound sandboxes, and network-bound external services. Even tasks sharing one component can differ by up to 32x in latency, which makes single-queue scheduling prone to severe head-of-line blocking. Third, bottlenecks shift across requests, models, tools, and deployments; even a simple RAG pipeline can move its dominant cost between embedding and vector-database operations depending on the input, so static average-based optimization is inadequate. Fourth, production traces reveal many idle-but-live sessions that wait minutes to hours between steps while still holding conversational, tool, and environment state. Treating them as active wastes resources; treating them as finished loses resumability. The remaining findings, as indicated in the abstract, concern phenomena such as cross-request redundancy and control-plane overhead.
