paper.title: Beyond Final Scores: A Systematic Evaluation of Agents for Long-Horizon AI Research and Development
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of improving models, systems, and other technical artifacts through long-horizon experimentation. To understand the current state of this capability, however, evaluation must go beyond final scores, which neither reveal where progress is gained or lost nor indicate whether accumulated experience improves later decisions. We therefore present a systematic evaluation of seven frontier models on 36 long-horizon tasks based on a new framework that uses rule

summary.core_problem: 现有长周期AI研发Agent评测仅依赖最终得分，无法定位过程中的能力得失，也无法衡量经验积累对后续决策的提升效果。
summary.importance: 提出首个聚焦长周期研发任务过程性表现的Agent评测框架，系统刻画了当前前沿模型在自主研发场景下的真实能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 设计覆盖方案构建、执行、反馈控制三个阶段的规则化过程指标，对7个前沿模型在36个长周期研发任务上的run内行为、跨run/跨任务经验复用能力开展受控对比评测。
summary.experiments: 覆盖7个主流前沿模型、36个长周期AI研发任务，发现当前Agent更接近工程优化器而非自主研究员：性能波动大，最优解多为已有技术的适配组合，缺乏真正的原创研究与跨任务经验迁移能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluations of long-horizon AI R&D agents rely solely on final scores, failing to localize capability gaps during execution or measure how accumulated experience improves subsequent decisions.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first process-focused evaluation framework for long-horizon R&D agents, systematically characterizing the actual capability boundary of current frontier models in autonomous research scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs rule-based process metrics across three phases (solution framing, execution, feedback control), conducts controlled comparisons of in-run behavior and cross-run/cross-task experience reuse for 7 frontier models on 36 long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 7 leading frontier models on 36 long-horizon R&D tasks, finding current agents behave more like engineering optimizers than autonomous researchers: performance is highly variable, top solutions mostly adapt or combine existing techniques, with little genuine original research or cross-task experience transfer.

recommendation.zh: 长周期研发Agent过程评测，核心结论是现有模型仅能组合已有技术，无自主原创研究能力，作为能力边界参考即可。
recommendation.en: Process-focused evaluation of long-horizon R&D agents showing current models only combine existing techniques without genuine research capability, useful as a capability boundary reference.

paper.title: Do LLMs Beat Nash? Testing Decentralized Coordination in Self-Play Multi-Agent Games
paper.abstract: Large language model agents deployed without a central controller are often assumed to require communication to coordinate their actions. We ask what remains possible without it: when independent instances of the same model cannot communicate, can they still reason about their counterparts well enough to exceed the standard game-theoretic baseline for uncoordinated play? We introduce a benchmark of one-shot, no-communication games in which each of thirteen language models is told only that its c

summary.core_problem: 检验无通信条件下，独立运行的同一 LLM 实例能否在一次性多智能体博弈中超过 Nash 均衡这一标准去中心化基线。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是一个针对 LLM 去中心化协调能力的评测设置。它不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解模型是否内化了“他者也是同模型”的推理先验有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 one-shot、no-communication 的多智能体博弈基准，覆盖 2 人矩阵博弈的 7 类 archetype、每方 2 到 10 个动作，并扩展到 4 人以上的 team-based games。评测 13 个语言模型，只告知每个 agent 其对手/队友运行相同模型，然后将表现与底层博弈的 Nash 均衡及最优联合结果比较。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示有两个 frontier-hosted 模型能稳定超过 Nash 基线，并在若干博弈类型上接近联合最优；多数开源模型只有部分收益，且对博弈结构敏感。随着交互体数量增加到 4 人以上，性能明显下降。没有预训练数据、参数规模或训练 recipe 细节，重点在评测现象。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether independent instances of the same LLM can outperform the Nash equilibrium baseline in one-shot multi-agent games without communication.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is as an evaluation setup for decentralized coordination in LLM agents. It does not advance pretraining directly, but it probes whether models internalize a useful prior about identical counterparts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a benchmark of one-shot, no-communication games spanning seven two-player matrix-game archetypes with 2–10 actions per player, plus larger team-based games. Thirteen LLMs are evaluated under the prompt that all counterparts run the same model, and results are compared against Nash equilibrium and optimal joint outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, two frontier-hosted models consistently beat the Nash baseline and approach joint optima in several game types, while most open-weight models show only partial gains and strong dependence on game structure. Performance drops substantially in team games with four or more interactants. No pretraining-scale details are provided; the contribution is mainly evaluative.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但评测设定干净，能测出模型是否学到“同模型他者”先验；看任务设计和失败案例就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup is clean enough to probe whether models learned a same-model counterpart prior; read the benchmark design and failure cases, not every table.

paper.title: Unified Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Complex Graph Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Graph reasoning provides a promising testbed for evaluating the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), as graph instances can be programmatically generated, structurally controlled, and naturally scaled to long-input settings. However, existing graph reasoning benchmarks have limited coverage of data complexity, rely heavily on manual construction, and lack unified evaluation across text-based and code-based reasoning modes. To address these limitations, we propose {\dataset}, a five

summary.core_problem: 构建一个覆盖多维复杂度的图推理 benchmark，用于评估 LLM 在文本推理和代码推理模式下的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测框架。图推理可以程序化生成、控制结构复杂度，并自然扩展到长输入，因此适合作为 reasoning 和 long-context 的可控探针。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出五阶段半自动构建流程，沿 Graph Size、Task Complexity、Task Description、Graph Loading、Task Source 五个维度扩展样本；用 LLM 生成任务描述、图数据、参考解、加载脚本、问题形式和评测脚本，并在关键质量节点加入人工验证。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 规模、评测模型列表或分数。实验设计强调同时覆盖 text-based reasoning 与 code-based reasoning，以统一比较模型在不同解题接口下的图结构推理能力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Pennsylvania State University 和 Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute；无法从给定信息确认知名作者或团队代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds a multi-dimensional graph-reasoning benchmark for evaluating LLMs under both text-based and code-based reasoning modes.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a benchmark and construction framework. Graph reasoning is attractive because instances can be generated programmatically, structurally controlled, and scaled to long-input regimes, making it a useful probe for reasoning and long-context behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a five-stage semi-automatic pipeline that varies Graph Size, Task Complexity, Task Description, Graph Loading, and Task Source. An LLM generates task descriptions, graph data, reference solutions, loading scripts, question variants, and evaluation scripts, with human validation at key quality checkpoints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report benchmark size, model list, or numeric results. The evaluation is designed to compare text-based and code-based graph reasoning within a unified framework.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Pennsylvania State University and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute; no notable author or prior team signal is available from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 图推理可控生成是干净评测方向，但又是 benchmark 工程；看五维度生成流程即可。
recommendation.en: Controlled graph generation is a clean evaluation direction, but this is mostly benchmark engineering; the five-axis construction pipeline is the part to inspect.

institutions: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Troy, NY, US

paper.title: Edit2TikZ: A Comprehensive and Challenging Benchmark for Scientific Figure Editing with TikZ
paper.abstract: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown substantial potential in visual understanding and graphic code generation, editing scientific figures through code presents a greater challenge: a model must jointly recover visual structure, ground the requested change, generate compilable code, and preserve all unrelated content. While existing TikZ benchmarks mainly focus on figure reconstruction and generation, few systematically evaluate instruction-guided scientific figure editin

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评测 MLLM 通过 TikZ 代码进行科学图形指令编辑能力的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 和评测协议。它覆盖视觉结构恢复、编辑请求定位、可编译代码生成和无关内容保持，比单纯 TikZ 重建更接近真实科研图形编辑。对 VLM/code 模型评估有价值，但与基座预训练方法本身距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: Edit2TikZ 包含 1,548 个高质量样本，结合真实世界与受控合成编辑案例。任务支持文本定位请求和视觉定位请求，并包含多步编辑及 step-level annotations。作者还构建了人类对齐的评估框架，用来同时衡量 requested edit 是否完成，以及未被要求修改的内容是否被保留。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出被评估模型列表和数值结果。实验应评测当前 MLLM 在科学图形编辑中的能力，包括视觉理解、TikZ 代码生成、编译成功率、编辑完成度和内容保持。
summary.authors_note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on instruction-guided scientific figure editing through TikZ code.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. It tests visual-structure recovery, edit grounding, compilable code generation, and preservation of unrelated content, going beyond existing TikZ reconstruction tasks. It is useful for VLM and code-model evaluation, but it is not directly about foundation-model pretraining methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Edit2TikZ contains 1,548 high-quality samples combining real-world and controlled synthetic edit cases. It supports both textual and visual localization requests, includes multi-step editing, and provides step-level annotations. The evaluation framework is designed to be human-aligned, measuring both whether the requested edit is completed and whether irrelevant content is preserved.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the full model list or numerical results. The evaluation likely covers current MLLMs on visual understanding, TikZ code generation, compilation success, edit completion, and preservation of unedited content.
summary_en.authors_note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM-code 评测资产知道即可；任务很细，除非关心图形代码生成，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Good to know as a VLM-code evaluation asset; the task is narrow, so skip the full paper unless figure-code generation matters.

paper.title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value,

summary.core_problem: 现有前沿LLM在高阶数学推理任务上表现接近人类水平，但在最基础的数值任务（大数量级比较、大整数加法、基础分数运算、科学计数法操作）上存在系统性失效。已有研究多将这类问题归为高阶数学推理能力不足的附属表现，未将基础数感作为独立研究对象，缺乏统一分析框架区分基础数感与高阶数学推理，也没有系统梳理数感失效的模式、根因与改进路径。
summary.importance: 数感缺陷的根源来自预训练阶段的基础设计选择，包括tokenizer构造、训练数据中的数值表示方式、模型原生的算法执行能力，这些问题无法仅靠SFT/RL阶段刷高阶数学benchmark解决。提出的二维接地框架可以帮助研究者在改进定量能力时，区分是表示层缺陷还是过程层缺陷，避免干预方向错位——只针对高阶推理做优化，却没有修复底层数值处理的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出数值接地框架（Numerical Grounding Framework, NGF），将数值能力拆解为两个正交维度：表示接地（Representational Grounding, RG），即数字表面形式到内部表示的映射能可靠保留序关系、量级大小、不同格式的等价性；过程接地（Procedural Grounding, PG），即算术操作的执行过程与输出符合数学定义。基于该框架，工作系统梳理了8个与LLM数感相关的研究方向，整理了评测体系从GSM8K、MATH这类饱和的高阶数学基准，向NumericBench、Number Cookbook、GSM-Symbolic等新一代诊断性数值基准演进的脉络，将典型数值失效归为四类：对问题表面表述的脆弱性、Tokenizer引入的伪影、长度泛化失败、算法不对称性，并逐类对应分析架构、数据、训练流程层面的根因与已验证的缓解方案。
summary.experiments: 作为综述类工作，未开展新的大规模模型训练实验，核心贡献是对现有实证结果做结构化整合：已公开的测试显示，前沿模型会稳定出现9.11>9.9这类基础量级比较错误，大整数加法精度随数字位数增加快速下跌，基础数感能力随模型规模的scaling效应极弱——参数规模增长不会自然带来基础数值处理能力的可靠提升。现有干预手段中，调整数字的tokenization策略、显式构建数值内部表示、过程监督对过程接地类失效有可测量的改善，但表示接地类失效目前尚无通用解决方案。
summary.reading_guide: 该工作为综述体裁，无需逐字通读。重点关注第3章的NGF框架定义、失效模式分类，以及根因与改进方案的映射关系，核心内容约1小时可读完。无需花费时间在罗列相关工作的部分，重点关注其中提到的Tokenizer对数字的拆分影响、基础数感不随模型规模有效scaling的实证结论，这些内容对预训练阶段的tokenizer设计、数据构造有直接参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Frontier LLMs achieve near-human performance on high-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks but systematically fail on elementary numerical tasks including magnitude comparison, large-integer addition, fraction arithmetic, and scientific notation operations. Existing work treats these failures as secondary side effects of poor general mathematical reasoning, and does not treat basic numeracy as a distinct research object. No unified analytical framework exists to separate basic numeracy from high-level mathematical cognition, or to systematically map failure modes, root causes, and mitigation paths.
summary_en.importance: These numeracy failures trace back to fundamental pretrain design choices including tokenizer construction, numeric representation in training data, and the model's native capacity for algorithmic execution—issues that cannot be resolved by post-training on advanced math benchmarks alone. The proposed two-dimensional grounding framework helps researchers disentangle representational flaws from procedural flaws when improving quantitative capability, avoiding misaligned interventions that target high-level reasoning while leaving primitive numeric processing unaddressed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeric competence into two orthogonal dimensions: Representational Grounding (RG), the faithful mapping from surface numeral forms to internal representations that preserve ordering, magnitude, and format equivalence; and Procedural Grounding (PG), the faithful execution of arithmetic procedures consistent with formal mathematical definitions. Using NGF as an organizing lens, the work synthesizes eight related research strands, traces the evaluation shift from saturated high-level math benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) to new diagnostic numeracy benchmarks (NumericBench, Number Cookbook, GSM-Symbolic, etc.), categorizes numeracy failures into four classes (fragility to surface phrasing, tokenization artifacts, length generalization failure, algorithmic asymmetry), and maps each failure class to architectural, data, and training root causes alongside documented mitigation strategies.
summary_en.experiments: As a research synthesis, the work does not report new large-scale model training results. It consolidates existing empirical findings: frontier models routinely produce magnitude comparison errors such as claiming 9.11 > 9.9, large-integer addition accuracy degrades rapidly with digit length, and basic numeracy exhibits very weak scaling with model size—increasing parameter count does not reliably improve primitive numeric processing. Among documented interventions, adjusted numeric tokenization, explicit internal numeric representations, and process supervision show measurable effects on PG failures, while no general solution exists for RG failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a structured review; close line-by-line reading is not required. Focus on the NGF definition, failure mode taxonomy, and the mapping between root causes and mitigation strategies in Section 3. Core content can be covered in roughly one hour. Skip exhaustive listings of tangentially related work, and pay specific attention to documented effects of tokenizer digit splitting and the weak scaling of basic numeracy, as these carry direct implications for pretraining data and tokenizer design.

recommendation.zh: 把数值能力拆解为表征接地和过程接地两个维度，覆盖tokenizer、预训练数据分布的影响，做预训练数据或tokenizer设计的重点看§3的NGF框架和失败模式梳理。
recommendation.en: Decomposes numeracy into representational and procedural grounding, covering tokenizer and pretraining data distribution effects. Teams working on pretraining data or tokenizer design should focus on §3 for the NGF framework and failure mode review.

paper.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
paper.abstract: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system. While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability. In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design

summary.core_problem: 现有模型-Harness系统是静态的，无法对齐人类设计先验、通过经验积累实现递归自改进，难以支撑长程智能体设计任务。
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，提出元Harness优化的长程智能体设计框架，配套发布论文转海报任务的评测数据集PosterBench。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AutoDesign框架：元Harness优化器基于rollout反馈，引导代码Agent递归优化Harness系统，使其对齐人类设计先验并积累可复用经验；以学术论文转海报任务为实例，构建包含100篇跨学科论文的PosterBench主赛道与10篇的受控评测子集PosterBench-mini。
summary.experiments: 在PosterBench主赛道上AutoDesign得分78.32，超过闭源商业系统，摘要未披露更多baseline模型、评价维度细节与统计显著性结果。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未完整披露，暂无公开知名核心作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing model-harness systems are static, unable to align with human design priors or achieve recursive self-improvement through experience accumulation, making them unsuitable for long-horizon agentic design tasks.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation + data contribution that proposes a meta-harness optimization framework for long-horizon agentic design, along with the PosterBench evaluation dataset for the paper-to-poster generation task.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the AutoDesign framework: A meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve the harness system based on rollout feedback, aligning it with human design priors and accumulating reusable experience; For instantiation and evaluation, builds PosterBench (100 cross-disciplinary papers for the main track) and PosterBench-mini (10-paper subset for controlled evaluation) for the academic paper-to-poster task.
summary_en.experiments: AutoDesign achieves a score of 78.32 on the PosterBench main track, outperforming closed-source commercial systems; more baseline models, evaluation dimension details and statistical significance results are not disclosed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliation information is not fully disclosed; no publicly well-known core authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 特定任务的Agent Harness优化工作，仅作领域文献备查，无预训练相关直接价值。
recommendation.en: Task-specific agent harness optimization work, only for domain literature reference, no direct pretraining-related value.

paper.title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form.   We introduce Apodex Discovery,

summary.core_problem: 现有AI评测体系无法衡量面向开放未知问题的发现式能力——即从模糊的真实目标出发，自主完成问题拆解、环境交互、结论验证、方案迭代，最终产出此前未知的新发现的能力，也缺乏支撑这类能力运行和评测的基础设施框架。
summary.importance: 指出了当前基准体系的能力边界缺口：现有静态问答、窄域交互基准只能衡量在明确给定任务、工具、成功标准条件下的解题能力，无法覆盖真实世界中最重要的开放探索类任务。提出的四组件框架为下一代面向长周期复杂任务的AI系统设计和对应的评测方案构建提供了结构化参考，也为基础模型能力从“解题”向“发现”迭代的方向提供了清晰的问题拆解。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Apodex Discovery框架，将发现式AI的核心执行单元定义为重型求解器（heavy-duty solver），这类求解器的运行需要四类基础设施支撑：一是问题表述模块，将模糊的人类开放目标转化为明确的目标、约束、假设、成功标准；二是真实环境模块，提供求解所需的数据、工具、算力、实验接口、人类交互通道；三是验证机制，同时支持结果校验和过程校验，对中间结论和最终产出的正确性、相关性做可复现的验证，支持盲轨迹审核；四是修复循环，将计算结果、实验反馈、外部评估、人类判断的信号回传给求解器，支撑失败定位、假设修正、方案迭代。配套构建TRACES真实基准，将单元分析对象从单步答案、单任务成败扩展到完整的发现迭代全流程。
summary.experiments: 框架层面明确对比了两类现有基准的核心局限：静态问答类基准（MMLU、GPQA、MATH、FrontierMath等）仅衡量固定提示到正确答案的映射能力，没有持久环境、外部动作、状态演化和失败反馈；窄域交互类基准（SWE-bench、WebArena、OSWorld、τ-bench等）虽提供可执行环境，但任务边界明确，仅以最终二值成功信号为指标，不评估问题拆解质量、证据溯源、备选方案考虑、验证后修复等发现流程的核心能力。目前公开内容未给出TRACES基准的具体任务设计和量化实验结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有评测体系局限性的分析、四个核心基础设施组件的定义，不需要深入细节。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。适合关心AI长期能力方向、下一代评测设计的研究者快速了解框架思路，当前工作仍处于概念提出阶段，缺少充分的实验验证和具体实现细节，暂不需要深挖。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI evaluation systems cannot measure discoverative capability: the ability to start from an ambiguous real-world goal, autonomously decompose problems, interact with environments, verify claims, iterate on approaches, and produce genuinely novel findings that were not previously known. A structured infrastructure framework to support and evaluate this class of capability is also missing.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a clear gap in the current benchmark ecosystem: existing static QA and narrow-domain interactive benchmarks only measure problem-solving ability when tasks, tools, and success criteria are fully specified, and cannot cover the open-ended exploration tasks that represent many of the most consequential real-world applications of AI. The proposed four-component framework provides a structured reference for designing next-generation AI systems for long-horizon complex tasks and building corresponding evaluation protocols, and gives a clear decomposition of the requirements for advancing foundation model capabilities from "solving given problems" to "making new discoveries".
summary_en.technical_approach: The Apodex Discovery framework defines the core operational unit of discoverative AI as a heavy-duty solver, which relies on four supporting infrastructure components: 1. Problem formulation, which translates ambiguous open human goals into explicit objectives, constraints, assumptions, and success criteria; 2. Reality-based environments, which provide access to data, tools, compute, experimental interfaces, and human interaction channels required for problem solving; 3. Verification mechanisms that support both outcome and process verification, producing reproducible checks of the correctness and relevance of intermediate claims and final outputs, with support for blind trajectory auditing; 4. Repair loops that feed signals from computation, experiment feedback, external evaluation, and human judgment back to the solver to support failure localization, hypothesis revision, and approach iteration. The accompanying TRACES reality benchmark shifts the unit of analysis from individual answers or single-task success/failure to full end-to-end discovery iteration episodes.
summary_en.experiments: At the framework level, the work clearly articulates core limitations of two existing benchmark families: static QA benchmarks (MMLU, GPQA, MATH, FrontierMath, etc.) only measure the ability to map fixed prompts to correct answers, with no persistent environment, external action, state evolution, or failure feedback; narrow interactive benchmarks (SWE-bench, WebArena, OSWorld, τ-bench, etc.) provide executable environments but have tightly bounded task definitions, rely only on final binary success signals, and do not evaluate core discovery process capabilities such as problem decomposition quality, evidence grounding, consideration of alternative approaches, and repair after verification feedback. The publicly available content does not include specific task designs or quantitative experimental results for the TRACES benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim is sufficient. Focus on the introduction’s analysis of limitations in existing evaluation systems and the definition of the four core infrastructure components; no deep dive into implementation details is needed. Estimated reading time is 15-20 minutes. The framework is a useful reference for researchers focused on long-term AI capability directions and next-generation evaluation design, but the work is currently at the conceptual stage with limited experimental validation and concrete implementation details, so no deep follow-up is required at this point.

recommendation.zh: 把发现型 AI 评测从解题推向长程真实调查，问题集和 environment 抽象值得看；对预训练的直接价值在 long-horizon 评测设计，读问题集和抽象定义两节即可。
recommendation.en: Pushes discoverative-AI evaluation from problem-solving toward long-horizon real-world investigation; the problem set and environment abstraction are worth reading for long-horizon eval design.

paper.title: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?
paper.abstract: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al. Whereas these conjectures had previously been attempted only with a bespoke agent, our open-source evaluation code runs any generic language model (LM) against them, and is secure against LM cheating attempts. We find that LMs equipped with a minimal set of tools resolve 147 of these conjectures with a budget of \$50 per attempt, scoring 30% on OEIS Open. OEIS Open

summary.core_problem: 现有开放数学问题基准（HorizonMath、FrontierMath:OP）依赖生成器-验证器缺口，只能覆盖少数可构造可计算验证的问题，验证结果只是证据而非严格证明，且每个问题需要手工编写验证器、存在高比例不可解问题；同时近期AI解决开放数学问题的案例缺乏系统的成功率、成本和模型对比数据。需要一个覆盖更广、验证可靠、可系统比较通用LM能力的开放数学问题基准。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个训练数据不会泄漏的、基于形式化证明的开放问题评测集，可用于衡量模型在数学推理前沿的真实能力边界，也可作为RL推理、推理时搜索、工具使用等后训练方法的硬评测基准；开放的评测脚手架也降低了不同模型和agent在同一任务上横向对比的成本。
summary.technical_approach: 基于OEIS的整数序列开放猜想，使用已有的Lean形式化结果构建基准：从2649条OEIS开放猜想中筛选500条非平凡、适合自动定理证明的问题，经Gemini agent形式化为Lean，排除8条技术问题后得到492条猜想构成OEIS Open，再随机抽取100条构成低成本子集OEIS Open Lite。评测要求模型在Lean中证明猜想或其否定，正确性由Lean内核保证，避免手工验证器的漏洞；同时设计防作弊机制，支持任意通用LM接入。评测时给模型配备最小工具集（Lean证明环境、搜索等），按单次尝试预算控制成本。
summary.experiments: 在50美元/次尝试预算下，带最小工具集的LM可解决492条中的147条，OEIS Open上成功率30%；在200美元/次尝试预算下，当前最优模型在OEIS Open Lite（100条）上成功率44%；额外给模型接入47.6万篇arXiv数学文献作为检索源，未带来OEIS Open Lite上的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看Introduction中对现有开放问题基准缺陷的逐条分析，以及Methods中基准构建的筛选流程和Lean形式化的风险控制；附录可关注防作弊机制的具体实现和评测脚手架的使用方式；阅读时间约30-40分钟。
summary.authors_note: Epoch Research；基于Tsoukalas等人2026年的OEIS猜想形式化工作构建。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing open-problem math benchmarks such as HorizonMath and FrontierMath:OP rely on a generator-verifier gap, which limits coverage to a small subset of constructible, computationally checkable problems, yields only evidence rather than rigorous proof, requires hand-written verifiers per problem, and includes a high fraction of unsolvable items. Meanwhile, recent high-profile AI demonstrations on open math problems lack systematic measurement of success rates, cost, and cross-model comparability. A benchmark with broader coverage, reliable verification, and support for generic LM evaluation is needed.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this benchmark provides a training-data-leakage-free evaluation set based on formal proofs to measure the real capability boundary of models at the frontier of mathematical reasoning. It also serves as a hard evaluation target for post-training methods including RL for reasoning, inference-time search, and tool use. The open evaluation scaffold lowers the cost of head-to-head comparison across different models and agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built on existing Lean formalizations of open conjectures about integer sequences from OEIS. From 2,649 open OEIS conjectures, 500 non-trivial problems suitable for automated theorem proving are selected and formalized in Lean via a Gemini-based agent; 8 items are excluded for technical reasons, leaving 492 conjectures as OEIS Open, with a random 100-item subset forming the cheaper OEIS Open Lite. Evaluation requires a model to prove either the conjecture or its negation in Lean, with correctness guaranteed by the Lean kernel instead of per-problem hand-crafted verifiers. Anti-cheating mechanisms are built in, and the scaffold accepts any generic language model. Models are evaluated with a minimal tool set under a fixed per-attempt cost budget.
summary_en.experiments: Under a $50 per-attempt budget, LMs with a minimal tool set resolve 147 out of 492 conjectures, reaching a 30% success rate on OEIS Open. Under a $200 per-attempt budget, the best current model reaches 44% on OEIS Open Lite. Augmenting models with retrieval over 476,000 arXiv mathematics papers does not improve performance on OEIS Open Lite.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim pass, focus on the Introduction's itemized analysis of limitations in existing open-problem benchmarks, and the Methods section covering the selection pipeline and misformalization risk control via integer-sequence conjectures. The appendix is useful for details on anti-cheating mechanisms and the evaluation scaffold. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Epoch Research; built on the 2026 OEIS conjecture formalization work by Tsoukalas et al.

recommendation.zh: 基于开放数学猜想的干净评测基准，完美规避数据污染，可用于预训练数学能力的 unbiased 评估，重点看评测协议设计。
recommendation.en: Clean math reasoning benchmark based on open conjectures, free of data contamination; useful for unbiased evaluation of pretrained math capability, focus on the evaluation protocol.

paper.title: VQ-bench: A Composable Vector Quantization Framework
paper.abstract: Vector quantization is an old problem but has recently become central to AI infrastructure. It is therefore experiencing a surge of renewed engineering and research activity. This paper provides a unified framework for developing and benchmarking new quantization algorithms. We describe 7 common conceptual quantization primitives and show how to compose them arbitrarily. We then re-express 25 common quantizers as pipelines of these primitives. Finally, we publish VQ-bench as open-source to be ex

summary.core_problem: 如何提供一个统一的框架来开发、组合和基准测试各种向量量化（Vector Quantization）算法？
summary.importance: 提出了 VQ-bench，这是一个可组合的向量量化框架。它将复杂的量化算法抽象为基本的原语，极大地简化了新算法的开发和现有算法的复现与对比，对 AI 基础设施（如检索、KV Cache 压缩）有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 定义了 7 种常见的概念性量化原语（primitives），并展示了如何任意组合它们。将 25 种常见的量化器重新表达为这些原语的流水线（pipelines）。
summary.experiments: 发布了开源的 VQ-bench 框架，并提供了公开可复现的基准测试结果（摘要未提供具体性能对比数字，重点在于框架的统一性和可复现性）。
summary.authors_note: Edo Liberty 是 Pinecone 的创始人/CEO，在向量搜索和量化领域有深厚背景。

summary_en.core_problem: How to provide a unified framework for developing, composing, and benchmarking various Vector Quantization algorithms?
summary_en.importance: Proposes VQ-bench, a composable vector quantization framework. It abstracts complex quantization algorithms into basic primitives, greatly simplifying the development of new algorithms and the reproduction/comparison of existing ones, which is practically valuable for AI infrastructure (e.g., retrieval, KV Cache compression).
summary_en.technical_approach: Describes 7 common conceptual quantization primitives and shows how to compose them arbitrarily. Re-expresses 25 common quantizers as pipelines of these primitives.
summary_en.experiments: Publishes the open-source VQ-bench framework and provides publicly reproducible benchmark results (abstract focuses on framework unity and reproducibility rather than specific performance numbers).
summary_en.authors_note: Edo Liberty is the founder/CEO of Pinecone, with a strong background in vector search and quantization.

recommendation.zh: Pinecone 创始人团队出的向量量化 Benchmark 框架，将量化算法解耦为 7 个原语，对做 KV Cache 压缩或检索引擎底层优化的研究员有很好的工程参考价值。
recommendation.en: A vector quantization benchmark framework by the Pinecone founder's team, decoupling quantization algorithms into 7 primitives; excellent engineering reference for researchers working on KV Cache compression or retrieval engine optimization.

paper.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
paper.abstract: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding a

summary.core_problem: 构建一个闭环 benchmark，评测前沿 coding agent 在固定算力预算下能否自主改进 world model 研究代码，而不是只完成预先写死的工程任务。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产与协议设计。它把 agent 评测从“按 spec 修代码”推进到“在开放研究方向中做迭代改进”，对研究型 agent 和自动化实验循环有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoWorldModel-Bench：提供统一 starter、固定 compute budget、八个游戏环境和统一 structured-state 表示，刻意剥离感知问题，只保留动力学建模与训练目标选择。这样可以让 agent 在分钟级迭代中修改模型、损失或训练流程，并以闭环结果计分。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 64 个 session，Codex-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在 63 个 session 中改进了 starter，91% 的获胜编辑不是简单调参而是非平凡研究改动。未见更细的统计显著性、方差分解和与人类研究者对照信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a closed-loop benchmark to test whether frontier coding agents can autonomously improve world-model research code under a fixed compute budget, rather than merely completing spec-defined engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. It pushes agent evaluation from 'implement the requested patch' toward 'iterate on an open research direction,' which is relevant for research agents and automated experimentation loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoWorldModel-Bench provides a common starter, fixed compute budget, eight game environments, and a unified structured-state representation. By removing perception and isolating dynamics modeling, it lets agents iterate quickly on architectures, losses, and training choices in a closed loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 64 sessions where Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improved the starter in 63 sessions, with 91% of winning edits being non-trivial research changes rather than mere hyperparameter tuning. The abstract does not expose deeper variance analysis or human baselines.

recommendation.zh: 评测想法比结果更值钱：它把 research agent 测试从 SWE 式修补转到开放式实验循环；只看 benchmark 设计和 state abstraction，模型排名先别太当真。
recommendation.en: The benchmark design matters more than the leaderboard: it shifts research-agent evaluation from SWE-style patching to open-ended experimental iteration; read the protocol and state abstraction, not the rankings.

paper.title: Benchmarking Trustworthiness of SLMs: Pre-trained vs. Compressed
paper.abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) have emerged as a more efficient alternative to traditional Large Language Models (LLMs), offering promising potential in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing approaches to building SLMs typically follow two paths: training compact models from scratch, or compressing larger pre-trained models using methods such as pruning, quantization, or distillation. As language models become increasingly integrated into real-world applications, ensuring their trustworthiness

summary.core_problem: 解决小语言模型在从头预训练与由大模型压缩两条构建路径下，其可信性差异缺乏系统评测的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 trustworthiness benchmark 式评估，而不是新训练方法。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它把压缩路径与从头训练路径放到公平性、鲁棒性、隐私和伦理等维度下比较，能帮助判断“便宜的小模型”在部署时会牺牲什么。
summary.technical_approach: 论文系统评测两类 SLM：一类是从头预训练的紧凑模型，另一类是由大模型经剪枝、量化、蒸馏等方式压缩得到的模型。方法上重点比较不同压缩手段对可信性的影响，并进一步检验“先得到一个更可靠的大模型，再压缩”是否比直接训练小模型更稳妥。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主要结论有两点：量化比剪枝更能保留 trustworthiness；从一个可靠的大模型压缩得到的小模型，在可信性上优于直接训练的小模型。摘要未给出具体模型规模、评测基准、压缩比例和数值差距，因此更适合作为结论线索，而不是立即采信的定量依据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所、清华大学、香港城市大学等机构。未见可直接确认的该方向头部工业实验室作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of a systematic comparison of trustworthiness between small language models trained from scratch and those obtained by compressing larger pretrained models.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is benchmark-style evaluation rather than a new training method. For pretraining researchers, the value is in comparing the two SLM construction routes across fairness, robustness, privacy, and ethics, which helps clarify what is lost when moving to cheaper small models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper evaluates two classes of SLMs: compact models pretrained from scratch, and compressed models derived from larger LMs via pruning, quantization, or distillation. The analysis focuses on how different compression methods affect trustworthiness and whether compressing a more reliable large model is preferable to directly training a small one.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights two main findings: quantization preserves trustworthiness much better than pruning, and compressing a reliable large model yields more trustworthy SLMs than training small models directly. The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, benchmark suites, compression ratios, or effect sizes, so it is more a directional signal than a quantitative reference.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, and City University of Hong Kong. No clearly identifiable top industrial lab authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法文，但结论对部署侧有用：若你必须做 SLM，先压一个可靠大模型比从头练小模型更稳；只把它当方向信号，别直接拿数值做决策。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining-method paper, but useful for deployment choices: if you need an SLM, compressing a reliable large model looks safer than training small from scratch; treat it as directional evidence, not a final quantitative answer.

paper.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays p

summary.core_problem: 评测生活助理型 Agent 在长时程、持续变化且包含隐式约束的环境中，是否具备主动性与跨时间一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。现有 agent 评测多是短回合、静态环境、显式指令，难以覆盖真实个人助理场景里“无人提醒也要持续跟进”的能力缺口；这类评测对 AI delegation 和长期记忆/计划研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VibeLifeBench：包含 200 个跨 10 个生活领域的多周任务，在一个带 22 个 mock services 的模拟世界中运行。环境按自身时钟推进，部分状态变化不会显式通知 agent，要求模型自行决定何时行动、何时询问、何时保持沉默，并维持长期计划一致性。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可确认其核心实验是对现有 life-agent/LLM agent 在该 benchmark 上做系统评测，重点考察 proactive、persistent、consistency 等维度。摘要未给出具体参评模型、分数区间和领先方法，因此目前更适合作为评测资产关注，而不是方法结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者署名为 Xiaohongshu Inc。属于产业侧生活场景 agent 评测工作，机构与题目场景较匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether life-assistant agents can remain proactive and temporally consistent in long-horizon, evolving environments with implicit constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. Most existing agent evaluations focus on short, static, explicitly specified tasks, leaving a gap for real assistant settings where the agent must keep acting without being constantly prompted. That makes it relevant to AI delegation and long-horizon planning research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces VibeLifeBench: 200 multi-week tasks across 10 everyday-life domains, instantiated in a simulated world with 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, some changes are silent, and the agent must decide when to act, ask, or stay silent while preserving plan coherence over time.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the main experiments benchmark existing LLM/life-agent systems on proactivity, persistence, and consistency. The abstract does not expose the exact model roster or score spread, so the paper is more useful as an evaluation asset than as a source of strong methodological conclusions.
summary_en.authors_note: Authored by Xiaohongshu Inc. This is an industry benchmark effort aligned with personal-assistant agent scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但长期 delegation 的评测空白补得还算准；看任务设计与 failure taxonomy 即可，别指望它给出训练方法答案。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but it targets a real gap in long-horizon delegation eval; read the task design and failure taxonomy, not for training recipes.

paper.title: CapProbe: Evaluating Detailed Image Captions via Full-Scene Dense Question Answering
paper.abstract: Evaluating detailed image captions from Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires going beyond surface-level semantic similarity. Reference-based metrics (e.g., CIDEr and SPICE) and LLM-as-scorer protocols struggle to verify dense factual claims, while existing QA-based alternatives generally offer lower probe density, narrower domain coverage, or no explicit alignment between individual questions and segmented image regions. We introduce CapProbe, a full-scene dense QA benchmark that turns detaile

summary.core_problem: 详细图像描述的现有评测难以逐条核验密集事实，尤其无法把文字陈述对齐到具体图像区域。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产与评测协议工作，贡献在于把长 caption 评测转成全场景、区域对齐的密集问答检查，适合分析 VLM 在细粒度事实覆盖与幻觉上的缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CapProbe：先把图像分解为覆盖前景与背景的粗语义区域，再为每个区域生成多道选择题，覆盖 10 类语义属性；同时用两层 taxonomy 组织领域分布，并引入 language judge 将模型答案映射为可比较分数，从而把 caption 评测转成区域级 factual checking。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 346 张图、1,868 个区域、25,650 道题，平均每图 74 个 QA。摘要称其比 CIDEr/SPICE 和一般 LLM-as-judge 更能检出密集事实错误，并能区分不同 captioning/VLM 系统的细粒度能力；未见大规模预训练或统一多模态建模实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation for detailed image captions cannot reliably verify dense factual claims or align textual statements with specific image regions.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-asset paper: it reframes long-caption evaluation as full-scene, region-aligned factual checking, which is useful for diagnosing coverage and hallucination in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: CapProbe decomposes each image into coarse semantic regions covering foreground and background, then generates multiple-choice questions for each region across 10 semantic categories. A two-level taxonomy organizes domains, and a language judge maps answers into comparable caption scores.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 346 images, 1,868 regions, and 25,650 questions, averaging 74 QA pairs per image. The abstract claims stronger sensitivity to dense factual errors than CIDEr/SPICE and generic LLM-as-judge setups, but this is not a pretraining or unified-modeling paper.

recommendation.zh: 做 VLM 预训练诊断可以留作工具箱，但它更像 caption factuality checklist；读任务定义和误差分解就够，不必深读正文。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM diagnosis tool, but it is basically a caption factuality checklist; read the task design and error breakdown, not the full paper.

paper.title: VisEditBench: Can Vision-Language Models Edit Visualization Code from Multimodal Feedback?
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities in generating visualization code from textual or visual specifications. However, real-world visualization authoring is inherently iterative: users frequently revise existing visualizations to repair flawed charts or adapt them to desired styles. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate generation from scratch, leaving visualization code editing from multimodal feedback largely unexplored. We introduce VisEditBench, a benchmark of 1,395 h

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM/LLM 评测多看“从零生成可视化代码”，但真实工作流更常见的是基于多模态反馈对既有可视化代码进行迭代编辑；缺少对应 benchmark。
summary.importance: 提供一个面向“多模态反馈驱动的代码编辑”的评测资产，覆盖修复与风格迁移两类真实场景；对做多模态代码能力/交互式编程 agent 的团队是补齐评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 VisEditBench：1,395 条人工标注的可视化代码编辑任务；两种设置——(1) feedback-guided repair：给 buggy/标注过的图表 + 文本反馈，要求修改代码；(2) reference-guided restyling：给目标图像，要求把代码改到匹配目标风格/外观。
summary.experiments: 评测 20 个 SOTA VLM；摘要提到 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 表现最好但任务仍困难（摘要截断，未给出完整数值与对比细节）。
summary.authors_note: York University / NTU / Salesforce AI Research；偏 benchmark 构建与多模态代码编辑评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Most VLM/LLM benchmarks test visualization code generation from scratch, while real workflows require iterative code editing from multimodal feedback; a benchmark is missing.
summary_en.importance: Provides an evaluation asset for multimodal feedback-driven code editing (repair + restyling), filling a gap for multimodal coding/interactive programming research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces VisEditBench with 1,395 human-annotated visualization code-editing tasks in two settings: (1) feedback-guided repair using buggy/marked charts plus textual feedback; (2) reference-guided restyling to match a target chart image by editing code.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 20 state-of-the-art VLMs; the abstract notes Claude-4.6-Sonnet performs best but the task remains challenging (abstract truncated; detailed numbers not provided here).
summary_en.authors_note: York University / NTU / Salesforce AI Research; benchmark-centric work.

recommendation.zh: 评测资产不错但偏窄（可视化代码编辑）；做通用 pretrain 的只需扫任务定义与失败案例，除非你在做多模态代码/交互式编辑。
recommendation.en: Good but narrow benchmark (viz code editing); for pretraining folks, skim task setup + failure modes unless you actively work on multimodal coding/editing.

paper.title: How Robust Are LLMs to Vietnamese Dialects?
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on standard written Vietnamese, yet everyday communication frequently involves regional dialects that preserve meaning but differ in surface form. Existing Vietnamese dialect work largely addresses this issue through dialect-to-standard normalization instead of measuring how the model fails under Vietnamese dialectal inputs. To address this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation of LLM robustness to Vietnamese dialect variation across

summary.core_problem: LLM 在标准书面越南语上评测较多，但对“语义相同、表面形式不同”的越南语方言输入鲁棒性缺少系统测量。
summary.importance: 提供一个受控的方言改写评测集，用于量化模型对方言变体的性能退化与失败模式；对多语种预训练数据覆盖与鲁棒性分析有参考价值，但属于语言特定资产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VialectBench：从 400 条标准越南语源样本出发，人工改写为 6 个方言组，共 2,400 条方言版本；覆盖 ER/NLI/QA/MCQA，核心评测是“同一语义在不同方言表面形式下模型决策是否稳定/性能是否下降”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型列表与降幅数字；主结果是系统性量化性能退化与错误类型分布。
summary.authors_note: VNU-HCM 系列高校 + NYU Abu Dhabi 等；以越南语方言鲁棒性评测为主。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs are mostly evaluated on standard written Vietnamese, but robustness to dialectal inputs with the same meaning is under-measured.
summary_en.importance: Provides a controlled dialect-rewrite benchmark to quantify degradation and failure patterns under Vietnamese dialect variation; useful for multilingual pretraining coverage/robustness, but language-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces VialectBench: 400 standard Vietnamese instances with 2,400 human-written dialect rewrites across six dialect groups, spanning ER/NLI/QA/MCQA; evaluates decision stability and performance drop across dialectal surface forms.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model lists or exact degradation numbers; focuses on systematic measurement of drops and error patterns.
summary_en.authors_note: VNU-HCM institutions + NYU Abu Dhabi; benchmark for Vietnamese dialect robustness.

recommendation.zh: 作为“方言=表面扰动”的受控评测样例可备查；但语言特定且对 pretrain recipe 反馈弱，除非你在做越南语/多语种数据配比。
recommendation.en: A decent controlled dialect-as-perturbation benchmark to cite, but it’s language-specific and offers limited direct guidance for pretraining recipes unless you care about Vietnamese/multilingual mixtures.

institutions: VNU University of Engineering and Technology

paper.title: From Reasoning Depth to Reasoning Breadth: Evaluating Multi-Point Associative Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress on reasoning tasks that require increasingly long and complex inferential chains. This progress primarily reflects reasoning depth. A complementary and comparatively unexamined capability is reasoning breadth: exploring multiple semantic directions in parallel and integrating the resulting clues into one coherent answer. We introduce MPAR-Bench, a bilingual English-Chinese benchmark that isolates reasoning breadth through multi-point as

summary.core_problem: 现有推理评测偏“推理深度”（长链条），但缺少对“推理广度”（并行探索多条语义线索并整合）的隔离测量。
summary.importance: 提出一个专门测 reasoning breadth 的中英双语 benchmark（MPAR-Bench），并给出构造流程；对设计更贴近开放式联想/线索整合的训练信号与评测有启发，但仍是评测资产为主。
summary.technical_approach: MPAR-Bench：每题给出多个相互独立、语义多样的线索（clues），要求模型猜出隐藏目标词/短语（灵感来自 Just One）；用 multi-agent 线索生成、embedding 多样性过滤与人工核验构造 1,000 题；除 exact match 外还用 ANLS、embedding 相似度等指标评估。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型排名与数值；重点是 benchmark 设计与对“广度推理”能力的区分性评估。
summary.authors_note: Peking University + Kuaishou Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning evaluations emphasize depth (long chains) but under-measure breadth: exploring multiple semantic directions in parallel and integrating clues.
summary_en.importance: Introduces MPAR-Bench (EN/ZH) to isolate reasoning breadth with a concrete construction pipeline; useful for designing breadth-oriented signals, though primarily an evaluation asset.
summary_en.technical_approach: MPAR-Bench frames each item as recovering a hidden target from several independently generated, semantically diverse clues (inspired by the game Just One). Built via multi-agent clue generation, embedding-based diversity filtering, and human verification (1,000 items). Evaluates with exact match plus ANLS and embedding similarity metrics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed model rankings or numbers; emphasis is on benchmark design and discriminative evaluation of breadth reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: Peking University + Kuaishou Technology.

recommendation.zh: 概念上把 breadth 从 depth 里拆出来是对的，但 1k 规模与指标设计决定它更像“新题型”；只看任务定义与数据构造流程即可。
recommendation.en: Separating breadth from depth is the right framing, but with 1k items it’s more a new task format than a definitive eval; read the task spec and data construction pipeline only.

paper.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as mobile assistants, where a key challenge is leveraging personal information scattered across multiple applications (apps) to complete user instructions. However, due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks, their capabilities remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce SPIEval, a human-curated benchmark grounded in five cognitive capabilities (i.e., reasoning, disambiguation, integration, preference inference, and multi-intent

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 作为移动助手时，能否跨多个 app 利用分散的个人信息完成真实用户指令。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent/mobile assistant benchmark。贡献在于把“分散个人信息整合”做成可控、可验证的评测环境，而不是提出新的通用 agent 方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 SPIEval，围绕 reasoning、disambiguation、integration、preference inference、multi-intent decomposition 五类能力设计 250 个任务，覆盖 10 个 app、4,335 条个人记录和 21 个工具，支持多轮交互与可验证结果。
summary.experiments: 评测 9 个代表性 LLM。最强模型 GPT-5.5 (xhigh) 仅 57.3% 准确率，最弱模型明显更低，说明跨 app 的个人信息整合仍是难点。论文重点是 benchmark 设计与误差分析，而非训练或架构创新。
summary.authors_note: 来自复旦大学与腾讯混元团队，属于面向移动助手场景的评测型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can act as mobile assistants by integrating scattered personal information across multiple apps to complete realistic user instructions.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent/mobile-assistant benchmark. Its contribution is a controllable and verifiable evaluation environment for scattered personal information, rather than a new general agent method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce SPIEval, a benchmark built around five capabilities: reasoning, disambiguation, integration, preference inference, and multi-intent decomposition. It contains 250 tasks, 4,335 personal records across 10 apps, and 21 tools, with support for multi-turn interaction and verifiable outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate 9 representative LLMs. The best model, GPT-5.5 (xhigh), reaches only 57.3% accuracy, with much weaker models far below that, indicating that cross-app personal information integration remains difficult. The paper is centered on benchmark design and analysis rather than training or architecture innovation.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Fudan University and Tencent Hunyuan, and is best viewed as an evaluation asset for mobile-assistant agents.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，知道有这么个 mobile assistant benchmark 即可；若你做 tool-use eval，只看任务构成和错误分解，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: This is only loosely connected to pretraining; know that the benchmark exists, and if you care about tool-use eval, just read the task taxonomy and error breakdown.

paper.title: On the Limitations of Cross-Lingual Consistency in Multilingual Text-to-image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generation has achieved remarkable progress in recent years. However, existing research has largely focused on English-only settings, leaving cross-lingual performance gaps and language-specific effects insufficiently explored. To fill this gap, we introduce LingT2I, a benchmark covering 10 widely used languages with 33K prompts, designed to evaluate cross-lingual effects in both content generation and text rendering. Building on this benchmark, we conduct a comprehensive cro

summary.core_problem: 评估多语言 prompt 下文本到图像模型的内容生成和文字渲染是否保持跨语言一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成评测资产和行为分析。它不是 LLM 预训练核心论文，但对统一多模态模型的 multilingual alignment、视觉-语言 tokenizer 和跨语言数据配比有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 LingT2I benchmark，覆盖 10 种常用语言和 33K prompts，从内容生成和文本渲染两个方面评估跨语言效果，并分析语言因素和文化上下文对生成模式的系统性影响。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕现有 T2I 模型的跨语言评估展开，报告语言不平等、不同指标之间的语言依赖 trade-off，以及若干语言相关生成模式。摘要未列出具体模型名单、指标数值和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Khalifa University、Queen Mary University of London、The Chinese University of Hong Kong、The University of Melbourne 和 University of Central Florida。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether text-to-image systems behave consistently across multilingual prompts in both visual content generation and text rendering.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark and analysis for multilingual T2I behavior. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multilingual alignment in unified multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce LingT2I, a benchmark with 33K prompts in 10 widely used languages. They evaluate cross-lingual effects on generated content and rendered text, then analyze language-dependent patterns tied to linguistic and cultural factors.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates existing T2I models and reports linguistic inequality, language-dependent trade-offs across metrics, and systematic generation patterns. The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list or quantitative margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include Khalifa University, Queen Mary University of London, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, The University of Melbourne, and University of Central Florida.

recommendation.zh: 看 benchmark 设计即可；它提醒多模态预训练别只用英文 prompt 评估 alignment，方法部分不用深读。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark setup, not the full method; it is a useful reminder that English-only prompts hide multimodal alignment failures.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Affiliation:The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: KVDiagnosis: A Diagnostic Benchmark for KV-Cache Compression in Long-Context Language Models
paper.abstract: KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory, but aggregate task scores reveal neither which correct executions fail nor why. We present KVDiagnosis, a diagnostic dataset and benchmark with three contributions. First, a 25-method taxonomy groups methods into five mechanism families and links them to eight verified implementations and their valid diagnostic measurements. Second, for every supported method setting, we evaluate all sources in each fixed split against a per-source FullCache cont

summary.core_problem: 现有KV-cache压缩评估仅使用聚合任务分数，无法揭示哪些正确执行失败以及具体失败原因的问题
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，提出首个KV-cache压缩细粒度诊断基准，建立了方法分类学和统一测量格式
summary.technical_approach: 将25种KV-cache压缩方法划分为5个机制家族，对应8种已验证实现；对每个方法设置，在固定数据划分上与全缓存基线逐源对比，筛选出全缓存正确、压缩后错误的C-to-W样本；设计统一记录格式关联输出、运行元数据与缓存、似然、注意力、解码等多维度测量指标
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-8B上测试4种证据感知工作负载，生成59800次压缩运行，覆盖2600个源，得到12520个C-to-W样本；固定诊断规则下63.2%的样本可测量性低或部分可测

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache compression evaluations only use aggregate task scores, which cannot reveal which correct executions fail or why
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: presents the first fine-grained diagnostic benchmark for KV-cache compression, with a method taxonomy and unified measurement format
summary_en.technical_approach: Groups 25 KV-cache compression methods into 5 mechanism families with 8 verified implementations; for each method setting, compares against per-source FullCache baseline on fixed splits to select C-to-W (correct-to-wrong) samples separately; designs a common record format linking outputs, run metadata to cache, likelihood, attention and decoding measurements
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Qwen3-8B with 4 evidence-aware workloads, yielding 59,800 compressed runs across 2,600 sources and 12,520 C-to-W rows; 63.2% of samples have low or partial measurability under fixed diagnostic rules

recommendation.zh: KV-cache压缩的诊断基准设计精细，C-to-W样本筛选方法值得做长上下文推理的研究者参考，重点看方法部分的分类学和测量格式
recommendation.en: A well-designed diagnostic benchmark for KV-cache compression; the C-to-W sample selection method is worth referencing for long-context inference work, focus on the taxonomy and measurement format in methods

paper.title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 MLLM 幻觉评测的两个缺口：静态 benchmark 覆盖面窄，且很快被新模型饱和；已有评测多集中在物体存在性或属性错误，难以系统暴露指令服从、拒答边界、知识编造等更复杂的失真模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近评测与红队工具。但它对基座模型训练有两个启发。第一，幻觉不只是视觉 grounding 问题，还包括 instruction-level 和 knowledge-level 的训练信号冲突。第二，论文指出 helpfulness-oriented RL 可能放大 sycophancy，即模型为了满足用户暗示而编造信息。这对 post-train 数据、reward 设计、拒答样本比例、以及 multimodal grounding loss 的设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一是 UniHall，一个按 Object、Instruction、Knowledge 三个维度组织的 hallucination benchmark。Object 维度覆盖存在性、属性、关系等视觉事实错误；Instruction 维度关注错误服从、拒答失败、迎合式回答；Knowledge 维度关注模型对外部事实的编造。数据来自 Hallu-PI、BEAF 等开放域资源以及领域数据，经过人工标准化和类别映射。文中提到 object-level 超过 1000 个代表实例，原始数据按目标规模的 5-10 倍过采样后由 meta-reviewers 分配和筛选。第二是 SAMF，即 Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing。它借鉴软件 fuzz testing，用进化式 mutation 和强化学习生成语义尽量保持、但更容易触发幻觉的图像与 prompt 变体。评测端不是单一 LLM judge，而是 coarse-to-fine 的 structured oracle：规则、检测器和 LLM verifier 互补使用，用来判断错误类型、严重程度和可能原因。它和 POPE、HallusionBench 的区别在于：不是只做静态题集，也不是只看 object hallucination，而是把动态变异、细粒度 taxonomy 和结构化 oracle 放在一个闭环里。
summary.experiments: 实验主要比较静态 UniHall 与 fuzzing 后的表现差异。核心现象是：多个先进 MLLM 在 SAMF 生成的变异输入上性能明显下降，说明静态 benchmark 分数会高估模型鲁棒性。论文还报告了一个对训练有用的观察：经过更强 helpfulness 对齐的模型，在误导性或不可满足指令下更容易出现 sycophancy 和信息编造，而不是承认不确定或拒答。由于提供内容中没有完整实验表，无法确认各模型的具体降幅、样本规模和 oracle 一致性数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 hallucination taxonomy 和 alignment tax 的定义，再看 Table 1 对 UniHall 与 POPE、AMBER、HallusionBench、OpenCHAIR 等 benchmark 的差异。Method 中重点看 SAMF 的 mutation 策略和 structured oracle pipeline，这部分比数据集本身更有迁移价值。若关注 post-train，可重点找 helpfulness-hallucination trade-off 的实验表和失败案例，判断它是否能转化为 reward model 或 refusal data 的诊断集。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a weakness in current MLLM hallucination evaluation: static benchmarks have narrow coverage and saturate quickly. Most prior tests focus on object-level visual errors, while instruction-level failures and knowledge fabrication remain under-tested.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and stress-testing paper rather than a pretraining method paper. Its value for foundation-model research lies in the training signals it exposes. It separates visual grounding failures from instruction-following and knowledge-level fabrication, and it reports a helpfulness-hallucination tension: models optimized heavily for being helpful may become more willing to satisfy misleading requests with fabricated content. That observation is relevant for RLHF/RLAIF reward design, refusal data construction, and multimodal grounding evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. UniHall is a benchmark organized around a three-way taxonomy: Object, Instruction, and Knowledge hallucinations. Object cases include existence, attributes, and relations; instruction cases include refusal failures and sycophancy; knowledge cases cover fictitious factual claims. The seed data is repurposed from open-domain and domain-specific multimodal benchmarks such as Hallu-PI and BEAF, then normalized into a unified annotation protocol. The text states that the object-level split contains over 1,000 representative instances, with raw sources over-provisioned by 5-10x before filtering. SAMF, or Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing, is the dynamic component. It uses evolutionary mutation, including reinforcement learning, to generate adversarial image and prompt variants while trying to preserve semantics. Evaluation is handled by structured oracles: symbolic rules, detectors, and LLM verifiers are combined in a coarse-to-fine pipeline rather than relying on a single judge. Compared with POPE or HallusionBench, the main difference is the combination of fine-grained taxonomy, dynamic multimodal mutation, and structured verification.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments show a clear drop from static benchmark performance to fuzzed stress-test performance across strong MLLMs, indicating that static scores can hide brittle grounding behavior. The paper also highlights that models aligned more strongly for user helpfulness can show more instruction-level hallucination, especially sycophantic fabrication under misleading prompts. The provided content does not include the full result tables, so exact degradation numbers, model-by-model rankings, and oracle agreement statistics cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20-30 minutes. Start with the taxonomy and the benchmark comparison table, since they define what the paper adds beyond POPE, AMBER, HallusionBench, and OpenCHAIR. Then read the SAMF method, especially the mutation loop and the oracle design. For training researchers, the most useful part is the evidence around the helpfulness-hallucination trade-off and the failure cases that could be turned into reward-model or refusal-policy diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 只看 taxonomy 和 fuzzing mutation 设计即可；对预训练没直接动作，但能暴露 VLM 数据与对齐里的脆弱点。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and mutation design only; it does not change pretraining directly, but it can reveal weak spots in VLM data and alignment.

paper.title: Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven rapid progress in autonomous agents, yet standard evaluations remain confined to static task solving. An emerging frontier is harness evolution---the agent's capacity to autonomously optimize its own operating harness. However, systematically benchmarking this capability remains challenging, as existing evaluations fail to isolate harness improvements from base model strength, prevent task-specific overfitting, or capture long-horizon iterative research.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型能不能把任务做对”，而是“模型能不能持续改进承载任务执行的 agent harness”。这里的 harness 指可执行的外层脚手架：提示、工具调用流程、状态管理、错误恢复、子任务编排、代码逻辑等。难点在于，现有 agent benchmark 往往把基础模型能力、任务难度、harness 设计混在一起，导致你很难判断分数提升究竟来自更强的 base model，还是来自更好的 harness。作者把问题拆成三个必须同时满足的条件：任务要对 harness 改动敏感，而不是被底模能力主导；验证集和测试集要在这种“敏感性”上分布一致，避免在验证集上过拟合；评测过程要允许多轮、长时程的代码级迭代，而不是单轮 prompt search。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出了新的预训练方法，而在于把“agent self-improvement 的可测部分”单独剥离出来，形成了一个更干净的评测对象。对于做 pretrain 和 post-train 接口的人，这很重要：如果未来希望让模型在 deployment 中自动改 scaffold、自动做工具链优化，首先需要知道模型到底有没有这种内生能力，以及这种能力和底模规模、领域、policy model 是否解耦。Evo-Bench 的贡献量级更接近“评测协议和问题定义”而不是“方法突破”。它把 harness evolution 从零散案例推进到可比较、可复现实验，尤其强调 transfer：同一个演化出来的 harness 能否迁移到别的 policy model 上。这一点对研究‘结构性改进是否比 prompt trick 更稳’很有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个 harness-guided benchmark construction framework。不是先随便收一批任务再让模型去改 harness，而是先用辅助任务诱导出一组多样化 harness，再反过来用这些 harness 去筛任务，保留那些对 harness 差异真正有响应的任务。这样做的原因很直接：如果任务对 harness 不敏感，benchmark 最后测到的还是 base model strength。

具体设计有三层。第一层是 harness-sensitive task construction。作者先构造或收集多个候选 harness，在固定 policy model 下运行，观察任务分数对 harness 变化的响应幅度，只保留能拉开不同 harness 表现的任务。第二层是 sensitivity-aware stratified splitting。作者不是按任务来源随机切分，而是按任务对 harness 的敏感性、难度和分布特征做分层切分，保证 validation 和 evaluation 在“可被 harness 改善”的统计属性上对齐，同时保持任务不重叠。这样可以减少 evolver 在验证集上学到 task-specific patch 的风险。第三层是 controlled long-horizon evolution。每次迭代中，evolver 只能看到截至当前轮的 validation 证据，包括历史 harness、聚合分数和任务级 outcome，然后修改可执行 harness 代码，再在固定 policy model 上重跑。这个设置把问题限定为：在固定底模下，模型能否根据失败模式做研究式迭代，而不是靠换底模取胜。

从建模角度看，这篇工作的关键不是提出新的 evolver 算法，而是把 evolver、policy model、task suite 三者的耦合关系控制住。尤其值得注意的是，作者把 evolved harness 当作一种可迁移的 reasoning structure，而不是某个模型专属的 prompt。这个 framing 很像把外部 scaffold 视为一种非参数化、可执行的“后训练权重”。
summary.experiments:
主实验在 Search、Office、General 三个 domain、五个已有 benchmark 上进行，评测了 9 个前沿闭源和开源模型作为 evolver。固定 policy model 后，最强的两个 evolver 是 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 4.8，相对 seed harness 分别提升 16.6 和 16.1 分，接近人工工程 baseline 47.5。这个结果说明，当前强模型已经能做出实质性的 harness 改进，但距离人工设计仍有明显差距。

分析部分比总分更有信息量。第一，evolution 存在明显 early saturation：前几轮很快找到有效结构，后续轮次反而更容易引入有害修改。这说明当前模型在“发现 obvious fix”上还可以，但在长期维护、回归测试、避免破坏已有能力上不稳定。第二，收益高度依赖 domain。Search 任务中，模型能通过复制或稳定化 web navigation 结构拿到很大增益；General tasks 中，某些自动合成的 harness 甚至能超过人工工程；Office 任务则更难，因为它依赖细粒度、流程特定的数据处理和操作顺序，模型不容易从有限 validation signal 中归纳出可靠 workflow。第三，迁移实验显示，合成 harness 对不同 policy model 具有鲁棒性，能在 Qwen、DeepSeek、GLM 等不同架构或家族上带来一致增益。这支持了作者的一个核心判断：演化出来的不是某个底模专属的 prompt hack，而是更一般的执行结构。

虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从叙述可见，作者重点看的是相对 seed harness 的绝对分数提升、不同轮次的收益曲线、按 domain 分解的增益，以及跨 policy transfer 的稳定性。这几组实验共同支撑 benchmark 的有效性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，把作者定义的三个挑战记住：harness sensitivity、cross-split generalization、long-horizon evolution。然后直接看 benchmark construction 和主实验图表，重点确认作者是如何证明“这个 benchmark 测的是 harness evolution，而不是底模强弱”。

建议优先看三类内容。第一，任务筛选和 split 构造细节，尤其是 sensitivity-aware stratification 的指标定义和实施方式；这是 benchmark 是否站得住的关键。第二，evolution trajectory 分析，关注 early saturation 的证据：是 validation gain 停滞、test gain 回落，还是代码修改复杂度上升导致回归。第三，cross-policy transfer 实验，这部分最接近基座研究者关心的问题：外部 scaffold 到底是不是一种可迁移的结构先验。

如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可完成有效泛读：读引言、方法总览、主结果表、trajectory 分析图、transfer 实验。若要深挖，值得进一步检查作者是否控制了 API budget、编辑步数、工具权限和执行环境一致性；这些因素会显著影响 benchmark 解释性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether a model can solve agent tasks well. It asks whether a model can improve the executable agent harness itself over multiple rounds. Here, the harness includes prompts, tool-use logic, control flow, state handling, recovery code, and other scaffold components around a fixed policy model. The core difficulty is evaluation: most agent benchmarks entangle base-model strength, task difficulty, and harness quality, so score gains do not cleanly reflect harness-evolving ability. The paper isolates three requirements for a valid benchmark: tasks must be sensitive to harness changes rather than dominated by the base model; validation and test splits must align in that sensitivity to avoid split-specific overfitting; and the setup must support long-horizon iterative code refinement rather than one-shot prompt search.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model researchers is as an evaluation and problem-definition contribution. It turns harness evolution into a measurable capability instead of a collection of anecdotes. This matters for the pretrain/post-train interface: if future systems are expected to improve their own scaffolds, tool chains, or execution policies during deployment, we need a benchmark that separates intrinsic scaffold-improvement ability from raw model strength. The paper also highlights transferability: whether an evolved harness helps multiple policy models, not just the one used during search. That is a useful lens for studying whether external scaffolds behave like reusable reasoning structures rather than model-specific prompt tricks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is a harness-guided benchmark construction framework. Instead of starting from a fixed task set and asking models to optimize harnesses on it, the authors first induce a diverse set of candidate harnesses on auxiliary tasks, then use those harnesses to identify tasks that are genuinely responsive to harness quality. This design choice is important: if tasks are not harness-sensitive, the benchmark will mostly measure base-model strength.

The framework has three main components. First, harness-sensitive task construction: candidate tasks are retained only if performance varies meaningfully across different harnesses under a fixed policy model. Second, sensitivity-aware stratified splitting: tasks are split into validation and evaluation sets not by naive random partitioning, but by preserving distributions over sensitivity and related task characteristics, while keeping the suites disjoint. This is meant to reduce task-specific overfitting to the validation set. Third, controlled long-horizon evolution: at each iteration, the evolver sees cumulative validation-side evidence from previous harnesses, including aggregate scores and task-level outcomes, then edits the executable harness code and reruns the fixed policy model. This keeps the benchmark focused on iterative scaffold improvement under a fixed underlying model.

Methodologically, the paper is less about a new evolver algorithm and more about controlling the coupling among evolver, policy model, and task suite. A notable framing is that evolved harnesses are treated as transferable reasoning structures, closer to reusable external programs than to model-specific prompts.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluation covers three domains—Search, Office, and General Agent tasks—built from five established benchmarks, with 9 frontier and open-weight models used as evolvers. Under a fixed policy model, the strongest evolvers are GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 4.8, improving over the seed harness by 16.6 and 16.1 points respectively, approaching a human-engineered baseline of 47.5. The result shows that current top models can make substantial scaffold improvements, but still leave a noticeable gap to manual engineering.

The analysis is more informative than the headline numbers. First, evolution shows clear early saturation: models discover useful structures quickly in early rounds, then often introduce harmful modifications later. That suggests current systems are better at finding obvious fixes than at maintaining and extending a working scaffold without regressions. Second, gains are strongly domain-dependent. Search benefits the most, likely because web-navigation structure can be replicated and stabilized. General tasks sometimes allow evolved harnesses to surpass manual engineering. Office tasks remain difficult because they require highly specific processing workflows that are hard to infer from limited validation feedback. Third, transfer experiments show that synthesized harnesses improve multiple policy models, including Qwen, DeepSeek, and GLM families. This supports the claim that the evolved artifacts are not merely prompt hacks tied to one base model, but more general execution structures.

The full text excerpt does not expose every table entry, but the experimental backbone is clear: absolute improvement over the seed harness, trajectory analysis over evolution rounds, domain-wise breakdowns, and cross-policy transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the Introduction and keep the three benchmark requirements in mind: harness sensitivity, cross-split generalization, and long-horizon evolution. Then move directly to the benchmark construction section and the main result figures. The key question to track is whether the benchmark truly measures harness-evolving ability rather than raw model quality.

Three parts deserve attention. First, the task-selection and split-construction details, especially how sensitivity-aware stratification is defined and implemented. That is the foundation of the benchmark. Second, the trajectory analysis showing early saturation; check whether the evidence comes from validation plateaus, evaluation regressions, or increasingly destructive code edits. Third, the cross-policy transfer experiments, which are the most relevant for foundation-model researchers interested in reusable external structure.

If time is limited, a useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes: read the introduction, method overview, main result tables, trajectory figures, and transfer section. If reading more carefully, inspect whether the paper controls for API budget, edit budget, tool permissions, and execution environment, since those details strongly affect interpretability.

recommendation.zh: harness自主进化是agent能力的新维度，对研究长程agent能力演化有参考，只看 §2 的benchmark构建逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: Autonomous harness evolution is a new dimension of agent capability; refer to §2 for benchmark construction logic if studying long-horizon agent evolution.

paper.title: PluginEval: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained Error Attribution in Function Calling
paper.abstract: Reliable evaluation of tool routing is critical as Large Language Models increasingly operate as autonomous agents. Current benchmarks face three structural limitations: data distributions that follow a power law leave rare scenarios underrepresented; the absence of adversarial hard negatives obscures performance differences across models; and annotation pipelines depend on LLM judgments that have not been validated through execution. In this paper, we introduce PluginEval, a benchmark construct

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM function calling 和 tool routing 构建细粒度诊断 benchmark，解决长尾场景、困难负例和未执行验证带来的评测失真。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产和评测流程。它把工具调用拆成可诊断决策，并用确定性验证与真实 API 执行替代未校验的 LLM judge，对 agent/tool-use 后训练和模型选择有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: PluginEval 采用两阶段构建流程：先把 tool routing 表述为三类连续决策，并分离候选调用生成与验证；再按每个 plugin 的 capability、intent 和 boundary 分解触发场景与排除场景，生成不同难度查询，补齐覆盖缺口并加入 adversarial hard negatives。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出 benchmark 规模、模型列表或具体分数。可确认的是标注质量来自确定性校验和真实 API 执行，而不是单纯 LLM 判断；评测目标是揭示不同模型在罕见场景、边界场景和困难负例上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a diagnostic benchmark for LLM function calling and tool routing, targeting long-tail coverage, hard negatives, and unreliable judge-based annotation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset and construction protocol. By decomposing tool routing into diagnosable decisions and validating calls through deterministic checks and real API execution, it is directly useful for agent/tool-use post-training and model selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: PluginEval uses a two-stage pipeline. It first formulates tool routing as a sequence of three decisions and separates call generation from verification. It then decomposes each plugin by capability, intent, and boundary to generate trigger and exclusion cases at multiple difficulty levels, including adversarial hard negatives.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report benchmark size, evaluated model list, or score deltas. It does state that quality signals come from deterministic validation and real API execution rather than unvalidated LLM judgments, with the goal of exposing model differences on rare, boundary, and adversarial cases.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 构造流程；执行验证和 hard negative 设计比榜单分数更有用，可借到 tool-use 数据评审里。
recommendation.en: Skim the construction pipeline; execution validation and hard-negative design are more reusable than the leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/f

summary.core_problem: 现有仓库级 coding agent benchmark 主要看最终补丁是否通过测试，无法解释 agent 在需求澄清、实现规划、代码生成链条中哪里偏离了正确路径。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产贡献。SWE-RPG 把最终可执行补丁评测和中间过程的 ground-truth reference 结合起来，试图把 coding agent 评测从单一 pass/fail 推向可诊断的过程评测。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了包含三类信号的仓库级 benchmark：最终 patch 的可执行测试结果、需求澄清的标注参考、实现规划的标注参考。核心不是提出新的 coding agent，而是用经过验证的中间 GT 对完整 agent trajectory 做回溯诊断，分析失败来自需求理解、计划制定还是代码落地。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、样本量和提升数字。实验重点应是用多个 coding agent 在 SWE-RPG 上运行，并展示中间 GT 能提供比最终测试通过率更细的错误归因。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level coding-agent benchmarks usually score only whether the final patch passes tests, leaving no clean way to locate failures in requirement clarification, planning, or code generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. SWE-RPG augments executable patch evaluation with validated intermediate ground truths, moving coding-agent evaluation from a binary outcome toward trajectory-level diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark provides ground-truth references for requirement clarification and implementation planning, in addition to final patch execution. The main contribution is not a new agent method, but a GT-aligned retrospective analysis protocol for full coding-agent trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, dataset scale, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares multiple coding agents and shows that intermediate GTs expose failure modes hidden by final pass/fail scores.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和诊断协议；对预训练没直接动作，但能校准 coding agent eval 是否只在测补丁运气。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and diagnosis protocol; it will not change pretraining, but it helps calibrate whether coding-agent evals are just testing patch luck.

paper.title: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
paper.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models has transformed survey writing from a months-long manual effort into an automated process. As generation scales, reliable evaluation becomes the bottleneck, and LLMs are increasingly used as survey evaluators. However, existing approaches largely rely on off-the-shelf LLM-as-a-judge methods without systematic alignment to human reviewers, and there remains a lack of systematic frameworks for quantifying alignment with human reviewers. To address thi

summary.core_problem: 如何把“survey 论文评审”这件事从松散的 LLM-as-a-judge 提示工程，变成一个可度量、可复现、能对齐真实人类审稿人的评测任务：既要输出多维度分数，也要给出可用的维度化理由，并且能用误差指标量化与人类审稿的一致性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接增益有限，但对“评测信号如何结构化、如何把人类评审文本变成可学习的监督/对齐目标”有参考价值。它提供了一个相对少见的资产形态：从真实 peer-review 报告抽取维度分数与理由，并用 MSE/MAE 这类回归误差显式度量 judge 与人类的偏差。若团队在做 LLM judge、reward model、或面向写作/长文生成的评测体系，这种“维度化评分 + 解释 + 对齐误差”的框架可迁移；但它不触及 tokenizer、scaling law、训练稳定性等预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 数据与标注：收集 675 篇 survey 论文与 1,630 份真实评审报告；将自由文本评语结构化为四个稳定维度：Readability（可读性）、Structure（结构）、Comprehensiveness（覆盖全面性）、Criticalness（批判性/分析深度）。关键在于把“审稿人怎么说”转成“每维分数 + 该维理由”的统一表示，便于训练与评测。
