summary.technical_approach: 提出了 SCHEMA 框架，核心是拓扑感知的评测和反事实归因。首先通过自动化 pipeline 构建科学概念图谱；然后基于图谱生成多跳推理和实验执行任务；最后，设计了一个多智能体协作的反事实推理机制（Abduction-Intervention-Prediction），通过系统性地替换轨迹中的幻觉声明，定位幻觉发生的具体步骤并诊断其因果机制。
summary.experiments: 构建了生物医学领域的 benchmark。实验揭示了科学幻觉主要源于领域先验知识的缺陷和概念间连通性的薄弱。特别是拓扑中心概念上的错误，会引发推理链条上的级联失败。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 2 中关于反事实归因（Counterfactual Attribution）的具体实现，特别是多智能体（solver, validator, planner）如何协作完成轨迹编辑和根因定位。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent hallucination evaluations operate at an isolated query level, failing to capture how a single conceptual error cascades through reasoning chains in complex domains like scientific research, where knowledge is topologically interconnected.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a paradigm shift from surface-level accuracy metrics to mechanism-level attribution. It provides methodological insights for building more robust scientific reasoning agents during pre- and post-training, and for designing long-horizon evaluations beyond single-step QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SCHEMA framework, centered on topology-aware evaluation and counterfactual attribution. It first builds a scientific concept graph via an automated pipeline, then generates multi-hop reasoning and experimental tasks. Crucially, it employs a multi-agent counterfactual reasoning mechanism (Abduction-Intervention-Prediction) to systematically edit trajectories, replacing hallucinated claims to isolate the exact step and causal mechanism of the failure.
summary_en.experiments: Constructed a biomedical benchmark. Findings reveal that scientific hallucinations stem primarily from flawed domain priors and weak conceptual interconnectivity. Errors on topologically central concepts trigger cascading failures across reasoning chains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the implementation of Counterfactual Attribution, specifically how the multi-agent system (solver, validator, planner) collaborates for trajectory editing and root cause localization. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读任务构造和指标定义即可；它提醒 agent eval 不能只看平均准确率。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and metrics; the useful signal is that agent evaluation should not stop at mean accuracy.

paper.title: Measuring in-context algorithmic reasoning in language models against an exact Bayes-optimal standard
paper.abstract: Whether large language models perform genuine algorithmic reasoning or mere pattern completion is hard to test, because most benchmarks lack a ground truth for correct inductive inference. We introduce F-ICL, an in-context-learning benchmark that supplies one exactly. Using the Turing-complete machine F, complement-symmetrised into sF to remove output-polarity bias, we exhaustively enumerate all 1.5 billion programs of length $L\le13$ and compute the Bayes-optimal posterior in closed form under

summary.core_problem: 如何判断 LLM 的 in-context learning 是真正的算法归纳推理，还是表面模式匹配？现有 benchmark 缺少一个关于「给定证据后理想推断应该是什么」的精确 ground truth，模型只能和其他模型或人类答案比较，无法和正确后验比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值偏分析侧而非训练侧。它把 Solomonoff 归纳推理从理论拉到一个可计算、可验证的小规模基准上，给出了一个无调参的 Bayes 最优后验作为标尺，可以用来量化 ICL 收敛速度、归纳偏置和 token 分布与算法先验的偏离。对研究 ICL 机制、预训练数据如何塑造隐式归纳偏置、以及 LM-as-compression 这条线有参考意义，但不直接给出训练改进方案。
summary.technical_approach: 选了一个极小的图灵完备纸带自动机 F（Brainfuck 家族，5 条指令），穷举长度 L≤13 的全部约 15 亿个程序，按有界 universal (Levin–Solomonoff) 先验加权。由于穷举是精确的，程序行为到先验质量的映射就是充分统计量，任意 few-shot 上下文的后验预测可以闭式算出。为消除输出极性偏置，把 F 补对称化为 sF，每个任务配一个按位补码的 twin，最优分数在两者上相同，original-twin gap 就隔离出模型自身的归纳偏置。用 GPU 加速穷举 + 独立 Python 参考实现 + 逐字节交叉校验来认证 ground truth。评测用有界对称散度衡量模型服务分布与最优后验的距离，给出难度感知分数和 facet profile，覆盖 induction、continuation、abduction 三类任务。
summary.experiments: 穷举规模 15 亿程序（L≤13）。在一系列开源和前沿 LLM 上评测，结论是：开源模型能跟住最优趋势但远未达到 Bayes 效率——简单任务能解，困难任务需要的示例数远超必要，且 token 级分布在高置信处与算法先验不匹配。F-ICL 能把 Bayes-rational 推理和强启发式 foil 区分开。具体模型分数和消融在正文结果部分给出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 中关于「为什么需要精确后验标准」的论证，再看 Methods 里 F 自动机定义、补对称化 sF 和后验闭式计算的部分。图表重点关注难度-散度曲线和 original-twin gap。对预训练研究员，真正值得想的是：这种 Bayes 最优标尺能否用来诊断预训练数据 mixture 对隐式归纳偏置的影响，而不只是评测现成模型。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to tell whether an LLM's in-context learning reflects genuine algorithmic induction or surface pattern matching? Existing benchmarks lack a precise ground truth for what the ideal inference from given evidence should be, so models can only be compared against other models or human answers, never against the correct posterior.
summary_en.importance: The value is analytical rather than recipe-level. It brings Solomonoff induction from theory to a computable, certifiable small-scale benchmark, providing a parameter-free Bayes-optimal posterior as a yardstick. This lets researchers quantify ICL convergence speed, inductive bias, and the divergence of token-level distributions from an algorithmic prior. It is relevant to work on ICL mechanisms, how pretraining data shapes implicit inductive bias, and the LM-as-compression line, but it does not directly propose a training improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: A minimal Turing-complete tape automaton F (Brainfuck family, five instructions) is fixed, and all ~1.5 billion programs of length L≤13 are exhaustively enumerated under a bounded universal (Levin–Solomonoff) prior. Because enumeration is exact, the map from program behavior to prior mass is a sufficient statistic, and the posterior predictive for any few-shot context is computed in closed form. To remove output-polarity bias, F is complement-symmetrized into sF; each task is paired with its bitwise complement twin, on which the optimum scores identically, so the original-twin gap isolates the model's own inductive bias. Ground-truth certification uses GPU-accelerated enumeration, an independent pure-Python reference, and exact cross-checks (byte-for-byte agreement of per-output program counts, witness re-execution, bit-identical posterior agreement). Models are scored with a bounded symmetric divergence against the optimal posterior, summarized by a difficulty-aware score and facet profile across induction, continuation, and abduction tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Enumeration covers 1.5 billion programs at L≤13. Across a panel of open-weight and frontier LLMs, open models track the optimal trend but fall well short of Bayes efficiency: they solve easy tasks, need far more examples than necessary on harder ones, and produce token-level distributions that are confidently mismatched with the algorithmic prior. F-ICL separates Bayes-rational inference from strong heuristic foils. Per-model scores and ablations are in the results section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Start with the Introduction's argument for why an exact posterior standard is needed, then the Methods section defining the F automaton, the sF complement symmetrization, and the closed-form posterior. Focus on figures showing difficulty-vs-divergence curves and the original-twin gap. For pretrain researchers, the productive question is whether such a Bayes-optimal yardstick can diagnose how pretraining data mixture shapes implicit inductive bias, rather than only evaluating finished models. Estimated 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用算法信息论构造贝叶斯最优 ICL 参照系的思路很干净，重点看 §3 基准构造和 Fig 5 模型偏离度分析。
recommendation.en: Clean approach to building a Bayes-optimal ICL reference via algorithmic information theory; focus on §3 benchmark construction and Fig. 5 model deviation analysis.

paper.title: Style Wins, Substance Loses: A Diagnosis of LLM-as-Judge in Idea Generation
paper.abstract: However, whether these judges truly evaluate the scientific substance of ideas or are influenced by superficial stylistic presentation remains an open question. To address this question, we propose SciStyleBench, a unified three-component benchmark for diagnosing and mitigating stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation: (i) First, SciStyleStage, a three-stage evaluation environment that applies controlled stylistic perturbations to fixed scientific content across three settings no context, fix

summary.core_problem: 诊断 LLM-as-Judge 在科学创意评估中是否真正评价内容实质，还是被表面文风所左右。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献与评测方法创新：构建了可控文风扰动的科学创意评估基准，并给出风格偏倚、实质识别率、对抗胜率等量化指标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SciStyleBench 三件套：1) SciStyleStage 在三种上下文设置下对固定科学内容施加 15 种文风扰动，覆盖 600 个科学创意、每设置 9000 条评估样本；2) SciStyleMetrics 用 SBI/SRR/AWR 量化风格偏倚、实质区分能力和排序鲁棒性；3) SciStyleExtractor 作为即插即用的去偏评估模块。
summary.experiments: 在无上下文、固定领域上下文、开放检索上下文三种设置下评测主流 judge 模型，系统暴露 LLM judge 对文风的偏好强于对科学实质的区分能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Diagnoses whether LLM-as-Judge in scientific idea generation evaluates substantive merit or is primarily driven by superficial stylistic presentation.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and evaluation methodology contribution: introduces a controlled stylistic-perturbation benchmark for scientific idea evaluation with dedicated bias-metrics and a debiasing module.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SciStyleBench with three components: SciStyleStage applies 15 style variants to fixed scientific content across three context settings (600 ideas, 9,000 instances per setting); SciStyleMetrics defines Style Bias Index, Substance Recognition Rate, and Adversarial Win Rate; SciStyleExtractor is a plug-and-play debiasing evaluator.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates mainstream judge models under no-context, fixed-domain-context, and open-retrieval-context settings; results systematically show LLM judges favor style over scientific substance.

recommendation.zh: 做对齐或自动评测的人重点看 §3 的指标定义和 §5 的偏倚模式，可直接迁移到内部 judge 质检流程。
recommendation.en: For alignment or auto-eval work, focus on §3 metric definitions and §5 bias patterns; they are directly portable to internal judge quality-control pipelines.

paper.title: Illuminating Visual Identity in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
paper.abstract: Universal Multimodal Embeddings (UMEs) aim to unify various modalities and tasks into a shared representation space. In recent years, this field has witnessed substantial progress driven by the development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, a crucial capability, visual identity discrimination, remains underexplored in existing UME methods, despite its critical role in a wide range of tasks, including instance retrieval, re-identification, and identity preservation in AI-genera

summary.core_problem: 解决通用多模态 embedding 对视觉身份区分能力评测不足的问题，尤其是实例检索、重识别和生成内容身份保持中的 identity discrimination。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏 benchmark 和表示学习。它把 visual identity discrimination 作为 UME 的一个缺口单独定义，并构建 MVEB，用真实和合成数据支持评测与训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VisID 的统一任务表述，并发布 Multimodal Visual Identity Embedding Benchmark。方法上还给出一个联合优化框架，同时学习通用多模态表示和视觉身份表示；从摘要看更像在现有 UME/MLLM 表示体系上补齐 identity 维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。实验应围绕 MVEB 上的身份判别、实例检索、re-identification 和 identity preservation 能力展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the missing visual identity discrimination capability in universal multimodal embeddings, especially for instance retrieval, re-identification, and identity preservation in generated content.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and representation-learning formulation. It defines VisID as a distinct evaluation axis for UMEs and introduces MVEB, built from real-world and synthetic datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified formulation for visual identity discrimination and a learning framework that jointly optimizes general multimodal representations and identity-sensitive visual representations. The work appears to extend existing UME/MLLM embedding systems rather than introduce a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, baseline names, or numerical gains. Evaluation is centered on MVEB and visual identity tasks such as retrieval, re-ID, and identity preservation.

recommendation.zh: 这是 UME 的身份维度补洞，适合作为多模态 embedding 评测备查；不必读训练细节。
recommendation.en: This fills an identity-evaluation gap for UMEs; keep it as a multimodal embedding benchmark reference, but skip the training details.

paper.title: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should generate consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很明确：多模态大模型在面对语义等价、但呈现模态不同的输入时，预测并不稳定。具体说，同一句题目里把“可视觉化的概念”从文字换成对应图片后，模型常常从答对变成答错。作者把这种现象定义为 modality gap，并把它从一个零散观察变成了可系统测量、可训练干预的问题。关键不在于模型会不会看图，而在于模型是否真正学到了“语义跨模态不变性”：同一概念以文本 token 或视觉 token 出现时，后续推理链条应尽量一致。对 MLLM 预训练来说，这是比传统 VQA 准确率更基础的能力约束。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它提出了一个比常规图文 benchmark 更贴近统一建模目标的诊断维度：不是测“图像是否提供额外信息”，而是测“图像替换文本后语义是否保持”。这直接对应 native multimodal pretraining 是否真的把不同模态映射到兼容表示空间。第二，作者给出的结果说明，modality gap 在 42 个模型上普遍存在，平均掉点 19.6%，而且单靠更大训练算力、CoT、few-shot 都很难补上，这说明问题更像训练目标和数据分布错配，而不是提示词技巧不足。第三，作者进一步证明可以在 pre-training 和 post-training 两个阶段用 TokenSwap 数据增强来缩小 gap，且不明显伤害文本能力和常规视觉语言能力。这一点对数据配比、跨模态 curriculum、以及 post-train 是否能修补 pretrain 缺口，都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 TokenSwap：从纯文本样本中找出可视觉化、且对任务有贡献的概念，把这些概念替换成语义对齐的自然图像，形成 image-interleaved 输入。它不是把整段文字渲染成图片，也不是构造传统图文问答，而是在 token/phrase 粒度做替换，尽量保持原始句法结构、上下文和推理负担不变。这样做的好处是控制变量更干净：文本版和多模态版之间，唯一主要变化就是某些语义单元从文字 token 变成视觉 token。

构建 TokenSwap-Bench 时，作者以 MMLU 为底座，经过三步处理。第一步，用 Gemini-2.0-Flash 识别题目和选项中可视觉化的概念，通常是具体实体或视觉可落地的短语。第二步，用文生图模型为每个概念生成对应图像。第三步，做一套比较严格的过滤，避免 benchmark 测到的是图像生成噪声而不是模态差异。这里有几个过滤点比较关键：
1. 图像忠实性验证：检查生成图像是否真的表达了目标概念，且在当前语境下不改变原意。
2. 任务相关性验证：把被替换概念从原文本里删掉，若模型性能不受影响，则说明这些概念并不关键，这类样本会被过滤掉。这样可以避免“替了也无所谓”的伪 gap。
3. 语义可恢复性验证：对替换后的图像做 caption，再把 caption 填回文本，检查是否能恢复原语义，尽量保证视觉替换不是不可逆的信息损失。

训练干预部分，作者不是提出新架构，而是提出一种数据增强思路：把 text-only 数据和 image-interleaved 对应样本一起用于训练。论文强调这种增强既可用于 pre-training，也可用于 post-training。它背后的假设很朴素：如果模型在训练中反复看到“同一语义内容以文本和视觉两种 token 形式出现”，就会被迫学习更稳定的跨模态表示与推理路径。相比只靠图文对齐 loss 或 caption-style 数据，这种做法更直接地监督“替换不变性”。
summary.experiments:
实验最重要的结论有四个。

第一，modality gap 普遍且幅度不小。作者在 42 个 MLLM 上测试，文本输入换成 image-interleaved 输入后，性能下降范围是 4.2% 到 47.4%，平均下降 19.6%，并给出 ±3.3% 的 95% 置信区间。这个量级已经不是边角误差，而是会系统影响多模态推理可靠性的缺口。

第二，reasoning-oriented 模型 gap 明显更小。文中报告 reasoning 模型平均 gap 约 10.1%，非 reasoning 模型约 25.5%。这说明较小的 gap 可能不是来自推理提示词，而是来自训练阶段的特殊机制，比如更强的中间过程监督、更多跨模态 reasoning 数据、或更强调一致性的后训练配方。

第三，常见 prompting 手段帮助有限。无论是 chain-of-thought 还是 few-shot，都不能稳定缩小 gap。这个结果很重要，因为它把问题从“推理时没想清楚”转回“表示层和训练分布没对齐”。

第四，单纯扩大训练算力收益很弱。作者提到训练 FLOPs 增加 10 倍，gap 只大约缩小 2.8%。这说明 scaling 对这个问题不是主解，至少在现有数据和目标下，模型不会自然学到足够强的跨模态不变性。

在训练增强实验里，TokenSwap 数据在 pre-training 和 post-training 两个阶段都能有效减小 modality gap，同时不牺牲 text-only 或常规 vision-language 表现，部分设置下还有轻微增益。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整表格数字，但从作者的表述看，结论不是“只在单一模型上有效”，而是具有一定普适性。阅读时应重点核对：不同模型规模、不同训练阶段、不同增强比例下，gap 缩小幅度是否稳定；以及 text-only / VL benchmark 是否真的没有明显回退。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题定义—benchmark 构造—现象分析—训练修复”四步来读。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2。这里把问题讲得最清楚：什么叫 modality gap，为什么 TokenSwap 比把整段文本变图片更干净，以及最终 benchmark 长什么样。

然后看 TokenSwap-Bench 构造细节，尤其是过滤流程。这里决定 benchmark 是否可信。重点看：概念抽取标准、图像生成质量控制、task relevance 检验、semantic recoverability 检验。如果这些环节不严，gap 可能只是替换噪声。

接着看 42 个模型的大表和 reasoning vs non-reasoning 的分组结果。这里最值得深挖的是：哪些模型 gap 小，是否与训练数据、视觉 encoder、interleaved pretraining、后训练 recipe 有对应关系。若正文或附录给了按架构、机构、训练范式的拆分，建议细看。

最后看训练增强实验。重点不是“能不能涨分”，而是三件事：一，pre-train 和 post-train 哪个阶段更有效；二，是否存在 text-only 能力回退；三，增强样本比例和收益是否线性。预计泛读 25–35 分钟，若要判断是否值得在自家配方里复现，过滤流程和训练实验至少要精读一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in multimodal LLMs: they often change their prediction when semantically equivalent text spans are replaced by aligned images. The authors call this the modality gap. The key issue is not generic image understanding, but semantic invariance across modalities. If a concept appears as text tokens in one prompt and as visual tokens in another, a well-trained MLLM should preserve the same reasoning trajectory and final answer. The paper turns this from an anecdotal observation into a measurable benchmarked problem, and then asks whether training can reduce it.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is fairly direct. First, it introduces a diagnostic that is closer to the goal of unified multimodal modeling than standard vision-language benchmarks. Instead of testing whether images add complementary information, it tests whether images can substitute text without breaking semantics. That probes whether pretraining actually learned compatible cross-modal representations. Second, the empirical result is strong enough to matter: across 42 MLLMs, the average drop is 19.6%, and neither scaling, CoT, nor few-shot prompting fixes much of it. That points to a training-distribution and objective mismatch rather than an inference-time prompting issue. Third, the paper shows that TokenSwap-style augmentation can reduce the gap in both pre-training and post-training without hurting text-only or standard VL performance. That makes it relevant to data mixture design, multimodal curriculum, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central method is TokenSwap. Starting from a text-only sample, the pipeline identifies visualizable concepts that matter for the task, replaces them with semantically aligned natural images, and keeps the surrounding text unchanged. This is different from rendering the whole prompt as an image or building a conventional image-question pair. The replacement happens at the concept or phrase level, so the text-only and multimodal versions remain structurally close. That gives a cleaner controlled test: the main change is that some semantic units move from text tokens to visual tokens.

TokenSwap-Bench is built on top of MMLU. The construction has three main stages. First, Gemini-2.0-Flash is used to identify concepts in questions and answer options that can be visually grounded. Second, each concept is turned into an image with a text-to-image model. Third, the benchmark applies several filters to ensure that measured gaps are not artifacts of poor substitutions. The important filters are:
1. Faithfulness verification: the generated image must correctly represent the intended concept in context.
2. Task relevance verification: if removing the replaced concepts from the original text does not affect prediction, the sample is not useful for measuring a meaningful gap and is filtered out.
3. Semantic recoverability: the substituted image is captioned and the caption is inserted back into text form to check whether the original semantics can be recovered.

The training-side intervention is data-centric rather than architectural. The authors augment training with image-interleaved counterparts of text data, and they test this both in pre-training and post-training settings. The intuition is simple and plausible: repeated exposure to semantically matched text and image realizations should force the model to learn more stable cross-modal representations and more consistent reasoning under token-type substitution. Compared with generic image-text alignment losses or caption-style supervision, this directly targets substitution invariance.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four main empirical takeaways.

First, the modality gap is pervasive and large. Across 42 MLLMs, replacing text spans with aligned images causes performance drops ranging from 4.2% to 47.4%, with an average decrease of 19.6% and a reported 95% confidence interval of ±3.3%. This is not a small robustness issue; it is a systematic reliability problem.

Second, reasoning-oriented models show much smaller gaps. The paper reports an average gap of about 10.1% for reasoning models versus 25.5% for non-reasoning models. That suggests the difference is likely due to training-time mechanisms rather than prompting alone, such as stronger process supervision, more multimodal reasoning data, or post-training recipes that implicitly enforce consistency.

Third, common prompting strategies do not reliably solve the problem. Chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting provide limited benefit. This matters because it shifts the diagnosis away from inference-time reasoning and toward representation learning and training distribution.

Fourth, scaling compute helps only marginally. A 10× increase in training FLOPs reduces the gap by only about 2.8%. So this is not something current scaling trends fix automatically.

On the mitigation side, TokenSwap augmentation reduces the modality gap in both pre-training and post-training while preserving text-only and standard vision-language performance, with slight gains in some cases. The excerpt does not include all table values, so the exact effect sizes should be checked in the full results. The key things to verify are consistency across model sizes, sensitivity to augmentation ratio, and whether the claimed no-regression result on text-only tasks really holds.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in four passes: problem definition, benchmark construction, empirical diagnosis, and training mitigation.

Start with the introduction and Figures 1 and 2. They explain the problem crisply: what the modality gap is, why concept-level swapping is cleaner than full prompt rendering, and what the benchmark examples look like.

Then read the TokenSwap-Bench construction carefully. This is where benchmark credibility lives. Focus on concept extraction, image generation quality control, task-relevance filtering, and semantic recoverability checks. If these are weak, the measured gap could just reflect substitution noise.

Next, inspect the large-scale evaluation across 42 models, especially the reasoning vs non-reasoning split. The most useful question is which training choices correlate with smaller gaps: interleaved multimodal pretraining, stronger reasoning supervision, different visual encoders, or post-training recipes.

Finally, read the training augmentation section. The important questions are not just whether scores improve, but where the gain comes from: pre-training vs post-training, whether text-only capability regresses, and how the benefit scales with augmentation ratio. A skim should take about 25–35 minutes. For replication decisions, the benchmark filtering details and the training ablations deserve a close read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“多模态只是把图塞进上下文”这个幻觉戳破了；读定义和主表就够，训练结论先别外推过头。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it punctures the illusion that multimodality is just text reasoning with images inserted; the definition and main table are enough, but do not overgeneralize the training implications.

paper.title: DungeonBench: A Benchmark for Rules-Rich Tactical Reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons Combat
paper.abstract: Games and simulators make valuable benchmarks by turning decisions into measurable outcomes, but many current suites under-test rules-rich tactical reasoning: the ability to choose well when geometry, timing, resources, objectives, and rule interactions all matter at once. We introduce DungeonBench, a benchmark for tactical reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons combat, built to cover the vast majority of combat-relevant 2014 System Reference Document content whose effects can be resolved by the simula

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM/agent 在规则密集、资源受限、时序与空间耦合的战术推理场景中的真实决策能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。它补的是现有游戏/模拟器评测对 rules-rich tactical reasoning 覆盖不足的问题，对 agent 评测设计有参考价值，但与基座预训练距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DungeonBench，以 Dungeons & Dragons 战斗为环境，尽量覆盖 2014 SRD 中可由模拟器解析的大部分战斗规则。每一步提供完整战术观察、待决策状态和可执行动作列表，要求模型在移动、攻击、法术、反应、资源与未来遭遇之间做价值判断。
summary.experiments: 包含两个 track，并在统一协议下评测模型/agent 的战术决策表现。摘要未给出具体参评模型、分数区间和误差分析，但从设计上看更强调规则交互复杂度而非开放式文本生成。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether LLMs/agents can perform tactical reasoning under dense rules, scarce resources, temporal constraints, and spatial interactions.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It fills a gap left by existing game/simulator evaluations that under-test rules-rich tactical reasoning. Useful for agent evaluation design, but only loosely connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: DungeonBench builds a Dungeons & Dragons combat benchmark covering most combat-relevant 2014 SRD content that can be resolved by a simulator. At each step, the model receives a tactical observation, a pending decision, and an indexed set of legal actions spanning movement, attacks, spells, reactions, objectives, and resource use.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark includes two tracks and evaluates model/agent tactical decision quality under a unified protocol. The abstract does not provide detailed model lists or score ranges, but the setup clearly emphasizes rule interaction complexity rather than open-ended generation.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent eval 题材有点新意，但离 pretrain 很远；只需看任务接口和失败类型，别在具体分数上花时间。
recommendation.en: The setting is fresh for agent eval, but it is far from pretraining; inspect the task interface and failure modes, not the leaderboard details.

paper.title: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
paper.abstract: As LLMs evolve from code completion systems into autonomous scientific agents, evaluating their ability to conduct experiments has become increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically focus on static code generation, paper replication, or final answer correctness, but do not directly assess whether agents can interpret experimental evidence and use it to guide subsequent hyperparameter decisions. To address this gap, we introduce AgentHPOBench, a sequential benchmark comprising 30 execut

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM agent 是否具备顺序式实验优化能力，而不只是一次性生成代码或给出最终答案。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向 scientific agent 的 benchmark，贡献在评测协议而非方法本身。对研究“模型能否根据实验反馈更新后续决策”这个问题有价值，但对预训练研究员更多是外围信息。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentHPOBench，包含 30 个可执行机器学习任务，覆盖 7 类研究场景。每个任务从一个已验证 baseline run 开始，agent 需要多轮读取历史配置、指标和日志，再提出下一组合法超参数，形成 sequential intervention setting。
summary.experiments: 在统一协议下评测 12 个常用 agents，并与传统 HPO baseline 对比。结果表明当前 agents 已有一定实验优化能力，但仍明显落后于专门 HPO 方法。摘要未给出具体领先方法和量化差距。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Jie Zhou、Xuanjing Huang，通常与阿里巴巴达摩院/复旦大学相关；仅从给定信息无法完全确认具体机构归属。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents can perform sequential experimental optimization rather than merely generate code or output a final answer.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution for scientific agents, centered on protocol design rather than a new method. It is useful for studying whether models can update decisions from experimental feedback, but it is peripheral to pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentHPOBench contains 30 executable ML tasks across seven categories. Each task starts from a validated baseline run, after which an agent repeatedly observes accumulated configurations, metrics, and logs, and proposes the next valid hyperparameter configuration in a sequential intervention loop.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 12 widely used agents under a unified protocol and compares them with conventional HPO baselines. The main takeaway is that current agents show measurable optimization ability but still trail specialized HPO methods. The abstract does not provide exact margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jie Zhou and Xuanjing Huang, often associated with DAMO Academy and Fudan University, though the exact affiliations cannot be fully confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 这是个像样的 sequential agent eval，但和基座训练接口不深；看 benchmark protocol 和 agent-vs-HPO gap 就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a decent sequential-agent benchmark, but it does not connect deeply to foundation training; the protocol and the agent-vs-HPO gap are the only parts worth checking.

paper.title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
paper.abstract: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each f

summary.core_problem: 构造一个匹配式改写基准，评估 AI 文本检测器在 LLM 改写人类文本和改写 LLM 文本时是否仍然可靠。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 贡献。它补上了常规 AI 文本检测评测的缺口：传统设置通常比较人写文本和直接生成文本，但真实风险常出现在人类文本被 LLM 改写之后。
summary.technical_approach: ARB 从 XSum、WritingPrompts、OpenWebText 各取 600 篇人类源文本，共 1,800 篇，并用 Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B 生成匹配变体。每个源样本包含 HUMAN、Free-LLM、H2L、LLM2L 四类版本，用于控制主题和作者来源差异。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个检测器：FastDetectGPT、Binoculars-falcon-7b、RADAR、BERT-Defense、RoBERTa-Defense，并采用严格的 TPR@1%FPR 操作点。摘要说明检测器在传统直接生成设置上的表现不能直接代表改写场景表现，但截断信息未给出完整数值结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a matched benchmark for testing whether AI-text detectors remain reliable when human-authored text is rewritten by LLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation dataset. It targets a gap in standard detector benchmarks, which usually compare human text with direct LLM generations and may not reflect the more realistic rewriting setting.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARB uses 1,800 human source texts, with 600 items each from XSum, WritingPrompts, and OpenWebText. Four open-weight generators—Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, and Gemma-2-9B—produce matched variants: HUMAN, Free-LLM, H2L, and LLM2L.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates FastDetectGPT, Binoculars-falcon-7b, RADAR, BERT-Defense, and RoBERTa-Defense at TPR@1%FPR. The abstract indicates that conventional direct-generation performance does not fully predict rewriting behavior, but the provided excerpt is truncated before full numerical results.

recommendation.zh: 作为数据污染和合成文本检测的备查基准即可；它离预训练方法较远，不值得读正文。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for synthetic-text detection and data provenance; it is too far from pretraining methodology to warrant a full read.

paper.title: Autonomous Repair for Multi-Agent Systems via Monte-Carlo Tree Search
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly deployed to solve complex tasks. In case of incorrect or unsatisfactory outputs, users have to manually locate agent mistakes by inspecting agent trajectories (i.e., {\em failure attribution}) and provide feedback to refine the outputs (i.e., {\em repair}). Despite some recent work in MAS failure attribution, automated mechanisms to recover from such mistakes remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose MARS, a search-based framework that f

summary.core_problem: 多智能体系统输出错误时，缺乏自动化的故障修复机制，当前工作主要停留在故障归因阶段。
summary.importance: 方法创新+基准贡献：首次将MCTS引入多智能体系统自动修复，并发布含1310条可复现故障轨迹的StateMAS基准。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MARS框架，将多智能体修复建模为蒙特卡洛树搜索过程，采用诊断引导的扩展策略与分类增强评估，并用部分rollout替代完整模拟以降低token消耗。
summary.experiments: 构建StateMAS基准，覆盖4类智能体故障共1310条可回放轨迹；在该基准上验证MARS相比基线修复成功率更高且token成本更低。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent systems lack automated failure recovery mechanisms; existing work mostly stops at failure attribution.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation plus benchmark contribution: first to apply MCTS to multi-agent system repair, and releases StateMAS with 1,310 replayable failure trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: MARS formulates MAS repair as Monte-Carlo Tree Search with diagnosis-guided expansion and taxonomy-augmented evaluation; it uses partial rollout instead of full simulation to reduce token cost.
summary_en.experiments: StateMAS benchmark covers 4 agent failure types with 1,310 replayable trajectories; MARS achieves higher repair success rate and lower token cost than baselines on this benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体修复方向的增量工作，MCTS+部分rollout的思路可作为agent自修复的弱参考，看摘要和基准描述即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multi-agent repair; the MCTS + partial rollout idea is a weak reference for agent self-repair, read only abstract and benchmark description.

paper.title: IFHierBench: Hierarchical Instruction Following for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Instruction-following ability is critical for deploying large language models in real-world applications, where downstream components depend on the output satisfying specific constraints. Modern deployments increasingly handle the full task in a single LLM call, with one prompt specifying a layered output whose overall artifact, structural sections, and nested fields must each satisfy concrete constraints. Existing instruction-following benchmarks treat the constraint set as a flat list applied

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的“指令遵循”，而是更贴近真实生产提示词的分层约束遵循问题：一个长 prompt 往往同时规定整份输出的全局格式、某个 section 的局部结构、以及 section 内字段的细粒度内容要求。现有 IFEval、IFBench、ComplexBench 这类基准把约束视为平铺列表，检查时默认作用于整段输出，无法表达“某条约束只对某个嵌套区域生效”。这会系统性高估模型能力，因为模型即便没有生成正确的外层结构，只要在别处碰巧满足了内层关键词或长度要求，也可能被 flat checker 判为正确。IFHierBench 的核心问题，就是把 instruction following 从‘全局平面约束’推进到‘带作用域的层级约束’，并用确定性程序检查而不是 LLM judge 来避免评测噪声。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于把一个已经接近饱和的评测维度重新拉开。论文显示，现有模型在传统 instruction-following benchmark 上分数已经较高，但一旦要求模型同时维护外层结构、内层字段和局部内容约束，性能明显下滑，最强模型的 prompt-level accuracy 也只是略高于 50%。这说明当前模型的“遵循能力”很大一部分建立在平面化评测之上，而不是稳定的层级约束建模能力。对预训练和后训练都有启发：如果真实应用 prompt 越来越长、越来越结构化，那么训练目标、合成数据和对齐数据都需要显式覆盖 scoped constraints，而不是只做全局格式控制。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三层设计。第一层是结构约束 taxonomy 的构建。作者从 PromptSet 中抽取 GitHub 上 LLM 应用的 prompt template，经过仓库热度、长度和显式输出约束过滤后，保留 1,232 个模板，再用 GPT-5.4 辅助标注结构级输出格式，并人工审核新类别，最终得到 10 类 structure-level constraints。文中明确提到 free-form string 占 50.8%，其余高频类别包括 labeled sections、JSON、Markdown 等，这一步的意义是让 benchmark 的结构约束来自真实应用，而不是纯手工想象。

第二层是层级样本合成。作者不是直接手写 600 个 prompt，而是从 IFEval seed task 出发，构造 constraint tree。树的节点可以是结构约束，也可以是内容约束；采样采用 depth-first 方式，并用 sibling-conflict matrix 过滤互相冲突的兄弟约束，避免出现天然不可满足的 prompt。之后再把同层兼容约束合并成自然语言句子，渲染成单次调用场景下的长 prompt。这个设计比简单拼接约束更合理，因为它显式控制了树深、兄弟冲突和语言可读性。

第三层是分层 checker。每种约束都配一个 deterministic Python checker，最终沿 constraint tree 组合成 hierarchical checker。关键不只是“检查有没有满足”，而是先定位作用域，再在对应子区域内检查内容。例如先确认是否存在目标 section，再在该 section 内检查子标题、句数、关键词等。这样就避免了 flat benchmark 常见的 scope leakage。整体上，这篇工作的技术重点不在模型，而在 benchmark construction pipeline：真实约束抽取、层级树生成、作用域感知的程序化验证。
summary.experiments:
实验规模不大，但结论很清楚。基准共 600 个 prompt，按约束树深度 0 到 3 分层，每层 150 个；覆盖 35 种约束，其中 10 种是结构级、25 种是内容级。作者评测了 7 个主流模型。最关键的结果有两个：第一，最强模型的 prompt-level accuracy 也只是略高于 50%，远低于现有平面 instruction-following benchmark 上常见的高分；第二，随着 constraint depth 增加，准确率显著下降，说明模型不是简单地“多几个约束就差一点”，而是对嵌套作用域的维护能力在快速退化。

从论文给出的任务设定看，prompt-level accuracy 是严格指标：整棵树上的约束都满足才算正确，因此它比 token-level 或单约束平均准确率更能反映真实部署风险。更值得注意的是，作者强调 prior benchmarks 已接近饱和，而 IFHierBench 仍能把模型区分开，这说明难点确实来自 hierarchical scoping，而不是单纯增加 prompt 长度。若全文中提供了按结构类型、内容类型、深度分桶的细分结果，建议重点看哪些约束最先崩：通常会是外层结构缺失导致内层检查整体失效，或者模型生成了正确关键词但放错 section。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解 flat constraints 与 hierarchical constraints 的差别，这是整篇工作的立足点。然后看 benchmark construction：一是结构约束 taxonomy 的来源，二是 constraint tree synthesis 和 sibling-conflict matrix，这两处决定了数据是否真实、是否可满足。再看 checker 设计，确认它如何做 scope-aware verification，而不是简单正则匹配。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：按 depth 的准确率曲线、按约束类型的错误分布、以及与 IFEval/ComplexBench 的对比。如果时间有限，30 分钟足够抓住主线。若要判断它对训练有没有启发，再多看 appendix 里的 prompt 示例和 checker 细节，看看这些约束是否容易转成 SFT/RL 数据或合成 curriculum。一个值得深挖的问题是：模型失败究竟来自长程规划不足、结构 token 生成不稳定，还是训练数据里缺少显式的层级输出监督。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a more realistic form of instruction following: hierarchical, scope-aware constraints inside a single long prompt. In production prompts, constraints are often layered: the whole response must follow a global format, specific sections must satisfy local structural requirements, and nested fields must obey content-level rules. Existing benchmarks such as IFEval, IFBench, and ComplexBench flatten all constraints into a single list applied to the entire output. That setup cannot express scope, so it can overestimate model capability: an inner constraint may be marked correct even if the required outer section was never produced. IFHierBench is built to measure instruction following under nested scopes with deterministic verification.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly evaluative, but the implication reaches pretraining and post-training. Current models appear close to saturation on flat instruction-following benchmarks, yet they drop sharply once constraints become hierarchical. The strongest model only slightly exceeds 50% prompt-level accuracy on this benchmark. That suggests current alignment pipelines teach models to satisfy visible surface constraints, but not to reliably maintain scoped structure across nested regions. For foundation-model work, this matters because real prompts are becoming longer, more structured, and more single-shot. If the deployment interface shifts in that direction, training data and objectives need explicit coverage of scoped constraints rather than only global formatting behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The benchmark has three main components. First, the authors derive a structure-level constraint taxonomy from real prompts. They start from PromptSet, filter GitHub LLM application prompts by repository popularity, prompt length, and explicit output constraints, and retain 1,232 prompt templates. GPT-5.4 is used to annotate output-format constraints, with manual review for new categories. This yields 10 structure-level constraint types grounded in actual application prompts rather than purely synthetic design.

Second, they synthesize hierarchical prompts as constraint trees. Starting from IFEval seed tasks, they sample trees in a depth-first manner, while a sibling-conflict matrix prevents incompatible sibling constraints from co-occurring. Compatible sibling constraints are then merged into natural-language instructions so the final prompt resembles a realistic single-call specification rather than a raw concatenation of rules.

Third, they build deterministic hierarchical checkers. Each constraint type has a Python checker, and these are composed along the tree. The key idea is scope-aware verification: the checker first identifies the relevant region, then evaluates inner constraints only within that region. This avoids the scope leakage that affects flat benchmarks. The technical contribution is therefore not a new model, but a careful benchmark-construction pipeline: real-world constraint extraction, tree-based synthesis, and deterministic scoped checking.
summary_en.experiments:
The benchmark contains 600 prompts, evenly stratified across constraint-tree depths 0 through 3, with 150 prompts per depth. It covers 35 constraints in total: 10 structure-level and 25 content-level. The paper evaluates seven leading models.

Two findings matter most. First, even the best model only slightly exceeds 50% prompt-level accuracy, far below the near-saturated numbers often seen on flat instruction-following benchmarks. Second, performance degrades sharply as hierarchy depth increases. This indicates that the difficulty is not just “more constraints,” but maintaining nested scope and structure over the full response.

Prompt-level accuracy is intentionally strict: a prompt is counted correct only if the entire constraint tree is satisfied. That makes the metric closer to deployment reality than averaging independent constraint checks. The most informative breakdowns are likely the depth-wise curves and the error categories where outer structural failures invalidate inner content checks. If the appendix includes prompt examples and checker traces, those are useful for understanding whether failures come from missing outer sections, misplaced content, or local keyword compliance without correct structure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the motivating example that contrasts flat versus hierarchical constraints. That is the conceptual center of the paper. Then read the benchmark construction section carefully: the structure-level taxonomy, the tree synthesis process, and the sibling-conflict matrix are what determine whether the benchmark is realistic and satisfiable. After that, inspect the checker design to see how scope-aware verification is implemented.

In the experiments, focus on three things: accuracy versus depth, breakdown by constraint type, and comparison against prior flat benchmarks. A quick read takes about 30 minutes. If you want to assess training implications, spend extra time on the prompt examples and checker details in the appendix. The main follow-up question is whether model failures are caused by weak long-range planning, unstable generation of structural tokens, or insufficient training data with explicit hierarchical supervision.

recommendation.zh: 结构化输出能力是SFT/后训练的核心指标之一，只看评测设计和最强模型50%准确率的结论即可，可用于内部对齐评测集设计参考。
recommendation.en: Structured output compliance is a core SFT/post-training metric; read only the benchmark design and the 50% top-model accuracy finding for internal alignment eval design reference.

paper.title: Skill Use or Skill Theater? Evaluating the Reasoning Backroom in Skill-Augmented Language Agents
paper.abstract: Reusable skills are becoming a standard interface for extending language agents with task procedures. Yet evaluators usually infer skill use from visible reasoning or the agent's own attribution. These signals show what the agent appears to use, not whether the skill changed its decision. We ask whether skill-augmented agents exhibit a \textbf{Reasoning Backroom}, a systematic gap between stated skill use and intervention-measured influence. We introduce BACKTRACE, an evaluation framework that p

summary.core_problem: 现有技能增强型语言智能体的评估依赖可见推理链或自报技能使用情况，无法验证技能是否真正因果性影响决策，"推理后室"（声明使用与实际因果影响的系统性偏差）的普遍程度未被量化。
summary.importance: 1. 揭示了智能体可观测推理信号与实际因果依赖的脱钩，对依赖推理轨迹做RLHF、技能注入、工具调用微调等预训练后流程的有效性评估有警示意义；2. 因果干预式的评估框架可用于验证技能学习、多智能体协作训练等方法的实际作用，而非仅看表面性能或自报归因；3. 多智能体场景下的归因失真问题，为多智能体预训练的评估设计提供了新的维度。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案为Backtrace评估框架，配套BackroomBench测试集。框架关键设计包括：1）先让智能体生成答案并锁定，之后再询问技能归因，避免归因问题影响决策；2）为每个带技能的测试样本匹配无技能的反事实对照组；3）对技能的语义、措辞、名称、内容、分配、通信路径做干预，通过不同干预下答案的变化计算技能的实际因果影响，而非依赖自报声明。BackroomBench覆盖逻辑推理和数学两个领域，包含单智能体和角色结构化多智能体两种配置，适配12种模型变体。该框架形式化了"推理后室"的多种表现形式：静默吸收（技能影响答案但未被声明）、表演性使用（声明使用但实际无影响）、影响传播（多智能体中技能影响传递但来源丢失）、归因错配等。
summary.experiments: 实验结果显示：1）在12种模型、两个领域、单/多智能体配置下，推理后室现象普遍存在，可见的技能声明稳定，但实际因果依赖和影响的正负性差异很大；2）智能体会静默吸收部分技能的影响，也会自信地引用实际没有作用的技能，还会遵循技能内容但识别不出真正起作用的组件；3）多智能体场景下偏差更大：技能影响在通信中保留但来源被混淆，智能体认错起作用的队友，无技能的团队也会声称使用了不存在的技能和来源；4）基于可见推理轨迹或显式技能声明训练的检测器无法有效识别这些错配。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐先读引言部分的"推理后室"问题定义，再读问题形式化章节快速理解核心洞察；实验部分重点看单/多智能体场景的主要发现，不需要深入推导细节。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of skill-augmented language agents rely on visible reasoning traces or self-reported skill usage, which cannot verify whether a skill causally influences the final decision, leaving the prevalence of the "Reasoning Backroom" (systematic gap between stated use and actual causal impact) unquantified.
summary_en.importance: 1. It reveals the decoupling between observable reasoning signals and actual causal dependencies in agent systems, which serves as a caution for evaluating post-pretraining pipelines that use reasoning traces for RLHF, skill injection, or tool-use fine-tuning; 2. The causal intervention framework provides a more rigorous way to validate the actual effect of skill learning and multi-agent collaboration training, rather than relying on surface-level performance or self-reported attribution; 3. The attribution distortion in multi-agent settings offers a new dimension for evaluation design of multi-agent pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Backtrace is an evaluation framework for causal skill attribution, paired with the BackroomBench testbed. Key design choices include: 1) Agents generate and commit to answers before being asked about skill usage, to prevent attribution queries from affecting decisions; 2) Each skill-conditioned run is paired with a matched no-skill counterfactual; 3) Interventions on skill semantics, wording, identity, content, assignment, and communication paths are used to measure actual causal influence instead of self-reported claims. BackroomBench covers logic reasoning and MATH domains, with both single-agent and role-structured multi-agent configurations across 12 model variants. Multiple manifestations of the Reasoning Backroom are formalized, including silent uptake, performative use, influence propagation, and contribution mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: Key experimental findings: 1) Across 12 model variants, two domains, and both single- and multi-agent settings, the Reasoning Backroom is pervasive: stated skill usage remains stable while causal reliance and the sign of skill impact vary substantially; 2) Agents silently absorb influence from some skills without acknowledgment, confidently cite inert skills that do not change outcomes, and follow procedural content without identifying the active component; 3) The gap widens in multi-agent systems: skill influence survives communication but its source is lost, agents misidentify which teammate contributed, and teams with no skills still claim to use non-existent skills and sources; 4) Detectors built from visible reasoning traces or explicit skill-use claims fail to resolve these mismatches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction for the definition of the Reasoning Backroom, then read the problem formulation section to grasp the core insight. For experiments, focus on the main findings in single- and multi-agent settings. Detailed derivations and minor ablation details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用反事实干预测技能真实因果影响，思路干净，对设计Agent评测和理解工具使用机制都有参考，重点看§3的干预设计。
recommendation.en: Clean counterfactual-intervention approach to measuring true causal impact of skills; useful for agent eval design and tool-use mechanism studies. Focus on §3 intervention design.

paper.title: An Empirical Study of Coordination Mode as the First-Class Citizen in From-Scratch Multi-Agent Coding
paper.abstract: Multi-agent vibe coding promises to accelerate software development, yet existing benchmarks rely on synthetic environments that ignore practical time and monetary costs, conflate reasoning with communication, and reward only superficial completion. We introduce multi-agent from-scratch evaluation benchmark, MSEval, evaluating multi-agent coding on real-world tasks. Grounded in 10 authentic, full-stack projects across 10 domains, MSEval scores performance using hierarchical requirements and dete

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体编码评测要么基于合成环境，要么固定单一协作模式，无法定量衡量在从零搭建真实软件项目时，协作拓扑、迭代反馈和成本开销对交付质量的实际影响。
summary.importance: 属于 multi-agent coding 的评测基础设施工作，对基座研究的直接启发有限，但在评测协议上提供了两个可迁移的想法：把协作模式作为一等自变量、把 wall-clock 与 token 成本作为与功能分并列的指标。对做长链路 agent post-training 或用代码/工程任务评估模型能力的研究者有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MSEval，包含 10 个真实 full-stack 项目、10 种协作拓扑（feature squad、layer specialist、pipeline handoff、swarming、rotation、PM oversight、QA-first、PR review、adversarial testing、competitive teams），配套运行时 LegoGent 支持有界同步、显式消息传递、CI/CD 部署和行为完成检查，以及自动 grader TAgent 对部署后的 UI/API/code 面进行探查，给出带权反馈，最多支持三轮迭代 refinement。评测同时记录功能分、延迟、token 使用量（含 prefix cache），用于刻画速度–成本–质量三者的权衡。
summary.experiments: 共构造 10 个项目 × 10 种协作模式 = 100 个 case 的评测网格。论文主要给出 benchmark 设计和框架性实证结论：协作拓扑、模型能力与项目领域共同决定 speed–cost–quality trade-off；不同模式并非单调优劣，存在明显的 domain–topology 交互。具体各模式相对提升数字在提供的全文片段中未展开。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看 Introduction 中与 SWE-bench、CloudDevBench、TheAgentCompany 的定位对比表，以及协作模式定义、指标设计（token cost / latency / iterative feedback）部分。方法实现细节（LegoGent 同步机制、TAgent 探查策略）可快速浏览。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent coding benchmarks either rely on synthetic environments or fix a single collaboration mode, making it impossible to quantitatively measure how coordination topology, iterative feedback, and cost affect delivery quality when building real software projects from scratch.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-infrastructure paper for multi-agent coding, with limited direct implications for base-model pretraining. Two ideas are transferable, however: treating coordination mode as a first-class independent variable, and reporting wall-clock latency and token cost alongside functional scores. It is relevant to researchers working on long-horizon agent post-training or using software-engineering tasks to evaluate model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MSEval, which consists of 10 realistic full-stack projects, 10 collaboration topologies (feature squads, layer specialists, pipeline handoff, swarming, rotation, PM oversight, QA-first, PR-style review, adversarial testing, competitive teams), a runtime called LegoGent that supports bounded synchronization, explicit peer messaging, CI/CD deployment, and behavioral completion checks, plus an automated grader TAgent that probes deployed UI/API/code surfaces and returns weighted feedback for up to three refinement rounds. Functional score, wall-clock latency, and token usage (including prefix-cache savings) are logged jointly to characterize the speed–cost–quality trade-off.
summary_en.experiments: A 10 × 10 evaluation grid is constructed, covering 100 cases across projects and collaboration modes. The paper reports benchmark design and framework-level empirical findings: topology, model capability, and project domain jointly determine the speed–cost–quality trade-off, and no single mode dominates uniformly; domain–topology interactions are substantial. Concrete per-mode performance numbers are not available in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the positioning table in the introduction (comparison with SWE-bench, CloudDevBench, TheAgentCompany), the definitions of collaboration modes, and the metric design (token cost, latency, iterative feedback). Implementation details of LegoGent synchronization and TAgent probing can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体编码评测的新范式，核心看§3协作拓扑设计与§5拓扑vs模型能力的对比结果，对RL后训练的多智能体数据构造有参考。
recommendation.en: New paradigm for multi-agent coding evaluation; focus on §3 topology design and §5 topology-vs-model-capability comparison, useful for multi-agent RL post-training data construction.

paper.title: Benchmarking LLM Competence on Logical Inference over Probability Operators
paper.abstract: Both expressions of uncertainty and inferences are ubiquitous in natural language, and valid inferences over natural-language expressions of uncertainty are necessary for not only everyday conversations but also for high-stakes domains such as medicine and law. While large language models are increasingly evaluated on logical reasoning tasks, disentangling principled, symbolic reasoning from clever surface-level pattern matching is fraught with difficulty. We introduce a benchmark for reasoning

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否真正掌握了自然语言中概率算子上的逻辑推断，而不是靠表面模式或答案偏置作答。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个程序化生成的逻辑推理 benchmark，并提出 competence floor 这种更稳健的度量，用来揭示 Yes/No 偏置掩盖下的真实能力；对推理评测设计有启发，但不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕 gradable epistemic modals（如 probably、might、must）构造 15 类推理模板、14,320 条英文样本，系统控制问句形式、否定策略和表层内容；在 29 个模型上评测，并用最差的 Yes/No 准确率定义 competence floor。
summary.experiments: 共 14,320 个程序生成样本、29 个模型。主要发现是多数模型存在与逻辑形式无关的 Yes/No 偏置，因此平均准确率会高估能力；competence floor 更能暴露真实下限。未见预训练规模或数据配比层面的实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Haverford College。未见顶级实验室背景，但问题设定较干净，偏评测方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can perform logical inference over probability operators in natural language, rather than exploiting surface patterns or answer biases.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a procedurally generated reasoning benchmark and a stricter metric, competence floor, that exposes hidden Yes/No biases. Useful for reasoning evaluation design, but not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: It creates 14,320 English prompts across 15 inference templates involving gradable epistemic modals such as probably, might, and must, while systematically varying question form, negation strategy, and surface content. It evaluates 29 models and defines competence floor as the worse of Yes- and No-conditioned accuracies.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 14,320 generated examples and covers 29 models. The key finding is that many models show strong Yes/No biases independent of logical form, so average accuracy overstates competence; competence floor better captures the true lower bound. There is no direct pretraining-scale or data-mixture study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Haverford College. No obvious major-lab affiliation, but the setup looks relatively clean and evaluation-focused.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但评测设计是干净的；只看 competence floor 的定义和偏置分析即可，能提醒你别再拿平均准确率当推理能力。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the eval setup is clean; read the competence-floor metric and bias analysis to avoid over-trusting average accuracy as reasoning ability.

paper.title: Can Agents Deceive? Evaluating Reasoning and Deception in ParliamentBench using a Social Deduction Game
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as agents in high-stakes settings, such as medical and legal systems, understanding their deceptive capabilities is fundamental to safety. Controlled social deduction games provide a reproducible proxy for isolating and evaluating these complex adversarial behaviors. We present the open-source benchmark framework ParliamentBench based on the game Secret Hitler to evaluate LLMs in scenarios that require deception, persuasion, and reasoning under inform

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在信息不对称、需要欺骗与说服的社会博弈中，是否真的具备稳定的推理与欺骗能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测工作，不是方法创新。它把“欺骗能力”从开放式安全讨论拉回到可复现实验环境，用社交推理游戏构造出更接近 agent 对抗场景的测试协议，并提出区分社交推理、欺骗一致性和总体表现的新指标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ParliamentBench，以 Secret Hitler 这类 social deduction game 为环境，让 16 个模型在 1600 局模拟对战中彼此博弈、与人类对战，并与线上真实游戏数据比较。核心做法是把角色信息不对称、公开发言、投票与策略性误导拆成可量化指标，而不是只看胜率。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 16 个 LLM、1600 场对局，设置包括模型互打、人与模型对战以及与在线游戏数据对照。结果显示前沿模型在合作与欺骗角色上形成明显头部集群，但从摘要看，论文更强调评测区分度，而不是给出机制解释或训练启示。未见与预训练配方、模型结构或数据因素的系统关联分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM agents can reliably reason and deceive under asymmetric information in a controlled social-deduction setting.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a modeling one. Its value is in turning vague safety concerns about deception into a reproducible benchmark with role asymmetry, persuasion, and strategic lying, plus metrics that separate reasoning from deceptive consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces ParliamentBench, built on a Secret Hitler-style game. Sixteen LLMs are evaluated across 1,600 matches in self-play, human-play, and comparisons against online game traces. The main design choice is to score social deduction, reasoning, and deception consistency separately instead of relying on win rate alone.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark covers 16 LLMs and 1,600 simulated games. Frontier models form a strong top cluster across cooperative and deceptive roles. From the abstract, the work appears useful as an eval asset, but it does not yet connect outcomes to pretraining data, architecture, or training dynamics in a clean causal way.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent safety eval 可以记住这套协议，但对基座预训练帮助有限；看指标设计和头部模型分层就够了，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful to bookmark as an agent-safety eval, but the pretraining signal is weak; the metric design and model stratification are the only parts worth skimming.

paper.title: SWE-NFI: Studying and Benchmarking Coding Agents for Non-Functional Improvements
paper.abstract: Although coding agents have achieved impressive performance on correctness-oriented benchmarks, their ability to make behavior-preserving non-functional improvements (NFIs) remains underexplored. In real-world software development, developers continuously improve software quality without changing observable behavior, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness and provide limited support for assessing these non-functional improvements.   In this paper, we present SWE-NFI, a

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评测 coding agents 做非功能性改进的 benchmark，而不只评估代码是否通过功能测试。
summary.importance: 贡献是 SWE/coding agent 评测资产。它补上了现有 correctness-oriented benchmark 的盲区：真实软件维护常常要求在行为不变的前提下改善质量、可维护性、性能或风格。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWE-NFI，从真实开源 Python 项目的已合并 pull requests 中构造 188 个任务，并把开发者导向的 non-functional improvements 操作化为 92 条可执行规则。评测同时包含功能正确性测试和规则化 NFI 检查。
summary.experiments: 评测了商业和开源 coding agents。摘要片段显示最佳 agent 在某个主要指标上达到 70.0%，但完整指标定义、各模型排名和失败类型需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on behavior-preserving non-functional improvements, beyond functional correctness.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation asset for SWE/coding agents. It targets a gap in correctness-oriented benchmarks: real software maintenance often requires quality improvements without observable behavioral changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-NFI contains 188 tasks derived from real merged pull requests in open-source Python projects. It operationalizes developer-oriented non-functional improvements into 92 executable rules and combines functional tests with rule-based NFI evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate commercial and open-source coding agents. The abstract fragment reports that the best-performing agent reaches 70.0% on a main metric, but the exact metric, model ranking, and failure taxonomy require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看任务构造和 92 条规则，能判断 coding posttrain 是否过拟合“修 bug”单一范式。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the task construction and 92 rules to see whether coding post-training is overfit to bug-fixing.

paper.title: RefCaptioner: Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
paper.abstract: Existing video captioning models generate natural descriptions of video content but cannot explicitly ground local visual elements to multiple reference images. We introduce multi-reference image-grounded video captioning, a new task requiring factual video descriptions with phrase-level reference grounding, and propose RefCaptioner, a two-stage post-training framework for this task. RefCaptioner combines mixed-data SFT with Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO to jointly improve reference sele

summary.core_problem: 解决视频字幕模型不能把局部视觉短语显式绑定到多张参考图的问题，目标是在生成视频描述时同时完成参考选择、短语级 grounding 和干扰参考拒绝。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态后训练任务定义、训练数据和评测资产：提出 multi-reference image-grounded video captioning，构建 2 万视频、171,354 张参考图的训练语料，并给出 MRVBench 评估视频事实性和多参考 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RefCaptioner 两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段用混合数据 SFT 保持通用视频描述能力并学习多参考绑定；第二阶段用 Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO，把参考覆盖、短语绑定、干扰项拒绝和跨参考一致性纳入奖励设计。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖真实视频和 AI 生成视频上的 MRVBench，并与开源视频字幕模型比较。摘要称 RefCaptioner 在开源模型中取得最佳总体表现，同时尽量保持原有视频字幕能力；未给出参数规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses video captioning with explicit phrase-level grounding to multiple reference images, including reference selection, local binding, distractor rejection, and cross-reference consistency.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a multimodal post-training task, dataset, and evaluation asset: multi-reference image-grounded video captioning, a corpus of 20,000 videos and 171,354 reference images, and MRVBench for factuality and multi-reference grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: RefCaptioner uses a two-stage post-training pipeline. Mixed-data SFT teaches the grounding behavior while preserving generic captioning ability, and Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO optimizes coverage, phrase-reference binding, distractor rejection, and consistency rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on MRVBench over real-world and AI-generated videos against open-source video captioning models. The abstract reports the best overall open-source performance while retaining general captioning ability, but does not expose model scale or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 多参考 grounding 的奖励设计可以扫一眼，主要价值在任务和数据定义；对基座预训练没有直接动作。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward design for multi-reference grounding; the value is in the task/data definition, not in a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: MemeBench: What LVLMs Miss When Interpreting Culture-Dependent Memes
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models have improved at describing visual content, but accurate descriptions do not ensure interpretation when meaning depends on knowledge beyond the pixels. Memes expose this gap because they rely on cultural entities, background knowledge, and community conventions. Most meme benchmarks reduce interpretation to labels or holistic scores, obscuring where an explanation breaks down. We introduce MemeBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,253 Chinese and English memes with huma

summary.core_problem: 现有梗图评测仅输出整体理解分数，无法定位LVLM在解释依赖文化背景知识的梗图时具体的失败环节
summary.importance: 提出针对文化依赖梗图理解的细粒度诊断基准，填补多模态模型文化常识对齐的评测空白
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含1253条中英双语梗图的MemeBench，配套人工标注的VIKR四维度分解标注（视觉线索、实体关联、知识单元、推理机制），实现细粒度错误定位
summary.experiments: 测试26个主流LVLM，发现所有模型的视觉内容识别能力均显著优于文化知识推理能力，最强模型仍存在22.6%的视觉-知识性能缺口

summary_en.core_problem: Existing meme interpretation benchmarks only produce holistic scores, unable to localize specific failure modes of LVLMs when interpreting culture-dependent memes requiring external background knowledge
summary_en.importance: Introduces a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark for culture-dependent meme understanding, filling the evaluation gap for cultural commonsense alignment in multimodal models
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds MemeBench with 1,253 Chinese and English memes, paired with human-annotated VIKR schema (Visual clues, Identity links, Knowledge units, Reasoning mechanisms) for granular failure localization
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 26 mainstream LVLMs, finding all models perform reliably better on visible content recognition than knowledge-dependent reasoning, with even the strongest model showing a 22.6% visual-knowledge performance gap

recommendation.zh: 细分文化梗图场景的VLM诊断基准，对通用多模态预训练参考价值有限，知晓22.6%知识缺口结论即可
recommendation.en: Niche diagnostic benchmark for culture-specific meme understanding, limited value for general multimodal pretraining; note the 22.6% visual-knowledge gap result and skip the rest.

paper.title: BlueprintRepair: Typed Local Edits for Failed Lean Proof Blueprints
paper.abstract: LLM-based Lean proving systems increasingly organize a proof as a blueprint: a dependency graph of formal statements. We introduce BlueprintRepair, a repair interface that lets a model change this graph through ten schema-checked local operations. An operation names the node it edits, so the target theorem cannot be changed. Lean checks every applied change, and an accepted repair must declare every blueprint lemma its proof uses. We also construct BlueprintTrace, a benchmark of 142 controlled f

summary.core_problem: LLM 证明系统中 blueprint（依赖图）失败后，如何用类型化局部编辑做低成本修复？
summary.importance: 形式化证明/coding agent 方向的接口设计与 benchmark 工作；对 agent action space 设计有一定启发，但非基座研究核心。
summary.technical_approach: BlueprintRepair 提供 10 种 schema-checked 的局部图编辑操作，操作只改指定节点、不能改目标定理，每次修改经 Lean 检查，并要求声明所用 lemma；同时构建 BlueprintTrace（142 个受控失败案例，含完整接受/拒绝轨迹）。
summary.experiments: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下，typed edits / exact patches / full rewrites 解题数相近，但 typed repair 每个解决状态成本最低（patching 1.30×、rewriting 2.06×），在 10K completion tokens 预算内接近最优。

summary_en.core_problem: How to repair failed proof blueprints (dependency graphs of statements) in LLM-based Lean provers via typed local edits?
summary_en.importance: An interface-design and benchmark contribution for formal-proof/coding agents; relevant to agent action-space design but peripheral to foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach: BlueprintRepair exposes ten schema-checked local graph operations that edit named nodes without changing the target theorem; Lean checks every change and accepted repairs must declare used lemmas. Ships BlueprintTrace, 142 controlled failures with full accepted/rejected trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, typed edits, exact patches, and full rewrites solve similar counts, but typed repair is cheapest per solved state (patching 1.30x, rewriting 2.06x) and near-optimal within 10K completion tokens.

recommendation.zh: action space 设计的干净对照：受约束局部编辑比整文件重写便宜 2×，做 coding agent 的可看 §接口对比表。
recommendation.en: A clean action-space ablation: constrained local edits are ~2x cheaper than full rewrites; check the interface comparison table if you work on coding agents.

paper.title: ToxScreen: Detecting Whether an LLM Has Been Poisoned
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed in high-stakes domains, adversaries may poison training data to implant backdoors: hidden triggers that covertly manipulate model behavior at inference time. We ask whether a defender can recover such a trigger under realistic affordances, namely white-box access to the weights and knowledge of the behavior of concern, but no training data, no trusted reference model, no knowledge of the trigger, and no certainty that the model is poisoned. To evaluat

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后门检测方法普遍依赖不切实际的前提假设：防御者可访问同架构干净参考模型、可信干净数据集、或已知触发器的部分特征，无法覆盖真实审计场景——防御者仅拥有模型白盒权重、明确待检测的恶意行为类型，没有训练数据、没有参考模型、也无法预先确认模型是否被投毒，该场景下目前缺少标准化的触发器恢复评测基准。
summary.importance: 提供了贴合真实预训练模型供应链风险的后门检测测试床，观测到的投毒模型副作用（整体越狱易感性上升、真实性分数下降、参数层面的耦合抑制特征）为预训练后模型完整性校验、第三方开源模型审计、非可信来源数据的投毒检测提供了可落地的信号参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖多维度变量的约800个后门模型集：包含4类攻击目标（拒绝抑制、情感引导、安全误分类、实体引导）、4类触发器机制（单token、多token、语义触发器、无显式token的上下文触发）、多档投毒率、1B到70B共6个模型规模、不同后门植入方式；严格限定防御者权限为仅白盒权重+已知攻击目标，配套统一的触发器恢复成功率评分框架；额外开展投毒模型的行为和权重特征分析，识别通用投毒痕迹。
summary.experiments: 所有植入后门在分布内和训练未见过的保留有害样本上均达到高攻击成功率，干净任务性能下降可忽略；简单的候选字符串按触发攻击成功率排序的方法可以有效恢复所有高有效性后门的真实触发器，而3种梯度优化类prompt搜索方法完全失败，最终收敛到通用越狱对抗后缀，无法定位真实触发器；投毒模型存在明确可观测的副作用：真实性基准分数大幅下降、对通用越狱攻击的易感性显著上升；权重分析发现攻击行为对应明确的参数抑制模式，利用该信号可大幅降低投毒检测的误报率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分的真实威胁模型定义、基准覆盖的变量维度、现有防御方法的对比结果、投毒带来的泛化副作用观察；无需深入评测框架实现细节，除非直接开展后门检测相关工作，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM backdoor detection methods rely on unrealistic assumptions: defenders have access to a clean same-family reference model, curated trusted datasets, or partial prior knowledge of trigger properties. These assumptions do not match real-world audit scenarios, where defenders only hold white-box model weights and know the target malicious behavior to detect, with no access to training data, no reference model, and no upfront confirmation that poisoning has occurred. No standardized trigger recovery benchmark exists for this realistic threat model.
summary_en.importance: ToxScreen delivers a testbed aligned with real pre-training supply chain risks. The observed side effects of poisoned models (broadly increased jailbreak susceptibility, degraded truthfulness scores, distinct parameter coupling and suppression patterns) provide actionable signals for post-pretraining integrity checks, third-party open-source model audits, and poisoning detection for untrusted training data sources.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark curates roughly 800 backdoored models spanning multiple variable dimensions: 4 attack objectives (refusal suppression, sentiment steering, safety misclassification, entity steering), 4 trigger families (single-token, multi-token, semantic triggers, implicit context-dependent triggers with no explicit trigger token), multiple poisoning rates, 6 model scales from 1B to 70B, and different backdoor injection mechanisms. The evaluation strictly enforces defender affordances of white-box access only plus known attack objectives, with a unified scoring harness for trigger recovery success. Additional behavioral and weight analysis is conducted to identify generic poisoning signatures.
summary_en.experiments: All planted backdoors achieve high attack success rates both in-distribution and on held-out harmful prompts unseen during poisoning, with negligible degradation to clean task performance. Simple candidate string ranking by triggered attack success rate reliably recovers true triggers for all effective backdoors, while three gradient-based prompt optimization methods fail entirely, converging to generic adversarial jailbreak suffixes instead of the planted trigger. Poisoned models exhibit measurable side effects: large drops in truthfulness benchmark scores, significantly higher susceptibility to generic jailbreaks, and a distinct parameter suppression pattern correlated with attack behavior that can reduce false positive rates in detection.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read at a skim level. Focus on the realistic threat model definition in the introduction, the dimension coverage of the benchmark, comparative results of existing defense methods, and observed generalized side effects of poisoning. Skip implementation details of the evaluation harness unless working directly on backdoor detection. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读设定和数据构造即可；它把后门检测从玩具触发器拉到更干净的威胁模型，适合做安全回归集。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and dataset construction; it moves backdoor detection away from toy triggers and is useful as a security regression suite.

paper.title: TREK: A Travel Reasoning and Evaluation Kit for LLM Agents in Complex Trip Planning
paper.abstract: Travel planning is a demanding stress test for tool-using LLM agents: a usable itinerary is a single artifact that must be right along many axes at once - every flight, hotel, and attraction must exist and be bookable, the days must be physically traversable, the total must clear a budget, and the plan must serve a traveler whose needs are only partly stated. Existing agent benchmarks reward these properties one at a time and grade the final output with soft or LLM-judged rubrics, which cannot c

summary.core_problem: 提出一个面向复杂旅行规划 Agent 的可执行性评测，要求最终行程同时满足实体真实性、时空可达、预算约束和用户偏好。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent benchmark 和可审计评测协议；它试图从软性 LLM judge 转向可验证约束，但领域仍然是旅行规划，通用性需要谨慎看。
summary.technical_approach: TREK 将旅行规划建模为联合约束满足问题，包含可行与可证明不可行任务，并给出 typed failure causes，如路线、实体和预算原因。评测重点不是逐项打分，而是验证一个完整 itinerary 是否整体可执行。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 800 个多约束任务，其中 533 个可行、267 个可证明不可行。摘要未给出具体模型列表、成功率或不同 Agent 框架的详细结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港中文大学和澳门理工大学；Irwin King 长期从事信息检索、Web mining 和机器学习相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: TREK evaluates LLM agents on complex trip planning where a single itinerary must satisfy factual, spatiotemporal, budgetary, and user-preference constraints.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an agent benchmark with auditable constraint checks. It moves away from soft LLM-judged rubrics, although the travel domain limits its generality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark formulates trip planning as a joint constraint-satisfaction problem, with both feasible and provably infeasible tasks and typed failure causes for route, entity, and budget violations. The unit of evaluation is the executability of the whole itinerary.
summary_en.experiments: TREK contains 800 multi-constraint tasks: 533 feasible and 267 provably infeasible. The abstract does not report detailed model lists, success rates, or agent-framework comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Macao Polytechnic University. Irwin King is known for work in information retrieval, web mining, and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 旅行规划是窄域，但“可证明不可行样本+硬约束校验”比软 judge 干净；看任务构造即可。
recommendation.en: Domain is narrow, but infeasible cases plus hard constraint checks are cleaner than soft judges; skim task construction only.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: AVE-Compass: Towards Holistic Evaluation for Audio-Video Editing Abilities
paper.abstract: While instruction-based video editing has advanced rapidly, real-world videos contain tightly coupled audio and visual signals, and editing one modality often requires coordinated changes in the other. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate visual transformations on silent clips or isolated audio editing, leaving complex audio-visual editing and cross-modal consistency underexplored. We introduce AVE-Compass, a comprehensive benchmark with 145 curated source videos, 196 audio-visually coupled ed

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是音视频编辑能力缺少细粒度评测的问题。现有视频编辑评测多关注静音视频的视觉变化，音频评测又常是孤立的音频生成或同步检测，无法判断模型是否同时完成目标编辑、保留非目标内容，并维持音画一致。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一多模态建模和评测信号设计。音视频编辑不是单纯的下游任务，它暴露了统一生成模型的几个核心短板：跨模态因果约束、时间同步、局部编辑与全局保真之间的冲突。对于研究视频-音频统一 tokenizer、AR+diffusion 联合建模、native multimodal pretraining 的团队，这类 benchmark 能帮助定位模型到底是不理解指令、不保留上下文，还是缺少音画联合规划能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AVE-Compass，用于 free-form audio-video editing 评测。数据包含 145 个源视频、196 条音视频耦合编辑指令和 2,688 个细粒度 checklist item。任务体系覆盖 28 类编辑操作，分为 joint audio-visual、speech、video-only、audio-only 四个分支。构建流程包括从现有视频数据集、网络视频和 AIGC 视频中收集候选样本，过滤无效音轨、音画错位、主体或声源不清晰的样本，再进行视频内容、镜头结构、主体、风格和声源标注。指令生成采用 human-in-the-loop：LLM 先基于结构化视频描述生成候选指令，critic 模型过滤不自然、不可行或与源视频不匹配的指令，最后由人工复核。评测协议将表现拆成 Instruction Following、Fidelity Preserving、Realism 和 Editing Intent。执行和保真主要由 MLLM checklist 判断，真实感由单独的 MLLM rubric 评估，同时加入音画同步、视频质量和音频质量等自动指标。论文还提出 AVE-Agent，将自由形式编辑指令分解为 task topology graph，并用 self-reflection 检查中间编辑状态，以改善复杂联合编辑任务中的质量和同步。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了代表性的开源和闭源音视频编辑系统，结论是当前系统在跨模态编辑下仍不稳定。最明显的问题出现在音频侧：模型容易错误删除或破坏背景声，也容易生成与视觉事件时间不一致的音频。视频-only 和音频-only 分支也用于检查非目标模态是否被无意修改。AVE-Agent 在复杂 joint editing 场景中改善了编辑质量和音画对齐，但给出的主要价值更偏诊断基准和错误分析，而不是一个完整替代生成模型的新训练范式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 AVE-Compass: Benchmark and Evaluation，以及 Fig. 2 的任务 taxonomy 和数据分布；再看评测协议中四个维度如何拆分，尤其是 checklist 如何区分目标编辑和非目标保真。若关注多模态生成模型的训练信号，可以看错误分析部分，重点关注音频漂移、背景声破坏、音画不同步这些 failure mode。AVE-Agent 部分可快速浏览，主要了解 task topology decomposition 和 self-reflection 如何作为规划层补丁使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of fine-grained evaluation for audio-video editing. Existing video-editing benchmarks mostly evaluate visual changes on silent clips, while audio benchmarks often focus on isolated audio generation, replacement, or simple synchronization. They do not tell whether a model completes the intended edit, preserves untouched content, and keeps audio and visual signals temporally and semantically consistent.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is in unified multimodal modeling and evaluation design. Audio-video editing stresses capabilities that native multimodal models should eventually learn during pretraining: cross-modal dependency tracking, temporal alignment, local controllability, and preservation of non-target content. For work on audio/video tokenization, unified generative pretraining, or AR-diffusion hybrid models, AVE-Compass provides a useful diagnostic surface rather than just an application benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: AVE-Compass contains 145 source videos, 196 audio-visually coupled editing instructions, and 2,688 atomic checklist items. Its taxonomy covers 28 operation types across four branches: joint audio-visual editing, speech editing, video-only editing, and audio-only editing. Source videos are collected from existing video datasets, web videos, and generated videos, then filtered for valid audio tracks, audio-video alignment, clear subjects, clear sound sources, and well-defined editable targets. Instructions are generated from structured source-video descriptions through a human-in-the-loop pipeline: modality-aware LLM generators propose candidate instructions, a critic model filters unnatural or infeasible cases, and humans perform final verification. Evaluation is decomposed into Instruction Following, Fidelity Preserving, Realism, and Editing Intent. MLLM-based checklists judge edit execution and preservation, a separate MLLM rubric evaluates perceptual realism, and automatic metrics track audio, video, and cross-modal quality. The paper also introduces AVE-Agent, which decomposes free-form instructions into task topology graphs and uses self-reflection to inspect intermediate editing states.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate representative open-source and closed-source editing systems and find that current systems remain unreliable under cross-modal editing instructions. The dominant failures are on the audio side: background sounds are often incorrectly removed or distorted, and generated audio is frequently misaligned with edited visual events. The benchmark also exposes unintended changes to non-target modalities in video-only and audio-only settings. AVE-Agent improves editing quality and audio-video alignment in complex joint editing cases, but the stronger contribution is the benchmark and its diagnostic breakdown rather than a new foundation-model training recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and evaluation sections, especially Fig. 2 for the task taxonomy and data distribution. The most useful part for multimodal pretraining work is the decomposition into instruction following, preservation, realism, and intent, because it clarifies which failure modes a unified model fails on. The error analysis is worth reading for concrete cases of audio drift, background-sound corruption, and temporal mismatch. The AVE-Agent section can be read quickly as a planning-layer baseline rather than the central contribution.

recommendation.zh: 音视频统一生成缺少干净评测；先看checklist设计和失败案例，模型排名反而是次要信息。
recommendation.en: Unified audio-video generation lacks clean evaluation; read the checklist design and failure cases first, with rankings treated as secondary.

paper.title: CLBench-V: Evaluating Multimodal Context Learning from Grounding to Knowledge Acquisition
paper.abstract: Real-world tasks often require models to learn from task-specific context rather than relying only on pre-trained knowledge. While recent work has highlighted this capability as context learning, existing evaluations mainly focus on textual contexts. In many practical settings, however, the context to be learned from is multimodal: scientific findings are conveyed through figures and tables, financial indicators are scattered across converted reports, and spatial decisions depend on maps, scenes

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的多模态问答，而是更细一层的“多模态上下文学习”评测问题：当模型在推理时拿到一段包含文档页、图表、表格、网页截图、多图证据等在内的上下文，它到底是在哪一步失效的。现有 benchmark 多半只看最终答对没有，或者只覆盖纯文本 context learning，难以区分模型是没有找到证据、找到了但不会用，还是明明上下文里定义了新知识却仍被预训练先验带偏。CLBench-V 试图把这三类失败拆开，并在统一框架下评估多模态模型从 grounding 到新知识获取的完整链条。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测侧，而不是方法侧。它补上了一个此前较空缺的位置：多模态模型常被说成“支持长文档、支持多图、支持图表理解”，但这些能力和真正依赖上下文学习不是一回事。CLBench-V 的价值在于把 context learning 分成 L0 Context Grounding、L1 New Information Application、L2 New Knowledge Learning 三层，使研究者能更清楚地判断瓶颈是在视觉证据定位、上下文信息调用，还是对上下文中新规则/新结论的吸收。对预训练研究员来说，这种分解有助于反推训练目标和数据配比：如果模型 L0 强但 L2 弱，问题可能不在视觉编码，而在训练中缺少“从上下文获得新知识并覆盖参数记忆”的信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，这篇工作核心是 benchmark 设计与数据构造。第一，作者提出三层层级定义。L0 测模型能否在多模态上下文中定位、读取、整合证据；L1 测模型能否把新提供的事实、数值、案例用于已有能力框架内的推理；L2 测模型能否从上下文本身学到新规则、结论、任务语义或经验知识，而不是回退到已有先验。这个划分比传统 document QA 或 chart QA 更强调“上下文依赖性”，也比一般 long-context eval 更强调 failure localization。第二，数据来源是多源混合：一部分来自公开 benchmark 的转换，一部分是新构造的领域任务，例如近期医学论文结论推断、金融报告中的 ROE 分析等。作者强调自动化构造与过滤流程，用来降低人工标注成本，同时保证题目确实需要依赖给定上下文，而不是靠常识或参数记忆即可作答。第三，评测框架做了统一化处理，包括统一推理接口、统一打分流程，并额外分析 judge 的一致性问题。也就是说，这篇工作的重点不只是“凑一批多模态题”，而是把任务组织原则、数据筛选、评分协议和误差分析放在一起，形成一个可诊断的评测资产。
