summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个多模态模型、共 3,443 个样本。文中给出的最重要结果是：当前系统在这个 benchmark 上整体表现仍然偏低，最佳 overall score 只有 0.2847，说明“能看图、能读文档”离“可靠地从多模态上下文中学习并使用信息”还有明显距离。模型之间也呈现层级分化：InternVL3.5-30B-A3B 在 L0 Context Grounding 和 L2 New Knowledge Learning 上最好，Qwen3.5-Plus 在 L1 New Information Application 上最好。这一点很有意思，因为它说明多模态能力不是单轴能力，不同模型可能分别擅长证据落点、信息调用和新知识吸收。作者还分析了 context length、图像数量、答案类型、judge 选择与代表性失败模式。全文传达出的结论是，随着上下文变长、视觉项变多，模型更容易出现忽略证据、误绑证据、被已有知识覆盖上下文知识等问题。若从实验阅读优先级看，最值得关注的不是单个榜单名次，而是这些分层结果和 failure mode 的对应关系。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 benchmark design，抓住三层定义：L0/L1/L2 分别在测什么，以及为什么这样划分。然后重点看任务来源与数据构造部分，确认每类任务如何保证“必须依赖上下文”。再看主实验表，关注 overall score 很低这一点，以及 InternVL 与 Qwen 在不同层级上的分化。最后看 judge reliability、context length、image count 和 failure cases 这几部分，它们决定这个 benchmark 是否真的能用于诊断，而不只是做排行榜。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做多模态预训练或长上下文训练，建议额外细看新构造任务的过滤标准和评分协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific evaluation gap: multimodal context learning, not generic multimodal QA. The key question is where a model fails when the required information is provided at inference time through mixed context such as document pages, charts, tables, screenshots, and multi-image evidence. Existing context-learning benchmarks are mostly text-only, and many multimodal benchmarks only test end-task accuracy without separating failure modes. CLBench-V is built to distinguish three cases: failure to ground the relevant evidence, failure to apply newly provided information, and failure to acquire knowledge that exists only in the given context.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly evaluative, but it is relevant to pretraining because it exposes a capability decomposition that current multimodal models often blur together. A model may read images reasonably well and still fail to use context-defined rules or conclusions. The L0/L1/L2 split gives a cleaner handle on whether the bottleneck lies in visual grounding, context-conditioned application, or context-driven knowledge acquisition. For pretraining researchers, this matters because different failure profiles point to different training deficits: weak L0 suggests representation and retrieval issues; weak L1 suggests poor context-conditioned reasoning; weak L2 suggests insufficient training signal for overriding parametric priors with in-context evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core contribution is benchmark design plus data construction. First, the paper defines a three-level hierarchy. L0 Context Grounding tests whether a model can locate, read, and combine multimodal evidence. L1 New Information Application tests whether it can use newly supplied facts, values, or cases within capabilities it already has. L2 New Knowledge Learning tests whether it can absorb rules, discoveries, task semantics, or empirical conclusions that are defined only in the context. This is more diagnostic than standard document QA or chart QA because it is explicitly organized around context dependence and failure localization. Second, the benchmark mixes converted public tasks with newly constructed domain-specific tasks, including recent medical-paper conclusion inference and financial-report ROE analysis. The authors emphasize automated construction and filtering so that instances scale while still requiring genuine context use rather than memorized world knowledge. Third, they standardize inference and scoring across tasks and also study judge reliability. That makes the benchmark more than a collection of multimodal questions; it is a structured evaluation asset with a clear capability taxonomy and analysis protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 6 multimodal models on 3,443 instances. The headline result is that current systems remain weak: the best overall score is only 0.2847. This is the main empirical message. Models that can process multimodal inputs still struggle to reliably learn from them at inference time. Performance also differs by level. InternVL3.5-30B-A3B leads on L0 Context Grounding and L2 New Knowledge Learning, while Qwen3.5-Plus leads on L1 New Information Application. That split is informative because it suggests multimodal context learning is not a single axis of competence. The paper also analyzes judge choice, context length, image count, answer types, and representative failure modes. The practical pattern is familiar but now better localized: longer contexts and denser visual evidence increase failures such as missing the right evidence, misbinding evidence, or reverting to pretrained priors instead of using context-defined knowledge.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and benchmark design to understand the L0/L1/L2 hierarchy. Then read the task construction section, especially how the authors ensure that answers truly depend on the provided context. After that, inspect the main results table and focus less on ranking and more on the level-wise differences across models. The most useful later sections are the judge reliability analysis and the breakdowns by context length, image count, and failure type. Those sections determine whether CLBench-V is actually diagnostic. A first pass should take about 20 to 30 minutes. If you work on multimodal pretraining or long-context training, spend extra time on the newly built tasks and the filtering/scoring protocol.

recommendation.zh: 多模态ICL评测的新基准，三维度能力拆解可用于模型失效定位，只看任务设计与维度划分部分即可
recommendation.en: New multimodal ICL benchmark with 3-way capability breakdown for failure localization; only read task design and dimension framing sections

paper.title: WorkSurface-Bench: Benchmarking Enterprise Agents on Multi-Surface Knowledge Routing
paper.abstract: Enterprise agents often need to integrate heterogeneous knowledge sources: documents for narrative facts, tables for computation, and dependency graphs for file relationships. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate retrieval or tool use without distinguishing whether an agent first selects the appropriate knowledge sources. We introduce WorkSurface-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability as surface routing. It contains 1,151 atomic tasks derived from persona-scoped Workspace-Bench-Lite

summary.core_problem: 评测企业 agent 在多种知识表面之间先选对信息源、再完成问答的能力，而不是只测检索或工具调用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测协议。它把 enterprise agent 常见的 document/table/graph 混合环境拆成更细的“surface routing”问题，这对 agent 评测设计是有价值的，但对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorkSurface-Bench，包含 1,151 个 atomic tasks，覆盖文档、表格、图结构和跨表面问题；答案可审计，表格答案由 DuckDB 查询复现，文档答案绑定文本 span，图答案绑定依赖标注；并在 gold-constrained 与不同 agent 设置下系统评测。
summary.experiments: 评测 4 个模型骨干、6 种受控 agent 设置，共得到 27,624 条无协议错误轨迹。结果显示在 gold-constrained tool access 下 Route F1 可达 98.7-99.8，但最终 Answer 指标仍明显落后，说明选对知识表面不等于完成推理。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和中关村学院。属于较规范的 benchmark 构建工作，重点在可审计答案和将 routing 与 answering 解耦。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether enterprise agents can first choose the right knowledge surface and then answer correctly, instead of only testing retrieval or tool use.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. It isolates “surface routing” over documents, tables, and graphs, which is useful for agent evaluation design, though only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces WorkSurface-Bench with 1,151 atomic tasks spanning document, table, graph, and cross-surface questions. Answers are auditable: table answers are reproduced via DuckDB queries, document answers are tied to verified spans, and graph answers are traced to dependency annotations. Multiple controlled agent settings are evaluated.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 4 model backbones under 6 controlled agent settings, totaling 27,624 protocol-error-free trajectories. Under gold-constrained tool access, Route F1 reaches 98.7-99.8, while final answer quality remains substantially lower, showing that correct routing does not imply successful reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Zhongguancun Academy. The work is a fairly clean benchmark effort with emphasis on auditable answers and separating routing from answering.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent eval，读任务定义和误差拆解就够了；对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，但“先路由后推理”的分解很干净。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and error decomposition if you care about agent eval; limited pretraining value, but the routing-vs-answering split is clean.

paper.title: HANDBOOK.md: A Benchmark for Long-Context Agentic Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed under standing instructions: a system prompt, a policy file, or a skills document is placed in context, and the agent is trusted to let it govern every action that follows. Existing benchmarks rarely test this deployment pattern directly; they measure whether an agent can complete a task, not whether a long, binding policy document actually constrains its behavior over an extended tool-use horizon. We present HANDBOOK.md, a benchmark of 65 agentic

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent基准多测试任务完成能力，未直接评测长约束性文档（如企业手册）在长工具使用周期中对Agent行为的约束效果，不符合真实企业部署场景
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向企业长手册场景的长上下文Agent指令跟随评测，覆盖多领域、多工具、长SOP约束
summary.technical_approach: 构建65个Agent任务，模拟自包含企业环境（文件工作区+邮件/聊天/日历/issue跟踪/商务服务等工具，通过MCP协议暴露），每个任务由20-124页的专家编写SOP约束，覆盖5个业务领域
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露评测模型与结果，仅提及包含65个任务，覆盖金融、医疗账单、保险、物流、HR5个领域、10个虚构公司
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Edwin Chen（前Google Brain研究员，Surge AI创始人，专注NLP评测与数据质量），所属机构未明确披露

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks mostly measure task completion, not whether long binding policy documents reliably constrain agent behavior over extended tool-use horizons, which mismatches real enterprise deployment patterns
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution; first long-context agentic instruction-following benchmark modeled on enterprise handbook scenarios, covering multiple domains, tools, and long SOP constraints
summary_en.technical_approach: Includes 65 agent tasks set in self-contained company environments with file workspaces and mock email/chat/calendar/issue-tracking/commerce tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol, governed by expert-written SOPs of 20-124 pages across 5 domains
summary_en.experiments: Full model evaluation results are not disclosed in the truncated abstract; the benchmark covers 5 domains and 10 fictional companies with 65 total tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Edwin Chen (ex-Google Brain, founder of Surge AI, focused on NLP evaluation and data quality); affiliated institutions not explicitly disclosed

recommendation.zh: 企业长手册场景的Agent指令跟随基准，贴近真实部署，作为评测资产备查即可，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Agent instruction-following benchmark with realistic enterprise long-handbook scenarios; keep as evaluation reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: ADAGE: A Language-Agnostic Pipeline for Analogical Reasoning Evaluation
paper.abstract: Multilingual reasoning evaluation overwhelmingly relies on translating English benchmarks, a practice that introduces linguistic artifacts and fails to test culturally-grounded reasoning. We introduce ADAGE (Analogical Difficulty-by-design Assessment for Grounded Evaluation), a language-agnostic pipeline that combines native-speaker curation with LLM-assisted generation to construct challenging, translation-free benchmarks for abstract analogical reasoning. We validate ADAGE by constructing benc

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多语推理评测中的翻译偏差：把英文 benchmark 机器翻译到其他语言，往往测到的是翻译质量和英语文化假设，而不是目标语言文化中的类比推理能力。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在评测和数据覆盖。它说明多语能力不能只靠 translated benchmark 判断，尤其是涉及隐喻、谚语、社会常识和文化 schema 的抽象推理。对预训练数据工作也有提示：低资源语言缺的不只是 token 数量，还包括本地文化结构、表达习惯和可迁移的抽象关系。
summary.technical_approach: ADAGE 是一个语言无关的 benchmark 构建 pipeline，用 native-speaker curation 和 LLM-assisted generation 结合生成 translation-free 的类比谚语推理题。流程包括数据获取、主题聚类、场景生成、自动过滤、干扰项选择、多 agent 验证和最终数据清理。核心设计是 difficulty-by-design：先按主题聚类谚语，再构造同簇、跨主题近邻和随机干扰项，让题目有可控难度梯度。任务不是让模型解释谚语，而是给出新场景，让模型选择最适用的谚语，从而测试抽象含义能否迁移到新语境。
summary.experiments: 作者用 ADAGE 构建了三个 benchmark：阿拉伯语 CAPR-ar、阿姆哈拉语 CAPR-am、日语 CAPR-ja。实验评估 14 个 open-weight 模型，参数规模从 270M 到 35B，零样本设置。结果显示，模型在英文谚语推理上表现较好，但迁移到三个 native benchmark 后准确率下降 12 到 52 个百分点。错误分析显示，跨主题近邻干扰项吸引了更多错误，并且模型能力越强，这种难度梯度越清晰，说明干扰项设计确实在测类比结构，而不只是表面词匹配。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 pipeline 图和 methodology 中的 thematic clustering、scenario generation、distractor selection 三部分；这些决定了 ADAGE 是否可复用。实验部分重点看英文 benchmark 与 CAPR-ar/am/ja 的性能差距，以及错误分析中的干扰项分布。对预训练研究而言，不必深读所有语言学背景，保留它对多语数据与评测设计的警示即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses translation bias in multilingual reasoning evaluation. Translating English benchmarks into other languages often measures translation artifacts and English-centric cultural assumptions rather than reasoning within the target language and culture.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is evaluation and data coverage. It shows that multilingual reasoning cannot be reliably assessed with translated benchmarks, especially for tasks involving metaphor, proverbs, social assumptions, and culturally shared schemas. It also has implications for pretraining data: low-resource language gaps are not only about token volume, but also about native cultural structures and abstract relational knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADAGE is a language-agnostic pipeline for constructing translation-free analogical proverb reasoning benchmarks. It combines native-speaker curation with LLM-assisted scenario generation. The pipeline has seven stages: data acquisition, thematic clustering, scenario generation, automated filtering, distractor selection, multi-agent validation, and final dataset curation. The main design choice is difficulty-by-design. Proverbs are clustered by theme, and distractors are selected from same-cluster, cross-theme near-match, and random groups to create a controlled difficulty gradient. The task tests analogical application rather than proverb explanation: given a novel scenario, the model must choose the proverb whose abstract meaning best applies.
summary_en.experiments: The authors instantiate the pipeline in three languages: Arabic CAPR-ar, Amharic CAPR-am, and Japanese CAPR-ja. They evaluate 14 open-weight models ranging from 270M to 35B parameters in a zero-shot setting. Models that perform well on English proverb reasoning drop by 12 to 52 percentage points on the native benchmarks. Error analysis supports the distractor design: cross-theme near-matches attract disproportionately many errors, and the difficulty gradient becomes clearer for stronger models. This suggests the benchmark is testing analogical structure rather than simple lexical overlap.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the pipeline figure and the methodology sections on thematic clustering, scenario generation, and distractor selection; these are the reusable parts. In the experiments, inspect the gap between English proverb reasoning and CAPR-ar/am/ja, plus the error analysis over distractor types. For pretraining research, the main value is the warning about translated multilingual evaluation and the need for native cultural reasoning data, not the full linguistic background.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“translation-free + 母语者策划”的构建流程与误差来源分析；用它能更干净地反推 pretrain 语料覆盖缺口。
recommendation.en: Read for the translation-free, native-speaker-first construction recipe; it’s a cleaner probe of pretraining coverage gaps than translated benchmarks.

paper.title: Language Shapes Instruction Hierarchy Compliance in Multilingual LLMs
paper.abstract: Instruction hierarchy (IH) requires models to prioritize instructions by source, ensuring that higher-priority instructions override lower-priority ones. Despite its importance for safe and controllable deployment, existing evaluations have focused almost exclusively on English, leaving it unclear whether IH compliance remains stable in multilingual settings. We introduce XIH-Bench, a benchmark for multilingual IH evaluation with both same-language and cross-language conflicts across six languag

summary.core_problem: 在多语言部署里，指令层级（System/User/Tool）发生冲突时，模型是否还能稳定地“按来源优先级”而不是“按语言强弱”来决策；以及语言切换会以什么方式系统性地改变层级服从（IH compliance）。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏评测与诊断，但对预训练/对齐有直接信号：同一个模型对不同语言的“可控性”不是常数，而是会随语言在层级中的位置发生非对称变化。这意味着仅用英文做 prompt-injection / hierarchy 评测会高估真实部署鲁棒性；也提示预训练与对齐阶段的多语数据配比、语言专精（language specialization）和 tokenizer/分词粒度，可能会通过“语言可抑制性”影响安全边界。对做多语基座或全球化产品的团队，属于需要纳入常规回归的评测资产。
summary.technical_approach:
构建 XIH-Bench：把“任务语义与冲突结构”固定，只系统性置换高/低优先级指令所用语言，从而把语言因素从任务难度里剥离出来。基准覆盖：6 种语言（英/德/西/法/印地语/中文）、4 个冲突域、3 种层级设置（System>>User、System>>Tool、User>>Tool），并区分 Reference（无冲突）与 Conflict（低优先级显式反指令）两种条件，用性能跌落来度量 IH 破坏程度。论文报告两个稳定现象：
1) 语言依赖的非对称性：某语言在高优先级位置可能提升服从，但放到低优先级位置时反而更“难被压住”，更容易干扰高优先级指令；
2) Language Boundary Effect：跨语言冲突（高低指令不同语言）整体比同语言冲突更容易保持层级，推测语言差异给模型提供了额外的“分隔线索”，帮助区分来源层级。
此外作者做了模型族层面的比较，指出部分模型存在明显语言专精：被偏好的语言在层级冲突中拥有不成比例的影响力，表现为低优先级也更难被覆盖。
summary.experiments:
规模与设置：共 78,894 条评测实例；4 域 × 3 层级设置 × 6 语言的同语/跨语组合，并在 Reference/Conflict 两条件下对比。模型：13 个模型、来自 5 个家族（文中未在给定片段里列出具体名单）。主要结果以规律性结论为主而非单点分数：
- 观察到跨语言冲突的 IH compliance 系统性更高（Language Boundary Effect）。
- 观察到语言在高/低优先级位置的作用不对称：同一语言可能“更会服从”也“更难被抑制”。
- 语言专精模型的偏好语言在冲突中更具支配性。
给定全文片段未包含具体数值表格与各模型分数；若需要做训练侧决策，建议直接对照论文主表/附录提取：各语言对、各层级设置下的 compliance drop，以及与 Reference 的差值。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读路径（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Benchmark 设计图（Figure 2）与任务结构，确认它如何“固定语义、只换语言”。
- 重点看两条核心发现对应的主结果表/图：语言非对称性与 Language Boundary Effect（通常会以 heatmap 或 language-pair 矩阵呈现）。
- 再看模型族/语言专精分析部分：它更接近可操作结论（哪些模型更容易出现偏好语言支配）。
精读建议：把“Reference vs Conflict 的差值”当作主要指标，而不是只看 Conflict 绝对分；并按 System>>User / System>>Tool / User>>Tool 分开看，因为低层来源不同会改变攻击面（tool output prompt injection vs user jailbreak）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether instruction-hierarchy compliance (System/User/Tool precedence) remains stable in multilingual settings, and how the language choice at different hierarchy positions systematically changes conflict resolution—potentially making models follow “language dominance” rather than “source priority.”
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation/diagnosis contribution, but it surfaces a training- and alignment-relevant failure mode: controllability is not language-invariant, and the effect is position-dependent (a language can help compliance when placed at higher priority yet become harder to suppress when placed at lower priority). This implies English-only hierarchy/prompt-injection evaluations can overestimate real-world robustness. For multilingual base models, it suggests data mixture, language specialization, and tokenization choices may translate into different “suppressibility” profiles across languages—an operational safety concern.
summary_en.technical_approach: XIH-Bench is built to isolate language as the independent variable: keep task semantics and conflict structure fixed, then systematically swap the languages used in the higher- vs lower-priority instructions. The benchmark spans 6 languages (EN/DE/ES/FR/HI/ZH), 4 conflict domains, and 3 hierarchy settings (System>>User, System>>Tool, User>>Tool). Each instance has a Reference condition (only the higher-priority instruction) and a Conflict condition (an explicit contradictory lower-priority instruction); the performance drop from Reference to Conflict quantifies hierarchy breakage. Two consistent findings are reported: (1) language-dependent asymmetry across hierarchy positions (a language that boosts following at the top can be disruptive at the bottom), and (2) a Language Boundary Effect where cross-language conflicts yield higher compliance than same-language conflicts, plausibly because language contrast provides an extra boundary cue for separating instruction sources. The paper also attributes part of the variance to model-specific language specialization, where a favored language exerts disproportionate influence even when it should be overridden.
summary_en.experiments: Scale: 78,894 evaluation instances across domains, hierarchy settings, languages, and Reference/Conflict conditions. Models: 13 models from 5 families (specific model list and numeric scores are not present in the provided excerpt). Reported results emphasize robust qualitative patterns rather than a single leaderboard: cross-language conflicts are consistently easier for maintaining hierarchy; language effects are asymmetric by hierarchy position; and language-specialized models show stronger dominance of their preferred language. For actionable training decisions, the key numbers to extract from the main tables/appendix are (i) compliance drop (Reference→Conflict) per language pair and (ii) how that drop changes across the three hierarchy settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the benchmark design figure (Figure 2) to verify the “fixed semantics, swapped languages” control.
- Read the main result plots/tables that support the two headline effects: asymmetry by hierarchy position and the Language Boundary Effect (often shown as language-pair matrices).
- Then read the analysis on model families/language specialization, since it connects directly to deployment risk.
When reading results, prioritize Reference-vs-Conflict deltas over absolute Conflict accuracy, and separate System>>User vs System>>Tool vs User>>Tool because different lower-level sources correspond to different real attack surfaces (user jailbreak vs tool-output injection).

recommendation.zh: 多语言 IH 的两个现象值得加进安全 eval；正文只需看语言位置互换实验和 cross-language vs same-language 分解。
recommendation.en: The multilingual IH effects are worth adding to safety evals; read only the language-position swaps and the cross-language versus same-language breakdown.

paper.title: Spatial-IQ: Deconstructing Spatial Intelligence via Hierarchical Capability Tests
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at visual interpretation but fail on spatial reasoning tasks that humans solve reliably. Existing benchmarks evaluate these models as black boxes, limiting their ability to identify the underlying causes of lower performance: when a model fails a spatial reasoning task, it remains difficult to ascertain whether the hurdle is perceptual, such as recognizing object boundaries, or cognitive, such as reasoning about occlusion to infer hidden geometry. W

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的空间推理评测仅返回最终任务的二元正确率，无法定位失败根因——无法区分错误来自低层次感知环节（如物体边界识别）还是高层次认知环节（如遮挡推断、支撑关系推理），也无法验证模型是否习得了与人类一致的层级化空间推理结构，而非依赖统计相关性猜测答案。
summary.importance: 为视觉语言模型的空间/物理常识能力评测提供了可诊断的分层框架，能够精确定位模型在物理世界建模上的能力短板；提出的分层任务分解式训练思路，为多模态模型空间能力的对齐训练提供了可复用的范式参考。
summary.technical_approach: 参考皮亚杰人类发展心理学与儿童空间认知标准化测试（考夫曼儿童评估测验的积木计数子项），将3D堆叠物体计数这一核心空间任务拆解为9个具有依赖关系、从感知到认知递进的子任务，额外加入心理旋转作为能力探针；基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim生成带全层级标注的合成视觉数据集，覆盖每个子任务的中间真值；训练侧提出两阶段方案：首先依据子任务依赖关系设计显式链式思考格式做监督微调，随后采用可验证奖励的强化学习，同时为最终答案正确和每个子步骤正确发放奖励。
summary.experiments: 覆盖闭源MLLM、开源MLLM、图像生成编辑模型的评测，并设置人类受试者作为对照，结果显示现有性能靠前的MLLM常能猜对最终计数结果，但中间子任务的正确率远低于人类，不具备人类表现出的层级推理依赖结构；初步训练结果显示，分层SFT结合分步RL的方案相比直接端到端训练最终答案有显著性能提升，可让模型习得类似人类的层级分解推理策略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对现有空间推理评测缺陷的分析、层级化任务拆解的设计逻辑，以及两阶段训练范式的动机，数据集生成的具体实现细节可略过，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks for multimodal large language models only return binary correctness scores for end tasks, failing to localize root causes of failures: they cannot distinguish errors originating from low-level perception (e.g., object boundary detection) from those caused by high-level cognitive deficits (e.g., occlusion inference, support relation reasoning), nor can they verify whether models acquire hierarchical spatial reasoning structures consistent with humans, rather than guessing answers via statistical correlations.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a diagnostic hierarchical evaluation framework for spatial and physical commonsense capabilities of vision-language models, enabling precise localization of weaknesses in physical world modeling. The proposed hierarchical task decomposition training approach offers a reusable paradigm reference for aligning spatial capabilities in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Piaget's developmental psychology and standardized children's spatial cognition tests (the Block Counting subtest of the Kaufman Assessment Battery for Children), the framework decomposes the core task of counting stacked 3D objects into 9 dependent subtasks progressing from perceptual to cognitive levels, with mental rotation added as an additional capability probe. Fully annotated synthetic visual stimuli are generated via NVIDIA Isaac Sim, with ground truth for all intermediate subtasks. For training, a two-stage pipeline is introduced: first supervised fine-tuning on an explicit chain-of-thought format derived from subtask dependencies, then reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, which grants rewards for both correct final answers and correct execution of each intermediate step.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover closed-source MLLMs, open-weight MLLMs, and image editing models, with human participants as a control group. Results show that top-performing MLLMs often guess the correct final count but perform far worse than humans on intermediate subtasks, lacking the hierarchical reasoning dependency structure observed in humans. Initial training results show that the combination of hierarchical SFT and stepwise RL delivers significant performance gains over end-to-end training on final answers alone, enabling models to learn human-like hierarchical decomposition strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the introduction's analysis of limitations in existing spatial reasoning benchmarks, the design logic of hierarchical task decomposition, and the motivation for the two-stage training paradigm. Details of dataset generation can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做多模态预训练，读任务分解和误差归因设计就够了；它不改方法论，但能帮你把“空间推理差”拆成可训练的问题。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal pretraining, read the task decomposition and error attribution design; it won’t change your method, but it can turn “poor spatial reasoning” into trainable subproblems.

paper.title: SQBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Task Delivery by Language-Model Agents in Production-Oriented Workflows
paper.abstract: Existing evaluations of large language models cover knowledge, reasoning, coding, and tool use, but they rarely treat a verifiable deliverable produced within a constrained workflow as the unit of evaluation. We introduce SQBench, a benchmark for evaluating production-oriented task delivery by language-model agents. SQBench v1.0 contains 220 standardized tasks organized into L1 atomic capabilities, L2 composite skills, and L3 business scenarios. Each task requires an agent to process input asset

summary.core_problem: SQBench 评测的是 LLM agent 在受约束工作流中交付可检查产物的能力，而不是只回答问题、完成环境交互，或在工具调用轨迹上得分。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测资产论文，对基座预训练没有直接方法贡献，但对 post-train 和 agent 训练信号设计有参考价值。它把评价单位从“答案”移动到“deliverable”：文件是否存在、字段是否正确、格式是否可解析、证据是否可追溯、是否违反权限或遗漏目标。这个角度能暴露不少通用 benchmark 看不到的失败，例如语义答案接近正确，但产物无法被下游流程消费。对构造 agent SFT/RL 数据时的奖励设计也有启发：奖励不能只看任务完成，还要显式惩罚交付风险。
summary.technical_approach: SQBench v1.0 包含 220 个标准化任务，分为 L1 atomic capabilities、L2 composite skills、L3 business scenarios。每个任务定义 instruction、初始资产、可用工具、网络和资源边界、交付路径、评分规则和风险触发条件。功能需求按可验证性选择评分方式：能确定性检查的用自动脚本，需要语义判断的用 LLM judge 和固定 rubric。评分流程先计算 Completion，再根据 10D Risk Matrix 记录独立证据触发的风险，得到 Risk Penalty 和 Performance。Strict Pass 的条件更严格：Completion = 1 且 Risk Penalty = 0。风险维度覆盖 fabricated facts、format violations、unauthorized actions、tool misuse、forgotten objectives 等交付层面的失败。
summary.experiments: 论文在 27 个模型配置上评估 SQBench v1.0。最高 Weighted Pass@1 为 60.5%；27 个配置在 L3 business scenarios 上的平均 Strict Pass@1 只有 18.5%。这个差距说明，模型在原子能力或局部工具使用上可用，并不等于能稳定交付符合约束、可审计、可消费的产物。结果还按 aggregate、layer、industry 和 risk dimensions 做描述性分析，用来定位失败来自任务层级、行业场景还是具体风险类型。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。优先看 benchmark definition、task schema、scoring pipeline 和 10D Risk Matrix。实验部分看 27 个模型配置的 Weighted Pass@1、L3 Strict Pass@1，以及风险维度分解。若关注 agent RL 或 workflow data synthesis，可以重点看 Completion 与 Risk Penalty 的分离设计；它比单一成功率更适合转化为训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: SQBench evaluates whether language-model agents can deliver verifiable artifacts in constrained workflows, rather than merely produce plausible answers, call tools, or reach an environment state.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation paper, not a pretraining contribution. Its value for LLM research lies in how it defines supervision targets for agentic post-training. The unit of evaluation is a deliverable: required files, fields, formats, paths, code behavior, evidence, and permission constraints. This exposes failures that answer-centric benchmarks often miss, such as a semantically reasonable response that cannot be parsed, audited, or consumed by a downstream process. The design is also relevant for reward modeling: task completion and delivery risk are separated instead of collapsed into one score.
summary_en.technical_approach: SQBench v1.0 contains 220 standardized tasks organized into L1 atomic capabilities, L2 composite skills, and L3 business scenarios. Each task specifies the instruction, input assets, available tools, execution boundaries, delivery path, scoring rules, and risk-trigger conditions. Functional requirements are scored according to verifiability: deterministic checks are used when possible, while semantic requirements use an LLM judge with predefined rubrics. The scoring pipeline computes Completion first, then applies independently evidenced triggers from a 10D Risk Matrix to derive Risk Penalty and Performance. Strict Pass requires both Completion = 1 and Risk Penalty = 0. The risk dimensions include fabricated facts, format violations, unauthorized actions, tool misuse, and forgotten objectives.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is run on 27 model configurations. The best reported Weighted Pass@1 is 60.5%, while the mean L3 Strict Pass@1 across configurations is 18.5%. This gap indicates that partial tool competence and local correctness do not reliably translate into production-style delivery. The paper also reports descriptive breakdowns by aggregate score, capability layer, industry scenario, and risk dimension, which helps identify whether failures come from task complexity, workflow type, or specific delivery risks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is appropriate. Read the benchmark definition, task schema, scoring pipeline, and 10D Risk Matrix first. In the results, focus on Weighted Pass@1, L3 Strict Pass@1, and the risk breakdowns. For agent RL or workflow data synthesis, the most useful design choice is the separation between Completion and Risk Penalty, since it maps naturally to multi-component training signals.

recommendation.zh: 生产导向Agent评测的新维度，风险矩阵设计有参考性，重点看§3任务分层和附录指标定义。
recommendation.en: New dimension for production-oriented agent evaluation; the risk matrix design is worth referencing, focus on §3 task hierarchy and appendix metric definitions.

paper.title: AlloBench: Measuring Online Tool Allocation Capability in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Creating a reusable tool is an investment: an agent pays a fixed cost now in exchange for the potential of future reuse. Therefore, a user should prefer an agent that creates a small number of highly reusable tools, rather than many one-offs. We introduce a paired benchmark that tests whether LLM agents exhibit conscious allocation behavior under a fixed budget in two contexts: an abstract text-based formulation and a code-construction task. We find that every frontier model we test---Claude Hai

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在面对任务流和有限工具创建预算时，是否具备有意识的工具分配能力——即判断何时值得为一类任务创建可复用工具，而非为每个任务一次性处理。现有评测只测「能否写出正确工具」或「能否从工具库中选对工具」，从未测量更基础的「何时应该创建工具」这一预算感知决策能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于揭示了一种能力断层：前沿模型在抽象的预算分配问题上表现接近最优，但这种能力无法迁移到具体的代码工具创建场景。这说明后训练（post-training）可能在特定输出模态（如代码生成）上压制了已有的抽象推理能力，而非简单的「模型不会预算规划」。这一发现对理解 SFT/RL 后训练如何塑造模型行为、以及能力迁移的边界条件有参考价值——尤其是对 agent 能力的预训练/后训练分工设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AlloBench，一个配对式基准测试，在两种框架下测试同一预算分配问题：(1) 抽象的文本球收集游戏；(2) 具体的代码脚本编写任务（数学题求解脚本）。基准的核心机制是：agent 面对 T=60 个任务流，来自 N=8 个隐式类别，最多可创建 B 个工具，工具一旦创建可复用。最优策略不是在首次遇到某类时就创建工具，而是等待确认该类会重复出现后再投入预算，因为稀有类上的错误投入会导致频繁类的机会成本。论文设计了「早期陷阱」来放大这一效应。评测同时覆盖抽象和具体两种框架，通过对比同一模型在两种框架下的表现，定位能力断层的位置。
summary.experiments: 测试了 Claude Haiku、Claude Opus、GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-5.6 Sol 四个前沿模型。核心发现：所有四个模型在抽象分配框架下表现接近最优，但都无法将这种能力迁移到脚本编写任务中。进一步定位失败触发点：前三个模型（Haiku / Opus / GPT-5.4-mini）的失败点在「需要输出代码」这一步——即使脚本不被评测执行，只要要求写代码就会失败；而最强模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 的失败点在完整脚本构建环节。论文还验证了在抽象预算分配上的后训练无法迁移到工具创建场景，并推测这种能力压制可能由主流后训练方法的某些特性导致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看 §1 引言中对「工具创建时机」这一未被测量的基础决策的界定，以及 §2 AlloBench 的形式化定义和最优策略分析（附录 A.1 的 Dirichlet 先验下的等待收益推导值得一看）。核心实验结论在 §4，尤其是抽象→具体的能力断层定位。对预训练研究员来说，最有价值的观察是「抽象能力存在但在代码输出模态下被压制」这一现象，它提示后训练可能引入了模态特定的行为偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluations measure whether a model can write a correct tool or select the right tool from a library, but they never test a more fundamental decision: when should an agent create a reusable tool at all, given a limited budget over a stream of recurring tasks? This budget-aware tool allocation capability is essential for efficient agentic systems but remains unmeasured.
summary_en.importance: The work reveals a capability gap that is relevant to understanding post-training effects: frontier models perform near-optimally on abstract budget allocation, yet this ability fails to transfer to concrete code tool creation. This suggests that post-training may suppress existing abstract reasoning capabilities in specific output modalities (e.g., code generation), rather than models simply lacking budgeting competence. The finding informs the design of pretraining/post-training pipelines for agent capabilities, particularly around how modality-specific behavior can mask general reasoning skill.
summary_en.technical_approach: AlloBench is a paired benchmark that tests the same budget-allocation problem in two framings: (1) an abstract text-based ball-collection game, and (2) a concrete code-construction task (writing scripts to solve math word problems). The core mechanism: an agent faces a stream of T=60 tasks drawn from N=8 latent classes, with a budget of at most B tools that can be reused once created. The optimal policy is not to commit on first encounter, but to wait for confirmed recurrence—since mis-investing in a rare class incurs large opportunity cost on frequent classes. The benchmark is designed with early traps to amplify this effect. By comparing performance across the two framings within the same model, the study localizes where the capability breaks down.
summary_en.experiments: Four frontier models are tested: Claude Haiku, Claude Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, and GPT-5.6 Sol. All four perform near-optimally in the abstract allocation framing but fail to transfer this ability to script-writing. Failure-mode localization shows that the first three models (Haiku / Opus / GPT-5.4-mini) fail at the step of required code emission—they degrade even when the scripts are not evaluated for execution, simply because they are asked to write code. The strongest model (GPT-5.6 Sol) fails specifically at full script construction. The paper also demonstrates that post-training on abstract budget allocation does not transfer to tool creation, and conjectures that this capability suppression is caused by characteristics of predominant post-training methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15–20 minutes. Focus on §1 for the crisp articulation of the unmeasured "when to create a tool" decision, and §2 for the formalization of AlloBench and the optimal policy analysis (Appendix A.1's derivation of the waiting benefit under a symmetric Dirichlet prior is worth a look). Key results are in §4, particularly the localization of the abstract-to-concrete capability gap. For pretraining researchers, the most valuable observation is that abstract competence exists but is suppressed under code output modality—suggesting that post-training can introduce modality-specific behavioral biases.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务设计和 failure-mode 表；它测的是抽象规划到工具构建的迁移断裂，比常规 tool-use 分数更有诊断性。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure-mode tables; it probes the transfer break from abstract planning to tool construction better than ordinary tool-use scores.

paper.title: Similarity Is Not Logic: Factored Inference for Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Dual-encoder vision-language models (VLMs) expose a similarity interface that enables zero-shot retrieval but fails compositional constraints: queries like "umbrella and no person" retrieve images containing both, even when concept detection is reliable. We trace this to an interface-level Bag-of-Concepts effect, where similarity scores approximate mean pooling of concept evidence regardless of operators. Although operator-dependent signals exist in text embeddings, they are too weak or misalign

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的不是 VLM 表示能力不足，而是 dual-encoder VLM 的接口失配：模型只暴露一个 image-text similarity 分数，这个分数适合检索相似性，却不适合执行布尔逻辑约束。像“umbrella and no person”这类查询，模型往往会把同时含有 umbrella 和 person 的图像排得更高。作者沿全文反复强调，问题不在于文本编码器完全不懂 negation 或 conjunction，而在于这些 operator-dependent 信号在点积相似度下太弱、方向也不对，最后排序仍被概念证据的平均化主导，形成 bag-of-concepts 行为。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为它主要讨论 dual-encoder VLM 检索接口，而不是生成式统一建模、预训练目标或训练动态。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“表示里有信号”和“接口能否执行该信号”明确分开，这对多模态统一模型、tool interface、甚至 LM judge 设计都很重要。第二，它说明很多失败不是靠继续 fine-tune 编码器就能解决，因为瓶颈在打分与组合规则，而不是特征本身。这种分析方式对研究 tokenizer、retrieval head、reward model 接口也有启发。整体上更像一篇机制分析加接口修补的工作，适合了解，不属于必须精读的 pretrain 论文。
summary.technical_approach:
作者先做机制拆解，再给出 training-free 修复。机制部分围绕一个核心判断：标准 dual-encoder similarity s(I,T)=<f(I),g(T)> 在复合查询下近似于对原子概念证据做 soft pooling，而不是执行逻辑运算。为此，论文用 COCO 上的一到两个概念查询，把图像按 Both、A-only、B-only、Neither 四个象限分组，观察不同逻辑表达式下各象限的平均得分与排序。结果显示，像 ¬A∧¬B 这样的 anti-monotone 查询会系统性偏向 Both 象限，说明 negation 没有真正改变排序机制。作者进一步做 span-residual decomposition 一类分析，区分文本 embedding 中由概念词本身带来的主导方向和由操作符带来的残差信号，发现 operator 信息并非不存在，而是幅度太小或与图像证据方向失配，无法在点积下主导排序。

基于这个判断，作者提出 factored inference 和 LCSE。思路是把“证据提取”和“约束执行”拆开：先用冻结的 VLM 对每个原子概念单独打分，得到 concept-level evidence；再在模型外部根据解析后的查询结构执行布尔逻辑，例如 conjunction、negation、NOR 等。为了不破坏标准 similarity 中对场景、风格、上下文的有用信息，LCSE 不是完全抛弃原始分数，而是做 logic-constrained score editing：只有当查询包含需要非均值聚合的逻辑操作时，才自适应地编辑原始相似度，把原子证据和逻辑约束注入最终排序。这样做的取舍很清楚：不改编码器，不重新训练，保留原有检索能力；代价是需要 query parsing，并且当前主要覆盖一到两个视觉概念上的布尔组合。
summary.experiments:
实验主要由三部分组成。第一，作者在 COCO val2017 上做控制实验，证明 CLIP 类模型虽然能检测单个概念是否存在，但“a X”和“no X”的排序几乎不变。文中给出的代表性数字是：概念存在检测 AUC 约 0.88，而两类查询的排名 Spearman 相关高达 0.94，说明 negation 信号没有真正进入排序。第二，作者构建 FACTOR-Bench，用 operator-contrastive caption pairs 和验证过的概念 presence/absence 标注，专门测模型是否执行布尔语义，而不是仅仅跟踪提到的概念。第三，作者在 FACTOR-Bench、NegBench 和 retrieval retention 任务上比较标准 CLIP、SigLIP 及若干 fine-tuned 变体与 LCSE。结论是 LCSE 在 negation、conjunction、exclusion 等约束查询上更稳定，且对普通检索保留更好。全文还强调，单纯在 negation 数据上 fine-tune 往往会牺牲标准检索行为，因为它试图在表示层补接口层的问题。

从当前提供的正文片段里，可以确认关键定性结论和少量数字，但没有完整主表，因此不宜编造各 benchmark 上的精确提升幅度。若要严谨记录，建议核对 §5 的主结果表、不同 backbone 的 retention 指标，以及 LCSE 中 score edit 的具体公式和阈值设置。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点不在方法复杂度，而在问题拆解是否干净。建议先看 §3 的 failure pattern：尤其是“a X”对“no X”的排序相关性、四象限偏好图，以及 anti-monotone 查询为何会偏向 Both。这里基本决定了论文是否成立。然后看 §4 的 factored inference / LCSE，确认它不是重新训练一个逻辑模型，而是把原子证据提取和逻辑执行分离。最后看 §5，重点关注两类结果：一类是逻辑约束查询上的提升，另一类是 standard retrieval retention 是否保持。若只想抓住主线，40 分钟左右足够。值得多想一步的是，这类“接口不支持组合语义”的问题，在 unified multimodal LM 中是否会以别的形式重现，例如单一 reward head、单一 similarity head、或单一 judge score 对复杂约束的失真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about missing visual or textual representations per se. It targets an interface failure in dual-encoder vision-language models: they expose a single image-text similarity score, which works for retrieval but does not execute Boolean constraints. Queries such as “umbrella and no person” often rank images containing both umbrella and person near the top. The central claim, supported throughout the paper, is that operator-dependent information is not entirely absent from text embeddings. The real bottleneck is that dot-product similarity is dominated by concept evidence and behaves like a bag-of-concepts aggregator, so negation and conjunction signals are too weak or misaligned to control ranking.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, since the paper focuses on dual-encoder VLM retrieval rather than generative pretraining, scaling, or optimization. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, it cleanly separates representation from execution: a model may encode operator information, yet the exposed interface may be unable to act on it. That distinction matters beyond VLM retrieval, including reward models, retrieval heads, and other scoring interfaces. Second, it shows that fine-tuning the encoder is not always the right fix when the bottleneck sits in the scoring rule itself. So this is better read as a mechanistic interface paper than as a core pretraining contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first diagnoses the mechanism, then proposes a training-free fix. The diagnosis centers on the claim that standard dual-encoder similarity s(I,T)=<f(I),g(T)> behaves like soft pooling over atomic concept evidence rather than logical execution. Using one- and two-concept queries on COCO, images are partitioned into four quadrants: Both, A-only, B-only, and Neither. The authors then inspect mean scores and rankings under different logical forms. Anti-monotone queries such as ¬A∧¬B systematically prefer the Both quadrant, which should be the least preferred one. This shows that negation does not actually alter the ranking mechanism. The paper further analyzes the text embedding into dominant concept-related directions and weaker operator-related residuals, arguing that operator information exists but is attenuated or poorly aligned with image evidence under dot-product scoring.

Based on that diagnosis, the paper proposes factored inference and LCSE. The idea is to separate evidence extraction from constraint execution. A frozen VLM is used to score each atomic concept independently, producing concept-level evidence. Boolean operators are then executed outside the model using the parsed query structure. To avoid discarding useful non-logical information captured by the original similarity score, LCSE performs logic-constrained score editing rather than replacing the score entirely. It adaptively edits the holistic similarity only when the query requires non-mean aggregation. This preserves standard retrieval behavior where no logical constraint is present. The trade-off is clear: no retraining and better semantic control, at the cost of requiring query parsing and currently focusing on Boolean compositions over one or two visual concepts.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments have three main parts. First, the paper shows on COCO val2017 that CLIP-like models can detect whether a concept is present, yet fail to execute negation in ranking. A representative result reported in the text is that concept detection reaches about AUC 0.88, while the rankings induced by “a X” and “no X” have Spearman correlation around 0.94. So the model changes the text embedding, but not enough to change the ordering. Second, the paper introduces FACTOR-Bench, built from operator-contrastive caption pairs with validated concept presence and absence labels, to test whether a model follows Boolean semantics rather than merely tracking mentioned concepts. Third, LCSE is evaluated on FACTOR-Bench, NegBench, and retrieval-retention settings against standard CLIP, SigLIP, and fine-tuned variants. The reported pattern is that LCSE improves constraint-sensitive retrieval while preserving ordinary retrieval better than training-based fixes. The paper also argues that fine-tuning on negation-heavy data often harms standard retrieval because it tries to repair an interface problem at the representation level.

The excerpt here supports the main qualitative findings and a few concrete numbers, but not the full result tables. Exact benchmark gains should be taken from Section 5 and the appendix rather than inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a good skim paper. The main value is the problem decomposition, not method complexity. Start with Section 3 and check whether the failure pattern is convincing: the ranking correlation between affirmative and negated queries, the quadrant preference plots, and the anti-monotone cases are the key evidence. Then read Section 4 to understand that LCSE is not a retrained logic model; it is an interface that separates atomic evidence extraction from logical execution. Finally, look at Section 5 with two questions in mind: does it improve Boolean-constrained retrieval, and does it preserve standard retrieval when no constraint is present? Around 40 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. The broader question worth carrying forward is whether similar interface bottlenecks appear in unified multimodal LMs through single reward heads, single similarity heads, or scalar judges that cannot faithfully execute structured constraints.

recommendation.zh: 明确指出双编码器VLM的瓶颈在相似度聚合接口而非表征，预训练时需考虑逻辑约束对齐信号，重点看§3缺陷分析和Fig2可视化。
recommendation.en: Pinpoints dual-encoder VLM bottleneck at similarity aggregation interface rather than representations; pretraining should incorporate logical constraint alignment signals, focus on §3 analysis and Fig 2 visualization.

paper.title: AI-generated Images Challenge Visual Trust in High-risk Scenarios
paper.abstract: Rapid advances in image generation are eroding the evidentiary value of visual content in settings where authenticity can affect public safety and personal reputation. Yet existing detection benchmarks rarely examine synthetic images in public- and individual-safety contexts, where misleading visual content may carry substantial risks. Here we introduce SafeIMG, a safety-oriented benchmark spanning 12 public- and individual-safety scenarios generated using GPT Image 2. Unlike benchmarks centred

summary.core_problem: 构建面向公共安全和个人安全场景的 AI 生成图像检测 benchmark，评估检测器和 VLM 是否能识别高风险合成图像及其可疑区域。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/合成图像安全评测资产。它不直接推进预训练方法，但对多模态模型的真实性判断、局部异常定位和安全评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SafeIMG，覆盖 12 类公共安全与个人安全场景，图像由 GPT Image 2 生成。与只给 image-level 标签的检测集不同，SafeIMG 提供人类标注的可疑区域和解释，包含局部伪影、高层 commonsense inconsistency、物理不一致等，用于检查模型判断是否对齐人类发现的异常。
summary.experiments: 评估对象包括专门的 synthetic-image detectors 和 VLM。摘要结论是两类系统都不可靠，说明当前检测器和通用 VLM 在高风险合成图像场景下仍难以稳定识别并定位异常；摘要未给出完整模型列表、分数或最强模型的具体数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Southeast University、The Hong Kong Polytechnic University、Wuhan University 等；Min-Ling Zhang 是多标签学习方向知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for detecting AI-generated images in public- and personal-safety scenarios, including whether models can localize suspicious regions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety-oriented VLM and synthetic-image detection benchmark. It does not advance pretraining methods directly, but it is relevant to authenticity judgments, anomaly localization, and multimodal safety evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SafeIMG spans 12 public- and individual-safety scenarios generated with GPT Image 2. Unlike generic image-level detection datasets, it provides human annotations that localize suspicious regions and explain local artifacts, commonsense inconsistencies, and physical inconsistencies. This tests whether detector decisions are grounded in the same anomalies humans identify.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates specialized synthetic-image detectors and vision-language models. The abstract reports that neither class of systems is reliable in these high-risk scenarios. It does not provide the full model list, numerical scores, or the strongest system’s exact result in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Southeast University, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and Wuhan University. Min-Ling Zhang is a well-known researcher in multi-label learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据设计和失败案例；它是 VLM 安全评测，不会改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read only the dataset design and failure cases; this is VLM safety evaluation, not a pretraining recipe signal.

paper.title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
paper.abstract: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, a

summary.core_problem: 如何把“社会智能”（心智推断、关系与规范推理、情境化行为）从零散任务评测，推进到可诊断、可训练、可部署支撑的一整套框架；并回答一个更工程化的问题：当模型要长期在社会环境中服务时，哪些社会能力缺口最关键、如何补、如何在推理时稳定落地。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的直接关联偏弱，更像是面向对齐/agent 的能力框架与评测+训练配方集合。但它提供了两类可迁移启发：
- 评测资产层面：把社会智能拆成结构化能力空间（多维度、多范式、共享场景控制变量），这类“诊断式 benchmark”思路可迁移到预训练阶段的能力剖面评估（而不只是单分数）。
- 训练闭环层面：强调“诊断→定向监督→on-policy 蒸馏→rubric RL→部署时外部支撑”的流水线，体现了 post-train 信号如何被组织成可迭代工程系统。若团队在做长期交互式 agent 或安全对齐，这套组织方式可能比单点算法更有用。
summary.technical_approach:
Zing（知境）由三块组成：
1) SoMBench：心理学启发的社会智能评测基准，把能力定义成结构化空间（3 个一级维度、17 个二级维度、71 种任务范式），并通过共享场景（284 个）控制题型、叙事视角、上下文长度等变量，减少“换题即换能力”的噪声。
2) 训练配方：用能力诊断来构造定向监督数据，然后做 SFT、on-policy distillation（更贴近交互分布）、以及基于 rubric 的强化学习来强化社会推理与行为选择。
3) Actio：部署时的 harness-controlled 架构，把推理所需的“类型化支撑”路由进来，包括程序性指导、运行时心智状态表示、可复用经验、外部社会/规范知识等，试图把一部分难以参数化的社会先验放到检索/工具/结构化记忆里。
整体取舍是：不把社会智能当成单一数据集或单一 reward，而是把它拆成可测的子能力，并在训练与推理时分别提供稳定支撑。
summary.experiments:
给定全文片段主要是框架与动机描述，未包含可核对的关键数值（例如：在 SoMBench 上相对哪些基线提升多少、训练各阶段的增益、Actio 的在线收益等）。从摘要信息可知 SoMBench 含 3,481 个实验任务（experiments）与 284 个共享场景，并控制多种元数据变量。若要判断其方法有效性，建议在全文中重点核对：
- SoMBench 的评分协议（自动/人工、rubric 细则、可靠性）与泄漏控制；
- 分阶段训练的消融：SFT vs on-policy distill vs rubric RL 的边际贡献；
- 部署时支撑（Actio）对长程交互稳定性的增益，以及是否引入新的失败模式（例如过度依赖外部规范库）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 SoMBench 的能力空间定义与任务范式列表，判断它是否覆盖你关心的社会场景，控制变量是否合理。
- 再读训练配方章节的“数据如何从诊断来、rubric 如何写、on-policy 如何采样”，这是可复用的工程细节。
- 最后读 Actio 的系统设计：它更像部署架构提案，适合评估可实现性与维护成本。
如果只关心预训练：可以只取其“诊断式 benchmark 设计”方法论，训练与部署部分可快速略读。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn “social intelligence” (mental-state inference, social relations and norms reasoning, context-sensitive behavior) from fragmented tasks into a diagnosable, trainable, and deployment-grounded stack for LLMs operating as long-term collaborators in human environments.
summary_en.importance: Weak direct linkage to base pretraining; it is closer to alignment/agent capability engineering (benchmark + training recipe + deployment harness). Still, it offers transferable ideas: (1) diagnostic benchmarking via a structured capability space and controlled shared scenarios—useful as a template for pretraining-stage capability profiling beyond single aggregate scores; (2) an explicit closed loop from diagnosis to targeted supervision, on-policy distillation, rubric-based RL, and inference-time supports, illustrating how post-training signals can be operationalized into an iterative system rather than a one-off fine-tune.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work packages three components:
1) SoMBench: a psychology-grounded benchmark that defines social intelligence as a structured capability space (3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, 71 task paradigms). It uses shared scenarios (284) and controls factors like question format, narrative perspective, and context length to reduce confounds.
2) Zing training recipe: capability diagnosis is used to construct targeted supervision, followed by SFT, on-policy distillation to better match interactive distributions, and rubric-based reinforcement learning to strengthen social reasoning and behavior.
3) Actio deployment harness: a harness-controlled architecture that routes typed supports into inference—procedural guidance, runtime mental-state representations, reusable experience, and external social/normative knowledge—explicitly offloading part of the “social priors” from parameters to structured retrieval/tools/memory.
The key design choice is to treat social intelligence as a layered capability with measurement, parametric internalization, and runtime grounding, rather than as a single dataset or reward.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt is largely conceptual and does not include verifiable headline numbers (e.g., gains over baselines on SoMBench, stage-wise ablations, or online improvements from Actio). From the available text: SoMBench includes 3,481 experiments and 284 shared scenarios with controlled metadata. To assess effectiveness, the critical checks in the full paper are: (i) scoring protocol and reliability (rubrics, human/auto judging, leakage control), (ii) ablations across SFT vs on-policy distillation vs rubric RL, and (iii) deployment-time impact of Actio on long-horizon interaction stability and any new failure modes introduced by external normative knowledge.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the SoMBench capability taxonomy and task paradigms first; verify coverage and whether the controlled variables are well-motivated.
- Then read the training recipe details: how diagnosis maps to data construction, how rubrics are specified, and how on-policy sampling is done—these are the most reusable engineering parts.
- Finally read Actio as a deployment architecture proposal; evaluate feasibility and maintenance cost.
If your focus is strictly pretraining, treat this mainly as a diagnostic-benchmark design reference and skim the training/deployment sections.

recommendation.zh: 社会智能拆维度的 eval 设计可借鉴；训练 recipe 先当 post-train 弱信号，重点看错误分布而非总分。
recommendation.en: The social-intelligence decomposition is reusable for eval design; treat the training recipe as weak post-training signal and focus on error distributions, not aggregate score.

paper.title: Tokengeist: Multi-Turn Attribution Tracing in Agentic Conversations
paper.abstract: When a language model produces a response in a multi-turn conversation, which tokens from prior turns shaped that answer, and how did those dependencies propagate across prior turns? Existing context attribution methods process the full context in a single pass, recovering surface-level dependencies but missing the layered, non-linear structure of real-world dialogues and multi-step reasoning tasks. We introduce multi-turn context attribution (MTCA): given a target span in a model response, the

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究多轮 agent 对话中的归因问题：给定最终回复里的一个 claim 或 span，如何追踪它依赖了哪些历史 turn，以及这些依赖如何通过中间 assistant turn、tool result 和用户输入逐层传播。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但对长上下文、agentic workflow 和工具调用模型的可解释性有参考价值。常规 context attribution 把上下文当作一条扁平序列，只能给出哪些 token 或 turn 与最终答案相关，难以说明信息路径。对于训练和评测 agent 模型，这类 provenance graph 可以帮助定位错误来源：是工具结果错误、用户输入被误读、中间摘要丢信息，还是最终回答臆造了不存在的依赖。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义了 multi-turn context attribution，目标不是一次性给历史 token 打分，而是恢复一个跨 turn 的依赖 DAG。Tokengeist 是一个 attribution-method-agnostic 框架：从目标 span 出发，先用任意单轮 attribution 方法找出直接相关的前序 turn；再把这些前序 turn 当作新的目标，递归向更早的上下文追踪，直到到达 system、user 等外生输入或其他终止节点。形式化中区分 exogenous turns、assistant endogenous turns 和 tool-result turns；token 级别用于计算 attribution，sentence 或 turn 级别用于聚合与图构建。这个设计的核心取舍是复用已有 attribution 方法，而不是重新训练一个专用解释模型；代价是最终图质量仍受底层 attribution 方法影响。
summary.experiments: 作者构建了 MTCABench，包含 665 个多轮对话和 3,845 个标注 target span，其中 688 个来自 ConFETTI，3,157 个来自 TauBench。数据包含工具调用轨迹，也覆盖 hallucination、无关 turn 干扰等已知失败模式，并提供 gold provenance graph。实验重点是比较扁平 attribution 与递归多轮追踪的差异。文中示例显示，flat attribution 会把最终退款说明主要归因到最近的取消工具结果 T27，但真正支撑保险退款资格的路径来自更早的用户健康原因 T23、保险字段 T9，以及由用户 ID T3 触发的查询链。提供的全文片段没有包含完整指标表，只能确认作者报告了 flat attribution 的系统性失败，并评估了不同 base attribution methods 接入 Tokengeist 后的表现。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 TauBench airline 的例子，它说明为什么扁平归因会把最近但无关的工具结果误判为关键证据。Problem Formulation 值得看，因为它定义了 turn 类型、target span、token-level attribution 和 graph-level provenance 的关系。方法部分重点看递归停止条件、turn 聚合策略、tool result 的处理方式。实验部分优先看 MTCABench 的标注协议和 metric，而不是只看总体分数；这些细节决定该 benchmark 是否适合评估真实 agent trace。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies attribution in multi-turn agentic conversations. Given a specific claim or span in a final assistant response, the goal is to trace which earlier turns supported it and how the dependency propagated through intermediate assistant messages, tool results, and user inputs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to long-context and agentic model evaluation. Standard context attribution treats the whole context as a flat sequence and can identify locally relevant tokens or turns, but it cannot recover the path by which information was transformed across a conversation. For agent training and debugging, such provenance graphs can help separate tool errors, user-information misreading, lossy intermediate summaries, and unsupported final claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define multi-turn context attribution as recovering a dependency DAG over conversation turns. Tokengeist is agnostic to the underlying attribution method. Starting from a target span, it applies a single-turn attribution method to identify directly relevant earlier turns, then recursively treats those turns as new targets and traces their own dependencies backward until reaching exogenous inputs such as system or user turns, or another stopping condition. The formulation distinguishes exogenous turns, model-generated assistant turns, and tool-result turns. Attribution is computed at the token level, then aggregated to sentence or turn-level units for graph construction and path extraction. The main design choice is to reuse existing attribution methods inside a recursive graph-building procedure, rather than train a specialized explainer. The limitation is that graph quality remains coupled to the quality of the base attribution method.
summary_en.experiments: The authors introduce MTCABench with 3,845 annotated target spans across 665 multi-turn conversations. The benchmark includes 688 examples from ConFETTI and 3,157 from TauBench, with gold provenance graphs. The conversations include tool-calling traces and cases designed around known failure modes such as hallucination and distraction by irrelevant turns. The qualitative example in the introduction shows a typical failure of flat attribution: a final refund claim is attributed mostly to the nearby cancellation tool result T27, while the actual support comes through a longer path involving the user’s health reason T23, an insurance field in a tool result T9, and a lookup chain seeded by the user ID T3. The provided text does not include the full metric table, so only the broad finding can be stated: flat attribution fails systematically in multi-turn settings, and the paper evaluates several base attribution methods within Tokengeist.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the TauBench airline example in the introduction, since it explains why nearby tool results can dominate flat attribution even when they are not the real evidence. Then read the problem formulation for the definitions of turn types, target spans, token-level attribution, and provenance graphs. In the method section, focus on recursion, stopping criteria, aggregation from tokens to turns, and special handling of tool results. In the experiments, prioritize the MTCABench annotation protocol and metrics over aggregate scores, because these details determine whether the benchmark captures realistic agent traces.

recommendation.zh: 微软推出的多轮归因工具带评测基准，可用来分析长上下文对话模型的token依赖路径，读§3的DAG归因框架即可。
recommendation.en: A multi-turn attribution tool from MSR with an evaluation benchmark; useful for analyzing token dependency paths in long-context dialogue models, read §3 on the DAG attribution framework.

paper.title: Grounding latent algorithm routing in transformer reasoning
paper.abstract: A central question in the in-context learning literature is whether transformers can organize episode-level adaptation around different inductive-bias families. We study this question in a controlled setting through latent algorithm routing: route-like behavior in which the solver-family preference changes with the latent data-generating regime while prompt form is held fixed, remains stable under nuisance perturbations, and is selectively influenced by targeted activation interventions without

summary.core_problem: 该工作关注一个较窄但有意义的问题：在同一种 prompt 形式下，dense decoder-only Transformer 是否会根据 episode 的潜在数据生成机制，选择不同的“算法族”来完成 in-context learning。它要排除三类常见误判：模型只是利用格式线索、模型只是连续插值不同解法、probe 只是事后读出了相关信号但没有参与计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。它把 ICL 中的“模型会不会在上下文内做算法选择”变成了可测的诊断问题，并给出 RouteBench 这样一个受控环境。对基座研究员有用的地方在于：它把 route-like computation 拆成结构必要性、表面扰动不变性、因果可编辑性三个条件。这个框架可以迁移到更真实的预训练模型分析，例如研究模型在数学、代码、检索、鲁棒估计等任务之间是否形成可干预的内部计算分工。它也和 MoE 的显式路由形成对照：dense 模型里可能存在可读出的软路由变量，但这不等于存在硬符号 router。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 RouteBench 展开。一个 episode 由 support set 和 query 组成，序列化格式固定，变化的是潜在 regime。作者构造四类具有不同归纳偏置的 solver family：ridge-like 对应全局 shrinkage，lasso-like 对应稀疏性，Huber-like 对应重尾噪声下的鲁棒性，kNN-like 对应局部相似性。训练时不给 route label，测试时用模型输出与各 solver 输出的距离定义行为代理：模型当前答案更接近哪一类 solver，就把它视为偏向该 route。这个代理不是硬路由真值，而是为了做行为和因果诊断。核心设计有三点：第一，latent regime 改变但 prompt syntax 不变时，偏好的 solver family 应该系统变化；第二，表面扰动、自然语言渲染等 nuisance perturbation 不应显著改变 route；第三，通过 targeted activation intervention 能选择性改变 route identity，同时不大幅破坏答案质量。作者还设置了固定 solver、全局 mixture、input-conditioned soft mixture、unsupervised Gumbel router、privileged-stat router 和 oracle upper bound 作为参照，并加入 probe permutation、matched patching、route-proxy margin、四路统一设置和 Switch-MoE 诊断来控制读出伪相关。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 pairwise RouteBench 和统一四路设置。主要现象是：较大的 dense decoder-only Transformer 在固定 prompt 形式下，会随潜在数据 regime 改变而表现出不同 solver-family 偏好；这种偏好在若干表面扰动和自然语言渲染下保持相对稳定；中间激活中可以解码出 route-like 变量；对目标激活做 patching 或编辑时，route proxy 的变化大于答案质量的退化。对照实验包括 probe permutation 和 matched patching，用来检验读出信号是否只是训练 probe 的伪相关。文中可确认的实验设计较完整，但给出的文本片段没有暴露具体参数量、数据规模、各表格数值和提升幅度，因此不宜补写具体数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 latent algorithm routing 的定义，重点理解三个判据：structural necessity、nuisance invariance、causal editability。然后看 RouteBench 的 regime 和 solver-family 构造，判断这些归纳偏置是否足够可分。实验部分优先看四类结果：route proxy 的 margin 分析、自然语言和格式扰动下的稳定性、activation intervention 或 patching、probe permutation 和 matched controls。最值得深挖的是“行为上接近某个 solver”与“内部真的存在参与计算的 route variable”之间的差距；作者的干预实验就是为了缩小这个差距，但仍不能证明模型实现了离散算法路由。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether dense decoder-only Transformers can condition their in-context computation on the latent data-generating regime, while the surface form of the prompt is held fixed. The target is not ordinary accuracy. The target is to distinguish genuine route-like algorithm selection from prompt-template artifacts, smooth interpolation among solvers, or probes that merely decode a correlated state after the computation has already happened.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic and diagnostic, not a new pretraining recipe. It gives a controlled way to study whether in-context learning contains episode-level variables that behave like algorithm-family choices. The useful part for pretraining research is the decomposition of routing evidence into three tests: the preferred solver should change when the latent regime changes, remain stable under nuisance perturbations, and be causally editable through targeted activation interventions. This framing is also useful when comparing dense models with explicit MoE routing: a dense model may contain decodable soft routing structure without implementing a hard symbolic router.
summary_en.technical_approach: RouteBench constructs episodes with a support set and a query. The serialization is kept fixed, while the latent regime changes. The solver bank contains four clean representatives of different inductive biases: ridge-like solvers for global shrinkage, lasso-like solvers for sparsity, Huber-like solvers for robustness to heavy-tailed noise, and kNN-like solvers for locality. Route labels are never given to the dense Transformers. At evaluation time, the model answer is compared with the outputs of these solver families, and the closest solver family defines a behavioral route proxy. The paper then checks whether this proxy satisfies structural necessity, nuisance invariance, and causal editability. The baselines include fixed solver representatives, a global mixture, an input-conditioned soft mixture, an unsupervised Gumbel router, privileged-statistic routers, and an oracle. Additional controls include natural-language renderings, a unified four-way setting, route-margin checks, probe permutation controls, matched patching controls, and Switch-MoE diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments cover pairwise RouteBench settings and a unified four-way setting. The main finding is that larger dense decoder-only Transformers show regime-dependent solver-family preferences under fixed syntax. These preferences are relatively stable under nuisance surface perturbations and natural-language renderings. Route-like variables are decodable from intermediate activations, and targeted activation interventions can shift the inferred route more than they degrade answer quality. Probe permutation and matched patching controls are used to reduce the risk that the signal is only a spurious readout. The provided text does not expose exact model sizes, data scales, or table-level numerical gains, so the reliable summary is about the experimental structure and qualitative conclusions rather than specific numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough for most readers. Focus first on the definition of latent algorithm routing and the three grounding criteria. Then inspect the construction of RouteBench and ask whether the four solver families are cleanly separated enough to support the claim. In the experiments, prioritize the route-margin analysis, nuisance-invariance tests, activation patching or intervention results, and the probe permutation or matched-control sections. The main technical point to examine is the gap between behavioral solver similarity and a causally active internal routing variable; the intervention experiments are the strongest part of the evidence, but they still do not prove a discrete internal router.

recommendation.zh: ICL机制研究的新角度，重点看§3的路由定义和§4的规模实验，理解Transformer隐式选择归纳偏置的能力。
recommendation.en: Novel angle on ICL mechanism; focus on §3 routing definition and §4 scaling experiments to understand Transformers' implicit inductive bias selection.

paper.title: AssumptionMiner: Extracting, Tracing, and Revising Implicit Assumptions in LLM Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate code from natural-language prompts, yet real-world prompts rarely provide complete specifications. When prompts leave input formats, error handling, or design decisions unspecified, LLMs fill these gaps with implicit assumptions that shape the generated code's behavior and correctness. Because these assumptions remain hidden, generated code may satisfy tests while violating developer intent. We present AssumptionMiner, a framework that makes implicit assumpt

summary.core_problem: LLM代码生成时，自然语言prompt存在未明确规范，模型填充的隐式假设不可见，导致代码通过测试但违反开发者意图的问题。
summary.importance: 方法+数据贡献，提出隐式假设的显式化框架，同时发布含676条标注假设的180个歧义编程任务基准。
summary.technical_approach: 1) AssumptionMiner框架生成代码同时输出显式假设层，结构化表示推断的约束和设计决策；2) 基于AST的依赖图实现假设修改后仅重生成受影响代码；3) 构建180个歧义编程任务benchmark，含人工验证子集。
summary.experiments: 构建180个歧义编程任务，含676条标注假设，包含人工验证的子集用于评测假设提取的准确性。
summary.authors_note: Michigan Technological University，无知名作者识别。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem that natural language prompts for LLM code generation have unspecified specifications, and implicit assumptions filled by models are invisible, leading to code that passes tests but violates developer intent.
summary_en.importance: Method + data contribution; proposes an explicit assumption framework for implicit assumptions, and releases a benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) AssumptionMiner framework outputs an explicit assumption layer alongside code, structurally representing inferred constraints and design decisions; 2) AST-based dependency graph enables targeted regeneration of only code affected by revised assumptions; 3) Builds benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with human-verified subset.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions, including a human-verified subset for evaluating assumption extraction accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Michigan Technological University; no well-known authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 代码生成隐式假设的工具化探索，benchmark可作为代码预训练数据歧义性分析的参考，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Tool-oriented exploration of implicit assumptions in code generation; benchmark can serve as reference for ambiguity analysis of code pretraining data, no need to read full text.

institutions: explicit can support more inspectable and controllable
onds, a workflow that has moved from research prototypes
Jie JW Wu is with Michigan Technological University, Houghton

paper.title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have advanced rapidly, yet progress remains fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulty, and interaction settings. We frame this as full-scenario agentic scaling and present AgentOmnia, a framework coordinating task-space definition, data synthesis, post-training, evaluation, and improvement across To-Consumer (ToC), To-Business (ToB), and To-Employee (ToE) applications. An extensible Domain x Capability x Atomic Difficulty taxonomy aligns these stages an

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM Agent的研究在领域、能力、任务难度、交互设置上高度碎片化，缺乏统一的全场景Agent scaling框架与配套的评测、数据合成、后训练流程。
summary.importance: 系统创新（全场景Agent开发框架AgentOmnia）+ 基准贡献（OmniaBench，含大规模有状态环境与工具）+ 方法创新（双向环境-任务合成、回滚课程后训练），为Agent的规模化开发提供了统一范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Domain×Capability×Atomic Difficulty的可扩展任务分类法，对齐任务定义、数据合成、后训练、评测环节；设计双向环境-任务合成、工具依赖/程序结构/求解器混合的数据合成pipeline；采用SFT、在线Agent RL、回滚课程的组合后训练方案；将评测失败转化为PRD反哺迭代。
summary.experiments: 构建包含5,018个有状态环境、255,375个工具、52,361个任务的OmniaBench；给定摘要未披露模型规模、基线方法及具体性能提升数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM agent research is highly fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulties, and interaction settings, lacking a unified full-scenario agent scaling framework and supporting evaluation, data synthesis, and post-training pipelines.
summary_en.importance: System innovation (full-scenario agent development framework AgentOmnia) plus benchmark contribution (OmniaBench with large-scale stateful environments and tools) plus methodological innovation (bidirectional environment-task synthesis, rollback curriculum post-training), providing a unified paradigm for large-scale agent development.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an extensible Domain×Capability×Atomic Difficulty task taxonomy to align task definition, data synthesis, post-training, and evaluation; designs a bidirectional environment-task synthesis pipeline combined with tool-dependency, program-structured, and solver-based methods; adopts a combined post-training scheme of SFT, online agentic RL, and rollback curriculum; translates evaluation failures into PRDs to feed back into iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs OmniaBench with 5,018 stateful environments, 255,375 tools, and 52,361 tasks; given abstract discloses no model size, baselines, or specific performance improvement data.

recommendation.zh: 全场景Agent的全流程框架，重点看§3任务分类法和§4数据合成pipeline，可借鉴到预训练多领域语料构建与后训练流程设计中。
recommendation.en: Full-pipeline framework for full-scenario agents; focus on §3 task taxonomy and §4 data synthesis pipeline, which can inform multi-domain corpus construction and post-training pipeline design.

paper.title: ConsistencyGate: Preventing Memory Contamination in LLM Agents via Self-Consistency Admission Control
paper.abstract: LLM agents that operate over many turns accumulate facts in an external memory store and reuse them as premises for downstream reasoning. A hallucinated fact written at one step therefore persists as a false premise for every subsequent step, a failure mode we call memory contamination. Existing memory management addresses retrieval and capacity but not write-time correctness; this admission problem cannot be solved by utility- or recency-based criteria, and uncontrolled contamination compounds

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent多轮交互中，外部记忆写入的幻觉事实会持续污染后续推理，现有内存管理仅关注检索/容量，未解决写时正确性问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新（提出无需微调的写时准入机制）+ 基准贡献（构建两个真实对话评测集），填补了Agent内存写时校验的研究空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ConsistencyGate写时准入门控，在将候选事实写入记忆前调用LLM K次生成软支持分，均值超阈值才准入；另有log-prob变体仅需单次前向，适配低延迟场景；模型无关，无需微调。
summary.experiments: 构建两个真实对话基准测试集以量化内存污染影响；给定摘要未披露模型参数量、基线方法及具体性能提升数据。
summary.authors_note: Florida State University，未披露知名作者及团队代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Hallucinated facts written to LLM agents' external memory persist across multi-turn reasoning and contaminate downstream outputs, while existing memory management only addresses retrieval and capacity instead of write-time correctness.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation (training-free write-time admission control) plus benchmark contribution (two real-conversation evaluation sets), filling the gap of write-time memory verification for LLM agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ConsistencyGate, a write-time admission mechanism that queries the LLM K times to get soft support scores for candidate facts, admitting only those with average scores above a threshold; a log-probability variant requires only one forward pass for low-latency scenarios; model-agnostic and training-free.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs two real-conversation benchmarks to measure memory contamination impact; given abstract discloses no model size, baselines, or quantitative performance gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Florida State University; no notable authors or representative team works disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 推理时门控方案，无需修改预训练，可作为Agent记忆模块的弱基线，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Inference-time gating scheme with no pretraining modifications; serves as a weak baseline for agent memory modules, only the methods section is worth reading.

paper.title: Medical-Checklist: Assessing the Comprehension of Medical Images by Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: This paper introduces a new benchmark test, Medical-Checklist, for assessing medical multimodal models. The recent advancements in multimodal models have demonstrated significant potential in the field of medical vision-language tasks. However, it is becoming increasingly clear that evaluating these models' performance, whether they are applied to natural or medical images, is challenging. The critical question is whether the models can accurately understand an input image while associating it w

summary.core_problem: 解决医学多模态模型评测里，现有指标难以判断模型是否真的理解图像与文本对应关系的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark/evaluation protocol。虽然场景在医学影像，仍有一点方法学价值：用最小文本扰动构造二选一判别，测试模型是否抓住关键概念，而不是靠语言先验蒙对。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Medical-Checklist：给定一张图像和两条候选描述，其中错误描述只替换一个医学概念词或短语，模型需做二分类选择。这个设计试图统一评估不同架构和训练方式的多模态模型，并把评测聚焦到概念级图文对应。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和完整结果，但强调该任务足够简单，能在不同类型的多模态模型间统一比较。对预训练研究员的价值主要在评测构造思路，而不是医学结果本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 Bannapol Limanond、Masanori Suganuma、Takayuki Okatani。未从给定信息中确认更具体的团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of evaluating whether medical multimodal models truly understand image-text correspondence rather than exploiting superficial cues.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol. While the domain is medical imaging, the methodological idea is still somewhat useful: use minimal textual perturbations in a forced-choice setup to test concept-level grounding instead of language-prior guessing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Medical-Checklist presents an image with two captions, where the incorrect one differs by a single substituted medical concept. The model must choose the correct caption, aiming to isolate concept-level image-text understanding across diverse multimodal models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model scales or full quantitative results, but emphasizes that the task is simple enough to compare heterogeneous multimodal models under a unified protocol. The value for pretraining researchers lies more in the evaluation design than in the medical findings.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are Bannapol Limanond, Masanori Suganuma, and Takayuki Okatani. No stronger lab context can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 医学场景限制了外推性，但“单概念替换 + 二选一”这个评测模板很干净；做 VLM 对齐时可直接借去测语言先验泄漏。
recommendation.en: The domain is narrow, but the single-concept substitution plus forced-choice protocol is clean; borrow the template if you need to probe language-prior leakage in VLMs.

paper.title: Ground Truth First: A Longitudinal Evaluation Instrument for Agent Memory, and the Tenure Crossover in Memory-Architecture Rankings
paper.abstract: Benchmarks for LLM-agent memory typically generate conversations first and extract answer keys afterwards -- with documented label-error and contamination problems -- and they overwhelmingly measure short interaction histories. We invert the pipeline: a seeded life-script sampler emits facts with validity intervals, volatility classes, and source channels before any text exists; an LLM renderer writes chat and email from per-event fact manifests; a fidelity verifier confirms every planted fact;

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent memory benchmark 往往先生成对话再反推答案，容易带来标签错误、污染和短上下文偏置，导致对记忆架构的评估失真。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测方法论文。它不直接推进预训练，但对长期记忆、合成评测构造、标签保真和 contamination 控制给出了较干净的设计，对做 long-horizon agent eval 的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者反转 benchmark 构造流程：先用 life-script sampler 生成带有效期、波动性、来源渠道的事实脚本，再由 LLM 渲染成聊天和邮件，随后用 verifier 检查每个植入事实，并机械生成问题与 gold answers。数据还包含 as-of-date 问题、sent/received trust 区分和 benign injection probes。随后在固定 answerer、版本化 LLM judge 的设置下评测五种 memory architecture。
summary.experiments: 构造约 380 个问题、15 种题型的合成长期记忆评测集，并比较五种 memory 架构与无记忆对照。摘要中的核心结果是出现“tenure crossover”：短期与长期交互历史下，记忆架构的优劣排序会发生反转。由于规模不大、作者为独立研究者，结论更适合作为评测设计信号，而非定论。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者；工作代表性在于评测构造思路较干净，而非大规模实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent-memory benchmarks often generate conversations first and derive answer keys afterward, which introduces label errors, contamination, and a bias toward short histories.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it offers a cleaner way to build long-horizon memory benchmarks with better label fidelity and contamination control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper inverts the benchmark pipeline: a life-script sampler first generates facts with validity intervals, volatility classes, and source channels; an LLM then renders chats and emails; a verifier checks planted facts; and questions plus gold answers are instantiated mechanically. The benchmark also includes as-of-date questions, sent/received trust distinctions, and benign injection probes. Five memory architectures are then evaluated under a fixed answerer and versioned LLM judge.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains about 380 questions across 15 types. The headline finding is a tenure crossover: architecture rankings change when moving from shorter to longer interaction histories.
