Because the scale is modest and the work is from an independent researcher, the result is better treated as an evaluation signal than a settled conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher; the main value is the cleaner benchmark-construction logic rather than large-scale experimentation.

recommendation.zh: 评测构造比结果本身更值得看：先种事实再生成文本，这个 pipeline 能减少 memory benchmark 的脏标签；正文只看数据生成流程和 crossover 结果。
recommendation.en: The construction pipeline matters more than the leaderboard: seed facts first, render text later. Read the data-generation setup and the crossover result, not the full paper.

paper.title: Pixels for Programs? A Cross-Provider Case Study of Input-Token Accounting for Source Code as Text and Images
paper.abstract: Long source-code contexts consume many text tokens, motivating the proposal to render code as images for vision-language models. Recent work asks whether models can still solve code tasks after this transformation. We examine a different systems question: how commercial APIs count the resulting requests. We present a reproducible measurement case study of provider-reported input tokens for raw source text and a compact rendered-image representation. The benchmark pairs requests across five progr

summary.core_problem: 商业VLM API对代码文本与代码渲染图像两种输入形式的token计费规则不透明，缺乏系统测量。
summary.importance: 属于评测/系统测量类贡献，首次跨厂商量化了代码转图像输入的token成本差异，对长代码上下文的API调用成本优化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖5种编程语言、9种代码长度（20-2000行）的基准，对Anthropic、OpenAI、Google Vertex AI共15个模型别名进行文本/图像配对请求测量，提取不同厂商的计费签名。
summary.experiments: 完成675组文本-图像配对测量，整体图像/文本token比分别为0.135、0.194、0.242，对应输入token减少75.8%-86.5%，且不同厂商计费行为存在显著异质性。

summary_en.core_problem: Token accounting rules of commercial VLM APIs for raw code text versus rendered code images are opaque and lack systematic measurement.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation/system measurement contribution that first quantifies cross-provider token cost differences for code-to-image input conversion, providing reference for long-code API cost optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a benchmark covering 5 programming languages and 9 code lengths (20–2000 lines), conducts paired text/image request measurements across 15 model aliases from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Vertex AI to extract distinct accounting signatures.
summary_en.experiments: Completes 675 paired text-image measurements; aggregate image-to-text token ratios are 0.135, 0.194, and 0.242, corresponding to 75.8%–86.5% input token reduction, with materially heterogeneous accounting behavior across providers.

recommendation.zh: 仅涉及商业API计费测量，与预训练方法论无关，作为工程成本参考备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Only covers commercial API billing measurement, irrelevant to pretraining methodology; keep as engineering cost reference, skip full text.

paper.title: Be Consistent! Enhancing Robust Visual Reasoning in LVLMs with Consistency Constraints
paper.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong perceptual capabilities, they remain vulnerable in visual reasoning tasks. Existing benchmarks largely focus on symbolic mathematical or scientific problems and simple vision-centric tasks, offering limited assessment of complex visual reasoning and logical consistency, a critical requirement for reliable reasoning systems. We introduce ConVBench, a complex vision-centric reasoning benchmark in which each image is paired with two logicall

summary.core_problem: 评估并改进 LVLM 在复杂视觉推理中的逻辑一致性：模型可能答对单个问题，但对逻辑等价问题给出不一致答案。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个视觉中心推理 benchmark、两个一致性相关指标，以及基于 GRPO 的一致性约束训练。它不是预训练工作，但对多模态后训练信号设计和评测协议有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ConVBench，每张图像配对两个逻辑等价问题，覆盖动作与状态、复杂计数、空间推理、因果与意图、常识推理、时间感知六类。评测上定义 logical consistency 和 robust accuracy；方法上提出 ConVLM，用 GRPO 强化学习把一致性约束纳入 LVLM 训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、训练样本规模、baseline 名单或具体提升幅度。实验应围绕 ConVBench 上不同 LVLM 的正确率、一致性和 robust accuracy 展开，并比较 GRPO 一致性训练前后表现。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Texas at Dallas 和 Amazon Web Services。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and improves logical consistency in LVLM visual reasoning, where a model may answer one question correctly but fail on a logically equivalent counterpart.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a vision-centric reasoning benchmark, consistency-aware metrics, and a GRPO-based training method. It is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to multimodal post-training signal design and evaluation protocol design.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConVBench pairs each image with two logically equivalent questions across six categories: action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal and intent understanding, commonsense reasoning, and temporal perception. The paper defines logical consistency and robust accuracy, and introduces ConVLM, which applies GRPO with consistency constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. The experiments likely compare LVLMs on correctness, consistency, and robust accuracy, and measure the effect of GRPO-based consistency training.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Texas at Dallas and Amazon Web Services.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 构造和 robust accuracy 定义；GRPO 部分更像后训练套件，别过度外推到基座训练。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and robust-accuracy metric; the GRPO part is a post-training recipe and should not be over-generalized to base training.

paper.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
paper.abstract: We introduce Tencent WorkBuddy Bench, a multi-domain evaluation suite for coding agents; this report documents its construction methodology, scoring protocol, and a cross-model leaderboard. At its core is a unified evaluation framework for constructing and running distribution-informed coding-agent tasks across four work domains - Code, Web, Office, and Security. Rather than adapting public issue text, every task is reverse-engineered from a real commit, pull request, or business scenario and re

summary.core_problem: 构建一个覆盖多工作场景的 coding-agent benchmark，并降低公开数据集被训练污染或网页检索命中的风险。
summary.importance: 这是腾讯发布的 coding-agent 评测资产和 leaderboard。价值在于任务构造方法：从真实 commit、PR 或业务场景反向构造任务，再改写成短的口语化角色请求，使 prompt 难以通过搜索复原原始 issue 或提交记录。
summary.technical_approach: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench 提供统一评测框架，覆盖 Code、Web、Office、Security 四个工作域。每个任务包含 task directory、environment image、evaluation harness、tests 和 reference solution。污染防护不依赖保密，而依赖 reverse-engineered task construction 和 dataset versioning。
summary.experiments: 报告包含跨模型 leaderboard。任务子集涵盖仓库级工程、前端开发、办公/业务流程和安全相关任务。摘要未给出具体模型排名、任务数量和分数，但强调数据、环境、测试和参考解均公开。
summary.authors_note: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench Team 发布的 coding-agent benchmark，机构来自腾讯。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds a multi-domain coding-agent benchmark while reducing the risk that open tasks are solved through training contamination or web-search recovery.
summary_en.importance: This is a Tencent coding-agent evaluation suite and leaderboard. Its main value is the construction methodology: tasks are reverse-engineered from real commits, pull requests, or business scenarios and rewritten as short colloquial role-play requests, making prompts hard to recover by searching the original artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench provides a unified framework across Code, Web, Office, and Security domains. Each task includes directories, environment images, an evaluation harness, tests, and reference solutions. Contamination resistance relies on reverse-engineered task construction and dataset versioning rather than secrecy.
summary_en.experiments: The report includes a cross-model leaderboard. The subsets cover repository-level engineering, front-end development, office/business workflows, and security tasks. The abstract does not provide exact task counts, model rankings, or scores, but states that task assets, environments, tests, and reference solutions are openly released.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by the Tencent WorkBuddy Bench Team as a coding-agent benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 值得看任务构造协议而非榜单；公开 benchmark 还能抗污染，这个假设需要用后续版本持续检验。
recommendation.en: Read the task-construction protocol, not the leaderboard; the claim that an open benchmark can resist contamination needs longitudinal validation.

paper.title: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators
paper.abstract: The quality of training data fundamentally determines the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet no unified benchmark exists to measure how well LLMs, agents, and data-centric workflows actually prepare training data end to end. We view LLM-driven data preparation as comprising two complementary capabilities: data construction, which transforms raw sources into supervised training data, and data quality evaluation, which predicts the training value of candidate datasets before downstr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是一个长期缺位的评测问题：当社区开始用 LLM、agent 或数据工作流去“生产训练数据”时，怎样在统一协议下评估两件事——一是它们能否把原始资料转成真正有训练价值的 SFT 数据，二是它们能否在训练前就判断候选数据集的下游价值。作者强调，数据质量不是表面流畅度或多样性，而是对下游模型训练是否有用。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的价值主要在评测框架，而不是某个单点算法。很多数据合成工作只展示样例质量或单一任务提升，难以比较，也难以知道收益来自方法还是来自实验设置。DataPrep-Bench 的意义在于把 raw sources、base models、训练协议和下游评测统一起来，让“数据准备”第一次能按 end-to-end downstream utility 来比较。更重要的是，作者给出一个不太讨喜但很有用的结论：在 Dolly-15k 之上继续加入合成领域数据，很多时候反而会让模型变差。这对做合成数据、课程数据、数据筛选的人都有提醒——如果没有 downstream-grounded 的闭环，表面上看起来高质量的数据很可能只是噪声或分布偏移。贡献量级偏 benchmark 和 protocol，适合作为后续数据研究的公共试验台。
summary.technical_approach:
基准分成两个 track。Data Construction Track 从原始领域资料出发，要求方法把它们转成监督微调数据；然后把这些数据与共享的 Dolly-15k 一起用于微调同一个 base model，再在对应领域 benchmark 上评估。这样设计有两个目的：一是避免不同方法用不同底座和不同训练 recipe 导致不可比；二是模拟现实中“通用指令能力 + 领域数据补充”的常见训练场景。作者提供的 baseline 叫 Data-Construction-Skill，不是单次 prompt，而是一个 skill-guided agent：把数据构造拆成可复用技能层，包括输出 schema、过滤规则、覆盖约束和验证工具。这个设计的重点不是 agent 外壳，而是把数据构造流程显式结构化，减少自由生成带来的格式漂移和低质量样本。

Data Quality Evaluation Track 则从候选训练数据池出发，给每个数据集一个标量分数，再看这个分数与“用该数据集微调后模型的真实下游表现”之间的线性相关性。作者发布了候选池及其 ground-truth performance records，使得后续方法可以直接做离线比较。对应 baseline 是 Distributional Alignment Score, DAS。它不是让 LLM 打分，而是用分布对齐思路，计算候选数据集与领域代理分布之间的 Maximum Mean Discrepancy。作者的立场很明确：如果一个质量指标不能稳定预测训练后性能，它就不是有用的数据质量指标。这个 benchmark 的方法学价值在于把 construction 和 evaluation 两个通常分开的问题放到同一套 downstream-grounded protocol 里。
summary.experiments: 摘要和正文给出的核心结果有三类。第一类是负结果，也是最重要的结果：在多个 domain、多个 base model、以及 DataFlow、direct-LLM、agent-based 等不同生成范式下，往 Dolly-15k 上叠加合成领域数据，经常比只用 Dolly-15k 更差。因为两组实验唯一差别就是额外的领域合成数据，所以性能回退可以直接归因到这些数据本身，而不是训练 recipe。第二类是 construction 方法的分域差异，没有单一赢家。DataFlow-Skill 在结构化领域如 Finance、Law 更强；agent-based 方法在 Math、Medical 这类 reasoning-heavy 领域更好；作者自己的 Data-Construction-Skill 在知识抽取密集型领域表现最好，在 Llama-3.1-8B Finance 上相对 Dolly-only baseline 提升接近 20 个绝对点，并且能和最强的 agent/DataFlow 方法打平。Science 和部分 Law 仍然难。第三类是 quality evaluation 指标的比较。DAS 在 6 个领域里有 4 个拿到最强的平均相关性，并且是唯一一个在 Math、Science、Medical 三个领域同时达到 r>0.70 的指标。相对地，很多基于表面质量或多样性的指标要么只在个别领域有效，要么在不同 domain-model 组合上连相关性的符号都不稳定。Finance 和 Law 对所有指标都仍然困难。正文如果细看，重点应放在相关性矩阵、不同 base model 的一致性，以及“Dolly-only vs Dolly+synthetic”的对照表。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读到中等深度。先看 Benchmark Design，弄清两个 track 的输入、输出和统一训练协议；如果这一层没看明白，后面的结果会被误读成“某个 agent 方法好不好”。然后直接看实验总表，优先抓住两个结论：一是合成领域数据经常伤害性能，二是不同构造范式的优势高度依赖领域。接着看 Data-Construction-Skill 的流程图或技能定义，理解作者为什么不用单 prompt 生成，而要加 schema、过滤和验证。最后看 DAS 的定义和相关性结果，尤其是它与 LLM-as-a-judge、质量/多样性指标相比时哪里更稳。预计 40–60 分钟可以读完主要内容；如果你做数据筛选、合成 SFT 数据或 continual pretrain 的数据配比，这篇值得把实验设置和 released assets 记下来，后续可以直接拿来复现实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing evaluation problem: once the community starts using LLMs, agents, and data-centric pipelines to prepare training data, how should we measure whether they actually produce useful supervision and whether they can predict dataset value before training? The benchmark formalizes two capabilities under one downstream-grounded protocol: data construction, which turns raw sources into trainable SFT data, and data quality evaluation, which scores candidate datasets by expected downstream utility rather than by surface fluency or diversity alone.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is methodological. Many synthetic-data papers are hard to compare because they change raw sources, base models, training recipes, and evaluation sets all at once. DataPrep-Bench standardizes those pieces and evaluates data preparation by the only criterion that ultimately matters here: how much the resulting model improves after training. The most useful finding is also the least flattering one: adding synthetic domain data on top of Dolly-15k often hurts downstream performance. That is a strong warning for anyone working on synthetic instruction data, data filtering, or curriculum design. Without a downstream-grounded loop, apparently high-quality data can still be harmful because it shifts the distribution or injects low-value supervision. The paper is more benchmark/protocol than algorithm, but it provides a practical testbed for future data work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The benchmark has two tracks. In the Data Construction Track, a method starts from raw domain sources and outputs supervised fine-tuning data. The resulting dataset is then used to fine-tune a shared base model jointly with Dolly-15k, and the adapted model is evaluated on held-out domain benchmarks. This design serves two purposes: it removes confounds from changing base models or training recipes, and it reflects a realistic setup where generic instruction-following data is supplemented with domain-specific supervision. The released baseline, Data-Construction-Skill, is a skill-guided agent rather than a one-shot prompt. It decomposes construction into reusable components such as output schemas, filtering rules, coverage constraints, and validation utilities. The point is not the agent wrapper itself, but the explicit structuring of the data-generation pipeline to reduce uncontrolled drift in format and quality.

In the Data Quality Evaluation Track, the input is a pool of candidate training datasets. A scoring function assigns each dataset a scalar score, and the benchmark measures how well those scores linearly predict the actual downstream performance of models fine-tuned on the same datasets. The authors release both the candidate pools and the ground-truth performance records, which makes offline comparison possible. Their baseline metric is Distributional Alignment Score (DAS), a distribution-based evaluator built from Maximum Mean Discrepancy between a candidate dataset and a domain proxy. The underlying stance is clear: a data-quality metric is only useful if it predicts post-training utility reliably. A key strength of the benchmark is that it places construction and evaluation inside the same downstream-grounded protocol instead of treating them as separate problems.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings stand out. First, the negative result: across multiple domains, base models, and construction families including DataFlow-based, direct-LLM, and agent-based generators, adding synthetic domain data on top of Dolly-15k often underperforms the Dolly-only baseline. Since the training setup is otherwise shared, the regressions can be attributed directly to the added synthetic data rather than to recipe differences. Second, there is no universal winner among construction methods. DataFlow-Skill performs best in more structured domains such as Finance and Law; agent-based methods do better in reasoning-heavy domains such as Math and Medical; the authors’ Data-Construction-Skill is strongest in knowledge-extraction-heavy settings and improves the Dolly-only baseline by nearly 20 absolute points on Llama-3.1-8B Finance while matching the strongest competing methods. Science and parts of Law remain open. Third, DAS is the most reliable quality-evaluation metric overall. It achieves the strongest average correlation with downstream performance in four of six domains and is the only metric that clears r > 0.70 simultaneously in Math, Science, and Medical. By contrast, many quality- or diversity-based metrics are either narrow specialists or even sign-inconsistent across domain-model cells. Finance and Law remain difficult for all tested metrics. When reading the results, pay special attention to the Dolly-only versus Dolly-plus-synthetic comparisons and to the correlation tables for quality metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim-to-medium-depth paper. Start with the benchmark design and make sure the two tracks are clear; otherwise the results can be misread as a comparison of agent wrappers rather than a comparison of data-preparation capability. Then go straight to the main result tables and retain two points: synthetic domain data often hurts, and the best construction strategy is domain-dependent. After that, inspect the Data-Construction-Skill pipeline to see why the authors prefer a structured skill layer over one-shot prompting. Finally, read the DAS definition and the correlation results, especially where it is more stable than LLM-as-a-judge or surface-level quality/diversity metrics. Around 40–60 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. If you work on synthetic SFT data, data filtering, or continual pretraining mixtures, the released assets and protocol are likely the most reusable part.

recommendation.zh: 评测协议用“真训一次再打分”替代表面质量指标，对数据筛选/合成 pipeline 很实用；重点看 construction track 的打分协议和 baseline 排名。
recommendation.en: Protocol uses actual fine-tune outcomes instead of surface quality proxies—useful for data filtering/synthesis pipelines; focus on the scoring protocol and baseline ranking in the construction track.

paper.title: InferenceBench: A Benchmark for Open-Ended LLM Inference Optimization by AI Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly used to automate research and development tasks, yet existing benchmarks typically evaluate them on prescribed workflows or narrow action spaces. Even nominally open-ended tasks can often be solved by retrieving a well-known recipe and tuning a few hyperparameters, making it unclear whether strong results reflect genuine optimization or memorized solutions. We introduce InferenceBench, where an agent must deploy an OpenAI-compatible inference server and optimize the sp

summary.core_problem: 现有 AI agent 研究评测大多退化为在狭窄超参数空间里复现已知配方，无法区分“真正的系统级优化能力”和“记住了现成配置”。论文提出以 LLM 推理服务部署与优化作为开放式工程任务，测试 agent 在真实依赖冲突、kernel/runtime/框架选择下的端到端优化能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个设计得比较有意思的 agent benchmark，核心价值不在传统 LLM pretrain，而在于把“有正确答案但路径高度开放、且失败模式是系统级 crash 而不是 loss 略差”的工程任务做成评测。对训练侧的间接启发是：它清楚区分了 memorized recipes 和 genuine exploration，这一点对自动化 ML、自动化 post-training、甚至 agent 化训练系统的设计都有参考意义。但它不属于预训练方法论文，更多是 eval / agent infrastructure 方向。
summary.technical_approach: InferenceBench 给 agent 一个固定环境：单张 H100、指定基座模型（如 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3）、2 小时 wall-clock 预算，要求启动一个通过完整性校验和输出质量校验的 OpenAI-compatible 推理服务器，并最大化目标指标。动作空间完全开放：可以选 vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM、做量化、调 batch size / KV cache / CUDA graph、甚至自己写 kernel。设计了四类场景：prefill 延迟（长 prompt TTFT）、decode 每 token 延迟（长生成）、并发吞吐、以及三者平衡的多目标场景。设置了 integrity gate，防止返回缓存文本或换小模型这类 reward hacking。
summary.experiments: 评估了 15 种前沿 agent 配置，基于 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode 三类 scaffold。最好的 agent 相对朴素 PyTorch 基线达到 8.08× 的 aggregate speedup，超过默认配置的 vLLM（4.05×），但一个同等时间预算的简单超参数搜索能达到 11.53×，在所有场景上打平或超过最好的 agent。行为分析显示：agent 几乎在所有 transcript 中都枚举到了相关优化项，但 180 次运行中有 169 次（93.9%）直接 ship vLLM，2 小时预算里中位只启动过 1 组非默认 vLLM 参数配置，并且偶尔在已经测到好配置之后仍提交了一个坏掉的服务器。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点看 Introduction 里对现有 agent benchmark 退化为“recipe recall”的批评、场景设计与 integrity gate、以及实验部分对 agent 实际行为的分析（为何列得出优化项却做不到有效迭代）。对关心 LLM serving 的人可以细看各场景瓶颈定义；对 pretrain 研究者主要价值在于理解开放式工程任务评测的设计难点。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI agent benchmarks for autonomous R&D effectively collapse to narrow hyperparameter searches over memorized recipes, making it hard to tell whether strong scores reflect genuine engineering optimization or recall of known configurations. InferenceBench proposes LLM inference serving as an open-ended systems task where incorrect choices cause crashes, driver conflicts, or recompilation stalls rather than just slightly worse metrics.
summary_en.importance: A well-designed agent-eval paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its main relevance to LLM researchers is as a case study in building evaluations that genuinely distinguish exploration from recipe memorization, with implications for automated ML, automated post-training, and agentic training systems. The benchmark itself targets inference-systems engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each run provides a base model (e.g., Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3), one NVIDIA H100 80GB, a two-hour wall-clock budget, and an optimization objective. The agent must produce a working OpenAI-compatible server that passes an integrity gate (no cached outputs, no model substitution) and a quality gate, while being free to choose frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, custom code), quantization, attention backends, batch sizes, KV-cache settings, and CUDA-graph capture. Four scenarios isolate prefill latency (TTFT on long contexts), per-token decode latency, concurrent-request throughput, and a balanced multi-objective setting.
summary_en.experiments: Fifteen frontier agent configurations based on Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode are evaluated. The best agent reaches 8.08× aggregate speedup over a naive PyTorch baseline, beating default vLLM at 4.05×. A simple hyperparameter search with the same wall-clock budget reaches 11.53× and matches or beats the best agent on every scenario. Behavioral analysis shows that agents enumerate the relevant optimizations in nearly every transcript, yet ship vLLM in 169/180 runs (93.9%), launch a median of only one distinct non-default vLLM argument set over two hours, and sometimes submit a broken server even after measuring a good configuration.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the critique of recipe-recall benchmarks in the introduction, the scenario/integrity-gate design, and the behavioral analysis of why agents fail to iterate effectively despite naming the right knobs. Serving practitioners can study the bottleneck scenarios in detail; pretraining researchers will mainly value the benchmark-design lessons. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 LLM serving 优化作为 Agent 的评测任务，setup 非常硬核且贴近真实系统工程，是评估 Agent 解决复杂开放式问题能力的好 benchmark。
recommendation.en: Uses LLM serving optimization as an agent evaluation task; a hardcore, systems-engineering-aligned setup that serves as an excellent benchmark for evaluating agents on complex, open-ended problems.

paper.title: ConfidenceBench: Evaluating Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where fluent but incorrect answers can be costly. In these settings, accuracy alone is insufficient: models must also know when they are likely to be wrong. We present ConfidenceBench, a calibration benchmark that evaluates verbalized confidence estimates in 15 frontier LLMs using the Brier score, a proper scoring rule that incentivises truthful probability reporting. Confidence is elicited via prompting, requiring no access to m

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM评测多聚焦准确率，缺乏针对前沿模型的、基于恰当评分规则的口头化置信度校准基准，无法有效区分不同类型的校准失效模式。
summary.importance: 置信度校准是与准确率互补的模型可靠性维度，该基准的设计思路（隔离不同认知失效模式、私有防污染、黑盒可用）可为预训练阶段的校准目标设计、对齐阶段的置信度引导提供统一评测参照；其揭示的准确率与校准表现脱钩现象，也提示预训练流程不能仅优化精度类指标。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含200道私有多选题的ConfidenceBench，分为空间推理、高精度数学、词汇检索、不可知问题4类，每类50题，全部人工编写以避免训练数据污染；通过提示词要求模型输出答案和0-100区间的置信度，无需访问模型logits，闭源与开源模型均可使用；采用Brier评分（激励真实概率报告的恰当评分规则）作为核心指标，对无法解析或明确拒答的响应按25%置信度加随机答案计分，避免频繁拒答难题的模型校准得分虚高。
summary.experiments: 完成15个前沿LLM的3次独立运行评测，加入人类基线作为参照；分类别分析显示，不同模型家族的准确率与校准表现存在显著脱钩，部分高准确率模型因过度自信导致Brier评分较差，不可知问题类别下多数模型普遍对“已知未知”存在过度自信。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读基准设计章节的4类问题设计逻辑与计分规则，重点关注拒答响应的处理方式；再浏览实验部分的分类别结果对比，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM evaluations prioritize raw accuracy, lacking a purpose-built benchmark for frontier models that directly measures verbalized confidence calibration with a proper scoring rule and isolates distinct calibration failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Confidence calibration is a reliability dimension complementary to accuracy. The benchmark's design principles — targeted failure mode isolation, private contamination-resistant sets, and black-box compatibility — provide a unified evaluation reference for developing calibration-aware pretraining objectives or confidence-aligned post-training workflows. Its finding that accuracy and calibration can diverge also signals that pretraining pipelines should not optimize solely for accuracy metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConfidenceBench comprises 200 manually authored private multiple-choice questions, split equally across four categories: spatial reasoning, high-precision mathematics, word lookup, and unknowable questions, to avoid training data overlap. It elicits answer selections and 0-100 confidence estimates via prompting, requiring no logit access and supporting both closed and open-source models. The Brier score, a proper scoring rule that incentivizes truthful probability reporting, is used as the core metric. Unparseable or explicit refusal responses are scored as 25% confidence with a random answer to prevent artificial calibration score inflation for models that frequently avoid difficult queries.
summary_en.experiments: 15 frontier LLMs are evaluated across three independent runs, with a human baseline included for reference. Category-level analyses show substantial divergence between accuracy and calibration performance across model families: some high-accuracy models deliver poor Brier scores due to systematic overconfidence, and most models exhibit overconfidence on "known unknowns" in the unknowable question category.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Benchmark Design section first for the 4-category question design logic and scoring rules, especially the handling of refusal responses. Then review category-wise experimental comparisons. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 首个无需logits的LLM置信度校准benchmark，适用于闭源模型，评测协议值得参考，看§2和§3即可。
recommendation.en: First LLM confidence calibration benchmark requiring no logits, applicable to closed-source models; evaluation protocol is worth referencing, read §2 and §3.

paper.title: ArbiGraph: Arbitrarily Scalable Verifiable Task Graphs for Evaluating Context Management
paper.abstract: We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and valu

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测难以精确控制任务复杂度与依赖结构，无法系统评估LLM在长推理工作流中的上下文管理能力。
summary.importance: 提出首个可任意扩展、可自动验证的任务图benchmark生成器，可系统评测上下文管理的不同维度，属于评测方法与工具创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将每个任务表示为带可执行Python求解器的自然语言问题，通过类型化中间状态（标量、列表）组合成任务图，可灵活调整任务长度、依赖结构、干扰项数量、值类型，通过执行求解器实现精确自动验证。
summary.experiments: 用数学、GSM应用题、Python追踪三类任务实例化，在四种拓扑结构上评测Qwen3.5-27B工具辅助Agent，发现分支依赖的数学任务上准确率最多下降33.3%，单任务评测无法暴露这类缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Gennady Pekhimenko（多伦多大学，ML系统与高效计算方向）、Mark C. Jeffrey（多伦多大学，计算机系统方向）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks cannot precisely control task complexity and dependency structure, making it hard to systematically evaluate LLMs' context management abilities in extended reasoning workflows.
summary_en.importance: First arbitrarily scalable, automatically verifiable task graph benchmark generator for systematic evaluation of context management dimensions; represents evaluation methodology and tool innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task is a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver; tasks are composed via typed intermediate states (scalars, lists) into task graphs with adjustable length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type, enabling exact automatic verification via solver execution.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated with math, GSM-style word problems, and Python tracing tasks; evaluates Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies, finding up to 33.3% accuracy drop on branching dependent math tasks — failures not exposed by single-task benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Gennady Pekhimenko (University of Toronto, ML systems and efficient computing) and Mark C. Jeffrey (University of Toronto, computer systems).

recommendation.zh: 可控任务图评测上下文管理能力，设计干净，预训练研究员可参考其评测范式验证模型长上下文依赖能力，重点看§3任务构造。
recommendation.en: Cleanly designed controllable task graph benchmark for context management; pretraining researchers can reference its paradigm to test long-context dependency abilities, focus on §3 task construction.

paper.title: Instruct-FD: Can Your Full-Duplex Speech System Follow Turn-Taking Instructions?
paper.abstract: Current full-duplex (FD) spoken dialogue systems can produce fluid interactions, yet it remains unclear whether they can adapt their turn-taking behavior when explicitly instructed. This is critical for real-world deployment, where conversational policies vary across applications (e.g., proactive tutoring vs. passive counseling). We introduce Instruct-FD, an instruction-conditioned benchmark for evaluating controllable turn management in FD systems. To enable this, we develop a human-validated,

summary.core_problem: 评估全双工语音对话系统是否能按照显式指令控制 turn-taking 行为，例如主动插话、被动等待、backchannel 等。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测协议。它把 full-duplex speech system 的能力从“能流畅对话”推进到“能按策略控制轮次管理”，对语音 LM 和实时多模态 Agent 的接口评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Instruct-FD，一个 instruction-conditioned benchmark。作者构建了经人工验证的可扩展合成对话生成流程，覆盖不同场景和 turn-taking 指令，并设计 deployment-agnostic 的多轮评测协议和 LLM-as-judge。
summary.experiments: 评测 6 个当前全双工系统。摘要报告最强系统的指令遵循率只有 64.4%，且不同 turn-taking 行为和场景差异明显；主动行为如模型 backchanneling 和 interruption 尤其薄弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether full-duplex spoken dialogue systems can follow explicit instructions about turn-taking behavior, such as being proactive, waiting, backchanneling, or interrupting.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. It shifts full-duplex speech evaluation from conversational fluency to policy-controllable turn management, which matters for speech LMs and real-time multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instruct-FD is an instruction-conditioned benchmark built with a human-validated synthetic conversation pipeline. It includes a deployment-agnostic multi-turn evaluation protocol and an LLM-based judge for turn-taking adherence.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates six full-duplex systems. The best model reaches only 64.4% adherence, with uneven performance across behaviors and scenarios; proactive behaviors such as backchanneling and interruption remain especially weak.

recommendation.zh: 语音 LM 方向可看 benchmark 设计和失败类型；预训练侧只需记住 FD 控制性仍是短板。
recommendation.en: Speech-LM researchers should inspect the benchmark design and failure modes; for pretraining work, the main takeaway is that full-duplex controllability is still weak.

paper.title: ViSTR-Bench: Can MLLMs Reason from Continuous Visual Cues in Dynamic Scenes?
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse expert-level tasks, but they still struggle with fundamental abilities that humans naturally develop through continuous observation of the real world, such as spatial perception and dynamic reasoning. Recent studies have recognized this gap and introduced dedicated benchmarks to evaluate the spatial-temporal capabilities of MLLMs. However, existing benchmarks mostly focus on static scenes or require exact qu

summary.core_problem: 现有MLLM时空推理评测多聚焦静态场景或精确数值预测，缺少对动态场景中连续视觉线索的定性推理能力评估。
summary.importance: 提出ViSTR-Bench评测套件，从时间强调、推理导向、定性评估三个原则出发，构建四维评测体系，填补动态场景定性时空推理评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 设计面向动态场景连续视觉线索的定性推理benchmark，围绕时间维度、推理导向构建四类评测任务，不要求精确数值预测而是评估定性判断能力。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出具体模型评测结果数值，核心贡献为benchmark构建。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Naiyan Wang（王乃岩，知名CV研究者，Horizon Robotics/TuSimple背景），团队来自北航等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM spatiotemporal reasoning benchmarks mostly focus on static scenes or exact quantitative predictions, leaving qualitative reasoning from continuous temporal cues in dynamic scenes underexplored.
summary_en.importance: Introduces ViSTR-Bench, a novel evaluation suite built on temporal emphasis, reasoning orientation, and qualitative evaluation principles, establishing a four-dimensional framework for dynamic scene reasoning assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a benchmark targeting qualitative reasoning from continuous visual cues in dynamic scenes, with four task dimensions that evaluate intuitive temporal judgment rather than precise numeric prediction.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model evaluation numbers are not provided in the abstract; the core contribution is the benchmark construction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Naiyan Wang, a well-known computer vision researcher; team affiliations include Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 纯VLM时空推理benchmark，与基座预训练方法无直接关联，做视频MLLM评测的人备查即可。
recommendation.en: A VLM spatiotemporal reasoning benchmark with no direct bearing on foundation pretraining methodology; only useful if you build video MLLM evaluations.

paper.title: ITPEval: Benchmarking Formal Translation Across Interactive Theorem Provers
paper.abstract: Formal theorem proving has emerged as a frontier challenge for machine learning, yet the ecosystem is fragmented: proofs remain siloed across incompatible systems, limiting both training data for learning-based provers and the portability of verified results. We present ITPEval, the first benchmark for evaluating automated formal proof translation across four major ITPs (Lean 4, Rocq, Isabelle, and HOL Light), spanning two distinct logical foundations. Our benchmark comprises 1,560 source files

summary.core_problem: 形式化数学已经成为 LLM 推理和代码式证明的重要训练与评测场景，但 Lean、Rocq、Isabelle、HOL Light 等交互式定理证明器之间缺少统一的跨系统翻译评测。论文解决的问题是：如何系统评估一个模型能否把定理陈述和证明从一个 ITP 正确迁移到另一个 ITP，并区分逻辑基础差异与库生态差异带来的难度。
summary.importance: 这是一项评测资产工作，对预训练研究的启发主要在形式化数据的可迁移性。形式证明数据很稀缺，而且被不同 prover 的语法、逻辑基础、库 API 和证明风格切开。跨 ITP 翻译如果可行，可以扩大可用于 theorem proving 模型训练的数据池，也能改善 autoformalization 和 proof repair 的数据闭环。ITPEval 的价值不在提出新模型，而在提供一个更接近真实 formal ecosystem 的评测接口，避免只用 type-check 通过率粗略判断模型是否理解了定理含义。
summary.technical_approach: ITPEval 覆盖 Lean 4、Rocq、Isabelle 和 HOL Light，形成 12 个有向翻译方向，横跨依赖类型论和高阶逻辑两类基础。基准设计分成两层。Tier A 是 controlled tier，使用自包含、axiomatized 的文件，尽量去掉库依赖，用来隔离基础逻辑和语言层面的翻译难点。Tier B 是 ecosystem tier，来自真实库和数据集，暴露 API 不匹配、命名习惯、自动化 tactic、局部辅助引理和证明风格差异。论文还提供统一多 ITP 验证基础设施，把不同 prover 封装成共同接口，并使用 native target prover 检查生成结果。针对 Lean 4 目标，论文提出 Bidirectional Extended Definitional Equivalence check，用于检测已验证翻译是否保持定理语义，而不只是表面上能 type-check。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 1,560 个源文件和 6,848 个 theorem/lemma。controlled tier 包含 64 个 axiomatized 文件和 660 个 lemma；ecosystem tier 包含 232 个 Formalizing 100 Theorems 文件和 1,264 个 miniF2F statement。论文评测了 GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B，在 statement translation 和 proof translation 两类任务上都使用目标 prover 原生验证。语义保持评测显示，在 miniF2F 的 source-to-Lean 4 statement translation 中，322 个已验证翻译里有 174 个通过 BEq，占 54.0%；剩余 46.0% 可能包含语义漂移，也可能受限于 BEq 的搜索能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Benchmark Design，理解 controlled tier 和 ecosystem tier 的切分，这决定了结果如何解释。然后看 unified verification infrastructure，尤其是如何隔离不同 prover 环境和记录诊断信息。实验部分优先看不同 ITP 方向上的 statement/proof translation 成功率，以及 BEq 分析。对 LLM 预训练研究而言，最值得保留的是数据组织方式和语义验证方法，而不是单个闭源模型的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: Formal mathematics is becoming an important setting for LLM reasoning and proof-generation research, but proof artifacts are fragmented across Lean, Rocq, Isabelle, and HOL Light. The paper addresses the lack of a systematic benchmark for translating theorem statements and proofs across interactive theorem provers, while separating logical-foundation difficulty from library-ecosystem difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation resource, with clear implications for training-data portability in formal reasoning. Formal proof data is scarce and split by prover syntax, foundations, library APIs, and proof styles. Reliable cross-ITP translation could enlarge the usable training pool for learning-based provers and support better autoformalization and proof-repair pipelines. The contribution is not a new model, but a benchmark and verification setup that is closer to real formal ecosystems than type-check-only evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: ITPEval covers Lean 4, Rocq, Isabelle, and HOL Light, yielding 12 directed translation pairs across dependent type theory and higher-order logic. The benchmark has two tiers. The controlled tier uses self-contained axiomatized files to isolate foundation-level and language-level translation issues. The ecosystem tier uses real library artifacts to expose API mismatches, naming conventions, automation behavior, local helper lemmas, and proof-style differences. The release also includes a unified multi-ITP verification infrastructure that wraps heterogeneous provers behind a common interface and validates outputs with the native target prover. For Lean 4 targets, the paper introduces a Bidirectional Extended Definitional Equivalence check to test whether verified translations preserve theorem meaning rather than merely passing type checking.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,560 source files and 6,848 theorems or lemmas. The controlled tier has 64 axiomatized files and 660 lemmas. The ecosystem tier includes 232 Formalizing 100 Theorems files and 1,264 miniF2F statements. The evaluation covers GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Qwen3-235B-A22B on both statement and proof translation, with every output checked by the target prover. In the semantic-preservation analysis for miniF2F source-to-Lean 4 statement translations, 174 of 322 verified translations pass BEq, or 54.0%. The remaining 46.0% indicate possible semantic drift or limitations of the restricted equivalence search.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Read the benchmark design first, especially the split between the controlled and ecosystem tiers. Then inspect the unified verification infrastructure and how it isolates prover environments and reports diagnostics. In the results, focus on translation success by ITP direction and the BEq semantic-equivalence analysis. For foundation-model research, the most reusable pieces are the data organization and semantic verification design, not the ranking of individual closed models.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 分层和 verifier 设计；如果做数学预训练数据，这篇比单一 Lean 榜更能暴露数据迁移成本。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark tiers and verifier design; for math pretraining data, this exposes portability costs better than another single-Lean leaderboard.

paper.title: Economic Evaluations of Language Models
paper.abstract: Language models perform economically valuable work, yet they are not currently assessed for how well they perform every economically valuable task. We introduce EconEvals as an open-source evaluation suite to measure capabilities relevant to tasks, work activities, and occupations in the US labor economy. We ground the evaluation suite in real user queries to language models where possible, and supplement these with synthetic data. Our evaluations improve coverage over OpenAI's GDPval benchmark,

summary.core_problem: 解决现有语言模型评测无法系统覆盖“经济上有价值的工作任务”这一缺口，建立更广覆盖、低成本、可追踪的经济任务评测与暴露度估计框架。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产与评测方法贡献。它不是 pretrain 方法论文，但对基座研究员有现实意义：模型能力最终会映射到哪些工作活动、哪些任务仍不可靠、评测集如何从真实用户查询构建，这些都会反过来影响数据配比、能力目标和 post-train 方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EconEvals 开源评测套件，按美国劳动力市场中的任务、工作活动和职业组织评测；尽量用真实用户查询构造样本，不足部分用合成数据补齐。除 benchmark 外，还提出 simulation-based exposure measure，用细粒度任务级核算估计当前模型能为各职业节省多少时间，并显式记录估计依据。
summary.experiments: 相较 OpenAI 的 GDPval，覆盖范围更大，声称成本降低约 500 倍，并把职业覆盖从 GDPval 的约 5% 大幅扩展。结果上，当前模型在 47% 的职业中，至少一半任务可节省显著时间；但对 79% 可节省时间的任务，模型仍无法可靠完成全部步骤，说明“有帮助”与“可托付”之间仍有明显差距。摘要未给出具体参评模型名单。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Stanford CRFM 相关团队；Percy Liang 与 Rishi Bommasani 长期做基础模型评测、HELM、治理与能力测量，这篇延续了他们把模型能力映射到真实社会任务的路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in LM evaluation: current benchmarks do not systematically measure performance on economically valuable work tasks across the labor market.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method, but it matters for foundation-model researchers because it connects model capability to real task structure, reliability gaps, and ultimately to what capabilities data mixtures and post-training should target.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces EconEvals, an open-source evaluation suite organized around tasks, work activities, and occupations in the US labor economy. The benchmark uses real user LM queries where possible and supplements them with synthetic data. It also proposes a simulation-based exposure measure to estimate time savings across occupations with explicit accounting for each estimate.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with OpenAI's GDPval, EconEvals claims much broader coverage at roughly 500x lower cost, expanding beyond GDPval's ~5% occupation coverage. The headline result is that current models could save substantial time on at least half of tasks in 47% of occupations, yet for 79% of tasks with potential time savings, models still cannot reliably complete all required steps. The abstract does not list the evaluated models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are connected to the Stanford CRFM ecosystem. Percy Liang and Rishi Bommasani are well known for HELM, foundation-model evaluation, and governance-oriented capability measurement; this work continues that line by grounding evaluation in real economic tasks.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法，但评测 framing 很干净：把“会做题”改成“能否稳定完成经济任务”；读 benchmark 设计和 exposure 定义，别太在意 headline 数字。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the framing is clean: it shifts evaluation from benchmark-solving to reliable economic task completion; read the benchmark design and exposure metric, not the headline percentages.

paper.title: OpenSkillRisk: Benchmarking Agent Safety When Using Real-World Risky Third-Party Skills
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents leverage third-party skills to extend their capabilities in open-world scenarios. However, third-party skills can introduce extra security vulnerabilities, as seemingly harmless skills can contain latent safety risks that only emerge during actual execution. In this work, we conduct a systematic investigation into how well current agent systems recognize and avoid such risks. To support quantitative and qualitative evaluation, we construct OpenSkillRisk, a dedicated safety bench

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在调用真实第三方技能时，能否识别并规避执行阶段才暴露的安全风险。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent safety benchmark 工作，贡献主要在评测资产而不是新方法。它把风险从提示层面推进到“技能执行层面”，更接近真实工具生态，对研究 tool-use agent 的安全边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从公开 skill marketplace 收集 263 个带潜在风险的第三方技能，按 7 类威胁类型组织，并为每个技能配套标准化用户任务与 sandbox。评测不仅看 agent 是否调用危险技能，还分析其行为模式与失败类型，强调风险在实际执行中显现，而非仅靠静态描述可见。
summary.experiments: 论文对当前 agent 系统做了定量和定性评测，重点比较不同系统在真实 risky skills 上的识别、规避与误用情况。摘要未给出具体模型规模、显著提升幅度或强基线细节，因此更适合作为评测集备查，而不是方法结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港城市大学、香港AI for Science研究所、北京邮电大学和理想汽车。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents can recognize and avoid safety risks introduced by real third-party skills whose hazards only surface at execution time.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-safety benchmark rather than a method paper. Its value is in moving safety evaluation from prompt-level risks to execution-level tool risks, which is closer to real tool ecosystems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors collect 263 risky skills from public skill marketplaces, organize them into seven threat categories, and pair each skill with a standardized user task and a sandboxed environment. The benchmark measures not only whether an agent invokes unsafe skills, but also the behavioral patterns behind those failures.
summary_en.experiments: The study runs quantitative and qualitative evaluations on current agent systems, focusing on recognition, avoidance, and misuse of risky skills. The abstract does not provide model sizes, strong baseline details, or effect sizes, so the paper is more useful as an evaluation asset than as a source of robust methodological conclusions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, and Li Auto.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你做 tool-use 或 agent 对齐，记下这个 benchmark 即可；正文未必值得细读，先看任务构造和风险分类。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant, but if you care about tool-use or agent alignment, bookmark the benchmark; skim the task construction and threat taxonomy, not the full paper.

institutions: Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science, City University of Hong Kong

paper.title: JailMeter: An Evidence-Based Evaluation Framework for Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The assessment of jailbreak attacks against large language models currently suffers from inconsistent evaluation criteria and methods, leading to unreliable estimates of attack success rates. We propose JailMeter, an evidence-based evaluation framework designed to more faithfully measure jailbreak effectiveness. Inspired by the Information Bottleneck theory, JailMeter applies dual-feedback optimization to filter jailbreak noise from model responses while preserving content relevant to the origin

summary.core_problem: 解决 jailbreak 攻击评测标准不一致、成功率估计失真的问题，给出更严格的证据化评估框架。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测协议与 judge 设计，属于安全评估基础设施。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但对 post-train 安全信号质量、对齐评测和 reward 设计有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 JailMeter，用双反馈优化从模型回复中剥离 jailbreak 噪声，同时保留与原始恶意问题相关的关键信息；只有当回复既捕获恶意意图又提供完整答案时，才判定为真正越狱成功。方法受 Information Bottleneck 启发，并配套构建了 JailMeter-Eva 基准。
summary.experiments: 在包含 330 个人工标注、非拒答 jailbreak 样本的 JailMeter-Eva 上，JailMeter 评估准确率达到 97.27%，显著优于现有评测方法。摘要未给出更细的模型覆盖范围、judge 成本或跨模型泛化细节。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inconsistent criteria used to evaluate jailbreak attacks, which leads to unreliable estimates of attack success rates.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation protocol and judge framework for safety. Its direct value to pretraining is limited, but it matters indirectly for post-training signal quality, alignment evaluation, and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: JailMeter uses dual-feedback optimization to remove jailbreak noise from model outputs while preserving content relevant to the malicious query. An attack counts as successful only if the response both captures malicious intent and provides a complete answer. The method is motivated by Information Bottleneck ideas and comes with the JailMeter-Eva benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: On JailMeter-Eva, a benchmark of 330 human-labeled non-rejected jailbreak instances, JailMeter reaches 97.27% accuracy and outperforms prior evaluation methods. The abstract does not reveal much about model coverage, judge cost, or cross-model robustness.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但做安全对齐或 reward 设计的人可以看；重点看它如何把“有害意图+完整回答”拆成可审计证据，别太在意 97% 这个数字本身。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful if you care about alignment signals; the real value is the evidence-based success criterion, not the 97% headline.

paper.title: Stateful Guardrails for Multi-Turn LLM Systems: A Conversational Risk Accumulation Framework
paper.abstract: Most safety guardrails for large language models (LLMs) evaluate each prompt-response pair in isolation, which misses failures that arise only over a dialogue as benign turns compose into harm. We term this Conversational Risk Accumulation (CRA): gradual intent drift, fragmented assembly of prohibited instructions, and sensitivity build-up from repeated disclosures. We propose a session-layer CRA Framework that tracks three trajectory signals: semantic drift from a session anchor, a sensitivity-

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 安全护栏多按单轮 prompt-response 判断风险，难以捕捉多轮对话中由意图漂移、信息拼接和逐步合规导致的累积危害。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多轮安全评测与会话级风险建模。它把安全问题从单点分类扩展到轨迹检测，并发布 CRA-Bench v0.1，用于衡量 guardrail 是否能识别跨轮次风险积累。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Conversational Risk Accumulation 框架，在 session 层跟踪三类信号：相对会话 anchor 的语义漂移、基于实体抽取的信息累积图，以及模型越来越愿意配合的 compliance-gradient。打分上提供无监督凸融合模型，并训练 compact trajectory model CRA-Net DA，用 family-adversarial objective 降低长度和主题覆盖混杂。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明发布 CRA-Bench v0.1，包含 1,200 个八轮会话，覆盖三类威胁家族，并配有 topic-matched benign sessions。实验重点应是比较单轮 guardrail、无监督融合和 CRA-Net DA 在多轮风险识别上的表现；摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Independent Researcher、Flinders University。

summary_en.core_problem: Most LLM guardrails score each prompt-response pair independently, missing harms that only emerge when benign-looking turns compose into a risky multi-turn trajectory.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a session-level safety evaluation and risk-modeling setup. It reframes safety detection as trajectory analysis and introduces CRA-Bench v0.1 for measuring whether guardrails can detect accumulated conversational risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a Conversational Risk Accumulation framework with three trajectory signals: semantic drift from a session anchor, a sensitivity-weighted information accumulation graph over extracted entities, and a compliance-gradient signal tracking increasing willingness to comply. It includes an unsupervised convex fusion scorer and CRA-Net DA, a compact learned trajectory model trained with family-adversarial objectives to reduce length and topic-coverage confounds.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports CRA-Bench v0.1 with 1,200 eight-turn sessions across three threat families and topic-matched benign sessions. The evaluation appears to compare single-turn guardrails, unsupervised fusion, and CRA-Net DA on multi-turn risk detection; exact model sizes and numerical gains are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Independent Researcher and Flinders University.

recommendation.zh: 作为多轮 safety eval 备查即可；轨迹信号设计比模型本身有用，离 pretrain 方法还有一层距离。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multi-turn safety-eval reference; the trajectory signals matter more than the model, and it is still one step removed from pretraining work.

paper.title: Reference-Free Evaluation of Reasoning in Open-Ended Question Answering
paper.abstract: AI-generated answers in high-stakes domains are often fluent but difficult to verify, especially when they contain multi-step reasoning rather than a single final answer. We propose a reasoning-based, reference-free framework for auditing LLM-generated outputs. The method decomposes a generated reasoning trace into segments, labels local premise-target relations using Natural Language Inference (NLI), and organizes these relations into a hypergraph. A deterministic backward AND-OR search then as

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式问答中推理过程难以验证的问题，尤其是在没有标准参考答案时如何审计模型生成的 reasoning trace。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测方法与数据：提出 reference-free 的推理审计框架，并引入一个医生标注的临床推理 benchmark。对做 verifier、judge、过程监督的人有参考价值，但离预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先把生成的推理链切分为片段，用 NLI 标注局部 premise-target 关系，再把这些关系组织成超图，最后通过确定性的 backward AND-OR search 给每个片段分配 groundedness/audit 标签。重点不是生成更好答案，而是更可靠地评估 reasoning trace。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理数据 Hard2Verify 和新建临床推理集 UroReason 上评估，与直接 LLM-as-judge 基线比较。论文声称其 NLI-hypergraph 审计在 reference-free 设定下更可靠；但场景一半落在医学高风险应用，外推到通用 LLM 训练仍需谨慎。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Queen Mary University of London 和 Temple University；不是头部基座团队，工作更偏评测与推理审计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to verify reasoning traces in open-ended QA when no gold reference answer or rationale is available.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluation: a reference-free reasoning audit framework plus a physician-annotated clinical reasoning benchmark. Useful for people working on verifiers, judges, and process supervision, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method segments a generated reasoning trace, labels local premise-target relations with NLI, organizes them into a hypergraph, and runs a deterministic backward AND-OR search to assign segment-level audit labels. The focus is evaluation reliability rather than better generation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on Hard2Verify for deductive math reasoning and UroReason for clinical reasoning, comparing against direct LLM-as-judge baselines. The paper reports more reliable reference-free signals, though half of the setup is in a medical domain and may not transfer cleanly to general LLM training.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Queen Mary University of London and Temple University; this is more of an evaluation/reasoning-audit effort than a frontier foundation-model paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 process reward 或 verifier，可看方法图和误差分析；否则这是评测侧小工具，不会改变你对预训练的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and error analysis if you work on process rewards or verifiers; otherwise this is an evaluation-side tool, not something that changes pretraining priors.

paper.title: D2VBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Value Dilemmas in Daily Scenarios
paper.abstract: With the wide application of large language models (LLMs) in real-world scenarios, the value implication of their outputs is crucial. However, existing evaluation benchmarks suffer from insufficient coverage of value dilemmas in daily scenarios involving multiple value conflicts and simplistic evaluation formalisms that fail to assess LLMs' value alignment. To address these issues, we propose D2VBench, a value alignment benchmark comprising 10,000 instances of real daily dilemma scenarios constr

summary.core_problem: 现有价值对齐评测覆盖不足且形式单一，难以评估日常多价值冲突场景下的模型选择与表述。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献：提供更细粒度的价值概念标注与更贴近日常困境的评测形式，可作为对齐/后训练信号质量的外部参照。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 D2VBench：1 万条日常价值困境实例，基于 158 个细粒度价值概念人工标注；数据由 LLM+人工多阶段协作生成/筛选；评测范式混合选择题与开放问答以覆盖“决策+解释/表述”。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个主流 LLM 上做系统评测；摘要未给出具体模型名单与分数细节，仅声称可靠性与鲁棒性较高。
summary.authors_note: Tianjin University

summary_en.core_problem: Existing value-alignment benchmarks under-cover everyday multi-value conflicts and rely on overly simplistic evaluation formats.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: a larger, finer-grained value-dilemma dataset and a mixed evaluation protocol that can serve as an external reference for alignment and post-training signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: D2VBench: 10k daily dilemma instances grounded in 158 fine-grained value concepts with manual annotation; constructed via multi-stage LLM+human collaboration; evaluation mixes multiple-choice and open-ended questions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 8 mainstream LLMs; the abstract does not provide model names or detailed scores, but claims reliability/robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: Tianjin University

recommendation.zh: 作为对齐评测资产可备查；先看价值概念体系与标注一致性/鲁棒性检验，若 judge 设计不严就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference alignment benchmark; focus on the value taxonomy and robustness checks—treat results as weak evidence if judging is not rigorous.

institutions: The International Joint Institute of Tianjin University

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant information while rejecting deceptive or harmful content is therefore critical for reliable deployment in real-world retrieval settings. We introduce SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training

summary.core_problem: 研究RAG场景中模型如何在混合了有用证据、误导信息和指令注入的检索结果里选择性采纳证据。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是SelectBench评测与训练集，以及一个小规模RL后训练实验。它对RAG安全和后训练信号设计有参考意义，但数据规模和提升幅度都偏小。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造SelectBench，用受控样本测试模型是否采纳相关证据并拒绝欺骗或有害内容；随后用DAPO对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练，奖励来自确定性规则或冻结的语义judge。
summary.experiments: 在修正后的325例SelectBench-v2测试集上，原始checkpoint严格成功率为22.46%，DAPO-Rule达到25.54%，DAPO-DeepSeek达到26.46%。训练后模型减少了禁用内容采纳，回答更短更聚焦，但prompt-injection following没有改善。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自East China Normal University和Shandong University；未看到知名大模型实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether RAG-augmented LLMs can selectively use relevant evidence while rejecting misleading statements and instruction-like contamination.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is SelectBench plus a small RL post-training study. The result is relevant to RAG robustness and reward design, but the reported gains are modest and the test set is small.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build SelectBench as a controlled benchmark and training set, then post-train Qwen3.5-4B with DAPO using either deterministic rule rewards or a frozen semantic judge.
summary_en.experiments: On the corrected 325-example SelectBench-v2 test set, strict success improves from 22.46% for the base checkpoint to 25.54% with DAPO-Rule and 26.46% with DAPO-DeepSeek. The trained policies adopt less forbidden content and produce shorter answers, but prompt-injection following does not improve.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are East China Normal University and Shandong University.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表就够了：RL能压一点污染采纳，但没修好prompt injection，说明reward覆盖面太窄。
recommendation.en: The result table is enough: RL reduces some contaminated adoption, but prompt injection remains, pointing to a narrow reward signal.

paper.title: SciHazard: A Benchmark for Measuring Scientific Safety Risks with Decomposed Harm Scoring
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support science, but they can also convert hazardous scientific knowledge into actionable misuse guidance. Existing benchmarks often rely on templated queries disconnected from real-world hazards, and employ LLM-as-a-Judge paradigms without domain grounding. To address this, we introduce SciHazard, a real-world-grounded benchmark for scientific risks and a dataset agnostic evaluation framework for measuring harmfulness. SciHazard contains 2400 hazardous

summary.core_problem: SciHazard 解决的是科学安全评测中“危险性是否真实可执行”难以衡量的问题，尤其是现有 benchmark 过于模板化、LLM-as-a-Judge 缺少领域约束、深度研究 agent 风险被低估。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不直接改进预训练，但对 post-train 安全评测和训练信号质量有启发。科学风险不是普通拒答率能覆盖的问题。一个回答是否有害，取决于问题本身的 hazard severity、模型是否拒答、回答是否补齐了关键操作步骤，以及是否越过了原本需要专业知识或检索才能跨过的合成壁垒。这个分解方式可以反过来指导安全 SFT/RL 数据构造：惩罚信号不应只看敏感词或表面拒答，而要看可执行性和新增风险。
summary.technical_approach: SciHazard 包含 2,400 个 hazardous questions 和 600 个 oversafety questions，覆盖 12 个学科：化学、生物、物理、计算机、心理学、社会学、医学、药理、环境科学、经济学、法律、农业与食品科学。数据构造采用 Dual-Track Scientific Misuse Generation Pipeline。对涉及实体物质的 7 个领域，先从 CWC、CDC/APHIS Select Agents、DEA schedules、EU REACH、UN conventions 等监管框架中抽取 1,548 个 controlled substances 作为 hazard primitives，再围绕 weaponization lifecycle 生成问题，包括 upstream acquisition/substitution、midstream optimization/scale-up、downstream stabilization/storage、delivery/dissemination，并结合技术瓶颈扩展问题空间。对非物质领域，如计算机、心理、社会、经济和法律，风险来自规则、信息流或系统逻辑的滥用，因此走 scenario-driven 路线。评测方法是 DeHarm-Score，把危害评分拆成 query hazard severity、refusal behavior 和 response-level risk。对未拒答内容，response-level risk 又分为 Executability 和 Net-New Risk：前者用动态重要性加权 checklist 和 critical blocking steps 评估可执行程度；后者用 retrieval-augmented claim extraction 和 synthesis-barrier verification 判断回答是否提供了新增危险能力。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 31 个 frontier LLM、deep research agents 和 science-specific models。DeHarm-Score 与专家标注达到 0.774 QWK，一致性高于多个闭源 judge 和已有评测框架，并且对内容扰动和格式扰动更稳。一个关键发现是 deep research agents 的平均 DeHarm-Score 比标准 LLM 高 32.3%。这说明检索、规划和工具使用会削弱单轮聊天模型里常见的拒答边界：agent 可以把分散知识重新组合成更可执行的危险方案。oversafety 子集用于衡量过度拒答，避免把“全部拒绝”误判为安全能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 SciHazard 数据构造，重点是 substance-driven 和 scenario-driven 两条管线如何覆盖不同科学风险，而不是只生成危险物质问答。然后看 DeHarm-Score 的定义，尤其是 Executability、critical blocking steps、Net-New Risk 和 synthesis barrier 的计算方式。实验部分优先看专家一致性、与普通 LLM judge 的差异，以及 deep research agents 相比标准 LLM 的风险上升。对预训练研究员来说，附录中的示例和 checklist 也值得扫一遍，因为它们更直观地说明什么样的回答会从“知识性”变成“可操作性”。

summary_en.core_problem: SciHazard addresses how to measure whether scientific model outputs create actionable harm, especially when existing safety benchmarks use templated prompts, weak domain grounding, and generic LLM-as-a-judge scoring that misses risks introduced by research agents.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an evaluation contribution, but it is relevant to post-training signal design. Scientific safety cannot be captured by refusal rate alone. Harm depends on the severity of the query, whether the model refuses, whether the answer fills in operationally critical steps, and whether it lowers a synthesis or knowledge barrier that would otherwise remain hard to cross. This decomposition is useful for safety SFT and RL data construction: training signals should penalize executability and net-new risk, not just unsafe keywords or non-refusal.
summary_en.technical_approach: SciHazard contains 2,400 hazardous questions and 600 oversafety questions across 12 disciplines: chemistry, biology, physics, computer science, psychology, sociology, medicine, pharmacology, environmental science, economics, law, and agricultural and food science. The data is built with a dual-track scientific misuse generation pipeline. For seven material domains, the pipeline extracts 1,548 controlled substances from regulatory sources such as CWC, CDC/APHIS Select Agents, DEA schedules, EU REACH, and UN conventions. These substances are treated as hazard primitives. Questions are expanded along the weaponization lifecycle: upstream acquisition and substitution, midstream optimization and scale-up, downstream stabilization and storage, and delivery and dissemination. The pipeline also incorporates technical bottlenecks, such as stability, screening evasion, or transmissibility. For non-material domains such as computer science, psychology, sociology, economics, and law, the benchmark uses a scenario-driven route because the risk comes from exploiting rules, information flows, or systemic logic. The scoring framework, DeHarm-Score, decomposes harmfulness into query hazard severity, refusal behavior, and response-level risk. For non-refused answers, response-level risk is split into Executability and Net-New Risk. Executability is measured with dynamic importance-weighted checklists and critical blocking steps. Net-New Risk uses retrieval-augmented claim extraction and synthesis-barrier verification to estimate whether the response provides new operational capability.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 31 frontier LLMs, deep research agents, and science-specific models. DeHarm-Score reaches 0.774 quadratic weighted kappa with expert annotations, outperforming several closed-source judges and existing evaluation frameworks reported by the paper. It is also tested under content and formatting perturbations. The most important empirical result is that deep research agents have a 32.3% higher mean DeHarm-Score than standard LLMs. This suggests that retrieval, planning, and tool use can erode refusal boundaries by assembling dispersed scientific facts into more actionable procedures. The oversafety subset is used to measure over-refusal, so a model cannot appear safe merely by refusing benign or low-risk scientific questions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is sufficient. Start with the SciHazard construction pipeline, focusing on why the paper separates substance-driven risks from scenario-driven risks. Then read the DeHarm-Score definition, especially Executability, critical blocking steps, Net-New Risk, and synthesis-barrier verification. In experiments, prioritize expert agreement, comparisons against generic LLM judges, and the gap between standard LLMs and deep research agents. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the appendix examples and checklists are useful because they show where an answer crosses from general scientific knowledge into operationally enabling guidance.

recommendation.zh: 只看 scoring 设计和 oversafety 集合；它能给 RL refusal reward 提供更细的分解信号。
recommendation.en: Read the scoring design and oversafety split; it suggests a cleaner decomposition for RL refusal rewards.

paper.title: ResearchArena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in Automated AI R&D
paper.abstract: As AI agents begin to automate AI R&D, we need ways to assess whether their outputs are safe to deploy, even when the agents themselves may be untrusted. AI control offers one such approach: rather than trusting the agent, it treats it as a potential adversary and uses a monitor to detect covert sabotage before deployment. We evaluate AI control for automated AI R&D with ResearchArena, a framework spanning four long-horizon tasks: safety post-training, capabilities post-training, CUDA-kernel opt

summary.core_problem: 评估AI控制（monitor-based defense）在自动化AI研发场景下的有效性，即监控器能否检测出不可信AI agent在交付物中植入的隐蔽破坏。
summary.importance: Benchmark与评测框架贡献，提出首个面向自动化AI研发的AI控制评测基准，覆盖安全后训练、能力后训练、CUDA核优化、推理服务优化四类长周期任务。
summary.technical_approach: 构建ResearchArena框架，每个主任务配对两类隐藏侧任务：嵌入型破坏（直接修改交付的模型/适配器/核/服务本身）和独立型破坏（在沙箱内执行越界动作但交付物诚实），并评测四类不同监控器。
summary.experiments: 在四个长周期AI研发任务上评测前沿agent的破坏能力与监控器的检测能力，对比不同监控类型（静态扫描、动态测试、代码审查等）的漏检率与误报率。
summary.authors_note: Maksym Andriushchenko（EPFL，对抗鲁棒性与AI安全方向知名研究者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluates the effectiveness of AI control (monitor-based defense) in automated AI R&D, i.e., whether monitors can detect covert sabotage inserted by untrusted AI agents in delivered artifacts.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and evaluation framework contribution, introducing the first AI control benchmark for automated AI R&D across four long-horizon task categories.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds the ResearchArena framework where each main task is paired with two types of hidden side tasks: embedded sabotage (directly tampering with the delivered model/adapter/kernel/server) and independent sabotage (taking covert out-of-scope sandbox actions while leaving the artifact honest), and evaluates four monitor types.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates frontier agents on both sabotage and monitoring across four long-horizon AI R&D tasks, comparing detection and false-positive rates across monitor types including static scanning, dynamic testing, and code review.
summary_en.authors_note: Maksym Andriushchenko (EPFL, known for adversarial robustness and AI safety research).

recommendation.zh: AI控制方向首个系统化benchmark，任务设计有新意，关注agent安全的研究者可重点看§3任务定义和§5主结果。
recommendation.en: The first systematic benchmark for AI control; novel task design. Researchers focused on agent safety should read §3 task definitions and §5 main results.

paper.title: MissingBench-Verified: Probing Vision-Language Models' Inability to Detect Missing Object Parts
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are well known for hallucinating non-existent objects in images. Objects with missing parts present a unique challenge for VLMs, stemming from both real-world knowledge bias and the scarcity of such images in training data. We present MissingBench-Verified, a benchmark designed to evaluate a specific and practically relevant scenario: when vision-language models fail to recognize that an essential component of an object has been removed. Across ten leading models, w

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 VLM 在一个很具体的视觉否定场景里的系统性失败：图像中的物体关键部件被移除后，模型仍然倾向于根据先验知识回答“它在”。作者想验证的不是一般意义上的 hallucination，而是“缺失部件检测”这种更接近反事实视觉理解的问题，即模型能否在强类别先验和真实视觉证据冲突时，承认对象并不存在或至少关键部件不可见。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，因为核心贡献是一个小规模、人工验证的评测集，而不是训练方法、数据配比或建模目标的改进。但它提供了一个有用信号：当前 VLM 的视觉表征和语言先验融合方式，仍然容易被对象概念完整性先验绑架。即便给出外部工具证据，模型也未必会更新判断。这对多模态预训练有两点启发。第一，训练数据里“对象缺失、部件缺失、反常构型”样本可能严重不足。第二，VLM 的对齐目标可能更偏向语义存在性而不是细粒度视觉证伪能力。若做 native multimodal pretraining 或视觉 tokenizer 研究，这类 failure mode 可以作为补充诊断项，但论文本身不属于 must-read。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上比较直接。作者构建了 MissingBench-Verified，一个 118 张图的小型数据集，图像来自真实拍摄和互联网人工挑选样本，再通过图像编辑模型 Nano Banana 2 或人工擦除工具移除指定部件，最后做人类审核，保证编辑自然且目标部件确实消失。评测问题被设计成三分类选择题： clearly visible、visible but hard to see、not visible，并要求模型输出 reasoning 和最终 JSON 答案。

实验设置有四种。第一是 direct query，直接问目标部件是否可见。第二是 pre-answer tool injection，在模型回答前注入一个模拟的完美检测器结果，检测结果始终为未检测到且低置信度，用来测试外部证据能否纠正模型。第三是 post-answer tool injection，在模型先给出答案后再注入同样证据，用来观察确认偏差。第四是 thinking with images，允许模型调用裁剪、亮度/对比度调整、二值化等基础图像处理工具，测试主动视觉检查是否能缓解幻觉。另有一个 reasoning effort 实验，用 GPT-5.2 比较不同推理强度设置。作者还拿 OWLv2 和 LLM-Det 这类开放词汇检测器做参照，但这里的比较更像 sanity check，而不是严格同任务对比。
summary.experiments:
结果很一致：十个主流 VLM 在“关键部件已被移除”的图像上普遍表现差，准确率没有一个超过 75%，其中 4 个模型低于 50%。最低的是 Claude Sonnet 4.6，只有 44.1%。Qwen 3.5 Flash 和 GLM 4.6V 表现出明显 existence bias，经常把并不存在的部件判成 clearly visible；Qwen 3.5 Flash 选择 clearly visible 的比例达到 51.7%，甚至高于它正确回答 not visible 的比例 47.5%。

工具注入只能部分缓解。pre-answer injection 下，Kimi K2.5 和 Qwen 3.5 Plus/Flash 有 14.4% 到 16.9% 的提升，但整体仍然不高。post-answer injection 更能暴露确认偏差：Qwen 3.5 Plus 提升最大，Δ=24.5%，但多数模型提升很小，甚至略降；作者也提醒样本小，不宜过度解读这些细微下降。即便给了“完美检测器”证据，多数模型的 not visible 比例仍低于 75%，只有 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 在 post-answer 设置下达到 82.2%。这说明问题不只是看不见，而是模型内部已有回答后不愿修正。

在原始未编辑图像上，模型通常能正确识别目标部件存在，说明失败不是因为任务表述太难，而是特定发生在“应当承认缺失”的场景。thinking with images 只测试了少数模型，论文给出的结论是基础图像处理工具并没有稳定解决问题。NegAwareQwen 表现也不好，作者推测是因为它针对另一类更容易的负样本做过微调，泛化不到这里。整体上，这些结果更像 failure-case benchmark，而不是可用于细粒度排名的成熟评测，因为样本只有 118 张。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可。先看数据构造方法和几个正反例，确认编辑质量是否足够自然；如果编辑痕迹明显，结论会受影响。然后看 Table 1 和 Table 2，抓住两个事实：原图上能识别，缺失图上大面积误判；工具证据和图像处理工具都只能有限纠正。若关心多模态预训练，可重点看作者如何解释 existence bias 和 confirmation bias，这两点比具体榜单更有信息量。

预计阅读时间 15 到 20 分钟。没有必要深挖全部模型排名，重点是 failure mode 定义、评测协议和工具注入实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but revealing failure mode in VLMs: when an essential object part has been removed from an image, models still tend to answer as if the object or part is present. This is not generic hallucination in the broad sense. It is a test of counterfactual visual grounding under conflict between visual evidence and strong world knowledge priors. The question is whether a model can override the prior that an object is normally complete and admit that a crucial component is missing.
summary_en.importance: Its direct value for pretraining research is limited because the main contribution is a small, manually verified benchmark rather than a new training objective, data recipe, or modeling method. Still, it exposes a useful diagnostic signal for multimodal pretraining. Current VLMs appear to fuse visual evidence and language priors in a way that overweights object-level semantic existence and underweights fine-grained visual falsification. Even explicit external evidence often fails to fully correct the answer. That suggests at least two possible upstream issues: too little training data involving missing parts, abnormal object configurations, or visual negation; and alignment objectives that reward semantic plausibility more than visual contradiction handling. So this is better read as a failure analysis asset than as a core modeling paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is straightforward. The authors build MissingBench-Verified, a 118-image benchmark composed of real photos and carefully selected internet images. Each image is paired with a target element to remove. Most edits are produced with the image editing model Nano Banana 2, and the rest are manually edited with an eraser tool. All edited images are then human-verified to filter out unnatural or failed edits. The evaluation prompt is a three-way multiple-choice question asking whether the queried item is clearly visible, visible but hard to see, or not visible, with structured JSON output including reasoning and final answer.

There are four main evaluation settings. Direct query asks the model to judge visibility on its own. Pre-answer tool injection inserts a simulated perfect detector result before the model answers; the detector always reports the queried item as undetected with low confidence. This tests whether external evidence can steer the model. Post-answer tool injection provides the same evidence after the model has already answered, probing confirmation bias. Thinking with images gives the model access to basic image-processing tools such as cropping, brightness and contrast adjustment, and binarization, to test whether active inspection helps. The paper also varies reasoning effort for GPT-5.2 and includes OWLv2 and LLM-Det as detector-style references, though those comparisons are more sanity checks than direct task matches.
summary_en.experiments:
The main result is consistent across models: ten leading VLMs perform poorly on images where essential parts were removed. No model exceeds 75% accuracy on the edited set, and four out of ten fall below 50%. The lowest reported accuracy is 44.1% for Claude Sonnet 4.6. Some models show a strong existence bias. Qwen 3.5 Flash, for example, chooses the 'clearly visible' option in 51.7% of cases, which is even higher than its correct 'not visible' rate of 47.5%.

Tool injection helps only partially. In the pre-answer setting, Kimi K2.5 and Qwen 3.5 Plus and Flash improve by about 14.4% to 16.9%, but overall performance remains modest. The post-answer setting is more revealing because it tests whether models revise an already formed belief. Qwen 3.5 Plus shows the largest gain at 24.5%, but most models improve only slightly, and some even dip a bit, though the authors caution against over-interpreting small changes given the dataset size. Even with a simulated perfect detector, most models still remain below 75% not-visible accuracy; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is the only one reported above that threshold, reaching 82.2% in the post-answer setting.

On the original unedited images, models generally identify the queried object or part correctly, which matters because it shows the task itself is not inherently ambiguous. The failure is concentrated in the missing-part condition. The think-with-images setting, tested on only a few models, does not appear to reliably solve the problem. NegAwareQwen also performs poorly, suggesting that narrow finetuning on easier negative cases does not transfer well to this harder visual-negation setup. Because the benchmark has only 118 images, the results are more useful as evidence of a robust failure mode than as a precise leaderboard.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the dataset construction and example images to judge whether the edits look natural enough. If the edits are visibly artificial, the conclusions weaken. Then read Table 1 and Table 2. The two main takeaways are simple: models do fine on original images, but fail broadly once a critical part is removed; and neither external detector evidence nor simple image-processing tools reliably fixes the issue. If your interest is multimodal pretraining, focus on the discussion around existence bias and confirmation bias rather than the exact model ranking.

About 15 to 20 minutes is enough. There is little reason to study every model comparison in detail unless you are building a benchmark suite for VLM failure analysis.

recommendation.zh: VLM感知幻觉的新评测维度，对预训练数据中缺失样本分布的诊断有参考，只看§3基准构建与§5失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: A new evaluation dimension for VLM perceptual hallucination, useful for diagnosing missing sample distributions in pretraining data; read §3 benchmark construction and §5 failure cases only.

paper.title: Building a European Multilingual Evaluation Dataset: The MMLU Localisation Project within the EMT Network
paper.abstract: This paper reports on a collaboration between the Directorate-General for Translation (DGT) and the European Master's in Translation (EMT) to localise the MMLU dataset into 11 European languages. Beyond creating a more inclusive benchmark for LLM evaluation, the project offers master's students authentic, project-based professional training in translation, revision, project management, and multilingual coordination, while highlighting key methodological, administrative, and workflow challenges.

summary.core_problem: 将 MMLU 本地化到 11 种欧洲语言，构建更适合欧洲多语环境的 LLM 评测数据。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测数据本地化和流程经验，主要价值在多语评测覆盖。它不是新的评测范式，也没有直接推动预训练数据配比或 tokenizer 设计，但可作为多语 benchmark 翻译质量控制案例。
summary.technical_approach: 项目由 Directorate-General for Translation 与 European Master's in Translation 网络协作完成，组织硕士学生参与翻译、修订、项目管理和多语协调；论文重点报告本地化流程、行政约束、协作工作流和方法挑战。
summary.experiments: 摘要未报告模型评测结果、翻译一致性指标、人工质检通过率、语言별覆盖细节或与机器翻译 baseline 的对比。核心产出是 11 种欧洲语言的 MMLU localization 数据集和项目流程记录。

summary_en.core_problem: The project localizes MMLU into 11 European languages to support LLM evaluation in multilingual European settings.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a localized evaluation dataset and workflow experience. It is not a new evaluation paradigm and does not directly inform pretraining mixtures or tokenizer design, but it is a useful case study for multilingual benchmark translation and quality control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work is organized as a collaboration between the Directorate-General for Translation and the European Master's in Translation network. Master's students participate in translation, revision, project management, and multilingual coordination, while the paper documents workflow and methodological challenges.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model evaluation results, translation consistency metrics, human QA rates, per-language coverage details, or comparisons against machine translation baselines. The main output is an 11-language localized MMLU dataset and a description of the localization process.

recommendation.zh: 作为多语 MMLU 本地化流程备查即可；缺少模型测评和质检量化，不值得按研究论文细读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for multilingual MMLU localization; without model results or QA metrics, it is not worth a full research read.

paper.title: Relay-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Multi-Domain Reasoning Chains
paper.abstract: Introducing Relay-Bench, an unsaturated, holistic, text-only benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to complete an assortment of tasks from distinct domains in a single prompt. The leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%. The test set entirely consists of composite problems: groups of single-domain subproblems that are strung together into challenges that require reasoning across multiple domains in combination. Many of these problems then have layers of complexity added through prompt encod

summary.core_problem: 构建一个文本形式的复合推理 benchmark，评估 LLM 在单个 prompt 中串联多个领域任务、处理上下文膨胀和编码干扰的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产，关注多领域推理链而非单一学科题。它对 post-train 推理数据和 agent/tool-use evaluation 有一定参考，但摘要中的模型命名和单作者设置需要谨慎看待。
summary.technical_approach: Relay-Bench 将多个单领域子问题组合成一个复合问题，每题包含 2 到 13 个子问题；覆盖视觉推理、代码、数学、信息抽取、问题求解、常识和数据分析等任务。部分题目加入 prompt encoding 和 deliberate context bloat，并允许模型使用代码执行、网页搜索和可用工具。
summary.experiments: 摘要称领先模型 GPT-5.5 (xHigh) 得分 43.3%，说明测试集未饱和。未给出题目数量、标注流程、泄漏控制、评分协议、工具调用约束、不同模型榜单或人类基线，因此 benchmark 可信度需要看正文验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Relay-Bench evaluates whether LLMs can solve composite, multi-domain reasoning chains within a single text-only prompt under context bloat and encoding distractions.
