summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset focused on chained multi-domain reasoning rather than isolated subject tests. It may inform post-training data design and agent/tool-use evaluation, but the model naming and single-author setup warrant caution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark strings together multiple single-domain subproblems into composite tasks, with 2 to 13 subproblems per item. It covers visual reasoning, coding, math, information extraction, problem solving, general knowledge, and data analysis. Some items add prompt encoding and deliberate context bloat, while models are allowed to use code execution, web search, and available tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%, suggesting the benchmark is unsaturated. It does not provide item counts, annotation procedures, contamination controls, grading protocols, tool-use constraints, full model rankings, or human baselines.

recommendation.zh: 看任务构造和评分协议就够；43.3% 这种数字先别信，关键是是否有泄漏控制和工具约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the task construction and grading protocol only; treat the 43.3% number as weak until leakage controls and tool constraints are clear.

paper.title: ExpertVerse: A General-Purpose Benchmark for Expert-Level Reasoning in Knowledge-Intensive Visual Synthesis
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal generative models have enabled instruction-based image generation to move beyond semantic manipulation to knowledge-driven visual reasoning. However, these methods focus on explicit commonsense reasoning, shallow causal understanding, and direct knowledge recall, failing at knowledge-intensive generation. We develop \textbf{ExpertVerse}, a capability-centric benchmark to evaluate generative models via knowledge-intensive lens. ExpertVerse stratifies reasoning genera

summary.core_problem: 现有图像生成评测主要覆盖显式常识、浅层因果或知识回忆，难以衡量模型在知识密集型视觉合成中的专家级推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测资产和数据集。ExpertVerse 提供面向知识密集型视觉生成的能力分类、专家标注样本和大规模带推理轨迹的数据，对多模态生成模型的能力边界分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 9 类认知能力和 8 个专家学科的正交 taxonomy，细分为 58 个子学科，覆盖单图编辑、多图组合和文生图。作者人工标注 1,611 个实例，并通过自动化流程扩展出 ExpertVerse-100K，包含 reasoning traces 和知识锚定 rationale；还基于该数据训练 KnowThinker，并使用 RL 做进一步优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模：1,611 个专家标注实例和 100K 规模的自动生成数据。模型实验包括训练 KnowThinker 并与现有多模态生成模型比较，但摘要截断，未提供具体模型规模、baseline 名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image-generation evaluations focus on commonsense, shallow causality, or direct recall, and do not adequately test expert-level knowledge-intensive visual synthesis.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and dataset contribution. ExpertVerse offers a capability taxonomy, expert-annotated cases, and a larger rationale-annotated corpus for probing knowledge-heavy visual generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark organizes tasks along 9 cognitive capabilities and 8 expert disciplines, further split into 58 sub-disciplines. It includes single-image editing, multi-image composition, and text-to-image generation. The authors curate 1,611 expert-annotated instances and build ExpertVerse-100K with reasoning traces and knowledge-grounded rationales, then train KnowThinker with reinforcement learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 1,611 expert-annotated examples and a 100K-scale generated dataset. It mentions training KnowThinker and comparing against multimodal generative models, but the provided abstract does not include model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是视觉生成评测资产，不是基座训练论文；作为知识密集型多模态 eval 备查即可。
recommendation.en: This is a visual-generation evaluation asset, not a base-model training paper; keep it as a reference for knowledge-intensive multimodal eval.

paper.title: DRNOISE: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in Misleading Evidence Environments
paper.abstract: Deep research agents increasingly operate over the open web, where relevant records coexist with redundant summaries, outdated reports, and misleading documents. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether agents preserve sound evidential standards when an ordinary-looking false document is deliberately seeded into a searchable environment and offers a direct shortcut to a conflicting answer. We introduce DRNOISE, a 100-task benchmark for answer recovery under misleading evidence. Ea

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评测 deep research agent 在有误导性证据时是否仍能坚持基于底层记录完成验证，而不是被一个看起来可信、直接给出答案但实际错误的文档提前带偏。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 agent 评测和后训练信号设计有启发。它把问题从能不能检索到证据，推进到检索到之后如何使用证据。对研究型 agent 来说，核心能力不只是搜索和摘要，还包括在冲突证据下延迟下结论、完成证据链、区分直接断言和可验证记录。这个 benchmark 可以作为训练 verifier、反思策略、证据使用 policy、以及 agent RL 奖励设计时的诊断工具。
summary.technical_approach: DRNoise 是一个成对干预 benchmark，共 100 个任务，覆盖 10 类证据操作。每个任务有 clean 和 noisy 两个版本。clean 语料中不存在直接写出答案的单一文档，正确答案需要从两条相互印证的间接记录链中推导出来。noisy 版本只增加一个普通外观的错误文档，这个文档直接陈述一个冲突答案。这样设计可以控制变量：任务、真实证据和搜索界面都不变，唯一变化是多了一个容易接受的错误捷径。如果 agent 在 clean 中能答对，而在 noisy 中输出该错误值，失败就更可能来自证据使用策略和停止策略，而不是检索能力不足。论文还做了 trace 和 intervention 分析，用来定位模型是在没找到真实证据、没完成证据链、还是已经看到真实证据但仍采信错误文档。
summary.experiments: 论文在同一 search-agent harness 下评测了 5 个当代语言模型。对 clean 条件下表现较强的 agent，加入一个误导性文档后准确率下降 66 到 88 个百分点。退化同时出现在符号型和数值型任务中，说明问题不只是算术聚合失败。轨迹分析显示，主要机制是 premature stopping：agent 经常已经检索到支持真实答案的记录，也同时看到误导文档，但在完成和核对证据链之前停止。少数情况下，agent 甚至在完成真实证据路径后仍覆盖为错误答案。论文还测试了通用 verification prompt、改变来源可信度、改变 retriever 等干预，效果有限；让真实证据结构上更容易使用可以显著降低错误，但不能完全消除。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 benchmark 构造部分，尤其是 clean-noisy paired intervention、两条间接证据链、单个 misleading document 的设计。实验部分优先看 accuracy drop、错误类型分解和 trace analysis。对做 agent 后训练的人，更值得看 intervention analysis：哪些简单提示无效，哪些结构性改变能减少 premature stopping。这部分能帮助判断 verification 该靠 prompt、检索排序、证据图构造，还是训练时显式惩罚过早停止。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether deep research agents maintain sound evidence standards when a searchable environment contains one plausible but false document that gives a direct conflicting answer. The failure mode is not missing evidence; it is accepting an answer-shaped shortcut before reconstructing the answer from lower-level records.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation paper, but it is relevant to agent post-training and verifier design. It separates retrieval capability from evidence-use policy. A model may retrieve the right records and still fail because it stops too early or treats a secondary claim as sufficient evidence. For training research agents, this benchmark points to reward signals that should value completed evidence chains, conflict resolution, and calibrated stopping rather than only final-answer accuracy or citation count.
summary_en.technical_approach: DRNoise contains 100 tasks across 10 families of evidence operations. Each task has a paired clean and noisy corpus. In the clean corpus, the gold answer is entailed by two corroborating indirect record chains; no single document states the answer directly. In the noisy corpus, everything is held fixed except for one added document that looks ordinary and directly states a conflicting false answer. This paired intervention makes the diagnosis sharper: if an agent solves the clean task but outputs the designated false value in the noisy condition, the failure reflects how it uses evidence under conflict, not whether the task was within its basic capability. The authors analyze traces and interventions to distinguish retrieval failure, incomplete evidence-chain construction, premature stopping, and overriding of completed truthful evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is run with the same search-agent harness across five contemporary language models. Among agents that perform well in the clean setting, adding the misleading document causes 66 to 88 percentage-point accuracy drops. The effect appears in both symbolic and numerical task families, so it cannot be reduced to arithmetic aggregation errors. Trace analysis identifies premature stopping as the dominant mechanism: agents often retrieve truth-supporting records together with the misleading document, but stop before completing and reconciling an evidence route. In fewer cases, they complete a truthful route and still submit the false value. Generic verification prompts, source-credibility changes, and retriever changes do not remove the gap. Structural changes that make truthful evidence easier to use help substantially, but the failure remains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus first on the benchmark construction, especially the clean-noisy paired design and the requirement for two independent indirect evidence chains. Then read the main accuracy-drop results and the trace-based error decomposition. The most useful section for agent training is the intervention analysis, because it shows which mitigations are too weak and which changes improve evidence use by altering the structure of the task rather than only adding generic verification instructions.

recommendation.zh: 单条伪文档即可打穿主流 deep research agent 的事实性验证回路，这是长链推理/工具使用评测里少见的干净干预，值得读 §4 trace 分析。
recommendation.en: A single plausible fake document collapses factuality in mainstream deep-research agents; a rare clean intervention in long-horizon tool-use evaluation—read §4 trace analysis.

paper.title: EvoGUI: An Evolution-Aware Benchmark for GUI State-Transition Understanding
paper.abstract: GUI agents must reason about how actions transform interface states, but end-to-end success rates entangle this ability with perception, grounding, planning, and recovery. We introduce EvoGUI, a diagnostic framework that converts normalized GUI trajectories into three complementary visual question answering probes: temporal ordering, inverse action/value prediction, and contrastive one-step successor discrimination. Their labels are derived from trajectory order and logged actions, requiring no

summary.core_problem: GUI agent 的端到端成功率把感知/OCR/定位/规划/恢复等因素混在一起，难以单独诊断模型是否真正理解“动作如何改变界面状态”。该论文要解决的是：如何把已有 GUI 交互轨迹，低成本地转成专门测“状态转移理解（state-transition understanding）”的诊断题，并明确其反事实/可辨识性边界。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 VLM/多模态预训练与 agent 方向的评测很实用：它提供了一套可迁移的、从日志自动派生标签的 transition-level probes，用来衡量模型的局部世界模型能力（forward/inverse/dynamics discrimination）。这类诊断集能反向指导数据与训练目标：如果模型在 T2（逆向动作/值）或 T3（一步可达判别）系统性失败，说明需要更强的“动作—状态”配对数据、或在预训练/中训练加入更明确的时序与交互建模信号，而不是继续堆端到端 agent rollout。
summary.technical_approach:
EvoGUI 的核心是“轨迹规范化 + 三类 VQA 探针 + 机械派生标签”。
- 轨迹 schema：相邻截图 (s_t, s_{t+1})，记录动作 a_t（click/type/select）、可选值 v_t（输入文本/选项），以及元数据 m_t。不同数据源（Mind2Web、WebLINX）先做 schema normalization。
- T1 Temporal Ordering：从同一轨迹抽 K∈{3,4,5} 张截图打乱，让模型输出时间顺序，测时序结构理解。
- T2 Inverse Action/Value：给 (s_t, s_{t+1}) 预测动作类别；并提供更严格的 joint 版本，要求对 type/select 还原精确 value，避免模型只猜动作不管内容。
- T3 One-step Successor Discrimination：给当前状态与两个候选下一状态，让模型选日志中的真实相邻 successor。distractor 分三档：跨轨迹、同域、long-skip（同轨迹更后面的 s_{t+n}, n≥3）。作者明确：因为 distractor 来自日志采样而非执行验证的反事实，T3 测的是“在给定候选里识别相邻一步”，不是证明另一个候选在任何状态下都不可能一步到达。
- 质量控制：作者指出 GUI 截图可能有异步刷新/广告/加载等导致视觉歧义，因此有人审/过滤流程（全文后半应给出具体规则与一致性检查）。
summary.experiments:
EvoGUI-Bench 由 Mind2Web 与 WebLINX 构建，规模 3,000 instances，覆盖 120 domains。评测 28 个 VLM 配置的 zero-shot 表现。
关键结果：最强模型仅 60.4 EvoGain，整体远未饱和；并分析模型规模与 GUI 相关训练对分数的影响（摘要截断处暗示 scale 与 GUI 数据/训练会显著相关）。
从任务设计可预期的细粒度现象（通常会在全文分析里出现）：
- T2 joint（动作+值）显著难于 action-only，暴露“读懂输入框内容/选项文本并对齐到变化”的短板。
- T3 long-skip distractor 最具诊断性，因为它要求模型理解一步变化的局部性，而不是仅凭同域相似度匹配。
具体分项数字与各模型配置差异需要回看主表与分任务 breakdown。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先读 Benchmark 部分对三任务（T1/T2/T3）的形式化定义与 distractor 采样策略，这是这篇论文的“方法”。
- 重点看作者对标签可辨识性与反事实边界的声明（尤其是 T3 不保证不可达），这决定了如何正确解读分数。
- 看质量控制与歧义案例：GUI 里异步变化会让 transition 监督变脏，这部分对后续扩展到更多轨迹数据很关键。
- 最后扫实验主表：关注分任务表现差异，而不是只看总分 EvoGain；它更像诊断仪表盘。

summary_en.core_problem: End-to-end GUI agent success rates entangle perception, OCR, grounding, planning, and recovery, making it hard to isolate whether a model truly understands how actions transform interface states. The paper targets a scalable way to convert existing GUI trajectories into transition-level diagnostic questions with automatically derived labels, while being explicit about ambiguity and counterfactual limitations.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution rather than a new pretraining objective, but it is useful for foundation-model development in two ways: (1) it provides transition-level probes that better reflect “local world modeling” for GUI interaction (ordering, inverse dynamics, one-step successor discrimination); (2) it can feed back into data/recipe decisions—systematic failures on inverse action/value or one-step reachability suggest missing action-conditioned temporal supervision in pretraining or mid-training, not merely insufficient agent rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
EvoGUI consists of trajectory normalization plus three VQA-style diagnostics with mechanically derived labels.
- Normalized schema: consecutive screenshots (s_t, s_{t+1}), logged action a_t (click/type/select), optional value v_t (typed text/selected option), and metadata.
- T1 Temporal ordering: given K screenshots (K=3/4/5) from the same trajectory in shuffled order, predict the chronological order.
- T2 Inverse action/value: given (s_t, s_{t+1}), predict the action class; a stricter joint variant requires exact value recovery for type/select to prevent partial credit.
- T3 One-step successor discrimination: choose the logged adjacent successor among two candidates; distractors are sampled as cross-trajectory, same-domain, or long-skip (a later state s_{t+n}, n≥3) from the same trajectory. The paper explicitly notes that since distractors are log-sampled rather than execution-validated counterfactuals, T3 measures discrimination among provided candidates, not universal impossibility.
- Quality control: acknowledges GUI-specific ambiguity (async refresh, ads, loading) and applies manual filtering/validation steps (details are in the benchmark construction section).
summary_en.experiments:
EvoGUI-Bench is instantiated from Mind2Web and WebLINX with 3,000 instances across 120 domains. The authors evaluate 28 VLM configurations zero-shot.
Headline result: the best model reaches only 60.4 EvoGain, indicating the benchmark is far from saturated. The paper also studies how model scale and GUI-related training correlate with performance (the abstract suggests a notable dependence).
For practical reading, the most informative results are the per-task breakdowns: action-only vs joint action+value on T2, and the effect of distractor tiers (especially long-skip) on T3. Exact numbers require the main tables/appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the benchmark/task definitions carefully; T1/T2/T3 and distractor sampling are the core contribution.
- Pay attention to the stated limits (especially T3’s non-counterfactual nature) to avoid over-interpreting scores.
- Review the ambiguity/quality-control section; GUI transitions are noisy and this determines how transferable the pipeline is.
- Then scan the main results table and per-task breakdowns; treat EvoGain as a dashboard, not a single ranking.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和 28 模型结果就够；它给 GUI agent 评测补了一个比成功率更干净的中间变量。
recommendation.en: Read the probe design and the 28-model results; it adds a cleaner intermediate variable than end-to-end success for GUI agents.

paper.title: Adaptive Adversaries: A Multi-Turn, Multi-LLM Benchmark for LLM Agent Security
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents process external content, exposing them to prompt injection and multi-turn manipulation. Most safety benchmarks evaluate defenders against fixed attack pools collected before evaluation, single-turn or multi-turn. We present a 21-scenario benchmark for \emph{adaptive multi-round attacks against memoryless LLM defenders}: an autonomous LLM attacker observes prior defender responses and pivots across rounds, while each defender response is evaluated as a fresh interaction. Holding

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM Agent 在面对自适应、多轮提示注入攻击时的安全性，而不是只测固定攻击池。
summary.importance: 这是 Agent security benchmark 贡献。它把攻击者建模为可观察防守方历史响应并逐轮调整策略的 LLM，从评测协议上挑战了静态攻击集的安全结论。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 21 个攻击场景；攻击端由自治 LLM 扮演，可根据上一轮防守响应改变攻击；防守端每次响应按 memoryless fresh interaction 处理；使用固定场景、固定攻击者/防守者和结构化输出评分，比较单轮与最多 15 轮自适应攻击。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告：只看第一轮攻击时 ASR 为 0–1%；允许 15 轮自适应攻击后 ASR 升至 5.4–14.0%。合并三个前沿攻击 LLM 能发现比最佳单一攻击者多 1.4–2.2 倍的 unique successful attacks，且与已有 benchmark 攻击的余弦相似度仅 0.02–0.14。摘要提到 Claude Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 在防守表现上接近。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM-agent security under adaptive, multi-turn prompt-injection attacks rather than fixed attack pools.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-security benchmark contribution. It changes the evaluation protocol by modeling the attacker as an LLM that observes prior defender responses and adapts across rounds, challenging conclusions drawn from static attack sets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 21 scenarios. An autonomous LLM attacker observes previous defender outputs and pivots over rounds, while each defender response is scored as a memoryless fresh interaction. Scenarios, attackers, defenders, and structured-output scoring are held fixed, and first-turn scoring is compared against up to 15 rounds of adaptive attack.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 0–1% ASR when scoring only the first attacker turn, rising to 5.4–14.0% with 15 adaptive rounds. Pooling three frontier attacker LLMs finds 1.4–2.2x more unique successful attacks than the best single attacker, with low cosine similarity to existing benchmark attacks, 0.02–0.14. The abstract states that Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 are close as defenders.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议和 ASR 对比即可；它修正了“固定攻击池足够测安全”的弱 prior，但不是训练方法。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and ASR tables; it weakens the fixed-attack-pool prior, but it is an evaluation paper rather than a training recipe.

paper.title: Seeing What Is Actually There: PriVE-Bench and PriVE-Tools for Counterfactual Evaluation of Agentic Visual Evidence in VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often answer visual questions using learned language and category priors rather than grounding their predictions in the image itself. Counterfactual images provide a natural diagnostic setting for this failure mode: when visible evidence contradicts what is usually true, a grounded model should answer from the pixels, while a prior-following model will produce a canonical but visually incorrect response. However, existing counterfactual benchmarks mainly ask whether

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是 VLM 在“视觉证据”和“语言/类别先验”冲突时到底看不看图，进一步问的是：如果给模型更多 agentic 风格的视觉证据视角，比如框选、裁剪、放大、轮廓叠加，它会不会更愿意根据像素修正原本的先验性回答。核心问题不是再证明一次 VLM 有 prior-following，而是把这种失败模式放到一个可控的 counterfactual setting 里，检验额外证据视图是否真的能改善 grounding。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性有限，因为它主要是评测资产而不是训练方法。但它对多模态预训练和 native VLM 研究仍有启发。第一，它把“看起来会答”与“是否真正依赖视觉证据”分开了，适合诊断图文对齐训练是否过度借助语言先验。第二，它提醒一个常见误区：给模型更多视觉工具或更多局部视图，不等于模型会使用这些证据。若预训练或指令微调阶段没有学会在先验冲突时重加权视觉信号，工具增强可能只增加输入复杂度。第三，PriVE-Tools 这种受控证据条件设计，对后续做多视图训练、视觉 verifier、或 tool-augmented VLM 的数据构造有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 PriVE-Bench，本质上是一个 prior-vs-evidence 的 counterfactual benchmark。每个样本由 original/counterfactual 图像对组成：原图符合常见视觉预期，反事实图则通过定向修改打破某个典型先验。作者覆盖五个域：object existence、counting、fashion attributes、industry/common-object attributes、medical modality consistency。每个样本都定义 visually correct answer 和 prior-consistent biased answer，因此模型输出可以被归类为 correct、biased、other，而不是只看对错。

第二层是 PriVE-Tools。它不是做一个自由工具调用 agent，而是把常见视觉操作转成受控 evidence condition：bounding-box overlays、crops、zoom panels、contour overlays。关键设计是固定底层图像、问题、正确答案、偏置答案和评分规则，只改变证据呈现方式。这样能把“工具是否帮助模型利用视觉证据”从“agent 规划是否成功”“工具调用链是否稳定”等因素里剥离出来。

评测协议上，作者同时测试 original-only、counterfactual-only、paired-image 三种输入模式，并覆盖 yes/no、multiple-choice、open-ended 问题形式。指标除了 accuracy，还单独统计 prior-following error rate 和 other-response rate。这个拆分很重要，因为在 counterfactual 场景里，单纯准确率下降并不能区分模型是看错了、跟随了先验，还是输出了别的无关答案。整体方法的价值在于评测控制做得比较干净。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结论看，实验主要得到三点。第一，counterfactual 输入会系统性诱发 prior-following，而不只是让模型更不确定。也就是说，很多错误答案不是随机噪声，而是稳定落在“类别上通常正确、但对当前图像错误”的那个 biased answer 上。第二，paired-image 输入有时有帮助，因为原图和反事实图并排时，某些差异更容易被比较出来，但这种帮助并不稳定，也不能消除 prior-following。第三，PriVE-Tools 中的工具化证据视图效果高度依赖模型：作者评测的 closed-source VLM 在 crop 和 zoom panel 等条件下整体 grounding 有改善，而若干 open-source 模型的 aggregate 效果较弱，甚至为负。

从研究解读上，这说明失败点不只是“看不到关键区域”，还包括“即便关键区域被显式暴露，模型也未必重写原有先验”。如果一个模型在 raw image 上错、在 crop/zoom 后仍错，而且错误继续落在 biased answer 上，那更像是视觉证据在决策层权重不足，而不是视觉编码器单纯分辨率不够。摘要截断没有给出完整数字，因此不宜编造具体百分点；但从作者的结论表述看，prior-following error rate 是这篇论文最该看的主指标，而不是总准确率。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读。先看 benchmark construction，确认五个 domain 的 counterfactual 是怎么做的，以及 correct / biased / other 三分类规则是否足够严格。然后看 evaluation protocol，特别是 original-only、counterfactual-only、paired-image、tool-conditioned 这几种设置如何保持其余变量不变。结果部分建议优先看不同模型在 prior-following error rate 上的变化，而不是只看 accuracy 排名；再看哪些工具条件对 closed-source 有帮助、对 open-source 无帮助，这里最能反映“证据可见 ≠ 证据被使用”。如果只想抓主线，20–30 分钟足够。更值得深挖的是数据构造细节：反事实修改是否引入低层视觉伪迹，paired-image 是否给了额外比较捷径，以及 medical modality consistency 这类域是否会把任务难度和先验强度混在一起。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in VLMs: when visual evidence conflicts with learned language or category priors, do models answer from the pixels or from what is usually true? It then asks a more current question motivated by tool-augmented vision systems: if we provide extra evidence views such as crops, zooms, boxes, or contours, will the model actually revise a prior-driven answer? The contribution is not just to show that prior-following exists, but to test whether additional visual evidence helps under controlled counterfactual conditions.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited because this is mainly an evaluation asset, not a new training recipe. Still, it is useful for multimodal pretraining and native VLM work. First, it cleanly separates apparent task competence from genuine visual grounding. That matters when image-text pretraining may let the model rely too heavily on language-mediated priors. Second, it highlights a practical lesson: exposing more visual evidence does not guarantee that the model will use it. If pretraining or instruction tuning does not teach the model to upweight visual signals under prior conflict, tool augmentation may add complexity without fixing the decision rule. Third, the controlled evidence-view setup is a good template for future work on multi-view training, visual verifiers, or tool-conditioned multimodal data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. The first is PriVE-Bench, a counterfactual benchmark built around prior-versus-evidence conflicts. Each example contains an original image and a counterfactual image. The original conforms to common expectations, while the counterfactual violates a canonical attribute, count, part, or modality expectation. The benchmark spans five domains: object existence, counting, fashion attributes, industry/common-object attributes, and medical modality consistency. Each item defines both a visually correct answer and a prior-consistent biased answer, so model outputs can be categorized as correct, biased, or other rather than only correct or incorrect.

The second layer is PriVE-Tools. Instead of evaluating a free-form visual agent, the paper converts common visual operations into controlled evidence conditions: bounding-box overlays, crops, zoom panels, and contour overlays. The key design choice is to keep the underlying image, question, correct answer, biased answer, and scoring rubric fixed while changing only the evidence presentation. That isolates whether the evidence view itself helps the model use visual information.

The evaluation protocol includes original-only, counterfactual-only, and paired-image inputs, and supports yes/no, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. Metrics include accuracy, prior-following error rate, and other-response rate. That metric split is important because a drop in accuracy alone cannot tell whether the model is following a prior, becoming uncertain, or producing unrelated outputs.
summary_en.experiments:
The main findings are clear even from the available full text. First, counterfactual inputs induce systematic prior-following errors rather than merely generic confusion. Many wrong answers land specifically on the prior-consistent biased option. Second, paired-image inputs sometimes help because they make the visual discrepancy easier to compare, but they do not reliably remove prior-following. Third, tool-derived evidence views are model-dependent: in the reported evaluations, closed-source VLMs benefit more consistently from crops and zoom panels, while several open-source models show weak or even negative aggregate effects.

The important interpretation is that the bottleneck is not only visual access. In many cases, the relevant evidence is made more explicit, yet the model still does not revise its answer. That suggests a failure in evidence weighting or decision integration, not just a failure of raw perception. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so it is better to avoid inventing exact percentages. The metric to watch is prior-following error rate, not just overall accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark construction and verify how the five domains are built, especially how the correct, biased, and other labels are defined. Then read the evaluation protocol to see how original-only, counterfactual-only, paired-image, and tool-conditioned settings are controlled. In the results, focus on changes in prior-following error rate rather than headline accuracy. Also pay attention to the asymmetry between closed-source and open-source models under crop and zoom conditions; that is where the paper most clearly shows that visible evidence is not the same as used evidence. A 20–30 minute read is enough for the main idea. The deeper questions are whether the counterfactual edits introduce low-level artifacts, whether paired-image inputs create comparison shortcuts, and whether some domains mix prior strength with task difficulty.

recommendation.zh: 反事实 grounding 诊断思路干净，对 VLM 对齐/幻觉评测有参考；只看 benchmark 构造与错误分类表即可。
recommendation.en: Clean counterfactual grounding diagnostic for VLM hallucination evaluation; read the benchmark construction and error taxonomy, skip the rest.

paper.title: Apple-$π$: Benchmarking Thinking with Video Towards Law-Grounded Physical Intelligence
paper.abstract: Modern video generation models are increasingly hailed as emerging world models with an internalized grasp of physical law. Yet existing benchmarks largely evaluate physical plausibility only at the output level, without verifying whether the model arrives there through a faithful, law-grounded reasoning process. We introduce Apple-PI, the first benchmark that anchors video-model evaluation explicitly in physical laws. Apple-PI comprises three components. 1) Orchard: a dataset of 400 videos cove

summary.core_problem: 评估视频生成模型是否真的按物理定律进行可解释推理，而不只是生成看起来合理的视频结果。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频物理推理 benchmark。它把视频生成模型的“世界模型”说法拆成感知、建模、推演三个环节，试图区分输出拟真和 law-grounded reasoning，对多模态预训练和视频生成评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Apple-PI，包括 Orchard 数据集、三阶段评测协议和混合评测套件。Orchard 含 400 个经典力学视频，覆盖 10 类任务，并区分单一定律任务和多定律组合任务。协议用带信息图标注的首帧进行 chain-of-frames prompting，将生成视频视为模型外显推理轨迹，再结合 MLLM 打分和物理规则检查。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整被测模型列表和数值结果，只说明该 benchmark 面向现代视频生成模型，关注物理可行性、定律表述和推导过程的一致性。规模上数据集为 400 个视频、10 个经典力学任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether video generation models reason according to physical laws, rather than merely producing visually plausible outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark contribution for video physical reasoning. It decomposes the “world model” claim into perception, formulation, and deduction, which is useful for evaluating multimodal and video-generation pretraining systems beyond surface-level realism.
summary_en.technical_approach: Apple-PI contains the Orchard dataset, a three-stage scientific-reasoning protocol, and a hybrid evaluation suite. Orchard has 400 videos across 10 classical-mechanics tasks, separating single-law cases from multi-law generalization cases. The protocol uses infographic-annotated first frames and chain-of-frames prompting, treating generated videos as visible reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide a full model list or quantitative leaderboard. The stated scale is 400 videos over 10 mechanics tasks, with evaluation focused on perception, law formulation, and deduction consistency.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频世界模型评测备查即可；核心假设是“生成轨迹可当推理轨迹”，这个假设有用但需要警惕。
recommendation.en: Useful as a video-world-model eval reference; the key assumption that generated trajectories expose reasoning is interesting but fragile.

paper.title: Can AI Agents Really Complete RTL-to-GDS? Lessons from Benchmarking Tool-Interactive EDA Workflows
paper.abstract: LLM-driven agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for electronic design automation (EDA), demonstrating strong potential for automating complex design workflows. However, existing evaluations primarily examine individual language models on isolated EDA tasks, providing limited insight into how different agent systems perform across complete EDA flows. In this work, we present FluxBench, a systematic evaluation of AI agents on end-to-end EDA workflows under unified prompts, tool envir

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在完整 RTL-to-GDS EDA 工具链中的真实能力，而不是只看孤立代码生成或单步任务。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark/evaluation protocol：把工具交互、统一 prompt、统一环境和端到端工作流放进同一评测框架。对通用 agent 研究有方法论意义，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FluxBench，在开源与闭源 EDA 工具环境下，系统评测 agent 在 RTL 生成、迭代修复、工具反馈利用、逻辑综合、布局布线和 ECO 自动化等环节的表现，并分析效率与失败模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明覆盖完整 RTL-to-GDS 流程，包含工业级商业 EDA 工具和开源工具链；但未给出具体参评模型、样本规模和关键数值。价值主要在评测设置是否干净、是否能揭示 tool-interactive agent 的瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether LLM agents can actually handle full RTL-to-GDS EDA workflows rather than isolated code-generation subtasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol: unified prompts, tool environments, and end-to-end workflows for tool-interactive agents. This matters for agent evaluation, though its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is modest.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper presents FluxBench, benchmarking agents across open-source and commercial EDA flows, including RTL generation, iterative repair, tool-feedback use, synthesis, place-and-route, and ECO automation, with efficiency analysis and failure characterization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates coverage of full RTL-to-GDS workflows with both open and industrial toolchains, but does not provide model roster, benchmark size, or headline numbers. The real value will depend on how cleanly the benchmark isolates agent-tool interaction bottlenecks.

recommendation.zh: 这是工具交互 agent 的压力测试，不是基座论文；若你关心 agent eval 设计，可只看任务分解和失败类型，别把结论外推到通用推理能力。
recommendation.en: This is a stress test for tool-interactive agents, not a base-model paper; read the task decomposition and failure taxonomy, but do not overgeneralize its conclusions to generic reasoning.

paper.title: ProEvent: An Event-centric Benchmark for Proactive Agents
paper.abstract: Proactive agents are expected to anticipate user needs and provide autonomous assistance by perceiving environmental context without explicit instructions. A fundamental capability of such agents is to identify and track users' upcoming events, enabling continuous and event-specific assistance. For example, by recording the time and location of a planned hike, an agent can deliver weather reminders in advance or provide navigation support before departure. However, existing works on proactive ag

summary.core_problem: 构建评测 proactive agents 是否能从持续即时聊天中识别、维护和跟踪用户即将发生事件的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评测资产。现有 proactive agent 评测常偏向显式任务或单轮辅助，而事件驱动的长期上下文维护更接近真实个人助理场景。对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 long-horizon memory、用户状态建模和 agent evaluation 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProEvent，一个 event-centric benchmark。数据由合成但尽量真实的即时聊天组成，包含动态多用户互动、并发聊天线程和现实噪声；评测目标是让 agent 主动维护用户 timetable，并据此提供事件相关辅助。核心是评测协议与数据设计，不是新的 agent 架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据规模、参评模型、指标或 leaderboard 结果。可确认的是 benchmark 面向 open-ended proactive assistance 的可靠评估，强调事件识别、跟踪和日程维护能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether proactive agents can identify, maintain, and track users' upcoming events from ongoing instant messaging chats.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation contribution. Existing proactive-agent evaluations often focus on explicit tasks or single-turn assistance, while event-centric long-horizon state tracking is closer to realistic personal-assistant use cases. The direct relevance to pretraining is moderate, but it is useful for long-horizon memory and user-state evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProEvent is an event-centric benchmark built from synthetic but realistic instant messaging chats. It includes dynamic multi-user interactions, concurrent chat threads, and real-world noise. Agents are evaluated on proactively maintaining a user's timetable and enabling event-specific assistance. The core contribution is the benchmark and protocol, not a new agent architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, evaluated models, metrics, or leaderboard numbers. It states that the benchmark targets reliable evaluation of open-ended proactive assistance through event identification, tracking, and timetable maintenance.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory eval 备查即可；看数据生成协议，别把合成聊天结果外推到真实用户环境。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-memory eval reference; read the data protocol, but do not overread synthetic-chat results.

paper.title: Salience Induction against Multi-Hop RAG Agents: Threat and Defense
paper.abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly retrieve external evidence and orchestrate tools for knowledge-intensive applications. In Multi-Hop question answering, agents chain facts across documents. Existing defenses focus on content poisoning, which injects false facts, and prompt injection, which embeds directives. We identify a third attack surface: the salience channel, through which fact position, emphasis, framing, and semantic proximity can redirect reasoning even

summary.core_problem: 多跳RAG Agent的现有防御仅覆盖内容投毒和提示注入，忽略了“事实为真但通过位置/强调/语义邻近等显著性操纵即可误导推理”的第三类攻击面。
summary.importance: 方法+数据贡献：首次形式化定义显著性诱导（Salience Induction）攻击，提出6类编辑算子与迭代生成-验证流水线，并构建带诱饵标注的多跳基准SalientWiki-MH。
summary.technical_approach: 将攻击形式化为“保持事实为真、保持检索轨迹语义完整、仅通过显著性编辑改变多跳属性绑定”的约束优化问题；设计6类Salience-Editing算子，并在事实一致性与隐蔽性约束下用proposer-verifier迭代生成攻击样本。
summary.experiments: 在GPT、Claude、Gemini等5个前沿模型家族上测试，多跳QA准确率在攻击下显著下降；同时给出基线防御的脆弱性分析，具体下降幅度待正文补充。
summary.authors_note: 国防科技大学团队，无公开顶级知名研究者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing defenses for multi-hop RAG agents only cover content poisoning and prompt injection, ignoring a third attack surface where factually-true claims can still mislead reasoning via salience manipulation (position, emphasis, framing, semantic proximity).
summary_en.importance: Method + data contribution: first formalizes Salience Induction attacks, proposes six editing operator classes with an iterative proposer-verifier pipeline, and releases SalientWiki-MH, a decoy-annotated multi-hop benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes the attack as a constrained optimization problem: preserve factual truth, keep retrieval trace semantically intact, and alter multi-hop attribute binding solely via salience edits; designs six Salience-Editing operators and generates attacks under factual + stealth constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across five frontier model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), reports significant accuracy drops in multi-hop QA under attack; also analyzes vulnerability of baseline defenses; exact magnitudes pending full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: National University of Defense Technology team; no publicly recognized top-tier researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: 做RAG/Agent对齐的人可快速扫攻击算子定义，对基座预训练无直接启示，作为安全背景知识备查。
recommendation.en: Quickly skim the attack operator taxonomy if working on RAG/agent alignment; no direct implication for base pretraining, keep as background security reference.

paper.title: Before the Action: Benchmarking LLMs on Prospective Hypothesis Discovery
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at answering pre-specified questions, yet their ability to navigate the open-ended, pre-conclusion stage of discovery remains largely unmeasured. We introduce Prospective Hypothesis Discovery (PHD), which asks models to autonomously construct grounded, discriminative, and testable hypothesis spaces from inconclusive evidence, including anomalous observations and fragmented records, to guide subsequent investigation. To evaluate this capability, we introduce Hyp

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是训练方法，而是一个长期缺位的评测问题：现有 LLM benchmark 大多默认问题已经被表述清楚，模型只需回答、规划或执行；但在真实研究、事故分析、金融研判、运维排障里，更早一步的能力是从不完整、无结论、甚至带噪的事实中提出一组可检验、彼此可区分、且有后续调查价值的假设。作者把这一定义为 Prospective Hypothesis Discovery。难点有两个：一是如何从事后写成的专家文档中构造“结论被拿掉但事实仍成立”的输入上下文，避免信息泄漏；二是如何评价开放式假设空间，而不是把任务错误地压成单一标准答案。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系有限，但对能力评测和数据构造方法有启发。它测的不是常规 QA、也不是标准 agent 成败，而是更接近科研探索、故障诊断、分析建模中的前置认知能力。对于基座模型研究，这类 benchmark 的价值在于：它能把“模型是否会提出有区分度的候选解释”从后续执行能力里剥离出来。若一个模型在这类任务上持续偏弱，问题可能来自预训练语料中的因果压缩、后训练中过度偏向单答案格式、或推理模板把开放探索收缩成了结论复述。贡献量级主要体现在 benchmark 设计与评测协议，而不是方法创新。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分成数据构建和评测两部分。

数据侧，作者提出 Retrospective Context Regression，并配套 Forge–Audit 流程。核心思路是从已经完成的专家文档中，回退构造一个“pre-conclusion”视角的上下文：保留在时间上可见、且能支撑推理的事实材料，删除明确结论、目标假设、回溯性因果归因等强泄漏信号。作者强调这不是试图精确恢复历史上作者当时知道的一切，而是构造一个对模型可见、同时满足 leakage control、temporal admissibility、faithfulness、supportability 的 conclusion-free context。参考侧则保留假设与证据，用于后续验证和诊断。

评测侧，作者认为单参考匹配和绝对 rubric 都不适合开放式假设生成。原因很直接：同一上下文往往支持多个合理方向，reference matching 会低估未出现在 gold 中但合理的假设；而绝对打分在高质量开放回答之间分辨率不够。为此他们设计了 HypoEval：在同一上下文下，对两个模型生成的 hypothesis set 做 pairwise arena 比较，从六个维度判断哪一方更好，包括 Contextual Grounding、Inferential Insight、Evidential Justification、Hypothesis-Space Breadth、Directional Distinctness、Analytical Utility。之后用 Bradley–Terry–Davidson 模型把成对比较聚合成全局排名。rubric 分数仍然保留，但只作为诊断工具，不作为主排名依据。

这个设计的关键取舍很清楚：他们放弃“唯一正确答案”的便利，换取对开放探索任务更贴近实际的评测信号；同时又不完全依赖自由文本 judge，而是用成对比较加统计聚合来提高稳定性。
summary.experiments:
基准名为 HypoArena，包含 988 个案例，覆盖六个领域：Biomedical Science、Machine Learning、Social Science、Financial Analysis、IT Operations、Safety Investigation。作者评测了 15 个当代语言模型，并比较了 arena ranking 与 rubric scoring 的差异。

主要结果有三点。第一，arena 式 pairwise 评测能拉开更清晰的模型层次，而 rubric 分数往往挤在 1–5 分量表中的不到 1 分区间，分辨率不足。第二，agent-mode 的结构化分析技能带来的收益并不统一，效果依赖模型本身，说明“加 agent 外壳”并不能稳定提升前置假设发现能力。第三，作者做了 human-expert alignment 和 cross-judge triangulation，用来验证排名的可靠性。

从已给内容看，论文没有在这里展开每个模型的具体 Elo/BTD 分数、各领域排名变化和 judge 一致性系数，因此不宜编造数字。阅读原文时应重点看：1）Retrospective Context Regression 的泄漏审计有多严格；2）pairwise judge 的提示词和校准方式；3）不同领域是否存在显著不同的模型排序；4）rubric 与 arena 不一致时，究竟是哪类输出被 rubric 误判。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇文章适合按“任务定义—数据构建—评测协议—实证分析”四步读。先看 Introduction 和任务定义，确认它测的是 hypothesis-space construction，而不是开放问答。然后重点看 HypoData 的构建流程，尤其是 conclusion-free context 的标准、泄漏控制规则、以及 Forge–Audit 的人工或自动审计环节。接着看 HypoEval：六个维度的定义、pairwise 比较模板、Bradley–Terry–Davidson 聚合方式。最后再看主实验，判断 arena 排名是否真的比 rubric 更有分辨率。

如果只是泛读，30–40 分钟足够。优先看 Table 1、数据构建示例、评测协议图、以及人类对齐实验。对基座研究员来说，最值得深挖的不是 leaderboard，而是这种“从事后文档回退构造 pre-conclusion context”的数据方法。它未来可以迁移到科学发现、故障分析、代码调试甚至 reward model 数据构造里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing evaluation target rather than a new model architecture. Most LLM benchmarks assume that the task has already been formulated: the model answers a question, follows instructions, or executes a plan. Real discovery often starts earlier, from incomplete evidence, anomalies, and fragmented records, where the key competence is to construct a grounded and testable hypothesis space before any conclusion is known. The authors call this Prospective Hypothesis Discovery (PHD). The two hard parts are data construction—removing conclusion leakage from expert-written documents while preserving usable factual context—and evaluation—scoring open-ended hypothesis sets without collapsing the task into single-answer matching.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it matters as an evaluation asset for model capabilities that standard QA and agent benchmarks do not isolate. For foundation-model research, this benchmark is useful because it separates hypothesis generation from downstream execution. If a model performs poorly here, the weakness may come from pretraining data that over-compresses causal narratives into finalized conclusions, from post-training that over-rewards single-answer formats, or from prompting styles that suppress exploratory reasoning. The main contribution is therefore in benchmark design and evaluation protocol, not in a new learning method.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main components: data construction and evaluation.

On the data side, the authors introduce Retrospective Context Regression together with a Forge–Audit pipeline. The idea is to start from completed expert artifacts—papers, investigation reports, analyst notes, professional blogs—and reconstruct a model-visible context that approximates the pre-conclusion stage. The context retains temporally admissible factual content while filtering explicit conclusions, target hypotheses, and retrospective causal attributions that would leak the answer. The goal is not to perfectly recover the historical information state of the original author, but to build a conclusion-free context that satisfies explicit controls for leakage, temporal validity, faithfulness, and supportability. References keep the hidden hypotheses and evidence for later verification and diagnosis.

On the evaluation side, the paper argues that both reference matching and absolute rubric scoring are poor fits for open-ended hypothesis discovery. A single context can support multiple legitimate directions, so exact-match style metrics under-credit plausible but non-reference hypotheses. Rubric scoring, meanwhile, often lacks resolution when comparing strong open-ended outputs. To address this, the authors propose HypoEval, an arena-style pairwise protocol. Given the same context, two models’ hypothesis sets are compared along six dimensions: Contextual Grounding, Inferential Insight, Evidential Justification, Hypothesis-Space Breadth, Directional Distinctness, and Analytical Utility. Pairwise judgments are then aggregated with the Bradley–Terry–Davidson model to produce a global ranking. Rubric scores are retained only as diagnostics.

The design choice is deliberate: give up the convenience of a single gold answer in exchange for a signal that better matches exploratory reasoning, while using pairwise comparison plus statistical aggregation to improve robustness.
summary_en.experiments:
HypoArena contains 988 cases across six domains: Biomedical Science, Machine Learning, Social Science, Financial Analysis, IT Operations, and Safety Investigation. The authors evaluate 15 contemporary language models and compare arena-based ranking against rubric-based scoring.

Three findings stand out from the provided text. First, pairwise arena evaluation yields a more clearly stratified leaderboard, whereas rubric scores cluster within sub-one-point bands on the 1–5 scale and therefore provide weak discrimination. Second, agent-mode structured analysis does not help uniformly; its effect is heterogeneous and model-dependent, which suggests that wrapping a model in an agent scaffold does not reliably improve early-stage hypothesis discovery. Third, the paper checks ranking reliability through human-expert alignment and cross-judge triangulation.

The excerpt does not include the exact model scores, judge agreement coefficients, or domain-specific ranking shifts, so those details should be verified in the original paper. The most important empirical sections to inspect are the leakage audit for Retrospective Context Regression, the pairwise judging prompt and calibration setup, the extent of cross-domain rank stability, and the cases where rubric and arena disagree.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in four passes: task definition, data construction, evaluation protocol, then empirical analysis. Start with the introduction to understand that the target is hypothesis-space construction rather than open-ended QA. Then move to the HypoData section and focus on how conclusion-free contexts are created, what counts as leakage, and how the Forge–Audit process enforces temporal and factual constraints. After that, read HypoEval carefully: the six evaluation dimensions, the pairwise comparison template, and the Bradley–Terry–Davidson aggregation. Only then look at the leaderboard and reliability studies.

For a skim, 30–40 minutes is enough. Prioritize Table 1, the data construction examples, the evaluation protocol figure, and the human-alignment analysis. For foundation-model researchers, the most reusable idea is not the leaderboard itself but the method of regressing from finalized expert documents back to pre-conclusion contexts. That data construction pattern could transfer to scientific discovery, debugging, incident analysis, and even reward-model data creation.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接改 pretrain，但它测的是“结论出现前”的假设生成，这比又一个 QA 榜单更接近 agentic reasoning；先看数据构造是否真去掉 hindsight leakage。
recommendation.en: It does not directly change pretraining, but it measures hypothesis generation before conclusions exist, which is closer to agentic reasoning than another QA leaderboard; first check whether hindsight leakage is truly removed.

paper.title: An Exam for Active Observers
paper.abstract: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for ML

summary.core_problem: 提出一个评测多模态大模型是否具备主动观察能力的 benchmark，而不是只评测单张图像的静态描述或问答。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark。ActiveVision 把视觉理解从一次性 perception 扩展到闭环观察：模型需要根据中间假设反复查看图像区域。这个失败模式对 native multimodal 预训练有提示，但它本身不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: ActiveVision 包含 3 类共 17 个任务，任务设计要求模型进行多步视觉检查，并按访问顺序列出标注点。评测目标是把主动 gaze-like observation 从普通视觉问答中分离出来，使其成为可测量能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 frontier MLLMs 在 ActiveVision 上大幅失败：最高分模型 GPT-5.5 在最高 reasoning-effort 设置下只解出 10.6%，17 个任务中 11 个为零分；Claude Fable 5 只得 3.5%；3 名人类参与者平均 96.1%。这些数字主要说明 benchmark 对现有 MLLM 的分布外压力很强。
summary.authors_note: 来自 University of Southern California。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for measuring whether multimodal LLMs can actively observe an image instead of answering from a single static view.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset. ActiveVision turns visual understanding into a closed-loop process where the model must repeatedly inspect regions based on intermediate hypotheses. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining, but it is not itself a training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActiveVision contains 17 tasks across three categories. The tasks are designed to require repeated visual perception and ordered reporting of visited labeled points, separating active observation from ordinary image captioning or VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports severe failures by frontier MLLMs: GPT-5.5 at the highest exposed reasoning-effort tier solves only 10.6% of items and scores zero on 11 of 17 tasks; Claude Fable 5 scores 3.5%; three human participants average 96.1%. The key result is a large human-model gap under closed-loop visual inspection.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Southern California.

recommendation.zh: 扫任务定义和失败案例即可；它指出 MLLM 的主动感知缺口，但暂时不给预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the task design and failure cases; it exposes an active-perception gap in MLLMs, but does not yet translate into a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: IMBench: A Benchmark for Intuitive Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Humans combine reasoning and motor control to solve complex manipulation tasks under diverse constraints. They build an understanding of the physical world that helps them convert reasoning into actions and quickly adapt to new scenes, tasks, and rules. We refer to this capability as intuitive manipulation. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this integration: they evaluate physical reasoning in isolation from execution, or measure policy performance without requiring explicit reasoning. We intr

summary.core_problem: 构建一个同时评估物理直觉、任务推理、动作生成和迭代执行的机器人操作 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是具身智能评测资产。它补足了只测物理推理或只测策略执行的评测缺口，对 VLA/机器人基础模型评估有参考，但离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: IMBench 将 intuitive manipulation 定义为感知、物理结构推断、动作序列生成和执行反馈的整合能力。任务覆盖接触丰富操作、工具使用和多阶段依赖，并带有显式约束。论文还提供可扩展工具，用于生成不同场景和任务变体。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 包含 35 个任务和 14K 条过滤轨迹。摘要未给出具体模型榜单、参数规模、各基线表现或提升幅度，因此目前只能确认其数据规模和任务设计。

summary_en.core_problem: It builds a benchmark for robotic manipulation that jointly evaluates physical intuition, task reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an embodied-agent evaluation asset. It fills a gap between pure physical-reasoning tests and policy-only execution benchmarks, which is relevant to VLA evaluation but only indirectly related to LLM base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: IMBench defines intuitive manipulation as an integrated capability spanning perception, physical-structure inference, feasible action-sequence generation, and execution under feedback. The tasks include contact-rich manipulation, tool use, multi-stage dependencies, and explicit constraints. The benchmark also provides scalable tools to generate diverse scenarios and task variants.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 35 tasks and 14K filtered trajectories. The provided abstract does not include model leaderboards, parameter sizes, baseline numbers, or effect sizes, so only the dataset scale and task design can be verified from the given information.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLA 评测备查即可；若不做具身预训练，只看任务 taxonomy 和失败模式，不必细读实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLA evaluation reference; if you do not train embodied models, read the task taxonomy and failure modes only.

paper.title: Controlled Reformulation Testing for Logical Consistency in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently contradict themselves when the surface form of a logically equivalent question changes. We present a benchmark of 350 question families (1,750 total questions) for Controlled Reformulation Testing (CRTBench) to evaluate logical invariance. In this benchmark, we investigate LLMs' ability to maintain consistent answers across controlled reformulations, which include contrapositive rewriting, double negation, negation flipping, and passive voice. We evaluate

summary.core_problem: 高逻辑题准确率不能保证模型在等价改写下保持答案一致。CRTBench 用受控逻辑变换来定位这种不一致，而不是只看普通 paraphrase 后的表现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于评测信号更细。它把“推理能力”拆成了正确性和逻辑不变性两个维度，并能定位到反否命题、双重否定、量词改写等具体失败源。这个方向对构造推理数据、筛选 CoT、评估 RL 后模型是否学到稳定推理规则都有参考意义，但它主要是评测资产，不是训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是构造 350 个 question family，共 1,750 道题。每个 family 包含一个 base question 和四个受控改写。变换分三类：等价保持变换，如反否命题、双重否定、De Morgan、量词改写、被动语态；答案反转变换，即 negation flip；表面控制变换，即被动语态。核心指标有两个：base accuracy 只看原题是否答对；family consistency 要求同一 family 内所有版本都符合各自标签。这个指标比单题准确率更严格，能揭示模型是否只是在局部题面上答对，而没有保持逻辑等价关系。
summary.experiments: 数据覆盖 7 类推理：命题逻辑、三段论、De Morgan、量词推理、多跳推理、嵌套否定、条件谬误，每类 50 个 family。作者在温度为 0 的 zero-shot 设置下评估 GPT-5.4、GPT-5.4-mini、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Flash、o4-mini 等模型。主要现象是 accuracy-consistency gap。GPT-5.4-mini base accuracy 为 98.9%，family consistency 只有 60.3%，差距 38.6 个百分点；GPT-5.4 base accuracy 同为 98.9%，family consistency 为 86.6%；o4-mini 的 family consistency 达到 96.9%。变换层面看，GPT-5.4-mini 在被动语态上约 98.7%，但在反否命题上只有 72.4%，说明失败主要来自逻辑结构变换，而不是表面改写。开启 reasoning effort 对 GPT-5.4-mini 帮助明显，family consistency 从 60.3% 提到 85.4%，但对 GPT-5.4 的整体一致性提升不明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看 Benchmark Design 中 family consistency 的定义、各类 transformation 的标签规则，以及 Experiments 中按 transformation 和 category 拆分的表格。真正有用的是错误归因方式：它比整体逻辑 benchmark 更容易回答“模型到底在哪种逻辑操作上不稳”。人工标注部分也值得扫一眼，因为这类 benchmark 的可靠性主要受改写保真度和标签一致性影响。

summary_en.core_problem: High accuracy on logic questions does not imply that a model gives invariant answers under logically equivalent reformulations. CRTBench tests this invariance with controlled logical transformations rather than unconstrained paraphrases.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is diagnostic granularity. The benchmark separates answer correctness from logical invariance, and attributes failures to specific operations such as contraposition, double negation, and quantifier rewriting. This is relevant for reasoning-data construction, CoT filtering, and checking whether RL or SFT improves stable rule use, although the contribution is primarily an evaluation asset rather than a training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 350 question families and 1,750 total questions. Each family has one base question and four reformulations. Transformations include equivalence-preserving operations such as contraposition, double negation, De Morgan rewrites, quantifier rewrites, and passive voice; an answer-reversing operation, negation flip; and a surface-control operation, passive voice. The key metric is family consistency: a family counts as consistent only if the model answers the base question and all reformulations according to their labels. This is stricter than base accuracy and exposes contradictions that single-question accuracy hides.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset covers seven reasoning categories: propositional logic, syllogistic reasoning, De Morgan laws, quantifier reasoning, multi-hop inference, nested negation, and conditional fallacies, with 50 families each. Models are evaluated zero-shot at temperature 0, including GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4-mini, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and o4-mini. The main result is a large accuracy-consistency gap. GPT-5.4-mini reaches 98.9% base accuracy but only 60.3% family consistency, a 38.6-point gap. GPT-5.4 also has 98.9% base accuracy but 86.6% family consistency. o4-mini is strongest among the reported models with 96.9% family consistency. Transformation-level results show that GPT-5.4-mini handles passive voice at about 98.7% but drops to 72.4% on contraposition, indicating that the failures come from logical operations rather than surface wording. Higher reasoning effort raises GPT-5.4-mini consistency from 60.3% to 85.4%, while the larger GPT-5.4 does not improve overall.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the Benchmark Design section for the definition of family consistency, transformation labels, and answer-reversal rules. Then read the experiment tables broken down by transformation and category. The main reusable idea is the attribution protocol: it makes logical inconsistency more actionable than aggregate logic benchmarks. The manual validation procedure is also worth checking, because this type of benchmark depends heavily on transformation fidelity and label correctness.

recommendation.zh: benchmark 不大，但 setup 很干净；如果你关心 reasoning post-train 到底学到了什么，只看 family-level consistency 和 contrapositive 那组结果就够了。
recommendation.en: The benchmark is small but the setup is clean; if you care what reasoning post-training actually buys, just read the family-level consistency results and the contrapositive slice.

paper.title: Are LLM-Generated GPU Kernels Production-Ready? A Trace-Driven Benchmark and Optimization Agent
paper.abstract: Existing GPU kernel generation benchmarks draw problems from synthetic or curated sources that diverge from deployed workloads. We present Atrex-Bench, a benchmark whose 30 operators and 440 shapes are sampled directly from full-cluster production inference traces of compute-limited, memory-rich GPUs. Each problem carries an importance weight derived from its share of observed GPU time, weighted by application card-hours and computed separately for the serving phases in which it runs, together w

summary.core_problem: 现有GPU核生成基准的问题来自合成或人工筛选的数据集，与生产集群实际推理负载的算子分布、形状倾斜、重要性权重严重偏离，无法衡量LLM生成的核是否达到生产部署要求，同时现有评测的正确性指标存在有效性幻觉，无法区分真正的目标DSL实现和调用PyTorch fallback（回退机制）的投机方案。
summary.importance: 为LLM编码Agent在高性能计算（尤其是LLM推理栈的GPU核优化）场景的落地提供了真实可信的评测基准；提出的重要性加权、按形状roofline（屋顶线，衡量硬件理论性能上限的经典模型）打分、隐藏生产溯源的评测合约，为面向生产负载的编码基准设计提供了通用范式；暴露的正确性奖励黑客问题，对编码Agent的训练目标和评测指标设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建Atrex-Bench：从部署超过1万张XPU-A、H20加速卡的生产推理集群的全栈trace（框架层+设备运行时）中采样，得到30个算子、440个热点形状；每个（算子，形状）对按其在生产服务中的GPU时间占比加权，为每个问题计算独立的roofline上限，且隐藏生产溯源和roofline相关信息避免Agent投机取巧。2）提出Atrex-Kernel-Agent（AKA）：采用profile（性能剖析）驱动的测量-修订工作流，加入「优化dropout」（部分重启以跳出停滞的搜索上下文）和分层优化知识库，解决目标DSL使用率低、与roofline上限差距大的问题。
summary.experiments: 1）基准评测：6个前沿编码Agent中最优的原生模型仅达到参考roofline的10.7%（S_agg=0.107），无Agent能匹配生产部署的手写优化核。2）正确性幻觉分析：Qwen3.7-Max的正确性达84.8%，但FlyDSL（目标硬件的专用核编写语言）使用率仅43.8%，大量正确结果来自PyTorch fallback而非真正的目标DSL实现。3）AKA效果：在弱基础模型上，将0%的FlyDSL fallback转化为近100%的DSL核，在attention_forward算子上性能是fallback方案的6.7倍；在强基础模型上，将S_agg从0.28提升至0.42，在两个attention算子上超过手写生产基线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章的基准设计部分（trace采样流程、重要性加权机制、roofline计算方法、评测合约设计）和第4.3节的正确性幻觉分析；第5章的AKA方法可泛读，实验部分关注核心量化指标即可；预计阅读时间30-40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴研究团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GPU kernel generation benchmarks rely on synthetic or curated problem sets that deviate sharply from real production inference workloads in operator distribution, shape skew, and importance weighting, making them unable to evaluate whether LLM-generated kernels meet production deployment requirements, while standard correctness metrics suffer from a validity illusion as they cannot distinguish real target-DSL implementations from speculative solutions that delegate work to PyTorch fallbacks.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a credible evaluation benchmark for deploying LLM coding agents to high-performance computing scenarios, particularly GPU kernel optimization for LLM inference stacks. Its evaluation contract — importance weighting, per-shape roofline (a classic model for measuring theoretical hardware performance upper bounds) scoring, and hidden production provenance — provides a general paradigm for building production-oriented coding benchmarks. The exposed correctness reward hacking issue also offers insights into the design of training objectives and evaluation metrics for coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Constructs Atrex-Bench: samples 30 operators and 440 hot shapes from full-stack traces (framework layer + device runtime) of production inference clusters with over 10k XPU-A and H20 accelerators. Each (operator, shape) pair is weighted by its share of production serving GPU time, assigned an individual roofline ceiling, and stripped of production provenance and roofline-related artifacts to prevent speculative exploitation. 2) Proposes Atrex-Kernel-Agent (AKA): adopts a profile (performance profiling)-driven measure-revise workflow, adds optimization dropout (partial restarts to escape stalled search contexts) and a layered optimization knowledge base to address low target-DSL adoption and large gaps to roofline ceilings.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Benchmark evaluation: the best vanilla coding agent among 6 frontier models reaches only 10.7% of the reference roofline (S_agg=0.107), with no agent matching hand-tuned production kernels. 2) Correctness illusion analysis: Qwen3.7-Max achieves 84.8% correctness but only 43.8% adoption of FlyDSL (a domain-specific language for writing kernels for target hardware), with most correct results coming from PyTorch fallbacks rather than real target-DSL implementations. 3) AKA performance: on a weaker base model, it converts 0% FlyDSL fallbacks to nearly 100% DSL kernels, delivering 6.7x speedup over the fallback on attention_forward; on a stronger base model, it lifts S_agg from 0.28 to 0.42, outperforming hand-tuned production baselines on two attention operators.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (benchmark design: trace sampling pipeline, importance weighting mechanism, roofline calculation method, evaluation contract design) and Section 4.3 (correctness illusion analysis). Skim Section 5 for the AKA method and core quantitative experimental metrics; expected reading time 30-40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Alibaba Research Team

recommendation.zh: 生产trace驱动的GPU kernel基准很有现实意义，结论显示当前代码智能体在真实算子上性能远低于预期，看实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Production trace-driven GPU kernel benchmark is practically meaningful; results show current coding agents perform far below expectations on real operators, read the experiments section only.

paper.title: ToolAlignBench: Investigating Alignment Conflicts in Tool-Calling Enabled LLMs
paper.abstract: Safety alignment in LLMs aims to align models with human values, but which values take precedence when they conflict? We investigate this question in the context of tool-calling LLM agents deployed in regulated industries, where agents processing confidential documents may encounter content that triggers safety-trained values (e.g., public welfare) that conflict with deployment-context instructions (e.g., internal logging). To empirically verify this phenomenon, we build a benchmark of 128 scena

summary.core_problem: 当工具调用 LLM agent 部署在受监管行业中处理机密文档时，安全对齐训练中植入的公共利益等价值可能与部署场景下的组织指令（如仅做内部记录）发生冲突，导致模型在两种都具有正当性的行为之间做出不可预测的选择。现有 benchmark 只测功能能力或安全拒答，不测这种价值冲突下的行为。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐研究的直接启发有限，但揭示了一个真实的对齐缺口：安全对齐不是单一维度的“拒答/不拒答”，而是在多元价值之间存在优先级排序问题。abliteration 实验也提供了一个观察点——移除安全方向后模型行为如何变化，这对理解 safety representation 在激活空间中的结构有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 ToolAlignBench，包含 16 个领域共 128 个场景（64 个违规场景 + 64 个结构匹配的安全场景）。设定 agent 任务为内部文档记录与摘要，赋予其访问敏感数据和外部通信工具的能力。观察模型是否会在发现组织违规证据时，越过部署指令进行举报、数据外泄或证据篡改等行为。对比了专有模型、开源模型和 abliterated 版本的行为差异。
summary.experiments: 测试 12 个模型。开源模型如 Llama-8B 误对齐率高达 68.3%，而 GPT-5-mini 仅 0.3%。安全对齐的开源模型在违规场景下最高有 43.4% 的概率覆盖部署指令。abliteration 移除安全拒答方向后，举报和数据外泄行为的变化模式被单独分析。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 Introduction 中的场景设定和 Results 中不同模型的行为差异数字。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。benchmark 本身规模较小（128 个场景），方法论上更偏现象展示而非机制研究。

summary_en.core_problem: When tool-calling LLM agents are deployed in regulated industries to process confidential documents, safety-aligned values (e.g., public welfare) may conflict with deployment-context instructions (e.g., internal logging only), forcing the model to choose between two legitimately justifiable behaviors. Existing benchmarks measure functional capability or safety refusal but not behavior under such value conflicts.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct relevance to pretraining, but it exposes a real alignment gap: safety alignment is not a binary refuse/comply dimension but involves value prioritization under pluralistic, legitimate interests. The abliteration comparison also offers a data point on how behavior changes when the safety direction in activation space is removed.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolAlignBench consists of 128 scenarios across 16 domains (64 wrongdoing + 64 matched safe scenarios). The agent is tasked with internal document logging and summarization, with access to sensitive data and external communication tools. The authors measure whether models override deployment instructions to whistleblow, exfiltrate data, or tamper with evidence when encountering organizational wrongdoing. Proprietary, open-source, and abliterated models are compared.
summary_en.experiments: 12 models tested. Open-source models such as Llama-8B show misalignment rates up to 68.3%, while GPT-5-mini shows only 0.3%. Safety-aligned open-source models override deployment instructions up to 43.4% of the time in wrongdoing scenarios. Abliteration effects on whistleblowing and data exfiltration are analyzed separately.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the scenario setup in Introduction and the cross-model behavior numbers in Results. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. The benchmark is small (128 scenarios) and the work is primarily phenomenological rather than mechanistic.

recommendation.zh: 多元对齐冲突是后训练与部署端长期被忽视的维度，对做对齐与安全训练的预训练团队有参考，重点看 §4 行为分类与冲突场景设计。
recommendation.en: Pluralistic alignment conflict is a long-overlooked dimension at the post-training/deployment boundary, useful for alignment and safety-focused pretraining teams; focus on §4 for behavior taxonomy and scenario design.

paper.title: SportD: Can VLMs Physically Strategize?
paper.abstract: Vision--language models have become increasingly capable of interpreting visual scenes, but it remains unclear whether they can use information to make strategically effective decisions. We investigate this question in soccer, where models observe the seconds preceding an on-ball decision and must choose whether to shoot or pass to a specific teammate. Unlike conventional visual-understanding tasks, soccer enables decisions to be evaluated quantitatively by estimating the value of every availabl

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 是否不仅能看懂画面，还能在动态体育场景中做出物理上和策略上合理的决策。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark 和评测协议：把足球决策转成可量化的 action-value 评估，而不是只做主观问答。这对多模态 agent/VLM 的“看懂 ≠ 会决策”问题有一定参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SportD：从 2022 世界杯中收集 478 个持球决策片段，模型观察决策前几秒视频后，需要在射门或传给特定队友之间选择。评测用 possession-value model 估计每个可选动作对得分概率的增益，从而计算最优动作准确率和次优动作损失。
summary.experiments: 评测 3 个 frontier VLM。最佳模型只在 31.4% 事件上选到最高价值动作，而职业球员为 38.9%。这说明当前 VLM 在动态策略决策上明显落后人类。数据规模不大，但评测定义比常见 VQA 更贴近决策质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether VLMs can make physically and strategically sound decisions in dynamic sports scenarios, not just describe visual content.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark and evaluation protocol: soccer decisions are scored with quantitative action values rather than subjective QA. This is somewhat useful for multimodal agent/VLM evaluation, though still far from core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces SportD, a benchmark of 478 on-ball decisions from the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Models observe the seconds before a decision and must choose between shooting or passing to a specific teammate. A possession-value model estimates the scoring gain of each available action, enabling optimal-action accuracy and value-forfeiture metrics.
summary_en.experiments: Three frontier VLMs are evaluated. The best model selects the highest-valued action on only 31.4% of events, versus 38.9% for professional players. The dataset is small, but the protocol is more decision-grounded than standard VQA.

recommendation.zh: 评测想法比结果更有用：把多模态决策质量落到 action value 上是对的，但样本太小，适合当 eval 设计参考，不值得细读模型分析。
recommendation.en: The evaluation idea is more useful than the leaderboard: grounding multimodal decisions in action value is the right move, but the sample size is too small for strong conclusions.

paper.title: MultiRef-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Reference-to-Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-reference-to-audio-video (MR2AV) generation aims to generate coherent audio-video content conditioned on multiple references and textual instructions. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on text-driven generation, single-reference subject preservation, or isolated audio-video alignment, leaving the emerging MR2AV setting largely unexplored. Compared with these settings, MR2AV requires models to jointly reason over multiple references while generating synchronized visual and audio content. Mod

summary.core_problem: 现有音视频生成评测基准未覆盖多参考条件下的音视频联合生成（MR2AV）场景，无法评估模型对多参考实体的绑定、组合及音视频同步生成能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向多参考条件音视频生成的统一评测基准，填补了该细分场景的评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 通过可扩展、可控的资产组合流水线构建350个标注样本，覆盖多视角主体保持、多实体绑定、人-物-场景组合三类核心任务；设计可解释的多维度评测指标，分别评估参考保真度、实体组合一致性、音视频同步性等维度。
summary.experiments: 选取当前主流的多模态生成模型作为基线，在三类子任务上进行系统评测，发现现有模型在多实体绑定与音视频联合一致性上存在明显短板。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、新加坡国立大学、香港科技大学（广州）、清华大学、北京大学等高校。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-video generation benchmarks do not cover the multi-reference conditioned audio-video generation (MR2AV) setting, failing to evaluate models' ability to bind and compose multi-reference entities while generating synchronized audio-visual content.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark contribution that first builds a unified evaluation benchmark for multi-reference conditioned audio-video generation, filling the evaluation gap in this emerging scenario.
summary_en.technical_approach: 350 curated samples are constructed via a scalable and controllable asset-composition pipeline, covering three core tasks: multi-view subject preservation, multi-entity binding, and human-object-scene composition. Interpretable multi-dimensional metrics are designed to evaluate reference fidelity, entity composition consistency, and audio-video synchronization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates mainstream multimodal generation models as baselines across three subtasks, revealing that existing models have obvious shortcomings in multi-entity binding and joint audio-visual consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Nanjing University, National University of Singapore, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Tsinghua University, Peking University, etc.

recommendation.zh: 仅面向多参考音视频生成细分场景的评测基准，不做多模态统一生成预训练的研究员无需深入。
recommendation.en: A benchmark only for the narrow multi-reference audio-video generation scenario; no need for researchers not working on unified multimodal generative pre-training to dive in.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: KeyFrame-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Keyframe-Conditioned Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video generation increasingly relies on keyframe-based workflows, where creators specify a sequence of reference images to guide generation. Although recent models support multi-keyframe conditioning, it remains unclear whether they can faithfully reproduce the prescribed keyframes while maintaining overall video quality. We present KeyFrame-Compass, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating keyframe-conditioned video generation. The benchmark contains 386 carefully curated samples spanni

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成评测未覆盖关键帧条件生成场景，无法系统评估模型对指定关键帧的还原能力与整体视频质量的平衡表现。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向关键帧条件视频生成的综合评测基准，覆盖多应用场景、多条件格式、多关键帧密度等设置。
summary.technical_approach: 构建386个精心筛选的样本，覆盖3个应用领域、2种视频结构、2种提示粒度、2种条件格式、4种关键帧密度；提出自动化评测框架，将关键帧执行拆解为存在性、保真度、时序顺序、定位、持久性、唯一性6个互补指标，同时评估整体视频质量。
summary.experiments: 对主流关键帧条件视频生成模型进行系统评测，发现现有模型在关键帧时序一致性、多实体定位等维度存在显著缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、清华大学、北京大学等高校。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation benchmarks do not cover the keyframe-conditioned generation setting, failing to systematically evaluate models' balance between faithful keyframe reproduction and overall video quality.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark contribution that first builds a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for keyframe-conditioned video generation, covering multiple application scenarios, conditioning formats, and keyframe densities.
summary_en.technical_approach: 386 curated samples are constructed, covering 3 application domains, 2 video structures, 2 prompt granularities, 2 conditioning formats, and 4 keyframe densities. An automated evaluation framework is proposed, decomposing keyframe execution into 6 complementary metrics (presence, fidelity, temporal ordering, localization, persistence, uniqueness) while assessing overall video quality.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of mainstream keyframe-conditioned video generation models reveals significant defects in temporal consistency of keyframes and multi-entity localization.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Nanjing University, Tsinghua University, Peking University and other academic institutions.

recommendation.zh: 仅针对关键帧条件视频生成的细分评测基准，做通用多模态生成预训练的研究员仅需知晓存在即可。
recommendation.en: A niche benchmark for keyframe-conditioned video generation; researchers working on general multimodal generative pre-training only need to be aware of its existence.

paper.title: SciDiagramEdit: Learning to Edit Scientific Diagrams from Paper Revisions
paper.abstract: Editing the figures in a research paper is a routine and time-consuming part of everyday research practice: authors relabel components, rearrange panels, and restyle visuals as they revise their manuscripts. Automating this editing workflow under a natural-language instruction, however, is challenging, because a scientific figure is a dense infographic in which heterogeneous visual elements such as schematics, plots, photos, captions, and arrows are composed under a tight visual grammar to advan

summary.core_problem: 现有方法难以根据自然语言指令自动编辑科学图表，缺乏真实编辑监督数据与可交互的编辑框架。
summary.importance: 提出首个从论文修订历史挖掘的科学图表编辑benchmark，以及基于技能演化的agent编辑框架，属于多模态编辑领域的数据集与方法贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 从arXiv版本历史中挖掘图表before/after配对数据，基于作者真实修订意图构建benchmark；采用agentic skill evolution框架，在可编辑矢量图源上执行编辑操作，支持用户协同编辑。
summary.experiments: benchmark包含从arXiv挖掘的真实科学图表编辑对；验证了skill-evolution框架在多种编辑任务上的有效性（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括KAUST、微软研究院、南洋理工大学；作者包含Jürgen Schmidhuber（深度学习先驱）、Ziwei Liu（NTU多模态知名学者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Automating scientific diagram editing via natural language instructions is challenging due to lack of real editing supervision data and interactive frameworks for dense infographics.
summary_en.importance: Presents the first scientific diagram editing benchmark mined from paper revision histories, plus an agentic skill-evolution editing framework; contributes both dataset and method for multimodal editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mines before/after figure pairs from arXiv version histories grounded in authors' real revision intents; adopts an agentic skill evolution framework operating on editable vector sources with user co-editing support.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmark consists of real scientific diagram editing pairs from arXiv; validates skill-evolution framework performance across various editing tasks (specific metrics not provided in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include KAUST, Microsoft Research, Nanyang Technological University; authors include Jürgen Schmidhuber (deep learning pioneer) and Ziwei Liu (prominent NTU multimodal researcher).

recommendation.zh: 从arXiv版本历史挖多模态编辑监督信号的思路有参考价值，作为多模态编辑benchmark备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: The idea of mining multimodal editing supervision from arXiv revision histories is worth noting; keep as literature reference for multimodal editing benchmarks, no need to read full text.

institutions: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

paper.title: WaterMoE: Expert-Routing-based Watermarking for High Fidelity and Efficiency
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success but raise growing concerns about content provenance and misuse, motivating the need for reliable watermarking techniques. However, these techniques have rarely been adopted in practice mainly for two reasons: i) severely degraded model performance, and ii) additional inference overhead. To confirm the problem, we construct a comprehensive benchmark spanning different generation tasks to systematically evaluate 9 representative waterma

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM watermarking 在复杂生成任务中质量下降明显、且推理开销过高，导致难以在真实系统中部署的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献分两部分：一是做了 9 种 watermark 方法的系统 benchmark，指出现有方法主要针对流畅文本而非受约束复杂任务；二是提出面向 MoE 模型的路由级 watermark。对基座预训练不是核心，但对 MoE 推理控制、内容溯源和生成约束有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: WaterMoE 不直接在 token sampling 上加偏置，而是通过控制性扰动 expert router 的选择，把 watermark 信号嵌入到专家激活路径中，再累积影响 token 选择分布。这样试图在保持文本质量的同时减少额外推理开销，利用的是 MoE 路由本身已存在的离散选择结构。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明构建了覆盖不同生成任务的 benchmark，并比较 9 个代表性 watermark 方法；结论是现有方法在受限和复杂任务上表现差，且开销不适合低时延系统。新方法面向 MoE LLM，但摘要未给出模型规模、任务细节、检测准确率、质量损失和时延开销的具体数字，因此目前更适合快速浏览其 benchmark 设定和主表。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the practical failure of LLM watermarking methods: they often degrade quality on constrained generation tasks and add too much inference overhead for deployment.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes both a benchmark over nine watermarking methods and a router-level watermarking method for MoE models. It is not central to pretraining, but it may be relevant for researchers interested in MoE control, provenance, and generation constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: WaterMoE embeds the watermark not by directly biasing token sampling, but by perturbing expert routing decisions so that the watermark signal accumulates through expert activation patterns and eventually shifts token selection. The idea is to exploit the discrete routing structure already present in MoE inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the authors build a benchmark spanning multiple generation tasks and evaluate nine representative watermarking methods, finding that most existing methods fail on constrained and complex tasks and incur too much overhead for latency-sensitive systems. The proposed method targets MoE LLMs, but the abstract does not provide model sizes, task details, detection rates, quality trade-offs, or latency numbers.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 部分可看：若你在做 MoE 控制或生成约束，先看主表，方法细节次之。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark is the part to inspect: if you care about MoE control or constrained generation, read the main table before the method section.

paper.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: While search agents demonstrate impressive capabilities in multi-step question answering, their robustness to poor-quality evidence remains under-explored. This phenomenon occurs rarely in realistic benchmarks but can lead to dramatic failure in real life applications. Therefore in this study we propose DeepStress, a stress testing framework that controls the frequency of challenging evidence by replacing the retrieval module of search agents with a controlled synthetic environment. We use this

summary.core_problem: 解决 search agent 在检索证据质量变差时缺少系统性压力测试的问题，尤其是现实中少见但代价很高的低可信、低相关或含错证据场景。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测框架与指标，而不是又一个 agent。它把检索质量拆成 trustworthiness、relevance、factuality 三个可控维度，适合研究 parametric knowledge 与 retrieved knowledge 冲突时 agent 的失效模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DeepStress，用受控合成环境替换 search agent 的原始检索模块，从而精确控制输入文档的可靠性分布。基于这一环境，对多个 search agent 在 HotpotQA 和 BrowseCompPlus 上做 stress test，并设计更细的结果指标来刻画系统输出及参数知识与外部证据的交互。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是若干 search agents，任务覆盖 HotpotQA 与 BrowseCompPlus。摘要显示不同 agent 在面对不可靠信息时差异显著，但未给出具体模型名、参数量和数值幅度。对预训练研究员而言，价值不在 leaderboard，而在 failure taxonomy 和评测设计是否足够干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Orange Research。不是头部基础模型实验室，但做的是比较扎实的 agent stress-testing 方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of systematic stress testing for search agents when retrieved evidence becomes low-quality, especially in rare but costly cases involving untrustworthy, irrelevant, or false documents.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation framework and metrics, not another agent. It factorizes retrieval quality into trustworthiness, relevance, and factuality, which is useful for studying failure modes when parametric knowledge conflicts with retrieved evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepStress replaces the native retrieval module of search agents with a controlled synthetic environment, allowing precise control over the reliability profile of retrieved documents.
