It then stress-tests several search agents on HotpotQA and BrowseCompPlus, with new metrics to characterize outcomes and the interaction between parametric and retrieved knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover multiple search agents on HotpotQA and BrowseCompPlus. The abstract reports substantial differences in robustness to unreliable information, but does not provide model names, parameter counts, or effect sizes. For a pretraining researcher, the value is less about the leaderboard and more about whether the failure taxonomy and evaluation setup are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Orange Research. This is not a top foundation-model lab, but the work appears to be a fairly serious agent stress-testing effort.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但评测切口是对的：当参数知识和检索证据冲突时，agent 怎么坏掉，这比再刷一个 QA 分数更值得看；先读指标定义和 controlled setup。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it asks the right evaluation question: how agents fail when parametric knowledge conflicts with retrieval; read the metric design and controlled setup before anything else.

paper.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
paper.abstract: Most reported gains from agent-optimization methods are one-shot: an agent is optimized against a fixed benchmark and the resulting improvement is reported as if it were a stable property of the method. This does not test the setting that matters for deployed agents, where optimization is applied recursively as new failures and new tasks appear over time. The central question this raises is whether optimizer-driven gains compound: after an agent has been optimized once, can it be optimized again

summary.core_problem: 检验 agent optimizer 在持续到来的新任务上是否能“复利式”累积收益，而不是只在一次性静态 benchmark 上看起来有效。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测设定而不是新 agent 方法。它把 agent 优化从单阶段静态评测改成两阶段 continual-learning 评测，直接暴露现有优化器是否会遗忘旧收益。这对看 agent scaling、test-time optimization 和部署稳定性的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Terminal-Bench 2.0 构建两阶段 continual-learning evaluation，在相同优化预算下比较 GEPA、Meta Harness 和 RELAI-VCL 三类 agent-harness optimization 方法。重点不是提出新优化器，而是控制预算与任务到达顺序，观察第一轮优化后的收益在第二轮新任务到来后能否保留、迁移或被侵蚀。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明三种方法在传统单阶段静态设定下都优于 baseline agent，但在引入新任务后的持续学习设定中，收益不再稳定累积，部分方法出现旧任务收益回退或新旧任务兼顾失败。由于摘要未给出具体数值、agent backbone 和任务规模，当前更应把它当作评测协议信号，而不是结论终局。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Soheil Feizi。Feizi 在鲁棒性、评测与模型行为分析方面有较强辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether gains from agent optimizers actually compound when new tasks arrive over time, instead of merely looking good in a one-shot static benchmark setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol, not a new agent method. By turning agent optimization into a two-phase continual-learning test, it exposes whether current optimizers preserve earlier gains or simply overfit to a fixed benchmark. This is relevant for people tracking agent scaling, test-time optimization, and deployment stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on Terminal-Bench 2.0, the paper introduces a two-phase continual-learning evaluation and compares GEPA, Meta Harness, and RELAI-VCL under matched optimization budgets. The point is not to invent another optimizer, but to control budget and task arrival so one can measure whether improvements from phase one survive phase two.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, all three methods beat the baseline agent in the conventional single-phase static setting. Once new tasks are introduced, however, the gains do not reliably compound, and some methods appear to lose prior improvements or fail to balance old and new tasks. Since the abstract omits exact numbers, backbone details, and task counts, the result should be treated as a strong evaluation signal rather than a settled empirical law.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Soheil Feizi, who is well known for work on robustness, evaluation, and model behavior analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新 agent 算法，而是把“优化有效”这件事测得更干净；若你关心 test-time scaling 或 agent 训练闭环，只看设定和主表即可。
recommendation.en: Not a new agent algorithm, but a cleaner way to test whether optimization really sticks; if you care about test-time scaling or agent training loops, the setup and main table are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
paper.abstract: What happens to an LLM agent's tool choice when the reliable tool silently changes within an ongoing session? We borrow set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study how well agents adapt to hidden reliability shifts. Our benchmark mounts tool-skill libraries with redundancies, where many tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. In our evaluation framework, a branched schedule shifts the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs every shift with a no-shift control.

summary.core_problem: 评测 agent 在会话中工具可靠性悄然变化时，是否能像 set-shifting 一样及时调整工具选择，而不是固化在早期形成的调用惯性里。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 评测工作，不直接服务于基座预训练，但对 tool-use agent 的行为诊断有一定新意：它不只看任务是否完成，而是看在隐藏分布切换下，策略是否能重新分配工具调用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者借用认知心理学中的 set-shifting 概念，构造带冗余工具库的 benchmark：多个工具都能完成任务，但隐藏可靠性不同；在分支式日程中，可靠工具组会在会话中途切换，并配对 no-shift 对照。论文定义 set-shifting accuracy，衡量每个 post-shift 窗口都路由到目标工具组的联合概率，并在开源 agent harness 中测试开源模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示，agent 往往在每个边界后几轮内收敛到少数重复 routine，工具调用份额集中在少数离散值；不同模型在同一组 routine 上表现出不同失败模式。实验更像行为剖面而非能力上限测试。未见与预训练直接相关的模型或数据分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents can adapt their tool choice when hidden tool reliability changes mid-session, rather than getting stuck in early routines.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-evaluation paper, not a foundation-model pretraining contribution. Its value is the behavioral diagnostic: it measures adaptation under hidden distribution shifts instead of only end-task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: Borrowing the notion of set-shifting from cognitive psychology, the benchmark builds redundant tool libraries where multiple tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. A branched schedule changes the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs each shift with a no-shift control. The main metric is set-shifting accuracy, defined over post-shift routing windows.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that agents quickly settle into a small recurring routine after each boundary, with tool-call shares concentrating on a few discrete values. Different open-weight models exhibit distinct failure modes over the same routines. The setup is more diagnostic than capability-maximizing.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 tool-use agent eval，可以记下这个“隐藏可靠性切换”设定；否则和基座研究距离较远，看 metric 定义即可，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: If you work on tool-use agent evaluation, keep the hidden-reliability-shift setup; otherwise this is far from core foundation-model work and the metric definition is enough.

paper.title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
paper.abstract: Real-world deployment of embodied agents requires active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation. However, existing frameworks often rely on privileged simulator states or assume complete instructions, bypassing realistic deployment challenges. To bridge this gap, we present REAL, an agentic framework for open-world mobile manipulation. REAL establishes sim-to-real-consistent environment APIs without oracle perception and integrates a simulated user to enable human-i

summary.core_problem: 现有具身智能体框架多依赖模拟器特权状态或完整指令，难以适配真实开放世界移动操作中的探索、视觉定位与意图澄清需求。
summary.importance: 方法创新+Benchmark贡献，提出兼顾探索、交互与可部署性的具身智能体框架，并构建覆盖多任务维度的真实评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 提出REAL框架，构建与真实一致、无感知先验的环境API，集成模拟用户支持人机交互；设计多样化任务组合驱动数据采集、SFT与在线RL迭代优化；配套REAL-Bench评测体系。
summary.experiments: 在REAL-Bench的241项任务（主动探索、视觉干扰、关节操作、交互消歧）上验证，训练后的智能体表现优于主流基线；未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing embodied agent frameworks rely on privileged simulator states or complete instructions, failing to address exploration, visual grounding, and intent disambiguation in real-world open-world mobile manipulation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation plus benchmark contribution; proposes an embodied agent framework balancing exploration, interactivity, and deployability, with a multi-dimensional real-world evaluation suite.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces REAL framework with sim-to-real consistent environment APIs free of oracle perception, a simulated user for human-in-the-loop interaction, and diverse task compositions driving data collection, SFT, and online RL; paired with REAL-Bench benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 241 REAL-Bench tasks spanning active exploration, visual distraction, articulated manipulation, and interactive disambiguation, outperforming leading baselines; specific model size and training data scale not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能体方向的常规框架+Benchmark工作，与LLM基座预训练关联较弱，仅作领域动态备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: A standard embodied agent framework plus benchmark work with weak relevance to LLM base pretraining; keep as domain background reference, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: MemOps: Benchmarking Lifecycle Memory Operations in Long-Horizon Conversations
paper.abstract: Long-term memory has become a foundational capability for LLM-based agents that accompany users across extended, multi-session interactions. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate such memory almost exclusively through downstream question answering, scoring only the correctness of a final answer. This black-box formulation conflates the heterogeneous causes of memory failure, such as missing the introduction of a relevant fact, binding an operation to the wrong target, or relying on stale values

summary.core_problem: 现有长对话记忆benchmark仅通过下游QA正确率黑盒评测，混淆了记忆失败的不同原因（如事实缺失、操作绑定错误、值过期等），可能奖励记忆状态不一致但答案正确的情况。
summary.importance: 首次提出将对话记忆建模为生命周期操作序列的评测范式，推出MemOps benchmark，属于评测方法创新，为长记忆能力的细粒度诊断与优化提供新工具。
summary.technical_approach: 将记忆拆解为remember、forget、update、reflect等显式生命周期操作及其组合，设计MemOps评测基准，通过细粒度标注每个记忆操作的正确性，而非仅最终答案，来定位记忆失败的具体原因。
summary.experiments: 构建了覆盖多类记忆操作的长对话评测数据集，在多个主流LLM与agent模型上完成基线测试，量化了不同模型在各记忆操作维度的能力缺陷（具体数值未在摘要中披露）。
summary.authors_note: MemTensor（上海）科技有限公司与中国人民大学等机构合作，团队专注于长记忆AI系统研发。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-conversation memory benchmarks only evaluate through black-box downstream QA accuracy, conflating different causes of memory failure (e.g., missing facts, wrong operation binding, stale values), and may reward correct answers with inconsistent memory states.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first evaluation paradigm that models conversational memory as a sequence of lifecycle operations, and releases the MemOps benchmark. It is an evaluation method innovation providing a new tool for fine-grained diagnosis and optimization of long-term memory capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes memory into explicit lifecycle operations including remember, forget, update, reflect, and their compositions. Designs the MemOps evaluation benchmark, which locates specific causes of memory failure by fine-grained annotation of each memory operation's correctness rather than just the final answer.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs a long-conversation evaluation dataset covering multiple types of memory operations, conducts baseline tests on multiple mainstream LLMs and agent models, and quantifies capability defects of different models across memory operation dimensions (specific values not disclosed in the abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between MemTensor (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd. and Renmin University of China, with the team focusing on long-memory AI system R&D.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文预训练或agent记忆的研究员可参考其评测范式设计，细粒度记忆操作的拆解思路可用于预训练能力的细粒度诊断。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on long-context pretraining or agent memory can reference its evaluation paradigm design; fine-grained memory operation decomposition can be used for pretraining capability diagnosis.

paper.title: LakeQuest: A Three-Domain Benchmark for Grounded Question Answering across Data Lakes
paper.abstract: While modern question answering (QA) systems excel on clean, schema-aligned corpora, real-world knowledge is rarely so neatly packaged. Answering questions over enterprise and scientific data lakes requires systems to navigate heterogeneous, weakly structured collections of tables, passages, and linked metadata. Current benchmarks abstract away this noisy discovery process, failing to evaluate end-to-end performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce LakeQuest, a human-validated benchmark of 9,84

summary.core_problem: 评测问答系统在真实 data lake 中端到端发现证据并合成答案的能力，而不是只在干净、schema 对齐的语料上做 QA。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。它把检索源发现、跨表格/文本/元数据证据定位、答案合成放在同一个评测链路里，能暴露标准 RAG 在真实企业和科研数据湖中的失败模式；但它更偏 RAG/QA 系统评测，对基座预训练方法的直接信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 LakeQuest，包含 9,846 个人工验证 QA pair，覆盖 AI/ML metadata、retail banking、multimodal biomedical drug information 三个领域。每个问题配有精确的、模态感知的 evidence pointer，并把 source discovery 与 cross-modal synthesis 分开分析。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了标准 RAG 等 baseline 的评测，用于衡量端到端 retrieve-and-synthesize pipeline。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据或提升幅度，只明确指出该 benchmark 能分离源发现错误和跨模态合成错误。
summary.authors_note: University of Waterloo；Victor Zhong 长期做语义解析、结构化数据问答和检索问答相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether QA systems can discover evidence and synthesize answers over realistic data lakes, rather than over clean and schema-aligned corpora.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It stresses end-to-end source discovery, heterogeneous evidence grounding, and answer synthesis across tables, passages, and metadata. The connection to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, but it is useful for understanding where RAG-style systems fail outside sanitized datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: LakeQuest contains 9,846 human-validated QA pairs across three domains: AI/ML metadata, retail banking, and multimodal biomedical drug information. Each question is paired with exact modality-aware evidence pointers, and the evaluation separates source discovery from cross-modal synthesis.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates standard RAG baselines and related retrieve-and-synthesize pipelines. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data details, or numerical gains, but emphasizes diagnostic failure decomposition.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Waterloo; Victor Zhong is known for work on semantic parsing, structured QA, and retrieval-grounded question answering.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RAG 评测资产知道即可；预训练研究员只需看数据构造和错误分解，不必读完整实验。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as a RAG evaluation asset; for pretraining work, skim only the dataset design and failure decomposition.

paper.title: CoRe: A Comprehensive Framework for Cross-Image Comparative Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Cross-image comparative reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), especially when correct prediction requires fine-grained attribute grounding and globally consistent reasoning. We present CoRe, a unified framework for this problem. CoRe includes: (i) CoRe-20K, a large-scale triplet-based training set automatically constructed from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert collaborative pipeline, covering counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations; (ii) TriSR

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在多图比较推理中难以同时完成细粒度属性定位、跨图判断和全局一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态推理数据、训练框架和评测资产的组合。它把 cross-image comparative reasoning 单独拎出来，覆盖计数、深度、距离、空间关系等需要比较而非单图识别的能力，对 VLM 后训练和评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoRe 框架，包括从结构化视觉元数据自动构造的 CoRe-20K 三元组训练集，以及 TriSR 结构化奖励。TriSR 在 GRPO 优化中同时约束属性 grounding、判断对齐和 triplet consistency，避免只用最终答案奖励导致模型学到表面比较模式。
summary.experiments: 在 CoRe-Bench 上评测多图细粒度比较推理能力。摘要报告 CoRe 相比最强 baseline 的 partial accuracy 提升 28.2 个百分点，同时在常规多模态 benchmark 上保持竞争力。未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体 baseline 名称。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets VLM failures in cross-image comparative reasoning, where models must ground fine-grained attributes and maintain consistent judgments across multiple images.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a combined data, reward, and benchmark package for multi-image VLM reasoning. The task isolates comparative capabilities such as counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations, which are not well captured by standard single-image VQA setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRe builds a triplet-based training set, CoRe-20K, from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert construction pipeline. It also introduces TriSR, a structured reward scheme for GRPO that supervises attribute grounding, judgment alignment, and triplet-level consistency instead of relying only on final-answer reward.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are centered on CoRe-Bench. The abstract reports a 28.2-point gain in partial accuracy over the strongest baseline while remaining competitive on standard multimodal benchmarks. Model scale, training size beyond CoRe-20K, and detailed baselines are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和 TriSR 奖励设计；它更像 VLM 后训练 recipe，不会改变基座预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and TriSR reward design; this is more a VLM post-training recipe than a base-pretraining signal.

paper.title: The First ChineseBabyLM Challenge: training data-efficient and cognitively plausible language models for Chinese
paper.abstract: This paper describes the first ChineseBabyLM challenge, which will be held in the 2026 NLPCC conference. The challenge calls for researchers to train language models from scratch with 100 million Chinese tokens and evaluates the models on 3 tracks of tasks: NLU, cognitive alignment and Hanzi knowledge. There is no restriction on tokenizer, model architecture and the number of training epochs. Details of the challenge can be found in https://chinese-babylm.github.io/.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是提出一种新的中文预训练方法，而是给“低数据预算下的中文语言建模”建立一个可比较、可复现、带认知约束的评测框架。核心问题有两个：一是现有 BabyLM 主要围绕英语，不能覆盖中文在分词边界、字词结构、书写系统上的特殊性；二是仅看常规下游任务，无法判断模型是否真的在有限输入下学到了中文特有的语言规律和更接近人类的表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 eval 资产型工作，对预训练研究的价值主要在基准设计，而不是方法创新。它的重要性在于把中文数据效率研究从“少量数据上跑几个任务”推进到更系统的设定：固定约 1.02 亿词预算、允许自建同预算语料、同时考察 NLU、汉字知识和脑表征对齐。对 tokenizer、字词粒度建模、数据选择、课程学习、重复训练轮数这些预训练变量，它提供了一个比较合适的实验场。尤其是 Hanzi track 和 cognitive track，把中文特有结构与认知 plausibility 拉进主评测，这一点比单纯复刻英文 BabyLM 更有信息量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有新模型，核心贡献是 challenge 设计。训练规则要求参赛系统从随机初始化开始，在 1 亿级中文 token 预算下预训练。数据来源有两种：使用官方 1.02 亿词语料，或自建但必须满足相同词预算。这样设计的好处是既保留 BabyLM 的数据约束，又允许研究者探索数据筛选、语料构成和 tokenizer 方案。

评测分三条 track，共 14 个任务。第一条是 NLU，包括零样本 minimal-pair 和 CLUE 风格监督迁移任务。零样本部分用 ZhoBLiMP 和隐藏的 XCOMPS-ZH，前者偏句法与语义可接受性，后者偏概念-属性兼容性。第二条是 Hanzi track，直接测模型是否学到汉字的结构和音韵知识，而且如果 tokenizer 无法识别目标字或部件，评测直接记失败。这一点很关键，因为它把 tokenizer 设计从“实现细节”变成了显式研究变量。第三条是 Cognitive Modeling track，用 MulCogBench 的中文 fMRI 数据，拿模型隐状态去预测人类在词级和篇章级理解时的脑响应。

从预训练研究角度，最有意思的是它把三种不同能力放在同一个预算约束下：语言可接受性、汉字知识、神经对齐。这样一来，字符级 tokenizer、BPE、词级切分、混合粒度方案，不再只是看下游分数，而是要面对更细的能力取舍。
summary.experiments:
论文主体更像 task description 而不是方法实验。可确认的关键事实包括：训练预算是约 102 million Chinese words；最终评测共 14 个任务，分为 8 个 NLU、4 个 Hanzi、2 个 Cognitive Modeling 任务；ZhoBLiMP 最终评测包含 118 个 paradigm、每个 300 个样本，共 35,400 对 minimal pairs；隐藏任务 XCOMPS-ZH 包含 14,368 对 minimal pairs；AFQMC 训练/开发集规模为 34,334 / 4,316；OCNLI 为 50,437 / 2,950。正文还说明提供 baseline systems 和初始结果，但给出的全文片段没有包含完整 baseline 表和具体分数，因此不应虚构。

真正值得注意的实验设定细节有两点。第一，minimal-pair 任务对 tokenizer 很敏感，尤其 Hanzi 任务中出现 UNK 会直接失败，这会显著影响子词词表和字符覆盖策略。第二，认知任务不是传统 accuracy，而是用 encoding model 看隐藏状态对 fMRI 响应的预测相关性，这会鼓励研究者关注表示质量，而不只是任务头微调能力。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction，理解为什么中文不能直接沿用英文 BabyLM 的任务设计。然后重点看 Evaluation Tasks，尤其是三条 track 的定义和评分方式。对做预训练的人，最该细读的是 Hanzi track 的 tokenizer 约束，以及 cognitive track 如何把 hidden states 接到 encoding model 上。最后再看 baselines 和 challenge rules，判断这个 benchmark 对自己关心的问题是否合适。

如果只是想判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟足够：读任务设计、数据预算规则、隐藏测试设置即可。如果准备拿它做实验，就需要进一步核对官方语料构成、词预算定义、是否按 word 还是 token 计预算、以及不同 tokenizer 在 Hanzi 任务上的覆盖率统计。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper does not introduce a new Chinese pretraining method. Its main goal is to build a controlled benchmark for data-efficient and cognitively grounded Chinese language modeling. The core gap is twofold: BabyLM-style evaluation has been centered on English, and standard downstream tasks alone are not enough to tell whether a model trained on limited Chinese input has learned Chinese-specific linguistic structure or human-like internal representations.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset rather than a method paper. Its value for pretraining research comes from benchmark design. It creates a more disciplined setting for studying Chinese sample efficiency: a fixed budget of roughly 102 million Chinese words, optional self-compiled corpora under the same budget, and evaluation along NLU, Hanzi knowledge, and neural alignment. That makes it a useful testbed for tokenization, character-vs-word granularity, data selection, curriculum design, and repeated-epoch training under low-resource constraints. The Hanzi and cognitive tracks are the most distinctive parts; they make the benchmark more informative than a direct Chinese copy of English BabyLM.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There is no new model architecture here. The contribution is the challenge design. Systems must be pretrained from random initialization under a BabyLM-style data budget. Participants can either use the official 102-million-word corpus or build their own corpus under the same word budget. This preserves the core low-data constraint while leaving room for research on corpus composition, filtering, and tokenizer design.

Evaluation is organized into three tracks with 14 tasks in total. The NLU track combines zero-shot minimal-pair evaluation and supervised transfer tasks from CLUE. The zero-shot part includes ZhoBLiMP and a hidden XCOMPS-ZH benchmark: the former emphasizes syntactic and semantic acceptability, while the latter targets concept-property compatibility. The Hanzi track directly tests whether models acquire structural and phonological knowledge about Chinese characters. Importantly, if the tokenizer maps the target character or component to UNK, the model automatically fails that item. This turns tokenization coverage into an explicit research variable rather than an implementation detail. The Cognitive Modeling track uses Chinese fMRI benchmarks from MulCogBench, evaluating whether hidden states can predict human neural responses during word-level and discourse-level comprehension.

From a pretraining perspective, the interesting part is that all three dimensions are evaluated under the same data budget. Character tokenizers, BPE, word segmentation, and mixed-granularity schemes are therefore forced to expose their trade-offs more clearly.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper is mainly a task and benchmark description, not a method-heavy experimental study. The key confirmed facts are: the training budget is about 102 million Chinese words; the final evaluation contains 14 tasks grouped into 8 NLU tasks, 4 Hanzi tasks, and 2 cognitive modeling tasks; ZhoBLiMP contains 118 paradigms with 300 examples each, totaling 35,400 minimal pairs; the hidden XCOMPS-ZH task contains 14,368 minimal pairs; AFQMC has 34,334 training and 4,316 development examples; OCNLI has 50,437 training and 2,950 development examples. The text also mentions baseline systems and initial results, but the provided content does not include the full baseline tables or exact scores, so those should not be invented.

Two setup details matter a lot. First, minimal-pair evaluation is highly sensitive to tokenization, especially in the Hanzi track where UNK directly counts as failure. Second, the cognitive track uses correlation-based encoding-model evaluation rather than standard task accuracy, which shifts attention toward representation quality rather than only fine-tuning transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the Introduction to see why Chinese requires a different BabyLM design from English. Then read the Evaluation Tasks section carefully, especially the definitions and scoring protocols of the three tracks. If your focus is pretraining, pay special attention to the tokenizer constraint in the Hanzi track and to how hidden states are mapped into the fMRI encoding model. After that, check the challenge rules and baselines to decide whether the benchmark matches your research questions.

If you only want to assess relevance, 30 minutes is enough: read the task design, the data-budget rules, and the hidden-evaluation setup. If you plan to use the benchmark, you will need to inspect the official corpus composition, the exact definition of the word budget, whether your setup optimizes for words or tokens, and tokenizer coverage statistics for the Hanzi tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和数据约束即可；它是中文 tokenizer 与小数据预训练 recipe 的好试验场，不是结论型论文。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and data constraints; this is a useful testbed for Chinese tokenizer and small-data pretraining recipes, not a conclusion-heavy paper.

paper.title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
paper.abstract: We study LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts over multiple benchmarks whose induced model scores and rankings approximate those obtained from the full benchmark suite. In evaluation-unsupervised benchmark coreset selection (our approach), the selection algorithm uses no model evaluation outcomes, and operates on a fine granularity by producing subsets of prompts over multiple benchmarks rather than producing a sub-collection of entire benchmarks. We use submodula

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是大规模 LLM benchmark 反复评测成本过高的问题：在不使用历史模型得分、正确率或 response 的前提下，只根据 prompt 文本、答案字段和元数据，从多个 benchmark 中选出少量 prompt，使子集上的模型分数和排序尽量接近完整评测套件。
summary.importance: 对基座训练团队的直接价值在评测侧。预训练和 mid-train 阶段需要高频比较 checkpoint、数据配比和训练 recipe，完整跑多套 benchmark 成本很高。已有 benchmark coreset 方法常依赖历史模型评测结果，适合老 benchmark，不适合新 benchmark 或私有 benchmark。这项工作把问题改成 evaluation-unsupervised selection，降低了构建快速评测集的冷启动成本。它不是预训练方法论文，但对训练动态监控、模型选择和回归测试有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 benchmark coreset 当作子模优化问题。选择单位不是整个 benchmark，而是跨多个 benchmark 的单个 prompt，这比只选 benchmark 子集更细，可以避免某个 benchmark 内部冗余过高、但仍有少量独特样本被整体丢掉。每个样本的表示由 prompt 与 ground-truth 字段拼接后再 embedding 得到，ground-truth 字段包括答案、约束、patch 等可观测信息，但不包括模型输出或模型得分。在此基础上，工作比较了多类 submodular objective：DPP 用于鼓励多样性，facility location 用于覆盖语义空间，submodular mutual information 用于在候选样本和目标分布之间做覆盖匹配。差异在于，DPP 更强调被选样本之间不要相似，facility location 更强调每个未选样本都能被某个已选样本代表，mutual information 类目标则更像在约束预算下保留与完整集合相关的信息。
summary.experiments: 实验设定覆盖 35 个异质 benchmark，任务类型包括知识、数学、代码、指令遵循和 agentic 行为等。评估目标不是只看一个 aggregate score，而是同时看完整评测套件的模型分数、模型排名，以及不同能力维度下的保真度。这一点很重要，因为只拟合总体均分可能掩盖能力维度上的偏差。给定内容没有提供完整表格中的具体数值，因此不宜补写具体提升幅度。可以确认的是，实验重点在比较不同无监督子集选择目标相对于随机采样、整 benchmark 选择等基线的 score/ranking preservation，并分析 benchmark 间和 benchmark 内部的冗余。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看问题定义部分，尤其是 evaluation-supervised 与 evaluation-unsupervised 的区分，以及为什么不使用历史模型 response。然后看样本表示构造和各类 submodular objective 的定义，重点比较 DPP、facility location、submodular mutual information 的选择偏好。实验部分重点看三类图表：子集比例与 score/ranking fidelity 的关系，不同能力维度下的误差，以及 benchmark 冗余分析。若用于内部评测体系，最值得复用的是“跨 benchmark、prompt 粒度、无模型得分”的构建流程，而不是某个单一 objective。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build a small prompt-level coreset for LLM evaluation suites without using prior model scores, responses, correctness labels, or item-response statistics. The goal is to approximate full-suite scores and rankings while selecting only from observable benchmark fields such as prompts, answers, constraints, and metadata.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is evaluation efficiency during model development. Pretraining and mid-training workflows often require frequent checkpoint comparisons, data-mixture checks, and regression tests. Running a large heterogeneous benchmark suite each time is expensive. Prior benchmark compression methods often rely on historical model evaluations, which makes them less useful for new, private, or contamination-sensitive benchmarks. This work is useful because it targets the cold-start setting: construct a fast evaluation subset before collecting score matrices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates benchmark coreset construction as submodular subset selection at prompt granularity. Instead of selecting whole benchmarks, it selects fractional prompt subsets across many benchmarks, which can preserve useful non-redundant examples from otherwise redundant datasets. Each item is embedded using model-independent semantic features built from the prompt concatenated with ground-truth fields such as answers, constraints, and patches. The paper then compares several submodular objectives. DPP-style objectives favor diversity among selected items. Facility-location objectives favor coverage of the full item set through nearest selected representatives. Submodular mutual-information objectives aim to retain information about the target suite under a budget. These objectives encode different tradeoffs between diversity, coverage, and fidelity to the full benchmark distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematics, coding, instruction following, and agentic behavior. The fidelity criteria include preservation of model scores, model rankings, and capability-wise behavior rather than only an overall average. This design matters because errors can cancel out in aggregate scores while still distorting specific capabilities. The supplied content does not include the complete result tables, so exact numerical gains should not be inferred. The important experimental axis is the comparison between unsupervised submodular selection, random selection, and coarser benchmark-level selection under different subset budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the problem setup, especially the distinction between evaluation-supervised and evaluation-unsupervised coreset selection. Then read the item representation pipeline and the definitions of DPP, facility-location, and submodular mutual-information objectives. In the experiments, look for curves of subset budget versus score/ranking fidelity, capability-wise error plots, and redundancy analysis. For an internal evaluation pipeline, the most reusable idea is the cold-start, prompt-level, cross-benchmark selection protocol rather than any single objective.

recommendation.zh: 做内部模型快速评测或ablation筛选时可直接复用FL子模块选prompt的思路，重点看§3的子模块函数设计和§4的相关性实验。
recommendation.en: For fast internal model evaluation or ablation screening, directly reuse the FL submodular prompt selection pipeline; focus on §3 function design and §4 correlation experiments.

paper.title: GDP.pdf: Benchmarking Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Professional PDF Documents
paper.abstract: A large share of day-to-day work in professional domains happens inside PDF files: benefits packets, leases, datasheets, clinical guidelines, construction plans. Benchmarks for document AI have generally measured the required capabilities in isolation: OCR, layout analysis, chart reasoning, table QA, document VQA. A high score on any one of them does not necessarily reveal whether a model can answer a realistic question that someone in the field would actually ask about a specific PDF. GDP.pdf i

summary.core_problem: 现有文档 AI benchmark 把 OCR、版面分析、图表推理、表格 QA、文档 VQA 等能力拆开单独测，高分无法预测模型在真实专业 PDF 工作流中的表现；而且模型在真实 PDF 上的错误经常不是显性错误，而是引用了存在但不具决定性的条款或数字，看起来像对的，实际上没有 grounded 到正确证据。
summary.importance: 从评测角度补了一个重要缺口：面向真实职业场景的 grounded multimodal reasoning。核心贡献不是规模，而是构建原则——所有题目来自十个领域从业者的真实工作问题，且必须至少难住两个前沿多模态模型才被收录；评分用原子化 rubric，同时给严格通过率和部分得分，特别检查答案是否建立在正确证据上。对多模态长文档模型、文档智能以及“grounding 失败但表面答对”这类对齐/评测问题有参考价值，但属于评测工作，不直接贡献预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: GDP.pdf 构建了 100 道题，覆盖 Finance、Healthcare、Legal、STEM/Research、Engineering、Construction、Manufacturing/Supply Chain、Insurance、Real Estate、HR 十个领域。每题包含原始 PDF、自然语言问题、专家参考答案、领域标签、能力轴标签和原子化 rubric。筛选流程：1）领域专家提交自己工作中真实会问的问题及源 PDF；2）多个前沿多模态模型尝试作答，至少两个模型出现实质性错误（答案实质错误、漏掉决定性证据、编造内容）才保留；3）过滤掉仅凭通用先验知识就能回答、不需要读 PDF 的题；4）每题打上 11 个能力轴标签，分三层：基础抽取与 grounding、结构与多模态理解、高级推理。评分采用两级指标：rubric score 对每个原子判据给 0/1 部分分；strict pass rate 要求所有 rubric 条目都满足才算通过，排序以 strict pass 为主，rubric score 用于细粒度错误分析。
summary.experiments: 对 7 个前沿多模态模型做了 pilot 评测。论文强调严格通过率非常低，说明现有模型在真实专业 PDF 任务上离实用还有明显距离；rubric score 则揭示模型往往能完成部分子任务，但在决定性证据定位、脚注/附录/修订条款等“fine print”上频繁失败。错误分析围绕 11 个能力轴展开，重点关注三类问题：文档结构复杂性（跨页表格、边栏、图例、脚注、末尾修订）、背景知识与文档内容的交互、以及“错误不显眼”的 groundedness 失败——模型引用了真实存在但与问题无关的条款或数字。具体绝对分数在正文描述中强调 strict pass 很罕见，但该版本仅含 100 题，规模小，定位是诊断性 pilot 而非覆盖性 leaderboard。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对“分数高但真实任务不会做”的批评、benchmark 设计里的 adversarial screening 和 atomic rubric 评分协议、以及错误分析部分关于 grounding 失败的观察。如果关心文档 VLM 或 agent 在真实文件上的评测，可细看 capability taxonomy 和 rubric 设计示例。做基础预训练的读者可快速浏览，主要启发点是评测应如何捕捉“看起来对但证据错了”的失败模式。
summary.authors_note: Surge AI 团队发布。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing document AI benchmarks measure OCR, layout analysis, chart reasoning, table QA, and document VQA in isolation, so high scores do not predict whether a model can answer realistic questions about professional PDFs encountered in actual work; furthermore, failures on real PDFs are often not overt—the model cites a clause or number that does exist in the document, but it is not the decisive evidence, producing a plausible answer that is not properly grounded.
summary_en.importance: Fills an evaluation gap for grounded multimodal reasoning over real professional documents. The contribution is not scale but construction principle: every question is authored by working professionals across ten domains, and an item is included only if it defeats at least two frontier multimodal models. Scoring uses an atomic rubric that reports both a strict pass rate and partial credit, explicitly checking whether the response is anchored to the correct evidence. Relevant to researchers working on multimodal long-document models, document intelligence, and the broader problem of detecting grounding failures masked by superficially correct answers, though this is an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: GDP.pdf contains 100 question–document pairs spanning Finance, Healthcare, Legal, STEM/Research, Engineering, Construction, Manufacturing/Supply Chain, Insurance, Real Estate, and Human Resources. Each item includes the original PDF, a natural-language question, an expert reference answer, a domain label, capability-axis tags, and an expert rubric with atomic criteria. The construction pipeline is: (1) domain experts contribute questions from their actual workflows together with source PDFs; (2) several frontier multimodal models attempt each candidate, and an item is retained only if at least two models make a substantive failure (materially wrong answer, missed decisive evidence, or fabricated claim); (3) tasks answerable from general prior knowledge without reading the PDF are rejected; (4) each item is tagged against an 11-axis capability taxonomy organized into three tiers: foundational extraction and grounding, structural and multimodal comprehension, and advanced reasoning. Evaluation reports two metrics: a rubric score that gives partial 0/1 credit per atomic criterion, and a strict pass rate that requires every rubric element to be satisfied. Ranking is by strict pass rate, while rubric scores enable finer-grained error analysis.
summary_en.experiments: A pilot evaluation is run across seven frontier multimodal models. The paper highlights that strict pass rates are very low, indicating a substantial gap between current models and practical professional PDF workflows. Rubric scores show that models often succeed on partial sub-tasks but frequently fail to locate decisive evidence, especially in fine print such as footnotes, appendices, legends, plan symbols, and appended amendments. Error analysis is organized around the 11 capability axes, with emphasis on three recurring issues: structural complexity of real documents (multi-page tables, sidebars, legends, footnotes, amendments), interaction between domain background knowledge and document content, and non-obvious grounding failures where the model cites real but irrelevant clauses or numbers. The benchmark contains 100 items and is positioned as a diagnostic pilot rather than a large coverage leaderboard.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the Introduction's critique of isolated academic benchmarks versus real document workflows, the adversarial item screening and atomic rubric design, and the error analysis on grounding failures. Readers interested in document VLM or agent evaluation over real files can look more closely at the capability taxonomy and rubric examples. Those focused on foundation pretraining can read quickly; the main takeaway is how evaluation can be designed to catch failures that look correct but rely on the wrong evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by the Surge AI team.

recommendation.zh: 专业文档多模态推理的高质量评测集，多模态基座预训练时可直接引入作为验证集，重点看§3筛选流程和评分标准。
recommendation.en: High-quality benchmark for professional document multimodal reasoning; can be used directly as validation set for multimodal base pretraining, focus on §3 filtering pipeline and rubric design.

paper.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
paper.abstract: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用Agent评测框架以文本为核心，大多仅支持静态单轮、小规模工具集的视觉输入场景，缺少在动态多轮交互、多图像输入、大规模工具库条件下，对多模态Agent视觉工具调用能力的标准化统一评测体系。
summary.importance: 作为多模态工具调用方向的专项评测框架，填补了动态视觉工具调用场景的评测空白，其多维度任务设计和自动化场景生成流程，为多模态模型的工具调用能力迭代、预训练-后训练全流程的多模态Agent能力验证提供了可直接复用的测试基准。
summary.technical_approach: 在文本工具调用评测框架ToolSandbox基础上扩展，新增原生图像处理能力、视觉专属工具集，同时支持结构化工具调用、代码执行两种交互范式。构建的评测基准覆盖511个工具、16个应用领域，沿信息流类型、对话挑战类型、图像到达模式三个正交维度设计任务，包含258个人工校验的场景、1284张专属图像，支持多轮、多图像交互。配套自动化场景生成管线，通过信息流引导的任务规划、环境状态实例化、多阶段质量过滤，将人工成本从全量标注降低为定向审核。评测环节结合确定性状态校验与LLM裁判，从任务完成度、工具使用有效性、指令遵循、无副作用等多个维度完成打分。
summary.experiments: 对主流闭源、开源前沿模型的系统评测显示，现有模型在视觉工具调用任务上仍存在明显短板：多图像工作记忆是核心瓶颈，不同参数量模型呈现差异化的失败模式，在视觉grounding推理、多步交互、状态化工具使用环节均存在显著提升空间。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注框架设计部分的三维任务划分逻辑、实验部分的模型失败模式分析，可直接复用该基准评估自有多模态模型的视觉工具调用能力，预计阅读时间12分钟。
summary.authors_note: Apple机器学习团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing tool-calling agent evaluation frameworks are text-centric, mostly limited to static single-turn scenarios with small tool sets, and lack a standardized, unified evaluation system for multimodal agents' visual tool-calling capabilities under dynamic multi-turn interaction, multi-image input, and large tool library settings.
summary_en.importance: This dedicated visual tool-calling evaluation framework fills the gap in benchmarking for dynamic visual tool use scenarios. Its multi-dimensional task design and automated scenario generation pipeline provide a directly reusable testbed for iterating multimodal model tool-calling capabilities and validating multimodal agent performance across the full pretraining and post-training pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built as an extension of the text-centric ToolSandbox evaluation framework, the system adds native image processing support and vision-specific tools, supporting both structured tool calling and code execution interfaces. The benchmark covers 511 tools across 16 application domains, with tasks designed along three orthogonal axes: information flow type, conversational challenge type, and image arrival pattern. It includes 258 human-verified scenarios with 1284 curated images, supporting multi-turn, multi-image interactions. An automated scenario generation pipeline uses information-flow-guided planning, environment state instantiation, and multi-stage quality filtering to reduce manual effort from full annotation to targeted review. Evaluation combines deterministic state verification and LLM-based judges, scoring across dimensions including task completion, tool use validity, instruction following, and absence of unintended side effects.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of leading proprietary and open-weight models shows existing models still exhibit clear weaknesses on visual tool-calling tasks: multi-image working memory stands out as a core bottleneck, models of different parameter scales show distinct failure patterns, and significant gaps remain in visual grounding reasoning, multi-step interaction, and stateful tool use.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the three-dimensional task taxonomy in the framework design section and the model failure mode analysis in the experiment section. The benchmark can be directly adopted to evaluate visual tool-calling capabilities of in-house multimodal models. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Apple Machine Learning team

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §benchmark 和 failure analysis；低于 50% 的结果说明 VLM-agent 短板仍在视觉接地精度，不只是规划。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure analysis; the sub-50% result points to visual grounding precision, not just planning, as the VLM-agent bottleneck.

paper.title: Agentic Context Learning with Self-Discovered Specification
paper.abstract: Context learning is an emerging inference-time task where LLMs must learn and apply novel, task-specific knowledge from intricate contexts absent from pre-training; even frontier models score under 24% task success. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to understand why this setting remains difficult. A natural hypothesis is that failures stem from content access; yet across twelve retrieval, reflection, and verification baselines on CL-Bench, an extensive context learning be

summary.core_problem: 上下文学习（context learning）要求 LLM 从长上下文中学习并应用全新的任务特定知识，但前沿模型严格通过率仍低于 24%。传统假设认为失败源于内容检索不足，但实验显示检索、反思、验证等 12 类方法几乎无增益，核心瓶颈实际是「局部规范获取」——模型需要从上下文中发现并遵守查询隐含、低显著度、分散分布的行为约束（格式、边界处理、标签、完整性条件等），而非仅提取与查询相关的事实内容。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：长上下文能力的评测与训练不能只关注内容检索/理解，必须同时覆盖「规范获取」维度。当前预训练数据与目标函数（next-token 预测）对低显著度、分散式约束的学习激励不足，这解释了为何长上下文模型在真实部署中常出现「几乎正确但因细节违规失败」的 near-miss 现象。该结论可直接指导预训练数据构造（增加规范密集型文档）、训练目标设计（强化约束遵守信号）以及长上下文能力评测指标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 首先在 CL-Bench（1899 个长上下文、抗污染任务）上评测 12 种基线方法，覆盖检索与上下文重构、测试时自纠错、自生成规则验证、迭代检索扩展四类，确认内容访问不是瓶颈。随后对 31592 条 rubric 条目做分类，量化规范获取（55.4%）与内容获取（22.6%）的占比，并分析规范的查询隐含性（仅 23.3% 可从查询直接推断，76.7% 仅存在于上下文）与可恢复性（95.5% 可通过显式归纳从上下文中提取）。基于此提出极简干预方案 PSCI（私有规范契约归纳）：四步测试时脚手架——1）从上下文归纳任务特定的规范契约；2）在契约约束下生成答案；3）对抗式检查器对照契约审计草稿；4）修复违规项。整个过程不访问任务公开 rubric。
summary.experiments: 关键结果：1）12 种内容访问导向基线中，最优方法仅比直接全上下文提示基线（22.55% 严格通过率）提升不超过 1 个百分点；2）任务级严格通过率仅 22.55%，但 rubric 条目级通过率达 76.01%，失败多为单条关键规范遗漏的 near-miss；在仅差 1 条 rubric 的失败案例中，75.3% 遗漏的是行为规范而非事实内容；3）PSCI 在 GPT-5.1 上达到 28.14% 严格通过率，相对基线提升 5.59 个百分点（+24.8% 相对提升），在四类任务家族上均有一致增益；在 Qwen3.5-27B 上从 14.14% 提升至 19.42%；4）17 组消融验证了任务特定规范的必要性：打乱契约的 PSCI 低于基线，计算量匹配的通用批评回到基线，答案优先的顺序安排完全失效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：第 3 节 CL-Bench 与 rubric 分类——理解「内容获取 vs 规范获取」的划分依据与量化结果；第 4 节失败分析——看 near-miss 模式与规范的查询隐含性数据；第 5.2 节基线对比与 5.4 节消融实验——确认内容访问方法的失效边界与 PSCI 各组件的贡献。预计阅读时间 50-60 分钟。对预训练研究员，值得深挖的点是：next-token 目标为何对分散式低显著度约束学习不足，以及如何在预训练阶段注入规范遵守信号（而非仅依赖测试时脚手架）。

summary_en.core_problem: Context learning requires LLMs to acquire and apply novel task-specific knowledge from long contexts, yet frontier models still achieve below 24% strict task success. The conventional hypothesis attributes failures to insufficient content retrieval, but experiments show 12 classes of methods spanning retrieval, reflection, and verification deliver almost no gain. The actual bottleneck is specification acquisition: models must discover and comply with query-implicit, low-salience, scattered behavioral constraints (formats, edge-case handling, labels, completeness conditions, etc.) distributed across the context, rather than only extracting query-relevant factual content.
summary_en.importance: Implications for pretraining research: long-context capability evaluation and training cannot focus solely on content retrieval/understanding — specification acquisition must be covered as a separate dimension. Current pretraining data and the next-token prediction objective provide insufficient incentive for learning low-salience, distributed constraints, which explains the pervasive near-miss failure pattern in real long-context deployments (mostly correct but invalid due to minor rule violations). These findings directly inform pretraining data construction (adding specification-dense documents), training objective design (strengthening constraint-compliance signals), and long-context evaluation metric design.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, 12 baseline methods across four families — retrieval & context restructuring, test-time self-correction, self-generated rubric verification, and iterative retrieval scaling — are evaluated on CL-Bench (1,899 long-context, contamination-controlled tasks), confirming content access is not the bottleneck. Next, 31,592 rubric items are taxonomized to quantify the share of specification acquisition (55.4%) versus content acquisition (22.6%), and to analyze query-implicitness (only 23.3% of specs are directly inferable from the query, 76.7% exist only in context) and recoverability (95.5% can be extracted from context via explicit induction). Based on this diagnosis, a deliberately simple intervention called PSCI (Private Specification-Contract Induction) is proposed: a four-step test-time scaffold — 1) induce a task-specific specification contract from the context; 2) generate the answer under contract constraints; 3) an adversarial checker audits the draft against the contract; 4) a repair step fixes violations. The public task rubric is never accessed at any stage.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: 1) Among 12 content-access-oriented baselines, the best method improves upon the direct full-context prompt baseline (22.55% strict pass) by no more than 1 percentage point; 2) Task-level strict pass is only 22.55%, but rubric-item-level pass reaches 76.01% — most failures are near-misses missing exactly one critical item; among failures missing exactly one rubric item, 75.3% miss behavioral specifications rather than factual content; 3) PSCI achieves 28.14% strict pass on GPT-5.1, a +5.59 pp absolute (+24.8% relative) improvement over baseline, with consistent gains across all four task families; on Qwen3.5-27B, it improves from 14.14% to 19.42%; 4) 17 ablations validate the necessity of task-specific specifications: shuffled contracts collapse below baseline, compute-matched generic critique returns to baseline, and answer-first ordering fails entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 on CL-Bench and rubric taxonomy — understand the rationale and quantitative results of the 'content acquisition vs specification acquisition' distinction; Section 4 failure analysis — examine the near-miss pattern and query-implicitness data for specifications; Section 5.2 baseline comparison and 5.4 ablations — confirm the failure boundary of content-access methods and the contribution of each PSCI component. Estimated reading time: 50-60 minutes. For pretraining researchers, a worthwhile direction to dig deeper is why the next-token objective under-learns distributed, low-salience constraints, and how to inject specification-compliance signals during pretraining rather than relying solely on test-time scaffolding.

recommendation.zh: 失败分析有信息量：上下文学习的瓶颈不在检索而在隐式规范提取，对预训练数据设计与ICL机制研究有参考，重点看失败分析章节。
recommendation.en: Informative failure analysis: context learning bottleneck lies in implicit spec extraction, not retrieval. Relevant for pretraining data design and ICL mechanism studies; focus on the failure analysis section.

paper.title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
paper.abstract: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and

summary.core_problem: 现有AI Agent自动失败归因基准仅覆盖文本模态、规模极小（仅184条），且缺乏高质量自动标注的失败轨迹，无法支撑多模态、复杂场景下Agent失败归因能力的评测与研究。
summary.importance: 1）提供大规模多模态失败归因基准，可用于训练和评测具备自我错误诊断能力的Agent基座模型；2）可控错误注入的轨迹构造方法可迁移用于合成预训练/RL阶段的自我改进信号；3）揭示的跨模态、跨协议归因规律为Agent对齐训练的目标设计提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）提出可扩展的自动数据构造管线：先在26个基准、15种Agent框架上生成成功轨迹，再选定步骤注入6类（感知/推理/规划/行动/验证/协同）可控错误，从该步热启动生成失败续篇，注入错误直接作为金标决定性错误；2）构建Who&When Pro基准，覆盖文本、图像、视频3模态、9类任务；3）设计跨模态、跨协议、跨模型家族的归因行为分析框架。
summary.experiments: 基准包含12326条带金标的失败轨迹；实验发现视频模态的错误步骤定位难度最高，多模态轨迹为失败模式诊断提供更强线索；全轨迹归因协议显著优于增量式归因；开源模型作为归因骨干具备不错的性价比表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先级：第3节基准构造管线（重点3.3错误注入流程）→第4节核心实证规律与统计结论，附录可按需查看失败分类体系和基准明细；预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated failure attribution benchmarks for AI agents are restricted to text-only modalities, contain only 184 small-scale instances, and lack high-quality automatically annotated failure trajectories, making them unsuitable for evaluating and researching agent failure attribution in multimodal, complex real-world scenarios.
summary_en.importance: 1) Delivers a large-scale multimodal failure attribution benchmark that supports training and evaluation of agent base models with self-error diagnosis capabilities; 2) The controlled error injection trajectory construction pipeline can be transferred to synthesize self-improvement signals for pretraining or RL stages; 3) Revealed cross-modal and cross-protocol attribution patterns provide empirical guidance for agent alignment training objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Introduces a scalable automatic data construction pipeline: first roll out successful trajectories across 26 benchmarks and 15 agent frameworks, then inject 6 categories of controlled errors (perception/reasoning/planning/action/verification/coordination) at selected steps, and warm-start execution from that step to generate failed continuations, with the injected error directly used as the golden decisive error label; 2) Builds the Who&When Pro benchmark covering 3 modalities (text, image, video) and 9 task categories; 3) Designs an analysis framework for attribution behavior across modalities, protocols, and model families.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 12,326 failure trajectories with golden labels. Key findings include: step localization is particularly challenging for video modality traces; multimodal traces provide stronger cues for failure mode diagnosis; full-trajectory attribution protocols significantly outperform incremental protocols; open-weight models deliver favorable cost-performance trade-offs as attribution backbones.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 (benchmark construction pipeline, focus on §3.3 error injection workflow) → Section 4 (core empirical patterns and statistical conclusions). Appendices can be reviewed on demand for failure taxonomy and benchmark details. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent失败归因基准，失败注入方法学严谨，对做Agent评测或调试系统的人有参考，看基准构造章节即可。
recommendation.en: Rigorously constructed agent failure attribution benchmark with clean failure injection methodology; useful for agent evaluation and debugging systems; read the benchmark construction section.

paper.title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
paper.abstract: Agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous tasks, yet existing evaluations mostly focus on task success rather than whether agents know when to abstain. This gap poses real risks: under ambiguity, conflicting constraints, or tool failures, agents may execute unintended and irreversible actions. To close this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation framework for agentic abstention: the calibrated ability of tool-using LLM agents to recogni

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent评测仅关注任务成功率，未系统评估Agent在歧义、约束冲突、工具失效等场景下的弃权能力（即识别何时不应执行不可逆操作的校准能力），存在明确的安全隐患。
summary.importance: 1）证实Agent弃权能力是与任务求解能力独立的维度，仅靠模型缩放无法自动获得，需在预训练/对齐阶段引入专门的训练信号；2）配对任务的评测设计和自动合成管线可迁移用于构造弃权感知的SFT/RL训练数据；3）提出的执行前/运行时双阶段弃权分类体系为Agent基座的能力建模提供明确的目标维度。
summary.technical_approach: 1）推出首个系统性Agent弃权评测框架AgentAbstain，基于8类弃权场景（4类执行前可识别、4类运行时需通过工具交互发现）构建配对任务；2）每个配对任务共享42类MCP沙箱环境中的一个，仅通过单一可控扰动区分「应执行」和「应弃权」变体，避免恒执行/恒拒绝策略投机取巧；3）设计AbstainGen自动合成管线，通过DAG重放和跨模型校验生成任务，评测结合工具调用轨迹的确定性提交检查与LLM裁判的终端回复判断。
summary.experiments: 对17个前沿LLM、4种Agent框架开展评测，最佳模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro）配对准确率仅59.5%，17个模型中有13个得分低于50%；弃权能力与任务求解能力相关性极低，呈现独立的缩放规律；发现特有的「事后弃权」失败模式：Agent先提交不可逆操作，再声称拒绝执行任务。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先级：第2节评测框架设计（重点配对任务逻辑和8类弃权分类体系）→第4节核心实验结论，第3节自动合成管线可按需查看；预计阅读时间18-22分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluations focus almost exclusively on task success rate, with no systematic assessment of agent abstention capability — the calibrated ability to recognize when irreversible actions should not be executed under ambiguity, conflicting constraints, or tool failures, which creates tangible safety risks in real-world deployments.
summary_en.importance: 1) Verifies that agent abstention capability is a dimension independent of task-solving capability, and cannot be automatically obtained through model scaling alone, requiring dedicated training signals during pretraining or alignment stages; 2) The paired-task evaluation design and automated synthesis pipeline can be transferred to construct abstention-aware SFT or RL training data; 3) The proposed two-phase (pre-execution / runtime) abstention taxonomy provides clear target dimensions for capability modeling of agent base models.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Introduces AgentAbstain, the first systematic evaluation framework for agentic abstention, built on 8 abstention scenarios (4 identifiable pre-execution, 4 discoverable only via runtime tool interaction) with a paired-task design; 2) Each task pair shares one of 42 sandboxed MCP environments, and differs only in a single controlled perturbation to separate should-act and should-abstain variants, which prevents trivial always-act or always-refuse policies from achieving high scores; 3) Designs AbstainGen, a fully automated pipeline for task synthesis via deterministic DAG replay and cross-family LLM validation; evaluation combines deterministic commit checks on tool-call traces with LLM judgment of terminal responses.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 17 frontier LLMs across 4 agent harnesses. The best performing model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) only achieves 59.5% paired accuracy, and 13 of 17 models score below 50%. Abstention capability shows very low correlation with task-solving capability, following an independent scaling pattern. A unique post-hoc abstention failure mode is identified: agents first commit irreversible actions, then claim to have refused the task.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 2 (evaluation framework design, focus on paired-task logic and 8-category abstention taxonomy) → Section 4 (core experimental conclusions). Section 3 (automated synthesis pipeline) can be reviewed on demand. Estimated reading time: 18-22 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent弃权能力评测方向的首个系统性工作，配对设计干净，对Agent安全与校准研究有参考，看评测设计章节。
recommendation.en: First systematic work on agent abstention evaluation with a clean paired design. Useful for agent safety and calibration research; read the evaluation design section.

paper.title: The Compliance Trap: Diagnosing How AI Agents Consume Conflicting Memory
paper.abstract: Memory is becoming a core component of long-horizon AI agents, allowing agents to reuse past experience when operating web browsers, software tools, and other interactive environments. Existing work mostly treats memory as a supply problem, asking what experience to write, how to store it, and which entry to retrieve for the next task. Yet we still lack a clear account of how models consume retrieved memory across a multi-step action trajectory. This consumption process matters because it determ

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 memory-augmented agent 如何消费检索到的记忆，尤其是在记忆与当前任务冲突时，模型是在何处采纳错误信息、错误如何沿轨迹传播，以及是否能自我修正。
summary.importance: 它不是基座预训练方法论文，但对长程 agent 的训练与评测有参考意义。现有 memory agent 研究常把问题放在“写什么、存哪里、检索哪条”上，默认模型会合理使用检索内容。这个假设在长程交互中很脆弱：错误记忆一旦在早期动作中被采纳，后续观察和动作会进入另一条状态分支，简单的最终成功率很难解释失败来自检索、采纳、传播还是恢复能力。E-P-R 把 memory consumption 拆成 Entry、Propagation、Recovery 三个阶段，为训练控制策略、设计拒绝错误记忆的数据、构造 agent 评测协议提供了更细的诊断维度。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是固定 memory 内容，改变 memory 的可见时机，从而把检索质量和模型消费行为分开。memory 内容分为三类：helpful memory 提供任务相关指导，conflicting memory 提供看似合理但任务错误的指导，same-website cross-task control memory 作为内容控制。注入 schedule 分为 early、persistent 和 late：early 只在第一个可影响决策点出现，persistent 在每一步都出现，late 在若干动作之后才出现。E-P-R 三个指标分别对应不同机制：Entry 看记忆是否改变首次暴露后的动作；Propagation 看初始改变在后续步骤是否继续影响轨迹，尤其是在重复暴露下是否被放大；Recovery 看模型偏离后能否回到任务正确路径。这个设计的优点是变量干净：它不把 memory 系统的 retrieval 误差和 LLM policy 的服从倾向混在一起。
summary.experiments: 实验使用两个测试环境。第一个是在 WebArena 上做 paired protocol，保持 memory passage 不变，只改变注入阶段，用 early、persistent、late schedule 粗粒度探测 E-P-R。模型覆盖 Qwen3.5、Gemma4、Gemini-3 三个系列的五个模型。观察到的模式较一致：错误记忆容易在早期进入决策，重复暴露会放大影响，损害主要集中在采纳冲突记忆的轨迹上；一旦轨迹因为错误 memory 分叉，后续恢复困难。作者将这一现象称为 compliance trap。第二个是 MemTrapBench，用更受控的 trap 结构分别测量 uptake、persistence 和 correction，用于验证“首次采纳冲突记忆是最终失败主因”这一机制假设。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整数值表，因此精读时需要重点核对各模型的 entry rate、propagation rate、recovery rate，以及强模型是否只是平均成功率更高但被冲突记忆造成的绝对损害更大。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 supply-side memory 和 consumption-side memory 的区分，这决定了它和 Reflexion、ExpeL、AWM、MemGPT 等工作的差异。再看 Method 里 memory 类型、注入 schedule、E-P-R 指标定义。实验部分优先看 WebArena 的 paired protocol，而不是只看最终成功率；随后看 MemTrapBench 如何把 uptake、persistence、correction 分开。对做 agent 训练的人，更值得关注的是 conflicting memory 样本能否转成拒绝错误上下文的 SFT/DPO/RL 数据，以及 persistent exposure 为什么会让模型更难恢复。

summary_en.core_problem: This work studies how memory-augmented agents consume retrieved memories over a trajectory, especially when the memory conflicts with the current task: where the wrong memory first changes behavior, how that change propagates, and whether the agent can recover.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not about base-model pretraining, but it is useful for agent training and evaluation. Much of the memory-agent literature focuses on the supply side: what to write, how to store it, and which memory to retrieve. This work shifts attention to the policy that consumes the retrieved text. That distinction matters because a plausible memory can still be harmful if the model follows it at the wrong time or repeats it after the state has changed. The Entry–Propagation–Recovery decomposition gives a more informative diagnostic than final success rate. It can guide training data construction for memory rejection, control policies for memory exposure, and benchmarks for long-horizon agent reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method fixes the memory content and intervenes on when the agent can see it. Memory passages are grouped into helpful memories, conflicting memories, and same-website cross-task control memories. Exposure schedules include early injection, persistent injection, and late injection. Entry measures whether the memory changes the first action after exposure. Propagation measures whether the initial change continues to shape later actions, especially under repeated exposure. Recovery measures whether the agent can return to a task-correct trajectory after memory-induced divergence. This design separates retrieval quality from consumption behavior: the retrieved text is held fixed, so failures can be attributed to how the policy uses or overuses the memory.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebArena and a controlled benchmark called MemTrapBench. On WebArena, the authors run a paired protocol where the same memory passage is injected under different schedules. The tested models span five systems from the Qwen3.5, Gemma4, and Gemini-3 families. The reported pattern is consistent: conflicting memories enter early, repeated exposure amplifies their effect, and the damage is concentrated on trajectories that comply with the conflicting memory. Once the trajectory branches because of a wrong memory, recovery is difficult. MemTrapBench is used to validate the same mechanism in a more controlled trap structure by separately measuring uptake, persistence, and correction. The provided text does not include full numeric tables, so the main items to verify in a full read are entry rate, propagation rate, recovery rate, and how these vary with model strength.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should cover the main value. Start with the introduction’s distinction between memory supply and memory consumption. Then read the definitions of memory types, exposure schedules, and the E-P-R metrics. In the experiments, prioritize the paired WebArena protocol over aggregate success rate, then check how MemTrapBench separates uptake, persistence, and correction. For agent-training work, the most useful question is whether conflicting-memory cases can be converted into SFT, DPO, or RL data that teaches the model to reject task-wrong context.

recommendation.zh: 从记忆消费的过程性视角拆解agent行为，E-P-R三阶段框架对理解agent记忆机制有参考价值，重点看框架设计部分。
recommendation.en: Decomposes agent behavior from a processual perspective of memory consumption; the E-P-R three-stage framework is useful for understanding agent memory mechanisms, focus on framework design.

paper.title: WILDTRACE: Benchmarking Natural Evidence Trails in Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Answering complex questions over long documents frequently requires integrating evidence that the source itself disperses naturally across distant passages. In an incident report, the operating condition, design flaw, and missed safety check that jointly explain a disaster may appear dozens of sections apart; in a novel, a character's true motive may surface only through scenes far removed from the moment it becomes relevant. This source-internal evidence integration is central to real-world lon

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的 long-context QA，而是更窄也更难的一类问题：在原始长文档里，证据并不会被任务设计者预先挑出来，也不会以“needle”方式人工插入；模型需要自己在同一文档内部发现分散、同文体、低显著度的关键线索，并恢复这些线索之间的因果、时间、比较、解释或反事实关系，最后给出有根据的结论。作者认为，现有长上下文评测往往把难点拆开测：要么测能不能在长序列里找到插入事实，要么测给定证据后的推理，要么测人为拼接的 multi-hop 链条；但真实分析任务更接近“source-induced evidence trail recovery”，也就是证据发现和关系恢复同时成立。WildTrace 的核心问题就是为这种能力建立一个更干净的评测边界。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练方法，而在于把 long-context 评测里的一个长期混淆点拆清楚了：很多模型在“长上下文”上表现不错，可能只是因为证据被设计得过于显眼、位置受控、词面匹配强，或者支持段落已经被外部检索器预选。WildTrace 试图把这些 construction cue 压低，让评测更接近真实文档分析。对预训练研究员，这类 benchmark 的意义主要有三点。第一，它更适合区分“记忆窗口变长”与“证据组织能力变强”这两件事。第二，它能更真实地暴露模型在 source-grounded reasoning 上的短板，尤其是证据必要性、关系塌缩、局部捷径等问题。第三，它为后续做长上下文预训练、文档级数据构造、过程监督、检索-推理接口设计提供了更可操作的误差分解框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最关键的是 source-first 构造，而不是 question-first。作者从 214 份公开长文档源出发，覆盖技术事故报告和较少被公众熟知的文学叙事。先把每个 source 切成重叠窗口，再把局部上下文转成 evidence record，记录实体、事件、属性、时间标记、引语、局部关系和短摘要等信息。随后把这些 record 连成一个带类型的 source-internal graph；只有当原文局部上下文明确支持两条事实之间的关系时，才加边。接着不是人工随意出题，而是用几类“evidence geometry”在图上挖自然形成的证据轨迹，包括 forward chains、intersections、comparisons、temporal reconstructions、causal fan-in、abductive explanations、counterfactual branches 七类。也就是说，题目先由文档内部结构诱导出来，再由人工写成公开问题、参考答案、关键事实和 rubric。

作者对 benchmark fidelity 的控制做得比较细。候选样本是高召回挖掘出来的，但进入正式集之前要过多道门。四类主要威胁分别是：source grounding、multi-hop necessity、shortcut resistance、answerability。对应地，他们做了 grounding 检查，确保答案、关键事实、证据 span 和评分标准都能被原文支持；做 leave-one-out 和 single-clue ablation，排除掉删去部分证据后仍能唯一作答的伪 multi-hop 样本；做 no-document probe，过滤公共常识或污染导致的无文档作答；还做 evidence-conditioned 检查，验证隐藏 trail 一旦提供，是否足以支持答案。再加上人工审核和外部审计，去掉 unsupported facts、冗余线索、歧义答案和几何类型不匹配的样本。这个流程的重点不是规模，而是尽量把“自然证据链”这个概念落到可验证的数据工艺上。
summary.experiments:
数据构造上，作者从 214 个长文档源中得到 3,506 个带验证跟踪的候选 trail-question artifact，最终公开集保留 481 个任务，存活率 13.7%。这个数字本身说明自然证据链 benchmark 很难做：高召回挖掘不难，难的是把伪多跳、局部捷径、公共知识泄漏和答案歧义清掉。

从全文给出的实验意图看，重点不是刷一个大而全的榜，而是证明现有模型在这种“证据未显式给出”的长文档推理上仍有明显缺口。作者区分了两类能力：一类是 evidence discovery，另一类是 relation recovery。很多模型在给定证据条件下会明显变好，说明瓶颈并不只是推理器不够强，而是先前没能在原文里找到真正 load-bearing 的片段，或者没能保持这些片段之间的依赖结构。消融检查也很关键：如果一个样本在 single-clue 或 leave-one-out 下仍可解，就会被剔除，这使得最终集对“多证据必要性”更严格。由于你给出的全文片段没有完整榜单数字，我不编造具体模型分数；但从构造与验证设计可以明确看出，这个 benchmark 的实验价值主要体现在错误类型分解，而不是单一平均分。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把作者为什么不满意 needle、retrieval-given、reverse-engineered multi-hop 三类评测讲清楚。这里定义了 WildTrace 的真正边界：不是长上下文本身，而是 source-induced evidence trails。然后重点看数据构造流程图和 verification pipeline，尤其是 evidence record、typed graph、geometry mining、promotion gates 这几步。理解这几步后，基本就能判断这个 benchmark 是否真的比现有集更干净。

如果时间有限，优先看三类内容：第一，七种 evidence geometry 的定义和示例；第二，leave-one-out、single-clue、no-document probe 这些 fidelity 检查；第三，模型误差分析里 evidence discovery 与 reasoning failure 的区分。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主要贡献。若你做长上下文预训练或文档级数据合成，值得多看附录里的 annotation rubric 和 rejection case，因为那里最能看出作者如何处理“看起来像多跳、其实不是”的样本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a stricter setting than generic long-context QA: answers must be supported by naturally dispersed, source-internal evidence trails rather than benchmark-inserted facts, pre-selected passages, or reverse-engineered multi-hop chains. The model must discover which ordinary-looking fragments in a long document are actually load-bearing, determine how they relate, and then derive an answer from those relations. The missing evaluation boundary, as framed here, is not long context alone and not multi-hop alone, but full-document reasoning with hidden evidence and source-grounded dependencies.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic. WildTrace helps separate three capabilities that are often conflated: handling more tokens, finding the right evidence, and preserving the dependency structure that makes the evidence jointly sufficient. Existing long-context benchmarks often leak construction cues through inserted facts, lexical overlap, localized support, or externally supplied passages. This benchmark tries to remove those shortcuts. For foundation-model work, that matters because it gives a cleaner target for document-level pretraining, long-context data design, retrieval-reasoning interfaces, and process supervision aimed at evidence discovery rather than answer-only optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central design choice is source-first construction. Starting from 214 public long-form sources, including technical incident reports and lesser-known literary narratives, the authors segment each source into overlapping windows and convert local context into evidence records: entities, events, attributes, temporal markers, quotations, local relations, and short summaries. These records are then linked into a typed source-internal graph, with edges added only when the surrounding text supports the relation.

Benchmark items are mined from this graph using seven evidence geometries: forward chains, intersections, comparisons, temporal reconstructions, causal fan-in, abductive explanations, and counterfactual branches. Only after a natural trail is grounded in the source do the authors write the public question, reference answer, key facts, and rubric. This is a meaningful departure from question-first datasets, where evidence is often assembled around a target answer.

The verification pipeline is also a major contribution. Promotion to the final benchmark is organized around four threats: source grounding, multi-hop necessity, shortcut resistance, and answerability. Grounding checks ensure that answers, evidence spans, key facts, and rubric criteria are all supported by the source. Leave-one-out and single-clue ablations remove items where a proper subset of evidence already determines the answer. No-document probes filter contamination and public-knowledge shortcuts. Evidence-conditioned checks verify that the hidden trail is sufficient when supplied. Human review and external audits further remove unsupported facts, redundant clues, ambiguous answers, and geometry mismatches. The paper is less about scale and more about benchmark fidelity.
summary_en.experiments:
On the construction side, the pipeline starts from 3,506 validation-tracked candidate trail-question artifacts mined from 214 long-form sources, and only 481 tasks survive into the public release, a 13.7% acceptance rate. That low survival rate is informative: naturally occurring multi-hop evidence trails are easy to overgenerate but hard to verify cleanly.

The experimental message is not just that current models struggle, but why they struggle. The benchmark is set up to distinguish evidence discovery from downstream reasoning. Models can improve substantially when the relevant trail is supplied, which suggests that a large part of the failure is not pure reasoning weakness but failure to identify the right source fragments or to preserve the relation among them. The ablation-based filtering is also important experimentally: by rejecting items solvable from a single clue or a reduced evidence set, the final benchmark enforces genuine multi-evidence necessity more strictly than many prior datasets. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete leaderboard tables, so I will not invent model scores; the main empirical value lies in the benchmark design and the resulting error decomposition.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction. It clearly explains why needle-style probes, retrieval-given settings, and reverse-engineered multi-hop datasets are insufficient for this target capability. Then focus on the construction pipeline: evidence records, typed graph building, geometry-based trail mining, and the promotion gates. Those sections determine whether the benchmark is actually measuring what it claims to measure.

If time is limited, prioritize three parts: the definitions and examples of the seven evidence geometries; the fidelity checks such as leave-one-out, single-clue ablations, and no-document probes; and the error analysis separating evidence discovery failures from reasoning failures. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If your work touches long-context pretraining or document-level data curation, the annotation rubric and rejection examples are worth extra attention because they show how the authors operationalize “natural evidence trails” rather than merely naming them.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文的人该看：它不是新方法，但会直接影响你怎么看 needle 类结果；先读任务构造和误差分析，别只看总分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on long context: it will change how much you trust needle-style wins; focus on task construction and failure analysis, not just leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
paper.abstract: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to dec

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 评测大多停留在单视角或弱多视角感知，缺少对模型是否能把多视角观察整合成统一、世界坐标系下 3D 场景表征的诊断。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测工作，贡献在于把“world-centric multi-view integration”单独拎出来测。对做原生多模态预训练的人有价值，因为它测的不是普通图文对齐，而是更接近具身和 3D 理解所需的跨视角一致性能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MultiView-Bench，专门构造需要跨视角聚合信息、并在固定全局坐标系中判断物体关系的任务。设计上刻意区分：单图 2D 关系、3D 空间关系、以及多视角整合，借此定位 VLM 是卡在几何理解本身，还是卡在跨视角记忆与整合。
summary.experiments: 作者系统评测了前沿 VLM，结论是：模型在单图 2D 平面关系上通常表现较强，但在 3D 空间关系和多视角信息整合上明显失效；同时还分析了视觉语言数据中的偏置会如何掩盖真实的空间推理缺陷。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，因此更适合作为诊断基准而非性能论文来读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yale University 和 University of Edinburgh。未见可确认的一线基座模型作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM evaluations mostly test single-view or weak multi-view perception, but do not directly probe whether models can integrate multiple viewpoints into a coherent world-centric 3D representation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. Its value is in isolating world-centric multi-view integration as a distinct capability. For multimodal pretraining researchers, this matters because it targets cross-view consistency rather than generic image-text alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark built around tasks that require aggregating observations across viewpoints and reasoning in a fixed global coordinate frame. The setup separates single-image 2D relations, 3D spatial relations, and true multi-view integration, making failure modes easier to localize.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate frontier VLMs and find a consistent pattern: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but clear weakness on 3D spatial reasoning and cross-view aggregation. They also analyze dataset and prompt biases that can mask genuine spatial reasoning deficits. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact margins, so this is best read as a diagnostic benchmark rather than a performance paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Yale University and the University of Edinburgh. No clearly identifiable foundation-model lab authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练可以记住这个 benchmark，但不必细读正文；价值在于它把“跨视角整合失败”从泛泛空间推理里单独剥出来了。
recommendation.en: Worth bookmarking if you work on multimodal pretraining; the main value is that it cleanly isolates cross-view integration failure from generic spatial reasoning.

paper.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
paper.abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) have made remarkable progress in visual reasoning during the last decade. Most evaluations have used simple scenes (MS-COCO) that do not showcase complex human interactions or behaviors, only a handful of non-curated human descriptions as a benchmark, and have not focused on understanding the model's error types. Here, we introduce the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, containing 100 images depicting complex social interactions/behaviors. We analyze the progres

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM评测多基于MS-COCO等简单场景，缺乏对复杂社会交互场景下模型错误类型随时间演变的系统分析。
summary.importance: 构建复杂社会行为场景评测数据集，系统梳理近十年VLM在场景描述任务上的错误类型演变趋势。
summary.technical_approach: 构建含100张复杂社会交互图像的CSB数据集，对比2017-2025年间发布的9个VLM与人类描述的准确率，将错误拆解为检测、识别、幻觉、场景理解、空间依赖五类进行统计。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖4个早期VLM、5个现代MLLM，以20位人类标注者的描述为参考；初步结果显示VLM在CSB复杂场景上的性能提升幅度大于MS-COCO，不同错误类型的下降速度存在差异；摘要未披露完整量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM evaluations rely heavily on simple scenes like MS-COCO, lacking systematic analysis of how model error patterns evolve over time on complex social interaction scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a complex social behavior evaluation dataset, and provides a longitudinal analysis of VLM error patterns on scene description over the past decade.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs the 100-image Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset; evaluates 9 VLMs released between 2017-2025 against gold-standard human descriptions; categorizes errors into detection, recognition, hallucination, scene understanding, and spatial dependence for statistical analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 4 early VLMs and 5 modern MLLMs, with descriptions from 20 human annotators as reference; preliminary results show larger VLM performance gains on CSB than on MS-COCO, with differing decline rates across error types; full quantitative results are not included in the available abstract.

recommendation.zh: 基于100张图的小规模VLM长期错误趋势分析，样本量有限结论普适性弱，仅需了解其错误分类框架即可，无需细读实验。
recommendation.en: Small-scale (100-image) longitudinal VLM error analysis with limited statistical power; skim the error taxonomy, skip detailed experimental results.

paper.title: OmniMapBench: Benchmarking Visual-Centric Reasoning on Diverse Map Documents
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in LVLMs necessitate robust benchmarks for complex, visually grounded reasoning. A critical limitation is identified in many document understanding benchmarks: visual content is often reducible to text, enabling high performance without genuine visual grounding. To address this limitation, OmniMapBench is introduced to foster visual-centric reasoning for map documents. The benchmark comprises 2,096 manually annotated question-answer pairs across 1,603 map documents from nine

summary.core_problem: 构建一个面向地图文档的 LVLM 视觉中心推理 benchmark，避免模型仅凭 OCR 文本或题目线索取得高分。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 评测资产和评测指标。它指出许多文档理解 benchmark 的视觉依赖不足，并用 Visual Dependency Index 量化图像不可替代性；对多模态预训练的评测设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: OmniMapBench 包含 1,603 份地图文档和 2,096 个手工标注问答，覆盖九类地图，并按感知、定位、关系理解、多步视觉推理等层级设计问题。论文提出 VDI：将图像替换为与问题无关的描述后，观察准确率下降幅度，以衡量任务对真实视觉内容的依赖。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明对多个 LVLM 进行了系统评估，并将 OmniMapBench 与已有 benchmark 的 VDI 比较，结果显示该 benchmark 的 VDI 更高，说明其视觉依赖更强；具体模型列表、分数和提升幅度未在摘要中完整给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory、Zhejiang University 和 Shanghai Innovation Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a map-document benchmark for LVLMs that requires genuinely visual reasoning rather than relying on OCR text or question shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a VLM evaluation asset and a benchmark-level metric. It highlights that many document-understanding benchmarks are partially reducible to text and proposes Visual Dependency Index to quantify how much the image itself matters.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniMapBench contains 2,096 manually annotated QA pairs over 1,603 map documents from nine map categories. The tasks are organized by skill levels from perception to multi-step visual reasoning. The proposed VDI measures the accuracy drop when images are replaced by question-agnostic descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports comprehensive evaluation of multiple LVLMs and shows that OmniMapBench has higher VDI than established benchmarks, indicating stronger dependence on visual evidence. Exact model names, scores, and gaps are not fully specified in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Zhejiang University, and Shanghai Innovation Institute.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 VLM eval 设计备查；重点看 VDI 定义，地图场景偏窄，不足以改训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM eval-design reference; read the VDI definition, but the map domain is too narrow to change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Understanding Axes of Difficulty For Long Context Tasks Via PredicateLongBench
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated rapidly improving long-context capabilities, prompting a wave of benchmarks designed to evaluate them.
