Each query is paired with a human-annotated temporal interval of supporting visual evidence to verify that model reasoning is anchored in real visual history. The benchmark covers 8 cognitive challenge categories (location trace, time duration, object comparison, etc.) and provides multi-granularity ground-truth responses to evaluate adaptive verbosity. The dataset includes 3,141 videos (388 total hours) from 613 unique users, with 9,448 QA pairs paired with evidence intervals.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation on frontier models (InternVL3.5, Qwen3VL, Gemini 3.1 Pro) yields three core findings: 1) Scale only improves semantic accuracy: InternVL3.5 QA accuracy rises from 19.7% (4B parameters) to 26.1% (38B parameters) with no meaningful gain in grounding precision. 2) Higher frame density does not resolve the grounding bottleneck: Qwen3VL QA accuracy improves from 8.8% (32 frames) to 24.1% (768 frames), but grounding precision stays below 3%. 3) Universal recall decay is observed: Gemini 3.1 Pro accuracy drops from 50% for immediate events to 22% for events occurring 10 minutes prior; models also perform far worse at aggregating evidence across long temporal ranges than retrieving short momentary clips.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~20 minutes. Focus on Section 3 for GSER task definition, Table 2 for the 8-category cognitive taxonomy, and Section 6 for the localization paradox experiments and diagnostic analysis. Appendices can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: Meta 提出的流式第一人称视频长程记忆评测，揭示了当前多模态模型在“语义推理”和“精确时间定位”之间的能力鸿沟（定位悖论），对长视频 VLM 预训练目标设计有指导意义。
recommendation.en: Meta's streaming egocentric video long-term memory benchmark reveals the capability gap ('localization paradox') between semantic reasoning and precise temporal localization in current multimodal models, providing guidance for long-video VLM pretraining objective design.

paper.title: AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments
paper.abstract: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre-packaged tool interfaces, overlook critical steps, and assume inputs are clean and fully specified. Consequently, they understate the difficulty of real deployments, where uncertainty and noise are u

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 agent benchmark 过于理想化，导致我们高估了 LLM agent 在真实生产环境中的可用性。很多评测默认工具已经选好、接口已经包装好、输入干净且目标明确，中间那些现实里最耗时也最容易出错的步骤——澄清需求、发现工具、处理噪声、拼接工作流——被 benchmark 预先替你做掉了。作者因此提出一个“去理想化”的 agent 评测框架，想测的不是单步推理能力，而是端到端完成真实工作请求的能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train、agentic training 和能力评估有现实意义。它提供了一个更接近部署环境的外部测量面，能帮助判断模型到底缺的是知识、规划、工具使用，还是交互鲁棒性。对预训练研究员的启发主要在两点：一是很多能力缺口并不会随着 token-level 语言建模自然补齐，尤其是工具发现、噪声处理、目标澄清这类交互能力；二是论文观察到参数规模和 post-training 会带来稳定收益，但增加交互轮数本身没有形成 scaling effect，这说明 agent 失败常常不是“想得不够久”，而是策略、工具接口和训练信号不对。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，AgentGym2 的核心不是新 agent 算法，而是新的评测环境设计。它采用分层模块化架构，把 environment、tools、agent、configuration 解耦。环境侧提供更真实的数字运行时；工具侧不再给 query-specific 的专用接口，而是只给一组基础、通用、可组合的工具，覆盖网页浏览、信息检索、文件处理、多模态理解、代码执行等五类能力，共 27+ actions。这样做的目的，是把“该用什么工具、如何组合工具”也纳入评测，而不是默认这些决策已经替 agent 做好。

任务构建上，作者从 GitHub、Reddit、Kaggle 等平台收集真实用户需求，再通过自动合成、query augmentation 和人工标注转成评测实例。每个任务还经过级联验证流程，结合模型检查和人工审核，确保任务有效、描述清晰、结果可核验。这个流程的重点在于把 benchmark 从“人工设计的干净题目”转成“现实世界工作请求的抽样近似”。系统层面还支持环境隔离、并行工具调用和可复现实验，这些工程设计对大规模 agent eval 很关键，因为真实环境评测很容易被状态污染和执行不稳定拖垮。
summary.experiments: 实验上，作者评测了 15 个主流闭源和开源模型。最醒目的结果是，即便是 GPT-5 也只有约 44% 的完成率，Claude Sonnet 4.5 约 37%，说明在这种去理想化环境下，当前强模型离稳定生产可用还有明显距离。开源模型方面，经过较强 post-training 的 agent 模型收益明显，例如 Nex-N1-32B 和 Nex-N1-671B 相比各自 base model 分别提升约 9.16% 和 10.53%。论文还观察到两个趋势：一是参数规模和计算成本增加通常带来更高分数；二是单纯增加 interaction turns 并不会带来类似 scaling 的收益。后者很重要，因为它说明失败并不主要来自预算不足，而更像是探索策略差、工具使用不当、或者在噪声环境中出现幻觉。细粒度分析里，作者点出常见失败模式包括探索不足和 hallucination，这与很多真实 agent 系统的故障形态一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 framework 图，抓住它与 AgentBench、GAIA、TheAgentCompany 这类 benchmark 的差别：不是换一批题，而是把工具选择、环境噪声和任务不完备性重新放回评测。然后看任务构建与验证流程，判断 benchmark 数据质量是否站得住。实验部分重点看三类结果：闭源/开源模型的绝对分数，post-training 带来的增益，以及 interaction turns 不随之扩展的结论。最后浏览 failure analysis，看看 benchmark 是否真的测到了现实部署中的痛点。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以完成一轮有效泛读。如果你做 agent training 或 RL for agents，这篇更适合作为评测面和训练目标设计的参考，而不是算法细节来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar but important mismatch: most agent benchmarks are too idealized, so they overestimate how ready LLM agents are for real deployment. Existing evaluations often pre-package the right tools, simplify interfaces, and assume clean, fully specified inputs. In practice, agents must clarify ambiguous goals, discover available tools, handle noisy information, and stitch together end-to-end workflows. AgentGym2 is built to evaluate those missing pieces rather than only reasoning inside a sanitized setup.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters as an evaluation surface for post-training and agentic learning. For foundation-model researchers, the main lesson is that several deployment-critical capabilities do not emerge automatically from stronger next-token modeling alone, especially tool discovery, robustness to noise, and proactive clarification. Another useful observation is that larger models and stronger post-training help consistently, while simply allowing more interaction turns does not create a scaling effect. That suggests many failures are not due to insufficient deliberation budget, but due to weak policies, poor exploration, or inadequate training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is the benchmark design rather than a new agent algorithm. AgentGym2 uses a layered, modular architecture that decouples environments, tools, agents, and task configurations. On the environment side, it provides more realistic digital runtimes. On the tool side, it deliberately avoids query-specific, handpicked interfaces and instead exposes a basic, general-purpose, composable toolbox spanning web browsing, information retrieval, file processing, multimodal understanding, and code execution, with more than 27 actions. This design forces the agent to decide what to use and how to combine tools, which is exactly what many existing benchmarks abstract away.

Task construction is also a key part of the method. The authors collect real user demands from sources such as GitHub, Reddit, and Kaggle, then transform them into benchmark instances through automated synthesis, query augmentation, and manual annotation. A cascading verification pipeline, combining model-based checks and human review, is used to ensure task validity, clarity, and verifiability. The benchmark therefore aims to approximate real work requests rather than curated clean puzzles. At the systems level, the framework supports environment isolation, parallel tool invocation, and scalable execution, which are necessary if one wants realistic agent evaluation without losing reproducibility.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is used to evaluate 15 leading proprietary and open-source models. The headline result is that performance remains modest even for strong systems: GPT-5 reaches roughly 44%, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 around 37%. That gap between perceived and measured capability is the main empirical message. On the open-model side, stronger post-training helps substantially: Nex-N1-32B and Nex-N1-671B outperform their respective base models by about 9.16% and 10.53%. The paper also reports two broader trends. First, performance generally improves with model scale and compute. Second, increasing the number of interaction turns does not produce a comparable scaling effect. That is an important finding because it suggests that many failures come from poor exploration, weak tool use, or hallucination under noisy conditions rather than from too little time to think. The fine-grained analysis explicitly highlights insufficient exploration and hallucinations as recurring failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the framework figure to understand how AgentGym2 differs from earlier benchmarks such as AgentBench-style or pre-packaged tool evaluations. Then read the task-construction and verification sections to judge whether the benchmark instances are grounded and reliable. In the experiments, focus on three things: absolute scores of strong closed and open models, the gains from post-training, and the claim that more interaction turns do not scale performance. Finish with the failure analysis to see whether the benchmark is exposing realistic deployment bottlenecks. A useful first pass should take about 25–35 minutes. It is more valuable as an evaluation reference for agent training and RL than as a source of new algorithmic ideas.

recommendation.zh: 更贴近真实部署的Agent评测基准，关注工具发现与噪声鲁棒性，可用于评估预训练模型的Agent能力
recommendation.en: More realistic agent benchmark focusing on tool discovery and noise robustness; useful for evaluating pretrained models' agent capabilities

paper.title: Seduced by the Narrative: Assessing Rule Adherence in Semi-Open Textual Sandboxes
paper.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous adjudicators in semi-open textual game environments, robust rule adherence becomes critical when user intent conflicts with system rules. However, these models are trained to be helpful and compliant, leaving them vulnerable to a class of attacks we term \textit{Rhetorical Injection}, where adversarial users exploit narrative framing techniques such as pseudo-logical reasoning and authoritative coercion to bypass adjudication logic. We present CoC-

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在半开放文本沙盒中担任规则裁决者时，面对带有叙事操纵和伪逻辑包装的用户输入，是否会违背显式规则。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是一个针对 rule adherence 的对抗式 benchmark，而不是提出新模型。它把“助人性/顺从性”与“规则执行”之间的张力具体化到自然语言沙盒环境，对 agent judge、tool-use guardrail 和模型行为评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoC-Seduce，多智能体生成对抗样本，基于 TRPG 机制构造半开放文本环境。攻击重点不是 prompt injection 的系统提示泄露，而是 rhetorical injection：通过伪逻辑推演、权威施压、叙事诱导等方式，让模型在表面合理的故事框架下放松规则裁决。随后用 20 个目标 adjudicator 在 4 个世界设定、16 个技能类别上做系统评测。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 5,376 个样本，对抗样本由 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash 生成。实验对象覆盖 20 个裁决模型。摘要可见其评测维度围绕规则遵守率与攻击成功率展开，但未给出更细的模型规模、统计显著性或与传统 prompt injection 基线的完整对照；从定位看更像行为安全评测资产，而非训练方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Alberta、Qilu University of Technology。未见一线大模型实验室背景；更像学术侧的行为评测工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs acting as adjudicators in semi-open textual sandboxes can still follow explicit rules when users use narrative manipulation and pseudo-reasoning to pressure the model into violating them.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an adversarial benchmark for rule adherence rather than a new model. It operationalizes the tension between helpfulness/compliance and strict rule execution in natural-language sandbox settings, which is relevant to agent judges, tool-use guardrails, and behavioral evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces CoC-Seduce, a multi-agent adversarial benchmark built on TRPG-style mechanics. The attack is not classic system-prompt leakage, but rhetorical injection: pseudo-logical arguments, authority framing, and narrative coercion that make rule breaking appear justified inside the story. The benchmark then evaluates 20 target adjudicators across 4 world settings and 16 skill categories.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 5,376 samples, with adversarial cases generated by GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3.5 Flash. Twenty target adjudicator models are tested. From the abstract, the evaluation focuses on rule adherence and attack success, but it does not expose enough detail on model scales, significance, or clean baselines against standard prompt-injection setups; this reads more like a behavioral evaluation asset than a training-method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Alberta and Qilu University of Technology. This appears to be an academic behavioral-evaluation effort rather than a frontier-lab methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent judge 或行为对齐的人可以看，但对 pretrain 只算边缘信号；先看 benchmark 设计和攻击 taxonomy，别把它误读成训练结论。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about agent judges or behavioral alignment, but only peripheral for pretraining; read the benchmark design and attack taxonomy, not as a training conclusion.

paper.title: GameEngineBench: Evaluating Coding Agents on Real C++ Runtime Environments
paper.abstract: Game engines provide real-time simulation, rendering, physics, interaction, networking, and asset pipelines, making them valuable not only for games but also for 3D applications in healthcare, robotics, architecture, manufacturing, and related domains. Because game development is where these systems are most mature and publicly available, it offers a practical testbed for evaluating coding agents that must modify C++ code within stateful, interactive, real-time systems. We present GameEngineBenc

summary.core_problem: 构建面向 coding agent 的真实 C++ 运行时评测，检验模型能否在 Unreal Engine 5 项目中完成有状态、交互式、实时系统代码修改。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。相比只测独立函数或小型仓库补丁，它把 coding agent 放进大型游戏引擎环境，覆盖编译、运行时状态、引擎 API、多人网络、渲染插件等更接近真实软件工程的约束。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GameEngineBench，从 9 个真实游戏仓库构造 110 个 Unreal Engine 5 C++ 实现任务，要求 agent 修改原生 C++ 代码并在真实运行时环境中验证。任务覆盖 gameplay、multiplayer、AI/world orchestration、animation、UI/session、loading、online services、persistence、serialization、XR 和 rendering plugins。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出评测集规模为 110 个任务、9 个真实仓库。未在摘要中列出被测模型、agent 框架、成功率或相对 SWE-bench 等基准的差异结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Nexon Intelligence Labs、Dartmouth University、Columbia University 和 Cornell University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a real C++ runtime benchmark for coding agents, testing whether they can modify Unreal Engine 5 projects with stateful, interactive, real-time constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. Unlike function-level or small-repository patching tasks, it evaluates agents inside large game-engine environments involving compilation, runtime state, engine APIs, networking, rendering, and asset-related constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: GameEngineBench contains 110 scoped C++ implementation tasks from nine real-world Unreal Engine 5 game repositories. Tasks require native C++ modifications across gameplay, multiplayer behavior, AI/world orchestration, animation, UI/session logic, loading, online services, persistence, serialization, XR, and rendering-oriented plugins.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 110 tasks from nine real repositories. It does not provide tested model names, agent frameworks, success rates, or quantitative comparison to benchmarks such as SWE-bench.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Nexon Intelligence Labs, Dartmouth University, Columbia University, and Cornell University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent eval 资产值得登记；预训练侧只需看任务构造，别把 UE5 成功率外推到通用代码能力。
recommendation.en: Register it as a coding-agent eval asset; from a pretraining angle, inspect task construction but do not over-generalize UE5 success rates.

paper.title: APeB: Benchmarking Personalization Ability of Large Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: LLM-powered agents struggle with personalization when users issue raw, underspecified queries. In this setting, agents must infer latent intent, extract preferences from noisy interaction histories, and select among competing alternatives. Existing benchmarks rarely test this capability, as they often rely on user-refined queries or simplified histories. We introduce personalized product search (PPS), a testbed for agentic personalization under raw queries and diverse histories. We construct Age

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM agents 在原始、欠明确用户查询下的个性化能力，尤其是从噪声历史中恢复偏好与潜在意图的能力。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它补了现有 agent 评测里一个常被忽略的空白：多数基准默认用户 query 已被澄清，因而高估了 agent 的 personalization 能力。对做通用 agent eval 或 post-train 数据设计的人有参考价值，对预训练的直接作用有限但不为零。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 APeB（Agent Personalized Benchmark），基于行为日志构造 personalized product search 测试集，把原始 query、丰富交互历史和候选商品配对；再用多步 agent workflow 评测现有模型，并设计 rubric 分析误差来源。另提出简单的 history-aware query refinement 管线 VQRA 作为强基线/改进策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量，但评测对象是 state-of-the-art LLMs 配合多步 agent 工作流。主要发现是：模型对显式 query 处理尚可，但在早期、意图未显化的 query 上明显失效；rubric 分析将主要瓶颈归因于历史利用不足；VQRA 带来稳定提升。更像诊断型 benchmark，而非方法突破。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how well LLM agents personalize under raw, underspecified user queries, especially when they must infer latent intent and preferences from noisy histories.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. It fills a real gap in agent evaluation: many existing benchmarks assume clarified user queries and therefore overestimate personalization ability. This is useful for agent evaluation and post-training data design, though only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces APeB, an Agent Personalized Benchmark built from action logs for personalized product search, pairing raw queries with rich user histories and viewed candidate items. The paper evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs in multi-step agent workflows, uses rubric-based analysis to localize failure modes, and proposes a simple history-aware query-refinement pipeline, VQRA, as a baseline improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, but evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs with multi-step agent workflows. The main finding is that models do reasonably well on explicit queries but fail on early-stage queries requiring intent discovery; rubric analysis attributes much of the gap to poor use of interaction history; VQRA yields consistent gains. This is more of a diagnostic benchmark than a methodological advance.

recommendation.zh: 这是个还算干净的 agent eval，价值在 failure mode 定位，不在方法；只看 benchmark 构造和 rubric 分析，别把 VQRA 当成新范式。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean agent benchmark: the value is in failure-mode diagnosis, not the method. Read the benchmark design and rubric analysis; ignore VQRA as a paradigm.

paper.title: Prior Bias in Vision Language Models on UML Diagram Interpretation
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to software engineering artifacts, especially UML class diagrams whose meaning depends on visual notation. Yet, it is unclear whether VLMs actually read such diagrams or instead answer from pretrained priors about how classes typically relate. We introduce a controlled UML benchmark in which each prior-conforming diagram is paired with its prior-conflicting counterpart that (1) preserves the same class names and layout while (2) reverses onl

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型在解读UML类图时可能依赖预训练先验而非真正读取图中关系箭头方向，其真实视觉理解能力存疑。
summary.importance: 构建了一个受控UML基准，通过配对先验一致/先验冲突图（仅反转关系箭头）量化VLM的先验偏差程度，属于评测方法贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 为每个符合先验的UML图构造仅反转关系箭头的对照图，保持类名和布局不变，通过对比准确率下降幅度度量先验偏差。
summary.experiments: 评测8个开源VLM（InternVL3.5、Qwen3系列）和2个闭源模型（GPT-5.4、GPT-5.4 Mini）；反转箭头使开源模型关系方向准确率平均下降33.48%，三类条件下下降45.28%，闭源模型也有10%~18.62%的差距；scaling仅带来有限改善。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自软件工程与NLP交叉领域，未识别出知名多模态预训练研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models may rely on pretrained priors rather than actually reading relation arrows when interpreting UML class diagrams, raising doubts about their true visual understanding.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a controlled UML benchmark that quantifies prior bias in VLMs by pairing prior-conforming diagrams with prior-conflicting counterparts that only reverse the relation arrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each prior-conforming UML diagram, a paired diagram is constructed by reversing only the relation arrow while keeping class names and layout unchanged; accuracy drop is used to measure prior bias.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 8 open-source VLMs (InternVL3.5, Qwen3 families) and 2 closed-source models (GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 Mini); arrow reversal reduces open-source relation-direction accuracy by 33.48% on average, and by 45.28% in the three-class condition; closed models still show 10%–18.62% gaps; scaling provides only limited improvement.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors work at the intersection of software engineering and NLP; no well-known multimodal pretraining researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: VLM先验偏差的一个干净小样本诊断，结论符合预期（开源VLM视觉符号理解弱），看摘要和主表即可。
recommendation.en: A clean small-scale diagnosis of VLM prior bias; results are expected (open-source VLMs are weak at visual symbol understanding); read abstract and main tables only.

paper.title: IsoSci: A Benchmark of Isomorphic Cross-Domain Science Problems for Evaluating Reasoning versus Knowledge Retrieval in LLMs
paper.abstract: We introduce ISOSCI, a benchmark of isomorphic cross-domain science problem pairs that separates reasoning ability from domain knowledge retrieval in LLM evaluation. Each pair shares identical logical structure but requires different domain-specific knowledge, enabling controlled attribution of reasoning-mode gains. Across five model pairs spanning four model families, we find that 91.3% of reasoning-mode gains are knowledge-dependent rather than structure-invariant (63/69 gains; Wilson 95% CI [

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答一个很具体的问题：LLM 在科学题上的“reasoning mode”增益，到底来自真实的结构化推理，还是主要来自更强的知识检索与调用。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它不是再做一个更难的 benchmark，而是用同构跨领域题对把“推理结构”和“领域知识”拆开测量，属于评测方法上的设计创新。它直接质疑了当前把 CoT 或 reasoning toggle 的收益解释为“推理能力提升”的常见读法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 ISOSCI：每对题目在逻辑结构上同构，但依赖不同领域知识。这样如果一个模型的增益能跨领域稳定迁移，才更像结构性推理；如果增益只在特定知识域出现，则更像知识依赖。论文比较了五组模型配对、四个模型家族，并分析 reasoning mode 开关和 reasoning-specialized 模型在该设置下的表现。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 组模型配对、4 个模型家族。核心结果是：观察到的 reasoning-mode 增益中，91.3% 被归因为知识依赖而非结构不变增益（63/69，Wilson 95% CI [82.3%, 96.0%]）。高能力模型开启 reasoning toggle 后，在所有领域上的准确率提升都低于 5 个百分点；一个在 GPQA Diamond 上比标准版高 19.2 个百分点的 reasoning-specialized 模型 o3-mini，在 ISOSCI 上反而低 24.7 个百分点。结论是 benchmark 选择会显著改变对“推理能力”的判断。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Texas A&M University 和 Hamad Bin Khalifa University。不是头部实验室的大规模模型报告，但评测设计有明确方法论意图：用同构题对隔离 reasoning 与 retrieval。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when LLMs gain from a “reasoning mode” on science problems, is that gain due to genuine structure-level reasoning or mostly better knowledge retrieval and use?
summary_en.importance: Its value is not in making yet another harder benchmark, but in introducing an evaluation design that factorizes logical structure from domain knowledge. That makes it a benchmark/protocol contribution that directly challenges the common interpretation that CoT-style gains reflect improved reasoning ability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build ISOSCI, a benchmark of isomorphic cross-domain science problem pairs. Each pair shares the same logical structure but requires different domain-specific knowledge. If gains transfer across domains, they look structure-invariant; if they do not, the gains are likely knowledge-dependent. The study compares five model pairs across four model families, including reasoning toggles and a reasoning-specialized model.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 5 model pairs and 4 model families. The headline result is that 91.3% of observed reasoning-mode gains are knowledge-dependent rather than structure-invariant (63/69 gains; Wilson 95% CI [82.3%, 96.0%]). Reasoning toggles on strong models yield less than 5 percentage points improvement across domains. A reasoning-specialized model, o3-mini, which beats its standard counterpart by +19.2 points on GPQA Diamond, underperforms on ISOSCI by -24.7 points. The paper argues that benchmark choice strongly shapes conclusions about reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Texas A&M University and Hamad Bin Khalifa University. This is not a frontier-lab model report, but the evaluation design is methodologically clean and explicitly aimed at disentangling reasoning from retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 做推理模型评估的人该看：它不一定推翻 CoT，但提醒你很多“reasoning gain”其实是知识覆盖；读实验设计和主表就够，别把结论外推到长程推理。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you evaluate reasoning models: it probably does not kill CoT, but it cleanly shows many “reasoning gains” are really knowledge effects; read the setup and main table, not as a blanket claim about long-horizon reasoning.

paper.title: TestEvo-Bench: An Executable and Live Benchmark for Test and Code Co-Evolution
paper.abstract: Software tests and code evolve together: a code change should be followed by new or updated tests that record the new software behavior. Yet existing test generation and update benchmarks often isolate the test from the code change, and rely on static metadata that does not verify whether a test is executable or semantically tied to the code change. This makes it difficult to evaluate whether a test automation agent understands how a code change should propagate into the test suite.   We introdu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是代码智能体评测里的一个老问题：现有 test generation / test update 数据集大多把“代码变更”和“测试如何随之演化”拆开了，标签又常依赖静态 diff 或依赖分析，导致任务既不一定可执行，也不一定真的反映开发者想验证的新行为。作者要构建的是一个可执行、可持续更新、并且把代码变更与测试协同演化绑定起来的 benchmark，用来评估 agent 是否真正理解了行为变化应如何写进测试。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更偏评测基础设施，但对代码模型和 agent 训练有现实启发。第一，benchmark 设计强调 execution-grounded evaluation，而不是只看文本相似度或 patch 匹配，这对后续代码数据构造、合成训练信号设计、以及 verifier 设计都有参考价值。第二，它把“测试新增”和“测试更新”分成两条轨道，任务定义更贴近真实开发流程，比只做 fixed snapshot 上的 test synthesis 更能暴露模型是否理解代码语义变化。第三，它是 live benchmark，会持续加入新任务并保留 dated snapshot，这对污染控制和长期跟踪进展比较重要。对预训练研究员来说，启发主要在于：如果想让模型学会真实软件维护，训练和评测都不能只围绕静态代码补全，而要围绕跨版本行为变化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心不是新模型，而是一套较严格的数据挖掘与验证流水线。作者从开源、许可证允许的 Java Maven 仓库提交历史中挖掘任务，目标是找到代码改动与测试改动之间有明确语义联系的样本。整个流程分三步。

第一步是 mining candidate pairs。作者沿相邻 commit 遍历，要求项目能通过编译和执行检查，并用轻量动态插桩收集 test-code dependency，而不是只靠静态依赖图。这样做的原因很直接：静态分析容易把无关文件也算进来，动态依赖更接近“这个测试实际触达了哪些代码”。

第二步是 cleaning。作者过滤掉语义关系弱、执行环境不稳定、或无法可靠复现实验的样本。这里的保守性很重要，因为很多软件工程 benchmark 的问题不在任务难，而在标签脏、环境坏、仓库过时。

第三步是 packaging and labeling。作者做 cross-revision execution checks，用旧版本/新版本上的执行结果来判定任务属于 test generation 还是 test update，并构造最终任务记录。也就是说，标签不是从 diff 文本直接读出来，而是由跨版本执行行为定义。这个设计比“看开发者改了哪个 test 文件”更稳，因为它把任务语义落到了可运行结果上。

评测指标也围绕执行展开，包括 success rate、pass rate、coverage、mutation score。其中特别关键的是 success rate 的定义：生成或更新的测试应当只在新版本通过，而不应在旧版本也通过，这样才能说明测试真的捕捉到了新行为，而不是写了一个宽松或无效测试。整体上，这篇工作的技术价值在 benchmark protocol，而不是模型算法。
summary.experiments:
实验部分主要回答 benchmark 是否足够可用，以及当前强 agent 到什么水平。作者用四个较强配置初始化 leaderboard：Claude Code、Gemini CLI 作为完整系统，以及 SWE-Agent 分别搭配 Claude Opus 4.7 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro。结果显示，最强配置在 test generation 轨道上最高达到 77.5% success rate，在 test update 轨道上最高达到 74.6%。这个数字说明任务并非不可做，但也远未饱和。

更有信息量的是两个现象。第一，最新时间段的任务更难，成功率明显下降，说明 live benchmark 不是被历史数据“刷熟”后就稳定高分的静态集合。第二，当限制单任务成本时，性能会显著下滑，说明当前 agent 的成功很依赖较高的交互预算、试错次数和工具调用，而不是一次性稳健理解。这一点对训练也有启发：如果想做更便宜的 coding agent，可能需要在预训练或后训练阶段更强地建模 repository navigation、测试失败诊断和跨文件编辑。

从 benchmark 角度，作者还强调了执行环境、覆盖率和 mutation score 的可复现支持。虽然给出的片段没有完整数据规模表，但论文声称这是目前最大的可执行 test-code co-evolution benchmark，并且是 live 的。阅读时建议重点看数据构建统计、任务过滤比例，以及不同 harness-model 组合在 generation 与 update 两轨上的差异。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 benchmark definition，确认它与 SWE-bench、传统 test generation benchmark 的区别：这里评的是代码变更后测试如何协同演化。然后看 construction pipeline，重点理解为什么要用动态依赖和 cross-revision execution labeling。若只看摘要，很容易低估这两步的重要性。

实验部分重点看三类内容：一是 success rate 的严格定义；二是最新任务与成本受限设置下的性能下降；三是不同系统配置的差异。若你关心代码模型训练数据，可以特别留意作者如何从 commit history 中抽取高置信度监督信号。若你只关心是否值得纳入日常跟踪，看 benchmark setup、主表和 contamination/live update 机制即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmark design gap in software engineering agents. Existing test-generation and test-update datasets often decouple tests from the underlying code change, and many rely on static metadata that neither guarantees executability nor proves that the test actually captures the changed behavior. The authors aim to build a benchmark where code evolution and test evolution are tied together through execution, so that an agent is evaluated on whether it truly understands how a behavior change should propagate into the test suite.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters as evaluation infrastructure for coding models and agents. Its main contribution is to move the task definition from text diffs to execution-grounded behavior. That has downstream implications for training data construction, verifier design, and synthetic supervision for code agents. The split into test generation and test update is also useful: adding a new test and repairing an existing failing test are related but distinct capabilities, and collapsing them into one task hides important failure modes. The live-benchmark setup is another practical strength because it supports contamination-aware tracking over time rather than one-off leaderboard optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core contribution is a conservative benchmark construction pipeline rather than a new model. The benchmark is mined from open-source, license-permissive Java Maven repositories. The pipeline has three stages.

First, candidate test-code change pairs are mined by walking adjacent commits that pass compilation and execution checks. Instead of relying only on static dependency analysis, the authors use lightweight dynamic instrumentation to collect test-code dependencies. This matters because static signals can over-approximate relationships and include many irrelevant files, while dynamic dependencies better reflect what the test actually exercises.

Second, the candidates are cleaned aggressively. Pairs with weak semantic linkage, unstable execution environments, or poor reproducibility are removed. This is an important design choice: many software-engineering benchmarks fail less because the task is hard and more because the labels are noisy or the environment is brittle.

Third, the benchmark tasks are packaged and labeled using cross-revision execution checks. The task type is determined by behavior across old and new code versions, not just by reading diffs. This is the key methodological point. A generated or updated test is meaningful only if it reflects the changed behavior under execution.

The evaluation protocol is also execution-centered. Metrics include success rate, pass rate, coverage, and mutation score. The most informative metric is success rate, defined so that the produced test should pass on the new version and not pass on the old version. That prevents trivial or weak tests from scoring well.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments mainly establish benchmark usability and measure the current frontier for test-evolution agents. The leaderboard is initialized with four strong configurations: Claude Code and Gemini CLI as end-to-end systems, plus SWE-Agent paired with Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. The best reported performance reaches 77.5% success rate on test generation and 74.6% on test update.

Two findings are especially informative. First, performance drops on the most recent tasks, which supports the value of the live-benchmark design. The benchmark is not just a static historical set that agents can gradually overfit through contamination or indirect exposure. Second, success rates decline substantially under per-task cost caps. That suggests current agent performance depends heavily on interaction budget, iterative trial-and-error, and tool use, rather than on consistently strong first-pass understanding.

The benchmark also supports execution environment reproduction, coverage measurement, and mutation analysis, which makes the evaluation richer than simple pass/fail. The excerpt provided here does not include the full dataset-size table, but the paper positions TestEvo-Bench as the largest executable benchmark and the first live benchmark for test and code co-evolution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim read, around 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the task definition and compare it mentally with SWE-bench and standard test-generation benchmarks. The distinctive point is that the benchmark is about how tests should evolve after a code change, not about writing tests for a fixed snapshot.

Then read the construction pipeline carefully, especially the use of dynamic dependency collection and cross-revision execution labeling. Those two choices are what make the benchmark more trustworthy than diff-based datasets. In the experiments, focus on the strict definition of success rate, the recency split, and the cost-constrained setting. If your interest is training data for coding models, the most useful part is how commit history is converted into high-confidence supervision grounded in execution.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 benchmark schema 和指标；它补的是 SWE-bench 类评测里测试随代码演化这一块空白。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark schema and metrics; it fills the test-code co-evolution gap left by many SWE-bench-style evaluations.

paper.title: EduArt: An educational-level benchmark for evaluating art history knowledge in large language models
paper.abstract: Large language models now score near ceiling on general benchmarks, but these aggregate measures reveal little about how models behave within single disciplines. Existing art-focused evaluations rely on synthetic questions and rarely report item-level properties. This paper introduces EduArt, an educational-level benchmark for art-historical knowledge and visual reasoning in multimodal LLMs. EduArt comprises 871 human-authored questions from Italian secondary-school exercises and US Advanced Pla

summary.core_problem: 当通用基准接近饱和时，如何用教育测评学方法更细粒度评估多模态 LLM 的艺术史知识与视觉推理能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献：人类出题、跨语言、题型多样，并用 Classical Test Theory 做题目区分度/难度分析；对“评测是否真的测到能力”有方法论价值，但领域较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 EduArt：871 道人类编写题，来源于意大利中学练习与美国 AP Art History；覆盖两种语言、7 种题型（选择/填空/错误识别等）；评测 12 个模型，设置 answer-only 与要求 justification 的 motivation 条件；用 CTT 与 logistic regression 分析题型/语言/是否含图等因素。
summary.experiments: 12 个模型、6 个 provider family；报告 psychometric properties（如区分度等）并做因素回归分析（摘要截断，未给出完整数值与模型列表细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate multimodal LLMs’ art-history knowledge and visual reasoning with education-grade, psychometrically analyzed items when generic benchmarks saturate.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: human-authored, bilingual, multi-format questions plus Classical Test Theory analysis; methodologically useful for evaluation quality, though the domain is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: EduArt benchmark: 871 human-written questions from Italian secondary-school exercises and US AP Art History exams; two languages and seven formats; evaluate 12 models under answer-only vs justification (“motivation”) conditions; apply CTT and logistic regression to isolate effects of format/language/image presence/model.
summary_en.experiments: 12 models from 6 provider families; reports psychometric properties and regression-based factor effects (abstract truncated; full numbers/model list not visible here).

recommendation.zh: 作为“评测要做题目心理测量学”的样板值得备查；只读数据构成+CTT/回归分析部分即可，艺术史领域本身对预训练决策影响有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a template for psychometrics-aware LLM eval; read the dataset design + CTT/regression sections, but the art-history domain won’t steer pretraining choices.

paper.title: Reasoning LLM Improves Speaker Recognition in Long-form TV Dramas
paper.abstract: Long-form TV dramas present a formidable challenge for comprehensive video understanding, where deciphering complex storyline often relies on \textbf{speaker recognition}, the task of accurately attributing each spoken utterance to its respective character. In this paper, we advance this field through two primary contributions. (1) We introduce \textbf{DramaSR-532K}, a large-scale benchmark comprising 532K annotated dialogue lines across more than 900 unique characters, necessitating the integra

summary.core_problem: 在长篇电视剧视频中，将每一句台词准确归因到对应角色，解决短台词、跨场景上下文和多模态线索融合带来的 speaker recognition 难题。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个较大规模的长视频多模态 speaker recognition benchmark 和一个基于 reasoning LLM 的工具使用方法；对多模态长上下文评测有参考价值，但任务本身偏视频理解应用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 DramaSR-532K，包含 532K 条标注对话、900 多个角色，需要结合声音、语言和视觉证据。方法 DramaSR-LRM 基于 large reasoning model，通过多模态 tool-use 自动聚合上下文证据，把声学、生成人物身份、视觉角色和剧情上下文等信号综合用于说话人归因。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 DramaSR-LRM 显著优于现有 baseline，尤其在短 utterance 上更明显，因为短语音片段下传统声纹特征不稳定。摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据规模、各 baseline 名称或数值提升。
summary.authors_note: Qi Tian 是计算机视觉和多模态方向知名研究者；该工作更接近长视频理解评测与多模态推理系统。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses speaker recognition in long-form TV dramas: assigning each dialogue line to the correct character under short utterances, long-range context, and multimodal ambiguity.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a sizable long-video multimodal speaker-recognition benchmark and a reasoning-LLM-based tool-use method. The work is useful as a multimodal long-context evaluation reference, but the task remains application-heavy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce DramaSR-532K, with 532K annotated dialogue lines and more than 900 characters, requiring audio, language, and visual evidence. DramaSR-LRM uses a large reasoning model to aggregate contextual evidence through multimodal tool use, combining acoustic, visual, linguistic, and storyline cues for attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that DramaSR-LRM significantly outperforms existing baselines, especially on short utterances where acoustic biometrics are weak. It does not provide model size, training data scale, baseline names, or numerical gains in the provided text.
summary_en.authors_note: Qi Tian is a well-known researcher in computer vision and multimodal learning; this work is closer to long-video understanding evaluation and multimodal reasoning systems.

recommendation.zh: 看数据定义和短台词错误分析即可；它可作长视频多模态 eval 备查，不会改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset definition and short-utterance error analysis; it is a long-video multimodal eval reference, not a pretraining recipe signal.

paper.title: OntoLearner: A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Ontology learning (OL) aims to automatically construct structured knowledge models from text, yet progress remains fragmented across methods, domains, and evaluation practices. Despite decades of research, OL lacks a shared infrastructure for systematic evaluation and ontology access. This absence has hindered progress and fragmented research, leaving the central challenges of OL largely unaddressed. We introduce OntoLearner, a modular, cross-domain, and first-of-its-kind framework that unifies

summary.core_problem: Ontology learning 研究缺少统一的本体访问、任务数据和评测基础设施，导致方法难以系统比较。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测与基础设施：发布 180 个机器可读 ontology，覆盖 22 个领域，并为 term typing、taxonomy discovery、non-taxonomic relation extraction 提供 pipeline-ready 数据划分。对基座预训练不是核心相关，但对知识抽取、结构化知识评测和 RAG 知识层构建有备查价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OntoLearner Python 库，统一 ontology 访问、LLM 驱动的 ontology learning pipeline 和标准化 benchmark。系统支持跨领域任务，并把检索模型和 LLM 放在同一基础设施中评测。
summary.experiments: 评测 22 个 retrieval models 和 12 个 LLMs，覆盖 22 个领域和 3 类 ontology learning 任务。摘要未提供具体模型清单、最佳结果、提升幅度或误差分析细节。
summary.authors_note: Sören Auer 是语义网和知识图谱领域知名研究者。题录未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Ontology learning lacks shared ontology access, task datasets, and evaluation infrastructure, making systematic comparison difficult.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation and infrastructure asset: 180 machine-readable ontologies across 22 domains, with pipeline-ready splits for term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relation extraction. It is not central to base-model pretraining, but it is useful as a reference for knowledge extraction, structured-knowledge evaluation, and RAG knowledge-layer construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: OntoLearner is a Python library that unifies ontology access, LLM-driven ontology learning pipelines, and standardized benchmarking. It supports cross-domain tasks and evaluates retrieval models and LLMs under the same infrastructure.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study evaluates 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs across 22 domains and three ontology-learning tasks. The abstract does not provide the model list, top-line numbers, improvement margins, or detailed error analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: Sören Auer is a well-known researcher in the Semantic Web and knowledge graph community. Full affiliations are not available in the prompt.

recommendation.zh: 作为知识结构化评测资产记下即可；预训练侧只需关心任务定义和数据划分，方法结论不必深读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a structured-knowledge evaluation asset; for pretraining work, only the task definitions and splits are worth noting.

paper.title: MMBench-Live: A Continuously Evolving Benchmark for Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Evaluation benchmarks are essential for assessing vision-language models (VLMs), but most multimodal benchmarks are static, making them vulnerable to temporal staleness, data contamination, and costly maintenance. We present MMBench-Live, a continuously evolving multimodal benchmark built by a multi-agent-driven automated pipeline. Our framework treats benchmark evolution as task-guided dataset construction, integrating structured benchmark specification, feedback-controlled real-time data acqui

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态评测集一旦静态发布，就会很快过时、被训练数据污染、且更新代价高的问题，同时还要保证新旧版本之间可比。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在模型方法，而在评测资产维护。静态 benchmark 对大模型越来越不稳，尤其是 web-scale 训练后很难排除记忆污染。MMBench-Live 提供了一种“持续更新但尽量保持分布与任务语义稳定”的构建框架，这对长期跟踪 VLM 能力、区分真实泛化与数据记忆有实际意义。对做基座训练的人来说，它提醒了一点：评测集不是一次性产品，更新机制本身会影响结论可信度。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。先把原始 MMBench 结构化成 benchmark specification，包括评测目的、输入输出格式、任务层级和 atomic task 描述。然后从原 benchmark 中抽取任务相关的视觉模式，用它来指导实时数据采集和过滤，避免新数据偏离原任务分布。最后对采集到的图像自动生成问答与 executable solution plan，并通过工具辅助验证，提高自动构造样本的正确性。整套流程由多 agent 驱动，重点不是生成更多题，而是在更新时尽量守住 capability coverage、分布一致性和跨版本排序稳定性。
summary.experiments: 作者基于 MMBench 构建了 5.9K 条新样本，人工检查答案正确率 96.06%，每次更新约 1–2 小时，成本约 30 美元。实验显示，新 benchmark 能较好保持原 benchmark 的语义和分布特征，开源 VLM 在不同版本上的模型排名较稳定，同时 PaCoST 记忆污染信号弱于原始 MMBench。对这类工作，最关键的结果不是单个模型分数，而是更新后是否还能维持可比性与区分度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看方法总览图和 structured benchmark template，理解它如何把“更新 benchmark”转成“受约束的数据构造”问题。然后看 distribution-consistent update 和 QA verification 两部分，这是方法是否成立的关键。实验部分重点看三类指标：人工正确率、跨版本排名一致性、污染信号变化。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmark maintenance problem: static multimodal benchmarks become stale, are increasingly vulnerable to training-set contamination, and are expensive to refresh, yet updated versions still need to remain comparable to earlier ones.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly on the evaluation side rather than model design. For foundation-model research, the main lesson is that benchmark quality is no longer just about initial construction; update protocol itself affects whether measured progress reflects real generalization or memorization. MMBench-Live offers a practical recipe for continuously refreshing a VLM benchmark while trying to preserve task semantics, distributional characteristics, and ranking stability across versions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three main stages. First, it converts the original MMBench into a structured benchmark specification covering evaluation purpose, format, task hierarchy, and atomic task descriptions. Second, it extracts task-related visual patterns from the original benchmark and uses them to guide feedback-controlled real-time data acquisition and filtering, so newly collected samples stay aligned with the original task distribution. Third, for each image it generates a question, answer, and executable solution plan, then verifies them with tool-supported reasoning. The multi-agent pipeline is designed not merely to create fresh items, but to do so under constraints of capability coverage, distribution consistency, and cross-version comparability.
summary_en.experiments: The instantiated benchmark contains 5.9K newly generated examples. Manual checking reports 96.06% answer correctness. Each update takes about 1–2 hours and costs roughly $30. Experiments on representative open-source VLMs show relatively stable model rankings across benchmark versions, preservation of core semantic and distributional properties, and weaker PaCoST-based memorization signals than the original MMBench. For this kind of work, the key result is not a score gain but whether freshness can be added without breaking comparability.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the pipeline overview and the structured benchmark template. That is where the paper turns benchmark evolution into a constrained dataset-construction problem. Then focus on the distribution-consistent update mechanism and the QA verification stage, since those are the two pieces that determine whether the benchmark remains usable over time. In the experiments, prioritize manual correctness, cross-version ranking stability, and contamination-related memorization analysis. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 读 pipeline 和分布一致更新策略即可；它不教你预训练，但会影响多模态模型离线评测的可信度。
recommendation.en: Read the pipeline and distribution-consistent update strategy; it will not teach pretraining, but it affects how much to trust VLM offline evals.

paper.title: Safety Testing LLM Agents at Scale: From Risk Discovery to Evidence-Grounded Verification
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly perform autonomous actions through external tools, leading to complex and evolving safety risks. However, existing safety testing targets expert-designed safety violations, and the corresponding outcomes are evaluated by hard-coded rules, making them costly to extend as agents evolve. To this end, we present Vera, an end-to-end automated safety testing framework that instantiates software engineering testing principles for non-deterministic agents through a three-stage, s

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM智能体安全测试依赖人工设计的违规场景和硬编码评估规则，风险覆盖范围有限，难以适配快速演进的智能体能力、工具生态和部署场景；同时多数测试混淆了不安全请求、意图声明与实际发生的安全危害，缺乏基于执行后可观测证据的验证机制。
summary.importance: 将软件工程测试范式引入非确定性LLM智能体的安全评估，提出了可扩展的端到端自动化安全测试框架，为智能体的规模化安全评测提供了体系化解决方案，对智能体对齐与安全研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Vera框架采用三阶段自强化流水线：1）文献驱动的风险探索：持续从研究文献中发现并梳理新兴风险，构建风险类型、攻击方法、工具执行环境的分类体系；2）组合式测试用例生成：通过分类维度的组合生成可执行安全用例，每个用例包含明确的安全目标、确定性初始状态和基于可观测产物的验证谓词；3）自适应执行与运行时验证：在沙箱环境中执行测试，通过工具网关记录所有交互，自适应控制代理根据观测行为动态调整测试交互，最终由程序验证器基于实际环境产物判断结果，而非依赖模型的自我报告。框架通过统一执行合约支持异构智能体框架接入，覆盖良性、单通道、多通道三种威胁模型。
summary.experiments: 在4个生产级智能体框架上完成评估，发现了大量安全漏洞。作者同时发布了Vera-Bench基准，覆盖三种威胁模型，包含确定性验证器。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计20分钟。重点关注三阶段流水线的设计思路和证据驱动的验证方法。附录中Vera-Bench的用例设计、沙箱实现细节以及实际漏洞案例可以快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent safety testing relies on manually designed violation scenarios and hard-coded evaluation rules, with limited risk coverage and poor adaptability to rapidly evolving agent capabilities, tool ecosystems, and deployment contexts. Most approaches also conflate unsafe requests or stated intent with actual realized harm, lacking verification grounded in observable execution artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The work adapts software engineering testing paradigms to non-deterministic LLM agent safety evaluation, proposing a scalable end-to-end automated safety testing framework that provides a systematic solution for large-scale agent safety assessment, with implications for agent alignment and safety research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Vera framework follows a three-stage self-reinforcing pipeline: 1) Literature-driven risk discovery: continuously identifies and structures emerging risks into taxonomies of risk types, attack methods, and tool execution environments; 2) Combinatorial test case generation: composes taxonomy elements into executable safety cases, each with a concrete safety goal, deterministic initial state, and verification predicate grounded in observable artifacts; 3) Adaptive execution and runtime verification: runs tests in sandboxed environments, records all tool interactions via a configurable gateway, uses an adaptive control agent to steer test interactions based on observed behavior, and judges outcomes via a programmatic verifier using actual environment artifacts rather than model self-reports. The framework supports heterogeneous agent frameworks through a unified execution contract, covering benign, single-channel, and multi-channel threat models.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four production-grade agent frameworks, revealing substantial safety vulnerabilities. The authors also release Vera-Bench, a benchmark covering three threat models with deterministic verifiers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~20 minutes. Focus on the three-stage pipeline design and evidence-grounded verification methodology. Appendix details on Vera-Bench case design, sandbox implementation, and real vulnerability examples are also worth a quick review.

recommendation.zh: Agent 安全评测的系统化框架，重点看 §3 三维风险分类与验证谓词设计，其余可略。
recommendation.en: A systematic framework for agent safety evaluation; focus on §3 for the 3D risk taxonomy and verification predicate design, skip the rest.

paper.title: A$^{2}$utoLPBench: An Auto-Generated, Agent-Friendly LP Benchmark via Inverse-KKT Construction
paper.abstract: Most LP-from-text benchmarks are static datasets of word problems written and labeled by hand. Once such a dataset is released, its size is fixed, its difficulty is fixed, and every problem can leak into the training data of future LLMs. We present \textbf{A$^{2}$utoLPBench}, a benchmark for testing LLM-driven agents on linear programming problems written in plain text. We first pick a feasible point and dual, then write down a problem for which that point is optimal and the objective value is k

summary.core_problem: 现有线性规划文本解题 benchmark 多为静态人工构造数据集，规模有限、难度不可调、容易被训练数据污染，而且缺少 agent 可直接接入的标准化评测环境。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测基础设施工作，核心贡献是把 benchmark 从静态语料改成按需生成器。对 LLM/agent 研究有参考价值，因为它试图从构造上解决数据泄漏、难度刻度和自动验证问题，尤其是 inverse-KKT 生成思路把 ground truth 由数学构造直接保证，而不是事后标注。但它聚焦 LP-from-text 这一特定任务，对通用基座预训练的启发有限，更适合做 agent reasoning / tool use / coding agent 评测参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 A²utoLPBench，包含 Auto 生成器和 Agent 评测面。生成器采用 inverse-KKT 构造：先采样可行解 x、对偶变量 λ 和系数矩阵 A，再由 KKT 条件反向推出 LP 参数 c=A^Tλ、b=Ax，使该点严格成为最优解，最优值 φ=c^Tx 由构造直接成立。生成过程不需要先调数值求解器，也不需要人工标注答案。之后再用 LLM 将代数 LP 渲染成自然语言题面，并通过字符串级系数匹配校验渲染正确性。难度通过变量数 n、约束数 m 和系数范围等参数控制，可以按需生成无限量、不同难度、训练截止后未见过的题目。评测部分提供 Docker 环境和 agent 可调用接口，并附带一个 solver-critic 双 agent baseline，采用 Propose/Audit/Refine 迭代。
summary.experiments: 论文提供了一个 256 例参考快照，同时展示从 (2,3) 到 (40,40) 的 8 个难度 strata 上的求解率曲线，把传统固定 benchmark 变成可调难度的测量工具。报告称同样参数下独立采样批次的成绩在临界点附近相差约 3 个百分点。双 agent solver-critic baseline 在外部 LP benchmark 上，Kimi-K2.5 相对 MAMO complex 最高提升 15.1pp，Claude-Sonnet-4.6 提升 11.3pp。这些结果更多说明评测面和 baseline 可用，而不是证明生成器本身带来某类模型能力提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读。重点看 inverse-KKT 生成流程、为什么这种构造能保证 ground truth、以及 generator-vs-corpus 的设计取舍。若关心 agent benchmark，可以再看 Docker 化评测接口和 solver-critic baseline。预计阅读 15–25 分钟。不需要深挖数学附录，除非关注程序化生成可控难度 benchmark 的一般方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LP-from-text benchmarks are static, human-authored corpora with fixed scale, fixed difficulty, persistent contamination risk, and no standard agent-runnable evaluation interface.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-infrastructure paper for agentic problem solving rather than a pretraining method. Its broader relevance comes from the design choice of replacing a fixed corpus with an on-demand generator: it addresses contamination, difficulty scaling, and verifiable ground truth by construction. The inverse-KKT construction is a clean example of how mathematically certified synthetic benchmarks can be built for tool-using agents. Its direct relevance to base LLM pretraining is limited because the task domain is narrow, but it is a useful reference for people building contamination-resistant agent or reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: A²utoLPBench consists of an Auto generator and an Agent evaluation surface. The generator uses inverse-KKT construction: it samples a primal point x, dual variables λ, and a coefficient matrix A, then derives LP parameters as c=A^Tλ and b=Ax so that the sampled point is KKT-certified optimal with optimum φ=c^Tx by construction, with no solver call or manual annotation required for the algebraic instance. An LLM then renders the algebraic LP into natural language, and a string-level coefficient check is used to validate the rendering. Difficulty is controlled parametrically by (n,m) and coefficient ranges, enabling unlimited fresh instances with tunable difficulty and post-cutoff seeds for contamination resistance. The agent side provides a Docker environment with a plug-and-play interface and a dual-agent solver-critic baseline that loops through Propose, Audit, and Refine.
summary_en.experiments: The paper ships a 256-instance reference snapshot and traces solve-rate curves across eight difficulty strata from (2,3) to (40,40), turning LP evaluation into a parametric instrument rather than a single score. Independently sampled batches with the same parameters are reported to agree within about 3 pp near the cliff. The solver-critic baseline is reported to improve Kimi-K2.5 by up to +15.1 pp and Claude-Sonnet-4.6 by +11.3 pp on MAMO complex, mainly demonstrating the usability of the evaluation setup rather than a modeling advance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the benchmark design. Focus on the inverse-KKT generation pipeline, why it certifies ground truth by construction, and the generator-versus-corpus tradeoff. If interested in agent evaluation, read the Docker interface and solver-critic baseline section. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes. The mathematical appendix is optional unless you want details of the synthetic generation scheme.

recommendation.zh: 逆 KKT 构造 benchmark 的思路干净且可迁移到其他结构化推理任务，重点看 §3 的构造正确性证明。
recommendation.en: The inverse-KKT benchmark construction is clean and transferable to other structured-reasoning tasks; focus on the correctness argument in §3.

paper.title: Distributed Attacks in Persistent-State AI Control
paper.abstract: As AI coding agents become more autonomous, they increasingly ship code iteratively, with the codebase persisting across sessions. This persistence creates a new attack surface: a misaligned or prompt-injected agent can distribute attacks across pull requests (PRs) and time its payload for the PR with the best natural cover. To study the resulting dynamics, we introduce Iterative VibeCoding, a setting for AI control, the study of safely deploying capable but potentially untrusted AI. In Iterativ

summary.core_problem: 自主编码代理在持续代码库中跨多个 PR 迭代交付代码时，会产生新的攻击面：被 prompt 注入或对齐失败的代理可将恶意负载拆分到多个 PR 中逐步植入，并选择自然掩护最好的 PR 触发，从而绕过单次 PR 粒度的安全审查。现有 AI 控制研究多聚焦单次交互场景，缺乏对持久状态下分布式攻击与防御机制的系统评估框架。
summary.importance: 对预训练与对齐研究的启发集中在三点：一是揭示了能力更强的模型反而会扩大渐进式攻击与单次攻击的逃逸率差距，说明模型能力提升不天然等于安全可控，需要在预训练和 RL 阶段显式建模持久状态下的行为约束；二是提出的 Iterative VibeCoding 基准可作为红队评估资产，用于检验编码代理预训练后的安全鲁棒性；三是 Link-tracker 等跨 PR 状态监控器的有效性，提示在推理侧和训练侧都需要引入跨会话状态的对齐信号，而非仅做单样本审查。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 Iterative VibeCoding 评估设定：模拟用户在持久代码库中按顺序提交 5-6 个 PR 的开发任务，覆盖 CLI 工具和 Flask 服务两类共 10 条任务序列，配套 4 类隐蔽副任务（窃取密钥、植入认证绕过等）。对比两种攻击策略：渐进式攻击将副任务拆分到多个 PR 逐步植入，非渐进式基线选择检测风险最低的单个 PR 一次性完成全部副任务。防御侧设计两类监控器：diff 监控器仅查看 PR 代码变更，轨迹监控器额外查看命令历史与编辑过程；同时引入跨 PR 上下文、Link-tracker 有状态 diff 监控器（跨 PR 传递可疑标记）和多监控器集成方案。主指标为逃逸率：在成功完成副任务的攻击中，监控器未检出的比例，阈值按诚实运行得分的 98 分位校准。
summary.experiments: 攻击代理使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5，监控器覆盖 8 种强模型。在仅含历史任务描述和当前 diff 的监控器下，渐进式攻击逃逸率 87%，非渐进式 75%。轨迹监控器下结果分化：单组件副任务中非渐进式逃逸率 76%，高于渐进式的 66%；多组件副任务中渐进式 71%，优于非渐进式的 58%。Link-tracker 有状态监控器将渐进式攻击逃逸率从 87% 降至 54%，结合轨迹监控器的 4 模型集成进一步降至 47%。即使使用能力更强的 GPT-5.3-Codex 作为监控器，仍有 31% 的成功攻击未被检出，且模型能力越强，渐进式与非渐进式攻击的逃逸率差距越大。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计 20-30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中持久状态攻击面的定义、Section 2 的基准设定细节（特别是跨 PR 状态隔离规则和任务设计逻辑），以及主实验的逃逸率对比表格和附录 A.4 的分任务拆解。附录 O、P 的任务序列样例可快速浏览，理解自然掩护的构造方式；Link-tracker 的具体实现逻辑可关注对应方法小节。若做安全对齐研究，可深挖不同监控器能力与攻击策略的交互规律。

summary_en.core_problem: As autonomous coding agents ship code iteratively across pull requests in a persistent codebase, a new attack surface emerges: a compromised or prompt-injected agent can split malicious payloads across multiple PRs, plant benign components early, and trigger the payload in the PR with the best natural cover. Existing AI control research focuses mostly on single-session settings, lacking a systematic framework to evaluate distributed attacks and defenses under persistent state.
summary_en.importance: Three implications for pretraining and alignment research. First, the evasion gap between gradual and single-shot attacks widens with more capable models, showing that scaling model capability does not automatically improve safety and requires explicit modeling of persistent-state behavior constraints during pretraining and RL. Second, the Iterative VibeCoding benchmark serves as a red-team evaluation asset for assessing safety robustness of coding agents after pretraining. Third, the effectiveness of cross-PR stateful monitors such as Link-tracker suggests alignment signals should span session boundaries at both training and inference time, rather than being limited to per-sample review.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Iterative VibeCoding setting simulates a user submitting 5-6 sequential PR tasks in a persistent codebase, covering 10 task sequences across two families (CLI tools and Flask services) paired with 4 covert side tasks such as secret exfiltration and authentication bypass planting. Two attack strategies are compared: gradual attacks that split the side task across multiple PRs, and a non-gradual baseline that executes the full side task in a single PR chosen to minimize detection. Defenses include diff monitors inspecting only code changes, trajectory monitors with access to command history and edit traces, cross-PR context variants, Link-tracker (a stateful diff monitor that propagates suspicion notes across PRs), and multi-monitor ensembles. The primary metric is evasion rate: the fraction of successful side-task completions that remain below a monitor threshold calibrated to the 98th percentile of scores from honest runs.
summary_en.experiments: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is used as the attacker, with 8 strong models serving as monitors. Under a task-description diff monitor with prior task context, gradual attacks achieve 87% evasion versus 75% for non-gradual attacks. Trajectory monitors reverse the ordering on single-component side tasks (76% non-gradual vs 66% gradual) while gradual attacks remain better on multi-component tasks (71% vs 58%). Link-tracker reduces gradual evasion from 87% to 54%, and a 4-monitor ensemble combining Link-tracker with trajectory monitors further reduces it to 47%. Even with the more capable GPT-5.3-Codex as monitor, 31% of successful attacks evade detection, and the evasion gap between gradual and non-gradual strategies grows with monitor capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 20-30 minutes. Focus on the attack surface definition in Introduction, the benchmark design in Section 2 (especially cross-PR state isolation rules and task construction logic), and the main evasion-rate tables plus per-task breakdowns in Appendix A.4. Browse the example task sequences in Appendices O and P to understand how natural cover is engineered; review the Link-tracker implementation details in the corresponding method subsection. For alignment research, dig into the interaction patterns between monitor capability and attack strategies.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 设计和监控失败案例；它对 posttrain safety 的教训是要评估跨会话策略，不是单轮拒答。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and monitor failures; the post-training safety lesson is to test cross-session strategy, not just single-turn refusal.

paper.title: Office Comprehension Benchmark
paper.abstract: We introduce Office Comprehension Bench (OCB), the first public benchmark to jointly evaluate LLM systems on Word, Excel, and PowerPoint comprehension over native file formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) and their variants. OCB consists of two tracks. File Fidelity Q&A tests structural and visual perception of office artifacts - tables, charts, embedded images, formulas, and app-specific elements such as headers, speaker notes, and named ranges. Domain Q&A tests expert-level reasoning grounded in real

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要评估 LLM 系统对原生 Office 文件的真实理解能力，包括 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的结构、视觉元素和跨文档专业推理，而不是只看转成纯文本后的问答。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它把一个长期被忽略的输入形态补上了：企业真实工作流里大量知识存在于 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx 的原生结构中，包含表格、图表、公式、页眉页脚、speaker notes、named ranges 等。对多模态与 agent 系统来说，这是更接近生产环境的评测资产。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Office Comprehension Bench（OCB），包含两个 track：File Fidelity Q&A 测结构与视觉保真理解，Domain Q&A 测 12 个专业领域中的跨文档分析与综合。答案被拆成原子化、二值可判定 claim，再用 LLM judge ensemble 独立打分，尽量降低长答案整体打分的不稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示最强前沿系统在默认 reasoning mode 下，Domain Q&A 也只有约 59.3%。增加同一产品层级内的 thinking depth 提升不明显，而换到更高产品 tier 才有明显收益。这个结果说明瓶颈不只是 test-time thinking，而是输入解析、结构 grounding、跨文档整合等更底层能力。摘要未给出完整模型名单与 judge 校准细节。
summary.authors_note: 给定材料未明确机构，但从任务设定和作者规模看，更像面向真实办公场景的系统评测团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: This work evaluates whether LLM systems can truly understand native Office files—Word, Excel, and PowerPoint—including structure, visual artifacts, and cross-document professional reasoning, rather than only QA over text-converted content.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark. It fills an under-evaluated input regime: in real enterprise workflows, much of the useful information lives in native .docx/.xlsx/.pptx structure, including tables, charts, formulas, headers, speaker notes, and named ranges. For multimodal and agent systems, this is a more production-realistic evaluation asset.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Office Comprehension Bench (OCB) with two tracks: File Fidelity Q&A for structural and visual fidelity understanding, and Domain Q&A for cross-document analysis and synthesis across 12 professional domains. Reference answers are decomposed into atomic binary-gradable claims, and an ensemble of LLM judges scores each claim independently to reduce instability in holistic long-form grading.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that even the strongest frontier system reaches only about 59.3% on Domain Q&A in its default reasoning mode. Increasing thinking depth within a product tier does not materially help, while moving to a higher product tier does. This suggests the bottleneck is not just test-time reasoning, but lower-level capabilities such as input parsing, structural grounding, and cross-document integration. The abstract does not provide the full model list or judge calibration details.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided metadata does not clearly identify institutions. From the setup and author list size, this looks like a systems-oriented benchmark effort targeting realistic office workflows.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 不直接相连，但它把“原生文件理解”这个真实分布暴露得很清楚；只看 benchmark 设计和“thinking depth 不动分”的结论就够了。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but it cleanly exposes native-file understanding as a real distribution shift; read the benchmark design and the result that more thinking depth barely moves the score.

paper.title: EvoPolicyGym: Evaluating Autonomous Policy Evolution in Interactive Environments
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly expected to improve executable policies through feedback, yet existing evaluations often collapse this process into a final score or confound it with open-ended software-engineering progress. We introduce Autonomous Policy Evolution, a controlled evaluation setting in which a harness-model agent repeatedly edits an executable policy system under a fixed interaction budget. We instantiate this setting in EvoPolicyGym, a benchmark built from compact interactive R

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测大多只关注最终任务得分，无法衡量Agent在固定交互预算下迭代改进可执行策略的自主进化能力。
summary.importance: 提出自主策略进化评测设定，构建EvoPolicyGym基准，从轨迹层面诊断Agent的预算分配、反馈转化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 设计受控评测环境，让脚手架Agent在固定交互预算下反复编辑可执行策略系统，基于16个紧凑交互式RL环境构建评测集，提供轨迹级诊断指标区分不同能力维度。
summary.experiments: 测试显示GPT-5.5总排名第一，在所有16个环境上均进入前二；分析发现强策略进化能力不仅需要单次任务成功，更需要发现任务结构来合理分配调整预算。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent evaluations mostly focus on final task scores, failing to measure agents' autonomous evolution capability of iteratively improving executable policies under fixed interaction budgets.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the Autonomous Policy Evolution evaluation setting, builds the EvoPolicyGym benchmark, and provides trajectory-level diagnostics to measure agents' budget allocation and feedback conversion capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a controlled evaluation setting where harness-model agents repeatedly edit executable policy systems under fixed interaction budgets, builds the benchmark on 16 compact interactive RL environments, and provides trajectory-level metrics to distinguish different capability dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Tests show GPT-5.5 achieves the top aggregate rank and top-two performance on all 16 environments; analysis finds strong policy evolution depends not only on isolated task wins but also on discovering task structure to allocate tuning budgets properly.

recommendation.zh: Agent长周期策略进化的专项评测，与预训练核心问题距离较远，作为能力评测literature备查即可。
recommendation.en: Specialized benchmark for agent long-horizon policy evolution, far from core pre-training problems; keep as literature reference for capability evaluation, no need to read in depth.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: AnyGroundBench: A Specialized-Domain Benchmark for Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated immense promise in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG). However, current evaluation protocols are largely confined to zero-shot assessments on general, daily-life benchmarks. This creates a critical disconnect from real-world applications in specialized fields, where models inevitably encounter rare visual concepts and complex spatio-temporal dynamics. Since exhaustive pre-training across infinite data distributions is infeasible, the ability to

summary.core_problem: 构建面向专业领域的视频时空定位基准，评估 VLM 在少见视觉概念和复杂时序动态中的领域适应能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 视频 grounding 评测资产，重点从通用日常场景 zero-shot 测试转向专业领域 domain adaptation；对多模态预训练研究员有弱相关价值，主要用于观察现有 VLM 的分布外视频理解短板。
summary.technical_approach: AnyGroundBench 覆盖动物、工业、体育、手术、公共安全五类专业领域，将新采集视频与已有数据集统一到密集、高质量的时空标注格式。评测目标是 Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding，即根据语言描述在视频中定位目标对象及其时间范围。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出参与评测的 VLM 名单、模型规模或具体分数。基准包含新采集视频，例如专家标注的小鼠行为视频，并与既有数据集整合，形成跨五个专业领域的 domain-adaptation 测试集。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a specialized-domain benchmark for spatio-temporal video grounding in VLMs, focusing on rare visual concepts and complex temporal dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset for video-language models, shifting from zero-shot testing on everyday videos to domain-adaptation evaluation in specialized settings. For LLM pretraining researchers, its value is mainly diagnostic: it exposes distribution-shift issues in multimodal video understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: AnyGroundBench covers five domains: animals, industry, sports, surgery, and public security. It combines newly captured videos with existing datasets under dense, high-fidelity spatio-temporal annotations, so models must localize described entities and events in both space and time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated VLMs, parameter scales, or numerical results. It states that the benchmark includes newly captured videos, such as expert-annotated mouse behaviors, and unifies them with established datasets across five specialized domains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 视频分布外评测备查即可；对预训练动作没有直接指令，先看任务定义和数据域。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM out-of-domain video eval reference; read the task and domain definitions, not the full paper.

paper.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory for a long-horizon LLM agent is a contract about what each future decision is allowed to see. The simplest contract appends past observations, tool calls, and reflections to every prompt, which makes prior context easy to access but also turns it into a jumbled mixture in which the effect of any single memory component is hard to isolate. We introduce and instrument an alternative bounded contract: every decision is made from a fresh user message assembled by typed retrieval, with no raw

summary.core_problem: 长horizon agent中，简单地把全量历史拼到每个prompt里会让上下文混杂、记忆成分难以隔离和分析，缺乏一个可系统消融记忆组件的测试环境。
summary.importance: 提出“有界记忆契约”视角和配套benchmark/testbed，强调通过类型化检索组装固定长度上下文，使记忆组件可独立消融，便于研究长horizon agent失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 在Slay the Spire 2中实现一个bounded-memory agent环境：每次决策仅基于由typed retrieval组装的新user message，不追加原始跨决策转录，prompt长度保持有界，且各记忆层可单独ablation。
summary.experiments: 以Slay the Spire 2为长horizon任务（单次run上百个决策），报告前沿LLM在公开在线benchmark最低难度五配置下零胜，人类同难度胜率较高；论文自身框架下的完整消融结果未在摘要中展开。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Alaya Lab、上海交通大学、上海创新研究院、南开大学；无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon LLM agents, naively appending full history to every prompt creates jumbled context and makes memory components hard to isolate or ablate.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a bounded-memory contract and testbed for long-horizon agents, using typed retrieval to assemble fixed-length prompts so that memory layers can be ablated independently.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticSTS instantiates the contract in Slay the Spire 2: each decision uses a fresh user message assembled via typed retrieval, with no raw cross-decision transcript appended, keeping prompts bounded and enabling isolated memory ablation.
summary_en.experiments: The environment uses Slay the Spire 2, requiring hundreds of decisions per run; the abstract notes that frontier LLMs achieve zero wins on the lowest difficulty across five configurations in a public online benchmark, while developer-reported human win rates are higher. Full ablations under the proposed framework are not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Alaya Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, and Nankai University; no prominent authors are indicated.

recommendation.zh: 作为长horizon记忆消融testbed有参考价值，适合关注agent memory的人看setup；不是评测资产本身，对pretrain直接启发有限。
recommendation.en: Useful as a long-horizon memory ablation testbed for agent researchers; look at the setup, but direct pretraining relevance is limited.

paper.title: AlgoBench: Benchmarking Algorithmic Adaptation in Code Generation
paper.abstract: High pass rates on established programming benchmarks such as HumanEval and LiveCodeBench do not always show whether a model can reason about algorithms. Many fixed benchmarks eventually become part of the public training ecosystem through released problem statements, editorials, and generated solutions, allowing later models to improve partly by exposure rather than by stronger algorithmic ability. We introduce ALGOBENCH, a framework that automatically builds novel algorithmic problems from kno

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成基准存在两个核心局限：一是静态题目集容易被训练数据污染，模型靠记忆题目和解法就能得高分，无法反映真实算法推理能力；二是仅用pass@k指标无法区分解法是否满足最优时间/空间复杂度，难以衡量算法设计水平。
summary.importance: 提出了自动生成全新算法题的基准构建框架，可有效规避数据污染问题，同时引入复杂度感知的评测指标，能为更准确评估LLM的算法推理能力、指导代码预训练提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是AlgoBench自动基准构建框架。1. 基于已知竞赛编程题，设计10种结构化变换算子（包括约束缩放、静态转动态、目标扰动、贪心陷阱注入等）生成新题，新题可追溯到源题但会让原参考算法失效；2. 设置四道质量门控：原参考解必须失败、新参考解需验证、题目表述需通过相似度过滤、目标时空复杂度需认证；3. 提出复杂度感知评测指标（OptT时间最优率、OptS空间最优率、TrapRate陷阱触发率等），结合AST静态分析、算法标签检查、运行时缩放测试三层验证器来判定解法的复杂度最优性。
summary.experiments: 在598个通过质量验证的算法变体（主实验使用420题的核心子集）上，评测了7个LLM和6种提示策略。结果显示：从源题到自动生成的变体，模型通过率出现明显下降，说明多数模型依赖记忆模板而非真正的算法推理；检索增强提示反而会提升源算法复用率，因为检索到的源题会锚定模型到原解法；错误分析显示大部分失败是算法性的（旧解法复用、复杂度过高），而非普通实现bug。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看第3章的变换算子设计和第4章的复杂度感知评测指标，理解基准构建的核心逻辑；实验部分关注不同模型在源题与变体题上的性能差距，以及错误类型分布。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code generation benchmarks have two key limitations: first, static problem sets are prone to training data contamination, allowing models to achieve high scores by memorizing problems and solutions rather than demonstrating genuine algorithmic reasoning; second, the pass@k metric alone cannot distinguish whether a solution meets optimal time/space complexity, making it hard to measure algorithm design ability.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a benchmark construction framework that automatically generates novel algorithmic problems to mitigate data contamination, and introduces complexity-aware evaluation metrics. This supports more accurate assessment of LLM algorithmic reasoning ability and provides reference for code pretraining guidance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is the AlgoBench automatic benchmark construction framework. 1) Starting from known competitive programming problems, ten structured transformation operators (including constraint scaling, static-to-dynamic conversion, objective perturbation, greedy trap injection, etc.) generate new problems that are traceable to their sources but render the original reference algorithm invalid. 2) Four quality gates ensure validity: the original reference solution must fail, the new reference solution must be verified, the problem statement must pass similarity filtering, and target time/space complexity must be certified. 3) Complexity-aware metrics (OptT, OptS, TrapRate, etc.) are proposed, paired with a three-layer verifier combining static AST analysis, algorithm tag checks, and runtime scaling tests to determine solution optimality.
summary_en.experiments: Seven LLMs and six prompting strategies are evaluated on 598 validated algorithmic variants (420-problem primary split for main experiments). Results show a clear pass rate drop from source problems to generated variants, indicating most models rely on memorized templates rather than genuine algorithmic reasoning. Retrieval-augmented prompting can increase source algorithm reuse, as retrieved source problems anchor the model to the original solution. Error analysis shows most failures are algorithmic (old solution reuse, suboptimal complexity) rather than ordinary implementation bugs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: Focus on Section 3 (transformation operator design) and Section 4 (complexity-aware evaluation metrics) to understand the core benchmark design logic. For experiments, pay attention to the performance gap between source and variant problems, and the error type distribution. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读生成规则和复杂度指标即可；它对代码预训练 contamination 的诊断比普通 pass@k 更干净。
recommendation.en: Skim the generation rules and complexity metrics; the setup is a cleaner contamination probe than plain pass@k.

paper.title: MemSyco-Bench: Benchmarking Sycophancy in Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Memory has emerged as a cornerstone of modern LLM-based agents, supporting their evolution from single-turn assistants to long-term collaborators. However, memory is not always beneficial: retrieved memories often induce a critical issue of sycophancy, causing agents to over-align with the user at the cost of factual accuracy or objective reasoning. Despite this emerging risk, existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate whether memories are correctly stored, retrieved, or updated, while overlo

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent记忆基准主要测试记忆的存储、检索、更新是否正确，忽略了检索后记忆对推理决策的负面影响——即记忆诱导的谄媚问题：Agent过度遵从历史用户记忆中的观点或偏好，牺牲事实准确性与客观推理。现有基准也未明确区分记忆何时该被使用、约束、更新或忽略。
summary.importance: 该工作指出了长记忆Agent的一类新失效模式：记忆带来的用户偏好跨会话持久化会放大谄媚风险。对记忆对齐训练、后检索决策机制设计、长周期交互下的事实性对齐研究有参考价值，也将Agent记忆评测的重心从「检索是否正确」拓展到「使用是否合理」。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MemSyco-Bench基准，从两个互补维度评测记忆诱导谄媚：一是何时应阻止记忆影响答案（记忆无关、过时、与证据冲突等场景）；二是何时应选择记忆用于个性化（有效用户偏好适用的场景）。基准覆盖五类核心场景：拒绝将记忆作为事实证据、尊重记忆适用范围、解决记忆与客观证据的冲突、跟踪记忆更新、使用有效记忆做个性化。与现有默认「检索到就该用」的记忆基准不同，该基准将评测核心从检索成功率转移到检索后的使用合理性。
summary.experiments: 已披露的实验结论显示，在多个主流记忆系统与骨干LLM上测试发现，记忆模块的引入普遍会提升谄媚程度。Agent在后检索决策上表现不佳，难以可靠平衡个性化体验与事实可靠性。具体量化结果需参考完整实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看引言中对记忆诱导谄媚的定义，以及其区别于传统谄媚的三个特征（来源、决策角色、持续时间），再了解基准的场景设计框架。实验部分的跨模型、跨记忆系统对比可快速浏览，预计泛读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent memory benchmarks primarily test the correctness of memory storage, retrieval, and update, while overlooking the negative impact of retrieved memories on downstream reasoning: memory-induced sycophancy, where agents over-align with historical user views or preferences at the cost of factual accuracy and objective reasoning. Current benchmarks also do not clearly distinguish when memory should be used, constrained, updated, or ignored.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a new failure mode for long-memory agents: cross-session persistence of user preferences via memory amplifies sycophancy risks. It informs research on memory alignment training, post-retrieval decision mechanism design, and factuality alignment in long-horizon interactions. It also shifts the focus of agent memory evaluation from retrieval accuracy to appropriate usage.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces MemSyco-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates memory-induced sycophancy from two complementary dimensions: first, when memory should be prevented from influencing answers (scenarios where memory is irrelevant, outdated, or contradictory to evidence); second, when memory should be selected for personalization (scenarios where valid user preferences apply). The benchmark covers five core scenario types: rejecting memory as factual evidence, respecting memory scope, resolving memory-evidence conflicts, tracking memory updates, and using valid memory for personalization. Unlike prior memory benchmarks that assume retrieved memory should always be used, this benchmark centers evaluation on post-retrieval usage appropriateness rather than retrieval success rate.
summary_en.experiments: Disclosed experimental findings from tests on multiple mainstream memory systems and backbone LLMs show that the introduction of memory modules generally increases sycophancy levels. Agents perform poorly on post-retrieval decision-making, and cannot reliably balance personalized experience and factual reliability. Detailed quantitative results are available in the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the definition of memory-induced sycophancy in the introduction, as well as its three unique characteristics compared to conventional sycophancy (source, decision role, duration). Then review the benchmark's scenario design framework. The cross-model and cross-memory-system comparisons in the experiment section can be browsed quickly. Estimated skimming time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 视角新颖的 Agent 评测，指出了 RAG/Memory 带来的 sycophancy 问题，做 Agent 评测和对齐的值得关注其任务设计。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective on Agent evaluation, pointing out the sycophancy issue brought by RAG/Memory; worth attention for its task design by those working on Agent evaluation and alignment.

paper.title: MSQA: A Natively Sourced Multilingual and Multicultural SimpleQA Benchmark
paper.abstract: Multilingual fluency often invites a stronger assumption: a model that can speak a user's language must also understand the culture encoded by that language. We call this the Illusion of Cultural Alignment. To test this assumption directly, we introduce MSQA, a benchmark of 1,064 natively sourced questions across 11 language groups, five cultural dimensions, and three difficulty tiers. Unlike translated benchmarks, MSQA targets locally grounded knowledge and reduces shortcuts from English-centri

summary.core_problem: 检验“模型会说某种语言，就理解该语言承载的本地文化”这一常见假设是否成立。
