summary.technical_approach: IHBench 构造的是带状态机的多轮语音工作流。数据覆盖 10 个企业流程领域，包括 SaaS、金融服务、医疗预约、电信、电商、旅行、教育、政府、订阅媒体和专业服务。每个任务由结构化 knowledge base 支撑，包含有序 workflow stage、跳过条件、失败处理、终止条件、领域规则，以及具体的虚构用户信息。用户在 assistant 主导流程时插入打断，使打断成为对计划执行的干扰，而不是普通自由问答。论文定义了六类 interruption，并为不同类型设置不同恢复要求；已给出的例子包括 normal interruption、impatient interruption 和 correction。评分采用两条线：一条是 comparative task fulfillment judging，比较不同回答完成任务的程度；另一条是 absolute recovery quality assessment，用类型相关 rubric 判断恢复质量。评测由 LLM judge 执行，并通过人类评审、一致性分析和外部 benchmark 对照来校验可靠性。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 27 个 audio-language model 配置，分析维度包括总体分数、不同 interruption 类型的表现、随对话深度增加的退化，以及 audio input 和 text input 的差异。一个关键发现是，当前模型在 backchannel/filler 之后继续原 utterance 的能力差异很大：GPT-family audio 模型的 filler pass rate 只有 7%–31%；Gemini 2.5 系列达到 62%–68%；但 Gemini 3.x 系列回落到 13%–32%。这个结果说明 post-interruption recovery 不是随着模型规模或发布时间自然解决的问题，更可能依赖专门的数据覆盖、训练目标和交互轨迹监督。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 post-interruption recovery 的问题拆分，明确它和 barge-in/turn-taking benchmark 的边界。然后看 Benchmark Design，重点关注状态机 workflow、knowledge base 生成、六类 interruption 以及 type-specific rubric。实验部分优先看 per-type breakdown、conversation depth degradation，以及 audio-versus-text 对比；这些结果比单一总分更能说明模型缺口。若做语音 LM 预训练或 post-training 数据合成，可以进一步看 judge agreement 和 human validation，判断这个 benchmark 是否能转化为训练数据筛选或 reward signal。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether voice agents can recover correctly after a user interruption in a structured workflow. The focus is not only whether the model stops speaking, but what it says next: whether it handles the interjection, updates relevant information, avoids repeating content the user already heard, and resumes at the correct workflow step.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation paper, but it is useful for researchers working on speech LMs and native audio agents. Existing interruption benchmarks mostly measure barge-in, endpointing, and turn-taking behavior. IHBench shifts the measurement to semantic recovery and workflow-state maintenance after the interruption. That distinction matters because a model can stop speaking at the right time and still fail by re-reading the interrupted sentence, ignoring a correction, or losing its place in the task. For training audio-language models, these failures point to missing supervision and weak recovery objectives rather than only inference-latency problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: IHBench builds synthetic multi-turn conversations grounded in state-machine workflows. It covers 10 enterprise domains, including SaaS, financial services, healthcare, telecom, e-commerce, travel, education, government, subscription media, and professional services. Each task is backed by a structured knowledge base with ordered workflow stages, skip conditions, failure handling, termination conditions, domain-specific guidelines, and concrete fictional user facts. The assistant is expected to drive the workflow to a terminal outcome, while the user interrupts mid-process. This makes interruptions disruptions to an execution plan rather than ordinary free-form user turns. The benchmark defines six interruption types with different recovery requirements; the provided examples include normal interruptions, impatient interruptions, and corrections. Scoring uses two axes: comparative task-fulfillment judging and absolute recovery-quality assessment with type-specific criteria. LLM judges are used, with inter-judge agreement, human-judge validation, and a cross-benchmark comparison used to check reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 27 audio-language model configurations. The analysis covers overall scores, per-interruption-type results, degradation as conversation depth increases, and differences between audio and text input. One reported result is especially informative: after backchannel or filler interruptions, GPT-family audio models correctly continue the utterance less than one third of the time, with filler pass rates between 7% and 31%. Gemini 2.5 models perform better at 62%–68%, while the newer Gemini 3.x line drops to 13%–32%. This suggests that post-interruption recovery does not automatically improve with newer model releases, and may require targeted data, objectives, or interaction-level supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the introduction’s decomposition of post-interruption recovery and how it differs from barge-in or turn-taking evaluation. Then read the benchmark design section, focusing on the workflow state machines, knowledge-base generation, six interruption types, and type-specific rubrics. In the experiments, prioritize the per-type breakdown, conversation-depth degradation, and audio-versus-text comparison; these are more informative than a single aggregate score. For speech-LM pretraining or post-training data work, also inspect the judge agreement and human validation sections to assess whether the benchmark could be used as a data filter or reward signal.

recommendation.zh: 语音大模型交互评测的重要补充，将关注点从VAD转移到语义恢复，对研发端到端语音LM的团队很有价值。
recommendation.en: An important addition to voice LLM interaction evaluation, shifting focus from VAD to semantic recovery; highly valuable for teams developing end-to-end voice LMs.

paper.title: StaminaBench: Stress-Testing Coding Agents over 100 Interaction Turns
paper.abstract: We introduce StaminaBench, a benchmark that measures the stamina of coding agents: how many consecutive interaction turns (change requests) they can handle before failing. Unlike the prevailing fraction-of-tasks-solved metric, this matches real vibe-coding where sessions run dozens or hundreds of turns. In StaminaBench, agents implement a REST API server and modify it across a tunable number of procedurally generated follow-up change requests - 100 in our experiments, resulting in codebases of u

summary.core_problem: StaminaBench 要解决的是编码 Agent 评测过于单轮化的问题：现有 SWE-Bench、TerminalBench 等主要看一次性任务是否完成，不能衡量 Agent 在几十到上百轮需求变更中维持代码一致性、理解历史约束、持续调试和管理上下文的能力。
summary.importance: 这项工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对代码 Agent 的长程能力评测有参考价值。它把“能解一个任务”改成“能在持续变化的项目状态中坚持多少轮”，更接近真实编程使用场景。对预训练研究的启发主要在三点：一是长上下文不是只看读入长度，还要看状态追踪和选择性保留；二是代码能力不能只用独立样本估计，错误会随交互轮数累积；三是 harness、测试反馈和 retry loop 对模型表现影响很大，评测时需要区分模型能力和执行框架质量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个可程序生成的长程多轮编码基准。任务域选择 REST API server，因为接口清晰、可黑盒测试、语言无关，并且可以程序化生成实体、字段、关系、约束和聚合端点。每个 episode 从一个初始 API 规格开始，随后执行一串 schema change，包括添加、删除、重命名实体，修改字段，增加关系和 analytics endpoint。每一轮 Agent 根据自然语言需求修改代码，系统用隐藏测试通过 HTTP 检查实现是否匹配当前参考状态。更一般地，作者把多轮 Agent benchmark 抽象成 reference system 和 agent system：参考系统有状态空间、初始状态分布、合法动作集合、确定性 transition function 和环境动作选择策略；Agent 需要在每一步追踪参考状态。动作序列可以由硬编码 sampler 或受结构化动作空间约束的 LLM-driven sampler 产生，但规格和测试不依赖 LLM 生成，从而降低不可复现和测试错误风险。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个开源 harness 和 7 个开源模型，模型规模从 24B 到 744B total parameters。默认设置中每个任务最多包含 100 轮交互，代码库可增长到约 6000 行。主要发现是：即使模型较强，所有系统也会在很早的轮次失败，说明长程多轮编码与单轮 benchmark 的能力结构不同；harness 质量是前置条件，较弱的执行框架会显著限制强模型发挥；开启测试反馈和 retry loop 后，各模型表现都有明显改善，说明失败并不只来自语义理解，也来自缺少可操作的调试信号。论文还比较了硬编码变更采样和 LLM-driven 采样，用来控制需求序列的有效性和难度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对单轮代码评测局限的定义，Section 3.1 的 reference-system 抽象，以及 benchmark 如何保证有效性、可无限生成和可控难度。实验部分优先看不同 harness、是否提供 test feedback、是否允许 retry 的对比结果，这些比模型排名更有信息量。附录中 REST API 任务定义和 action space 适合快速扫一遍，用来判断这个基准是否覆盖真实代码维护中的复杂性。

summary_en.core_problem: StaminaBench targets a gap in coding-agent evaluation: most benchmarks measure whether an agent can solve one isolated task, while real agent-assisted programming often involves dozens or hundreds of consecutive change requests on an evolving codebase.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct contribution to base-model pretraining, but it is useful for evaluating long-horizon coding agents. Its main value is the shift from single-task success to survival over an evolving project state. For model researchers, it highlights that long-context coding ability depends on state tracking, selective memory, accumulated error control, and the quality of the execution harness. It also shows that test feedback and retry loops can materially change measured capability, so benchmark results should not be read as model-only signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark procedurally generates REST API server tasks. An episode starts with an initial API specification and then applies a sequence of schema changes: adding, deleting, or renaming entities, modifying fields, adding relationships, and adding analytics endpoints. The agent only sees feature descriptions and optionally textual test feedback. Hidden tests interact with the server through HTTP, so the implementation is treated as a black box and the evaluation is language-agnostic. The broader framework defines a reference system with a state space, an initial-state distribution, valid actions, a deterministic transition function, and an environment action-selection policy. The agent system must keep its code aligned with the reference trajectory. Change sequences can be sampled by a hardcoded policy or an LLM-driven sampler constrained by the structured action space, while specs and tests remain procedurally generated.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 6 open-source harnesses and 7 open-source models ranging from 24B to 744B total parameters. The benchmark runs up to 100 interaction turns, producing codebases of up to roughly 6,000 lines. The main result is that all tested systems fail early, even when using strong models. Harness quality is a prerequisite for good performance. Enabling test feedback and retry loops substantially improves results, indicating that many failures are tied to debugging signals and tool-loop design rather than model weights alone. The paper also studies different environment samplers for generating valid long-horizon change sequences.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the Introduction for the motivation against single-turn coding evaluation, Section 3.1 for the reference-system abstraction, and the benchmark-design section for validity and controllable difficulty. In the experiments, prioritize the harness ablations, test-feedback settings, and retry-loop results. The REST API task definition and action space in the appendix are useful for judging whether the generated tasks resemble realistic maintenance work.

recommendation.zh: 关注长周期 agent 评测的 benchmark，重点看其如何程序化生成 100 轮的变更请求并保证测试的稳定性。
recommendation.en: A benchmark focusing on long-horizon agent evaluation; pay attention to how it programmatically generates 100 turns of change requests while ensuring test stability.

paper.title: ROSE: Benchmarking the Perception-to-Action Gap in Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to act on visual information, yet the same scene may require different actions under different task contexts. How reliably can a model turn the same visual evidence into the action required by the current context? To answer this question, we introduce \textsc{ROSE} (\textbf{R}eference-conditioned \textbf{O}ddity and \textbf{S}ymbolic \textbf{E}xecution), a controlled benchmark that holds the visual scene fixed while varying regio

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态模型能否在视觉证据不变、任务语境变化时，把感知结果稳定地转成正确动作。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它不再只测“看见了没有”，而是测“在不同任务约束下能不能把同一视觉输入映射成不同正确动作”，这对多模态 agent 和视觉-语言接口评估是有意义的。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ROSE 基准，通过固定场景、改变区域约束与符号输出要求，构造 coupled counting 与 coordinate-action 任务，专门测 perception-to-action gap。设计上强调控制变量：视觉场景相同，只改任务上下文，因此更容易把错误归因到动作映射而非感知失败。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个近期 MLLM 上测试，论文称从计数任务到区域条件动作任务，性能最高下降 44.5 个百分点，而人类可达 98.8%。结果说明不少模型在“看懂”与“按上下文行动”之间存在明显断层。未见与预训练配方、数据或架构的直接联动分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal models can reliably convert the same visual evidence into different correct actions when task context changes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. Instead of only testing perception, it isolates the perception-to-action interface under controlled context shifts, which is relevant for multimodal agents and action-grounded MLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ROSE fixes the visual scene while varying region constraints and symbolic output requirements, creating paired counting and coordinate-action tasks. This controlled design makes it easier to attribute failures to action mapping rather than raw perception.
summary_en.experiments: Across nine recent MLLMs, the paper reports drops of up to 44.5 percentage points from counting-oriented tasks to region-conditioned action, while humans reach 98.8%. The result suggests a substantial gap between seeing and acting, though the paper does not directly connect this to pretraining recipes or architecture choices.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的评测切口：把视觉理解和动作映射拆开测；预训练研究员只需看任务构造和误差分解，不必细读全篇。
recommendation.en: A clean benchmark slice: it separates visual understanding from action mapping; for pretraining folks, the task design and failure decomposition are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
paper.abstract: LiveCodeBench (LCB) has recently become a widely adopted benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) on code-generation tasks. By curating competitive programming problems, constantly adding fresh problems to the set, and filtering them by release dates, LCB provides contamination-aware evaluation and offers a holistic view of coding capability. However, LCB remains restricted to Python, leaving open the question of whether LLMs can generalize across the diverse programming languages r

summary.core_problem: 现有 LiveCodeBench 主要评估 Python，无法衡量模型在多编程语言上的泛化与污染控制下的真实代码能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产扩展工作。贡献点在于把已有 contamination-aware coding benchmark 扩展到 12 种语言，并保持与原始 LCB 协议兼容。对做代码预训练或代码模型后训练的人有参考价值，但对通用 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 LiveCodeBench 中的 Python 任务系统化转换为其他编程语言中的等价任务，保留原 benchmark 的发布时间过滤、持续更新和执行评测协议。核心不是新模型，而是 benchmark 设计：跨语言任务等价性、污染控制延续、以及与原始 LCB 格式兼容以便自动继承未来更新。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 12 种编程语言，包括 Python。摘要强调 benchmark 构建与兼容性，没有给出大量模型结果细节；其主要实验价值在于比较模型跨语言代码生成能力，而非提出新的训练方法或 scaling 结论。

summary_en.core_problem: LiveCodeBench is mostly Python-centric, so it cannot properly measure cross-language coding generalization under contamination-aware evaluation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-asset extension. Its contribution is to expand a contamination-aware coding benchmark to 12 programming languages while preserving compatibility with the original LCB protocol. Useful for code-model pretraining or post-training, but only indirectly relevant to general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically transform Python tasks from LiveCodeBench into equivalent tasks in other languages, while preserving release-date filtering, continuous updates, and executable evaluation. The core contribution is benchmark design: cross-language task equivalence, retained contamination controls, and format compatibility with future LCB updates.
summary_en.experiments: It covers 12 programming languages including Python. The abstract focuses on benchmark construction and compatibility rather than detailed model results; its main value is enabling comparison of cross-language code generation, not introducing a new training method or scaling result.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做代码预训练或想看 contamination-aware eval 的资产设计，可以留档；否则读 benchmark protocol 即可，别在结果表上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Worth archiving if you work on code pretraining or contamination-aware eval design; otherwise just read the benchmark protocol and skip the result tables.

paper.title: CombEval: A Framework for Evaluating Combinatorial Counting in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We present CombEval, a dynamic benchmark for evaluating combinatorial counting in large language models. CombEval represents each problem as a typed Cofola specification over entities, combinatorial objects, object dependencies, and constraints, enabling controlled generation of natural-language counting problems with exact solver-verified answers. Unlike static collections, CombEval supports systematic variation of object type, entity scale, constraint count, and reasoning depth. We evaluate 11

summary.core_problem: 现有组合计数评测多为静态题目集，无法系统控制问题结构以诊断LLM在哪些组合结构上失败。
summary.importance: 提供一个可控、可程序化生成、有精确解验证器的组合计数诊断benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 用typed Cofola规范描述实体、组合对象、依赖和约束，按对象类型、实体规模、约束数、推理深度系统生成自然语言计数题，并用精确solver验证答案；评测direct和code-augmented两种设置。
summary.experiments: 评测11个LLM，发现模型在有序对象、不可区分元素、相对位置约束、嵌套依赖上表现脆弱，错误主要来自约束理解和计数原理误用；论文未报告新SOTA，定位是诊断性testbed。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing combinatorial counting benchmarks are static collections, preventing controlled diagnosis of which combinatorial structures break LLMs.
summary_en.importance: A controllable, procedurally generated counting benchmark with exact solver-verified answers for diagnostic evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Represents problems as typed Cofola specifications over entities, combinatorial objects, dependencies, and constraints, generating NL counting problems with systematic variation over object type, scale, constraint count, and reasoning depth; evaluates direct and code-augmented settings.
summary_en.experiments: Across 11 LLMs, finds brittleness on ordered objects, indistinguishable elements, relative positional constraints, and nested dependencies; errors concentrate on constraint interpretation and misapplied counting principles. No SOTA claim; positioned as a diagnostic testbed.

recommendation.zh: 组合推理的可控诊断benchmark，生成方式比MATH/GSM8K更干净，做推理数据合成或reasoning eval的人可备查。
recommendation.en: A cleanly controlled diagnostic benchmark for combinatorial reasoning; useful as a reference if you build reasoning data or eval, otherwise not urgent.

paper.title: RECOM: A Validity Discrimination Tradeoff in Automatic Metrics for Open Ended Reddit Question Answering
paper.abstract: Automatic metrics are the default for evaluating LLM-generated text, yet a metric is quietly asked to do two jobs: tell genuine content alignment from surface coincidence (validity), and tell a better system from a worse one (discriminative power). On open-ended, opinion-driven question answering, the two are in tension. We introduce RECOM (Reddit Evaluation for Correspondence of Models), a contamination-free evaluation dataset of 15,000 r/AskReddit questions (September 2025), each paired with i

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式、主观型问答中自动评测指标同时承担“判真伪”和“排模型优劣”两种职责时相互冲突的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产与评测分析：构建了一个污染可控的 Reddit 开放问答评测集，并明确指出常用自动指标在 validity 与 discrimination 之间存在结构性 trade-off。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RECOM 数据集，包含 1.5 万条 r/AskReddit 问题及其真实社区回复，时间上晚于被测模型训练截止；评测时让 5 个 7B-10B 开源模型对每个问题作答，并将多种自动指标与随机错配噪声底线比较，同时控制回答长度等混杂因素，分离“能否识别真实对应关系”和“能否区分模型强弱”两类能力。
summary.experiments: 评测对象为 5 个 7B-10B 开源 LLM。结果显示：cosine similarity 能较好区分真实回复与随机回复（Cohen's d 约 2），但几乎不能给 5 个模型排序（|d|<0.1）；BERTScore precision 表面上能排序（原始 |d| 最高约 0.63），但控制长度后显著塌缩。摘要未给出更多指标和模型名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a core evaluation problem in open-ended, opinion-heavy QA: automatic metrics are implicitly asked to both detect genuine correspondence and rank model quality, and these two goals may conflict.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluation methodology and dataset construction: a contamination-controlled Reddit QA benchmark plus a careful analysis showing a structural trade-off between validity and discriminative power in common metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces RECOM, a dataset of 15,000 r/AskReddit questions paired with authentic community replies that postdate all evaluated models' training cutoffs. Five 7B-10B open-source LLMs are scored against every reply, with random-derangement noise floors and controls for confounders such as response length, to separate correspondence detection from model ranking ability.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates five open-source 7B-10B LLMs. Cosine similarity cleanly separates real from random answers (Cohen's d around 2) but fails to rank the five models (|d|<0.1). BERTScore precision appears to rank models (raw |d| up to about 0.63), but this largely collapses after controlling for response length. The abstract does not list all metrics or model names.

recommendation.zh: 做 eval 的人该看，但对 pretrain 研究员只需读实验设计和长度控制那部分；它提醒你别把自动指标的排序结果当成训练信号真相。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about evaluation; for pretraining folks, the key part is the length-controlled analysis showing that metric rankings can be a confounded mirage rather than a trustworthy training signal.

paper.title: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Fine-Grained Image Tasks: From Evaluation to Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal perception and reasoning capabilities. While numerous benchmarks have evaluated LVLMs from holistic or task-specific perspectives, their capabilities on fine-grained image tasks-fundamental to computer vision-remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce FG-BMK, a comprehensive fine-grained evaluation benchmark containing 1.01 million questions and 0.28 million images, coveri

summary.core_problem: 现有 LVLM 评测大多关注通用问答或粗粒度能力，缺少对细粒度图像理解能力的系统诊断；这篇工作试图建立一个能区分“视觉表征不足、视觉到语义映射薄弱、还是细粒度知识缺失”的评测框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark 与诊断协议。对预训练研究员的价值在于：如果你在做原生多模态预训练、视觉 tokenizer、图文对齐或 unified multimodal model，这类细粒度失败模式比通用 VQA 分数更接近真正的表征瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 FG-BMK，包含 101 万问题和 28 万图像，覆盖常见物体域到专业域。评测同时包含 dialogue-level 的细粒度语义识别，以及 feature-level 的视觉可分辨性测试；并通过 human-oriented 与 machine-oriented 两种范式，诊断失败究竟来自视觉 backbone/encoder 表征、跨模态 grounding，还是知识层面的缺口。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在一组代表性 LVLM/VLM 上做了大规模评测与诊断，但未在摘要中给出具体模型名单、参数规模、领先模型、或量化差距。已知资产规模较大，适合作为后续多模态预训练模型的分析基准，而不是方法论文去追单点提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Serge Belongie。若正文机构信息无误，这通常意味着该工作在视觉识别与细粒度理解评测上有较强背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LVLM evaluations mostly emphasize generic QA or coarse-grained capabilities, leaving fine-grained image understanding poorly characterized. This work aims to build an evaluation framework that can disentangle failures due to weak visual representations, poor visual-semantic grounding, or missing fine-grained knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark plus diagnostic protocol. For pretraining researchers, the value is that if you work on native multimodal pretraining, visual tokenization, image-text alignment, or unified multimodal models, these fine-grained failure modes are often closer to the real representation bottlenecks than generic VQA scores.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces FG-BMK, with 1.01M questions and 0.28M images spanning common object-centric domains and specialized domains. It jointly evaluates dialogue-level fine-grained semantic recognition and feature-level visual discriminability, under both human-oriented and machine-oriented settings, to diagnose whether failures come from the visual encoder, cross-modal grounding, or knowledge limitations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the benchmark is used to evaluate a diverse set of representative LVLMs/VLMs at scale, but does not provide exact model names, parameter counts, top performers, or quantitative gaps. The asset is large enough to matter as an analysis benchmark rather than a method paper chasing a narrow gain.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Serge Belongie. If the affiliation details in the paper confirm it, that usually signals strong background in visual recognition and fine-grained evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做多模态预训练，只看 benchmark 设计和 failure taxonomy 就够了；正文大概率偏评测堆表，不必逐项细读。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal pretraining, read the benchmark design and failure taxonomy only; the rest is likely mostly leaderboard-style evaluation.

paper.title: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Text-Rich Images from GPT-Image-2
paper.abstract: Text-rich images often contain privacy-sensitive, transactional, or decision-relevant information. As recent multimodal image generation models become increasingly capable of synthesizing realistic textual content and structured visual designs, detecting AI-generated text-rich images has become an important challenge for digital trust and content authenticity. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on object-centric images and provide limited coverage of scenarios where textual semantics an

summary.core_problem: 如何系统评测“文本密集型（text-rich）”图像的AI生成检测能力，尤其覆盖票据/表格/UI等以文字语义与版式为核心的场景。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是Benchmark：补齐现有生成图像检测评测偏“物体中心”而忽视“文字+布局”场景的空白；对多模态预训练/生成模型的内容可信与溯源评测有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建一个面向GPT-Image-2生成的多域数据集（6类：商业海报、信息图、学术海报、收据、表格、UI截图），并用该基准对5种代表性AI图像检测器做零样本评测；同时分析按类别的性能差异与后处理（如压缩/扰动）下的鲁棒性退化。
summary.experiments: 数据规模8602张、6个域；评测设置为zero-shot，对5个检测器报告总体与分域表现，并做后处理鲁棒性分析（摘要未给出具体模型名与数值提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to benchmark detection of AI-generated text-rich images, where textual semantics and layout (receipts/tables/UI) dominate, rather than object-centric content.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: fills a gap in existing synthetic-image detection evaluations by targeting text-and-layout-heavy images; relevant to multimodal pretraining/generation trust and provenance evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Build a multi-domain dataset of GPT-Image-2 generated images (6 categories) and evaluate five representative detectors in a zero-shot setting, including per-category breakdown and robustness under post-processing.
summary_en.experiments: 8,602 images across 6 domains; zero-shot evaluation of 5 detectors with overall/category-wise results and post-processing robustness analysis (no concrete detector names or numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 只把它当“评测资产补洞”：text-rich 场景确实缺基准，但只测 GPT-Image-2 且零样本，外推性存疑；看类别拆分与鲁棒性表就够。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a gap-filling eval asset for text-rich images; single-generator (GPT-Image-2) and zero-shot-only make generalization questionable—skim the per-category and robustness tables.

paper.title: RedactionBench
paper.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly applied to sensitive domains that require redaction of personally identifiable information (PII). While redacting PII is a data cleaning prerequisite, existing benchmarks conflate extraction mechanics with privacy semantics. A public phone number is not equivalent to a phone number in a medical record. Whether information constitutes a violation depends heavily on who holds it, why, and in what context, fundamentally differentiating redaction from simple en

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 PII redaction 评测把“识别实体”与“是否构成隐私违规”的语境判断混在一起，导致模型评估失真。
summary.importance: 它的贡献是评测资产而不是方法突破。对基座研究员的价值主要在数据治理和预训练语料清洗侧：如果你关心数据脱敏、成员推断风险或隐私过滤，这个 benchmark 提醒你 redaction 不是简单 NER。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 contextual integrity 构建 RedactionBench，包含 11 个领域、200 份人工标注文档，多数来自真实世界来源；同时提出字符级指标 R-Score，使语义等价的脱敏结果得到相近评分，并减少不同 masking 格式带来的表面差异。论文还比较了 NER、实体抽取小模型和 LLM 在该任务上的表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出详细数值，但核心实验是：在新 benchmark 上评估多类系统，展示传统实体抽取范式难以覆盖语境依赖的隐私边界。由于数据规模较小，这更像高质量诊断集，而不是大规模训练资源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 A10 Networks。未见可确认的知名基座模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between entity extraction and true privacy redaction, arguing that whether text should be redacted depends on context, not just entity type.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a method advance. For foundation-model researchers, its main value is on the data-governance side: if you care about corpus sanitization, privacy filtering, or memorization risk, it is a useful reminder that redaction is not just NER.
summary_en.technical_approach: Grounded in contextual integrity, the authors build RedactionBench, a manually annotated benchmark of 200 documents across 11 domains, mostly seeded from real-world sources. They also introduce R-Score, a character-level metric that gives similar credit to semantically equivalent redactions and discounts superficial formatting differences. The paper evaluates NER models, extraction-oriented small language models, and LLMs on this setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed numbers, but the main experiment compares multiple system families on the new benchmark and shows that standard extraction-style approaches fail to capture context-dependent privacy boundaries. Given the small scale, this is better viewed as a diagnostic benchmark than a training resource.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from A10 Networks. No clearly identifiable high-profile foundation-model authors are evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做预训练数据清洗或隐私过滤，可以记住“redaction ≠ NER”；否则把它当小型诊断 benchmark 备查即可。
recommendation.en: Useful only if you work on corpus sanitization or privacy filtering: the main takeaway is that redaction is not just NER; otherwise keep it as a small diagnostic benchmark.

paper.title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
paper.abstract: Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object

summary.core_problem: 提出语言指令条件下的 3D 点轨迹预测任务：给定短视频历史、物体上的 3D 查询点和目标描述，预测未来 3D 运动轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向具身视觉和物理世界建模的一套数据、评测和模型栈。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对“视频-语言-3D 动作”统一建模有参考价值，尤其是把运动表示压缩成世界坐标系中的点轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张用世界坐标中的 3D points 作为类无关、视角稳定、紧凑且可服务下游规划的表示。系统包括 MolmoMotion-1M：从 1.16M unconstrained videos 标注得到的 action-described、object-grounded 3D point trajectories；PointMotionBench：覆盖 111 个物体类别和 61 种运动类型的人审 benchmark；以及支持自回归预测的 MolmoMotion 模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模为 1.16M 视频、benchmark 覆盖 111 object categories 和 61 motion types，但未提供模型参数量、训练细节、baseline 或定量提升。完整可信度需要看数据标注流程、3D 轨迹恢复误差和跨类别泛化表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formulates language-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given short visual history, 3D query points on an object, and a goal description, predict future 3D trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a data-benchmark-model stack for embodied visual intelligence and physical world modeling. It is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to unified video-language-3D modeling through compact point-trajectory representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that 3D points in world coordinates are class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for planning. It introduces MolmoMotion-1M, a corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories from 1.16M unconstrained videos; PointMotionBench, a human-verified benchmark over 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and a MolmoMotion model that supports autoregressive forecasting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the 1.16M-video corpus and benchmark coverage of 111 object categories and 61 motion types, but does not provide parameter count, training recipe, baselines, or quantitative gains. The key sections to inspect are the trajectory annotation pipeline, 3D recovery error, and cross-category generalization.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道的世界模型数据形态；别被 3D 任务带偏，只看轨迹表示、标注噪声控制和泛化实验。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a world-modeling data format; ignore the task framing and inspect the trajectory representation, annotation noise, and generalization tests.

paper.title: Introducing LifeSciBench
paper.abstract: Introducing LifeSciBench, an expert-authored, expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions.

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是：如何用更接近真实科研决策的任务，评估 AI 系统在生命科学研究中的能力与失效模式，而不是只看教科书式问答。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。对基座研究员的价值不在生命科学本身，而在它代表了一类更高保真、专家撰写且专家审核的真实任务评测范式，可用于检验模型在长链条研究任务、证据整合和高风险决策中的能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: OpenAI 提出 LifeSciBench，强调 expert-authored、expert-reviewed 的评测构建方式，目标是覆盖真实 life science research tasks and decisions。按描述看，它更像任务级 protocol 与数据集资产，而非新模型；重点应在任务设计、评分标准、专家审校流程以及对现实研究工作流的贴近程度。
summary.experiments: 公开摘要没有给出题量、任务分布、评分协议、参与模型和结果细节，因此暂时无法判断 benchmark 的区分度、污染风险和 judge 稳定性。若后续材料包含模型排名、专家一致性和任务分层，才适合进一步评估其作为通用科研 agent benchmark 的质量。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 发布的评测项目。由于来自顶级实验室，且面向真实科研任务，后续若公开更完整技术细节，值得持续跟踪。

summary_en.core_problem: The work aims to evaluate AI systems on life-science research tasks and decisions that are closer to real scientific work, rather than textbook-style QA.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. The value for foundation-model researchers is not the life-science domain itself, but the move toward higher-fidelity, expert-authored and expert-reviewed evaluation of long-horizon research tasks, evidence integration, and high-stakes decision-making.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenAI introduces LifeSciBench, emphasizing an expert-authored, expert-reviewed construction process for real-world life-science research tasks and decisions. From the description, this is primarily an evaluation asset and protocol rather than a new model; the key technical elements are likely task design, scoring criteria, expert review, and realism of the workflow abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The public blurb does not provide task counts, task taxonomy, scoring protocol, participating models, or result tables, so it is too early to judge discriminative power, contamination risk, or judge reliability. If fuller materials include model rankings, expert agreement, and task stratification, it could become a meaningful benchmark for research-oriented AI systems.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by OpenAI Research. Given the lab and the focus on real scientific tasks, it is worth tracking once fuller technical details are available.

recommendation.zh: 评测资产比方法更值得看：若任务设计和专家一致性做得干净，它会比常见 QA benchmark 更能暴露模型在真实科研决策里的短板；先看 protocol 和 annotation 细节。
recommendation.en: The benchmark matters more than any model result here: if the task design and expert agreement are clean, it should expose weaknesses that standard QA benchmarks miss; start with the protocol and annotation details.

paper.title: NarrativeWorldBench: A Frontier-Saturated Benchmark and a Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Co-Creative Audio Drama
paper.abstract: Long-form serialized audio drama, with arcs that run for 200 to 800 episodes, is a major creative medium and a setting where frontier large language models (LLMs) fail. We benchmark 21 models, spanning classical, fine-tuned, open-frontier, closed-frontier, and reasoning tiers, on a uniform set of structural narrative metrics. All closed-frontier systems saturate at a plot-beat F1 in the band [0.78, 0.81] and collapse by about -0.20 F1 at horizon h=200. We introduce NarrativeWorldBench, an open b

summary.core_problem: 如何评测并提升语言模型在“超长跨度、协作式续写”的叙事一致性：模型只看到前 k 集与第 k+h 集的结构化场景计划（中间 k+1…k+h-1 集被遮蔽），仍要在 h∈{10,20,50,100,200} 的跨度上保持剧情节拍、人物声线、世界规则、伏笔回收等结构指标稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值主要在两点：第一，给“长程一致性”提供了比 LongBench/RULER 更贴近生成式创作的可自动化指标体系，并用严格的遮蔽设计把能力从“检索/复述”里剥离出来；第二，提出用显式叙事潜变量做跨场景状态压缩与更新的路线，提示长程一致性可能更像“状态建模/世界模型”问题，而不是单纯扩大上下文或堆推理 token。整体更偏 eval+architecture 的交叉工作，对纯文本预训练 recipe 的直接可迁移结论有限。
summary.technical_approach:
基准部分：从 38 部开源可再分发音频剧系列构造 1,204 个 continuation 实例，平均每集约 4,820 词；每个实例在给定前文与“目标集”的结构化 scene plan 条件下生成第 k+h 集，刻意不提供中间集，避免模型靠长上下文记忆或检索取巧。指标共 9 个，主指标是基于 14 类 Save-the-Cat plot-beat 的 Plot-Beat F1（由独立 judge ensemble 抽取），并配套人物声线一致性、世界规则违背率、伏笔回收率、事件链时序一致性、主题复现、情绪弧线对齐（DTW）、对白归因准确率、母题持久性等。
方法部分（N-VSSM）：在 Mamba-2 8B 解码器上引入每个 scene 更新一次的叙事潜变量 z_t∈R^256。每到 scene 边界，用事件抽取器得到 e_t=(actor, action, object, location, outcome)，并用当前隐藏态 h_t 形成潜变量后验（文中表述为变分式更新），训练目标是 per-scene negative ELBO，带 KL annealing；另加一个 foreshadowing-payoff 辅助损失，直接把“伏笔—回收”结构信号注入训练。生成时通过 cross-attention 把 z_t 注入到每隔 4 个 Mamba block 的低秩 adapter（相当于把潜变量作为可控的全局状态通道，而不是把所有状态塞回 token 序列）。
跨语言部分：对每个目标语言学习一个残差变换 T_l:R^256→R^256（两层 MLP），用 24k 英语-目标语的平行 scene 对做对比学习并加散度惩罚；不重训解码器，仅把潜空间“搬运”到目标文化/语言的表示区域，作为 Cultural Transfer Function。
summary.experiments:
Frontier audit 覆盖 21 个系统（经典、叙事微调基线、开源前沿、闭源前沿、推理档）。在 h=50 时，闭源前沿与推理档在 Plot-Beat F1 上集中在 0.78–0.81，组间差异不显著（Welch t-test + Bonferroni，p>0.13）。随跨度增大，所有闭源与推理系统从 h=10 到 h=200 单调下降约 0.18–0.21 F1（Bonferroni 校正后 p<1e-4），表现为“长程坍塌”。
N-VSSM 在所有跨度保持 Plot-Beat F1≥0.84，曲线接近水平；并宣称单集推理成本约为同档系统的 1/4（表 3）。在 h=200 相对“frontier band”，结构指标提升集中在长程项：伏笔回收 +0.18、时序一致性 +0.14、母题持久性 +0.12。跨语言文化贴合度（7 分 Likert，母语者标注）在启用 Cultural Transfer Function 后，Hindi 4.31→4.51、Tamil 4.18→4.39、Telugu 4.22→4.42、Marathi 4.26→4.49（+0.20~+0.23）。训练侧信息：Mamba-2 8B 先在去重 480B token 英文 fiction mixture 预训练，再在 1.8M serialized-fiction scenes 上做系列级严格 held-out 的联合微调；384×H100 训练 9.4 天。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先级：
1) Benchmark 设定与“遮蔽中间集”的动机与实现细节（决定它测的是状态外推而非检索）。重点看任务构造流程、h 的定义、scene plan 的信息量边界。
2) 9 个结构指标的可复现实现：Plot-beat 抽取的 judge ensemble、世界规则来源（series bible）与违背判定、事件链抽取与时序违背率的定义。
3) Figure 2/表 2 的跨跨度坍塌曲线：它是全文最关键的经验现象。
4) N-VSSM 的潜变量注入位置（每 4 个 block 的 adapter + cross-attn）与训练目标（ELBO + KL annealing + 辅助损失），以及消融是否证明“显式状态通道”而非单纯数据/模型差异带来收益。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可抓住 benchmark 设计与主要结论；若要复现或迁移指标体系，需要额外对齐 judge/抽取器与规则库构建细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate and improve long-horizon narrative consistency for co-creative continuation: the model must generate episode k+h given episodes 1..k plus a structured scene plan for episode k+h, while episodes k+1..k+h-1 are hidden, across horizons up to h=200, and still maintain plot beats, character voice, world rules, foreshadowing payoff, and other structural constraints.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is (1) an evaluation setup that isolates state propagation from retrieval/copying by masking intermediate episodes, with a reproducible suite of structural narrative metrics; and (2) an architectural hint that long-horizon coherence may benefit from an explicit latent state channel (a lightweight world-model-like variable) rather than only longer context windows or more “reasoning tokens”. It is more of an eval+modeling contribution than a transferable pretraining recipe paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Benchmark: 1,204 continuation instances from 38 CC-licensed serialized audio dramas, genre-balanced, evaluated at h∈{10,20,50,100,200}. The primary metric is Plot-Beat F1 over a 14-class Save-the-Cat taxonomy extracted by a held-out judge ensemble; eight additional automated metrics cover voice consistency, rule violations from series bibles, foreshadowing payoff, temporal coherence via event-chain ordering, thematic recurrence, emotion-arc alignment (DTW), dialogue attribution F1, and motif persistence. Prompts are professionally translated into four Indic languages with native-speaker cultural-fidelity ratings.
Model (N-VSSM): a Mamba-2 8B decoder augmented with a per-scene latent z_t∈R^256 updated at scene boundaries using an event tuple e_t=(actor, action, object, location, outcome) and the decoder hidden state. Training uses a per-scene negative ELBO with KL annealing plus an auxiliary foreshadowing-payoff loss. At generation time, z_t conditions the decoder through cross-attention into low-rank adapters inserted every 4 Mamba blocks, acting as an explicit global-state pathway.
Cross-lingual transfer: a language-specific residual transform T_l:R^256→R^256 (2-layer MLP) trained on 24k parallel scene pairs with a contrastive objective and divergence penalty, shifting the latent into a target cultural/linguistic region without retraining the decoder.
summary_en.experiments:
Audit of 21 systems (classical, narrative fine-tunes, open frontier, closed frontier, reasoning-tier). At h=50, closed-frontier and reasoning-tier models cluster tightly at Plot-Beat F1 0.78–0.81 with no significant pairwise differences (Welch t-test + Bonferroni, p>0.13). All closed/reasoning systems show a monotonic drop of ~0.18–0.21 F1 from h=10 to h=200 (Bonferroni-corrected p<1e-4), i.e., a long-horizon collapse.
N-VSSM reports Plot-Beat F1 ≥0.84 at all horizons with a near-flat curve, and ~4× lower per-episode inference cost (Table 3). At h=200, it improves long-horizon structural metrics vs the “frontier band”: foreshadowing payoff +0.18, temporal coherence +0.14, motif persistence +0.12. Cultural Transfer Function improves native-speaker cultural-fidelity ratings (7-point Likert) by +0.20 to +0.23 across Hindi/Tamil/Telugu/Marathi. Training details: 480B-token deduplicated English fiction pretrain for the backbone; joint fine-tune with the latent module on 1.8M serialized-fiction scenes with strict series-level held-out splits; 384 H100 GPUs for 9.4 days.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with the benchmark construction and the “hide intermediate episodes” protocol; this determines what capability is actually measured.
- Inspect metric definitions and extraction pipelines (judge ensemble for plot beats; rule-violation detection from series bibles; event-chain extraction for temporal coherence).
- Focus on the horizon curves (Figure 2 / Table 2) showing the uniform collapse at h=200.
- For N-VSSM, read the latent injection design (cross-attn into periodic LoRA-like adapters) and the training objective (ELBO + KL annealing + auxiliary payoff loss); check whether ablations separate architectural effects from data/compute effects.
Time: ~30–45 minutes to capture the core ideas; longer if you intend to reproduce the metric stack or adapt it to other long-horizon generation settings.

recommendation.zh: 评测资产比方法本身更值得看：长程结构保持被单独量化了；先看 benchmark 设计和 horizon collapse 曲线，再决定要不要信 N-VSSM。
recommendation.en: The benchmark matters more than the model: it isolates long-horizon structural retention cleanly; read the metric design and collapse curves before buying the N-VSSM story.

paper.title: GameCraft-Bench: Can Agents Build Playable Games End-to-End in a Real Game Engine?
paper.abstract: Game generation is an emerging application of coding agents, requiring models to transform natural-language specifications into playable interactive systems. Unlike traditional coding tasks, game generation takes place within a game engine, where scripts, scenes, assets, rendering, and runtime interactions must jointly produce coherent gameplay. We formalize end-to-end game generation as the problem of producing a complete game artifact that realizes a specification through observable player-gam

summary.core_problem: 如何评测“端到端游戏生成”这种 coding agent 任务：模型不仅要写脚本，还要在真实引擎里产出可启动、可交互、可验证的完整工程，并且评测要能通过交互行为而不是静态代码检查来判断是否满足规格。
summary.importance: 这是典型 eval 资产，对预训练/训练动态的直接信息增益有限。它更像是给 coding agent 与工具使用系统提供一个更贴近真实开发的评测合同（engine grounding、artifact completeness、interactive verification）。如果研究重点是通用 LLM 预训练、数据配比、tokenizer、scaling law，这篇的优先级不高；但如果团队在做 code agent 的中后期训练（tool-use、执行反馈、长程任务），它能提供更“系统级”的失败模式分解与可复现评测框架。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 GameCraft-Bench：
- 环境：真实游戏引擎 Godot，要求 agent 在引擎原生工程结构/文档/资源约束下开发（Engine Grounding）。
- 输出：必须交付完整可启动的游戏工程，而不是局部补丁或单文件脚本（Artifact Completeness）。
- 评测：通过回放式交互（replayed demonstrations）验证游戏在玩家输入下的可玩性与行为一致性，而非仅靠静态单测或代码审查（Interactive Verification）。

基准包含 140 个任务、15 个 game families，并用 rubric 从机制、内容深度、视觉功能、呈现质量等维度做诊断。
summary.experiments: 作者评测多种前沿 coding agents，最强系统总体得分 41.46%，其余显著更低；失败不集中在单一能力，而是分散在核心机制实现、内容完整度、视觉反馈与美术呈现等多个环节，并且不同 game family 差异很大。给定片段未包含更细的 per-family/per-metric 表格与具体 agent 名单，需要在实验章节核对可复现细节（运行配置、交互轨迹数量、rubric 打分一致性）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
1）先读“desiderata”定义与 Table/Figure（解释为什么现有 benchmark 不满足三要素）。
2）快速看任务构成：15 个 families 各自考什么能力、规格描述粒度如何。
3）重点看评测协议：replay 交互如何生成、如何避免评测侧探索带来的不确定性、rubric 如何落地。
4）最后看诊断分析：哪些失败模式最常见，哪些更像工具链/工程管理问题而不是代码生成本身。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate end-to-end game generation by coding agents in a way that reflects real development: the agent must produce a complete, launchable game project in a real engine, and correctness should be judged via interactive behavior rather than static code inspection.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation asset. It has limited direct impact on core LLM pretraining topics (data/optimizer/scaling/tokenizer), but it is relevant if you work on code agents and post-training for tool use, execution feedback, and long-horizon project construction. The main value is a clearer benchmark contract and more diagnostic failure decomposition than typical code-only benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GameCraft-Bench is built around three desiderata:
- Engine Grounding: development happens in a real engine (Godot) with native docs/assets.
- Artifact Completeness: the output must be a full, runnable game project, not partial edits.
- Interactive Verification: evaluation is based on executable gameplay evidence via replayed interaction traces, complemented by rubric-based scoring over mechanics, content depth, visual functionality, and presentation.

The benchmark includes 140 tasks across 15 game families, aiming to cover diverse gameplay requirements and system components.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarking multiple frontier coding agents shows the best system reaches 41.46% overall, with most agents substantially lower. Errors are distributed across mechanics, content completeness, visual feedback, and presentation, and performance varies sharply by game family. The provided excerpt does not include detailed per-metric tables or full reproducibility specs; those need to be checked in the experiments section (runtime setup, replay protocol details, scoring reliability).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read the three desiderata and the comparison table/figures explaining why prior benchmarks fall short.
2) Skim task taxonomy: what each of the 15 families tests and how specs are written.
3) Focus on the evaluation protocol: how replay traces are constructed, how interaction verification avoids evaluator-side exploration variance, and how the rubric is operationalized.
4) End with the diagnostic analysis to understand dominant failure modes and whether they stem from coding, tooling, or project-level coordination.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和评价协议即可；它把 coding agent 评测从代码正确性推到可执行 artifact。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and evaluation protocol; it pushes coding-agent evaluation from code correctness toward executable artifacts.

paper.title: ReproRepo: Scaling Reproducibility Audits with GitHub Repository Issues
paper.abstract: Reproducing research results from papers and released code is central to scientific progress. Existing works have introduced benchmarks to evaluate whether LLM agents can assist with reproducibility, but they are difficult to scale due to their reliance on substantial manual effort for data curation and evaluation. We introduce ReproRepo, a scalable framework for reproducibility evaluation that leverages human-raised GitHub issues as naturally occurring supervision on realistic reproduction bloc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是“如何大规模、低人工成本地评估LLM agent对科研复现问题的发现能力”。以往复现评测要么靠专家手工设计任务、注入错误、写rubric，要么样本量很小，而且常常只覆盖高质量artifact。作者想把这个评测过程做成可扩展、可持续更新、且更贴近真实研究实践的基准：给定论文和代码仓库，让agent通过静态审查找出真实用户在GitHub issue里报告过的复现阻塞点。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但属于应当保留的eval类工作，因为它提供了一种新的、规模足够大的agent/research automation评测资产。对基座研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它把“真实用户遇到的问题”当监督信号，而不是专家合成任务，这种数据构造思路对训练数据和评测数据都很有借鉴意义。第二，它揭示了当前强agent在静态代码审查上的能力边界：语义层面能找到大部分问题区域，但精确定位和隐蔽错误仍然困难。对于做代码模型、agentic coding、自动科研、以及repo-level pretraining/eval的人，这个基准有实际参考价值。贡献量级主要在benchmark construction和evaluation protocol，而不是方法创新。
summary.technical_approach:
框架名为ReproRepo，核心设计是用GitHub issues替代昂贵的专家标注。整体流程分三步。

第一步是数据构造。作者从顶会论文中收集paper-repo对，再抓取对应仓库中的issue。随后筛选出与复现阻塞相关的issue，而不是一般功能请求或讨论。为了保证评测时agent不能直接“看到答案”，作者基于issue发生时间和修复PR时间构建仓库快照，例如issue-time snapshot、修复前snapshot、修复后snapshot。这样可以把真实历史问题转成隐藏测试项。

第二步是agent任务定义。给agent论文和固定版本代码仓库，但不允许执行代码，只做compute-light的静态审查。agent需要输出可能的复现阻塞点。这个设置很重要，因为现代ML仓库往往依赖GPU、大数据集、外部API，完全执行成本太高；作者因此把问题限定为“静态审计能发现多少真实阻塞”。

第三步是评测协议。作者把agent输出与人类issue进行匹配，既看exact match，也看semantic match；既看issue-level指标，也看paper-level指标，还统计成本。这个多层评估设计比较合理，因为复现问题往往存在表述差异，单纯exact match会低估agent能力，而只看语义相近又会高估其定位精度。论文还区分visible failures和less visible failures，帮助分析agent到底擅长发现哪类问题。

与已有基准相比，ReproRepo的差异不在于任务形式多新，而在于监督来源和规模。它不依赖专家写题，而是直接利用自然发生的用户痛点；规模上覆盖1149篇论文、7553个issue，明显大于多数既有复现评测。代价是标签噪声和issue质量不可控，但作者用多种匹配指标和快照构造来缓解这一点。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是这篇工作的主要亮点。作者在3个主要机器学习会议上构建了1149篇论文、7553个人类报告复现阻塞点的数据集，并评估了Claude Code、Codex与4个frontier LLM的组合。在静态审查设定下，结果比直觉上更强：Codex + GPT-5.5在NeurIPS 2024 main conference上，能为93.3%的论文找出至少一个语义相关的隐藏issue；在ICLR 2026上这一比例为89.7%。这说明即便不运行代码，强agent也能从论文与仓库结构中恢复相当多的人类复现痛点。

但作者没有把这个结果解读成“复现问题已被解决”。更关键的发现是：agent的semantic coverage高，但exact localization仍弱。它们更擅长发现可见的失败模式，比如缺失依赖、脚本错误、明显配置不一致；对隐蔽错误、晚期崩溃、语义更复杂的问题，命中率明显差。论文还指出false positive rate较低，这意味着agent不是靠大量泛泛而谈的猜测刷高召回，而是确实能定位到相近问题区域。

如果精读实验部分，建议重点看四类结果：一是不同模型/agent框架的paper-level与issue-level对比；二是exact match与semantic match之间的差距，这直接反映“知道哪里不对”和“准确指出哪一行/哪一模块不对”之间的落差；三是visible vs. less visible failure的分层分析；四是成本分析，因为这个benchmark的一个卖点就是可扩展性和更新便利性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“数据构造—评测协议—误差分析”的顺序读。

先看Figure 1和Table 1，理解ReproRepo相对PaperBench、CORE-Bench、REPRO-Bench等已有工作的区别。重点不是记名字，而是看它为什么能扩到1149篇：因为监督来自GitHub issue，而不是专家手工制作。

然后看数据构造细节。要确认issue筛选标准、repo snapshot如何对齐issue时间、如何处理修复前后版本，以及哪些issue被排除。这个部分决定benchmark是否真的在测复现阻塞，而不是在测仓库维护噪声。

接着看evaluation metrics。尤其注意exact match和semantic match的定义、issue-level与paper-level指标的关系、以及false positive如何统计。很多agent benchmark最后争议都出在匹配规则，这篇也不例外。

最后看qualitative analysis。最值得读的是失败案例：agent为什么能找到“语义区域”却不能精确定位；哪些问题静态分析天然难；是否存在从论文文本中猜到大致问题、但无法落实到代码位置的情况。若只想快速了解，读引言、Figure 1、Table 1、主结果表和误差分析，大约25到35分钟即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmark construction problem: how to evaluate LLM agents on research reproducibility at scale, with low manual overhead, and in a way that reflects real research practice. Prior benchmarks often rely on expert-written tasks, injected bugs, curated rubrics, or manual grading, which keeps them small and hard to update. ReproRepo reframes the problem by using real GitHub issues as naturally occurring evidence of reproducibility blockers, then asks agents to recover those blockers from the paper and repository snapshot.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is a relevant evaluation asset. Its main value is methodological: it shows how to build a large, renewable benchmark from real user pain rather than expert-designed tasks. That idea is useful beyond evaluation, including for data construction and supervision mining. For foundation-model researchers, the practical takeaway is that strong coding agents already have substantial semantic coverage in static repository audits, yet still struggle with precise localization and less visible failures. That matters for code models, agentic coding, automated research workflows, and repo-level evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ReproRepo has three core pieces.

First, data construction. The authors collect paper–repository pairs from major ML conferences, then mine GitHub issues from the linked repositories. They filter for issues that correspond to reproducibility blockers rather than generic feature requests or discussion. To avoid leaking the answer to the agent, they reconstruct repository snapshots aligned with issue timing and fix timing, such as issue-time snapshots, pre-fix snapshots, and post-fix snapshots. This turns naturally occurring historical failures into hidden evaluation targets.

Second, the task setup. Agents are given the paper and a fixed repository snapshot, but they do not execute code. The setting is intentionally compute-light and limited to static inspection. This is a practical design choice: many modern ML repositories require GPUs, large datasets, and external APIs, so full execution is expensive and hard to standardize. The benchmark therefore asks a narrower but still meaningful question: how many real reproducibility blockers can an agent surface from static inspection alone?

Third, the evaluation protocol. Agent findings are compared against human-reported issues using both exact match and semantic match. Metrics are reported at both the issue level and the paper level, along with cost. This layered evaluation is important because reproducibility failures are often described differently by different people. Exact match alone would understate capability, while semantic match alone would overstate localization quality. The paper also distinguishes visible failures from less visible ones, which helps characterize what current agents are actually good at.

Relative to prior work, the novelty is less about task format and more about supervision source and scale. Instead of expert-authored tasks, it uses naturally occurring GitHub issues. Instead of tens of papers, it covers 1,149 papers and 7,553 human-reported blockers. The trade-off is noisier supervision, but the snapshot design and multi-granularity metrics help manage that noise.
summary_en.experiments:
The scale of the evaluation is the main result. The benchmark covers 1,149 papers from three major ML conferences and 7,553 human-reported reproducibility blockers. The authors evaluate Claude Code and Codex paired with four frontier LLMs. Under the static-inspection setting, the results are stronger than one might expect: Codex with GPT-5.5 finds at least one semantically related hidden issue for 93.3% of NeurIPS 2024 main-conference papers and 89.7% of ICLR 2026 papers.

The more important finding, however, is the gap between semantic coverage and exact localization. Agents are often able to identify the right semantic region of failure, especially for visible problems such as missing imports, broken scripts, dependency mismatches, or obvious setup issues. But they are much weaker at pinning down the exact source of the problem and at identifying less visible failure types. The paper also reports relatively low false positive rates, which suggests the agents are not simply generating broad generic warnings to inflate recall.

When reading the experiments, focus on four things: comparisons across agent/model combinations; the gap between exact match and semantic match; the stratified analysis of visible versus less visible failures; and the cost analysis, since scalability is one of the benchmark’s main claims.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of data construction, evaluation protocol, then error analysis.

Start with Figure 1 and Table 1. They make the benchmark positioning clear relative to earlier reproducibility evaluations such as PaperBench, CORE-Bench, and REPRO-Bench. The key point is not the names, but why this benchmark scales: supervision comes from GitHub issues rather than expert-authored tasks.

Then read the data construction section carefully. Check how reproducibility-related issues are filtered, how repository snapshots are aligned with issue timing, and how pre-fix versus post-fix states are used. This determines whether the benchmark is really measuring reproducibility blockers rather than repository maintenance noise.

Next, read the metric definitions. Pay close attention to exact match versus semantic match, issue-level versus paper-level metrics, and how false positives are counted. In agent benchmarks, much of the real disagreement usually comes from the matching protocol.

Finally, spend time on the qualitative analysis. The most useful part is the failure analysis: why agents can often identify the right semantic area but fail to localize precisely; which failure types are inherently hard for static inspection; and whether some findings are inferred from the paper text without being grounded in the codebase.

If you only want the main ideas, read the introduction, Figure 1, Table 1, the main result table, and the qualitative error analysis. That should take around 25 to 35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但评测设计很干净；做 coding/agent eval 的人应直接看任务构造和误差分析，别被“90%”这个 headline 误导成能力已够用。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the eval design is clean; read the task construction and error analysis, and do not overread the '90%' headline as evidence that agents are already reliable.

paper.title: A Closer Look at Failure Modes in Temporal Understanding of Large Audio-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on a variety of audio understanding tasks but continue to struggle with temporal reasoning, a fundamental capability central to human auditory perception. Understanding the causes of these failures remains challenging as existing benchmarks report performance gaps without probing underlying mechanisms. To address this, we introduce a benchmark with 1,657 questions across three foundational tasks designed specifically for mechanistic

summary.core_problem: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在时间推理（如判断声音事件的先后顺序、持续时间）上表现不佳，其底层机制是什么？是模型没有关注音频，还是关注的方式不对？
summary.importance: 构建了一个专门针对 LALMs 时间推理能力的诊断性 Benchmark，并首次通过因果机制分析（Causal Mechanistic Analysis）探讨了 LALMs 在时间推理上失败的原因。研究表明，仅仅增加对音频模态的注意力权重是不够的，注意力在音频 Token 上的分布方式（Attention Scaling）才是关键，这为未来多模态模型的架构设计和推理优化提供了方向。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建了包含 1657 个问题的诊断性数据集，专注于三个基础时间推理任务：最早开始（EO）、最晚结束（LO）和最长持续时间（LD）。通过行为分析（对比仅音频、仅文本、音视频输入的表现），发现模型在有文本提示时严重依赖文本，忽视音频。核心贡献在于因果机制分析：对比了两种注意力干预方法——注意力上调（Attention Upweighting，增加音频模态的总注意力）和注意力缩放（Attention Scaling，重新分配音频 Token 内部的注意力）。
summary.experiments: 行为分析显示，在大多数模型中，仅文本（CQA）的准确率高于仅音频（AQA），说明模型存在模态偏见。机制分析表明，在大多数配置下，注意力缩放（Attention Scaling）比单纯的注意力上调（Upweighting）更能改善性能。在推理阶段，对识别出的瓶颈层应用注意力缩放，无需额外训练，即可将平均准确率从 55.9% 提升至 59.1%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Behavioral Analysis 部分关于模态偏见的实验设计，以及 Causal Mechanistic Analysis 中对 Attention Upweighting 和 Attention Scaling 的对比分析。这对于理解多模态模型中跨模态注意力的分配机制很有帮助。

summary_en.core_problem: Why do Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) struggle with temporal reasoning (e.g., determining the order or duration of sound events)? Is it a failure to attend to the audio modality, or a failure in how attention is distributed?
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces a diagnostic benchmark specifically for temporal reasoning in LALMs and provides the first causal mechanistic analysis of their failures. It reveals that simply increasing the overall attention to the audio modality is insufficient; the distribution of attention across audio tokens (Attention Scaling) is the critical factor. This insight offers a new direction for architectural design and inference optimization in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first construct a diagnostic dataset of 1,657 questions focusing on three foundational temporal tasks: Earliest Onset (EO), Latest Offset (LO), and Longest Duration (LD). Behavioral analysis (comparing audio-only, text-only, and audio-text inputs) confirms that models heavily rely on text cues and under-utilize audio when both are present. The core contribution is the causal mechanistic analysis, which compares two attention interventions: Attention Upweighting (increasing total attention to the audio modality) and Attention Scaling (redistributing attention among audio tokens).
summary_en.experiments: Behavioral analysis shows that text-only (CQA) often outperforms audio-only (AQA), indicating a strong modality bias. The mechanistic analysis demonstrates that Attention Scaling is more effective than Attention Upweighting in most configurations. Applying Attention Scaling at identified bottleneck layers during inference, without any fine-tuning, improves average accuracy across models and tasks from 55.9% to 59.1%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental design in the Behavioral Analysis section regarding modality bias, and the comparison between Attention Upweighting and Attention Scaling in the Causal Mechanistic Analysis. This provides valuable insights into cross-modal attention allocation in multimodal models.

recommendation.zh: 建议只看任务设计和注意力干预实验；“多给音频注意力不如重分配注意力”会影响音频 LM 的对齐 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and attention-intervention results; the useful prior shift is that reallocating audio attention beats merely increasing it.

paper.title: PARSE: Provenance-Aware Retrieval Sanitization for Professional Domain LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Prompt injection defenses evaluated on synthetic benchmarks do not generalize to real enterprise documents, which are longer, denser, and interleave legitimate authority language with factual content. We demonstrate this gap with a real-document benchmark of 122 tasks across five professional domains (financial, legal, medical, scientific, DevOps) using actual SEC filings, Federal Register rules, PubMed abstracts, arXiv papers, and GitHub postmortems. Paraphrasing, the strongest defense on synth

summary.core_problem: 解决现有提示注入防御在真实企业长文档场景下泛化性差、效用损失大的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+评测资产贡献：首次构建覆盖5大专业领域的真实文档提示注入基准，提出兼顾事实保留与攻击过滤的检索清洗 pipeline
summary.technical_approach: 提出PARSE框架：1）句子级注入概率分类；2）重写前提取结构化事实；3）一致性校验环验证事实保留；4）指令门控路由无需清洗的文档，核心是基于来源感知的细粒度清洗而非全局改写
summary.experiments: 构建122个任务的真实文档基准（覆盖SEC文件、联邦法规、PubMed、arXiv、GitHub事后分析），验证paraphrasing在真实场景下攻击成功率无显著下降（p=0.5）且效用从91.8%降至82.8%；PARSE保留90%+效用的同时显著降低攻击成功率

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the poor generalization and high utility loss of existing prompt injection defenses on long real-world enterprise documents
summary_en.importance: Method innovation + benchmark contribution: builds the first real-document prompt injection benchmark covering 5 professional domains, proposes a retrieval sanitization pipeline balancing fact preservation and attack filtering
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PARSE framework: 1) sentence-level injection likelihood classification; 2) structured fact extraction before rewriting; 3) consistency-check loop for fact preservation; 4) directiveness gate to route clean documents; core is provenance-aware fine-grained sanitization instead of global paraphrasing
summary_en.experiments: Built a 122-task real-document benchmark covering SEC filings, Federal Register rules, PubMed, arXiv, GitHub postmortems; paraphrasing brings no significant attack rate reduction (p=0.5) and cuts utility from 91.8% to 82.8%; PARSE reduces attack rate significantly with 90%+ utility retained

recommendation.zh: 仅需记住核心结论：合成基准上最优的paraphrasing防御在真实企业文档中完全失效，具体方法无需深读
recommendation.en: Only remember the core conclusion: paraphrasing, the top defense on synthetic benchmarks, fails completely on real enterprise documents; no need to dive into method details

paper.title: GRACE: Step-Level Benchmark for Faithful Reasoning over Context
paper.abstract: Many reasoning tasks require models to reason over input context, from document-grounded question answering to rule-based deduction. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting produces traces that appear transparent, yet individual steps can silently deviate from the source evidence, even when the final answer is correct. Existing methods detect hallucinations at the response level but fail to identify where in the chain a failure occurs or what type it is. We introduce GRACE, the first human-annotated st

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：在有外部上下文约束的文本推理里，模型的 CoT 过程是否逐步忠实于证据，而不是只看最终答案对不对。现有 hallucination 或 faithfulness 评测大多停留在 response level，最多判断整段回答有没有问题，无法定位是哪一步开始偏离上下文，也无法区分偏离是逻辑跳步、约束违背，还是凭空捏造证据。论文把这个问题形式化为 step-level context faithfulness：给定 references、question 和 reasoning trace，对每一步判断 faithful / unfaithful，并在出错时给出错误类别和解释。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train 信号设计、reasoning 数据构造、过程监督和 verifier 训练有明显价值。它把“过程是否忠实于上下文”从一个模糊概念变成了可标注、可训练、可评测的对象。更重要的是，作者明确区分了 process faithfulness 和 context faithfulness：一个步骤可以真实反映模型内部推理，但仍然不被上下文支持；也可以表面上贴合上下文，却未必是模型真实决策路径。这个区分对做 reasoning RL、step-level reward、judge/verifier 的人很关键，因为你到底在优化哪种信号，会直接影响训练结果。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是构建 GRACE benchmark，并配套一个数据驱动的错误 taxonomy。数据覆盖 10 个模型、4 个源数据集、2 类推理场景：evidence-grounded reasoning 和 deductive reasoning。每条 CoT 的每一步都标注三类信息：faithfulness label、error category、自然语言解释。

taxonomy 不是先验手工定义，而是 bottom-up 发现。作者先让强 LLM judge 对大量 unfaithful steps 生成自由文本 critique，再把这些 critique 做 embedding 和聚类，归纳出两条经验上可分的错误主线：GRACE-Inference 和 GRACE-Grounding。前者更偏推理错误，如无依据跳步、约束违背、无效演绎；后者更偏证据错误，如事实矛盾、幻觉证据、抽取错误。这个设计的好处是 taxonomy 来自真实错误分布，而不是研究者预设标签。

数据构建上，作者采用多 LLM judges 先做大规模自动标注。多个 judge 一致同意的样本进入可扩展训练集；judge 分歧较大的复杂样本交给人工标注，形成高质量 evaluation set。这样做是在成本和质量之间取平衡：训练集追求规模，测试集追求难度和可靠性。论文还把这个 benchmark 用在两个下游方向：一是训练 step-level evaluator，小模型微调后可以接近大模型；二是把 context faithfulness 信号接入 RL，作为下游任务训练中的额外奖励或约束，观察对准确率和推理可靠性的影响。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最重要的不是某个单点分数，而是三类发现。第一，GRACE evaluation set 对现有模型仍有明显 headroom。也就是说，即便最终答案正确，step-level 上仍有相当比例的 unfaithful reasoning；反过来，完全 faithful 的链条也可能得到错误答案。这说明 answer accuracy 不能替代过程忠实性评测。

第二，taxonomy 的区分是有经验支持的。通过对大量错误步骤的 critique 聚类，作者发现 inference-type 和 grounding-type 错误在分布上是可分的，而不是一个混杂标签。这让 evaluator 不只是输出“错了”，还能指出错在推理还是错在证据绑定。

第三，训练信号层面有两个结果。其一，用 GRACE 训练集微调较小 evaluator，可以达到接近更大模型的性能，说明 step-level faithfulness 判断是可以被蒸馏和专门学习的，而不必完全依赖最强 judge。其二，把 step-level context faithfulness 信号并入 RL 训练后，下游任务准确率和 reasoning reliability 都有提升。摘要和引言没有给出完整数字，全文主实验更值得看具体表格：重点不是绝对提升幅度，而是这种 reward 没有只把模型推向更保守的短回答，而是在正确率和忠实性上同时受益。

需要注意的是，这篇论文的实验重心是 benchmark 与 evaluator，而不是提出新的推理模型架构。因此如果从 pretrain 视角阅读，最该关注的是它如何定义可学习的过程监督信号，而不是把它当成又一个 CoT 数据集。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 和 Task Formulation，吃透 context faithfulness 与 process faithfulness 的区别；这是全文最重要的概念边界。然后看 taxonomy 构建部分，尤其是自由文本 critique 如何聚类成 GRACE-Inference / GRACE-Grounding，这决定了 benchmark 是否只是人工拍脑袋分标签。实验部分优先看三块：不同模型在 evaluation set 上的 headroom、small evaluator fine-tuning 的结果、以及把 faithfulness 信号接入 RL 后的变化。如果时间有限，40 分钟左右可以抓住主线。泛读时不必逐条看 annotation guideline，但值得留意作者如何处理 judge disagreement，因为这关系到数据噪声和后续可训练性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in reasoning evaluation: whether each step in a context-grounded chain of thought is faithful to the provided evidence, rather than merely whether the final answer is correct. Existing hallucination and faithfulness methods mostly operate at the response level. They can flag that something went wrong, but they usually cannot localize the failure to a particular reasoning step or distinguish between unsupported inference, constraint violation, and fabricated evidence. The paper formalizes this as step-level context faithfulness: given references, a question, and a reasoning trace, label each step as faithful or unfaithful, and assign an error type plus explanation when it is unfaithful.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training signal design, process supervision, verifier training, and reasoning data construction. Its main contribution is to turn context faithfulness from a vague desideratum into something that can be annotated, benchmarked, and optimized. A particularly useful conceptual move is the separation between process faithfulness and context faithfulness. A step may reflect the model's actual internal reasoning while still being unsupported by the context, or it may look well-grounded without reflecting the true decision process. That distinction matters if one wants to build RL rewards, step-level judges, or verifier models without conflating different notions of correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core artifact is the GRACE benchmark, together with a data-driven error taxonomy. The benchmark covers chains of thought from ten models over four source datasets spanning two reasoning settings: evidence-grounded reasoning and deductive reasoning. Each step in a trace is annotated with three pieces of information: a faithfulness label, an error category, and a natural-language explanation.

The taxonomy is discovered bottom-up rather than imposed manually. The authors first collect free-form critiques of many unfaithful steps using a strong LLM judge. These critiques are then embedded and clustered, yielding two empirically distinct error tracks: GRACE-Inference and GRACE-Grounding. The former captures deductive failures, logical leaps, and constraint violations. The latter captures factual contradiction, fabricated evidence, and extraction errors. This is a sensible design choice because it lets the taxonomy emerge from observed failure patterns rather than from a predefined label set.

For data construction, the paper uses multiple LLM judges to scale annotation. Cases with unanimous judge agreement form a large training set. Hard disagreement cases are sent to human annotators and become the high-quality evaluation set. This creates a practical split: scalable supervision for training, and more reliable, more difficult data for evaluation. The benchmark is then used in two ways. First, the authors train step-level evaluators and show that smaller models fine-tuned on the training set can approach larger ones. Second, they inject context-faithfulness signals into RL for downstream reasoning tasks and study the effect on both task accuracy and reasoning reliability.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important findings are qualitative and structural rather than a single headline number. First, the GRACE evaluation set reveals clear headroom for current models. A nontrivial fraction of traces that end with the correct answer still contain unfaithful intermediate steps, while some fully faithful traces still end in the wrong answer. This shows that answer accuracy is not a sufficient proxy for reasoning faithfulness.

Second, the taxonomy appears empirically meaningful. By clustering critiques of unfaithful steps, the authors find that inference-related failures and grounding-related failures separate into distinct groups rather than collapsing into one generic error label. That makes the benchmark useful not only for binary detection but also for diagnosis.

Third, there are two training-related results. Fine-tuning smaller evaluator models on the GRACE training set can bring them close to larger models, suggesting that step-level faithfulness judgment is learnable and can be distilled. In addition, incorporating step-level context-faithfulness signals into RL improves both downstream task accuracy and reasoning reliability. The introduction does not expose all the detailed numbers, so the main tables in the full paper are worth checking. The key point is not just the absolute gain, but that the reward appears to improve reliability without simply pushing the model toward shorter or overly cautious responses.

One caveat is that the paper is centered on benchmark construction and evaluator training, not on a new reasoning architecture. For a foundation-model reader, the main value lies in how it defines a trainable process-level supervision signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and task formulation. The distinction between context faithfulness and process faithfulness is the conceptual anchor of the paper. Then read the taxonomy construction section, especially how free-form critiques are clustered into GRACE-Inference and GRACE-Grounding. That part determines whether the benchmark is genuinely data-driven or just manually relabeled. In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: model headroom on the human evaluation set, fine-tuning results for smaller evaluators, and the RL experiments that use faithfulness as a training signal. If reading quickly, about 40 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The annotation guidelines can be skimmed, but the treatment of judge disagreement is worth attention because it directly affects label noise and trainability.

recommendation.zh: 首个步骤级上下文推理忠实性的人工标注基准，错误分类法自数据驱动聚类得到，读§3的分类体系和标注示例即可。
recommendation.en: First human-annotated step-level faithfulness benchmark for grounded reasoning, with a data-derived error taxonomy; only §3 on the taxonomy and annotation examples is worth reading.

paper.title: How Much Can We Trust LLM Search Agents? Measuring Endorsement Vulnerability to Web Content Manipulation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents synthesize open-web content into actionable recommendations on behalf of users, creating a risk that attacker-published pages are transformed into endorsed claims. We introduce SearchGEO, a controlled evaluation framework for measuring endorsement corruption in LLM-based web-search agents, combining a web-evidence manipulation pipeline, a five-mode attack taxonomy, and multiple output-level metrics. We evaluate 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. Res

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM search agent 在开放网页环境中是否会把攻击者操纵的内容转化为模型背书，从而形成错误推荐。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测框架 SearchGEO：它不是又一个 search agent，而是把 web manipulation、攻击类型和输出级指标系统化。对 agent 安全评估和 deployment 风险建模有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建受控网页证据操纵流水线，定义五类攻击模式，并设计多种输出层指标来测量 endorsement corruption；同时加入一个辅助 agent-skill probe，把“背书”转成安装命令等更高风险动作，观察不同后端的行为分化。
summary.experiments: 在 13 个 LLM backend、每个 308 个案例上评测。摘要给出明显差异：Claude-Sonnet-4.6 的总体 ASR 为 0.0%，Gemini-3-Flash 为 31.4%；同一 scaffold 对不同后端可能放大或降低攻击成功率。实验重点是模型家族差异和系统封装交互，而非训练方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAUST、吉林大学、浙大、IDSIA/USI/SUPSI、NNAISENSE 等。Jürgen Schmidhuber 署名使其在 agent 安全评测方向上更容易被关注。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM search agents can turn attacker-manipulated web content into model-endorsed recommendations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is the SearchGEO evaluation framework. This is not another search agent paper; it systematizes web manipulation, attack modes, and output-level metrics for agent safety evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework builds a controlled web-evidence manipulation pipeline, defines a five-mode attack taxonomy, and measures endorsement corruption with multiple output metrics. It also adds an auxiliary skill probe where endorsement becomes a higher-risk action such as an install command.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. The abstract reports strong backend variation: overall attack success ranges from 0.0% on Claude-Sonnet-4.6 to 31.4% on Gemini-3-Flash, and the same deployment scaffold can either amplify or reduce vulnerability depending on the backend.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from KAUST, Jilin University, Zhejiang University, IDSIA/USI/SUPSI, and NNAISENSE. Jürgen Schmidhuber's presence makes it more visible in the agent safety evaluation space.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent 或 tool-use 的都该看，尤其是同一 scaffold 对不同 backend 方向相反这点；这说明系统层结论别轻易外推，读实验表就够值回时间。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about agents or tool use: the key result is that the same scaffold can help one backend and hurt another, so system-level conclusions do not transfer cleanly.

institutions: Center of Excellence for Generative AI, KAUST

paper.title: CODA-BENCH: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
paper.abstract: Advanced agents are increasingly demonstrating the potential to operate as autonomous engineers, creating a growing demand for evaluation benchmarks that capture the complexity of real-world development. Such environments typically involve both complex code and large-scale data (i.e., file system). However, existing benchmarks usually evaluate code-centric or data-centric capabilities in isolation, leaving a clear gap with real development scenarios. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introduc

summary.core_problem: 如何评估 Code Agent 在包含复杂代码和大规模数据的真实数据密集型环境中的综合能力？
summary.importance: 提出了首个联合评估代码和数据智能的 benchmark（CODA-BENCH），填补了现有评测通常孤立评估代码或数据能力的空白，更贴近真实开发场景。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Kaggle 生态构建了一个数据密集的 Linux 沙盒，Agent 需要在包含大量文件（平均 980 个）的复杂文件层次结构中探索，识别相关资源并生成代码以完成数据驱动的分析任务。
summary.experiments: CODA-BENCH 包含 1009 个任务，跨越 31 个社区。测试了现有 Agent 在该环境下的表现，揭示了它们在处理大规模数据和复杂文件系统时的局限性。
summary.authors_note: 中国人民大学团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the comprehensive capabilities of Code Agents in real-world data-intensive environments involving both complex code and large-scale data?
summary_en.importance: Introduces CODA-BENCH, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate code and data intelligence, filling the gap where existing evaluations typically assess code or data capabilities in isolation, thus better reflecting real development scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed a data-intensive Linux sandbox based on the Kaggle ecosystem. Agents must explore complex file hierarchies (averaging 980 files) to identify relevant resources and generate code for data-driven analytical tasks.
summary_en.experiments: CODA-BENCH comprises 1,009 tasks across 31 communities. Tested existing agents in this environment, revealing their limitations in handling large-scale data and complex file systems.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by the Renmin University of China team.

recommendation.zh: 将 Code Agent 的评测从纯代码生成推向了“代码+大规模文件系统”的真实数据科学场景，是评估 Agent 长上下文和文件导航能力的重要 benchmark。
recommendation.en: Pushes Code Agent evaluation from pure code generation to real-world data science scenarios involving 'code + large-scale file systems', serving as an important benchmark for assessing long-context and file navigation capabilities.

paper.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench,

summary.core_problem: 现有 computer-use agent benchmark 在非个人环境中评估模型，无法测试需要登录或个人信息的真实 web 任务，与实际部署存在差距
summary.importance: 提出了首个面向个人智能计算机使用 agent 的 benchmark（MyPCBench），填补了评估与部署之间的 gap；Ruslan Salakhutdinov 团队出品
summary.technical_approach: 在 Linux 桌面构建 17 个模拟真实世界 web 应用和完整桌面栈，以《办公室》Michael Scott 为标准人设，定义 184 个来自 OpenClaw 社区的真实任务
summary.experiments: 测试 6 个闭源和开源模型，统一 computer+bash 工具界面；Claude Opus 4.6 最佳，完成 55.4% 任务
summary.authors_note: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov；Carnegie Mellon University；Ruslan Salakhutdinov 是深度学习和贝叶斯深度学习知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Current computer-use agent benchmarks evaluate in impersonal environments, cannot test web tasks requiring login or personal information — a gap between evaluation and real deployment
summary_en.importance: First benchmark (MyPCBench) for personally intelligent computer-use agents, filling the evaluation-deployment gap; from Ruslan Salakhutdinov's group at CMU
summary_en.technical_approach: Linux desktop with 17 simulated real-world web apps and full desktop stack, seeded for canonical persona (Michael Scott from The Office); 184 tasks inspired by real requests from OpenClaw community
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarked 6 closed and open-weight models with uniform computer+bash tool surface; Claude Opus 4.6 solves 55.4% of tasks as best performer
summary_en.authors_note: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov; Carnegie Mellon University; Ruslan Salakhutdinov is a prominent researcher in deep learning and Bayesian deep learning

recommendation.zh: CMU Salakhutdinov 团队的重要 benchmark 贡献，关注 agent 评测方向的读者应看任务设计和模拟环境搭建，对预训练研究员主要是评估设计有间接启发
recommendation.en: Important benchmark contribution from CMU Salakhutdinov's group; agent evaluation researchers should study task design and simulation setup; indirect inspiration for pretraining researchers on evaluation design

paper.title: ToolMenuBench: Benchmarking Tool-Menu Filtering Strategies for Reliable and Efficient LLM Agents
