paper.abstract: Tool-augmented large language model agents increasingly operate over large tool libraries, but existing evaluations often focus on whether a model can call a tool correctly rather than how the visible tool menu shapes reliability, efficiency, and safety-relevant risk exposure. We introduce ToolMenuBench, a benchmark for evaluating tool-menu construction in multi-step LLM agents. ToolMenuBench varies tool-menu size, distractor type, state-dependent task structure, and risk exposure, and reports b

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM Agent 在大工具库下如何构造可见工具菜单，以及菜单大小、干扰工具和风险暴露如何影响可靠性、效率与安全。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 工具使用评测基准。它把评测重点从“能否正确调用工具”推进到“给模型看哪些工具会改变行为”，这对 tool-use agent 的可靠性分析更贴近实际部署。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ToolMenuBench，通过控制工具菜单大小、干扰工具类型、状态依赖任务结构和风险暴露来测试多步 Agent；指标同时覆盖过滤器本身和下游 Agent 表现，包括可见工具数、风险工具暴露、任务成功率、错误工具调用、过早行动和 token 使用量。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个模型后端、3 种工具菜单大小、6 种过滤方法和 7 种评测设置上实验。摘要报告 CMTF 将任务成功率从 all-tools exposure 下的 32.1% 提升到 85.7%，同时平均 token 使用量减少约 98%；因果最小工具过滤在成功率、成本和风险之间取得较好折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how tool-menu construction affects the reliability, efficiency, and risk exposure of LLM agents operating over large tool libraries.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an agent benchmark that shifts evaluation from whether a model can call tools to which tools should be made visible. This is closer to practical deployment, where the exposed action space strongly shapes model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolMenuBench varies tool-menu size, distractor type, state-dependent task structure, and risk exposure in multi-step agent tasks. It reports both filter-level and downstream metrics, including visible tool count, risky-tool exposure, task success, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token usage.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates seven model backends, three menu sizes, six filtering methods, and seven evaluation settings. The abstract reports that CMTF raises task success from 32.1% under all-tools exposure to 85.7%, while reducing average token usage by about 98%. Causal minimal tool filtering gives the strongest overall tradeoff.

recommendation.zh: 工具菜单是被低估的 Agent 控制面；读指标和 CMTF 对照，别把数字外推到通用规划能力。
recommendation.en: Tool menus are an underrated agent control surface; read the metrics and CMTF ablation, but do not extrapolate the numbers to general planning.

paper.title: Dialogue SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Dialogue-Driven Coding Agents
paper.abstract: AI coding agents have rapidly transformed software engineering, powering widely used interactive coding assistants. Despite their interactive real-world use, existing benchmarks evaluate them as fully-autonomous systems. In this work, we introduce Dialogue SWE-Bench, an automatic benchmark dataset for evaluating the ability of coding agents to resolve real-world software engineering problems through dialogue with a user. We design a novel, persona-grounded user simulator to support our task eval

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很明确：现有 SWE-Bench 一类代码 agent 评测，把任务设成“拿到完整 issue 后自主修复仓库”，但真实使用里，问题描述常常不完整，用户会不断补充、纠正、拒绝方案。于是现有 benchmark 测到的主要是自治修复能力，而不是交互式澄清、需求对齐、边做边问的能力。论文把 repository-level 软件修复任务重写成 dialogue-driven setting，核心不是再造一个 coding benchmark，而是把“对话是否帮助 agent 获得缺失规格、减少误解、最终产出可通过测试的 patch”变成可自动评测的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法论文，但对 post-train、agent training、以及评测信号设计有现实意义。它指出一个常被忽略的断层：更强的代码模型，不一定就是更好的交互式 coding agent。这个结论会影响两类研究。第一类是 agent SFT/RL 数据构造：如果训练数据几乎都是单轮、规格完备的 coding tasks，模型就学不会主动澄清。第二类是 evaluator 设计：只看最终 patch pass rate，会掩盖 agent 在对话阶段的失误模式。贡献量级属于“评测设定补齐短板”，不是改变预训练范式，但对做 coding agent 或 tool-use post-training 的团队有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 benchmark 重构。作者从 SWE-Bench Verified 出发，不再把完整 issue text 直接给 agent，而是为每个任务设计一个固定的初始用户 query，故意只暴露部分信息。agent 的动作空间在原有编程环境操作之外，新增 message_user 动作，允许它向用户提问并接收回复。这样任务成功不只取决于代码能力，也取决于是否知道什么时候问、问什么、如何根据回答更新计划。

第二块是 user simulator。论文没有用一个无约束聊天模型来扮演用户，而是做了 persona-grounded simulator：用户回复受完整 issue text 约束，并带有角色设定，目的是同时保证两点，一是回答要忠实于原始任务规格，二是交互风格要更像真实用户，而不是把标准答案一次性吐给 agent。这里的关键设计不是“让模拟器更聪明”，而是“让模拟器更稳定、可复现、不会泄露超出用户视角的信息”。从 benchmark 角度，这比开放式人类评测更便宜，也比自由生成更可控。

第三块是 schema-guided agent。作者提出一个受 dialogue theory 启发的 agent 变体，用显式 schema 约束 agent 在对话中的行为，例如区分澄清需求、确认假设、汇报进展、请求决策等不同交互意图。它不是单纯在 prompt 里加一句“多问用户”，而是把对话动作组织成更结构化的决策过程。这样做的原因很实际：通用 coding agent 往往把对话当成普通文本输出，结果要么几乎不问，要么问得泛、问得晚、问完也不用。schema 的作用是把“何时问、为何问、问完怎么改计划”显式化。
summary.experiments:
实验重点有三层。第一层是 benchmark 上的主结果。作者评测了多种现有 coding models / agents，结论是模型在传统 coding benchmark 上更强，并不自动转化为 dialogue setting 下更强。这说明交互能力不是代码能力的自然副产物，而是单独需要训练和评测的维度。

第二层是 schema-guided agent 的增益。论文给出的摘要数字是，相比强基线提升 3% 到 14%。从任务性质看，这个幅度不算小，因为 repository-level SWE 任务本来通过率就低，几个点的绝对提升通常对应不少真实任务被从“误解需求”拉回到“可修复”。更重要的是，提升来自更好的提问与对齐，而不只是更强的 patch generation。

第三层是 dialogue quality evaluation。作者除了最终 resolved rate，还引入自动化对话质量评估，并用 LLM-as-a-Judge 去看提问是否相关、是否有帮助、是否冗余等。这个设计的价值在于把失败拆开：有的 agent 代码改得对但不会沟通，有的 agent 会沟通但问不到关键点，有的 agent 过度依赖用户。论文还讨论了 better coding models do not always correspond to better interactive agents，这个观察本身比单个分数更重要。

从给出的全文片段看，数据集基于 SWE-Bench Verified 重构，评测核心仍是最终 patch 通过测试的 resolved percentage，同时叠加多种 dialogue-level 指标。若精读原文，建议重点核对：任务数规模、user simulator 的温度与稳定性设置、不同 agent 的 message frequency 分布、以及 dialogue quality 与 task success 的相关性分析。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，抓住它为什么认为 fully-autonomous SWE evaluation 不够。这里有两个关键事实：大量 issue 本身欠规格；真实用户会频繁纠正 agent，但 agent 很少主动澄清。然后看 §3.2 和 §3.3，理解 benchmark 如何从 SWE-Bench Verified 改写成交互环境，以及 simulator 如何被约束，避免信息泄露和高方差。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，最值得看的部分是：Figure 2 的任务流程、user simulator 设计、主表里不同 agent 在 dialogue setting 的排名变化、以及 schema-guided agent 相对 baseline 的增益。若再多花一点时间，建议看自动 dialogue evaluation 的定义，因为这部分决定了 benchmark 是否只是在“多加一个聊天接口”，还是确实能测到交互质量。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，初始 query 的信息遮蔽程度如何控制；遮蔽太少，dialogue 变成装饰，遮蔽太多，又可能把任务变成猜谜。第二，simulator 是否会把 benchmark 变成“对 simulator prompt 的适配”。第三，schema-guided agent 的收益到底来自结构化对话，还是来自更长、更谨慎的 prompting。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a clear gap in coding-agent evaluation: existing SWE benchmarks mostly assume a fully specified issue and measure autonomous repository repair, while real usage is interactive and often underspecified. In practice, users clarify requirements, reject wrong assumptions, and steer the agent mid-trajectory. The paper reformulates repository-level software repair into a dialogue-driven benchmark, so the key question becomes whether an agent can ask useful questions, recover missing specification through interaction, and still produce a test-passing patch.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training, agent training, and evaluation design. The main takeaway is operationally important: stronger coding models do not automatically become stronger interactive coding agents. That has implications for training data construction and reward design. If agent SFT/RL data mostly contains single-turn, fully specified coding tasks, the model has little incentive to learn clarification behavior. It also matters for evaluation: patch success alone hides whether the agent failed because of coding, planning, or dialogue. The contribution is best viewed as a benchmark correction for an important missing capability rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, the benchmark reformulation. Starting from SWE-Bench Verified, the full issue text is no longer given to the agent upfront. Instead, each task begins with a fixed initial user query that only partially exposes the problem. The agent keeps its normal programming actions but gains an additional message_user action, allowing it to ask follow-up questions and receive replies. This changes the task from pure code repair to joint specification elicitation plus code repair.

Second, the user simulator. Rather than using an unconstrained chat model, the paper builds a persona-grounded simulator whose responses are anchored to the full issue text. The design goal is twofold: preserve faithfulness to the original task specification, and produce realistic user-style interaction without leaking omniscient information. This is an important benchmarking choice. A free-form simulator would be cheaper to build but much noisier and less reproducible; a tightly grounded simulator makes automatic evaluation more stable.

Third, the schema-guided agent. The proposed agent is informed by dialogue theory and uses an explicit interaction schema to structure user communication, such as clarification, assumption checking, progress reporting, and decision requests. This is more than adding a prompt like “ask the user when needed.” The point is to make dialogue a structured policy component rather than incidental text generation. In many off-the-shelf coding agents, dialogue is either underused or poorly timed; the schema is intended to make asking behavior purposeful and actionable.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments support three main claims. First, benchmark results show that stronger coding models in the standard autonomous setting do not necessarily rank higher in the dialogue setting. That is the central empirical result: interactive competence is not a free byproduct of better code generation.

Second, the proposed schema-guided agent improves over strong baselines by 3 to 14 percent, according to the paper’s headline numbers. For repository-level SWE tasks, that is a meaningful gain because absolute solve rates are typically low and a few points often correspond to a substantial number of recovered tasks. The paper argues that the gain comes from better clarification and alignment, not just stronger patch synthesis.

Third, the paper augments task success with automatic dialogue-quality evaluation using an LLM judge. This helps separate failure modes: some agents code well but do not communicate, some communicate but ask low-value questions, and some over-query the user. That decomposition is useful because final patch accuracy alone cannot explain why an agent failed.

From the provided full text, the benchmark is built by reformulating SWE-Bench Verified, the primary task metric remains resolved percentage via unit tests, and dialogue-level metrics are added on top. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking the exact task count, simulator settings, message frequency statistics, and the correlation between dialogue quality and task resolution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction. The most important setup is why fully autonomous SWE evaluation is insufficient: many real issues are underspecified, and users frequently correct agents while agents rarely seek clarification. Then read the benchmark reformulation and simulator sections carefully, especially how the environment is modified and how the simulator is constrained to avoid information leakage and high variance.

If you only spend 20 to 30 minutes, focus on the task-flow figure, the simulator design, the main ranking table showing how agents reorder under dialogue evaluation, and the ablation or comparison for the schema-guided agent. If you have more time, read the dialogue-quality evaluation section, because that determines whether the benchmark measures meaningful interaction quality or merely adds a chat channel.

Three questions are worth probing. How much information is hidden in the initial query? If too little is hidden, dialogue becomes cosmetic; if too much is hidden, the task becomes guesswork. Does the simulator introduce a new overfitting target? And does the schema-guided gain come from genuinely better interaction structure or simply from longer, more cautious prompting?

recommendation.zh: 把“交互式澄清”从 demo 拉回可自动评测，方向是对的；读数据构造+user simulator 设计即可，别太相信 3-14% 的绝对数（模拟器偏置风险）。
recommendation.en: It makes interactive clarification measurable rather than a demo; read the dataset construction and user-simulator design, but treat the 3–14% gains cautiously due to simulator bias.

paper.title: SEVRA-BENCH: Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) reviewers are increasingly used in pull-request (PR) workflows, where their approvals help decide which code is merged into a repository. This raises a question that benchmarks for static vulnerability detection or code generation do not address: can an automated reviewer reject a malicious contribution when the attacker controls both the code change and the accompanying PR text? We introduce SEVRA-BENCH (Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents), a bench

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM代码审查Agent的评测未覆盖攻击者同时控制代码变更和PR描述文本的社交工程攻击场景，无法衡量审查Agent被叙事误导、批准带漏洞PR的供应链安全风险。
summary.importance: 提出了代码审查Agent的一个新安全评测维度，对应真实软件供应链攻击路径。其观测到的“文本叙事优先级高于代码事实”的决策偏差，来源于模型预训练阶段形成的归纳偏置，对研究代码模型的鲁棒性、事实优先级判断有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SEVRA-BENCH基准：基于真实CVE漏洞的修复提交，机械回滚补丁重新引入真实漏洞，避免模型生成合成漏洞带来的分布偏差；给同一个漏洞diff搭配15种受控的社交工程叙事框架（包括紧急性声称、已获审批表述、权威援引等），固定diff不变只改文本，分离漏洞本身的可检测性和审查者对叙事的易感性两个变量；加入良性安全修复PR衡量误拒率。评测时让审查Agent通过标准API访问隔离的Gitea仓库，读取diff、搜索代码，最终给出批准/拒绝决策。
summary.experiments: 基准覆盖2025年CWE Top25中的前10类弱点，包含1062个恶意PR及匹配的良性对照PR。核心指标为相同漏洞diff在不同叙事框架下的批准率变化，可直接量化文本叙事对审查决策的影响幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言的威胁模型定义、基准构建部分的控制变量设计，不需要深究具体模型的评测数值，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for LLM-based code review agents do not evaluate the adversarial scenario where an attacker controls both the vulnerable code diff and accompanying pull request narrative, leaving unmeasured the supply-chain security risk of agents being socially engineered to approve malicious contributions.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a novel security evaluation axis for code review agents, corresponding to a realistic software supply chain attack vector. The observed decision bias — prioritizing persuasive narrative text over direct code evidence — arises from inductive biases learned during pretraining, and is relevant for research on code model robustness and fact prioritization.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEVRA-Bench constructs malicious PRs by mechanically reversing real CVE security patches to reintroduce ground-truth vulnerabilities, avoiding distribution artifacts from model-generated synthetic flaws. Each vulnerable diff is paired with 15 controlled social engineering framings (urgency cues, claims of prior approval, appeals to authority, etc.), with the diff held constant across framings to separate intrinsic vulnerability detectability from susceptibility to narrative manipulation. Benign security-fix PRs are included to measure false rejection rates. Evaluated agents interact with an isolated Gitea instance via standard APIs, read diffs, search code, and emit a binary approve/decline decision.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark covers the top 10 weakness categories from the 2025 CWE Top 25, comprising 1062 malicious PRs paired with matched benign controls. The core metric is approval rate for identical vulnerable diffs across different narrative framings, which directly quantifies the magnitude of narrative influence on review decisions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for threat model definition and the benchmark construction section for controlled variable design. No deep dive into per-model evaluation results is needed for pretraining researchers; expected read time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 填补了代码审查Agent面对社会工程学攻击的评测空白，§2的数据集构建流程可复用为代码预训练安全对齐的评测管线。
recommendation.en: Fills the evaluation gap for code review agents under social engineering attacks; the §2 dataset construction pipeline can be reused as a safety alignment evaluation pipeline for code pretraining.

paper.title: StreamMemBench: Streaming Evaluation of Agent Memory for Future-Oriented Assistance
paper.abstract: A central role of personal-agent memory is to turn stored information and prior interactions into future-oriented assistance. In daily use, useful cues come from what the agent observes and how the user interacts with the agent, and the agent must carry them forward from the current request to similar future tasks. Existing memory benchmarks usually test dialogue recall or task improvement in isolation, leaving the trajectory from streaming observations to later assistance largely untested. We i

summary.core_problem: 现有个人Agent memory评测benchmark通常只单独测试对话回忆或任务改进，缺乏对'从流式观察中识别有用信息→存储→当前任务使用→交互反馈巩固→后续任务复用'这一完整轨迹的系统性评测。
summary.importance: 提出了一个新的评测维度——从观察证据到初始使用再到后续复用的完整路径可追溯诊断——这对个人Agent memory机制的设计和评估有直接指导意义。区分了'存储了信息'和'能在适当的时候应用信息'两个层次的能力，指出现有系统在后者上表现不佳。
summary.technical_approach: 基于EgoLife第一人称生活记录数据集构建StreamMemBench，围绕从观察流中提取的每个证据锚点构建两步任务序列：(1) 初始任务episode：给Agent一个依赖该证据的辅助请求，Agent响应后接收模拟用户反馈；(2) 后续任务episode：给出一个基于同一证据的不同请求，测试初始交互是否被巩固和复用。通过四个指标诊断：Fidelity（证据是否在任务前被保留）、Feedback Incorporation（反馈是否在同一次交互中被吸收）、Initial Evidence Use（初始响应是否使用了证据）、Follow-up Reuse（后续响应是否复用了证据或交互经验）。
summary.experiments: 在8个memory系统、2个backbone上进行评测，发现当前memory系统在流式评测下面向未来辅助的能力不可靠：系统通常难以在初始任务中使用来自第一人称观察的证据，也难以将交互反馈转化为后续任务中可复用的行为。分析表明这些失效不能仅用存储问题解释，需要关注从观察证据到初始使用、反馈吸收、后续复用的完整路径。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Section 1（动机）和benchmark设计部分（证据锚点概念和两阶段任务设计），以及实验结果中的系统诊断分析。全文阅读约15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for personal agent memory typically test dialogue recall or task improvement in isolation, lacking systematic evaluation of the complete trajectory: identifying useful information from streaming observations → storage → current task use → interaction feedback consolidation → future task reuse.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new evaluation dimension — traceable diagnosis along the full path from observed evidence to initial use, feedback incorporation, and follow-up reuse — with direct implications for designing and evaluating personal agent memory mechanisms. Distinguishes between 'having stored information' and 'being able to apply it at the right time', showing that current systems perform poorly on the latter.
summary_en.technical_approach: StreamMemBench is built on the EgoLife egocentric life-logging dataset. Around each evidence anchor extracted from the observation stream, a two-step task sequence is constructed: (1) initial task episode: the agent receives an assistance request depending on the anchored evidence, then receives simulated user feedback after responding; (2) follow-up task episode: a different request grounded in the same anchor tests whether the initial interaction has been consolidated and can be reused. Four metrics diagnose performance: Fidelity (whether evidence is retained before the task), Feedback Incorporation (whether corrective feedback is absorbed within the same interaction), Initial Evidence Use (whether initial response uses the evidence), and Follow-up Reuse (whether follow-up response reuses evidence or interaction experience).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 memory systems across 2 backbones. Current memory systems are not reliable for future-oriented assistance under streaming evaluation: they often struggle to use evidence from egocentric observations in the initial task and to turn interaction feedback into reusable behavior for the follow-up task. Analysis shows these failures are not explained by storage alone, motivating evaluation that traces the full path from observed evidence to initial use, feedback incorporation, and follow-up reuse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 (motivation) and the benchmark design section (evidence anchor concept and two-phase task design), plus the system diagnosis in the experiments section. Full reading ~15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent 记忆评测的新角度——流式观察到后续复用的链路评估，作为 eval 类有一定设计新意，看 §3 测试构造即可
recommendation.en: Novel angle for agent memory evaluation focused on the streaming observation-to-reuse trajectory; read §3 for test construction only.

paper.title: Same-Origin Policy for Agentic Browsers
paper.abstract: Agentic browsers integrate autonomous AI agents into web browsers, enabling users to accomplish web tasks through natural-language instructions. The same-origin policy (SOP) is a fundamental browser security mechanism that prevents unauthorized automated cross-origin data flows induced by scripts. However, whether SOP remains effective in agentic browsers is an open question that has not been systematically studied. In this work, we bridge this gap. We first observe that an agentic browser can i

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic browser 在跨站点自动操作中可能绕过传统浏览器同源策略、造成跨源数据泄露的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在评测与系统安全边界定义：提出 SOPBench 系统性测 agentic browser 的 SOP 违规，并给出针对性防护机制 SOPGuard。对通用 Agent 安全评测有参考意义，但与 LLM 预训练本身距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先指出 agentic browser 本身可成为新的自动化跨源数据流通道，传统 SOP 只约束脚本，不足以约束代理行为。随后构建 SOPBench 评测 benign 与 attack 场景下的 SOP 违规，再在 BrowserOS 中实现 SOPGuard，对代理动作和跨源信息流做面向 agent 的策略约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明现有 agentic browsers 在正常和攻击场景下都频繁违反 SOP，SOPGuard 可缓解该问题；但未在摘要中给出 benchmark 规模、攻击类型分布、具体模型或量化改善幅度。更适合把它当 agent security benchmark + defense 原型来看。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Dawn Song、Neil Gong，属于安全与系统方向有代表性的研究者；论文主题更接近 agent/browser security，而非语言模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how agentic browsers can violate same-origin policy by turning the browser agent itself into a cross-origin data-flow channel.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation and security-systems framing: SOPBench for systematic SOP-violation testing in agentic browsers, plus SOPGuard as a mitigation. It is relevant to agent safety evaluation, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that classic SOP constrains scripts but not autonomous browser agents. It then introduces SOPBench to evaluate benign and adversarial SOP violations, and implements SOPGuard in BrowserOS to enforce agent-aware controls over actions and cross-origin information flows.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that existing agentic browsers frequently violate SOP in both benign and attack settings, and that SOPGuard mitigates the issue. It does not provide benchmark scale, attack taxonomy, model details, or exact gains in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dawn Song and Neil Gong, both well-known in security and systems. The work is much closer to agent/browser security than to language-model training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 browser agent 或 tool-use 安全，SOPBench 值得存档；对预训练研究员只需看 threat model 和 benchmark 设计，不必细读方法。
recommendation.en: Worth archiving if you work on browser agents or tool-use safety; for pretraining folks, the threat model and benchmark design are the only parts worth skimming.

paper.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
paper.abstract: As autonomous web agents are increasingly deployed to perform real-world tasks, ensuring their safety has become a critical concern. In this work, we study web agent behavior under realistic deceptive interfaces in the e-commerce domain. We introduce WebDecept, a lightweight and configurable plugin framework that enables controlled injection of deceptive interface patterns into existing web environments. Using WebDecept, we instantiate seven deceptive patterns commonly observed on the open web,

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态 Web Agent 在电商页面的欺骗性界面模式下是否会偏离用户目标或违反安全约束。
summary.importance: 这是 Web Agent 安全评测资产。它把广告诱导、域名跳转、购物操控等真实网页中的 deceptive pattern 注入现有环境，用于可控地测量 agent 对 UI 欺骗的鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 WebDecept，一个轻量、可配置的插件框架，在任务执行时从前端注入欺骗性界面元素。它不是训练方法，而是构造可控干预环境，比较不同 deceptive pattern 对 agent 行为的影响，并测试 prompt 约束的缓解效果。
summary.experiments: 作者实例化 7 类常见欺骗模式，包括 targeted advertisements、domain redirection 和 shopping manipulation，并在多个多模态 Web Agent 上做 controlled evaluation。结果表明当前 Web Agent 对多类欺骗界面较敏感，单靠 prompt-based constraints 往往不能稳定避免失败。摘要未给出具体 agent 名称和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 AAII、University of Technology Sydney 和 University of Liverpool。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal web agents remain safe and goal-consistent when exposed to deceptive e-commerce interfaces.
summary_en.importance: This is a web-agent safety benchmark contribution. It provides a controlled way to inject realistic deceptive UI patterns, such as targeted ads, domain redirects, and shopping manipulation, into existing web environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce WebDecept, a lightweight configurable plugin that modifies the frontend during agent execution. The work focuses on controlled evaluation rather than agent training, measuring how different deceptive patterns affect behavior and whether prompt-level constraints mitigate failures.
summary_en.experiments: WebDecept instantiates seven common deceptive patterns and evaluates multiple multimodal web agents. The reported finding is that current web agents are susceptible to several classes of deceptive interfaces, and prompt-based constraints are often insufficient. The abstract does not provide detailed model names or numeric scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are AAII, University of Technology Sydney, and University of Liverpool.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Web agent 安全评测备查即可；读 deceptive pattern 设计，不必细读结果表。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a web-agent safety benchmark reference; read the deceptive-pattern design, not the full result tables.

institutions: AAII, University of Technology Sydney, NSW

paper.title: LoSoNA: A Benchmark for Local Social Norm Adaptation in Group Conversations
paper.abstract: Online group chats are social spaces with local conversational norms that are rarely stated explicitly. The ability and willingness of LLM-based agents to recognize and adapt to these norms remains mostly unexplored. We introduce LoSoNA, a benchmark for local social norm adaptation in multi-party chat. Each scenario gives a subject model a curated group-chat transcript in which non-subject participants demonstrate a hidden local norm, followed by a final elicitor turn that forces a response reve

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 是否能从多人群聊历史中推断未明说的局部社交规范，并在最后一轮回复中适配该规范。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是对话与 agent 行为评测。它关注隐式规范学习，而不是显式安全规则或通用 instruction following；对 alignment eval 有参考价值，但不是基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LoSoNA benchmark。每个场景先给 subject model 一段群聊 transcript，非 subject 参与者在其中展示隐藏局部规范；最后给出 elicitor turn，迫使模型回答并暴露是否推断出该规范。评测包含四种 prompting 条件，控制是否显式提示模型把历史对话当作规范证据。
summary.experiments: 评估 8 个 frontier 与 open-weight 模型。朴素 prompting 下多数模型表现有限；显式 norm-aware prompting 的收益不稳定，Gemini 3.1 Pro 达到 84.2%，Claude Fable 5 达到 81.6%，若干其他模型提升很小或退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark tests whether LLM agents can infer unstated local social norms from multi-party chat history and adapt their final response accordingly.
summary_en.importance: This is a dialogue and agent-behavior evaluation contribution. It targets implicit norm adaptation rather than explicit safety rules or generic instruction following, making it relevant to alignment evaluation but not to foundation-model training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoSoNA gives a subject model a curated group-chat transcript where non-subject participants demonstrate a hidden local norm, followed by an elicitor turn that reveals whether the model inferred that norm. Four prompting conditions vary how explicitly the model is told to treat prior conversation as behavioral evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates eight frontier and open-weight models. Naive prompting remains weak for most models. Explicit norm-aware prompting helps unevenly: Gemini 3.1 Pro reaches 84.2%, Claude Fable 5 reaches 81.6%, while several models see only small gains or regressions.

recommendation.zh: 看数据构造和四种 prompt 条件即可；它测的是社交适配，不会改训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the data construction and the four prompting conditions; it measures social adaptation, not a training prior changer.

paper.title: ToolSense: A Diagnostic Framework for Auditing Parametric Tool Knowledge in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models deployed as agents over large tool catalogs face a critical tool-retrieval bottleneck. As embedding-based retrieval approaches rely on compact encoders that may under-capture specialized tool semantics, parametric tool retrieval addresses this by encoding each tool as a virtual token appended to the LLM vocabulary, fine-tuned in two stages (memorization then retrieval SFT) to use the LLM as a retriever, achieving strong performance on standard ToolBench retrieval benchmarks

summary.core_problem: 现有 parametric tool retrieval benchmark 使用完整指定的查询和约束解码评估，无法真正揭示 LLM 是否理解其工具语义。
summary.importance: 首次提出针对 parametric tool knowledge 的诊断评测框架，自动生成三级模糊度的真实检索 benchmark、MCQ 探测 benchmark 和 QA 探测 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: ToolSense 是一个开源 LLM 驱动的诊断框架，接受任意工具 catalog 作为输入，自动生成：(1) Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB) — 在三级查询模糊度下评估；(2) MCQ 探测 benchmark；(3) QA 探测 benchmark。核心在于暴露 parametric tool retrieval 在真实、模糊查询下的真实能力，而非使用约束解码掩盖缺陷。
summary.experiments: 将 ToolSense 应用于标准 ToolBench retrieval benchmark，对比现有 parametric 方法 (两阶段微调：记忆 + retrieval SFT) 在完整查询 vs 模糊查询下的表现，揭示现有评估的 inflated 结果。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未从摘要中确认，作者来自多所高校/研究机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing parametric tool retrieval benchmarks use fully-specified queries and constrained decoding evaluation, masking whether LLMs truly understand tool semantics.
summary_en.importance: First diagnostic evaluation framework for parametric tool knowledge; automatically generates retrieval benchmarks at three ambiguity tiers plus MCQ and QA probing benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolSense is an open-source LLM-powered diagnostic framework that takes a tool catalog as input and auto-generates: (1) Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB) at three query ambiguity levels; (2) MCQ probing benchmark; (3) QA probing benchmark. Critically exposes true retrieval capability under realistic, ambiguous queries rather than inflated scores via constrained decoding.
summary_en.experiments: Applied to standard ToolBench retrieval benchmarks, comparing existing parametric methods (two-stage fine-tuning: memorization + retrieval SFT) on fully-specified vs ambiguous queries, revealing inflated evaluation results.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliations not confirmed from abstract.

recommendation.zh: 核心贡献是 benchmark 生成框架而非方法，对 agent tool-use 评测研究有参考价值。看 §3-4 benchmark 设计和 Figure 2-3 揭示的现有评估 gap 即可，预训练研究员无需深入。
recommendation.en: Contribution is benchmark generation framework, not methodology. Relevant for agent tool-use evaluation research. Read §3-4 benchmark design and Figs 2-3 on evaluation gaps; pre-training researchers need not go deep.

paper.title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly being developed to accelerate scientific discovery, yet their practical capabilities in real research settings remain poorly understood. Existing benchmarks for AI agents rarely capture the complexity, heterogeneity, and extended reasoning required by scientific work, whereas benchmarks for scientific tasks often reduce research to static, direct problems and provide limited support for interactive evaluation. Here, we introduce SciAgentArena, a systematic benchmark fo

summary.core_problem: 现有 AI Agent 评测基准无法捕捉真实科学研究场景的复杂性、异质性和长程推理需求，而科学任务基准又常将研究简化为静态直接问题，缺乏交互评估支持。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献 — 提出 SciAgentArena，首个系统性评测真实科学研究场景下 AI Agent 能力的基准，约200个任务，含逐步验证和与 Agent 无关的交互环境。
summary.technical_approach: 任务来自跨领域的新兴科学需求；设计逐步验证机制和通用交互环境，支持评测各类 AI Agent 在多尺度科学挑战中的表现。
summary.experiments: 评估发现当前 Agent 能有效参与明确规定的数据分析工作流（任务结构和评估标准清晰时），但在开放性研究任务上表现仍有大幅差距。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI agent benchmarks fail to capture the complexity, heterogeneity, and extended reasoning of real scientific research, while scientific task benchmarks reduce research to static problems with limited interactive evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution — introduces SciAgentArena, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios with ~200 tasks, stepwise verification, and an agent-agnostic interactive environment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tasks drawn from emerging scientific needs across multiple domains; stepwise verification mechanism and generic interactive environment designed to assess diverse AI agents on multi-scale scientific challenges.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation shows current agents contribute effectively to well-specified data-analysis workflows (when task structure and criteria are clear) but remain substantially limited on open-ended research tasks.

recommendation.zh: 科学Agent评测方向的系统benchmark，对预训练研究员来说可用来了解科学推理能力边界，但不直接影响预训练设计，skim 实验结果部分即可。
recommendation.en: Systematic benchmark for scientific agent evaluation, useful for understanding scientific reasoning capability boundaries but does not directly inform pretraining design; skim the results section only.

paper.title: SciR: A Controllable Benchmark for Scientific Reasoning in LLMs
paper.abstract: Three paradigmatic forms of inference recur across scientific reasoning: deduction, induction, and causal abduction. Reliably evaluating LLMs on these in scientific settings is currently out of reach: scientific benchmarks built on human annotations are costly and lack mechanistic ground truth, while synthetic logical-reasoning benchmarks do not resemble real scientific documents. We introduce SciR, a benchmark that combines multi-paradigm reasoning with controllable scientific rendering, anchor

summary.core_problem: 现有科学推理评测很难同时具备真实科学文本形态、可验证机制答案，以及对不同推理类型和难度来源的可控拆分。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测基准。SciR 把演绎、归纳、因果溯因三类科学推理放到同一可控框架中，并用形式对象生成 ground truth，避免只依赖人工标注或纯符号玩具任务。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是先从形式对象生成任务，包括 deduction tree、inductive rule hypothesis、causal graph，再把这些对象渲染成多文档科学语篇。关键设计是把难度拆成两轴：抽取关键信息的难度，以及执行原则性推理的难度，从而能区分模型是读不出证据，还是推理过程失败。
summary.experiments: 论文测试了 6 个模型。摘要显示，两条难度轴都会降低所有模型表现，说明当前模型在科学场景下既受信息定位约束，也受结构化推理约束。由于提供的摘要被截断，未能确认具体模型列表、参数量和分数提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Current scientific-reasoning evaluations rarely combine realistic scientific discourse, mechanistic ground truth, and controllable separation of reasoning types and difficulty sources.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. SciR covers deduction, induction, and causal abduction within one controllable framework, using formal objects to generate verifiable answers rather than relying only on human annotation or toy logical tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark generates tasks from formal structures such as deduction trees, inductive rule hypotheses, and causal graphs, then renders them into multi-document scientific discourse. Its key design is a two-axis difficulty control: the difficulty of extracting relevant evidence and the difficulty of performing the intended inference.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates six models. The supplied abstract reports that increasing either evidence-extraction difficulty or inference difficulty hurts every model. The truncated abstract does not provide the exact model list, parameter scales, or numerical scores.

recommendation.zh: 可读构造方法而非分数；证据抽取和推理难度解耦，这类 eval 更适合诊断预训练缺口。
recommendation.en: Read the construction, not the leaderboard: the clean split between evidence extraction and inference is the useful diagnostic signal for pretraining.

paper.title: Beyond Problem Solving: UOJ-Bench for Evaluating Code Generation, Hacking, and Repair in Competitive Programming
paper.abstract: Despite strong performance in competitive programming, the role of Large Language Models (LLMs) in supporting human learning in the same setting remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce UOJ-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate not only the problem-solving ability of LLMs, but also their ability to identify errors in human-written code -- a crucial educational activity traditionally supported by running test cases over online judge systems. UOJ-Bench consists of three distinct ta

summary.core_problem: 现有竞赛编程评测仅关注代码生成能力，未覆盖LLM识别人类代码错误（hack）、修复错误的能力，无法全面评估LLM在编程教育与实际场景中的价值
summary.importance: 首次提出覆盖代码生成、漏洞挖掘、代码修复三任务的竞赛编程基准，属于评测资产贡献，填补了代码LLM多维度能力评测的空白
summary.technical_approach: 从Universal Online Judge（UOJ）的真实用户提交构建数据集，复用UOJ原生评测基础设施打分，三个任务分别对应生成正确代码、定位错误代码漏洞、修复错误代码通过测试用例
summary.experiments: 在真实竞赛提交构建的数据集上评测，one-shot设置下最强LLM的错误代码识别率不足50%；test-time scaling可将成功率提升至90%以上，但带来极高的计算成本

summary_en.core_problem: Existing competitive programming evaluations only focus on code generation ability, ignoring LLM's capability to identify bugs in human code (hacking) and repair bugs, failing to comprehensively assess LLM's value in programming education and real scenarios.
summary_en.importance: First competitive programming benchmark covering three tasks: code generation, hacking, and code repair; benchmark asset contribution filling the gap in multi-dimensional evaluation of code LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dataset constructed from real user submissions on the Universal Online Judge (UOJ), evaluated using UOJ's native judging infrastructure; three tasks correspond to generating correct code, locating bugs in buggy code, and repairing buggy code to pass test cases.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the dataset built from real competitive submissions: under one-shot setting, even the strongest LLMs achieve less than 50% accuracy in buggy code identification; test-time scaling improves success rate to over 90% but incurs extremely high computational cost.

recommendation.zh: 覆盖代码漏洞挖掘与修复的新基准，可更细粒度诊断预训练模型的代码推理能力，重点看附录的错误类型分布与数据集构建细节
recommendation.en: New code benchmark covering hacking and repair enables fine-grained diagnosis of pretrained code reasoning ability; focus on error type distribution and dataset construction details in the appendix.

paper.title: Does AI Reviewer See the Full Picture? Attacking and Defending Multimodal Peer Review
paper.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) into scientific peer-review workflows introduces novel and significant risks for adversarial manipulation, especially given the multimodal nature of scientific papers where figures, not just text, convey core evidence. This creates a significant gap: current robustness studies on AI peer-review are overwhelmingly text-only. Moreover, the problem is distinct from standard jailbreaking, as a peer-review attack seeks to ind

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI/MLLM 参与论文评审时，图文混合输入可被跨模态对抗操纵、而现有研究几乎只覆盖文本攻击的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测与鲁棒性基准工作。对基座预训练本身不直接给 recipe，但对多模态模型的安全评测、跨模态脆弱性和 judge/model-as-reviewer 可靠性有现实参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PaperGuard，包含三部分：多学科的 multimodal peer-review 数据集；统一的跨模态攻击套件，用于诱导特定评审失效，如抬高分数；以及相应防御机制与评测协议。重点不是通用 jailbreak，而是面向 peer-review 这种目标明确、领域约束强的 targeted failure。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其在多模态 peer-review 场景下系统评估攻击与防御，但未给出具体模型、样本规模和数值结果。若实验设计扎实，价值主要在 benchmark/protocol，而不是方法本身。
summary.authors_note: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill、Arizona State University。Tianlong Chen 在高效训练、鲁棒性和模型系统方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the risk that LLM/MLLM-based peer review can be manipulated through cross-modal attacks, while existing robustness studies are largely text-only.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and robustness benchmark paper. It does not directly change pretraining recipes, but it is relevant for multimodal safety evaluation, cross-modal brittleness, and the reliability of model-as-reviewer systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce PaperGuard, built around three components: a multimodal peer-review dataset spanning scientific domains, a unified suite of cross-modal attacks designed to induce targeted review failures such as score inflation, and corresponding defenses plus evaluation protocols. The focus is not generic jailbreaking but domain-specific targeted failures in peer review.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a systematic evaluation of attacks and defenses in multimodal peer-review settings, but does not provide model names, dataset scale, or quantitative results. If the setup is solid, the main value lies in the benchmark and protocol rather than a new modeling method.
summary_en.authors_note: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and Arizona State University. Tianlong Chen is active in efficient training, robustness, and model systems.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你关心 multimodal judge 或 model-as-evaluator 的脆弱性，只看 benchmark 设计与攻击 taxonomy 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about multimodal judges or model-as-evaluator brittleness, the benchmark design and attack taxonomy are the only parts worth your time.

institutions: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: EvoBrowseComp: Benchmarking Search Agents on Evolving Knowledge
paper.abstract: Search Agents -- large language models augmented with search tools -- have intensified the need for future-proof evaluation benchmarks. Existing benchmarks such as BrowseComp rely on static knowledge, making them vulnerable to test-set contamination and parametric memorization. Consequently, models can achieve high scores through fact recall rather than genuine retrieval, obscuring true browsing competence via reasoning shortcuts.   In this paper, we introduce EvoBrowseComp, an evolving benchmar

summary.core_problem: 解决搜索 agent 评测被静态知识污染的问题，使 benchmark 更能测到真实检索与浏览能力，而不是参数记忆。
summary.importance: 这是 agent eval 方向里相对干净的一类工作。贡献在于 contamination-resistant benchmark 设计，而不是 agent 方法本身。对预训练研究员的价值主要在评测方法论：如何把参数记忆和外部检索能力拆开测。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoBrowseComp，构造 400 个英文和 400 个中文复杂问题，问题通过 live web traversal 合成。数据生成使用三 agent 协作：QA synthesis agent 从实时网页获取新知识并生成问答；information filtering agent 过滤可信度和流行度以阻断参数记忆捷径；high-level guidance agent 将问题整理成需要多步浏览与推理的形式。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 contamination-free、双语和 evolving knowledge，但未给出参评模型、分数区分度、与 BrowseComp 的相关性差异或人类上限。若正文实验扎实，这类 benchmark 对 agent eval 有实际价值；但对 pretrain 本身仍是间接相关。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University，未见顶级基础模型实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses contamination in search-agent evaluation, aiming to measure real browsing competence rather than parametric recall on static knowledge.
summary_en.importance: This is one of the cleaner directions in agent evaluation. The contribution is benchmark design, not a new agent method. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly methodological: how to separate parametric memory from external retrieval ability.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoBrowseComp contains 400 English and 400 Chinese complex questions synthesized through live-web traversal. Data generation uses a three-agent pipeline: a QA synthesis agent gathers fresh web knowledge, an information-filtering agent removes shortcuts via credibility/popularity filtering, and a guidance agent reformulates questions to require multi-step browsing and reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes contamination-free bilingual evaluation over evolving knowledge, but does not provide model rankings, score spread, correlation with BrowseComp, or human ceilings. If the full paper is careful, the benchmark is useful for agent eval, though still only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University; no major frontier foundation-model lab affiliation is evident.

recommendation.zh: 点子是对的：把 search 能力和参数记忆拆开测；但这是 eval 资产，不是方法突破，先看数据构造规则和污染控制实验就够了。
recommendation.en: The idea is right: separate search competence from parametric memory; but this is an eval asset, not a method breakthrough, so just inspect the data-construction rules and contamination controls.

paper.title: Helping Figures Tell their Story! Paper-Grounded Video Generation Explaining Complex Scientific Figures
paper.abstract: Scientific figures compress complex pipelines into a single canvas, yet understanding them requires paper-grounded, step-by-step narration aligned with visual highlights a capability missing from current video generation systems and benchmarks. To address this, we introduce paper-grounded figure-to-video generation: generating narrated, region-grounded walkthrough videos from a figure and its paper. We propose MINARD (Multimodal Interpretation of Narrated Architecture via Region Decomposition),

summary.core_problem: 让模型基于论文正文和科学图表，生成带旁白、按区域高亮的解释视频。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成任务定义、方法管线和评测资源。它把科学图表理解、文档 grounding、区域级视觉指代和视频化讲解放在同一任务里，对 VLM/多模态生成评测有一定参考，但不是基座预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MINARD 管线：先从论文和图表生成忠实于论文内容的分步旁白，再把旁白片段顺序对齐到图中区域，形成可视化 walkthrough。论文还发布 FigTalk benchmark，并设计顺序 grounding 和组件级 grounding 指标，用于衡量解释是否对应正确图表区域。
summary.experiments: 在 FigTalk 上比较 MINARD 与已有方法。摘要称 MINARD 在自动指标和人工评估中生成更接近人类、对论文更忠实的旁白，并在 narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding 上优于现有方法；未在摘要中给出模型参数量、训练数据规模或具体提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, College Park；Jordan Boyd-Graber 长期从事 NLP、问答、信息检索和人机评测相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate narrated, region-grounded explanatory videos for scientific figures using both the figure and the paper text.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a new multimodal generation task, a pipeline, and an evaluation asset. It combines scientific figure understanding, document grounding, visual region reference, and video-style explanation. It is relevant to VLM evaluation and multimodal generation, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose MINARD, a pipeline that first generates paper-faithful step-by-step narrations and then sequentially grounds each narration segment to figure regions. They also release FigTalk with sequential and component-level grounding metrics to test whether the generated explanation points to the right parts of the figure.
summary_en.experiments: On FigTalk, MINARD is compared against existing approaches. The abstract reports more humanlike and paper-faithful narrations and better narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding under both automatic and human evaluation, but does not provide parameter scale, training data size, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Maryland, College Park. Jordan Boyd-Graber is known for work in NLP, question answering, information retrieval, and human-centered evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和 grounding 指标即可；它对科学 VLM eval 有用，但不改变多模态预训练的建模选择。
recommendation.en: Skim the task definition and grounding metrics; useful for scientific VLM eval, but it does not change multimodal pretraining design choices.

paper.title: Can AI Agents Synthesize Scientific Conclusions?
paper.abstract: Scientific AI agents increasingly retrieve evidence, reason across sources, and synthesize conclusions used in consequential decisions. Yet, their ability to do so in high-stakes domains such as health remains unclear. We introduce SciConBench, a large-scale live benchmark of 9.11K questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews to evaluate open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis. The benchmark draws on an expert-validated automated evaluation pipeline that decomposes conclu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作评估的是科学结论合成，而不是检索、引用或短答案问答。核心问题是：在干净的开放网页环境下，AI agent 能否从分散证据中生成类似系统综述的专家结论，尤其是在健康等高风险场景中。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在评测信号设计。SciConBench 把长程检索、证据筛选、冲突信息整合和结论生成放到同一个任务里，能暴露模型在 factual recall、factual precision、证据覆盖和泄漏依赖上的问题。对基座模型研究的启发主要有两点：一是当前模型的开放域科学综合能力仍受限，不能只看短问答或引用准确率；二是评测必须隔离可检索的标准答案，否则容易把“找到原文结论”误判成“完成科学综合”。
summary.technical_approach: SciConBench 从 Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 构造，包含 9.11K 个问题和专家写作的科学结论，并按月更新，以降低训练集或网页缓存中的泄漏风险。任务要求 agent 使用开放网页证据生成段落式结论。SciConHarness 提供 clean-room 评测环境，控制搜索和浏览工具，避免模型直接访问 ground-truth artifacts。评测管线先把参考结论和模型结论拆成 atomic facts，再用 LLM judge 评估 factual precision、factual recall 和 F1。precision 衡量生成事实是否正确，recall 衡量是否覆盖参考结论中的关键事实。这比只看整体相似度或引用匹配更适合长结论评测。
summary.experiments: 作者评估了 8 个前沿模型和 deep research agent。clean-room 条件下，最佳系统 o3-deep-research 的 factual F1 只有 0.337。与不受控设置相比，clean-room 评测使各系统 F1 下降 0.02 到 0.172，说明不少表面性能来自直接检索到标准综述或相关结论，而不是从原始证据中完成综合。作者还审计了 Google AI Overview、OpenEvidence 等面向用户的系统；即使这些系统可以访问 ground-truth artifacts，F1 也只有 0.361 到 0.522，并且会出现结论不完整或互相矛盾的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看数据构造部分、SciConHarness 的 clean-room 设计、atomic fact 评测流程，以及 clean-room 与 unconstrained 设置的结果差异。对预训练研究员，更值得关注的是评测协议如何处理泄漏、事实覆盖如何被量化，以及这种长程科学综合任务能否转化为 post-training 数据或 verifier 信号。具体健康领域结论不是重点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies scientific conclusion synthesis rather than retrieval, citation grounding, or short-form QA. The central question is whether AI agents can synthesize expert-style conclusions from open-web scientific evidence under a controlled evaluation setup, especially for high-stakes health questions.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is mainly in evaluation design. SciConBench combines long-horizon retrieval, evidence filtering, conflict resolution, and conclusion writing into one measurable task. It shows that current agents still struggle with factual coverage and correctness when they cannot directly retrieve the reference artifact. The work is also a useful reminder that leakage control matters for agent benchmarks: finding the original review conclusion is not the same as synthesizing a conclusion from evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: SciConBench is built from the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews and contains 9.11K questions paired with expert-written conclusions. The benchmark is updated monthly to reduce leakage. SciConHarness provides a clean-room evaluation harness with controlled search and browsing tools, limiting access to ground-truth artifacts. The evaluation pipeline decomposes both model outputs and reference conclusions into atomic facts, then uses LLM-based judges to compute factual precision, factual recall, and F1. Precision measures whether generated facts are correct; recall measures whether the key reference facts are covered.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 8 frontier models and deep research agents. Under clean-room evaluation, the best system, o3-deep-research, reaches only 0.337 factual F1. Compared with unconstrained settings, clean-room evaluation lowers F1 by 0.02 to 0.172, indicating that part of the apparent capability comes from retrieving ground-truth artifacts. The paper also audits consumer-facing agents such as Google AI Overview and OpenEvidence. Even with access to relevant artifacts, these systems achieve only 0.361 to 0.522 F1 and often produce incomplete or contradictory conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction, the SciConHarness leakage-control protocol, the atomic-fact evaluation pipeline, and the clean-room versus unconstrained comparison. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the useful parts are the evaluation signal, the leakage analysis, and the possibility of turning this task into training data or verifier supervision. The domain-specific medical findings are less central.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和 clean-room drop；它对预训练不直接给 recipe，但能校准“deep research agent 已会科学综合”的乐观判断。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and the clean-room drop; it gives no pretraining recipe, but it calibrates overly optimistic claims about deep research agents doing scientific synthesis.

paper.title: RAIL: Rethinking Auditory Intelligence in Large Audio-Language Models with a CHC-Grounded Benchmark
paper.abstract: Humans process rich auditory environments through tightly integrated cognitive capabilities such as audio perception, audio reasoning, and memory. Despite recent progress in large audio-language models (LALMs) across speech understanding and multimodal audio reasoning, current evaluation paradigms remain largely task- or modality-centric, focusing on end performance while overlooking underlying auditory cognitive behaviours. This reveals a fundamental gap between how auditory cognition is unders

summary.core_problem: 现有 large audio-language model 评测多按任务或模态给分，难以刻画模型是否具备类似人类的听觉感知、推理和记忆能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 与 evaluation protocol。RAIL 用 CHC 认知框架重构音频语言模型评测，把听觉智能拆成多个认知能力维度，这对音频 LM 和统一多模态预训练的能力诊断有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RAIL 评测范式，基于 Cattell-Horn-Carroll 认知理论，将 auditory cognition 形式化为五类核心能力，并设计结构化任务来测试模型如何处理、保持和整合声音信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出被评测模型、样本规模和具体排名；可以确认的是它面向 LALMs，覆盖 speech understanding 与 multimodal audio reasoning 之外的认知行为评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Current large audio-language model evaluations are mostly task- or modality-centric and do not directly measure auditory perception, reasoning, and memory as cognitive behaviors.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. RAIL grounds audio-language evaluation in the CHC cognitive framework, which is useful for diagnosing audio LMs and unified multimodal pretraining systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAIL formalizes auditory cognition into five core capabilities using the Cattell-Horn-Carroll theory and turns them into structured tasks that probe how models process, retain, and integrate auditory information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, dataset size, or numerical results. It states that the benchmark targets LALMs and goes beyond speech understanding and task-level multimodal audio reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 适合看任务分解表，不必迷信总分；音频 LM 预训练更需要这种能力轴而非 ASR 式指标。
recommendation.en: Read the capability taxonomy rather than the aggregate score; audio LM pretraining needs these axes more than ASR-style metrics.

paper.title: AI Coding Agents Can Reproduce Social Science Findings
paper.abstract: Recent anecdotal evidence suggests that AI coding agents can reproduce published findings when provided with original data and code; yet systematic evaluation across social sciences remains limited. Existing evaluation benchmarks are insufficient, either small or conflate agent performance with problems in the reproduction materials themselves, such as code that fails to execute correctly. Here we introduce SocSci-Repro-Bench, a benchmark of 221 tasks spanning four disciplines and 13 substantive

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答一个更干净的问题：当前 frontier coding agents 在给定原始数据和代码的前提下，究竟能否稳定复现社会科学论文结果，而不是被 benchmark 本身的材料缺陷混淆。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 设计。它把“agent 不会复现”和“原始复现材料本来就坏”这两件事拆开，构造了更可解释的 coding-agent 评测集。这对 agent eval 设计有参考价值，也能给 post-train/agent 训练提供更干净的目标信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SocSci-Repro-Bench，收集 221 个任务，覆盖四个学科和 13 个主题领域，并显式区分两类样本：一类是用公开材料可完全复现的研究，另一类是因缺失数据等原因可证明不可复现的研究。这样可以把 agent 的执行、调试、环境适配和研究复现能力，与数据材料缺陷分离开来。随后评测 Claude Code 与 Codex 两个 coding agents。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 221 个任务。结果上，Claude Code 与 Codex 都能复现相当比例的社会科学发现，且 Claude Code 明显优于 Codex；其复现率高于先前一般 LLM-based agents 的报告。摘要未给出具体成功率、运行预算和 pass criteria，因此读正文时应重点看任务过滤规则、环境标准化和评分协议是否足够严格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Oxford、University of Zurich、Carnegie Mellon University、New York University。Joshua Tucker 在计算社会科学与政治传播方向较知名，但这不是基座模型团队论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a cleaner question: can frontier coding agents actually reproduce published social-science findings when given original data and code, without conflating agent failure with broken reproduction materials?
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is benchmark design. It separates agent incapability from defects in the original replication package, yielding a more interpretable coding-agent evaluation setup. That is useful for agent eval design and for cleaner post-training targets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce SocSci-Repro-Bench with 221 tasks across four disciplines and 13 domains, explicitly separating studies that are fully reproducible from those that are demonstrably non-reproducible due to missing data or similar issues. This isolates agent execution, debugging, environment adaptation, and reproduction ability from dataset/package defects. They then evaluate Claude Code and Codex.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 221 tasks. Both Claude Code and Codex reproduce a substantial share of findings, with Claude Code clearly outperforming Codex; the reported rates exceed prior reports for general LLM-based agents. The abstract does not provide exact success rates, compute budgets, or pass criteria, so the key thing to inspect is the filtering protocol, environment standardization, and scoring rigor.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Oxford, University of Zurich, Carnegie Mellon University, and New York University. Joshua Tucker is well known in computational social science, though this is not a base-model lab paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 设计是干净的：它把 agent 失败和材料坏账拆开了；只看任务筛选与 scoring protocol 就够。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark design is clean: it separates agent failure from broken materials; read the task curation and scoring protocol, not the whole story.

paper.title: Claw-SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating OpenClaw-style Agent Harnesses on Coding Tasks
paper.abstract: General-purpose agents such as OpenClaw are increasingly used as autonomous tool users, but their coding ability is difficult to measure under SWE-bench: a generic agent does not by itself satisfy the clean Docker workspace, patch, and prediction contract required for scoring. We introduce Claw-SWE-Bench, a multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark and adapter protocol that makes heterogeneous agent harnesses, or claws, comparable under fair settings including a fixed prompt, runtime budget, worksp

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 coding agent harness 无法在 SWE-bench 风格设置下被公平比较的问题，尤其是不同执行脚手架在工作区、补丁提取和评分协议上不兼容。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测协议与基准资产工作，不是新 agent 方法。价值在于把 OpenClaw 一类通用工具使用型 agent 拉到统一约束下比较，减少“脚手架差异掩盖模型能力”的噪声，对后续 coding agent 评测更干净。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Claw-SWE-Bench 及配套 adapter protocol，统一固定 prompt、运行时预算、Docker/workspace contract、patch extraction 和 evaluator；基于 SWE-bench-Multilingual 与 SWE-bench-Verified-Mini 清理 future-commit 泄漏后构建 350 个实例，覆盖 8 种语言、43 个仓库；另给出一个通过 17 个校准列做 cost-aware、rank-aware 选择的 80 题 Lite 子集。
summary.experiments: 完整基准含 350 个 issue-resolution 实例，Lite 含 80 个实例。论文报告在 full benchmark 上，OpenClaw 配最小 direct-diff adapter 的得分很低，说明通用 agent 若不做专门工程适配，很难在 SWE-bench 风格任务上稳定满足补丁与执行契约。由于给出的摘要截断，具体分数和对比模型细节未完全可见。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 TokenRhythm Technologies、Infinigence AI、北京大学、香港城市大学、上海交通大学等。机构组合偏工程评测与系统落地，不是基座预训练团队。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of fair comparability for general-purpose coding agent harnesses under SWE-bench-style evaluation, where workspace, patch extraction, and scoring contracts differ across systems.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution rather than a new agent method. Its value is in normalizing OpenClaw-style tool-using agents under a shared contract, reducing harness-induced variance that otherwise obscures actual model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Claw-SWE-Bench and an adapter protocol that standardize prompt, runtime budget, Docker/workspace contract, patch extraction, and evaluator. The benchmark contains 350 issue-resolution instances across 8 languages and 43 repositories, built from SWE-bench-Multilingual and SWE-bench-Verified-Mini after future-commit cleanup. It also releases an 80-instance Lite subset selected via a cost-aware, rank-aware procedure over 17 calibration columns.
summary_en.experiments: The full benchmark has 350 instances and the Lite version has 80. On the full benchmark, OpenClaw with a minimal direct-diff adapter scores poorly, suggesting that generic agents without task-specific engineering struggle to satisfy the patch and execution contract required by SWE-bench-style coding evaluation. The abstract is truncated, so exact scores and full baselines are not visible here.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from TokenRhythm Technologies, Infinigence AI, Peking University, City University of Hong Kong, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The team profile is more evaluation/system-oriented than foundation-model pretraining-oriented.

recommendation.zh: 做 coding agent eval 的人可以收下协议设计，但对预训练几乎没有直接方法增益；看任务清洗和 adapter contract 即可，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about coding-agent evaluation hygiene, but it offers little direct pretraining signal; skim the cleanup protocol and adapter contract, then move on.

paper.title: GraphInfer-Bench: Benchmarking LLM's Inference Capability on Graphs
paper.abstract: Graph analysis underlies many applications whose answers cannot be looked up in a single record or retrieved along a path: laundering rings, drug repurposing, user preference, and scientific theme are all inferred from a node together with its neighbourhood. We introduce GraphInfer-Bench, a benchmark for whether LLMs can perform this graph inference: producing an open-ended answer that no single node supports and no path retrieves. Existing graph-QA protocols cannot test this capability: algorit

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM 是否能基于一个节点及其邻域做开放式图推断，而不是从单节点或路径中直接检索答案。
summary.importance: 贡献是 GraphInfer-Bench，一个面向图归纳推断的评测集。它补齐了现有 graph-QA 主要测试算法模拟、节点分类、KG-QA 或路径检索的问题，但对基座预训练方法的直接反馈有限。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 Description 和 Comparison 两类共五个任务，要求答案不能由单个节点或单条路径支持，而需要综合局部子图区域信息。数据自动构造，并经过四层质量控制筛选。
summary.experiments: 发布 42,000 个样本，覆盖六个真实世界图。摘要提到评测四类方法，但未给出完整模型列表、分数或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark tests whether LLMs can perform open-ended inference over a node and its neighborhood, rather than retrieving answers from a single node or path.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is GraphInfer-Bench, an evaluation suite for graph-level inferential reasoning. It targets a gap left by algorithm simulation, node classification, KG-QA, and path-retrieval-style graph QA, though its direct impact on pretraining methodology is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines five tasks under Description and Comparison, where the answer is not supported by any single node or path and must be inferred from a graph region. Samples are generated automatically and filtered through a four-layer quality-control process.
summary_en.experiments: The release contains 42,000 samples across six real-world graphs. The abstract says four method families are evaluated, but does not provide the full model list or quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 作为图推断 eval 备查即可；若关心 LLM 是否真会聚合邻域信息，看任务构造和质控流程。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a graph-inference eval reference; if needed, read only the task construction and quality-control protocol.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: 4DP-QA: Scalable QA for 4D Perception in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite recent advances, Vision Language Models (VLMs) still struggle to grasp the dynamics of the world. We note that the ability to reason about a 4D scene, challenging in itself, is further complicated by two factors. First, VLMs observe motion indirectly via its projection onto 2D images. Second, existing datasets fail to disentangle object and camera motion. To address these challenges, we present a QA generation pipeline that focuses on motion-related scene understanding. We take particula

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 VLM 难以理解 4D 场景动态，尤其难以区分相机运动与物体真实运动的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是数据与评测资产，加上一套面向运动理解的 QA 生成流程。它对原生多模态预训练有间接启发，尤其是视频/时序 VLM 需要什么监督信号，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 4D Perception QA 生成管线，核心是同时使用传统 tracking 和新定义的 True-Motion Tracking，把物体运动放到固定参考系中描述，以减少相机运动和物体运动的纠缠；基于此生成 400K 训练样本和 2.2K benchmark。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 400K 训练样本和 2.2K benchmark。实验方式是用该数据训练现有模型，并在外部 benchmark 上验证性能提升。摘要未给出具体模型规模、基线名称和提升幅度，因此目前更像数据有效性的初步证明，而不是范式级方法结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yale University；摘要中未出现可明确识别的业界标志性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the difficulty VLMs have in understanding 4D scene dynamics, especially disentangling camera motion from true object motion.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a data-generation and evaluation asset, plus a motion-focused QA pipeline. It is indirectly useful for native multimodal pretraining, especially for what supervision video/time-aware VLMs may need, but it is still one step removed from core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a 4D Perception QA generation pipeline. Its key idea is to combine standard tracking with a new True-Motion Tracking formulation that describes motion in a fixed reference frame, reducing entanglement between camera and object motion. This is used to build a 400K-sample training set and a 2.2K benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 400K training samples and a 2.2K benchmark. Existing models are trained on the new data and evaluated on an external benchmark, showing gains. The abstract does not provide model sizes, baselines, or exact margins, so the evidence currently reads as a useful data signal rather than a paradigm shift.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Yale University; no clearly identifiable high-profile industry author can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做视频/时序 VLM，值得看它怎样把 camera motion 从 supervision 里剥开；否则读数据构造部分就够，方法本身不深。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the supervision design that disentangles camera motion from object motion in video VLMs; otherwise, the data-construction section is enough.

paper.title: Mind the Gap: Can Frontier LLMs Pass a Standardized Office Proficiency Exam?
paper.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Model (LLM) agents for computer automation is accelerating, yet their ability to navigate complex, professional-grade productivity software is largely untested. We argue that Office automation is an ideal environment for benchmarking document-automation capability, as it requires long-horizon planning and reasoning, precise parameter configuration, and multi-application integration. To quantify this capability, we introduce an evaluation based on China's National

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的核心问题不是 Office 自动化方法本身，而是评测缺口：现有 agent benchmark 很少真正覆盖知识工作里最常见、也最容易暴露长程执行缺陷的办公软件环境。作者要回答的是，frontier LLM 和 coding agent 在真实、标准化、可机器评分的 Office 任务上到底能做到什么程度，以及它们失败主要卡在执行层、规划层，还是 Office 语义层。为此，论文把中国 NCRE 的 Word/Excel/PowerPoint 实操考试转成一个可复现实验基准 OfficeEval，用统一 rubric 去测单轮代码生成和自主 coding-agent 两种范式。
summary.importance: 从基座模型研究视角，这篇论文的价值主要在评测资产和误差分解，而不在提出新的训练方法。它的重要性有三点。第一，Office 环境比网页导航或代码补全更接近日常知识工作，任务天然是长链条、多步骤、跨应用、强约束的，这类环境能更早暴露模型在工具使用、状态跟踪、参数精确配置上的短板。第二，基准来自成熟的人类标准化考试，评分规则细到 7,118 个 machine-gradable criteria，避免了很多 agent benchmark 里常见的主观 judge 噪声。第三，论文给出的诊断很有信息量：强 agent 的代码执行成功率已经接近 98–99%，但操作语义正确率仍然低，说明当前瓶颈不再只是“代码能不能跑”，而是“是否真正理解 Office 对象模型、格式语义和任务约束”。这对 post-train、tool-use 数据合成、环境交互预训练都有直接启发。若从严格的预训练研究相关性看，它更偏 eval，但属于高质量、可迁移的 agent capability benchmark。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文的主要贡献是 benchmark construction 和 evaluation protocol，而不是新模型。OfficeEval 从 NCRE 一级、二级 MS Office 模块中抽取 200 道实操题，覆盖 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 三类应用，并保留原始评分 rubric 的点数分配。每道题都不是简单问答，而是要求模型对真实文档执行一串互相依赖的操作，例如格式设置、公式与函数、图表与透视表、邮件合并、动画与版式调整等。最终总共拆成 7,118 个可机器判分的 criteria，用 Score Rate 作为统一指标，即模型拿到的 rubric 分数占比。

评测设置分两类。第一类是 single-turn code generation：给模型任务说明和相关文件，让它一次性输出完成任务的代码。第二类是 autonomous coding agent：允许模型在更接近真实 agent 的循环中规划、编写、执行、修正代码。这个区分很关键，因为它把“模型能力”与“agent scaffold 带来的执行恢复能力”分开了。论文还做了中英文指令版本对照，用来检查语言是否是主要瓶颈；由于任务原始语言是中文，而参测模型大多具备多语能力，这个设计能帮助判断失败是否来自语言理解，还是来自 Office 操作语义本身。

另一个方法亮点是 error taxonomy。作者没有停留在总分，而是把错误拆成 execution crash 与 logic/operation errors。前者指代码无法运行、环境调用失败、脚本崩溃等；后者指代码能运行，但生成的文档、表格、幻灯片不符合 rubric 要求。这个拆分很重要，因为很多 agent 论文把“能跑通”当作很大进展，但在 Office 这种高约束环境里，真正难的是细粒度语义正确性。论文因此把 benchmark 从单纯排行榜，提升成了诊断工具。
summary.experiments:
核心结果很明确。单轮代码生成范式下，没有任何模型达到 practical subset 的 60 分参考线；最好的 Claude Opus 4.7 只有 36.6% SR。进入 autonomous coding-agent 范式后，成绩明显上升，Claude Code 达到 53.0%，Codex 达到 68.8%，后者超过了 60 分参考线，但仍显著低于 95.5% 的 community-reference score。模型间差异也很大，最低如 Grok-4.1-fast 只有 2.8% SR，说明“frontier API”标签并不自动转化为 Office 自动化能力。

更有价值的是误差分解。论文发现，在较强的 coding-agent 设置下，代码执行成功率可以从不足 50% 提升到 98–99%，但操作正确率仍然偏低。这意味着 agent scaffold、工具调用和自我修复已经能解决大量“脚本跑不起来”的问题，但离“按要求把文档改对”还有明显距离。换句话说，当前瓶颈从 execution robustness 转向 domain-semantic accuracy。

论文还利用 NCRE 的一级/二级结构分析难度梯度，通常可以看到 Level 2 任务显著更难，因为它包含更复杂的 Excel 操作、跨对象格式控制和 PowerPoint 动画等。中英文版本对照实验则用于检验语言因素；从论文主叙事看，语言不是主要矛盾，真正困难在于 Office-specific semantics 和长程多步依赖。若阅读全文，建议特别留意各应用维度的拆分结果，因为 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 往往对应不同类型的失败模式：Excel 更偏公式与结构逻辑，Word 更偏格式与版式细节，PowerPoint 更偏对象层级与视觉布局约束。
summary.reading_guide:
先看 benchmark 构建部分，尤其是任务来源、rubric 提取、machine grading 设计。这里决定了这个基准是否只是“把考试题搬上来”，还是一个真正可复现、可比较、可诊断的评测资产。重点确认三件事：评分是否客观、任务是否覆盖真实 Office 工作流、参考阈值 60 分与 95.5% community reference 分别代表什么。

第二个重点是主结果表。阅读时不要只盯总分，要同时看 single-turn 与 agent 两种范式的差距，以及不同模型之间的离散程度。这个差距本身就是结论：agent scaffold 能显著改善执行，但不能自动补上 Office 语义理解。

第三个重点是 error taxonomy 和应用维度拆分。若只看总 SR，很难知道模型到底是死在环境调用、代码生成，还是细节操作。论文最有启发的部分恰恰是把“能运行”和“做正确”分开。若你关心 post-train 数据构造、tool-use 训练或环境交互式评测，这部分最值得细读。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：1）Introduction；2）OfficeEval 构建与评分协议；3）主结果表；4）错误分析；5）语言对照实验。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若要深挖，可继续看附录中的任务示例和评分细则，这些内容对设计 agent 训练数据很有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation gap rather than a new Office automation method. The central question is whether frontier LLMs and coding agents can actually operate professional productivity software at a level comparable to standardized human certification, and if not, where they fail: execution, planning, or Office-specific semantics. To answer this, the authors convert the practical component of China's National Computer Rank Examination (NCRE) into OfficeEval, a benchmark built from real Word, Excel, and PowerPoint tasks with machine-checkable scoring rubrics.
summary_en.importance: Its value is primarily as an evaluation asset and a diagnostic study. For foundation-model researchers, the benchmark matters because Office automation is a strong stress test for long-horizon tool use: it requires precise parameter settings, stateful multi-step execution, and cross-application workflows. Unlike many existing agent benchmarks, the tasks are not synthetic and the scoring is not based on subjective LLM judges. The benchmark inherits 7,118 machine-gradable criteria from a mature human exam system, which makes the signal much cleaner. The most useful finding is the gap between execution success and semantic correctness. Strong coding agents can get code to run at 98-99% success rates, yet still score poorly on the actual task rubric. That suggests the bottleneck is shifting from raw code generation or tool invocation toward domain-specific semantic understanding of Office object models, formatting rules, and task constraints. This is more of an eval paper than a pretraining paper, but it is highly relevant to post-training, tool-use data synthesis, and environment-grounded capability assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is benchmark construction and evaluation protocol. OfficeEval is derived from the Level 1 and Level 2 MS Office practical exams in the NCRE. The benchmark contains 200 tasks spanning Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and preserves the original rubric structure and point allocations. These are not short QA items. Each task requires a sequence of interdependent operations on real documents, spreadsheets, or presentations, such as formatting, formulas, pivot tables, chart customization, mail merge, animation settings, and layout edits. The full benchmark is decomposed into 7,118 machine-gradable criteria, and performance is reported as Score Rate (SR), the percentage of rubric points earned.

The evaluation compares two paradigms. The first is single-turn code generation, where the model receives the task and relevant files and outputs code in one shot. The second is an autonomous coding-agent setup, where the model can iteratively plan, write code, execute it, inspect outcomes, and revise. This distinction is important because it separates raw model competence from the recovery and iteration benefits provided by an agent scaffold.

Another strong design choice is the bilingual setup. Since the original tasks are in Chinese, the authors also construct English-translated versions of all tasks, documents, and scoring criteria. This allows them to test whether language understanding is the main bottleneck or whether the harder issue is Office-specific semantic execution.

The paper's most informative methodological addition is its error taxonomy. Instead of reporting only aggregate scores, it distinguishes execution crashes from logic or operation errors. Execution failures include code crashes and environment-level failures. Logic errors correspond to cases where code runs but the resulting Office artifact does not satisfy the rubric. This turns the benchmark into a diagnostic instrument rather than just a leaderboard.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline results are straightforward. Under the single-turn code generation setting, no model reaches the 60-point reference threshold for the practical subset. The best model, Claude Opus 4.7, achieves only 36.6% SR. Under the autonomous coding-agent setting, performance improves substantially: Claude Code reaches 53.0% and Codex reaches 68.8%. Even then, models remain well below the 95.5% community-reference score used as a sanity-check upper baseline. Performance is also highly polarized across models, with some systems such as Grok-4.1-fast dropping to 2.8% SR, showing that frontier branding does not translate directly into Office competence.

The error breakdown is the most useful part of the study. In stronger coding-agent settings, execution success rises from below 50% to around 98-99%, but operation accuracy remains low. In other words, agent scaffolding and iterative repair solve much of the 'can the script run?' problem, but not the 'did it perform the correct Office operation?' problem. That is a meaningful diagnosis for future training work.

The benchmark also supports difficulty analysis through the NCRE Level 1/Level 2 split. Level 2 tasks are naturally harder because they involve more advanced spreadsheet logic, richer formatting constraints, and more complex PowerPoint operations. The Chinese-English comparison is used to test language sensitivity; the paper's overall conclusion is that language is not the dominant issue. The harder challenge is Office-specific semantics under long-horizon, multi-step execution. The per-application breakdown is also worth attention: Excel tends to stress formula and structural reasoning, Word stresses formatting and layout fidelity, and PowerPoint stresses object hierarchy and visual arrangement constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Begin with the benchmark construction section. The key question is whether OfficeEval is merely a repackaged exam or a rigorous, reproducible benchmark. Pay attention to task sourcing, rubric extraction, machine grading, and the meaning of the two reference points: the 60-point threshold and the 95.5% community-reference score.

Next, read the main results table with two comparisons in mind: single-turn generation versus autonomous agents, and variance across models. The gap between those two paradigms is itself a major result. It shows that agent scaffolding helps a lot with execution, but does not close the semantic gap.

Then focus on the error taxonomy and the per-application analysis. Aggregate SR alone hides the most important distinction in the paper: running code is not the same as performing the correct Office operation. If your interests include post-training, tool-use supervision, or environment-grounded evaluation, this is the section to read carefully.

If time is limited, a good reading order is: introduction, benchmark construction and scoring protocol, main results, error analysis, and the language comparison. That should take roughly 30-45 minutes. For deeper study, the appendix examples and rubric details are useful because they expose the granularity of the supervision signal and suggest concrete directions for synthetic training data or agent curriculum design.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构成和错误分析；它不改预训练方法，但能校准“Agent 已能办公自动化”的过高预期。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure analysis; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it usefully calibrates claims about office-automation agents.

paper.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
paper.abstract: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model ev

summary.core_problem: WorldOlympiad 解决的是视频世界模型评测过于偏向画质、语义对齐和短期平滑性的问题。它把评测目标转向三个更接近“世界模型”要求的维度：物理规律是否可信，三维几何是否稳定，长程交互是否能按控制信号持续演化。
summary.importance: 这篇更适合作为评测资产泛读。对 LLM 预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在多模态世界模型的能力拆解方式。它提醒一个关键点：视频生成模型如果要承担世界模型角色，常规视觉质量指标不足以反映建模质量。对做原生多模态预训练、视频 token 建模、AR+diffusion 联合建模的人，WorldOlympiad 提供了一组可操作的诊断维度，尤其是把物理、几何和交互控制分开评估，而不是用单一视频质量分数覆盖所有失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: WorldOlympiad 构建了 1,000 条高质量长视频，覆盖 robotics、gaming、real-world 三类场景。其中 robotics 来自 RoboCOIN，筛选 400 条双臂机器人操作视频，主要考察接触、抓取、状态变化和动作一致性；gaming 来自 GameGen-X，采样并切分为最长约 60 秒的视频片段，覆盖玩家导航、视角移动、战斗、技能释放和游戏状态变化；real-world 来自 LVD-2M，包含更开放的运动和相机动态。评测设计分为三条 track。physical track 使用物体分割和 MLLM-as-judge，检查力学、热现象、材料属性等可解释规则是否被遵守。geometry track 对生成视频做 3D 重建，文中提到使用 Gaussian splatting 来诊断跨帧几何一致性。interaction track 关注长程 chunk-by-chunk 生成中，模型是否能跟随控制信号，并保持状态连续。和 VBench、VBench++ 这类偏感知质量与时序平滑性的评测相比，它的差异在于评估对象不是“视频好不好看”，而是“生成过程是否能支撑可控、可持续的世界状态演化”。
summary.experiments: 实验部分 benchmark 了 8 个代表性长视频生成 pipeline，并在三类场景、三条能力轴上分析失效模式。给出的主要发现是：现有长视频模型在长上下文一致性、物理规则遵守、三维结构稳定性和交互控制上都有系统性短板。数据规模是 1,000 条长视频，组成是 400 条机器人视频、400 条游戏视频、200 条真实世界视频。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整结果表，具体模型名称、逐项分数和统计显著性无法确认；可确认的是评测协议强调长程生成和交互式 chunk 生成，而不是短视频单次生成。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构成和三条 track 的 metric 设计：physical track 如何把分割结果和 MLLM judge 结合，geometry track 如何用 3D 重建暴露跨帧结构漂移，interaction track 如何定义 chunk 间控制一致性。若关注视频世界模型预训练，可以重点看失败案例和指标定义，而不是只看 leaderboard 分数。最值得带走的是能力拆分方式：物理、几何、交互三类错误通常不会被 FVD、CLIP score 或普通视频质量指标稳定捕捉。

summary_en.core_problem: WorldOlympiad targets a gap in video world-model evaluation: most existing benchmarks measure visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal smoothness, but do not directly test physical plausibility, 3D consistency, and controllable long-horizon interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation resource rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from how it decomposes video world-model capability. For native multimodal pretraining, video-token modeling, and AR-diffusion hybrid systems, the benchmark makes a useful distinction between perceptual video quality and model reliability as a simulator. A model can produce visually plausible clips while still violating object permanence, geometry, physical dynamics, or user control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 1,000 curated long videos across three domains: 400 robotics videos from RoboCOIN, 400 gaming videos from GameGen-X, and 200 real-world videos from LVD-2M. The robotics subset emphasizes contact, manipulation, gripper motion, and action-consistent state changes. The gaming subset covers navigation, camera control, combat events, skills, and evolving game states, with long videos split into shorter chunks of up to about 60 seconds. The real-world subset adds open-domain motion and camera dynamics. The evaluation is organized into three tracks.
