paper.title: Continual Learning Bench: Evaluating Frontier AI Systems in Real-World Stateful Environments
paper.abstract: Continual learning, the ability of AI systems to improve through sequential experience, has attracted substantial interest, but no high-quality benchmark exists to evaluate it. We introduce Continual Learning Bench (CL-Bench), the first difficult, expert-validated benchmark designed to measure whether LLM-based systems genuinely improve with experience. CL-Bench spans six diverse domains (software engineering, signal processing, disease outbreak forecasting, database querying, strategic game-pla

summary.core_problem: 现有持续学习评测仅使用记忆召回、离线准确率等代理指标，无法有效衡量LLM系统的在线持续学习能力，缺乏覆盖真实领域的高质量基准。
summary.importance: 为持续预训练、测试时自适应、LLM代理的持续学习能力评测提供了标准化基准，其隔离基础模型能力、引入概念漂移的任务设计思路，也能为持续预训练的评测体系构建提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建CL-Bench基准，覆盖软件工程、信号处理、疫情预测等6个真实领域，所有任务经领域专家验证，设计为包含跨实例共享的可在线发现的潜在结构，部分任务引入概念漂移模拟真实环境变化；新增增益指标衡量在线经验带来的性能提升，隔离基础模型能力的干扰。
summary.experiments: 对前沿模型和多种代理架构的大规模评测显示，朴素上下文学习的效果优于专门设计的持续学习机制，当前系统普遍存在早期错误信念难以修正的问题，可靠的在线自适应能力仍未实现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章的基准设计准则、第4章的任务说明，第5章的前沿模型评测结论值得关注，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing continual learning evaluations rely on proxy metrics such as memory recall and offline accuracy, and cannot effectively measure the online continual learning capability of LLM systems, with a lack of high-quality benchmarks covering real-world domains.
summary_en.importance: It provides a standardized benchmark for evaluating continual learning capabilities of continual pretraining methods, test-time adaptation systems and LLM agents. Its task design principles of isolating base model capability and introducing concept drift also inform evaluation system construction for continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The CL-Bench benchmark covers 6 real-world domains including software engineering, signal processing and disease outbreak forecasting, with all tasks validated by domain experts. Tasks are designed to contain learnable latent structure shared across instances that can only be discovered online, and some variants introduce concept drift to simulate real-world environment changes. A gain metric is added to measure performance improvement from online experience, eliminating the interference of base model capability.
summary_en.experiments: Large-scale evaluation of frontier models and various agent architectures shows that naive in-context learning outperforms specially designed continual learning mechanisms. Current systems commonly fail to correct early incorrect beliefs, and reliable online adaptation remains an unsolved problem.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on benchmark design criteria in Section 3, task descriptions in Section 4, and frontier model evaluation conclusions in Section 5. Estimated reading time is 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 首个专家级持续学习benchmark，gain metric设计有参考价值；对pretrain的直接启示有限，读§3评测设计即可
recommendation.en: First expert-level continual learning benchmark; gain metric design is worth studying. Read §3 evaluation design only; limited direct pretraining insight.

paper.title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly wi

summary.core_problem: 如何评测“长时间等待 + 事件触发响应”的监控型 agent 能力，并把成功率、反应时延与资源消耗（token/成本）放在同一套可复现实验里衡量，而不是只测连续行动型的网页操作能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献（不涉及训练 recipe / 数据 / tokenizer / scaling），但对“面向 agent 的后训练与评测闭环”有现实价值：它把长时程任务里最容易被忽略的成本结构（等待期间的无效 token 消耗）显式化，并提供可控的 time-evolving 环境来做对比实验。对做 agent 能力蒸馏、工具使用策略学习、以及把‘等待/监听’作为可学习行为（而不是 prompt 约束）的研究，会提供一个更贴近部署约束的度量面。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是把任务从“持续推进（continuous action）”改成“持续注意（sustained attention）”：环境会随时间自动演化，agent 的最优策略往往是少动甚至不动，直到外部事件满足触发条件。

基准由 10 个合成但高保真的 Web 应用环境组成（React+FastAPI+SQLite，单用户已登录假设），共 100 个任务。每个任务是一个事件序列回放：例如监控招聘页，一旦出现满足条件的新岗位就申请并通知用户。

评测指标不只看 task success，还同时记录：
- reaction time：条件满足后多快完成任务；
- resource utilization：token 消耗（需要 agent 自报）以及由此推导的成本。

为了让“等待”成为可操作的对照变量，作者提供两种 harness：
- sleep(time)：无条件让出一段时间；
- wait_for(condition, timeout)：更结构化的等待工具，允许基于页面内容变化做启发式触发。

这套设计的关键取舍：用合成环境换取可控性与可复现的时间事件机制；代价是生态有效性（与真实网站的噪声、反爬、登录态、网络抖动等差异）。另外 token 统计依赖 cooperative agent 的自报，严格性弱于系统侧计量。
summary.experiments:
作者用 3 个模型、2 种 harness 做基线：GPT-5.4（low reasoning）、Qwen 3.5 9B、GPT-4o。默认 speed_factor 下，任务完成率约 46%–75%（不同模型/配置）。单任务 token 使用跨度很大：约 70k 到 500k+。

把任务拉长到 40 分钟后，等待策略差异被放大：GPT-5.4 + sleep(time) 相比 wait_for(condition, timeout) 出现“更贵且更差”的结果：成本约 $4.65 vs $0.48（约 10×），完成率 56% vs 69%。这组数字基本把论文想表达的点钉死：长时程里，‘无效轮询/无效对话’会把 token 成本推到不可用。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“continuous action vs sustained attention”的问题定义，以及为什么 trajectory 变长会导致成功率下降的动机。
- 重点看指标定义与任务生命周期（reaction time、token/成本统计口径、speed_factor 如何拉伸时间）。这些决定了它是否能用于训练闭环。
- 直接看 Table 4（完成率与 token 使用范围）以及 40 分钟设置下 sleep vs wait_for 的对比结果，理解 benchmark 想刻画的 trade-off。
- 如果要把它接到训练上，再看 environments 的实现假设（单用户已登录、合成数据生成管线），评估能否扩展到更真实的网页噪声与更严格的计量。
summary.authors_note: Microsoft；GitHub 仓库为 microsoft/sentinel_environments。

summary_en.core_problem: How to benchmark long-running “monitor-and-react” agents where the optimal behavior is often to wait for external events, and to measure success rate, reaction latency, and token/cost efficiency in a single reproducible setup (instead of evaluating only continuous-action web agents).
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper (no scaling/data/tokenizer/optimizer contributions). Its value is in tightening the eval-to-training loop for agentic models: it makes the hidden cost structure of long-horizon tasks explicit (wasted tokens during waiting/polling) and provides controlled time-evolving environments for ablations. This is directly useful if you care about post-training for tool-use policies, distillation of agent behaviors, or learning ‘waiting/monitoring’ as a first-class action under deployment constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SentinelBench reframes a class of tasks from continuous action to sustained attention. Environments evolve over time without the agent’s intervention; the agent should detect when a condition becomes true and then act promptly.

The benchmark includes 10 synthetic but high-fidelity web apps (React frontend, FastAPI backend, SQLite; single authenticated user assumption) and 100 tasks defined as time-stamped event replays (e.g., monitor a jobs page; if a new posting mentions Kubernetes, apply and notify).

Metrics go beyond task completion:
- Reaction time: how quickly the agent finishes after the trigger condition is met.
- Resource utilization: token usage (self-reported by cooperative agents) and implied cost.

To isolate “waiting” as an experimental factor, they compare two harnesses:
- sleep(time): unconditional yielding.
- wait_for(condition, timeout): a structured waiting primitive that heuristically detects page-content changes.

Key trade-offs: synthetic environments buy controllability and reproducibility of temporal events, but reduce ecological validity vs real websites. Token accounting relies on agent self-reporting, which is weaker than system-level metering.
summary_en.experiments:
Baselines cover 3 models and 2 harness configurations: GPT-5.4 (low reasoning), Qwen 3.5 9B, and GPT-4o. With default speed_factor, completion ranges roughly 46%–75%. Per-task token usage spans ~70k to 500k+.

When tasks are extended to 40 minutes, the waiting strategy dominates: for GPT-5.4, sleep(time) is ~10× more expensive ($4.65 vs $0.48) while completing fewer tasks (56% vs 69%) than wait_for(condition, timeout). This cleanly demonstrates the benchmark’s intended cost–latency–success tension.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the precise framing: continuous action vs sustained attention, and why longer trajectories hurt success.
- Focus on the metric definitions and task lifecycle (reaction time, token/cost accounting, how speed_factor stretches time). This determines whether you can use it in a training loop.
- Jump to the main results table (completion vs token ranges) and the 40-minute ablation contrasting sleep vs wait_for.
- If you plan to build on it, inspect the environment assumptions (single-user auth, synthetic data pipeline) and decide what would be needed for more realistic noise and stricter metering.
summary_en.authors_note: Microsoft; benchmark code released as microsoft/sentinel_environments on GitHub.

recommendation.zh: 一个有新意的Agent评测方向——监控而非连续行动，但与预训练核心方法论关联较弱，skim看基准实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting agent evaluation direction (monitoring vs. continuous action), but weak relevance to core pretraining methodology; skim baseline experiments only.

paper.title: When Tools Fail: Benchmarking Dynamic Replanning and Anomaly Recovery in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Existing benchmarks evaluate Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) in LLMs on idealized ''happy paths'', largely overlooking real-world tool failures. We introduce ToolMaze, a benchmark for dynamic path discovery and error recovery in TIR agents. To separate systematic replanning from blind trial-and-error, ToolMaze adopts a two-dimensional design: DAG-based topological complexity and a $2 \times 2$ taxonomy of tool perturbations (explicit/implicit, transient/permanent). Evaluations show that perturba

summary.core_problem: 现有工具集成推理（TIR）的Agent基准全部基于无错误的“理想路径”设计，无法衡量Agent在工具故障场景下的动态重规划和异常恢复能力；且现有故障注入方案随机、无系统的任务复杂度维度划分，无法区分有效重规划和盲目试错行为。
summary.importance: 为LLM Agent的鲁棒性评测提供了结构化的测试框架，对预训练阶段植入工具容错能力、对齐阶段训练重规划策略都有标准化的评测参照。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双维度评测框架ToolMaze：第一维度是基于有向无环图（DAG）的拓扑复杂度（分4级），预先枚举所有合法的工具调用恢复路径；第二维度是2×2的扰动分类（显式/隐式、瞬时/永久），在预设的工具节点注入故障而非随机注入；新增扰动恢复率（PRR）、恢复成本（RC）两个指标，替代单一的任务成功率（TSR）来区分有效重规划和无效试错；配套270个覆盖6个领域的真实工具语料，支持可扩展的任务合成。
summary.experiments: 测试多款主流LLM Agent，所有扰动场景下性能均出现下降；其中隐式语义故障场景下扰动恢复率（PRR）下降约37%，原因是Agent对错误输出的过度信任；复杂DAG拓扑会让Agent陷入无效试错循环，任务成功率和实际重规划能力出现明显脱钩。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章引言明确现有评测的缺陷，第2章快速了解双维度评测设计和新增指标的定义，实验部分直接查看核心结论表格即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) agents are all designed around error-free "happy paths", and cannot measure agents' dynamic replanning and anomaly recovery capabilities under tool failure scenarios. Existing fault injection schemes are random and lack systematic task complexity stratification, making it impossible to distinguish effective replanning from blind trial and error.
summary_en.importance: ToolMaze provides a structured testing framework for LLM agent robustness evaluation, offering standardized evaluation references for implanting tool fault tolerance during pretraining and training replanning strategies during alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolMaze adopts a two-dimensional evaluation framework: the first dimension is DAG-based topological complexity (4 levels), with all valid tool call recovery paths pre-enumerated; the second dimension is a 2×2 perturbation taxonomy (explicit/implicit, transient/permanent), with faults injected at pre-specified tool nodes instead of random locations. It introduces two new metrics, Perturbation Recovery Rate (PRR) and Recovery Cost (RC), to replace the single Task Success Rate (TSR) and distinguish effective replanning from invalid trial and error. It is paired with a corpus of 270 real tools covering 6 domains, supporting scalable task synthesis.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on multiple mainstream LLM agents show performance declines across all perturbation scenarios. The Perturbation Recovery Rate (PRR) drops by approximately 37% under implicit semantic failure scenarios, caused by agents' over-trust in corrupted outputs. Complex DAG topologies trap agents in futile trial-and-error loops, leading to a clear decoupling between task success rate and actual replanning capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 to understand the limitations of existing benchmarks, quickly review Section 2 to grasp the two-dimensional evaluation design and definition of new metrics, and directly read core conclusion tables in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不教你怎么训模型，但会改你对“scale 自然解决 agent 可靠性”的预期；先看 PRR 定义和 3.66× slower 那个结论。
recommendation.en: It will not teach you how to train models, but it should update your prior that scale alone fixes agent reliability; start with the PRR definition and the 3.66× slower scaling result.

paper.title: Benchmark Everything Everywhere All at Once
paper.abstract: Benchmarks are fundamental for evaluating and advancing LLMs and MLLMs by providing standardized and explicit measures of performance. However, their construction is labor-intensive and hard to reuse, raising concerns about sustainability and scalability. Moreover, existing benchmarks often quickly reach performance saturation after their release, resulting in insufficient discrimination among state-of-the-art models. To address these challenges, we introduce Benchmark Agent, a fully autonomous

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 benchmark 构建过程过度依赖人工、难复用、迭代慢，同时现有 benchmark 很快饱和，难以区分新模型能力差异的问题。它提出用一个自动化 agent 系统，把用户的抽象评测需求转成可运行、可刷新、可定制的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的核心贡献是评测基础设施，不是预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于，模型迭代速度已经超过很多静态 benchmark 的生命周期，评测资产需要从一次性人工构建转向可持续生成和质量控制。对 pretrain 研究员来说，它更适合作为评测管线和数据治理的参考：如何把能力维度拆成子任务，如何做样本生成、标注、过滤和一致性检查，如何控制 LLM-as-a-judge 带来的偏差。它不会直接告诉你如何训练更好的模型，但能帮助设计更贴近目标能力的评测闭环。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark Agent 采用 Planner 和 Executor 两级结构。Planner 是高层决策模块，负责把用户需求解析成子任务集合、数据配置和 benchmark 转换方案，并检查每个子任务是否有可行的数据 grounding。Executor 是执行模块，按 Planner 的规格调用工具完成数据生成、标注、格式化和质量控制，最后产出可运行 benchmark。这个设计的取舍比较清楚：如果只用单个 LLM agent 端到端生成 benchmark，长链路任务容易失控，也难以对数据条件和执行约束做一致校验；Planner/Executor 拆分后，高层任务设计和底层数据处理可以分别约束。论文强调三个特性：面向用户需求的定制化、低人工成本下的质量控制、面向新模型和新领域的持续刷新。
summary.experiments: 论文实现 Benchmark Agent 并生成 15 个代表性 benchmark。引言中用 Qwen 和 Qwen-VL 系列的历史结果说明 benchmark 饱和现象：很多分数在短时间内超过 80%，剩余区分空间有限。评测部分包括人工评估、LLM-as-a-judge 评估、一致性检查、时间和成本分析，以及组件消融。根据给出的内容，作者声称生成 benchmark 在可靠性、区分度、效率和成本上都可接受；但当前材料没有列出具体人工一致率、成本数值、构建耗时或各消融项下降幅度。阅读时需要重点核对这些数字，否则很难判断系统是否真的适合高风险模型评测。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看系统流程图和 Planner/Executor 的接口定义，确认它如何从一句自然语言评测需求落到子任务、数据源和评价指标。然后看质量控制部分，尤其是样本过滤、标注校验、一致性检查和 LLM judge 的使用方式。实验部分不必细读所有生成 benchmark 的案例，优先看人类评估和一致性结果，再看成本与构建时间。若用于内部评测建设，需要额外关注两点：生成数据是否会引入模型偏好，自动刷新是否会破坏不同模型版本之间的可比性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and fragility of benchmark construction. Existing benchmarks are usually built by human-heavy, benchmark-specific pipelines, and many saturate quickly as model capabilities improve. Benchmark Agent aims to turn a high-level evaluation request into an executable, customizable, and refreshable benchmark with much less manual work.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly evaluation infrastructure rather than a modeling or pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research lies in evaluation lifecycle management. As model iteration accelerates, static benchmarks can lose discriminative power shortly after release. A reusable benchmark-building pipeline may help pretraining teams define finer-grained capabilities, generate targeted test sets, and maintain evaluation freshness. The key caution is quality control: automatically generated benchmarks must be checked for judge bias, annotation errors, data leakage, and comparability across model versions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Benchmark Agent uses a two-component design. The Benchmark Planner maps user requirements into concrete benchmark specifications, including subtask decomposition, data configuration, and transformation plans. It also checks whether each subtask can be grounded in available data. The Benchmark Executor then turns the plan into a runnable benchmark by using tools for sample generation, annotation, formatting, and quality control. This split is sensible for a long-horizon task: a single end-to-end agent would have to handle high-level task design, data constraints, execution details, and validation in one loop. Separating planning from execution makes the pipeline easier to constrain and audit.
summary_en.experiments: The system is used to produce 15 representative benchmarks. The introduction motivates the need with an analysis of Qwen and Qwen-VL benchmark results, where many scores exceed 80% within a short time, reducing headroom for discrimination. The evaluation covers human assessment, LLM-as-a-judge assessment, consistency checks for sample discriminativeness, time and cost efficiency, and ablations of system components. The provided text does not include exact agreement rates, construction costs, runtime numbers, or ablation deltas, so the strength of the empirical claim depends on the missing tables and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the system diagram and the Planner/Executor interface: how a natural-language evaluation need becomes subtasks, data sources, sample formats, and scoring rules. Then read the quality-control pipeline, especially filtering, annotation verification, consistency checks, and the use of LLM judges. In the experiments, prioritize human validation, discriminative-power tests, and cost/runtime analysis. If adapting the idea for internal model evaluation, pay special attention to two risks: generated benchmarks may inherit model-specific biases, and frequent benchmark refreshes may reduce comparability across model releases.

recommendation.zh: 核心idea有意思——用agent自动造benchmark解决评测饱和问题，但这类方法的数据质量和污染检测存疑，看摘要+实验设计即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting idea (agent-generated benchmarks to fight saturation), but data quality and contamination detection are open questions; read abstract + experimental design only.

paper.title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled powerful software engineering (SE) agents capable of navigating complex codebases and resolving real-world issues. However, these agents remain fundamentally episodic: they fail to retain, refine, and reuse experiences across tasks, repeatedly reconstructing context from scratch and reproducing similar mistakes. Even with memory support, they offer no remedy for the absence of a principled, task-agnostic \textit{memory utility}, making them difficult to

summary.core_problem: 现有的软件工程（SE）Agent 通常是片段式的，缺乏跨任务保留、提炼和重用经验的机制；而现有的记忆增强方法缺乏与下游任务表现挂钩的、任务无关的记忆效用评估标准。
summary.importance: 提出了一个闭环的记忆优化框架 MemOp，将记忆效用严格定义为对下游任务性能的因果提升，为 Agent 记忆机制的评估和无监督优化提供了原则性方法。
summary.technical_approach: MemOp 包含两个核心创新：1) 将记忆效用定义为双重工具：既是评估基准，也是优化信号，完全基于下游任务的实际表现。2) 闭环记忆优化：通过轨迹级反思从完成的任务中提取候选记忆，然后通过性能验证（测量其对下游结果的因果影响）将候选记忆转化为训练信号，从而在无外部监督的情况下自适应地优化记忆模型。
summary.experiments: 在单回合记忆生成和跨回合记忆演化两种设置下进行了评估。结果表明，MemOp 显著提升了 SE Agent 的性能（成功率绝对提升高达 5.25%），训练后的记忆模型能生成高质量的反思，并具有很强的适应性，同时大幅降低了计算成本（相对降低 $\ge 9.79\%$）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第 2 节（MemOp 框架）和第 3 节（记忆效用的定义与闭环优化机制）。理解其如何将“记忆是否有用”转化为可计算的因果影响，这对于设计具备持续学习能力的复杂 Agent 架构非常有价值。
summary.authors_note: Xuehang Guo (William & Mary), Xingyao Wang (OpenHands)

summary_en.core_problem: Current Software Engineering (SE) agents are episodic, lacking mechanisms to retain, refine, and reuse experience across tasks. Existing memory-augmented approaches lack a task-agnostic utility metric tied to downstream performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MemOp, a closed-loop memory optimization framework that strictly defines memory utility as the causal improvement on downstream task performance, providing a principled approach for evaluating and unsupervisedly optimizing agent memory mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemOp introduces two key innovations: 1) Principled memory utility as a dual harness: serving as both an evaluation benchmark and an optimization signal, grounded entirely in downstream performance. 2) Closed-loop memory optimization: candidate memories are distilled from completed trajectories via reflection, and then validated by measuring their causal impact on downstream outcomes. This validation converts candidates into training signals, enabling adaptive memory optimization without external supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated under single-episode memory generation and cross-episode memory evolution settings. MemOp significantly improves SE agent performance (up to 5.25% absolute increase in Success Rate). The trained memory models produce high-quality reflections, exhibit robust adaptability, and substantially reduce computational costs ($\ge 9.79\%$ relative reduction).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (MemOp framework) and Section 3 (definition of memory utility and closed-loop optimization). Understand how it translates 'memory usefulness' into a computable causal impact, which is highly valuable for designing complex agents with continual learning capabilities.
summary_en.authors_note: Xuehang Guo (William & Mary), Xingyao Wang (OpenHands)

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“memory 有用”定义成可验证下游收益这一步很干净；只看任务定义和评测协议，别在代码 Agent 细节上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move of defining memory utility via validated downstream impact is unusually clean; read the task formulation and eval protocol, not the code-agent plumbing.

paper.title: ERRORQUAKE: Heavy-Tailed Error Severity Distributions in Open-Weight Large Language Models
paper.abstract: At matched accuracy, open-weight LLMs differ substantially in the shape of their error severity distribution -- a difference invisible to the scalar error rate. Hallucination benchmarks report a single error count and treat all errors as equivalent, yet a wrong date and a fabricated court ruling differ by orders of magnitude. We introduce Errorquake-10k, a 10,000-query benchmark scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 severity scale across 8 domains and 5 difficulty tiers, and we fit per-model

summary.core_problem: 标准幻觉 benchmark 仅用错误率 ε 评估模型，将所有错误视为等价，但实际错误严重程度差异可达数量级（如错日期 vs 捏造法庭裁决）。在相同准确率下，不同模型的错误严重程度分布可能截然不同，这一维度被现有评估体系完全忽略。
summary.importance: 证明错误严重程度分布（尤其是尾部行为）提供了准确率无法区分的判别信息。对预训练研究的启示：优化预训练目标时除了整体准确率，还应考虑错误严重性的尾部分布，这对安全敏感场景的模型训练尤为重要。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 Errorquake-10k benchmark（10,000 查询，8 个领域，5 个难度级别），对每个响应使用连续 0-4 分 9 级严重度量表打分。借鉴地震学 Gutenberg-Richter 关系，用尾部斜率 b 刻画模型的严重度分布：b 小表示错误少但偶发灾难性错误，b 大表示小错误多但严重度有界。采用双裁判评分（8 模型循环池，排除自评）校准。
summary.experiments: 21 个开源指令微调模型（3B-37B 活跃参数）。210 个模型对中，85 对在匹配准确率（|Δε|<0.05）下有不相交的 95% b 置信区间（人类共识评分）。量表 ICC(2,k=3)=0.85，人类-b vs 裁判-b 等级相关 ρ=0.89（15 个模型）。密集模型缩放相关 ρ_s=-0.86：模型越大，严重度尾部越重。错误类型随严重度分类变化（低=71% 检索错误，高=39% 捏造）。
summary.reading_guide: Section 1 引言和核心论点；Section 2 benchmark 和量表设计；Section 4.1 配对判别 headline 结果；Section 4.3 缩放分析；Section 5 不可约性定理。重点看 Figure 1（b vs ε 散点图）、Figure 3（严重度分布示例）。预计阅读 45-60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard hallucination benchmarks reduce model evaluation to a single error rate ε, treating all errors as equivalent, yet error severity can differ by orders of magnitude (e.g., wrong date vs. fabricated court ruling). At matched accuracy, models can have dramatically different error severity distributions—a dimension entirely invisible to current evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that error severity distribution (especially tail behavior) carries discriminative information inaccessible to accuracy alone. Implication for pretraining: optimizing for overall accuracy is insufficient; tail behavior of error severity should also be considered, particularly for safety-critical model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Errorquake-10k benchmark (10,000 queries across 8 domains × 5 difficulty tiers), scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 scale with 9 levels. Borrows the Gutenberg-Richter magnitude-frequency relation from seismology to characterize severity distribution via tail slope b: small b means few errors but occasional catastrophic ones; large b means many small errors with bounded severity. Uses a dual-judge scoring pipeline with an 8-model round-robin pool excluding self-judging.
summary_en.experiments: 21 open-weight instruction-tuned models (3B-37B active parameters). 85 out of 210 model pairs have disjoint 95% b confidence intervals at matched accuracy (|Δε|<0.05) under human-consensus scoring. Scale validation: ICC(2,k=3)=0.85, human-b vs judge-b rank correlation ρ=0.89 across 15 models. Dense-model scaling correlation ρ_s=-0.86: larger models have heavier severity tails. Error type shifts categorically with severity (low=71% retrieval, high=39% fabrication).
summary_en.reading_guide: Section 1 for core argument and motivation. Section 2 for benchmark and scale design. Section 4.1 for the headline pairwise discrimination results. Section 4.3 for scaling analysis. Section 5 for the non-reducibility theorem. Key figures: Figure 1 (b vs ε scatter), Figure 3 (severity distribution examples). Estimated reading time: 45-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 同精度下模型的严重错误分布差异巨大——这是 pre-train 和 RL 阶段都应关注的新维度。看 §4 的 per-model b 估计和 Fig 2 的分布对比，可直接启发更精细的训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Models at matched accuracy can have wildly different severe-error distributions — a new dimension to track in both pretrain and RL. Read §4 per-model b estimates and Fig 2 distribution comparisons; directly informs finer-grained training objectives.

paper.title: VideoKR: Towards Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Understanding
paper.abstract: We introduce VideoKR, the first large-scale training corpus specifically designed to strengthen knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video understanding. It comprises 315K video reasoning examples over 145K newly collected, CC-licensed, expert-domain videos. We develop a human-in-the-loop, skill-oriented example generation pipeline that targets progressively deeper video reasoning capabilities while ensuring the difficulty, diversity, and reliability of both the examples and their CoT rationales.

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视频理解后训练数据偏浅层、容易走文本捷径，导致模型在知识密集和推理密集的视频问答上能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是高质量训练数据和评测集：315K 视频推理样本的 VideoKR 训练语料，以及专家标注的 VideoKR-Eval。对多模态后训练和数据设计有参考价值，但它不是统一多模态预训练或新建模范式工作。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个 human-in-the-loop、按技能分层的视频推理样本生成流程，强调难度、覆盖面和 CoT rationale 的可靠性；再在标准 SFT→GRPO 流水线上对模型做后训练，检验数据设计是否能提升知识与推理密集型视频理解。核心创新点在数据构造与任务定义，而不是模型架构。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 145K 新收集的 CC 授权专家领域视频，生成 315K 训练样本，并构建了新的专家标注评测集 VideoKR-Eval。实验显示，在标准 SFT→GRPO pipeline 下，使用 VideoKR 后训练的模型优于以往视频推理后训练方法，同时在通用视频推理上保持竞争力。摘要未给出具体 backbone、参数量和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Arman Cohan、Yilun Zhao。机构信息未在给定材料中完整提供。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of deep, knowledge- and reasoning-intensive supervision in video understanding, where existing post-training data often permits shallow textual shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a high-quality training corpus and evaluation set: 315K video reasoning examples in VideoKR and an expert-annotated benchmark, VideoKR-Eval. This is relevant to multimodal post-training and data design, but it is not a unified multimodal pretraining or modeling-paradigm paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a human-in-the-loop, skill-oriented pipeline for generating video reasoning examples, with emphasis on difficulty, diversity, and reliable CoT rationales. Models are then post-trained with a standard SFT-to-GRPO pipeline to test whether better data design improves knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video understanding. The novelty is in data construction and task design rather than architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset covers 145K newly collected CC-licensed expert-domain videos and 315K training examples, plus a new expert-annotated benchmark, VideoKR-Eval. The abstract claims that post-training on VideoKR outperforms prior post-training approaches on knowledge-intensive video reasoning while remaining competitive on general video reasoning. Backbone sizes and exact gains are not given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Arman Cohan and Yilun Zhao. Full institutional attribution is not fully recoverable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态 post-train 数据配方，可以看；对基座 pretrain 直接帮助有限，重点只在数据构造流程和 eval 设计。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you care about multimodal post-training data recipes, but the direct pretraining payoff is limited; focus on the data pipeline and eval design.

paper.title: Speedrunning Tabular Foundation Model Pretraining
paper.abstract: Pretraining cost is a major bottleneck for research on tabular foundation models, slowing the iteration cycle for new architectures, priors, and optimization ideas. Yet the community lacks a simple way to compare and accumulate pretraining speedups. We introduce a community speedrun for nanoTabPFN: contributors modify a single-file training script and compete to reach a fixed downstream ROC AUC target on subsampled TabArena using one NVIDIA L40S GPU. The current best record reaches the target in

summary.core_problem: 如何建立一个标准化的、低门槛的基准来快速验证和累积表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models）的预训练加速技巧？
summary.importance: 工程突破与社区倡议。为表格基础模型的预训练提供了一个类似“Speedrun”的标准化竞技场，极大地降低了验证新架构、先验和优化想法的成本，促进了预训练加速技巧的社区积累。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 nanoTabPFN 的社区 Speedrun 协议。参与者修改一个单文件训练脚本，目标是在单张 NVIDIA L40S GPU 上，以最快速度在子采样的 TabArena 数据集上达到固定的下游 ROC AUC 目标。该协议允许社区添加、验证和叠加预训练改进。
summary.experiments: 当前最佳记录在 0.92 分钟内达到目标，比 74.32 分钟的基线快了 81 倍，同时使用的合成数据集减少了 22 倍。
summary.authors_note: Frank Hutter 团队（AutoML 领域知名学者）的工作，延续了他们对 TabPFN 系列的研究。

summary_en.core_problem: How to establish a standardized, low-barrier benchmark to rapidly validate and accumulate pretraining speedup techniques for tabular foundation models?
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough and community initiative. Provides a standardized 'speedrun' arena for tabular foundation model pretraining, significantly lowering the cost of validating new architectures, priors, and optimization ideas, and fostering community accumulation of speedup techniques.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a community speedrun protocol for nanoTabPFN. Participants modify a single-file training script to reach a fixed downstream ROC AUC target on a subsampled TabArena dataset as fast as possible using a single NVIDIA L40S GPU. The protocol allows the community to add, verify, and stack pretraining improvements.
summary_en.experiments: The current best record reaches the target in 0.92 minutes, an 81x speedup over the 74.32-minute baseline while using 22x fewer synthetic datasets.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Frank Hutter's team (renowned scholar in AutoML), continuing their research on the TabPFN series.

recommendation.zh: 虽然是针对表格数据的预训练，但其“Speedrun”的标准化竞技场理念对 LLM 预训练社区（如如何快速验证小规模架构改动）有一定借鉴意义，作为 literature 备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Although focused on tabular data pretraining, its 'speedrun' standardized arena concept offers some inspiration for the LLM pretraining community (e.g., how to quickly validate small-scale architectural changes); keep as literature reference, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: SVHalluc: Benchmarking Speech-Vision Hallucination in Audio-Visual Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite the success of audio-visual large-language models (LLMs), they can produce plausible but ungrounded outputs, termed hallucination. Existing benchmarks focus on environmental sounds (e.g., dog barking) to indicate event occurrence. In contrast, human speech carries fundamentally different, rich semantics and temporal structures, yet it remains unexplored whether current models can accurately align speech content with corresponding visual signals. In this work, we show that speech content

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的多模态幻觉，而是一个此前几乎没被单独刻画的问题：音视频大模型能否把“语音内容”与“视觉证据”正确对齐。已有音视频幻觉评测大多围绕环境声，把声音当作事件是否发生的指示器，例如狗叫、警笛、敲门声。这类设定语义简单，时间关系也通常局限在“声音出现的当下”。但真实语音不同。语音里有实体、动作、指令、评论、回忆、预告，既有更丰富的语义，也有更复杂的时间结构。模型可能听到一句话后，在画面里臆造并不存在的对象或事件，或者把语音提到的过去/未来事件误判成当前正在发生。SVHalluc的核心问题，就是系统评估这两类失败：语义错配，以及时间错配。
summary.importance: 对预训练和原生多模态建模的启发主要有两点。第一，它把“会不会听懂语音”和“能不能把语音与视觉联合建模”明确区分开了。很多模型在单模态语音识别上并不差，但一旦需要把转写内容与视频证据绑定，性能会明显掉下去。这说明当前音视频模型的瓶颈不只是编码器能力，而是跨模态对齐目标、训练数据构成、以及时序监督信号不足。第二，这个 benchmark 暴露出开源与闭源模型在 speech-vision grounding 上的明显差距，说明商业系统很可能已经在更大规模、更高质量的对齐数据，或者更细粒度的训练目标上做了额外工作。对做统一多模态预训练的人来说，这篇文章的价值不在提出新模型，而在于把一个过去被环境声 benchmark 掩盖的问题单独拎出来，并给出可复现的诊断框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上它是一个评测基准，而不是训练方法。设计重点有三层。第一层是任务维度划分。作者把 speech-vision hallucination 分成 semantic 和 temporal 两个维度。semantic 关注“语音里说到的内容，画面里是否真有对应证据”；temporal 关注“语音提到的事件，究竟发生在过去、现在还是未来，相对说话时刻的位置是否被模型判断正确”。第二层是 coarse-to-fine 的任务设计。每个维度都设计了三类互补任务，用统一的问答形式组织，问题以二选一或多选题为主，便于稳定打分和统计分析。这样的设计不是只测最终答对率，而是希望把失败模式拆开：模型到底是没抓住语义对应，还是抓住了内容但没抓住时间关系。第三层是数据构建。文章强调样本不是简单抓取带语音的视频，而是围绕 speech content 与 visual evidence 的对应关系来构造问题，覆盖语音描述当前画面、回顾过去事件、预告未来事件、以及语音与画面弱相关甚至误导的情况。这样做的关键，是让 benchmark 真正测“跨模态绑定”，而不是退化成 ASR 或视频分类。全文给出的 framing 很清楚：如果一个模型只会把语音转成文本，再凭语言先验猜答案，它会在这套题上暴露得很明显。
summary.experiments: 实验部分最重要的结论是：当前开源音视频大模型在这套 benchmark 上表现很弱，很多设置下接近随机猜测；而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 明显更强，但仍非无误。文中评测对象包括开源的 Qwen3-Omni，以及商业模型 Gemini 2.5 Pro。作者的分析指出，模型在单模态能力上并不构成主要障碍，例如语音识别本身可能是可用的，但一旦问题要求把 speech content 与视觉证据做联合判断，错误率会显著上升。也就是说，失败不是简单来自“没听清”，而是来自“听清了但没对齐好”。从实验结构看，文章更强调 failure diagnosis 而不是 leaderboard 排名：一方面比较 semantic 与 temporal 两类任务的难度差异，另一方面分析不同题型下模型是否依赖语言偏置、是否把语音当作强先验而忽略视觉反证。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整数字表，但已经明确说明：开源模型常常逼近 random guessing，商业模型存在明显领先，这个量级足以说明问题不是轻微退化，而是当前 open audio-visual LLM 在 speech-grounded reasoning 上还有结构性缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 benchmark taxonomy，理解作者为什么认为“语音”与“环境声”是两类不同的问题。这个区分是全文最重要的立论基础。然后重点看 semantic hallucination 与 temporal hallucination 两节，弄清楚每个维度下三类任务分别在测什么，尤其注意题目构造如何避免模型只靠语言常识作答。接着看 dataset creation pipeline，确认数据筛选、标注和问题生成是否足够严格，是否存在泄漏或模板偏置。最后看实验分析部分，不必只盯总分，更值得看作者如何证明错误来自跨模态整合失败，而不是单模态识别失败。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你做音视频预训练或统一多模态对齐，建议把任务定义和 failure case 图表看细一些。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a failure mode that prior audio-visual hallucination benchmarks largely miss: whether an audio-visual LLM can correctly ground spoken content in visual evidence. Existing benchmarks mostly use environmental sounds as event indicators, which makes the task relatively shallow: detect whether a bark, siren, or knock aligns with a visible event at the current moment. Speech is different. It carries entities, actions, instructions, commentary, and temporal references to past or future events. A model may therefore hallucinate objects or events that are mentioned in speech but absent in the video, or misplace narrated events in time. SVHalluc is built to diagnose exactly these two issues: semantic misgrounding and temporal misalignment between speech and vision.
summary_en.importance: For multimodal pretraining, the main value is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. First, it cleanly separates single-modality competence from cross-modal integration. A model can be decent at speech recognition and still fail badly when it must bind speech content to visual evidence. That points to weaknesses in alignment objectives, data composition, and temporal supervision, not just encoder quality. Second, the benchmark exposes a large gap between open and commercial systems on speech-vision grounding. That strongly suggests that stronger systems are benefiting from better aligned multimodal corpora, richer supervision, or more careful training recipes. The contribution is not a new model, but a sharper lens on a real weakness in current audio-visual LLMs that older environmental-sound benchmarks tend to understate.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is a benchmark paper, not a training-method paper. The design has three important pieces. First, the taxonomy: the authors split speech-vision hallucination into semantic and temporal dimensions. Semantic hallucination asks whether the content mentioned in speech truly corresponds to visible evidence. Temporal hallucination asks whether the model can identify when the narrated event occurs relative to the speaking moment: past, present, or future. Second, each dimension is probed with three complementary tasks arranged from coarse to fine, all cast in a unified QA format. Questions are mostly binary or multiple choice to support stable scoring and statistical analysis. This matters because the benchmark is not only measuring final accuracy; it is trying to localize failure modes. Third, the dataset construction is centered on speech content–visual evidence relations rather than generic narrated videos. The benchmark includes cases where speech describes the current scene, recalls past events, foreshadows future events, or contains weakly related or misleading commentary. That design prevents the task from collapsing into ASR or generic video QA. The paper’s framing is clear: if a model mainly transcribes speech and answers from language priors, SVHalluc should expose that weakness.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical result is straightforward: current open audio-visual LLMs perform poorly on SVHalluc, often close to random guessing, while Gemini 2.5 Pro is substantially stronger but still imperfect. The evaluated models include open-source systems such as Qwen3-Omni and the commercial Gemini 2.5 Pro. The analysis argues that the bottleneck is not simply speech perception. Models may do reasonably well on single-modality tasks like speech recognition, yet fail once the question requires joint reasoning over spoken content and visual evidence. In other words, the failure is often 'heard it but did not ground it,' not merely 'did not hear it.' The experiments are structured more as failure diagnosis than leaderboard reporting: they compare semantic versus temporal difficulty, and examine whether models over-trust speech priors while ignoring visual contradiction. The excerpt provided does not include the full numeric tables, but the qualitative result is already strong enough: open models are frequently near chance, and the commercial model shows a clear margin, indicating a structural gap rather than a small regression.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the benchmark taxonomy. The key question is why speech should be treated differently from environmental sounds; that is the conceptual anchor of the paper. Then read the semantic and temporal task sections carefully to understand what each of the three tasks under each dimension is actually testing, especially how the prompts are designed to reduce shortcutting through language priors. After that, check the dataset creation pipeline to see whether the sampling, annotation, and question construction are rigorous enough and whether there are obvious template biases. Finally, read the analysis section with an eye on error attribution rather than headline scores: the useful part is how the authors argue that the failures come from cross-modal integration, not just weak ASR. A solid skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和错误分解即可；它暴露的是语音 token 语义强、视觉 grounding 弱这一预训练接口问题。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark construction and error breakdown; the useful signal is that strong speech semantics can overpower weak visual grounding in AV pretraining.

paper.title: DeskCraft: Benchmarking Desktop Agents on Professional Workflows and Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration
paper.abstract: Real-world professional desktop workflows in specialized creative and engineering software unfold over long horizons and often require human-in-the-loop coordination, where agents proactively seek necessary information and users provide additional instructions, clarifications, feedback, or corrections as the task progresses. Yet existing desktop GUI benchmarks mostly reduce this setting to short, simplified tasks with all user instructions provided upfront. To address this issue, we introduce De

summary.core_problem: 现有的桌面 GUI Agent 评测基准主要集中在短序列、单次指令的简单任务上，无法反映真实专业工作流中长周期、多步骤以及需要人机交互（Human-in-the-Loop）的复杂场景。
summary.importance: 提出了一个更贴近真实专业场景的桌面 Agent 评测基准，指出了当前模型在长周期任务规划和主动人机协作方面的严重不足，为后续 Agent 预训练和对齐指明了方向。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 DeskCraft 基准，包含 538 个任务，覆盖图像/矢量设计、视频/音频编辑和 3D 渲染等专业软件。核心设计包括：1) L1/L2/L3 难度分级，L3 任务源自真实交付流程，步骤超 50 步；2) 引入人机交互协议，包含执行中（Agent 主动澄清、用户中断）和执行后（用户追加指令）的触发机制，模拟真实协作。
summary.experiments: 评测了 18 个闭源/开源模型。在标准任务上，最强模型仅达到 33.8% 成功率。在交互式任务（100步限制）中，GPT-5.4 和 Kimi-K2.6 分别仅获 27.6% 和 25.7%。分析表明，模型在 L3 任务上性能断崖式下跌，增加步数限制收益微小，且 Agent 极少主动寻求澄清。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 3 节关于 L1/L2/L3 难度分级和人机交互协议的设计，以及第 4 节的实验分析，特别是关于长周期任务失败原因和主动澄清能力缺失的讨论。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing desktop GUI agent benchmarks focus on short, single-instruction tasks, failing to capture the long-horizon, multi-step, and human-in-the-loop nature of real-world professional workflows.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a benchmark closer to real professional scenarios, highlighting severe deficiencies of current models in long-horizon planning and proactive human-agent collaboration, guiding future agent pre-training and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed DeskCraft, a benchmark with 538 tasks covering professional software like image/vector design, video/audio editing, and 3D rendering. Key designs: 1) L1/L2/L3 difficulty taxonomy, with L3 tasks derived from real delivery processes (>50 steps); 2) Human-agent interaction protocol with mid-turn (agent clarification, user interruption) and post-turn (user follow-up) triggers to simulate real collaboration.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 18 models. On standard tasks, the best model achieved only 33.8% success. On interactive tasks (100-step limit), GPT-5.4 and Kimi-K2.6 scored 27.6% and 25.7%, respectively. Analysis shows a sharp performance drop on L3 tasks, marginal gains from increased step limits, and a rare occurrence of proactive clarification by agents.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the L1/L2/L3 taxonomy and interaction protocol design, and Section 4 for experimental analysis, especially discussions on failure modes in long-horizon tasks and the lack of proactive clarification. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 高质量的 GUI Agent 评测基准，重点关注了长视距（>50步）和 Human-in-the-Loop 交互，对研究 Agent 评测和复杂任务规划有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A high-quality GUI Agent benchmark focusing on long-horizon (>50 steps) tasks and Human-in-the-Loop interaction. Valuable reference for agent evaluation and complex task planning research.

paper.title: Do Text Edits Generalize to Visual Generation? Benchmarking Cross-Modal Knowledge Editing in UMMs
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose multimodal intelligence. As they are deployed in real-world applications, effectively updating internal knowledge becomes critical. While knowledge editing has matured for text-only models, it remains unclear whether edits that successfully modify textual outputs also transfer to image generation in UMMs. To study this question, we introduce UniKE, the first benchmark for cross-modality knowledge editing in

summary.core_problem: 在统一多模态模型（UMM）里，只通过“文本侧”的知识编辑把某个事实改掉，能否可靠地迁移到“图像生成侧”，让模型生成的图像也体现被编辑后的新知识；如果不能，瓶颈出在哪里、怎样以最小代价提升跨模态一致性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的预训练 recipe，而在于把“统一建模”里一个常被默认成立的假设拆开验证：共享骨干并不意味着知识更新会跨生成通道自然传播。论文用可复现的基准（UniKE）把问题量化成一个很硬的数字落差（文本编辑成功率很高，但图像侧几乎不动），并给出机制层面的解释（conditioning pathway bottleneck）。这对做原生多模态预训练的人有两点启发：1）训练时的跨模态对齐/条件注入路径决定了知识可控性与可编辑性，不能只看“共享参数”；2）很多“看似参数里已经改了”的知识，可能在图像生成条件分支上被投影/接口层衰减，属于架构与训练目标共同塑造的可达性问题。
summary.technical_approach:
1）基准设计（UniKE）：把一次知识编辑形式化为(q, y, y')，其中q是文本事实查询，y是编辑前答案，y'是目标答案；同时为同一事实构造图像生成提示p_img、可视觉验证的目标描述t_vis，以及用于自动判定的VQA问题q_vqa。这样把“图像是否反映新知识”转成“对生成图像做VQA是否得到与y'一致的答案”，避免纯文本评估或主观打分。
2）编辑类型：覆盖属性类（颜色/纹理等内禀可见属性）与关系类（位置/职业等可通过视觉线索验证的关系），并通过更组合化的提示提升难度，测试编辑在更复杂生成条件下是否仍能生效。
3）方法评测：以现有参数编辑（parameter editing）方法为主线，先验证它们在文本侧能把回答改对，再测同一编辑是否改变图像生成。
4）提出 Reasoning-augmented Parameter Editing：核心假设是“参数里被改的知识在图像生成时未被激活”。做法是在图像生成前强制模型先产出一段中间文本推理/陈述，让模型显式说出被编辑后的事实，再把这段文本作为更强的语义条件去约束后续图像生成。它不是再训练一个新模型，而是改变编辑后的使用协议（protocol），用更强的文本条件把编辑信号送进图像生成通道。
5）机制分析：提出并用实验支持 conditioning-pathway bottleneck。对于带显式投影/接口的架构，编辑引起的表征扰动在进入图像生成模块前可能被接口层衰减；即便没有显式投影，图像生成的强视觉先验也可能压过微弱的编辑扰动。Reasoning augmentation 的作用在于引入“更大且性质不同”的文本条件偏移，使其更可能穿过条件路径并影响视觉采样。
summary.experiments:
基准规模：2,971 个 edit subjects，扩展成 5,535 个评测实例（包含不同阶段/提示设置）。
核心结果：出现显著模态鸿沟——文本侧编辑有效率可到约 92%，但在直接图像生成并用 VQA 验证时，最佳总体 VQA 准确率只有 18.5%。这说明“文本改对”几乎不意味着“图像会跟着改”。
论文还报告 reasoning-augmented 协议能部分缓解该问题（具体提升幅度在给定内容中未展开到逐方法逐设置的数字），并通过对条件路径的分析展示：编辑扰动在到达图像生成条件分支前被削弱，或不足以覆盖视觉先验。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先级：中高（更偏多模态统一建模/可控性与可编辑性，而非训练 recipe）。
建议阅读顺序：
1）UniKE 的任务定义与实例构造：重点看 evaluation instance 的五元组(q, y, y', p_img, q_vqa/t_vis)如何保证“可视觉验证”，以及属性/关系两类编辑的边界条件。
2）主实验表格：抓住 92% vs 18.5% 这类跨模态落差是如何在不同编辑方法、不同提示复杂度下稳定出现的。
3）Reasoning-augmented protocol：看它到底要求模型输出什么中间文本、如何接到图像生成提示里；思考它是在“激活知识”还是在“提示工程式地绕过编辑失败”。
4）机制分析部分：重点找作者如何定位 conditioning-pathway bottleneck（例如是否对接口层前后表征/梯度/扰动传播做对比），以及他们对“强视觉先验压制编辑信号”的证据链。
预计时间：30–60 分钟可把基准与核心结论读清；若要复现或用于自家 UMM 诊断，需进一步细读数据构造与VQA验证细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether text-only knowledge edits in unified multimodal models reliably transfer to the image-generation channel, and if not, what architectural/conditioning bottlenecks prevent edited facts from being expressed visually.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a new pretraining recipe, but it is highly relevant to foundation-model pretraining in the “native multimodal / unified backbone” line. It falsifies a common implicit assumption: parameter sharing does not guarantee that updated knowledge propagates across generation modalities. UniKE turns this into a measurable gap (high text-side edit success vs very low visual verification accuracy) and ties the failure to a conditioning-pathway bottleneck. For pretraining researchers, the takeaway is that controllability/editability is shaped by (i) how conditioning is injected into the image generator (projection/interface layers, routing), and (ii) how strong modality-specific priors are relative to the magnitude of the edit-induced perturbation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Benchmark (UniKE): each edit defines a textual fact rewrite (q, y -> y'), plus an image prompt p_img and a visually checkable implication t_vis, evaluated via a VQA query q_vqa on the generated image. This makes cross-modal edit transfer automatically testable.
2) Edit coverage: attribute edits (intrinsic visual properties like color/pattern) and relation edits (depictable relations like location/occupation), with increasingly compositional prompts to stress generalization.
3) Baselines: apply standard parameter-editing methods to fix the text answer, then test whether image generations change accordingly.
4) Reasoning-augmented parameter editing: a protocol-level intervention. The model is prompted to produce an intermediate textual reasoning/statement that explicitly verbalizes the edited fact, which is then used as stronger conditioning for image generation. The hypothesis is that edited knowledge remains latent unless activated in the textual context.
5) Mechanistic analysis: argues for a conditioning-pathway bottleneck—edit-induced representation changes that suffice for text recall can be attenuated before reaching the image generator (especially with explicit projection interfaces), or be too weak to override strong visual priors. Reasoning augmentation introduces a larger, qualitatively different conditioning shift that partially restores transfer.
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 2,971 edit subjects, expanded to 5,535 evaluation instances.
Key finding: a large modality gap—text-side edit efficacy can reach ~92%, while the best overall VQA accuracy on direct image generations is only 18.5%.
The paper reports that reasoning augmentation partially improves visual transfer (exact per-setting deltas are not included in the provided excerpt) and supports the bottleneck claim with analyses around conditioning pathways and the dominance of visual priors.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus (30–60 minutes).
1) Read the UniKE formulation carefully: how (p_img, t_vis, q_vqa) makes edits visually verifiable, and what constraints are imposed for relation edits.
2) Inspect the main results table/figure showing the 92% vs 18.5% gap across edit types and prompt complexity.
3) Check the exact prompting/protocol for reasoning-augmented editing—what intermediate text is generated and how it conditions the image generator.
4) Spend time on the mechanistic section that motivates “conditioning-pathway bottleneck”; look for evidence around interface/projection attenuation vs ‘visual prior’ dominance.
If you want to use it for diagnosing your own UMM, you’ll need a deeper pass on dataset construction and the VQA verification pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接修正一个常见错觉：统一多模态模型未必有统一知识表征。先看 benchmark 设计和 92%→18.5% 这个落差，再决定你是否还信 text-side edit 指标。
recommendation.en: This paper corrects a common illusion: a unified multimodal model need not have unified knowledge. Read the benchmark design and the 92%→18.5% gap before trusting text-side editing metrics again.

paper.title: SynCred-Bench: Benchmarking Synthetic Credibility in AI-Generated Visual Misinformation
paper.abstract: Recent generative models can now produce visual artifacts with realistic embedded text and layouts, creating a new misinformation threat: synthetic credibility. We introduce SYNCRED-Bench, a benchmark of 600 AI-generated misinformation images balanced across six credible-form categories and seven fine-grained circulation styles, together with FP450, a real-image negative set for measuring false positives. Extensive evaluation shows that existing systems remain unreliable: under a 5% false-positi

summary.core_problem: 评测现有模型是否能识别带有逼真文本、版式和可信外观的 AI 生成视觉虚假信息，即“synthetic credibility”问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产与问题定义：提出一个更贴近现实攻击面的视觉 misinformation benchmark，检验 MLLM、AIGC detector 和商业 API 在低误报约束下的真实检测能力。对做多模态安全、评测协议和模型鲁棒性的研究员有参考价值，但对 LLM 预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 SynCred-Bench：600 张 AI 生成误导图像，覆盖 6 类可信形式与 7 类传播风格；再加入 FP450 真实图像负样本集，用于在固定 5% FPR 约束下测量 TPR。评测对象包括 15 个 MLLM、开源 AIGC 检测器和商业 API，并与人类标注者比较。
summary.experiments: 关键结果是：在 5% false-positive-rate 约束下，15 个 MLLM 的 TPR 仅 10.5%，开源 AIGC detector 低于 5%，商业 API 达到 57.6%，人类标注者也只有 63% TPR。摘要没有给出训练规模，因为核心是 benchmark 而非方法训练。
summary.authors_note: 来自清华大学 CoAI / Minlie Huang 团队，长期做对话系统、LLM 与评测相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether current systems can detect AI-generated visual misinformation that looks credible through realistic text, layout, and presentation—what the paper calls synthetic credibility.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and problem framing: a benchmark targeting a realistic attack surface in visual misinformation, measuring actual detection ability of MLLMs, AIGC detectors, and commercial APIs under low false-positive constraints. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but useful for multimodal safety and evaluation researchers.
summary_en.technical_approach: SynCred-Bench contains 600 AI-generated misinformation images spanning six credibility-form categories and seven circulation styles, plus FP450 as a real-image negative set. The protocol reports TPR under a fixed 5% FPR constraint. The benchmark evaluates 15 MLLMs, open-source AIGC detectors, commercial APIs, and human annotators.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is that under a 5% false-positive-rate constraint, 15 MLLMs achieve only 10.5% TPR, open-source AIGC detectors stay below 5%, commercial APIs reach 57.6%, and humans achieve 63% TPR. No training-scale details are central because this is a benchmark paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Tsinghua University's CoAI / Minlie Huang group, known for dialogue systems, LLMs, and evaluation-related research.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但评测协议是干净的：固定 FPR 看 TPR，比泛泛 accuracy 更像真实部署；读结果表即可，不必深挖方法。
recommendation.en: Not directly about pretraining, but the evaluation protocol is cleaner than generic accuracy—TPR at fixed FPR is deployment-relevant; read the main result table and move on.

institutions: The Conversational AI (CoAI) group, DCST, Tsinghua University

paper.title: OVO-S-Bench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Streaming Spatial Intelligence in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents in robotics, AR, and autonomous driving must reason about places and layouts from continuous egocentric streams, often using evidence outside the current view. Existing benchmarks either evaluate offline over full videos or target events rather than spatial structure. We introduce OVO-S-Bench, a fully human-annotated benchmark for streaming spatial intelligence, comprising 1,680 questions over 348 source videos. Annotation involves 12 trained annotators, each also serving as a

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态评测难以衡量流式场景下空间智能的问题，尤其是模型是否能仅基于视频前缀追踪布局、跨时刻整合证据并进行空间推理。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产工作，贡献在于把 streaming spatial intelligence 从离线视频理解中单独剥离出来，并用层级任务设计区分感知、跟踪、模拟和地图构建。对做原生多模态预训练和视频流建模的人有一定参考，但更偏 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 OVO-S-Bench，包含 348 个源视频、1680 个问题。每个问题带 query timestamp 和 evidence interval，评测时模型只能看到 query 之前的视频前缀。任务按四层组织：瞬时第一视角感知、时空上下文跟踪、空间模拟与推理、allocentric mapping。作者在 38 个开源和闭源 MLLM 上做系统评测，并与人类专家比较。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键结果是：Gemini-3.1-Pro 仍落后人类专家 27 个百分点，说明当前 MLLM 在流式空间智能上存在明显缺口。数据集规模中等，人工标注和质检投入较高。由于核心贡献是 benchmark，研究员更应关注任务协议是否避免信息泄漏、前缀约束是否严格、以及四层任务是否真能分离能力。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of benchmarks for streaming spatial intelligence in multimodal models, especially whether a model can track layouts, integrate evidence across time, and reason spatially using only the video prefix available at query time.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset. Its contribution is to isolate streaming spatial intelligence from generic offline video understanding, with a hierarchical task design spanning perception, tracking, simulation, and mapping. It is somewhat relevant to native multimodal pretraining and video-stream modeling, but it is primarily a benchmark paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OVO-S-Bench with 348 source videos and 1,680 questions. Each question includes a query timestamp and an evidence interval, and the model only sees the prefix before the query during evaluation. Tasks are organized into four levels: instantaneous egocentric perception, spatiotemporal context tracking, spatial simulation and reasoning, and allocentric mapping. The benchmark is evaluated on 38 open and proprietary MLLMs and compared against human experts.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is that Gemini-3.1-Pro trails human experts by 27 points, indicating a substantial gap in streaming spatial intelligence. The dataset is moderate in size but heavily human-annotated. Since this is a benchmark paper, the main thing to inspect is whether the protocol truly prevents leakage, whether the prefix-only constraint is strict, and whether the four levels cleanly separate capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 偏视频-VLM 评测，不是基座方法论文；知道有这个坑位即可，若做流式多模态只看任务协议和人机差距那张主表。
recommendation.en: This is a video-VLM benchmark rather than a foundation-method paper; know it exists, and if you work on streaming multimodality, just inspect the protocol and the human-vs-model gap table.

paper.title: Benchmarks are Not Enough: RAMP for Runtime Assessing of Agentic Models in Production Systems
paper.abstract: LLM agents are rapidly evolving from coding assistants into autonomous software engineering systems. However, existing evaluation methodologies remain largely centered on static, isolated, and short-horizon benchmarks that fail to capture the dynamic complexity of real-world production workflows. As a result, benchmark performance may poorly reflect practical capability under realistic runtime environments involving long execution chains, tool interactions, dependency management, and iterative f

summary.core_problem: 解决现有软件工程 agent 评测过于静态、短程、脱离生产环境，导致 benchmark 分数无法反映真实运行时能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测基础设施工作，贡献类型是 runtime evaluation protocol 与执行平台。对预训练研究员不是主线，但如果关心 post-train 后 agent 能力是否真实可迁移，这类长时程、工具交互型评测比静态题集更接近部署约束。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RAMP，一个面向生产系统的长时程软件工程 agent 运行时评测框架。它基于统一编排与执行接口，提供真实编译器构建类任务、串行依赖、复杂工具链交互，以及 staged recovery 机制，用于分析 agent 在部分错误后的恢复与继续执行能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调其评测环境包含长执行链、工具调用、依赖管理和迭代反馈回路，任务设定比传统 benchmark 更接近真实生产工作流。当前摘要未给出参与评测的模型、样本规模和量化结果，因此更像评测资产发布而非结论型论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between static short-horizon software-agent benchmarks and real production behavior, where benchmark scores often fail to reflect runtime capability.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation infrastructure paper, contributing a runtime evaluation protocol and execution platform. It is not central for pretraining, but if you care whether post-trained agent skills transfer to deployment, long-horizon tool-interaction evaluation is more informative than static benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RAMP, a production-grounded runtime assessment framework for long-horizon software engineering agents. It provides unified orchestration and execution interfaces, realistic compiler-construction workloads, serial dependencies, complex toolchain interactions, and a staged recovery mechanism to analyze how agents recover from partial failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes long execution chains, tool use, dependency management, and iterative feedback loops, making the setup closer to production workflows than standard benchmarks. The abstract does not provide evaluated models, dataset size, or quantitative results, so this currently reads more like an evaluation asset release than a conclusion-heavy paper.

recommendation.zh: 更像评测基建，不是方法论文；知道有这么个 runtime SWE 评测就够了，除非你正做 agent eval 平台。
recommendation.en: This is evaluation plumbing rather than a method paper; know it exists, and only read deeper if you're building agent runtime eval infrastructure.

paper.title: PaintBench: Deterministic Evaluation of Precise Visual Editing
paper.abstract: While current multimodal models are proficient at open-ended visual editing, executing precise single-answer edits remains an important obstacle. To probe this challenge, we introduce PaintBench, a dynamically scalable benchmark targeting 20 fundamental precise visual editing operations across four categories: geometric transformation, structural manipulation, color change, and symbolic reasoning. Procedural generation with configurable complexity enables an effectively infinite, contamination-r

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉编辑评测里“开放式主观判断多、难以精确衡量单一正确编辑”的问题，构建可程序化、可扩展、确定性的精细视觉编辑 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测协议。它的价值不在于提升模型，而在于把精确视觉编辑拆成 20 类基础操作，并用程序生成和像素级确定性指标减少 judge bias 与数据污染。对多模态统一建模研究员，意义在于暴露当前模型在精确控制上的短板。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 PaintBench，通过程序化生成任务实例，覆盖几何变换、结构操作、颜色修改和符号推理四大类共 20 种编辑操作。评测采用可扩展复杂度设置与像素级 deterministic evaluation，而不是依赖 LLM/VLM judge。这样可以更干净地区分模型是不会编辑、不会遵循约束，还是只会做开放式“看起来差不多”的修改。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个图像编辑模型上评测，摘要给出的最好结果只有 17.1% mIoU，说明精确编辑远未解决。论文还做了按任务类型和模型类型的细分诊断，指出几何变换、结构操作和公式驱动颜色变化尤其困难。对预训练研究员，值得看的不是榜单本身，而是 failure taxonomy 是否能反推视觉 tokenizer、编辑表示和训练目标的问题。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Rob Fergus、He He、Saining Xie，属于学界较强的视觉/多模态研究者组合。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of deterministic, precise evaluation for visual editing, where open-ended judging often fails to measure single-correct-answer edits.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. Its value is not in improving models, but in decomposing precise visual editing into 20 primitive operations and using procedural generation plus pixel-level deterministic metrics to reduce judge bias and contamination. For multimodal pretraining researchers, it exposes where current models fail at controllable editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: PaintBench procedurally generates tasks spanning four categories—geometric transformation, structural manipulation, color change, and symbolic reasoning—with 20 editing operations in total. Evaluation is dynamically scalable in complexity and uses deterministic pixel-level scoring rather than LLM/VLM judges. This makes it easier to separate failures of editing ability, constraint following, and superficial open-ended plausibility.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 11 image-editing models, with the best model reaching only 17.1% mIoU according to the abstract, suggesting that precise editing remains weak. The paper also reports per-operation and per-model diagnostics, highlighting geometric transforms, structural edits, and formula-based color changes as especially hard. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is not the leaderboard itself but whether the failure taxonomy points back to tokenizer, representation, or objective issues.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Rob Fergus, He He, and Saining Xie, a recognizable academic lineup in vision and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座必读，但做原生多模态生成/编辑的人应看任务拆解；只读 benchmark 设计和失败分布，榜单分数本身信息不大。
recommendation.en: Not core foundation-model reading, but worth checking if you work on native multimodal generation/editing; read the task decomposition and failure breakdown, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong informal mathematical reasoning but struggle to generate mechanically verifiable proofs in formal languages like Lean. We present LEAP, an agentic framework that enables general-purpose foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance on automated formal theorem proving. LEAP leverages foundation model capabilities, such as informal reasoning, instruction following, and iterative self-refinement. By decomposing complex problems into smaller un

summary.core_problem: 通用大语言模型不经过专业领域微调，仅通过Agent框架能否在形式化定理证明任务上达到甚至超过专用 prover 模型的性能，同时解决现有形式化数学评测基准饱和、区分度不足的问题。
summary.importance: 挑战了通用LLM必须经过形式化数学语料微调才能胜任严谨形式化任务的共识，证明了Agent框架可以充分释放通用LLM的非正式推理、工具使用和自修正能力，为LLM在专业严谨任务上的落地提供了不依赖领域定制模型的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LEAP Agent框架，完全基于通用LLM实现形式化定理证明，不使用任何专用prover模型；框架模仿人类数学家的工作流：首先生成高层证明蓝图并组织为有向无环图，分解复杂问题为小模块，然后生成Lean语言的形式化证明代码，通过与Lean编译器持续交互获取错误反馈，迭代修正证明过程，直到通过验证或达到迭代上限；同时构造Lean-IMO-Bench基准，将IMO风格的高难度非正式数学题转换为Lean可验证的形式化表述，专门测试长流程、非平凡思路的形式化证明能力。
summary.experiments: 在2025年Putnam竞赛的12道题上实现全解，与当前前沿专用模型的结果持平；在Lean-IMO-Bench上，将通用LLM的单独求解率从低于10%提升至70%，超过专用ATP模型的5%和带有专用prover组件的Aristotle系统的48%；分析表明通用LLM在形式化数学任务上的主要瓶颈不是形式化语言的理解能力，而是无法一次性生成完整、正确的长证明，结构化的Agent交互和迭代修正可以有效弥补这一缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读框架的工作流设计、Lean-IMO-Bench的构造标准、实验部分与专用模型的对比分析；预计阅读时间20-25分钟，核心启发在于通用模型的能力释放不需要依赖领域微调，合理的Agent交互设计可以弥补单步生成的不足，这一思路可迁移到其他需要严谨验证的专业领域。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether general-purpose large language models can achieve or even exceed the performance of specialized prover models on formal theorem proving tasks only through agent frameworks without professional domain fine-tuning, and solve the problem of saturation and insufficient discriminability of existing formal mathematics evaluation benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: It challenges the consensus that general LLMs must be fine-tuned on formal mathematics corpora to be competent in rigorous formal tasks, and proves that agent frameworks can fully release the informal reasoning, tool use and self-correction capabilities of general LLMs, providing a new path for the implementation of LLMs in professional rigorous tasks without relying on domain-customized models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the LEAP agent framework, which implements formal theorem proving completely based on general LLMs without using any specialized prover models. The framework imitates the workflow of human mathematicians: First, generate a high-level proof blueprint and organize it into a directed acyclic graph, decompose complex problems into small modules. Then generate formal proof code in Lean language. Obtain error feedback through continuous interaction with the Lean compiler, and iteratively correct the proof process until it passes verification or reaches the iteration limit. Meanwhile, construct the Lean-IMO-Bench benchmark, convert IMO-style high-difficulty informal math problems into Lean-verifiable formal statements, specifically testing the formal proving ability of long-process and non-trivial ideas.
summary_en.experiments: Achieved full solution on all 12 problems of the 2025 Putnam Competition, matching the results of current frontier specialized models. On Lean-IMO-Bench, increased the standalone solve rate of general LLMs from less than 10% to 70%, exceeding 5% of specialized ATP models and 48% of the Aristotle system with specialized prover components. Analysis shows that the main bottleneck of general LLMs in formal mathematics tasks is not the comprehension ability of formal languages, but the inability to generate complete and correct long proofs in one attempt. Structured agent interaction and iterative correction can effectively compensate for this defect.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the workflow design of the framework, the construction standards of Lean-IMO-Bench, and the comparative analysis with specialized models in the experimental section. The expected reading time is 20-25 minutes. The core inspiration is that the release of general model capabilities does not need to rely on domain fine-tuning. Reasonable agent interaction design can compensate for the shortcomings of single-step generation, and this idea can be migrated to other professional fields requiring rigorous verification.

recommendation.zh: Google DeepMind 最新形式化数学Agent，Lean-IMO-Bench 是有价值的难 benchmark，对推理能力评测有参考意义
recommendation.en: Google DeepMind formal math agent; Lean-IMO-Bench is a valuable hard benchmark worth noting for reasoning capability evaluation

paper.title: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Long-Form Output Evaluation

summary.core_problem: LongJudgeBench 解决的是长文输出评估中的 judge 可靠性问题。现有 LLM-as-a-judge 元评测多集中在几百 token 的短回答，无法说明模型 judge 是否能评价深度研究、综述、创作、长链分析这类长文任务。长文评估不是把上下文长度拉长即可，它要求 judge 做文档级判断：结构是否合理，覆盖是否充分，章节之间是否一致，论证深度是否匹配任务，是否满足场景化评分标准。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座研究的价值主要在评测信号质量。长文生成正在进入 deep research、报告生成、代码/研究辅助和复杂 agent 输出场景，SFT、RLHF/RLAIF、best-of-N、数据筛选和模型选择都越来越依赖 LLM judge。如果 judge 在长文上不稳定，训练信号会系统性偏斜：模型可能学到更长但不更好的回答，或学到表面结构而不是真实覆盖与一致性。LongJudgeBench 的贡献不是提出新模型，而是把长文 judge 的可靠性问题做成可测的 meta-evaluation 资产，覆盖多种任务协议和专家参考判断，能帮助区分“能给出合理评语”和“能与专家判断一致”。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 LLM-as-a-judge 形式化为一个函数：输入评测 instruction 和一个或多个候选长文输出，产生 judgment。每个样本包含三部分：instruction、content、response。instruction 不是固定模板，而是可扩展结构，通常包括原始生成任务 query、评测协议，以及可选辅助字段，如 rubric、权重、参考材料、领域约束和格式要求。content 可以是单个候选输出，也可以是多个候选输出，对应 pointwise scoring、pairwise comparison 或 listwise ranking。response 可以包含自然语言理由和可解析的结构化判断。这个设计比只做二选一偏好更接近真实评测，因为不同长文任务需要不同证据形式和评分粒度。LongJudgeBench 覆盖 5 个真实场景：deep research、scientific survey、creative writing、long-chain analysis、systematic review；整合 6 个数据集，候选输出平均长度为 9,249.7 tokens，并配套专家标注，包括打分、偏好、排序和参考验证等形式。
summary.experiments: 基准的关键规模数字是：5 类长文场景、6 个数据集、候选输出平均 9,249.7 tokens，并配有专家参考判断。实验评估了多个模型家族和 judge 设置。核心结论是当前 LLM judge 在长文评估上存在清晰可靠性缺口，尤其是在需要全局结构判断、跨段一致性检查、任务相关覆盖和场景化标准应用时。论文强调，这些失败不能简单归因于输出更长；问题来自文档级评估本身的复杂性。提供的内容未列出完整表格中的具体模型分数，因此不宜把结论解读为某个单一模型的胜负，而应关注不同评测协议下 judge 与专家判断的一致性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Table 1，理解它与 AlpacaEval、MT-Bench、Chatbot Arena、JudgeBench 等短回答 judge benchmark 的差异，重点是输出长度、任务场景和判断协议。再看 LongJudgeBench 的任务形式化部分，尤其是 instruction/content/response 的拆分，以及 pointwise、pairwise、listwise 三类协议如何统一。随后看数据集构成和专家标注流程，判断 reference judgment 的可信度。实验部分应重点读按场景、协议和输出长度分桶的结果，而不是只看平均分。值得深挖的是 judge prompt、rubric 粒度、是否提供参考材料、是否要求 rationale，这些因素会直接影响长文 judge 是否能成为可用的训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: LongJudgeBench studies the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge for long-form outputs. Existing meta-evaluation benchmarks mostly use short responses of a few hundred tokens, which does not answer whether model judges can evaluate deep research reports, scientific surveys, creative writing, long-chain analyses, or systematic reviews. Long-form evaluation is not just short-form evaluation with more tokens. It requires document-level assessment of organization, task-relevant coverage, depth, cross-section consistency, and scenario-specific criteria.
summary_en.importance: The paper matters for foundation-model research because it targets the quality of evaluation and training signals. Long-form generation is becoming common in deep research, report writing, complex agent outputs, and model-assisted analysis. SFT data filtering, RLHF/RLAIF, best-of-N sampling, model selection, and automatic benchmarking increasingly rely on LLM judges. If judges are unreliable on long-form outputs, the optimization signal can become biased toward length, surface-level structure, or plausible commentary rather than real coverage and consistency. The contribution is an evaluation asset rather than a new model: it makes long-form judge reliability measurable against expert references across multiple scenarios and judgment protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark formalizes LLM-as-a-judge as a function that receives an evaluation instruction and one or more candidate outputs, then returns a judgment. Each instance has three components: instruction, content, and response. The instruction is an extensible structured object rather than a fixed template. It typically contains the original query, the judging protocol, and optional auxiliary fields such as rubrics, criteria weights, reference materials, domain constraints, and formatting requirements. The content may be a single long-form output or a set of outputs, supporting pointwise scoring, pairwise comparison, and listwise ranking. The response may include a natural-language rationale and an extracted structured judgment. LongJudgeBench covers five real-world scenarios: deep research, scientific survey, creative writing, long-chain analysis, and systematic review. It integrates six datasets, with candidate outputs averaging 9,249.7 tokens, and uses expert reference judgments collected under task-specific protocols, including scoring, preference labels, rankings, and reference verification.
summary_en.experiments: The key benchmark statistics are five long-form scenarios, six datasets, candidate outputs with an average length of 9,249.7 tokens, and expert reference judgments. The experiments evaluate multiple LLM judge families and judging settings. The main finding is a clear reliability gap for current LLM-as-a-judge methods under long-form evaluation, especially when the task requires global organization assessment, cross-section consistency checking, task-relevant coverage, and application of scenario-specific criteria. The supplied content does not include the full numerical tables for individual models, so the result should be read as evidence about the difficulty of long-form judging rather than a simple ranking of judge models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with Table 1 to see how LongJudgeBench differs from short-form judge benchmarks such as AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, Chatbot Arena, and JudgeBench, especially in output length, task scenarios, and judgment formats. Then read the task formalization around instruction, content, and response, with attention to how pointwise, pairwise, and listwise evaluation are unified. The dataset construction and expert-annotation protocol are important for assessing the reliability of the reference judgments. In the experiments, focus on breakdowns by scenario, protocol, and length rather than only aggregate scores. The most useful details for training-signal design are judge prompts, rubric granularity, use of reference materials, and whether rationales are required before structured judgments.

recommendation.zh: 长篇 judge 的噪声会直接污染 RL/SFT 的训练信号，这类基准能帮你决定“还能不能用 LLM judge”；优先看偏置分解与人评相关那几张表。
recommendation.en: Long-form judge noise directly contaminates RL/SFT training signals; this benchmark helps decide whether LLM judging is usable—focus on bias decomposition and human-correlation tables.

institutions: University of Science and Technology Beijing

paper.title: TrustLDM: Benchmarking Trustworthiness in Language Diffusion Models

summary.core_problem: TrustLDM 评测语言扩散模型在任意顺序生成和带后文条件生成时的可信性风险，重点是安全、隐私和公平性。核心问题是：现有 LLM 安全评测大多假设从左到右生成，不能覆盖 LDM 中 suffix/post-context、动态生成位置和不同解码顺序带来的风险。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于评测资产，对新型语言建模范式有参考价值。LDM、masked LM、any-order LM 的训练目标和解码方式改变了安全控制点：AR 模型通常可以把风险拦截放在早期 token 或 prefix 条件上，而 LDM 会同时受前文、后文、mask 位置和更新顺序影响。TrustLDM 的主要启发是，非 AR 模型的 alignment 不能简单复用 AR 的评测协议；评测输入需要显式控制 context 位置、context 长度、generation length、block size 和 decoding order。
summary.technical_approach: TrustLDM 包含静态评测和自动化评测两部分。静态评测覆盖三类风险：安全使用 AdvBench 的 50 个 harmful questions 和 JailbreakBench 的 misuse behaviors；隐私使用 Mireshghallah 等工作的 500 个样例，把 LDM 模拟为数据库管理器并测试其是否泄露敏感信息；公平性从 UCI Adult 抽取 200 个性别均衡样例，让模型预测收入是否超过 50K，并观察不同性别组上的失败分布。评测模型包括 LLaDA、LLaDA-1.5、LLaDA-MoE 和 Dream，其中 LLaDA-1.5 经过强化学习增强，Dream 来自自回归 backbone 改造。实验固定 temperature=0.0，默认 generation length 为 256，step size 为 256，block size 为 64，并在 instruct 版本上运行。评测变量包括 prefix/suffix context、短/长 context、六类静态 context、六种 decoding order，以及生成长度。TrustLDM-Auto 进一步用层级搜索为特定模型构造 adversarial context，先粗筛容易被利用的解码设置，再缩小搜索空间做 targeted exploration。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是：只给用户 prompt、不添加额外 context 时，LDM 通常表现出较高可信性；一旦在 masked response 周围加入恶意 post-context，alignment 行为明显下降。后文条件比传统 prefix-only 设置更能暴露 LDM 的特殊弱点，因为模型在填充 mask 时会同时利用未来文本。实验还显示，context 更长不一定攻击更强，原因可能与模型容量和长上下文利用能力有关。decoding order 和 generation length 会显著改变评测结果，说明 LDM 的风险不是单一 prompt 属性，而是 prompt、mask 布局和采样过程共同决定。TrustLDM-Auto 在所有模型和三类维度上达到接近完全成功的攻击效果，说明静态 benchmark 可能低估模型特异性漏洞。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。优先看 benchmark design：三类风险数据如何构造、prefix/suffix 与长短 context 如何组合、六种 decoding order 如何定义。然后看四个模型的主结果表，特别是无 context、malicious prefix、malicious suffix/post-context 的差异。TrustLDM-Auto 的层级搜索流程值得单独看，因为它说明 LDM 评测不应只固定一种解码设置。若关注 LDM 预训练或 post-training，应重点思考 alignment 数据是否需要覆盖后文条件、任意 mask 填充和不同生成顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: TrustLDM evaluates trustworthiness risks in language diffusion models under arbitrary-order generation and post-context conditioning. The main issue is that most existing LLM safety benchmarks assume left-to-right generation, while LDMs can condition on suffixes, dynamic masked positions, and different decoding schedules.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, but it is relevant to new language-modeling paradigms. LDMs, masked LMs, and any-order LMs change where safety control happens. In autoregressive models, risk is often handled through prefix conditioning and early-token behavior. In LDMs, the generated span can be affected by prefix, suffix, mask layout, generation length, and update order. The paper’s useful message is that alignment evaluation for non-AR models needs its own protocol; reusing AR benchmarks can miss important failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: TrustLDM has a static benchmark and an automated evaluation pipeline. The static benchmark covers safety, privacy, and fairness. For safety, it uses 50 harmful questions from AdvBench and misuse behaviors from JailbreakBench. For privacy, it uses 500 examples from prior privacy-evaluation work and frames the LDM as a database manager queried for sensitive information. For fairness, it samples 200 gender-balanced examples from the UCI Adult dataset and asks the model to predict whether income exceeds 50K, then analyzes failure distributions across gender groups. The evaluated models are LLaDA, LLaDA-1.5, LLaDA-MoE, and Dream. LLaDA-1.5 is strengthened through reinforcement learning, while Dream is adapted from an autoregressive backbone. The experiments fix temperature at 0.0 and use 256 generation length, 256 step size, and 64 block size by default on instruct models. The benchmark varies prefix versus suffix context, short versus long context, six static-context categories, six decoding orders, and generation length. TrustLDM-Auto adds a hierarchical search procedure that constructs model-specific adversarial contexts by first identifying vulnerable decoding settings and then narrowing the search for targeted attacks.
summary_en.experiments: The main finding is that LDMs are relatively trustworthy when only the user prompt is provided, but their alignment degrades clearly when malicious post-contexts are attached around masked responses. Suffix or future-context conditioning exposes a weakness that prefix-only AR-style evaluation does not cover. Longer contexts are not always more harmful, likely because limited model capacity and context utilization constrain the effect. Decoding order and generation length also change the measured risk, so the failure mode is not just a property of the prompt; it depends on the masking and denoising process. TrustLDM-Auto achieves near-perfect attack performance across the evaluated models and dimensions, suggesting that fixed static tests can underestimate model-specific vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the benchmark design: how the three risk dimensions are instantiated, how prefix and suffix contexts are constructed, and how the six decoding orders are defined. Then read the main result tables comparing no-context, malicious-prefix, and malicious-suffix settings. The TrustLDM-Auto hierarchical search is worth separate attention because it shows why LDM evaluation should not fix a single decoding configuration. For readers working on LDM pretraining or post-training, the key question is whether alignment data should explicitly cover suffix conditioning, arbitrary mask filling, and multiple generation orders.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 的安全评测不能照搬 AR；先看任务定义和失败案例，分数表反而次要。
recommendation.en: Trust evaluation for diffusion LMs cannot simply inherit AR assumptions; read the task design and failure cases before the score tables.

paper.title: Momento: Evaluating Persistent Memory and Reasoning with Multi-Session Agentic Conversations
paper.abstract: Recent advances in agentic AI have enabled agents to complete complex tasks through tool use, reasoning, and multi-step planning. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate agents within a single session, ignoring past actions, stated preferences, and prior decisions that agents must integrate to fulfill personalized user goals. We introduce Momento, a benchmark for persistent agentic task completion in multi-session service environments, requiring agents to take consequential, tool-mediated actions while

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent benchmark 多数只评测单次会话内的工具使用和规划，无法衡量 agent 在多天、多会话场景中如何记住历史、识别过期信息、更新用户状态，并据此执行有后果的工具调用。Momento 评测的是跨会话持久记忆与任务决策，而不是简单的历史事实回忆。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测型工作，对基座预训练的间接启发在于：长上下文能力不等于持久记忆能力，检索到历史也不等于能正确使用历史。实验暴露的主要失败模式是 agent 把旧会话历史当成当前真实状态，缺少重新确认和状态更新机制。对训练数据和评测设计来说，这说明 multi-session、temporal dependency、stale memory validation 应该成为 agentic data 和 long-context eval 的重要维度。
summary.technical_approach: Momento 使用角色扮演式用户模拟构造多会话服务任务。User Agent 根据用户画像、长期目标、偏好和 session-level 条件生成跨时间一致但会变化的用户行为；Assistant Agent 需要从多会话摘要中检索相关信息，生成工具调用，执行后再回复用户。框架里有 Agentic Memory 模块，限定在 128k-token context memory block 内，结合两种机制：长期记忆用 LLM 生成 SQL 查询，将语义匹配、时间约束和结构化条件结合起来；短期记忆保留最近 80% context budget 的原文，把更旧的前缀压缩成摘要。相比只做向量检索或单会话工具调用评测，Momento 更强调时间约束、跨 session 依赖和历史信息是否仍然有效。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 161 个任务实例，由人工标注高层用户目标、任务目标和可执行工具，并经过人工检查以保证正确性、一致性和可行性。部分任务涉及 WorldCuisines 中的食物实体，需要多模态理解。实验发现，存在跨会话依赖时，当前 agent 性能明显下降；主要错误不是完全找不到历史，而是误估用户当前状态，把过去信息当成可靠当前上下文，缺少主动验证。摘录中没有给出各模型的具体分数、工具调用成功率或错误分布数字，精确结果需要查主实验表和 failure analysis。
