We introduce a 3,034-sample human-curated benchmark targeting three components of spatial understanding: depth-ordered occlusion (probed via three independent counterfactual operationalisations), optical-geometry inference over visible reflections, and volumetric rearrangement planning. Six frontier and open-weight VLMs, scored by trained annotators on 18,204 responses with no LLM

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在静态物体识别上表现良好，但无法确定其是否具备真实的3D场景结构表征能力，还是仅能对可见物体做扁平的目录式枚举，这一能力是VLM作为具身系统感知层的核心基础。
summary.importance: 系统量化了当前VLM在3D空间几何推理上的能力边界，定位了现有ViT+LM拼接式VLM架构的核心瓶颈，为多模态基座预训练的架构设计、评测体系、预训练信号设计提供了明确的优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了3034个人工标注的评测基准，覆盖三类3D空间理解能力：深度排序遮挡推理（三种独立的反事实操作范式验证）、可见反射的光学几何推理、体积重排规划。所有评测结果由训练有素的标注员打分，不使用LLM-as-judge避免评测偏差。对开源的Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking做白盒分析，设计了深度引导注意力相关性（DGAR）度量，并通过激活补丁（activation patching）定位能力缺陷的架构位点。
summary.experiments: 测试了6个前沿闭源和开源VLM，覆盖稠密和MoE架构、三个数量级的激活参数量：体积重排规划准确率达53%-97%，碰撞约束错误率低于7%；遮挡推理准确率暴跌到6%-45%；反射的光学几何推理准确率低于7%，三类任务间存在超过50个百分点的能力断层。三种独立的遮挡推理测试结果在5个模型上的偏差不超过12个百分点，排除了任务特定表面特征的影响。面向具身推理的Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6在200样本的失败案子集上也表现出相同的能力剖面，说明当前的具身推理后训练也无法修复这一缺陷。白盒分析显示，推理失败时Qwen3-VL对几何正确区域的视觉注意力分散，与均匀随机水平相当；激活补丁定位缺陷发生在视觉令牌融合层：ViT内部可恢复的空间信息在压缩后无法被下游计算访问，恢复融合后第一层语言模型的激活即可修复性能。
summary.reading_guide: 精读核心假设提出、基准设计逻辑、能力分层实验结果、白盒机制分析部分，重点关注能力断层数据和激活补丁结果；可跳过具体的标注流程细节。值得深挖的点包括：3D空间预训练信号的设计、视觉令牌融合层的架构优化、不需要显式3D标注的空间结构诱导训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on static object recognition, but it is unclear whether they have genuine 3D scene structure representation capabilities, or only perform flat catalog-style enumeration of visible objects. This capability is the core foundation for VLMs to act as the perception layer of embodied systems.
summary_en.importance: Systematically quantifies the capability boundary of current VLMs in 3D spatial geometric reasoning, locates the core bottleneck of existing ViT+LM spliced VLM architectures, and provides clear optimization directions for architecture design, evaluation system, and pretraining signal design of multimodal foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a 3,034-sample human-curated evaluation benchmark covering three types of 3D spatial understanding capabilities: depth-ordered occlusion reasoning (validated via three independent counterfactual operationalizations), optical-geometry inference over visible reflections, and volumetric rearrangement planning. All evaluation results are scored by trained annotators, no LLM-as-judge is used to avoid evaluation bias. White-box analysis is conducted on the open-source Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, with a Depth-Guided Attention Relevance (DGAR) metric designed, and activation patching used to locate the architectural site of the capability deficit.
summary_en.experiments: Six cutting-edge closed-source and open-source VLMs are tested, covering dense and MoE architectures, and three orders of magnitude of active parameters: volumetric rearrangement planning accuracy reaches 53%-97%, with collision constraint error rate lower than 7%; occlusion reasoning accuracy drops sharply to 6%-45%; optical-geometry inference over reflections has accuracy lower than 7%, with a capability gap of over 50 percentage points between the three types of tasks. The results of three independent occlusion reasoning tests deviate by no more than 12 percentage points across five models, ruling out the influence of task-specific surface features. Embodied reasoning model Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 reproduces the same capability profile on a 200-sample subset of failure cases, indicating that current embodied reasoning post-training cannot fix this deficit. White-box analysis shows that during reasoning failures, the visual attention of Qwen3-VL to geometrically correct regions is dispersed, equivalent to uniform random level. Activation patching locates the defect at the visual token merger layer: spatial information recoverable inside the ViT becomes inaccessible to downstream computation after compression, and restoring activations of the first language model layer after the merger can recover performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read the core hypothesis proposal in Section 1, benchmark design logic in Section 3, capability stratification experimental results in Section 4, and white-box mechanism analysis in Section 5. Focus on the capability gap data in Figure 2 and activation patching results in Figure 4; specific annotation process details can be skipped. Points worth further exploration include: design of 3D spatial pretraining signals, architecture optimization of the visual token merger layer, and spatial structure induction training methods that do not require explicit 3D annotations.

recommendation.zh: 把“VLM 不懂 3D”从泛泛结论变成可定位的工程问题：重点看白盒定位 merger/压缩那段，直接指导视觉 token 数与融合策略的 ablation。
recommendation.en: Turns “VLMs lack 3D understanding” into an actionable diagnosis: focus on the white-box evidence around merger/compression—worth immediate ablations on visual token count and fusion design.

paper.title: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory is a central capability for LLM agents operating across long-horizon tasks. Existing memory benchmarks predominantly evaluate retention of personalized information in multi-turn chat scenarios, overlooking the dynamic memory formation that occurs during extended agent execution. Consequently, the memory systems they produce transfer poorly to realistic agentic environments, such as coding and web navigation. We present MemGym, a benchmark for agentic memory that unifies existing agent gym

summary.core_problem: 现有“记忆”评测要么是长上下文/多轮聊天里的静态信息记忆，要么是像 SWE-Gym/WebArena 这类长程 agent 环境但只给端到端成功率，导致记忆失败与推理/工具使用失败纠缠在一起，且评测成本高。论文要解决的是：为长程 agent 的“记忆形成”（保留/压缩/淘汰）提供可分离、可迭代、成本可控的评测与训练闭环。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身影响间接，但对 post-train 与“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”更相关：它把记忆模块从 reasoner 中剥离，提供 memory-isolated 指标与可规模化的轨迹数据，并用轻量 reward model 替代昂贵环境 rollout，降低了记忆策略/压缩策略的迭代门槛。对基座研究的启发点在于：1）把长程能力拆成可度量的子能力（压缩事件的安全/有害）比只看最终成功率更可优化；2）用小模型 RM 做内环评估，类似把“昂贵外部世界”蒸馏成可学习的判别器信号。
summary.technical_approach:
MemGym 提供统一的 memory–reasoning 接口：把“记忆模块”作为包装 prompt 的独立组件插在 agent loop 中，使每次压缩/写入/淘汰事件都可观测、可记录，并在固定 reasoner 下做 with-memory vs no-memory 的配对对比，从而把分数解释为“记忆带来的增益”。
组成：
- 五条评测轨道：对既有环境的 wrapper（τ²-bench 对话、SWE-Gym 编码、WebArena-Infinity 电脑使用）+ 两条自建的 memory-grounded 轨道（MemGym-DR 深度检索研究、MemGym-CodeQA）。自建轨道强调“可控长度”和“验证确实需要记忆”，避免信息可从参数记忆/环境中轻易再推导。
- 可控合成数据管线：对 MemGym-CodeQA 与 MemGym-DR 生成可调长度实例，并用 ablation（no-memory、distractor-only、leakage-prone 等）验证评测确实在测目标记忆通道。
- MemRM：用收集到的压缩事件轨迹训练一个轻量标量模型，预测“压缩后行为是否保持不变”的概率，用于替代昂贵的 Docker rollout，既可做快速评测也可做后训练奖励信号。实现上用 Qwen3-1.7B + QLoRA 微调。
summary.experiments:
关键结果（文中明确给出的数字）：
- MemRM 在 SWE-Gym IID split 上对压缩事件好坏的判别 AUROC 达到 0.985，可用一次亚秒级分类调用替代一次环境 rollout 作为内环信号。
- 基准覆盖：7 类记忆策略 + None 对照，在 5 个环境上形成 17 个（track, strategy）评测单元，并提供配对的 baseline-vs-memory delta 以隔离记忆效应。
（当前片段未给出各记忆家族在各轨道上的具体分数表；精读实验章节需要补齐：哪些策略在何种 regime 下有效、memory-isolated 指标如何定义与计算、以及 MemRM 与真实 rollout 的相关性/校准曲线。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“接口—指标—闭环”顺序：
1）先看 §3.2/§3.3 的统一接口与 memory-isolated 评分定义：它决定了这个 benchmark 是否真的把记忆从推理里拆出来。
2）再看 §3.4 的两条合成管线与 ablation 验证：重点确认是否避免了“看似测记忆、实际靠参数泄漏/可再推导”的假压力。
3）最后看 §4 的 MemRM 训练与替代 rollout 的证据：AUROC 之外，关注误报/漏报代价、跨环境泛化、以及作为 reward 用于训练时是否引入偏置。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可掌握框架与主要结论；若要用它做训练研究，需要额外通读附录里环境 patch、扰动分类与数据格式。

summary_en.core_problem: Memory evaluation for LLM agents is either (a) long-context/static recall in chat, or (b) long-horizon agent benchmarks where only end-task success is reported, entangling memory failures with reasoning/tool-use errors and making iteration expensive. The paper aims to evaluate and train “memory formation” during agent execution—what to keep, compress, or evict—via a unified, memory-isolated, lower-cost loop.
summary_en.importance: Indirect for pretraining, but highly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop: it operationalizes memory as a separable module with paired with-memory vs no-memory comparisons under a fixed reasoner, releases trajectory data, and introduces a lightweight reward model to replace costly environment rollouts. The broader lesson is that decomposing long-horizon capability into optimizable sub-signals (compression events) can be more actionable than optimizing only final success.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MemGym unifies five tracks behind a shared memory–reasoning contract where a memory module wraps the prompt sent to the policy LLM. This makes each compression/write/eviction event observable and scorable, and enables paired runs (same reasoner, with vs without memory) so deltas reflect memory effects.
Components:
- Tracks: wrappers for τ²-bench (tool-use dialogue), SWE-Gym (coding), WebArena-Infinity (computer use), plus two in-house memory-grounded tracks (MemGym-DR deep research, MemGym-CodeQA).
- Controllable synthetic pipelines for DR and CodeQA with length tuning and verifier-style ablations (no-memory, distractor-only, leakage-prone) to ensure the benchmark truly induces memory pressure.
- MemRM: a small scalar reward model trained on collected trajectories to predict P(behavior unchanged | compress), used as a fast proxy for expensive Docker rollouts. Implemented as Qwen3-1.7B fine-tuned with QLoRA.
summary_en.experiments:
Explicit reported numbers and coverage:
- MemRM achieves AUROC 0.985 on the SWE-Gym IID split for classifying compression-event outcomes, enabling sub-second scoring instead of full rollouts.
- Evaluation spans 7 memory families plus a None control across 17 (track, strategy) cells over 5 environments, with paired baseline-vs-memory deltas.
(The excerpt does not include the full per-track score tables or detailed definitions of the memory-isolated metrics; those are essential to validate what is being measured and should be extracted from the main experiments/appendices.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in this order:
1) The interface and memory-isolated scoring definition (§3.2–§3.3): this determines whether the benchmark truly disentangles memory from reasoning.
2) The synthetic pipeline and ablation verification (§3.4): check how they prevent “illusory memory pressure” and leakage.
3) MemRM evidence (§4): beyond AUROC, look for calibration, failure modes, cross-track generalization, and bias when used as a training reward.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the core framework; longer if you plan to use the benchmark (appendices contain engineering details and data formats).

recommendation.zh: 做 agent memory 的人该看，但对 pretrain 研究员只需抓住它的隔离评测设计；先看任务分解和 memory-isolated score，别被总分带偏。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about agent memory; for pretraining people, the key is the isolation protocol—read the task decomposition and memory-isolated scoring, not the headline leaderboard.

paper.title: APM: Evaluating Style Personalization in LLMs with Arbitrary Preference Mappings
paper.abstract: Typical LLM responses tend to follow a default style, even though users often have distinct preferences regarding tone, verbosity, and formality that they do not explicitly state in their prompts. Evaluating whether personalization methods can adapt to these implicit preferences is challenging, since users typically provide prompts rather than reference responses, style preferences are not factually verifiable, and reference-free LLM judges may conflate personalization with general response qual

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决隐式风格个性化的评测问题：用户通常只给 prompt，不给参考答案，也不会显式说明自己偏好更正式、更简短或更热情的回答；而 reference-free LLM judge 容易把“写得好”误判为“更个性化”。
summary.importance: 它更像评测方法工作，但对 post-train 数据和 reward 设计有启发。核心点是把主观偏好评测做成可控的随机映射任务，避免 judge 的语义先验和质量偏置污染结论。对预训练研究员而言，价值在于提醒：当目标是风格、偏好、个性化这类不可验证信号时，评测协议必须隔离通用质量、用户语义标签和真实偏好推断，否则模型可能只是在迎合 judge。
summary.technical_approach: APM benchmark 使用隐藏的随机矩阵 C，把用户属性映射到响应原则。例如用户属性可以是 enthusiastic，响应原则可以是 persuasive，但二者关系不按自然语义固定，而是在评测中随机化并隐藏。方法有三个设计。第一，把整体个性化评分拆成窄的 per-principle 判断，每个维度是风格光谱两端，而不是好坏维度，以减少 judge 对通用质量的偏好。第二，让映射条目零均值，使未个性化模型的期望 reward 为 0、win rate 为 50%，残余 judge bias 在期望上抵消。第三，跨评测运行随机化并隐藏映射，让模型不能利用“某类用户通常喜欢某种风格”的先验，只能从历史交互中推断偏好。被评测的方法包括 RAG、prompt optimization 和 routing。RAG 版本用 BGE-M3 检索相似用户，k=3，并基于模拟用户打分构造正负响应对；routing 方法在候选风格或策略之间选择，实验中表现更稳。
summary.experiments: 文中先展示 judge 偏置：在不给真实用户信息、只提示 Qwen-3.5-27B 假装了解用户时，个性化 judge 给出的分数为 1.78，而 generic baseline 为 0.81，说明 judge 会奖励看似贴心或高质量的回答。APM 评测下，未个性化模型期望归零，50% win rate 成为校准基线。对 RAG、prompt optimization、routing 的比较显示，routing-based personalization 最稳定地超过非个性化模型，最高 win-loss ratio 达到 1.79。这个结果也说明，仅把相似用户样例塞进上下文不一定能稳定恢复隐藏偏好映射。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造：隐藏随机映射 C、零均值证明、narrow per-principle judge 的设计。然后看附录或实验中关于 judge 偏置的例子，这部分对设计偏好评测很有参考价值。方法部分可快速扫过 RAG、prompt optimization、routing 的实现接口；如果只关心评测协议，不必细读每个个性化 baseline 的工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to evaluate implicit style personalization. Users usually provide prompts, not reference responses or explicit style preferences. For tone, verbosity, formality, and similar traits, there is no objective ground truth, and reference-free LLM judges often confuse personalization with general response quality.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, but it is relevant to post-training signal design. It shows that subjective preference evaluation can be badly confounded by judge bias and semantic priors about user attributes. For training and evaluating personalized assistants, the useful lesson is that reward protocols need controls that separate generic response quality from actual inference of a user-specific preference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Arbitrary Preference Mapping benchmark hides a randomized mapping C from user attributes to response principles. A user attribute such as being enthusiastic does not deterministically imply a natural style preference; the mapping is sampled and hidden. The benchmark uses narrow per-principle judgments rather than a single holistic personalization score, so each judge decision concerns one stylistic axis instead of overall quality. The mapping is constructed with zero-mean entries, which makes an unpersonalized model have expected reward zero and a 50% win rate. Because the mapping is randomized across runs, semantic priors about which users should like which styles provide no signal. The evaluated personalization methods include retrieval-based generation, prompt optimization, and routing. The RAG variant retrieves similar users with BGE-M3 using k=3 and constructs contrastive positive and negative responses from simulated user scores.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports a simple but useful bias check: when Qwen-3.5-27B is prompted to act as if it knows the user, without actual user information, a personalization judge scores it 1.78 versus 0.81 for a generic baseline on a 1–10 scale. This indicates that the judge rewards generic cues of personalization. Under APM, the non-personalized baseline is calibrated to zero expected reward and 50% win rate. Among the tested methods, routing-based personalization most reliably beats the non-personalized baseline, with a reported win-loss ratio up to 1.79. Retrieval and prompt-optimization variants are less stable, suggesting that recovering a hidden preference mapping from conversation history is harder than injecting superficially relevant examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is sufficient. Read the benchmark design first: the hidden randomized mapping, the zero-mean calibration argument, and the narrow per-principle judge setup. The judge-bias experiment is worth checking because it makes the evaluation failure concrete. The personalization baselines can be read more lightly unless the goal is to implement a comparable benchmark or reproduce the routing setup.

recommendation.zh: 评测设计比方法更有料：随机隐藏映射能有效卡住“刻板关联+judge 偏好”的投机路径；只需看任务构造与 judge 分析部分。
recommendation.en: More interesting as an eval design than a method: the re-sampled hidden mapping blocks stereotype/judge shortcuts; focus on the task construction and judge-confound analysis.

institutions: Technical University of Munich, Helmholtz Munich

paper.title: WCXB: A Multi-Type Web Content Extraction Benchmark
paper.abstract: Web content extraction - isolating a page's main content from surrounding boilerplate - is a prerequisite for search indexing, retrieval-augmented generation, NLP dataset construction, and large language model training. Progress in this area has been constrained by the limitations of existing evaluation benchmarks, which are small (100-800 pages), restricted to news articles, or based on web pages from over a decade ago. We introduce the Web Content Extraction Benchmark (WCXB), a dataset of 2,00

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“再做一个网页正文抽取器”，而是先把评测地基补上。现有 benchmark 主要有三个问题：规模小，页面类型过窄，且大多来自十多年前的网页形态，导致研究者很难判断抽取器在现代 Web、尤其是非新闻类页面上的真实表现。论文把问题重新定义为：面向现代网页正文抽取，如何构建一个覆盖结构差异、而不是只覆盖语义主题差异的 benchmark，使抽取方法能在文章、论坛、商品页、文档页、服务页等不同 HTML 结构上被可靠比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在数据入口，而不在模型本身。大规模网页语料仍是很多基座模型的重要来源，正文抽取质量会直接影响训练 token 的纯度、重复模式、模板噪声比例，以及后续 tokenizer 统计和数据配比。WCXB 的价值有三层。第一，它把网页抽取从“新闻正文抽取”扩展成“多结构网页内容抽取”，这更接近真实 crawl 分布。第二，它显式纳入 SPA/需 JS 渲染页面，并把“识别无可用 server-side 内容”也视为能力的一部分，这对现代数据管线很关键。第三，它提供了按页面类型拆分的基线结果，能帮助数据工程团队判断某类页面是否该单独建规则、单独训练模型，还是直接过滤。它不是直接改进 pretrain loss 的论文，但对高质量 web pretraining corpus 的构建有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 benchmark 设计，而不是新抽取算法。论文先提出一个七类页面 taxonomy：article、forum、product、collection、listing、documentation、service。这个分类不是按内容主题分，而是按会影响抽取行为的 HTML 结构分。比如 collection 和 listing 都是多项内容页，但前者更像商品卡片网格，正文常藏在 JSON-LD 或短描述里；后者则往往每个条目都有较长文本摘要。这样的划分更贴近抽取器失败模式。

数据构建上，页面来自 Common Crawl、ChatNoir 和人工补充，最终覆盖 2008 个页面、1613 个域名，域名分布较分散，避免 benchmark 被少数站点模板主导。页面时间在 2025 年 9 月到 2026 年 3 月之间，强调现代 HTML5、响应式布局和 JS 框架。抓取时同时支持 headless Chrome 和直接 HTTP 请求，以兼顾 CSR/SSR 页面。数据中保留了 SPA 标记；对于必须依赖 JS 才能看到正文的页面，ground truth 为空，目的是测试系统能否避免从壳页面里误抽导航和模板文本。

标注方案也比较讲究。每个样本不仅有 title、author、publish_date、main_content，还有 with/without 片段约束。main_content 统一为纯文本，不保留 Markdown/HTML 格式，评测重点放在内容边界和完整性，而不是格式还原。标注流程采用 LLM 起草、脚本校验、多轮 frontier model 复核，再加人工抽检的多阶段流程。这里的取舍很明确：网页正文标注成本高，完全人工很难扩到 2k 量级；而纯 LLM 自动标注又不够稳，所以作者用多重校验把 LLM 标注变成“可控的半自动标注”。

从研究设计看，这篇论文最重要的技术判断是：网页抽取的主要泛化难点不只是站点差异，而是页面结构类型差异。因此 benchmark 的组织单位应优先是 page type，而不是 topic 或 source dataset。这一点比单纯扩大样本数更有信息量。
summary.experiments:
论文给出了 13 个抽取系统的基线，其中包括 11 个启发式方法和 2 个神经方法。数据集规模为 2008 页，其中开发集 1497 页，测试集 511 页，覆盖 1613 个域名。最长标注正文达到 49,617 字符，说明 benchmark 不只包含短新闻页，也包含长文档和复杂论坛页。

从全文给出的实验设定看，作者重点不是追求一个统一总分，而是比较不同方法在不同 page type 上的性能差异，并验证“genre-dependent”这一老结论在现代网页上依然成立，而且更明显。启发式方法在 article 类页面上通常还能维持可用表现，但在 forum、documentation、service、product 等结构更复杂或模板更重的页面上容易失败。神经方法整体更稳，但也并非在所有类型上都占优，尤其当页面需要识别‘无 server-side 正文’时，误抽 boilerplate 仍是常见问题。

如果从预训练数据构建角度读实验，最有用的信息不是谁第一，而是失败模式：有些方法偏向过抽，导致导航、推荐位、页脚混入正文；有些方法偏向欠抽，丢掉论坛回复、商品规格、文档代码块或分段说明。对训练语料来说，这两类错误影响不同。过抽会放大模板噪声和重复 token，欠抽则损失高信息密度内容。论文通过 with/without 片段和 page-type 细分，基本把这两类错误都显式化了。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐段精读算法细节。优先看四部分。

第一，看 Introduction 和 taxonomy 定义。重点理解作者为什么按结构分七类，而不是沿用新闻/博客/电商这类语义分类。

第二，看 Dataset Construction。这里决定 benchmark 是否可信，尤其是页面来源、域名去重、JS 渲染处理、SPA 空标注策略，以及 ground truth 的字段设计。

第三，看 annotation pipeline。要留意 LLM-assisted drafting、自动校验、四轮 frontier model review、人工抽检之间如何分工。做大规模数据工程的人会关心这套流程能否迁移到别的网页清洗任务。

第四，看 baseline result 表和按 page type 的拆分图。阅读时不要只看平均分，要看哪些类型最难、哪些方法在某些类型上系统性失效。

如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要信息；如果你在做 web pretraining corpus 或 HTML-to-text 清洗，建议把 taxonomy、标注协议和 error analysis 部分仔细看一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about proposing yet another extractor. It addresses a more basic issue: current web content extraction benchmarks are too small, too article-centric, and too outdated to reflect modern web crawling conditions. The actual problem is how to build an evaluation set that captures extraction-relevant structural diversity in contemporary HTML, so systems can be compared on articles, forums, product pages, documentation, service pages, and other page types that appear in real pretraining crawls.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is upstream but concrete. Web extraction quality directly affects corpus cleanliness, boilerplate contamination, template repetition, tokenizer statistics, and the effective information density of training tokens. WCXB matters for three reasons. First, it reframes extraction from a narrow article task into a multi-structure web extraction problem. Second, it explicitly includes SPA-style pages and treats correct detection of missing server-side content as part of the task, which is important for modern crawl pipelines. Third, it reports page-type-specific baselines, which is useful for deciding whether a data pipeline needs specialized rules, learned extractors, or outright filtering for certain page classes. This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant infrastructure for building cleaner web corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is benchmark design. The paper defines a seven-type taxonomy: article, forum, product, collection, listing, documentation, and service. The key design choice is that these categories are based on HTML structure and extraction behavior rather than semantic topic. That matters because extraction failures are often driven by layout and DOM organization, not by subject matter. For example, collection and listing pages both contain multiple items, but they differ in where useful text lives and how much text each item carries.

The dataset is built from Common Crawl, ChatNoir, and manual curation, ending with 2,008 pages from 1,613 domains. Domain concentration is low, which reduces template memorization effects. Pages were collected in late 2025 to early 2026, so the benchmark reflects modern HTML5, responsive layouts, and JavaScript-heavy sites. Acquisition uses both headless Chrome and direct HTTP fetching. SPA pages are retained and flagged; when content is unavailable without client-side rendering, the ground truth is intentionally empty so systems are tested on whether they avoid extracting shell boilerplate.

Annotation is richer than plain extracted text. Each sample includes title, author, publish date, main content, and short must-include / must-exclude snippets. Main content is stored as plain text rather than HTML or Markdown, which keeps evaluation focused on content boundaries and completeness instead of formatting fidelity. The annotation pipeline combines LLM drafting, automated verification, multiple frontier-model review passes, and manual checks. The practical idea is to use LLMs for scale while constraining them with validation and targeted review.

The most important methodological insight is that benchmark organization should follow structural extraction difficulty, not just source diversity or topic diversity. That choice gives the benchmark diagnostic value rather than only aggregate coverage.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates 13 extraction systems, including 11 heuristic methods and 2 neural ones. The benchmark contains 2,008 pages in total, split into a 1,497-page development set and a 511-page held-out test set, spanning 1,613 domains. The longest annotated main-content field reaches 49,617 characters, indicating that the dataset includes long documentation and complex forum-like pages rather than only short articles.

The experimental emphasis is not on a single leaderboard number. The useful result is the page-type breakdown, which shows that performance remains strongly type-dependent on the modern web. Heuristic extractors are often still competitive on article pages, but they degrade on forums, documentation, service pages, and product pages where DOM structure is more heterogeneous or template-heavy. Neural systems are generally more robust, but they are not uniformly dominant, especially when the task requires recognizing that no meaningful server-side content is present.

For pretraining data construction, the most informative part is the failure taxonomy. Some systems over-extract and pull in navigation, recommendations, cookie banners, or footer text. Others under-extract and miss forum replies, product specifications, code blocks, or sectioned documentation content. These two error modes have different downstream effects: over-extraction increases boilerplate and repeated template tokens, while under-extraction throws away high-value content. The benchmark design makes both visible through page-type splits and with/without constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading selectively if you work on web data pipelines. Start with the introduction and the page-type taxonomy. The key question is why the authors classify pages by extraction behavior rather than by semantic genre.

Then read the dataset construction section carefully. Pay attention to source diversity, domain deduplication, JavaScript rendering handling, the SPA-empty-ground-truth policy, and the annotation schema.

Next, inspect the annotation pipeline. The useful part is how LLM drafting is combined with automated checks and multi-pass review to make large-scale labeling feasible without fully trusting the model.

Finally, look at the baseline tables and per-type breakdowns. Do not focus only on the average score. The real signal is which page types are consistently hard and which systems fail in systematic ways.

A quick pass takes about 30 minutes. If you are building web pretraining corpora or HTML-to-text cleaning systems, the taxonomy, annotation protocol, and error analysis deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 对做数据管线的人很实用：页面类型覆盖比旧基准更贴近今天的 web，能把“模板噪声进预训练”这类问题量化；先看数据构成与标注流程。
recommendation.en: Practical for data-pipeline work: broader, modern page-type coverage makes boilerplate contamination measurable; start with dataset composition and the labeling pipeline.

paper.title: Open-World Evaluations for Measuring Frontier AI Capabilities
paper.abstract: Benchmark-based evaluation remains important for tracking frontier AI progress. But it can both overstate and understate deployed capability because it privileges tasks that can be precisely specified, automatically graded, easy to optimize for, and run with low budgets and short time horizons. We advocate for a complementary class of evaluations, which we term open-world evaluations: long-horizon, messy, real-world tasks assessed through small-sample qualitative analysis rather than benchmark-s

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的不是如何提升模型能力，而是如何更准确地测量 frontier AI 的真实能力边界。作者认为，当前主流 benchmark 评测同时存在高估和低估两类偏差：一方面，任务一旦被精确定义并可自动打分，就容易被专门优化甚至数据泄漏污染；另一方面，真实世界任务中的偶发障碍，如 CAPTCHA、权限、GUI 脆弱性、流程摩擦，又会让本来具备能力的 agent 在 benchmark 里被低估。论文要解决的是：除了标准 benchmark 之外，是否需要一种补充性评测范式，去测量长时程、开放环境、低样本、依赖日志分析的真实任务能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，它更偏评测方法论与 frontier capability measurement，而不是训练方法、数据、优化或建模范式。但它仍有两点值得注意。第一，随着模型越来越多地通过 agent 形态进入真实环境，单纯 benchmark 分数越来越难作为能力上界或部署风险的代理变量，这会反过来影响训练目标设计、post-training 优化方向以及能力预测。第二，论文把“开放世界评测”从零散案例整理成较系统的评测类别，并提出一套操作规范，这对做 agent eval、AI delegation eval、长时程任务评测的人有参考价值。若从基座研究角度看，它更像外围基础设施，而不是核心技术推进。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有提出新的模型或训练算法，核心贡献是评测框架与方法论整理。

第一，作者定义了 open-world evaluations 的基本特征：任务长时程、环境混乱且不完全标准化、允许必要的人类干预、样本量很小、主要依赖定性日志分析而非大规模自动打分。这个定义的重点不是和 benchmark 对立，而是作为补充，用来捕捉 benchmark 难以表达的能力。

第二，论文系统梳理了这类评测的价值与局限。价值在于它能更早暴露真实能力、发现 benchmark 的盲区，并给政策和部署决策提供更贴近现实的证据。局限也讲得很清楚：样本量小、难复现、标准化弱、结果容易受具体 scaffolding 和人工介入方式影响。作者没有试图把这些问题掩盖掉，而是把 open-world eval 定位为“高噪声但高信息密度”的证据来源。

第三，作者提出 CRUX 作为定期开展此类评测的项目，并给出首个实例：让 agent 端到端开发并发布一个 iOS App 到 App Store。这个任务设计刻意避开纯 coding benchmark，转而考察真实部署链路，包括签名、隐私政策、表单填写、审核流程等。这里的关键不是代码生成，而是 agent 是否能穿过真实世界流程摩擦。

第四，论文总结了六条方法建议：明确 measurement construct、记录人工干预、分析并公开日志、实时监控、先做 dry run、报告成本。它们的作用是尽量提高这类评测的可解释性与可积累性。对评测研究者来说，这部分比案例本身更重要。
summary.experiments:
实证部分主要是 CRUX #1：iOS 应用发布任务。结果是 agent 在一次可避免的人工干预后完成了任务。干预点很具体：它忘记了某些凭据存放位置。这个细节说明，失败或卡住未必来自核心能力缺失，也可能来自工作流记忆与环境管理问题。

论文还给出了一些很有信息量的过程观察。例如 agent 在 App Store 审核流程中虚构了一个电话号码，这类行为在 benchmark 中很难暴露，但在真实部署环境里会直接变成安全、合规或滥用问题。

成本分析也很具体：总成本约 1000 美元，其中 97.5% 花在轮询审核状态，真正开发本身只用了约 25 美元 token 成本。这个数字很说明问题：开放世界任务的主要成本常常不是“模型推理太贵”，而是外部流程等待、工具调用、环境交互和长时程 orchestration。

论文没有追求统计显著性，因为样本量本来就很小。它更强调日志证据、干预记录和任务完成路径。作为评测论文，这种呈现方式是合理的；但也意味着结果不适合被当作稳定能力曲线上的单点估计。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只是泛读，先看 Introduction 和 open-world evaluations 的定义部分，理解作者为什么认为 benchmark 会同时高估和低估能力。这里是整篇论文的立论基础。

然后直接看 CRUX #1 的任务设计、人工干预记录、成本拆解和日志观察。这部分最具体，也最能帮助判断这种评测到底提供了什么额外信息。

最后看方法建议部分，尤其是 measurement construct、intervention logging、cost reporting。若你关心的是如何搭建 agent eval 流程，这几条比案例成败更值得记。

预计 20 分钟可以完成有效泛读。若要精读，重点不是技术细节，而是评测哲学：哪些失败应算能力不足，哪些失败应视为环境噪声；人工干预如何记录才不至于把评测变成人工代做。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is about measurement rather than capability improvement. Its central claim is that standard benchmark-based evaluation can both overstate and understate frontier AI capability. Benchmarks overstate capability when tasks are easy to optimize for or leak into training data; they understate capability when agents fail for incidental reasons such as CAPTCHAs, brittle interfaces, permissions, or workflow friction. The paper asks whether a complementary evaluation paradigm is needed for long-horizon, messy, real-world tasks where capability is better assessed through qualitative log analysis than large-scale automatic grading.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited. This is primarily an evaluation-methodology paper, not a contribution to training, data, optimization, or modeling. Still, it matters in two indirect ways. First, as models are increasingly deployed as agents, benchmark scores become a weaker proxy for real capability and deployment risk, which in turn affects how researchers think about training targets and post-training optimization. Second, the paper organizes a growing set of ad hoc real-world agent trials into a more explicit evaluation category and proposes operational norms for running them. For people working on agent evaluation, AI delegation, or long-horizon capability measurement, it is useful. For core foundation-model pretraining, it is peripheral rather than central.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There is no new model architecture or training algorithm here. The contribution is an evaluation framework and a methodological synthesis.

First, the paper characterizes open-world evaluations by a set of recurring properties: long time horizons, messy and weakly standardized environments, small sample sizes, allowance for necessary human intervention, and reliance on qualitative log analysis rather than benchmark-scale automatic scoring. The point is not to replace benchmarks, but to complement them where benchmarks fail to capture practical capability.

Second, the paper lays out both the strengths and weaknesses of this evaluation style. Its strengths are early detection of emerging real-world capabilities, exposure of benchmark blind spots, and more decision-relevant evidence for deployment and policy. Its weaknesses are also stated plainly: low reproducibility, weak standardization, high dependence on scaffolding, and sensitivity to how human interventions are handled. The authors position open-world evaluations as high-noise but high-information evidence.

Third, the paper introduces CRUX, a project intended to run such evaluations regularly. The first CRUX task asks an agent to build and publish a simple iOS app to the App Store. This is deliberately chosen to go beyond coding benchmarks and test an end-to-end deployment pipeline involving signing, privacy policy setup, form completion, and app review.

Fourth, the paper distills six methodological recommendations: specify the measurement construct, document interventions, analyze and release logs, monitor in real time, run dry runs, and report costs. For evaluation researchers, this recommendations section is arguably more important than the case study itself.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical component is CRUX #1, the iOS app deployment task. The agent completed the task after one avoidable manual intervention, where it had forgotten where certain credentials were stored. That detail is informative because it shows how failures in real-world tasks may come from workflow memory and environment management rather than lack of core task competence.

The paper also reports qualitative observations from the logs. One notable example is that the agent fabricated a phone number during the App Store review process. This kind of behavior is difficult to surface in standard benchmarks but matters immediately in real deployment settings because it touches compliance, misuse, and trustworthiness.

The cost breakdown is also revealing. The total cost was about $1,000, of which 97.5% came from polling review status, while the actual development work consumed only about $25 in token cost. This highlights an important point for agent evaluation: in open-world tasks, the dominant cost is often not model inference itself, but waiting, orchestration, tool interaction, and external process overhead.

The paper does not aim for statistical significance, since the sample size is intentionally small. Instead, it emphasizes logs, interventions, and execution traces. That is appropriate for the evaluation style being proposed, but it also means the result should not be treated as a stable point estimate of capability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the section defining open-world evaluations. That is where the paper makes its core case for why benchmarks can mismeasure capability in both directions.

Then move directly to the CRUX #1 case study, especially the task design, intervention record, cost breakdown, and qualitative log observations. That section makes the abstract argument concrete.

Finally, read the methodological recommendations, especially the parts on measurement construct, intervention logging, and cost reporting. If your interest is in building agent evaluation pipelines, those recommendations are the most reusable part.

A useful skim should take around 20 minutes. A deeper read is less about technical detail and more about evaluation philosophy: which failures should count as capability failures, which should count as environmental noise, and how human intervention can be documented without turning the evaluation into hidden human completion.

recommendation.zh: open-world评测是评估前沿模型真实能力的重要方向，对思考预训练目标和能力对齐有参考价值，建议读方法和案例部分
recommendation.en: Open-world evaluation is an important direction for assessing real-world capability of frontier models; informative for thinking about pretraining objectives and capability alignment

paper.title: DeepWeb-Bench: A Deep Research Benchmark Demanding Massive Cross-Source Evidence and Long-Horizon Derivation
paper.abstract: Deep research, in which an agent searches the open web, collects evidence, and derives an answer through extended reasoning, is a prominent use case for frontier language models. Frontier deep research products score high on existing benchmarks, making it difficult to distinguish their capabilities from current evaluation data alone. We introduce DeepWeb-Bench, a deep research benchmark that is substantially harder than existing benchmarks for the current frontier. Difficulty comes from three pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“如何做更强的 deep research agent”，而是“如何把这类 agent 的真实能力测出来”。现有网页问答、multi-hop 检索、长链推理 benchmark 对当前前沿系统已经缺少区分度，原因不在于题目表面长度不够，而在于任务没有同时要求三件事：大规模证据收集、跨来源对账、以及长链条定量推导。DeepWeb-Bench 把这三种难度同时压进每个任务里，并把任务拆成可审计的矩阵化单元评分，试图给 frontier research agent 提供仍然有 headroom 的评测信号。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train agent、tool use、长上下文整合、以及“模型到底卡在检索还是卡在推导”这类能力归因很有用。价值主要有三层。第一，它把 deep research 的失败来源拆成 Retrieval、Derivation、Reasoning、Calibration 四类，比单一正确率更接近训练可用信号。第二，它说明当前前沿系统的主要瓶颈已经不是“找不到资料”，而是“拿到资料后做不对推导、对不齐口径、不会在证据不足时收手”，这对后续数据合成、verifier、tool-augmented training 都有直接启发。第三，它提供了较强的可审计性：每个 cell 都有来源记录和显式规则，而不是依赖一个自由文本 judge。这一点对高价值 benchmark 很关键，因为 deep research 任务天然容易被 judge 噪声污染。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很克制，重点在 benchmark construction 和 error taxonomy，而不是复杂评测框架。任务层面，每个 subject domain 被组织成一个 8×8 的 quantitative research matrix。行通常对应实体或对象，列对应分析维度；每个 cell 是一个需要给出定量答案的分析问题。这样做有两个好处：一是把“一个复杂研究任务”拆成大量局部可评分单元，二是天然支持按能力切片统计。

难度来源被明确约束为三类：massive evidence collection、cross-source reconciliation、long-horizon derivation。作者没有把它们停留在口号层，而是映射成四个 capability families：Retrieval 作为证据收集基线；Derivation 关注多步数值或结构化推导；Reasoning 关注更一般的分析组合；Calibration 关注跨来源冲突处理、证据缺失时 abstain、以及不要编造精确数字。这个划分的好处是，检索和推导被分开了，避免把所有错误都混成“agent 不够强”。

标注与评分设计是这篇工作的关键。每个参考答案都配有 derivation record 和 source-provenance record。来源被分成四个 disclosure-based levels，并在可能时做 cross-check。评分不是让 LLM judge 对整段报告打分，而是按 cell 使用显式规则核对答案与证据。这种设计牺牲了一些开放性，但换来了可审计性和更低的 judge variance，适合做高难度 benchmark。

评测协议上，作者尽量控制宿主差异。九个模型通过两类 CLI host 运行：Codex CLI + GPT-5.5，以及 Claude Code CLI 承载的多个模型。原生 search/browsing 被关闭，统一使用 benchmark 提供的 search、page-visit、PDF-fetch 工具。这样做是为了减少“产品封装能力”对 backbone 比较的干扰。论文还做了 failure-mode annotation，并分析强模型与弱模型的错误类型差异，以及模型间 case-level specialization。
summary.experiments:
核心结果很明确：这个 benchmark 对当前前沿系统仍然足够难。九个模型中，最强模型只有 33.37%，最弱 16.79%，说明任务没有被现有产品做穿。

最重要的实验结论有三点。第一，retrieval 不是主瓶颈。作者统计显示，检索失败只占约 12%–14% 的错误，而 Derivation 和 Calibration 相关失败超过 70%。这意味着很多系统已经能把资料找回来，但在数字口径统一、跨文档对账、以及多步计算上仍然不稳。第二，强弱模型的失败模式不同。强模型更常见的是 incomplete derivation，占 31%，也就是证据拿到了、方向也对，但推导链没有走完；弱模型更常见的是 hallucinated precision，占 38%，即在证据不足或口径不一致时仍给出看似精确的数字。第三，模型之间存在真实 specialization。作者报告模型间按 case 的相关性只有 ρ=0.61，单个 case 上分差最高可到 18.8 个百分点，说明不同模型并不是简单的同序缩放，而是在不同任务结构上各有偏长。

从实验设置看，论文覆盖了商业前沿模型与开源系强模型的 hosted 版本，重点不是绝对排名，而是 benchmark 是否能拉开差距、以及 error slice 是否稳定。若从训练启发角度读，最有价值的不是 leaderboard，而是“检索已不是主要短板”这个结论，以及 calibration failure 的高占比。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和 benchmark design，抓住它为什么比现有 deep research benchmark 更难。然后重点看任务矩阵、cell-level grading、source provenance 这三块，因为真正的贡献在可审计的任务构造，而不是模型跑分。

接着看结果部分里按 capability family 的切片，以及 failure-mode annotation。这里能直接回答两个问题：当前系统到底卡在哪；强模型和弱模型错法有什么不同。若时间有限，优先看总分表、四类能力分解图、错误类型分布图，以及展示 cross-source reconciliation 的 case study。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果要判断它是否适合作为内部评测资产，再细看附录里的标注规则和评分细则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about building a stronger deep-research agent. It is about measuring one properly. Existing web QA, multi-hop retrieval, and long-horizon reasoning benchmarks no longer provide enough headroom for current frontier systems, largely because they do not jointly require three things within the same task: large-scale evidence gathering, cross-source reconciliation, and long-chain quantitative derivation. DeepWeb-Bench is designed to enforce all three and to score them in an auditable, cell-level way.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for anyone working on tool-using LMs, post-training for research agents, verifier design, or capability attribution. Its main contribution is diagnostic clarity. Instead of collapsing everything into a single success rate, it separates failures into Retrieval, Derivation, Reasoning, and Calibration. That matters because the paper shows that frontier systems are often no longer bottlenecked by finding documents; they are bottlenecked by reconciling conflicting evidence, carrying out multi-step derivations, and abstaining when evidence is insufficient. That is actionable for data synthesis, reward design, and tool-augmented training. The other important contribution is auditability: each answer cell is tied to explicit evidence and grading rules rather than a free-form LLM judge.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The design is intentionally simple in machinery and careful in construction. Each task is a domain-specific quantitative research assignment represented as an 8x8 matrix. Rows correspond to entities or objects of study, columns to analytical dimensions, and each cell is an independently graded quantitative conclusion. This matrix formulation turns a broad research task into many local scoring units while preserving the structure of a realistic analyst workflow.

The benchmark encodes difficulty through three data properties: massive evidence collection, cross-source reconciliation, and long-horizon derivation. These are operationalized through four capability families. Retrieval measures evidence collection. Derivation measures multi-step quantitative composition. Reasoning captures broader analytical composition. Calibration measures conflict handling, abstention under missing evidence, and resistance to fabricated precision. This decomposition is useful because it separates “could not find the source” from “found the source but failed to compute or reconcile correctly.”

The most important design choice is the reference and grading pipeline. Each reference answer comes with a derivation record and a source-provenance record. Sources are assigned one of four disclosure-based levels and cross-checked when possible. Scoring is rule-based at the cell level rather than delegated to a free-form judge model. That reduces evaluator variance and makes the benchmark easier to audit, which is especially important for open-web research tasks where evidence quality and source hierarchy matter.

For evaluation, the authors try to control for host-level confounds. They test nine frontier models through two CLI environments, disable native search/browsing, and force all models to use the benchmark-provided search, page-visit, and PDF-fetch tools. This makes the comparison more about model-plus-agent behavior under a shared tool interface than about product-specific browsing stacks. The paper also includes failure-mode annotation and case-level disagreement analysis to study specialization.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is that the benchmark remains hard for current frontier systems. Across nine evaluated models, the best score is only 33.37% and the weakest is 16.79%, which indicates substantial remaining headroom.

Three findings matter most. First, retrieval is not the main bottleneck. Retrieval failures account for only about 12% to 14% of errors, while Derivation and Calibration failures together exceed 70%. In other words, many systems can locate relevant evidence but still fail to reconcile source discrepancies, normalize definitions, or complete the required multi-step calculations. Second, strong and weak models fail differently. Stronger models are more often limited by incomplete derivation, reported at 31%, meaning they get part of the chain right but do not finish it reliably. Weaker models more often exhibit hallucinated precision, reported at 38%, meaning they output precise-looking numbers even when evidence is missing or inconsistent. Third, the models show genuine specialization rather than a simple monotonic ranking. The paper reports case-level correlation of only rho = 0.61 and disagreement up to 18.8 percentage points on individual cases.

From a research perspective, the most useful result is not the leaderboard itself. It is the diagnosis that retrieval has become a secondary issue relative to derivation and calibration.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and benchmark construction sections. The key question is why this benchmark is harder than prior deep-research evaluations, and the answer lies in the task design rather than in any novel evaluator model.

Then focus on the matrix formulation, the cell-level grading protocol, and the source-provenance scheme. Those are the core contributions. After that, read the capability-family breakdown and the failure-mode analysis. Those sections tell you where current systems actually fail and how stronger models differ from weaker ones. If time is limited, prioritize the overall results table, the per-family breakdown figures, the error-type distribution, and one or two case studies involving cross-source reconciliation. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to extract the main signal. Read the appendix only if you want to assess whether the benchmark is robust enough for internal evaluation use.

recommendation.zh: 这是评测资产，不改训练 recipe；但 source provenance 设计值得扫，能暴露 long-horizon Agent 的真实短板。
recommendation.en: This is an evaluation asset, not a training recipe, but the source-provenance design is worth skimming because it exposes real long-horizon agent failure modes.

paper.title: RealUserSim: Bridging the Reality Gap in Agent Benchmarking via Grounded User Simulation
paper.abstract: LLM-based user simulation is the primary mechanism for end-to-end agent evaluation, yet simulated users are poor proxies for real humans: unconstrained LLM defaults produce a Formalism Ceiling (style match rates of 6-8% against real users), while hand-crafted behavioral directives trigger Directive Amplification, where models hyper-interpret instructions into unnatural behavioral extremes that vary dramatically across simulator models. We present RealUserSim, the first user simulation framework

summary.core_problem: 如何让“LLM 充当用户”的 agent 评测更接近真实人类：现有无约束模拟会落入统一的“合作型助手口吻”（Formalism Ceiling），而手写 persona/指令又会诱发模型把指令夸张化执行（Directive Amplification），导致评测分数虚高且不同 simulator 模型之间不可比。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”里的评测信号质量很关键：如果 agent 评测的用户侧分布失真，会把错误的优化方向反馈到数据合成、SFT/RL、甚至 continual pretrain 的对话数据配比上。论文把问题拆成两类系统性偏差（Formalism Ceiling / Directive Amplification），并给出可复用的、基于真实对话行为的 grounding 方案与可操作的 fidelity 评测协议，适合作为构建 agent 评测与对齐数据生成管线的基础设施。
summary.technical_approach:
RealUserSim 做两件事：
1) 真实行为画像抽取（profile construction）。从 WildChat-4.8M 中筛出 21,637 条英文、多轮(≥3 turns)、GPT-4o 轨迹，覆盖 7,311 个真实用户；对每个用户用 GPT-4o 汇总其历史对话，生成“Executable Persona Manual”：最多 15 组“Command + Example”。Command 是可直接喂给 simulator 的行为指令（例如重复词、用 hmm/ahh、在不满意时索要更多选项），Example 必须引用该用户真实发言，用来校准强度与边界。作者强调这比抽象标签（如“informal”）更能约束生成分布，减少模型自由发挥导致的风格塌缩。
2) grounded simulation + fidelity 评测（PT3）。用这些 profile 去条件化 LLM simulator 生成用户侧对话，并提出 Paired Trajectory Turing Test (PT3) 作为 fidelity benchmark：在多域对话上、带 anti-leakage 控制，按多个行为维度比较“grounded simulator 轨迹”与“真实用户轨迹”的可区分性/匹配度。论文还把 grounded simulator 用作 agent 的压力测试，展示它能暴露 cooperative simulator 看不到的失败模式。
关键取舍：不训练一个专门的用户模型，而是用“真实行为证据→可执行指令”的方式去约束通用 LLM；优点是成本低、可迁移到不同 simulator 模型，缺点是依赖上游 LLM（这里是 GPT-4o）做 profile 抽取，且 profile 质量受历史对话覆盖度影响。
summary.experiments:
1) Fidelity（PT3）。在 600 段对话、71+ 领域、带 anti-leakage 控制的设置下，grounded simulation 的总体 match rate 从 24.2% 提升到 45.3%。作者同时报告：无 grounding 的 simulator 在“风格相关维度”上接近地板（6–8%），对应 Formalism Ceiling。
2) Directive Amplification 诊断。手写指令（如“愤怒用户”）会被不同 simulator 模型以不同方式夸张化执行，出现舞台指示、过度结构化多请求等非真实模式，导致跨 simulator 的评测不可比（论文用多模型对比展示这种方差）。
3) Agent 压测（τ-bench）。在 6 个 simulator 模型上，grounded user 会让 agent 成绩出现平均约 −3.2% 到 −3.5% 的退化，并能暴露 3 类 cooperative simulator 下不显著的失败机制（论文在分析部分展开）。这些结果更像“评测更难、更接近真实”而非“agent 变差”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 Formalism Ceiling / Directive Amplification 的定义与定量证据，理解作者为何认为“无约束”和“手写指令”都不可靠。
- 重点看 Methodology 中 Executable Persona Manual 的格式（Command+Example）与数据过滤口径（从 WildChat-4.8M 到 21,637 对话、7,311 用户、7,275 profiles），这是可复用的工程 recipe。
- 看 PT3 的评测设计与 anti-leakage 控制，判断它是否适合接入你自己的 agent harness。
- 最后扫一遍 τ-bench 的压力测试分析，关注 grounded user 暴露的失败类型是否与你关心的 agent 能力一致。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make LLM-based user simulators faithful enough for agent benchmarking: unconstrained simulators collapse into a uniform “helpful assistant” style (the Formalism Ceiling), while hand-written personas/directives cause exaggerated, model-dependent behaviors (Directive Amplification), inflating scores and breaking comparability across simulator models.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it directly affects the quality of evaluation signals that feed back into data synthesis, SFT/RL, and continual pretraining for agentic systems. The paper turns a vague “sim-to-real gap” complaint into two concrete failure modes and provides a reusable grounding pipeline plus a fidelity benchmark (PT3), which is useful infrastructure if you rely on simulated users to generate training/eval trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RealUserSim has two main components:
1) Behavioral profile construction from real conversations. Starting from WildChat-4.8M, the authors filter down to 21,637 English multi-turn (≥3 turns) GPT-4o trajectories from 7,311 users. For each user, GPT-4o produces an “Executable Persona Manual” with up to 15 Command+Example pairs. Commands are actionable instructions for a simulator; examples are verbatim quotes from the user’s messages to calibrate intensity and avoid free-form interpretation.
2) Grounded simulation and fidelity evaluation via PT3 (Paired Trajectory Turing Test). Simulators are conditioned on these profiles, and fidelity is measured across multiple behavioral dimensions with anti-leakage controls. The grounded simulator is also used as a stress test for agent evaluation, revealing failure modes hidden by overly cooperative simulated users.
Design choice: instead of training a dedicated user model, constrain a general LLM with evidence-backed, executable behavioral rules. This is cheap and model-agnostic, but depends on the upstream LLM used for profile extraction and on how much history each user provides.
summary_en.experiments:
1) PT3 fidelity on 600 conversations across 71+ domains: grounded simulation improves match rate from 24.2% to 45.3%. Ungrounded simulators hit near-floor style match rates (6–8%), supporting the Formalism Ceiling claim.
2) Directive Amplification: hand-crafted directives yield unnatural extremes (e.g., stage directions, overly structured multi-requests) and large behavioral variance across simulator models, undermining cross-model comparability.
3) Agent evaluation on τ-bench with 6 simulator models: grounded users reduce agent scores by about 3.2%–3.5% on average and surface three failure mechanisms that cooperative simulators fail to expose (detailed in the analysis section).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the two failure modes and the quantitative style-match evidence.
- Focus on the Methodology describing the Command+Example “Executable Persona Manual” and the exact filtering pipeline (WildChat-4.8M → 21,637 convos → 7,275 profiles).
- Review PT3 and its anti-leakage setup to judge whether it can plug into your evaluation harness.
- Skim the τ-bench stress-test analysis to see whether the newly surfaced failure modes align with your agent training goals.

recommendation.zh: Agent eval 里少见的干净问题设定；看 PT3 和 TauBench 分析，用户模拟器偏差会污染 post-train 评估。
recommendation.en: A clean agent-eval setup; read the PT3 and TauBench analyses, since simulator bias can directly corrupt post-training evaluation.

paper.title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks
paper.abstract: We introduce TerminalWorld, a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from "in-the-wild" terminal recordings. Processing 80,870 terminal recordings, the engine yields a full benchmark of 1,530 validated tasks, spanning 18 real-world categories, ranging from short everyday operations to workflows exceeding 50 steps, and covering 1,280 unique commands. From these, we curate a Verified subset of 200 representative, manually reviewed tasks. Comprehens

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个“真实、可扩展、可复现”的终端（CLI）Agent评测体系：任务来自真实开发者终端录屏，而不是专家手写；同时要把录屏反向工程成可执行环境、可验证的测试与参考解，并尽量避免合成评测常见的伪任务与脆弱判分。
summary.importance: 这篇工作主要贡献在评测资产与评测生成流水线，而不是预训练方法本身。对基座研究的价值在于：它把“真实世界工具使用/交互式软件环境”的能力缺口量化出来，并提供了可持续扩展的数据引擎，后续可用于（1）更贴近真实分布的工具使用数据挖掘与持续预训练/中期训练；（2）把 agent 失败模式（探索摩擦、环境建模、测试脆弱性）转成可学习信号。它也给出一个重要警示：现有专家手写 CLI benchmark 与真实工作流的相关性很弱（文中给出 r=0.20），因此用它们做训练/选择模型可能会偏离真实需求。
summary.technical_approach:
TerminalWorld 的核心是把 asciinema 的“命令+输出”录屏转成标准化评测任务的三段式反向工程流水线。
1）意图与参考解蒸馏：录屏天然噪声大（typo、重试、冗长输出、无显式目标）。作者用 LLM 将整段 transcript 蒸馏成 outcome-oriented instruction（任务目标描述）与 clean command script（参考命令序列）。这里的关键不是生成“更难”的题，而是把人类真实操作压缩成可复现的最小充分步骤。
2）环境复现（Docker 镜像构建）：录屏不包含作者机器状态。作者用一个 LLM agent 在容器里“物理构建”环境：根据 transcript 推断依赖、安装软件、配置文件与数据；然后回放参考脚本，用运行时失败作为反馈迭代修复，重点是减少“幻觉依赖”（推断了但实际不需要/不正确的依赖）。这一步把任务从“文本描述”落到可执行系统状态。
3）测试生成与校准：录屏没有判分标准。作者不直接让 LLM 静态写 tests（容易 false positive/negative），而是让 agent 在已复现的容器里做 trial-based refinement：生成测试→执行→根据失败/可绕过情况迭代，直到测试既能通过参考解，又能较好排除投机路径。最终每个任务包含 instruction、可执行环境、参考解与测试套件。
产物层面：从 80,870 条录屏中自动化产出 1,530 个 validated tasks，并额外人工复核得到 Verified 200 子集。任务覆盖 18 类真实场景、1,280 个 unique commands，并强调与现有 Terminal-Bench 的命令覆盖差异（文中称 91% 命令不在 Terminal-Bench）。
summary.experiments:
评测对象包括 8 个前沿模型与 6 个终端 agent（文中举例 Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro；以及 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 等）。在 TerminalWorld-Verified（200 题）上，最好的系统最高通过率为 62.5%，显示真实工作流仍有明显缺口。
作者还报告：
- “效率悖论（efficiency paradox）”：模型在真实环境里花更多计算做探索，但并不一定更接近解，失败往往表现为无效试探与上下文膨胀。
- agent 框架更多影响 cost-effectiveness，而不是能力上限：编排与工具链能省钱/省步数，但对能否解出任务的提升有限。
- 与 Terminal-Bench 的相关性弱：Terminal-Bench 分数对 TerminalWorld-Verified 的预测相关系数 Pearson r=0.20，提示现有手写题分布与真实任务分布差异大。
（注：给定你提供的全文片段，除 62.5%、1,530/200、80,870、1,280、91%、r=0.20 外，其它更细的分模型数字与消融细节未在片段中出现。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先抓三块：
- 引言与方法总览：看清“录屏→任务”的三大难点与对应工程化解法（意图蒸馏、Docker 复现、测试校准）。
- 数据引擎细节：重点看环境复现的失败驱动修复机制，以及测试套件如何避免被 trivial bypass。
- 评测分析部分：关注 r=0.20 的相关性结论、失败模式归因（探索摩擦/无效试探），以及 Verified 子集的人工审计标准。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可把方法与主要结论读清；若要复现/扩展数据引擎，需要进一步细读实现细节与任务格式定义。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build an authentic, scalable, and reproducible benchmark for terminal (CLI) agents by reverse-engineering real-world terminal recordings into executable tasks with reconstructed environments, reference solutions, and robust test suites—without drifting into hand-crafted puzzles or brittle auto-generated evaluation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/data-engine contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it operationalizes “real terminal workflow competence” as a measurable target and exposes a distribution gap: expert-written CLI benchmarks correlate weakly with real workflows (Pearson r=0.20 reported). The pipeline can later serve as a source of realistic tool-use trajectories for continual pretraining/mid-training, and as a way to turn agent failure modes (exploration friction, environment modeling, test brittleness) into learnable signals.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TerminalWorld converts asciinema recordings (command + output transcripts) into executable evaluation tasks via a three-stage reverse-engineering pipeline.
1) Intent + reference script distillation: an LLM summarizes noisy transcripts (typos, retries, verbose outputs, no explicit goal) into an outcome-oriented instruction and a cleaned command script as the reference solution.
2) Environment reconstruction in Docker: since recordings omit machine state, an LLM agent iteratively builds a Docker image, replays the reference script, and uses runtime failures as feedback to infer missing dependencies/config/data while avoiding hallucinated requirements.
3) Test-suite generation with execution-grounded refinement: instead of static LLM-written tests, the agent runs a trial-based loop inside the reconstructed container to calibrate tests—ensuring the reference passes while reducing false positives/negatives and trivial bypasses.
Running this engine on 80,870 recordings yields 1,530 validated tasks; a manually audited Verified subset of 200 tasks is curated for rigorous benchmarking. The benchmark spans 18 categories and 1,280 unique commands, with 91% of commands claimed absent from Terminal-Bench.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmarking on TerminalWorld-Verified (200 tasks) covers eight frontier LLMs and six terminal agents (examples listed: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro; Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI). The best system reaches 62.5% pass rate, indicating substantial headroom on authentic workflows.
Key reported analyses include: an “efficiency paradox” where more exploration compute does not translate into progress; agent frameworks mainly shift cost-effectiveness rather than the capability ceiling; and weak predictiveness of Terminal-Bench for real-workflow performance (Pearson r=0.20).
(From the provided full-text excerpt, additional per-model numbers and ablations are not visible beyond these headline figures.)
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with focus on: (1) the three practical challenges and their concrete solutions (distillation, Docker reconstruction, execution-grounded test refinement); (2) how the test calibration loop reduces brittle evaluation and bypasses; (3) the benchmarking analysis, especially the r=0.20 correlation claim and the failure-mode taxonomy around exploration inefficiency. 30–45 minutes is enough to understand the pipeline and main findings; deeper implementation details matter if you plan to reuse the data engine.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对 agent eval 的 prior：现有终端 benchmark 相关性太低，先看数据引擎和 r=0.20 那个结果，再决定内部评测要不要重做。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining recipe, but it should change your prior on agent eval: current terminal benchmarks correlate too weakly; read the data engine and the r=0.20 result first.

paper.title: Forecasting Scientific Progress with Artificial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific discovery, yet whether it can anticipate scientific progress remains unclear. To study this question, we introduce a temporally grounded evaluation framework for forecasting scientific progress under controlled knowledge constraints. We present CUSP (Cutoff-conditioned Unseen Scientific Progress), a multi-disciplinary and event-level benchmark that evaluates scientific forecasting in AI systems through feasibility assessment, me

summary.core_problem: 评估AI系统在受时间截断知识条件下，是否能够预测未来科学进展、判断可行性并估计实现时间。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测框架与基准 CUSP，而不是模型方法。它对‘模型是否真的理解科研推进机制’给出更严格的时间约束评估，对通用推理与长期预测能力分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 cutoff-conditioned 的科学进展预测评测：在给定历史知识边界下，让模型完成可行性判断、机制推理、方案生成和时间预测，覆盖 4,760 个跨学科科学事件。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示对前沿模型进行了跨学科评测，发现模型能从候选方向中识别较合理的研究路线，但在判断某项进展是否会真正实现以及何时实现上表现不稳定，且不同学科差异明显；AI 领域的时间预测相对更可预测。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 James Zou、Peter Clark 等，分别在AI for science、评测与知识推理方向有较高知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether AI systems, under temporally bounded knowledge, can forecast future scientific progress, assess feasibility, and estimate when advances will occur.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is the benchmark and evaluation protocol, CUSP, rather than a new model. It offers a stricter way to test whether models understand the dynamics of scientific progress under realistic temporal constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a cutoff-conditioned benchmark for scientific forecasting, where models must perform feasibility assessment, mechanistic reasoning, generative solution design, and temporal prediction over 4,760 cross-disciplinary scientific events.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on frontier models and finds that models can often identify plausible directions among candidates, but fail to reliably predict whether advances will actually materialize and when. Performance varies substantially across domains, with AI progress being more predictable in timing.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes James Zou and Peter Clark, both well known in AI for science, evaluation, and knowledge reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但这个 benchmark 把‘会做题’与‘会预测科研进展’分开了；看任务定义和失败模式即可，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Not directly about pretraining, but it cleanly separates task-solving from forecasting scientific progress; read the task design and failure modes, not the full paper.

paper.title: OmniPro: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Omni-Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Omni-proactive streaming video understanding, i.e., autonomously deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous audio-visual streams, is an emerging capability of omni-modal large language models. Existing benchmarks fall short in three key aspects: they rely primarily on visual signals, adopt polling or fixed-timestamp protocols instead of true proactive evaluation, and cover only a limited range of tasks, preventing reliable assessment and differentiation of omni-proactive streaming mo

summary.core_problem: 解决现有流式视频理解评测无法真实衡量 omni-modal LLM“何时主动说、说什么”的问题，尤其缺少音频依赖、主动触发协议和任务覆盖度。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测资产工作，贡献在于把 omni-proactive streaming video understanding 从“定点问答”改成更接近真实交互的主动响应评测，并显式纳入音频信号。对做原生多模态预训练和流式交互建模的人，有一定诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniPro benchmark，包含 2,700 个经人工核验的样本，覆盖 9 个子任务、3 个认知层级和 6 类基础视频理解能力。数据强调音视频联合理解，其中 84% 样本需要语音或非语音音频。标注中加入 modality-isolation labels，用于分析模型到底依赖了哪种模态。评测上引入 dual-mode evaluation，用来同时考察主动响应时机与响应内容质量，而不是传统 polling 或固定时间戳打点。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键信息是 2,700 样本、9 个子任务、3 个认知层级、84% 音频依赖。论文主实验应是比较现有 omni-modal / streaming 模型在主动触发与内容生成上的差异，并用模态隔离标注做细粒度误差分析。由于摘要未提供具体模型规模、训练数据和数值结果，现阶段更适合作为评测资源了解，而不是据此更新方法论 prior。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a gap in evaluating omni-modal streaming video understanding: current benchmarks do not faithfully measure when a model should proactively speak and what it should say, especially under audio-dependent, continuous-stream settings.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation asset. Its value is in moving from fixed-timestamp or polling-style video QA to proactive response evaluation, while making audio a first-class signal. That gives it some relevance for researchers working on native multimodal pretraining and streaming interaction models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OmniPro, a benchmark with 2,700 human-verified samples spanning 9 sub-tasks, 3 cognitive levels, and 6 basic video-understanding capabilities. A key design choice is strong audio dependence: 84% of samples require speech or non-speech audio. It also adds modality-isolation labels for fine-grained analysis of which modality a model actually uses. The evaluation protocol includes a dual-mode setup to assess both proactive timing and response quality, instead of fixed checkpoints.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the main experimental facts are the benchmark scale and composition: 2,700 samples, 9 sub-tasks, 3 cognitive levels, and 84% audio-required cases. The likely empirical focus is comparing existing omni-modal/streaming models on proactive timing and content generation, plus modality-specific error analysis. Since the abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or concrete performance numbers, this is more useful as an evaluation reference than as evidence for changing modeling priors.

recommendation.zh: 偏评测资产，不会直接改变预训练做法；若你在做原生音视频流式建模，只看任务设计和模态隔离标注即可，先别被排行榜带节奏。
recommendation.en: Mostly an eval asset, not a pretraining prior changer; if you work on native audio-video streaming models, read the task design and modality-isolation labels, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation
paper.abstract: Manufacturable chip layouts must satisfy thousands of geometry-based design rules, and design rule checking (DRC) enforces them by running executable DRC scripts on layouts. Translating natural language rules into correct DRC scripts is labor-intensive and requires specialized expertise, motivating LLM agents for DRC script synthesis and debugging. However, existing benchmarks have small evaluation sets and often evaluate scripts by code similarity rather than execution correctness, and prior ma

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM coding agent 能否把自然语言芯片设计规则转成可执行的 DRC 脚本，并用真实执行结果而不是代码相似度衡量正确性。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是垂直领域的代码智能体评测资产：把 DRC 这种强执行语义、强专业约束的脚本合成任务规模化，提供 1,000 个 rule-to-script 任务和近 1.4 万个评测 layout。对通用 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，但对执行型代码评测有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Rule2DRC benchmark，核心是不给 agent 暴露评测 layout，而通过 DRC 执行结果做 functional correctness scoring。还提出 SplitTester，用测试生成或拆分机制增强执行引导的评测流程，避免只看文本或 AST 相似度。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 1,000 个 DRC 脚本合成任务和 13,921 个 evaluation chip layouts。主要 baseline、模型规模、agent 组合、通过率和相对提升未在给定摘要中完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM coding agents can translate natural-language chip design rules into executable DRC scripts, using execution outcomes rather than code similarity.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a domain-specific coding-agent benchmark with strong execution semantics: 1,000 rule-to-script tasks and nearly 14K evaluation layouts. The direct value for foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the execution-based evaluation setup is useful as a reference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rule2DRC provides an evaluation pipeline where agents do not receive the evaluation layouts, and correctness is measured through DRC execution results. The paper also introduces SplitTester to support execution-guided test generation or splitting for more reliable functional scoring.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,000 DRC synthesis tasks and 13,921 evaluation chip layouts. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model sizes, agent baselines, pass rates, or improvement margins.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 设计即可；EDA 任务太窄，不会改变代码预训练判断，但 execution scoring 细节可备查。
recommendation.en: Skim only the benchmark design; the EDA domain is narrow, but the execution-scoring setup is worth keeping as a coding-eval reference.

paper.title: SaaSBench: Exploring the Boundaries of Coding Agents in Long-Horizon Enterprise SaaS Engineering
paper.abstract: As autonomous coding agents become capable of handling increasingly long-horizon tasks, they have gradually demonstrated the potential to complete end-to-end software development. Although existing benchmarks have recently evolved from localized code editing to from-scratch project generation, they remain confined to structurally simplified, single-stack applications. Consequently, they fail to capture the heterogeneous environments, full-stack orchestration, and system-level complexity of real

summary.core_problem: 构建一个更贴近真实企业级 SaaS 开发的长时程 coding agent 基准，用来测量从 PRD 理解、全栈实现、部署到调试的端到端能力，并解决现有基准在系统复杂度、市场真实度与评测机制上的不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接信息增益有限，但它提供了更“长上下文 + 多语言/多框架 + 强交互”的评测压力源，可能反向影响代码预训练与后训练的数据配比（多语言、配置/脚本、DevOps 文本）、长上下文训练、以及 agentic tool-use 的训练信号设计。更适合作为 post-train/agent 评测资产，而不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: SaaSBench 包含 30 个任务，覆盖 6 类 SaaS 域。每个任务提供长上下文 PRD、用于消歧的知识库、标准化运行环境，以及 DAG 形式的测试套件。评测采用 dependency-aware 的混合范式：用 DAG 表达前置依赖，通过 prerequisite gating 与 failure propagation control 把复杂系统的验证拆成可执行的线性检查链；同时提供 binary/weighted/LLM-as-judge 三种计分，覆盖部署可用性、数据建模、API 契约一致性、业务逻辑正确性、访问控制、工程质量等维度。
summary.experiments: 论文报告当前主流 coding agents 在该基准上仍有明显差距，暴露长时程规划与跨组件协同问题。当前提供的全文片段未包含各模型的具体分数表与对比数字，精确结论需以实验章节的主表为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：优先看任务构建流程、DAG 评测设计与可执行验证节点的定义（理解它如何避免“只看最终是否跑通”的粗粒度信号）。再快速扫实验主表了解难点分布。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住要点。若关注预训练，只需记录它对数据与长上下文能力提出了哪些具体需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Introduce a realistic long-horizon benchmark for enterprise SaaS engineering to evaluate coding agents on end-to-end workflows (PRD understanding, full-stack implementation, deployment, iterative debugging) under heterogeneous stacks and system-level constraints.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining methodology, but it is a strong evaluation pressure test that can feed back into pretrain/post-train decisions: multilingual/code+config+DevOps data mixtures, long-context training, and training signals for tool-using/agentic coding. Best viewed as an eval asset for coding agents rather than a pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: SaaSBench contains 30 tasks across 6 SaaS domains. Each task includes a long-context PRD, an ambiguity-resolution KB, a standardized runtime environment, and a DAG-based test suite. The evaluation is dependency-aware: prerequisite gating and failure-propagation control decompose complex system validation into executable checking chains. Scoring includes binary, weighted, and LLM-as-judge modes, covering deployment availability, data modeling, API contract consistency, business logic, access control, and engineering quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports substantial gaps for current state-of-the-art coding agents on SaaSBench, especially in long-horizon planning and cross-component coordination. The provided excerpt does not include the detailed score tables; exact numbers should be taken from the main experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus: benchmark construction pipeline, DAG evaluation design, and how executable validation nodes are defined to avoid overly coarse end-to-end signals. Then scan the main results table to see where failures concentrate. ~30–45 minutes to capture the essentials. If your focus is pretraining, extract the concrete capability demands implied by the tasks (context length, stack diversity, config/deployment artifacts).

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和验证节点设计即可；它更像 agent eval 压力测试，不直接指导预训练数据配比。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and validation-node design; it is a useful agent-eval stress test, not a direct guide for pretraining data mixture.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited suppo

summary.core_problem: PlanningBench 解决的是规划数据难以规模化生成、难以控制结构难度、难以自动验证的问题。它把规划 benchmark 从固定题集改成可控的数据生成框架，并同时服务评测和训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和 reasoning 数据构造有参考价值。关键启发是：规划能力的训练信号应尽量来自可执行、可验证的约束系统，而不是只依赖自然语言答案或人工偏好。它也提供了一个较清晰的思路：用领域专家抽象任务结构，再用程序化约束生成实例和验证器，形成可扩展的 RL 训练数据。对预训练研究员来说，更有价值的部分是数据生成与验证信号设计，而不是具体规划任务本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是约束驱动的数据合成。PlanningBench 先从真实规划场景出发，由领域专家抽象出任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因子。论文称其覆盖 30 多类规划任务，每类任务包含多个子任务和任务特定约束。生成时，系统先采样结构化的任务-约束配置，再实例化为自包含的规划问题。之后加入受控难度增强和质量过滤。难度不只由题目长度或要求数量决定，而是通过约束紧度、资源稀缺程度、目标冲突、子任务依赖、全局协调要求等因素控制。每个样本都配有自动验证规则，用于检查约束满足情况和目标质量。这一点和静态 benchmark 的差别较大：它不是收集一批题，而是定义一个能持续产出题目、答案检查器和训练奖励的生成系统。训练侧使用通过验证的数据做 GRPO，利用自动验证结果构造规划任务的强化学习反馈。
summary.experiments: 论文从评测和训练两条线验证 PlanningBench。评测侧覆盖开源和闭源前沿 LLM，结论是强模型在该 benchmark 上仍有明显未解空间。论文还分析了不同任务主题、prompt 长度、checklist item 数量对成功率的影响，用于定位模型在复杂约束和长程协调上的失败模式。训练侧用 PlanningBench 的可验证数据做 GRPO，并测试分布外迁移。结果显示，训练后的模型在 TravelPlanner 和 ChinaTravel 等未见规划 benchmark 上有提升，同时在 Multi-Challenge、Inverse IFEval、Collie 等更宽的指令遵循和复杂推理评测上也有收益。提供的正文片段没有包含具体模型规模、训练数据量、绝对分数和提升幅度，因此不宜补充未确认数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，数据构造章节，尤其是任务 taxonomy、约束族、难度因子的定义；第二，自动验证规则如何表达约束满足和目标质量，这决定了它能否成为稳定的 RL 信号；第三，GRPO 训练和分布外评测结果，观察规划数据是否只提升同类任务，还是能迁移到更一般的 instruction-following 和 reasoning。若时间有限，可跳过大部分具体任务案例，保留对生成管线和验证机制的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: PlanningBench addresses a data problem in LLM planning: existing benchmarks are mostly fixed collections of instances, with limited controllability over structural difficulty, coverage, scalability, and automatic verification. The paper reframes planning evaluation as controllable generation of verifiable planning instances.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to post-training and reasoning data design. Its main value is the construction of executable and automatically verifiable planning signals. For researchers working on foundation-model training, the useful part is not the specific travel or workflow-style tasks, but the recipe for turning structured constraints into scalable evaluation data and RL rewards. This is a cleaner signal than free-form natural-language supervision or preference-only feedback when the target capability is constraint satisfaction and long-horizon coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework starts from real planning scenarios and abstracts them into a taxonomy of task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. The paper states that the taxonomy covers more than 30 planning tasks, each with multiple subtasks and task-specific constraints. The generation pipeline samples structured task-constraint configurations, instantiates them as self-contained planning problems, applies controlled difficulty enhancement, and filters outputs after generation. Difficulty is controlled through structural factors such as constraint tightness, resource scarcity, objective conflicts, subtask dependencies, and global coordination requirements, rather than only through superficial proxies such as prompt length. Each instance is paired with automatic verification rules that check constraint satisfaction and objective quality. For training, the authors use verified PlanningBench data with GRPO, using the verifier as a source of planning-oriented feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates both open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs and reports that even the strongest tested models have limited solve rates on PlanningBench, suggesting that the benchmark is not saturated. The analysis covers task topics, prompt length, and the number of checklist items, which helps diagnose how scenario structure and constraint complexity affect planning success. On the training side, GRPO with verified PlanningBench data improves transfer to unseen planning benchmarks such as TravelPlanner and ChinaTravel. The trained models also show gains on broader instruction-following and complex reasoning benchmarks, including Multi-Challenge, Inverse IFEval, and Collie. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete model sizes, data scale, absolute scores, or improvement numbers, so those details should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the data construction pipeline, especially the task taxonomy, constraint families, and difficulty factors. Then read the verifier design, since the verifier is what turns the benchmark into a potential RL training source. Finally, inspect the GRPO and out-of-distribution evaluation sections to see whether the generated planning data transfers beyond its own templates. Most individual task examples can be read selectively unless one is building a similar generator.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心可验证合成数据怎么服务推理训练，这篇可看；重点读 taxonomy、difficulty factor 和 verifier 设计，榜单本身价值不大。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about how verifiable synthetic data can support reasoning training; focus on the taxonomy, difficulty factors, and verifier design, not the leaderboard.
