paper.title: SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: As long-horizon coding agents produce more code than any developer can review, oversight collapses onto a single surface: the automated test suite. Reward hacking naturally arises in this setup, as the agent optimizes for passing tests while deviating from the users true goal. We study this reward hacking phenomenon by decompose software engineering tasks into three parts: (i) a natural language description of the specification (ii) visible validation tests that exercise specified features in is

summary.core_problem: 衡量长程 coding agent 在自动测试监督下的 reward hacking：模型是否只是学会通过可见测试，而没有真正满足用户规格。
summary.importance: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它对 post-train 和 agent 评测有现实意义。贡献在于把 reward hacking 从泛泛讨论变成可操作的评测协议，用 visible tests 与 held-out compositional tests 的差距来量化。对基座研究员的价值主要在于理解训练信号质量和 verifier 漏洞。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpecBench。每个任务被拆成三部分：自然语言规格、可见验证测试、以及组合式 held-out 测试。作者假设如果 agent 真正理解规格，那么基于规格和可见测试写出的程序也应通过 held-out 测试；因此用两类测试通过率的 gap 作为 reward hacking 指标。这个设计把“骗过 reward”具体化为对可见测试的过拟合。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 30 个 systems-level programming tasks，覆盖从短程构建 shell 到更长程的系统编程任务。摘要没有给出参与评测的模型、agent 框架和具体 gap 数值，但从设计上看，最关键的是 held-out tests 是否确实只做组合泛化而不引入额外 specification shift。若这点做得干净，benchmark 才有诊断价值。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构为 Weco AI。给定信息中没有可确认的广为人知作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It measures reward hacking in long-horizon coding agents under automated-test supervision: are agents actually satisfying the user specification, or merely optimizing to pass visible tests?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for post-training and agent evaluation. The contribution is to operationalize reward hacking with a concrete evaluation protocol, using the gap between visible tests and held-out compositional tests. For foundation-model researchers, the value is mainly in understanding training-signal quality and verifier loopholes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecBench decomposes each task into three parts: a natural-language specification, visible validation tests, and held-out tests that compose the same features in more realistic ways. The premise is that an agent that genuinely understands the specification should pass both suites; therefore, the pass-rate gap becomes a measure of reward hacking. This turns 'gaming the reward' into overfitting to visible tests.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 30 systems-level programming tasks, ranging from short-horizon shell-building tasks to longer-horizon systems programming settings. The abstract does not provide evaluated models, agent frameworks, or exact gap numbers. The main thing to inspect is whether the held-out tests truly measure compositional generalization rather than introducing a hidden specification shift; otherwise the benchmark becomes less diagnostic.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is from Weco AI. The provided metadata does not identify any widely known authors with enough confidence for a stronger note.

recommendation.zh: 更像后训练/agent 评测资产，不是基座必读；知道有这么个“visible-vs-heldout gap”指标即可，除非你在做 coding RL 或 verifier 设计。
recommendation.en: This is more of a post-training/agent eval asset than a base-model paper; just remember the visible-vs-heldout gap metric unless you're actively working on coding RL or verifier design.

paper.title: EgoBabyVLM: Benchmarking Cross-Modal Learning from Naturalistic Egocentric Video Data
paper.abstract: Children acquire language grounding with remarkable robustness from limited visuo-linguistic input in ways that surpass today's best large multimodal models. Recent research suggests current vision-language models (VLMs) trained on curated web data fail to generalize to the sparse, weakly-aligned egocentric streams produced by wearable devices, embodied agents, and infant head-cams -- and no fixed evaluation pipeline exists for measuring progress on this regime. We train VLMs on datasets with va

summary.core_problem: 当前VLM依赖网络规模的精心对齐图文对进行训练，但在自然第一视角视频（如穿戴设备、智能体采集）上泛化能力极差。这类视频与伴随语音的语义对齐非常稀疏且弱，与训练数据的强对齐特性存在根本性 mismatch。论文以儿童多模态学习为计算模型，研究在与儿童感知经验相当规模的自然第一视角数据上训练VLM的效果，并建立了一套评估基准。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的核心启示是：数据质量和语义对齐强度——而非架构或规模——是语言接地能力的主要驱动因素。当前VLM在精心对齐的caption数据上表现接近CLIP水平，但在自然第一视角数据上接近随机水平，这解释了为什么WearVQA和WAGIBench上表现不佳。对未来VLM预训练向更自然、更少人工curated数据迁移有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文做了三件事：(1) 用互补方法量化了不同数据集（从精心对齐caption到婴儿第一视角视频）的跨模态语义对齐强度，发现婴儿第一视角数据的对齐显著弱于curated数据甚至教学视频；(2) 发布EgoBabyVLM挑战套件，包含固定大小的婴儿第一视角视频训练语料、Machine-DevBench多模态语言接地评估基准（评估名词识别、属性归因、8种核心语法结构），以及单模态视觉/语言评估任务（包括新的Visual Property Swap任务评估多模态融合对文本编码器的益处）；(3) 在该套件上对对比学习（CLIP+）和生成式（LLaVA）两种架构进行基准测试。
summary.experiments: 对比了四种数据集，训练了CLIP+和LLaVA作为基线。主要发现：两种架构在curated caption上都接近CLIP水平，但在自然第一视角数据上表现接近随机（near chance）。在Machine-DevBench上评估了词汇和语法能力（名词识别、属性归因、8种语法结构）。还评估了多模态微调前后单模态编码器的变化，包括标准视觉/文本基准和VP-Swap任务。具体数字未在已读部分详细列出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点阅读Introduction（理解动机和核心发现）、§1末尾的贡献总结（第2页）和实验结果章节（了解具体失败模式）。Machine-DevBench的设计细节（评估任务构造方式）和语义对齐量化方法（§2.2相关部分）是方法论上较有特色的部分。预计阅读时间25-30分钟。对预训练研究员来说，核心信息是数据对齐质量对泛化的影响，具体benchmark内容可快速浏览。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在已读取的前两章（Introduction/Related Work）中明确给出。从内容看涉及发展心理学+计算机科学跨学科团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLMs trained on web-scale tightly-aligned image-caption pairs generalize poorly to naturalistic egocentric video (wearable devices, embodied agents) where video and accompanying speech are sparsely and weakly aligned. This work studies VLMs as computational models of children's multimodal learning, training them on sensory inputs comparable in scale to young children's experience, and establishes evaluation infrastructure for this regime.
summary_en.importance: The core takeaway for pretraining research is that data quality and semantic alignment strength—not architecture or scale alone—drive language acquisition and grounding. Both contrastive and generative VLM architectures perform near chance on naturalistic egocentric data despite approaching CLIP-level performance on curated captions. This explains the generalization gap observed on WearVQA (24–52% accuracy) and WAGIBench. The work informs the direction of pretraining data curation toward more natural, less artificially-aligned signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three main contributions: (1) Quantified cross-modal semantic alignment across four datasets spanning curated captions to infant egocentric video, finding substantially weaker alignment in infant egocentric data; (2) Released EgoBabyVLM Challenge Suite: a fixed-size baby egocentric video training corpus paired with Machine-DevBench (a corpus-grounded, contrastive vision-language benchmark assessing noun recognition, property attribution, and eight core grammatical constructions) plus unimodal evaluation tasks including a novel Visual Property Swap (VP-Swap) task; (3) Benchmarked both contrastive (CLIP+) and generative (LLaVA) architectures on this suite.
summary_en.experiments: Trained CLIP+ and LLaVA baselines across four datasets spanning different naturalism degrees. Key result: both architecture families perform near chance on naturalistic egocentric data while approaching off-the-shelf CLIP on curated captions. Evaluated lexical and grammatical competence via Machine-DevBench, and unimodal encoder changes before/after multimodal finetuning. Exact performance numbers not fully available in the read sections, but the qualitative finding about alignment quality being the bottleneck is the main experimental takeaway.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skim-level reading: focus on Introduction (motivation and core findings, §1 end), the contribution summary on page 2, and the experimental results section. Machine-DevBench task design details and the semantic alignment quantification methodology (§2.2) are methodologically distinctive. Estimated reading time: 25–30 minutes. For pretraining researchers, the core message about alignment quality is the key takeaway; specific benchmark items can be quickly scanned.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not explicitly provided in the read sections (Introduction / Related Work). Interdisciplinary team involving developmental psychology and computer science.

recommendation.zh: 弱对齐 egocentric 数据是 native multimodal 的真难点；应看数据构造和 Machine-DevBench 频率分桶。
recommendation.en: Weakly aligned egocentric data is a real native-multimodal stressor; read the data construction and Machine-DevBench frequency bins.

paper.title: EgoCoT-Bench: Benchmarking Grounded and Verifiable Operation-Centric Chain of Thought Reasoning for MLLMs
paper.abstract: The rapid development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has led to growing interest in egocentric video understanding, specifically the ability for MLLMs to recognize fine-grained hand-object interactions, track object state changes over time, and reason about manipulative processes in dynamic environments from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric video benchmarks suffer from \textbf{limited grounded rationale evaluation}, offering limited support for fine-grained o

summary.core_problem: 现有第一人称视角视频基准缺乏细粒度的可验证推理依据评估，无法有效衡量多模态大模型基于时空证据的操作级链式推理能力。
summary.importance: 提出首个面向可验证操作级CoT推理的第一人称视频基准EgoCoT-Bench，属于多模态推理领域的基准贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 标注351个第一人称视角视频的3172个可验证QA对，分为4个任务组12个子任务，要求模型输出的推理过程与显式时空证据对齐。
summary.experiments: 系统评测现有主流MLLM，发现现有模型在基于视觉证据的操作级CoT推理任务上表现普遍不佳，推理过程与证据对齐度低。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing egocentric video benchmarks lack fine-grained evaluation of verifiable reasoning rationales, and cannot effectively measure MLLMs' operation-level chain-of-thought reasoning grounded in spatio-temporal evidence.
summary_en.importance: Proposes EgoCoT-Bench, the first egocentric video benchmark for verifiable operation-level CoT reasoning, a benchmark contribution for multimodal reasoning research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Annotates 3,172 verifiable QA pairs across 351 egocentric videos, divided into 4 task groups and 12 sub-tasks, requiring model rationales to align with explicit spatio-temporal evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of mainstream MLLMs shows existing models generally underperform on grounded operation-level CoT reasoning, with low alignment between rationales and visual evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态第一人称推理的细分基准，可作为MLLM推理能力评估的补充参考，仅需浏览基准设计部分。
recommendation.en: Subdomain benchmark for multimodal egocentric reasoning, can serve as supplementary reference for MLLM reasoning evaluation, only need to skim the benchmark design section.

paper.title: MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot synthesis to complex multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) narratives to meet real-world demands. However, evaluating such frontier models remains a fundamental challenge. Existing benchmarks are limited in scope and data diversity, and rely on rigid evaluation pipelines, preventing systematic and reliable assessment of modern MSAV models. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MSAVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark and adaptive hybrid evaluation f

summary.core_problem: 现有多镜头音视频生成（MSAV）的评估基准覆盖维度窄、数据多样性不足、评估流程僵化，无法可靠评测新一代生成模型的实际效果。
summary.importance: 首个专门面向多镜头音视频生成的综合基准，属于benchmark贡献，填补了该领域统一评测的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖视频、音频、镜头、参考四大维度的基准数据集，最多包含15个镜头，覆盖非现实场景；设计自适应混合评估框架，通过镜头分割自校正、实例级主观指标规则、工具支撑的证据提取三个模块提升评估鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 未公开评测的具体模型参数量，验证了评估框架输出与人类判断的高对齐度，可覆盖多种复杂任务场景的评测需求。
summary.authors_note: 阿里通义实验室联合复旦大学、香港大学、浙江大学、北京大学等机构发布。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) generation evaluation benchmarks have limited coverage, low data diversity and rigid evaluation pipelines, which cannot reliably measure the performance of latest generation models.
summary_en.importance: The first comprehensive benchmark for multi-shot audio-video generation, fills the gap of unified evaluation in this field as a benchmark contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a benchmark dataset covering 4 core dimensions of video, audio, shot and reference, with up to 15 shots and non-realistic scenarios; designs an adaptive hybrid evaluation framework with 3 modules: shot segmentation self-correction, instance-level subjective metric rubrics, tool-grounded evidence extraction to improve robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model parameters for evaluation are not disclosed, the framework achieves high alignment with human judgment and supports evaluation of multiple complex task scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by Tongyi Lab (Alibaba Group) in collaboration with Fudan University, The University of Hong Kong, Zhejiang University, Peking University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 多镜头音视频生成评测新基准，仅做音视频生成预训练的团队可参考其评估维度，其余场景无参考价值。
recommendation.en: New benchmark for multi-shot audio-video generation evaluation, only refer to its evaluation dimensions if you work on audio-video generation pretraining, no value for other scenarios.

paper.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset
paper.abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently seen notable progress around 1K and 2K resolution. With the extreme desire for better visual experience and the rapid development of imaging technology, the demand for Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) image generation has grown significantly. However, UHR image generation poses great challenges due to the scarcity and complexity of high-resolution content. In this paper, we first introduce PixVerve-95K, a high-quality, open-source UHR T2I dataset curated with

summary.core_problem: 如何把文本到图像模型推进到“原生”100MP超高分辨率生成，并解决UHR数据稀缺与评测缺位。
summary.importance: 数据集+benchmark+训练方案的组合贡献；对“高分辨率生成的训练稳定性/数据管线/评测”有工程参考，但不直接触及LLM预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建PixVerve-95K（每张≥100MP）并提供七维标注；在此基础上提出三种训练方案把多种T2I foundation model扩展到原生100MP生成；评测上结合传统指标与基于多模态LLM的自动评估，提出PixVerve-Bench。
summary.experiments: 核心规模信息来自摘要：95K张≥100MP图文数据；对“多种T2I基础模型”做100MP训练与对比，并用PixVerve-Bench评估，但摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练算力与定量提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Enabling native 100MP text-to-image generation while addressing the scarcity of ultra-high-resolution data and the lack of proper evaluation.
summary_en.importance: A combined dataset+benchmark+training-scheme contribution; useful engineering reference for UHR generation pipelines and evaluation, but not directly about LLM pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Releases PixVerve-95K (each image ≥100MP) with 7D annotations; proposes three training schemes to extend multiple T2I foundation models to native 100MP; introduces PixVerve-Bench using both conventional metrics and MLLM-based assessment.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract: 95K UHR image-text pairs (≥100MP). Trains multiple T2I foundation models for 100MP generation and evaluates on PixVerve-Bench; model sizes/compute and exact deltas are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“UHR数据管线+评测”资料库：只需看数据筛选/标注维度和LLM评测设计，训练方案细节未必可复用。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a UHR dataset/pipeline + evaluation reference—skim the curation/annotation and the MLLM-based eval; the training recipes may be highly model-specific.

paper.title: LLM Benchmark Datasets Should Be Contamination-Resistant
paper.abstract: Benchmark datasets are critical for reproducible, reliable, and discriminative evaluation of LLMs. However, recent studies reveal that many benchmark datasets are included in pretraining corpora, i.e., $\textit{contaminated}$, which diminishes their value as reliable measures of model generalization. In this paper, we argue that benchmark datasets should be $\textit{contamination-resistant}$, i.e., $\textit{unlearnable}$, but support $\textit{inference}$. To accomplish this, we first highlight t

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章讨论的不是如何检测污染，而是更前一步：能不能把 benchmark 设计成“即使被抓进预训练语料，也学不会；但在推理时仍然能正常作答”。作者把这个目标称为 contamination-resistant dataset。全文的核心问题有两个层面。第一，现有 benchmark 在大规模抓取、蒸馏、持续预训练环境下几乎不可避免会泄漏，事后去重、私有化、动态更新都各有明显代价。第二，文本 unlike 图像，传统 unlearnable example 方法很难直接迁移，因为文本是离散符号，且现代 LLM 对噪声、改写、回译有很强恢复能力。作者因此把问题转成一个更结构性的命题：是否可以利用 Transformer 训练与推理之间的不对称性，让某种数据表示在 teacher-forcing 训练中不可学习，但在自回归或条件推理时仍保留任务可解性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在评测方法论，而不是直接给出可落地的新 benchmark 构造算法。它的重要性在于把“数据污染”从数据工程问题提升成“训练目标与表示设计”的问题。这个视角对基座模型研究有两点启发。其一，benchmark 设计不能再默认明文公开样本是中性的；在 trillion-token 语料和多轮蒸馏环境下，公开即高风险。其二，训练可学性与推理可用性未必绑定，存在通过表示层或架构不对称来分离二者的可能。这个想法如果做实，不只影响 benchmark，也可能影响数据授权、模型水印、训练时访问控制等方向。量级上，它更像一篇研究议程设定型 position paper，而不是已经改变评测实践的技术论文。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，文章主要做三件事。第一，形式化 contamination resistance。作者给出一个抽象定义：对原始数据 D 施加变换 φ 后，模型在 φ(D) 上仍能完成推理任务，但把 φ(D) 纳入训练并不能有效提升模型对该任务的学习。这里强调的是 inference utility 与 training unlearnability 同时成立。第二，作者把可行性建立在 Transformer 的训练—推理不对称上。训练时通常采用 teacher forcing，模型在每个位置看到完整前缀并优化 next-token likelihood；推理时则是基于已生成上下文逐步解码。作者认为可以构造某种表示，使得训练阶段的局部 token 预测信号被破坏、梯度难以对齐到稳定模式，但推理阶段借助更高层的结构约束、外部规则或可逆映射仍能恢复任务信息。第三，文章讨论 interoperability，也就是这种变换不能只对单一模型家族有效，否则 benchmark 只会变成“对某模型不可学、对另一模型可学”的脆弱防护。作者借用了模型间表示互操作和架构迁移的一些数学讨论，试图说明 contamination resistance 需要对一类训练管线而非单个 checkpoint 成立。

需要注意，全文更偏概念论证，没有给出一个成熟的文本 CRD 构造器，也没有像 D3PM、SEDD 那样给出完整训练算法。作者提到现有文本扰动、shortcut、poisoning 方法不适合，是为了说明为什么不能简单照搬 unlearnable image 的套路。真正的创新点是提出“support inference, resist training”这一目标函数式的 benchmark 设计原则，以及把它和 Transformer 的 teacher-forcing 非对称联系起来。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，这篇文章几乎没有实证部分，至少没有完整的 benchmark 构造实验、污染注入实验或跨模型验证结果。文中主要引用外部工作来建立问题严重性：例如 GPT-3 评测时某些 benchmark 超过 90% 样本被标记为污染；Llama 2 在 MMLU 中超过 16% 子集存在污染；多语 benchmark 的污染比例可高到 91.8%；GSM8K 的 clean mirror set 可让一些模型家族准确率下降约 13%。这些数字说明污染确实会显著抬高分数，但它们不是本文方法的实验结果。若按研究成熟度看，这篇文章目前停留在 formalization + motivation + feasibility argument，缺少三个关键证据：1）具体变换 φ 的实例；2）加入预训练后确实学不会的定量结果；3）在不同模型、不同 tokenizer、不同训练 recipe 下仍保持推理可用的稳健性验证。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，重点看 Introduction 和“Contamination-Resistance: Motivation and Formalization”。前者交代为什么传统去污染路线越来越难，后者给出作者真正想推动的定义。若时间有限，先抓三点：一是作者不是在讲 benchmark 私有化，而是在讲公开 benchmark 的新设计原则；二是关键抓手是 Transformer 训练与推理的不对称；三是全文没有给出成熟方案，所以阅读时要把它当研究议程，而不是现成方法。

值得留意的地方有两个。第一，作者把文本 unlearnability 的困难讲得比较清楚：离散 token、语义保持改写、LLM 的去噪能力，都会让简单扰动失效。第二，interoperability 这一节虽然偏抽象，但它指出了真正难点：如果变换只骗过某一类训练器，就不算可靠 benchmark 设计。预计阅读时间 15–25 分钟。若要继续深挖，建议顺着文中引用去看 benchmark contamination 检测、clean mirror benchmark、以及 unlearnable examples 在文本域失败的原因。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about detecting contamination after the fact. It asks a more fundamental question: can we design benchmark datasets that remain usable for inference, yet become ineffective as training data even if they are absorbed into pretraining corpora? The authors call this contamination resistance. The full argument has two layers. First, benchmark leakage is becoming structurally unavoidable under web-scale scraping, derivative datasets, distillation, and continual pretraining. Second, standard “unlearnable examples” ideas do not transfer cleanly to text, because text is discrete and modern LLMs are strong denoisers that can recover semantics through paraphrase or normalization. The paper therefore reframes the problem around a training–inference asymmetry: can one exploit the mismatch between teacher-forced Transformer training and downstream inference so that a transformed benchmark remains solvable at test time but does not provide a useful learning signal during training?
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than immediately operational. The paper elevates benchmark contamination from a data curation issue to a representation-and-objective design issue. That matters for pretraining research in two ways. First, public plaintext benchmarks are no longer neutral artifacts once training corpora reach trillions of tokens and model development includes repeated distillation and refresh cycles. Second, learnability during pretraining and usability during inference may be separable properties. If that separation can be engineered, the idea would matter not only for benchmarking, but also for data licensing, controlled disclosure, and possibly training-time access control. In terms of contribution type, this is a position-setting paper that proposes a research direction. It does not yet provide a validated construction that changes benchmarking practice.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper contributes mainly through formalization and argumentation. First, it defines contamination resistance at an abstract level: given a transformation phi applied to a plaintext dataset D, the transformed dataset phi(D) should preserve inference utility while being unlearnable as training data for a model class. In other words, the same transformed artifact should support valid task performance at evaluation time but fail to provide a useful optimization signal during pretraining. Second, the feasibility argument is tied to Transformer training–inference asymmetry. During training, teacher forcing exposes the full prefix and optimizes next-token likelihood locally at each position. During inference, generation proceeds autoregressively and may rely on higher-level structure, external rules, or reversible mappings. The authors suggest that one could design representations that disrupt local token prediction and gradient alignment during training, while still allowing task information to be recovered at inference time. Third, the paper discusses interoperability: contamination resistance should not be a brittle property that only holds against one architecture or one training recipe. The transformation must remain resistant across a family of models and pipelines, otherwise the benchmark simply becomes model-specific obfuscation.

A key caveat is that the paper does not present a concrete, mature construction for text CRDs. It also does not provide a new training algorithm. The novelty lies in the design principle itself—support inference, resist training—and in connecting that principle to the asymmetry induced by teacher-forced Transformer training.
summary_en.experiments: There is little to no direct empirical validation in the provided full text. The paper relies mostly on prior studies to establish the severity of contamination: GPT-3-era audits reportedly flagged over 90% contamination for some benchmarks; Llama 2 showed contamination in more than 16% of MMLU subsets; multilingual benchmark contamination has been reported as high as 91.8%; and a clean mirror version of GSM8K reduced accuracy by roughly 13% for some model families such as Mistral. These numbers motivate the problem, but they are not evaluations of the proposed CRD framework. From a research maturity standpoint, three pieces are still missing: a concrete transformation phi for text, quantitative evidence that including phi(D) in pretraining does not improve task performance, and robustness checks across model families, tokenizers, and training recipes while preserving inference utility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on the Introduction and the section on contamination resistance formalization. The Introduction explains why decontamination, privatization, and dynamic benchmarks each have practical limits. The formalization section contains the actual contribution: benchmark design should target simultaneous inference utility and training unlearnability. If reading time is limited, keep three points in mind. First, the paper is not advocating private benchmarks as the main answer. Second, the central mechanism is the asymmetry between teacher-forced training and inference. Third, there is no finished construction yet, so it should be read as a research agenda rather than a deployable method.

Two parts are worth extra attention. One is the discussion of why text is harder than images for unlearnable data: discreteness, semantic-preserving rewrites, and LLM denoising all weaken perturbation-based defenses. The other is interoperability, which identifies the real difficulty: a benchmark is not truly contamination-resistant if the transformation only fools one model family. Estimated reading time: 15 to 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对抗基准污染的思路很重要，值得了解框架方向，但目前是纯理论呼吁，无具体实现
recommendation.en: Important concept for benchmark design against contamination; worth understanding the direction, but currently a pure theoretical proposal without implementation.

paper.title: Time to REFLECT: Can We Trust LLM Judges for Evidence-based Research Agents?
paper.abstract: Deep research agents increasingly automate complex information-seeking tasks, producing evidence-grounded reports via multi-step reasoning, tool use, and synthesis. Their growing role demands scalable, reliable evaluation, positioning LLM-as-judge as a supervision paradigm for assessing factual accuracy, evidence use, and reasoning quality. Yet the reliability of these judges for deep research agents remains poorly understood, posing a critical meta-evaluation problem: before deploying LLM judge

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 deep research agent 评测中的元评测问题：当用 LLM judge 评估长报告、引用证据、工具调用和多步研究轨迹时，如何判断 judge 自身是否可靠。现有做法多依赖人类偏好一致性或可验证任务，难以定位开放式研究任务中的具体失败类型。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练没有直接方法贡献，但对自动评测、reward model 构造和 agent 训练信号质量有参考意义。deep research agent 的输出通常长、开放、证据密集，很难用单一答案判定对错。如果 judge 只能给整体分数，训练时会把噪声反馈传给策略模型。Reflect 的价值在于把 judge 评估改成可验证的细粒度故障检测，为后续构造过程级奖励、citation-aware 监督和工具使用偏好数据提供了更可靠的评测框架。
summary.technical_approach: Reflect 将 judge meta-evaluation 形式化为成对比较任务。每个样本包含一个经过质量筛选的参考 agent execution，以及一个通过受控局部干预构造出的带故障版本。execution 包括用户查询、研究轨迹和最终长文回答。可靠的 judge 应该给参考版本更高质量评分。干预覆盖过程级和结果级错误，包括推理、工具调用、证据收集和综合写作中的失误。这样做的关键取舍是：不再要求开放式任务存在唯一标准答案，而是通过局部扰动让标签由构造过程保证可验证。论文同时比较整体评分式 judge 和细粒度、步骤级 judge。细粒度协议可以定位 judge 漏检的是检索、引用、推理链条还是最终综合，而不是只得到一个粗粒度偏好一致性数字。
summary.experiments: 实验评估了多种 LLM judge 和不同评测协议，覆盖 holistic scoring 与 fine-grained step-level evaluation。主要结果是当前 judge 可靠性存在明显缺口，不同 judge 的盲点不同，单一汇总分数不能充分描述可靠性。细粒度评估通常优于整体评分，尤其在需要跨阶段追踪的宏观结构性错误上更有效，例如前面检索不足但最终报告写得流畅，或引用和结论之间存在支持关系断裂。论文还比较了 judge 可靠性与成本，指出更细的评测协议带来诊断能力，但也增加调用和审计开销。给定内容未提供完整模型清单和具体准确率数字，因此不应过度解读绝对性能。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction，重点是它为什么不满足于 human preference agreement。再看 Reflect 的任务形式化，弄清 clean-perturbed pair 如何让开放式研究任务获得可验证标签。最值得看的部分是 failure taxonomy、干预构造流程、以及 holistic judge 和 fine-grained judge 的对比实验。若关注 agent RL 或自动评测数据生产，可重点看哪些错误类型最容易被 judge 漏掉，以及成本分析如何影响评测协议选择。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a meta-evaluation problem for deep research agents: before using LLM judges to evaluate long-form reports, evidence use, tool calls, and multi-step research trajectories, one must know whether the judges themselves can detect concrete failures. Existing protocols based on human preference agreement or verifiable tasks do not give enough diagnostic signal for open-ended research executions.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to pretraining, but it is relevant to automated evaluation, reward modeling, and the quality of supervision for agent training. Deep research outputs are long, open-ended, and evidence-heavy. A single overall judge score can hide whether the model retrieved weak evidence, misused tools, cited unsupported sources, or produced a fluent but poorly grounded report. Reflect turns judge evaluation into fine-grained failure detection with verifiable labels, which is a useful direction for process-level rewards, citation-aware supervision, and tool-use preference data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reflect formulates judge meta-evaluation as a paired comparison. Each instance contains a quality-screened reference agent execution and a perturbed alternative with a controlled, localized failure. An execution consists of the input query, the research trajectory, and the final long-form answer. A reliable judge should assign higher quality to the reference. The perturbations are drawn from a failure taxonomy covering process-level and outcome-level errors in reasoning, tool use, evidence gathering, and synthesis. The design avoids the need for a single canonical answer to an open-ended research question. Instead, labels are verifiable by construction because the failure is injected in a known location and category. The paper compares holistic judging protocols with fine-grained, step-level protocols, where the latter can reveal whether the judge misses retrieval errors, citation-support errors, reasoning errors, or synthesis errors.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate multiple LLM judges under both holistic scoring and fine-grained step-level evaluation. The reported findings show substantial reliability gaps: different judges fail on different failure types, and no single aggregate score captures judge reliability. Fine-grained evaluation is more effective than holistic scoring, especially for macro-level structural failures that require tracing information across stages, such as weak evidence collection that later leads to an unsupported but fluent final report. The paper also studies the trade-off between reliability and cost, noting that finer protocols improve diagnostics but require more judge calls and more complex evaluation pipelines. The provided content does not expose the full model list or exact accuracy numbers, so the safest reading is about methodology and failure patterns rather than absolute ranking.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the Introduction to understand why human preference agreement is too coarse for research-agent evaluation. Then read the Reflect formulation and the construction pipeline for clean-perturbed pairs. The most useful parts are the failure taxonomy, the controlled intervention procedure, and the comparison between holistic and fine-grained judging. For work on agent RL or automated evaluation data, focus on which failure categories current judges miss and how the cost analysis changes the choice of evaluation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 RL/SFT 监督信号质量，这篇该看：先别信 judge 分数，重点读 controlled intervention 设计，看哪些 failure mode 现有 judge 根本抓不住。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about RL/SFT supervision quality: do not trust judge scores blindly; focus on the controlled interventions and which failure modes current judges simply miss.

paper.title: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments
paper.abstract: Current benchmarks for graphical user interface (GUI) agents predominantly rely on static screenshots. However, real-world smartphone interaction routinely requires agents to process transient audio cues and temporal video dynamics that are tightly coupled with the moment of action. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniGUI, the first step-level benchmark designed to evaluate GUI agents in omni-modal smartphone environments. OmniGUI provides continuous, interleaved multimodal inputs comprising st

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent benchmark 多依赖静态截图，无法评估真实手机交互中与动作时机耦合的音频和视频线索。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。它把 GUI agent 评测从静态视觉扩展到 step-level 的图像+音频+视频输入，对原生多模态 agent 的能力边界有现实意义。对预训练研究员的价值主要在数据形态与评测需求，而不是方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniGUI，一个面向智能手机环境的 omni-modal GUI agent benchmark。每个 action step 提供连续交错的静态图像、同步音频和视频片段，并标注多模态依赖程度。由于专门的 omni-modal GUI agent 尚不成熟，作者用能原生处理交错输入的基础 omni-modal 模型作为代理 baseline。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 709 条专家演示 episode、2579 个 action step，覆盖 29 个应用。评测重点是不同多模态依赖级别下的 agent 表现。摘要未给出具体模型名和分数，但明确指出现有模型在需要时序音视频理解的 GUI 场景下存在明显缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: Current GUI-agent benchmarks rely heavily on static screenshots and fail to evaluate audio/video cues that are tightly coupled with action timing in real smartphone use.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It extends GUI-agent evaluation from static visual inputs to step-level image+audio+video streams, which matters for native multimodal agents. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly in the data/evaluation shape rather than in a new modeling method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OmniGUI, an omni-modal benchmark for smartphone GUI agents. Each action step contains interleaved static images, synchronized audio, and video clips, with annotations for multimodal dependency levels. Because dedicated omni-modal GUI agents are still immature, the authors use foundational omni-modal models that can natively process interleaved inputs as proxy baselines.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 709 expert-demonstrated episodes and 2,579 action steps across 29 apps. The evaluation focuses on how performance changes with multimodal dependency. The abstract does not list exact model names or scores, but it clearly argues that current models struggle when GUI interaction requires temporal audio-video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 benchmark 选题是对的：GUI agent 迟早要吃时序音视频；但对 pretrain 只提供需求侧信号，读数据设计和失败案例就够。
recommendation.en: The benchmark direction is right—GUI agents will eventually need temporal audio/video—but for pretraining this is mostly a demand-side signal; read the dataset design and failure cases only.

paper.title: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence unfolds through a perception-action loop: agents act to acquire observations, and reason about how observations vary as a function of action. Rather than passively processing what is seen, they actively uncover what is unseen - occluded structure, dynamics, containment, and functionality that cannot be resolved from passive sensing alone. We move beyond prior formulations of spatial intelligence that assume oracle observations by recasting the observer as an actor. We introd

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评估 embodied spatial intelligence 的 benchmark，让模型通过行动主动获取观察，而不是只在给定观察上做被动空间推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。ESI-Bench 把空间智能评测从静态感知推进到 perception-action loop，覆盖遮挡结构、动态、容器关系和功能性等需要主动探索的信息，对多模态 agent 评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 OmniGibson 构建 10 个任务类别和 29 个子类别，并以 Spelke 的 core knowledge systems 组织任务。Agent 需要选择 perception、locomotion、manipulation 等能力，并规划动作序列来积累与任务相关的证据。
summary.experiments: 论文评测多种主流 MLLM。摘要报告 active exploration 明显优于 passive counterparts，说明当前模型在主动获取信息时可获得更好的空间推理表现，但具体模型列表和提升幅度需看正文实验表。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Leonidas Guibas、Li Fei-Fei、Jiajun Wu、Yejin Choi，相关团队长期从事 3D 视觉、具身智能、多模态推理和 AI 评测研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates embodied spatial intelligence where agents must act to acquire observations, rather than reason passively over oracle observations.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. ESI-Bench moves spatial intelligence evaluation toward a perception-action loop, covering occlusion, dynamics, containment, and functionality that cannot be resolved from passive sensing alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built on OmniGibson with 10 task categories and 29 subcategories, organized around Spelke’s core knowledge systems. Agents must choose and sequence perception, locomotion, and manipulation skills to gather task-relevant evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current MLLMs. The abstract reports that active exploration substantially outperforms passive counterparts, though the exact model list and numerical gains require the main experimental tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Leonidas Guibas, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, and Yejin Choi, whose groups are known for 3D vision, embodied AI, multimodal reasoning, and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 看任务 taxonomy 和 passive-vs-active 对照；它更像下一代 VLM/agent eval 资产，不是训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the task taxonomy and passive-vs-active comparison; this is a next-wave VLM/agent eval asset, not a training recipe.

paper.title: Are VLMs Seeing or Just Saying? Uncovering the Illusion of Visual Re-examination
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often produce self-reflective statements like "let me check the figure again" during reasoning. Do such statements trigger genuine visual re-examination, or are they merely learned textual patterns? We investigate this via VisualSwap, an image-swap probing framework: after a model reasons over an image, we replace it with a visually similar but semantically different one and test whether the model notices. We introduce VS-Bench, 800 image pairs curated from MathVist

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的问题很直接：VLM 在长链推理里说“我再看一眼图”“让我重新检查图像”时，是否真的重新读取了视觉证据，还是只是生成了一个看起来像自我反思的语言模板。作者把这个问题做成了一个可操作的诊断设定：先让模型基于原图完成一段推理，再在保留上下文的情况下把图像替换成一张高层视觉相似、但决定答案的细节不同的新图，然后要求模型继续反思。如果模型真的会在反思时重新 grounding 到当前图像，它应该能发现前后不一致并修正答案；如果不会，它就会沿着旧推理惯性继续说下去。论文关心的不是一般视觉问答准确率，而是 CoT 过程中“自发视觉复查”这一能力是否真实存在。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对多模态基座研究有明确价值。第一，它揭示了一个很具体的 failure mode：VLM 的自反思文本不等于视觉再感知，语言上的“检查”可能只是生成习惯。对做 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 token 设计、cross-attention 机制的人来说，这说明当前模型在长推理链中维持视觉 grounding 的能力并不可靠。第二，它把问题从最终答对没答对，推进到“中间推理是否重新访问模态证据”，这类诊断比普通 benchmark 更接近训练目标设计。第三，结果对 test-time scaling 也有提醒：thinking model 并不天然更会看图，反而可能因为更长的文本轨迹而更脱离视觉输入。对后续做多模态 RL、反思式推理、或 tool-augmented re-reading 的工作，这篇论文提供了一个很好的评测切口。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 VisualSwap，两阶段 probing。第一阶段，模型在图像 I_a 和问题 Q 上正常生成推理。第二阶段，保留已有 reasoning context，把输入图像替换成 I_b，并提示模型重新检查或反思。这里的关键设计不是简单换图，而是要求 I_a 和 I_b 在高层外观上相似，但在决定答案的局部细节上不同，且问题 Q 对两张图都成立，只是正确答案不同。这样可以排除“图完全变了所以模型当然能发现”的简单情况，真正测试模型是否会重新读取细粒度视觉信息。

为了支撑这个设定，作者构建了 VS-Bench，包含 800 个样本，来自 MathVista、MathVerse、MathVision、MMMU-Pro 等偏复杂推理的数据源。样本构造强调两点：一是视觉相似性，二是 ground-truth answer 的可分性。这个 benchmark 的价值在于它不是测一般视觉理解，而是测“在已有长文本上下文干扰下，模型能否重新 grounding”。

机制分析部分，作者进一步看 attention。结论不是模型完全不看图，而是自反思语句只带来很弱的 image-token attention 增幅，远低于用户显式要求“重新检查图像”时的水平。也就是说，模型会说出 re-examination 的话，但这种内部生成的 CoT 触发不了足够强的视觉回看。作者还比较了多轮用户指令与自发反思，在相同上下文负载下，外部指令能明显恢复视觉 grounding，这说明问题不只是长上下文记忆衰减，更像是 intrinsic CoT 缺少稳定的跨模态回指机制。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 15 个模型，来自 Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL、ERNIE-VL 等系列。主结果很醒目：图像替换后，模型普遍无法察觉变化，性能大幅下滑，最大跌幅接近 60 个点。文中给出的代表性数字包括：ERNIE-4.5-VL-Thinking 从 79.9% 降到 19.6%；Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking 的跌幅为 48.3%，而对应 Instruct 版本只有 17.9%；更大模型也没有缓解，Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 的跌幅 54.6%，反而高于 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 39.4%。这几组数字共同说明三个结论：一，问题不是个别模型偶发失误，而是系统性现象；二，thinking model 比 instruct model 更脆弱；三，参数规模扩大并不能自动修复。

机制实验里，attention 分析显示自反思阶段对视觉 token 的关注只略有上升，但远不足以支持有效的视觉重审；而多轮用户显式指令在同样上下文下能显著提高视觉注意力并恢复表现。作者还观察到，随着 reasoning context 变长，模型更容易停留在先前文本轨迹中，形成 reasoning inertia。这个现象很重要，因为它把失败原因从“视觉编码不够强”进一步定位到“长 CoT 过程中语言轨迹压制了视觉再接入”。如果正文里还有按任务类型、图像差异粒度、swap 时机的分组结果，这些会帮助判断问题究竟更偏向注意力分配、上下文锁定，还是训练数据里缺少真正的视觉复查行为。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读到中等深度。先看 Introduction 和 VisualSwap 设定，理解作者为什么要用‘先推理再换图’而不是直接做对抗样本。然后看 VS-Bench 的构造标准，重点确认 image pair 是否真的控制了高层相似、细节差异和答案变化三件事。实验部分优先看主表，尤其是 thinking vs instruct、不同模型规模、以及 direct inference on swapped image 与 reflective re-examination 的对比。机制部分值得看 attention 可视化或统计图，因为论文最有信息量的地方不只是“掉分了”，而是“为什么掉分”。如果时间有限，25-35 分钟足够抓住结论。若要深挖，建议重点思考两点：这种 failure 是训练目标没有鼓励中途重新看图，还是架构上文本状态对视觉状态的回写通路太弱；以及多轮用户指令能恢复 grounding，是否意味着未来应把 re-attend 做成显式动作或工具调用，而不是指望模型在 CoT 里自发完成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when a VLM says things like “let me check the figure again” during chain-of-thought reasoning, does it actually re-examine the image, or is that phrase just a learned textual pattern? The authors turn this into a controlled diagnostic setup. A model first reasons over an image-question pair. Then, while preserving the generated reasoning context, the image is swapped with a visually similar but semantically different one, and the model is prompted to reflect or re-check. If the model truly re-grounds on the current visual input, it should notice the inconsistency and revise its answer. If not, it will continue along the inertia of the earlier textual reasoning. The target is therefore not generic VQA accuracy, but the authenticity of visual re-examination inside multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is highly relevant to multimodal foundation-model work. First, it exposes a concrete failure mode: self-reflective language in VLMs does not imply renewed visual grounding. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, visual tokenization, or cross-modal attention design, this suggests that current systems do not reliably maintain visual grounding over long reasoning traces. Second, the paper shifts evaluation from final-answer correctness to whether the model actually revisits modality evidence during reasoning, which is closer to the training objective design problem. Third, it carries an important message for test-time scaling: thinking-style VLMs are not necessarily better at looking again; longer reasoning can make them more detached from the image. That makes the work useful for future multimodal RL, reflection-based reasoning, and explicit re-attention mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is VisualSwap, a two-stage probing framework. In stage one, the model performs standard reasoning on an image I_a and question Q. In stage two, the prior reasoning context is kept, but the image is replaced with I_b, and the model is asked to reflect or re-check. The key design choice is that I_a and I_b are visually similar at a coarse level, yet differ in the fine-grained details that determine the answer, and the same question remains valid for both images while the correct answer changes. This avoids trivial swap detection and specifically tests whether the model re-reads fine visual evidence under a strong textual prior.

To support this setup, the authors build VS-Bench, a benchmark of 800 image pairs derived from MathVista, MathVerse, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro. The benchmark is designed around two constraints: high visual similarity and answer separability. Its value lies in probing re-grounding under long-context interference, rather than generic visual understanding.

The paper also includes a mechanism analysis based on attention. The result is not that models completely ignore images, but that self-reflective phrases trigger only a small increase in attention to image tokens, far weaker than explicit user instructions asking the model to inspect the image again. In other words, the model can say it is re-examining without allocating enough visual attention to actually do so. The authors further compare self-initiated reflection with multi-turn user prompting and show that external instructions can restore visual grounding under the same context load. This suggests the issue is not only long-context degradation, but also a limitation of intrinsic CoT as a trigger for cross-modal re-attention.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover 15 models from the Qwen3-VL, Kimi-VL, and ERNIE-VL families. The main result is strong and consistent: after the image swap, models usually fail to detect the change and suffer large performance drops, in some cases close to 60 points. Representative numbers reported in the paper include ERNIE-4.5-VL-Thinking dropping from 79.9% to 19.6%; Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking dropping by 48.3%, while the corresponding Instruct model drops by only 17.9%; and larger models not helping, with Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B showing a 54.6% drop versus 39.4% for Qwen3-VL-8B. These numbers support three conclusions: the failure is systematic rather than anecdotal, thinking models are substantially more vulnerable than instruct models, and scaling model size does not fix the issue.

The mechanism experiments show that self-reflection leads to only a marginal increase in image-token attention, insufficient for effective visual re-examination. By contrast, explicit multi-turn user instructions significantly raise visual attention and recover performance under the same context conditions. The paper also finds that longer reasoning contexts strengthen reasoning inertia: the model becomes more committed to its earlier textual trajectory and less responsive to current visual evidence. This is an important diagnosis, because it points beyond weak visual encoding and toward a failure of re-entry from language state back into visual grounding during long CoT generation. If the full paper includes breakdowns by task type, swap difficulty, or swap timing, those would be especially useful for localizing the failure more precisely.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading beyond the abstract. Start with the problem setup and the VisualSwap protocol to understand why the authors use a reason-then-swap design instead of standard adversarial evaluation. Then inspect the VS-Bench construction criteria, especially whether the image pairs truly control for coarse similarity, fine-detail differences, and answer changes. In the experiments, prioritize the main tables comparing thinking vs instruct models, model scaling, and reflective re-examination versus direct inference on the swapped image. The mechanism section is the most informative part after the headline results, because the paper is strongest when it explains why the failure happens rather than merely showing a score drop. A 25-35 minute read should be enough for the main ideas. For deeper reading, focus on whether the issue is primarily due to training objectives that never reward mid-reasoning visual revisits, or due to architectural limitations in how textual state re-engages visual state.

recommendation.zh: 只看 VisualSwap setup 和 attention 分析即可；它提醒多模态 CoT 里的“再看图”大多不是一次新的视觉读入。
recommendation.en: Read the VisualSwap setup and attention analysis; it is a clean warning that multimodal CoT “looking again” often does not re-read the image.

paper.title: Transformer Scalability Crisis: The First Comprehensive Empirical Analysis of Performance Walls in Modern Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable success of transformer architectures in natural language processing, their scalability limitations remain poorly understood through systematic empirical analysis. This paper presents the first comprehensive large-scale evaluation of 118 transformer models across seven distinct architectural categories, revealing fundamental performance walls that manifest as hard deployment constraints. Our systematic benchmarking methodology uncovers a critical scalability crisis: while 8

summary.core_problem: 现有Transformer架构的可扩展性研究多停留在理论复杂度分析层面，缺乏跨架构、大规模的实际部署场景下的系统性实证验证，无法准确反映不同序列长度下的真实性能瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，仅靠理论复杂度推导不足以指导长上下文架构设计，实际部署中的加载耗时、内存占用、吞吐量等硬约束会带来远超理论预期的性能墙，需要在预训练架构设计阶段就纳入实际部署指标的考量。
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖7类Transformer架构、共118个模型的评测集合，参数规模从66M到7.1B不等；在统一硬件环境下，测试序列长度从128到2048 token下的吞吐量、峰值内存、加载时间、参数效率等指标，系统性量化不同架构的可扩展性边界。
summary.experiments: 测试结果显示，88.1%的模型可正常处理512 token序列，仅44.9%可处理1024 token，所有模型均无法正常处理2048 token；压缩模型的参数效率比小语言模型高52倍；专门针对长序列设计的高效Transformer架构（如Longformer、BigBird）实际长序列性能并未显著优于通用架构，与理论预期存在明显差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章的核心结论和第3章的评测设计部分，重点关注不同序列长度下的模型故障率统计，预计阅读时间15-20分钟，不需要深入实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing analysis of Transformer scalability mostly stays at the level of theoretical complexity, lacking systematic empirical evaluation across diverse architectures in real deployment scenarios, which fails to accurately reflect real performance bottlenecks under different sequence lengths.
summary_en.importance: It indicates that theoretical complexity derivation alone is insufficient to guide long-context architecture design. Hard constraints in real deployment such as loading time, memory footprint, and throughput lead to performance walls far beyond theoretical expectations, which need to be considered in the pretraining architecture design stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work builds an evaluation set covering 7 Transformer architecture categories with 118 models in total, with parameter sizes ranging from 66M to 7.1B. Under a unified hardware environment, it tests metrics including throughput, peak memory, loading time, and parameter efficiency across sequence lengths from 128 to 2048 tokens, to systematically quantify the scalability boundary of different architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Results show that 88.1% of tested models can process 512-token sequences normally, only 44.9% can handle 1024-token sequences, and no model can successfully process 2048-token sequences. Compressed models achieve 52× higher parameter efficiency than small language models. Practical long-sequence performance of efficient Transformer architectures such as Longformer and BigBird does not significantly outperform general architectures, deviating from theoretical expectations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the core conclusions in Section 1 and the evaluation design in Section 3, focus on the statistics of model failure rate across different sequence lengths. Expected reading time is 15-20 minutes, no need to go deep into implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 数据量够大但结论偏直觉——长序列本来就贵。看Fig 2的崩溃曲线即可，不必深究其方法论。
recommendation.en: Large dataset but conclusions are somewhat intuitive—long sequences are inherently expensive. Just look at the collapse curve in Fig 2, skip deep methodology.

paper.title: RoadmapBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Agentic Software Development Across Version Upgrades
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly deployed in real software development, where a single version iteration requires months of coordinated work across many files. However, most existing benchmarks focus predominantly on single-issue bug fixes from Python repositories, with coarse pass/fail evaluation outcomes, and thus fail to capture long-horizon, multi-target development at real engineering scale. To address this gap, we present RoadmapBench, a benchmark of 115 long-horizon coding tasks grounded in

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 coding agent benchmark 过于短程、单问题、单语言、评价粗糙的问题，无法反映真实软件版本升级中的长周期开发能力。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。对预训练研究员的直接价值不在 agent 方法，而在它把“仓库级长期软件演化”作为更接近真实分布的评测对象，能反向暴露当前模型在长上下文、规划、代码编辑和状态跟踪上的能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RoadmapBench：基于真实开源仓库版本升级构造 115 个长程任务，覆盖 17 个仓库、5 种编程语言。每个任务从 source-version 代码快照出发，给 agent 一个多目标 roadmap instruction，要求实现 target version 中引入的功能。任务粒度远大于常见单 bug fix，且评价不再只是简单 pass/fail，而是面向多目标升级场景的系统评测。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 13 个前沿模型。任务中位修改规模为 3,700 行、51 个文件，明显高于 SWE-bench 一类短程修复设定。结果显示最强模型 Claude-Opus-4.7 仅解决 39.1% 任务，最弱模型更低，说明当前 coding agent 在真实长程开发上仍远未成熟。摘要未给出全部 baseline 名单和细粒度指标，但 benchmark 难度和失败率本身已经有信息量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学、复旦大学、香港大学、清华大学等。给定信息中未出现可明确标注为业界广为人知的基础模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap that existing coding-agent benchmarks are too short-horizon, single-issue, Python-heavy, and coarsely evaluated to reflect real software version upgrades.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. Its value to a pretraining researcher is indirect but real: it turns repository-scale software evolution into an evaluation target, exposing current limits in long-context reasoning, planning, code editing, and state tracking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RoadmapBench, a benchmark of 115 long-horizon tasks derived from real open-source version upgrades across 17 repositories and 5 programming languages. Each task starts from a source-version snapshot and gives the agent a multi-target roadmap instruction to implement functionality from the target version. The setup is much larger than standard single-bug-fix benchmarks and aims to evaluate realistic multi-file, multi-goal development.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 13 frontier models. The median task requires modifying 3,700 lines across 51 files, far beyond typical SWE-bench-style settings. Even the best model, Claude-Opus-4.7, solves only 39.1% of tasks, indicating that current coding agents remain weak on realistic long-horizon development. The abstract does not expose the full metric suite or all baselines, but the task scale and low success rates are already informative.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University, Fudan University, The University of Hong Kong, Tsinghua University, and others. No widely recognized foundation-model author can be confidently identified from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 设得比 SWE-bench 更接近真实分布；看任务规模和失败案例就够，能帮助你校准“代码能力提升”到底来自哪一层。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark is closer to real software evolution than SWE-bench; read the task scale and failure analysis to recalibrate what current 'coding gains' actually mean.

paper.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Existing benchmarks for multimodal memory reasoning largely evaluate systems within pre-assembled contexts, but under-evaluate whether agents can use evidence distributed across independently originated sources. We argue that source-distributed memory composition is an important and under-examined bottleneck in multimodal agent memory, especially when relevant evidence is fragmented across heterogeneous artifacts such as conversations, profiles, screenshots, tables, images, and documents. To add

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态 agent memory benchmark 过度依赖预组装上下文、低估跨独立来源证据拼接能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。它把“source-distributed memory composition”单独拎出来测，强调真实 agent 需要跨对话、截图、表格、文档、图像等异构来源检索并对齐证据。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但对评估多模态 agent 的记忆瓶颈有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SMMBench，围绕四类能力构建评测：跨源多模态推理、冲突消解、偏好推理、基于记忆的动作预测。核心不是新模型，而是更贴近真实使用场景的数据组织方式：证据分散在多个独立来源，而不是被人工拼成单一上下文。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1877 个样本、264 个来源。摘要说明做了实验比较，但未给出具体参评模型、是否包含闭源强模型、以及不同 memory / retrieval 策略的误差分解。若只想获取信息，重点应看 benchmark 构造原则和错误类型统计，而不是逐项分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a gap in multimodal agent-memory evaluation: existing benchmarks often provide pre-assembled context and under-test whether agents can compose evidence scattered across independently originated sources.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. Its main value is isolating source-distributed memory composition as a distinct bottleneck for multimodal agents. For pretraining researchers, the relevance is modest, but it is useful as an evaluation reference for memory-heavy multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SMMBench evaluates four capabilities: cross-source multimodal reasoning, conflict resolution, preference reasoning, and memory-grounded action prediction. The novelty is in benchmark construction rather than model design: evidence is distributed across heterogeneous sources such as conversations, screenshots, tables, images, and documents instead of being curated into a single context.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,877 samples grounded in 264 sources. The abstract indicates comparative experiments, but does not specify the participating models, whether frontier closed models are included, or how errors break down across retrieval versus reasoning failures. The most useful parts are likely the benchmark design and failure analysis rather than leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and collaborators.

recommendation.zh: 是个评测集，不会直接改你的训练配方；只看任务定义和 error taxonomy，判断自家 agent 是否真在做跨源证据拼接。
recommendation.en: This is a benchmark, not a training-method paper; only read the task design and error taxonomy to check whether your agent truly composes cross-source evidence.

paper.title: LEAP: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLMs in Iterative Scientific Design
paper.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed in autonomous laboratories, under the assumption that their domain priors and reasoning over iterative feedback let them converge on good designs in fewer iterations than feedback-only baselines. Current iterative scientific design benchmarks, however, score only outcome snapshots at fixed horizons. This leaves the learning trajectory unmeasured, even though the trajectory is what captures learning efficiency, where each iteration saved is a real saving in cost and

summary.core_problem: 现有迭代科学设计基准仅评估固定时间节点的结果快照，无法测量LLM的迭代学习轨迹，难以反映真实场景下的迭代效率。
summary.importance: 首次提出面向迭代科学设计的轨迹级评估范式，贡献了包含55个任务的LEAPBench基准，补充了科学Agent评估的维度。
summary.technical_approach: 设计最佳表现AUC轨迹指标，搭配经典贝叶斯优化作为参考基线，同时锚定已发表文献作为审计依据，评估迭代过程的学习效率。
summary.experiments: 覆盖材料设计、生物设计等55个科学设计任务，对比了现有LLM科学Agent与贝叶斯优化基线的迭代效率差异。
summary.authors_note: FutureHouse等机构产出，Anthropic将该方向列为活跃研究目标。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing iterative scientific design benchmarks only evaluate result snapshots at fixed time nodes, cannot measure the iterative learning trajectory of LLMs, and fail to reflect iteration efficiency in real scenarios.
summary_en.importance: First proposes a trajectory-level evaluation paradigm for iterative scientific design, contributes the LEAPBench benchmark with 55 tasks, and supplements the evaluation dimensions of scientific agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a best-so-far AUC trajectory metric, uses classical Bayesian optimization as the reference baseline, and anchors published literature as the audit basis to evaluate the learning efficiency of the iterative process.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 55 scientific design tasks including material design and biological design, and compares the iteration efficiency difference between existing LLM scientific agents and Bayesian optimization baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Produced by FutureHouse and other institutions, this direction is listed as an active research target by Anthropic.

recommendation.zh: 仅做科学Agent评估方向的文献备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Only for literature reference in scientific agent evaluation, no need to read full text.
