paper.title: Editor's Choice: Evaluating Abstract Intent in Image Editing through Atomic Entity Analysis
paper.abstract: Humans naturally communicate through abstract concepts like "mood". However, current image editing benchmarks focus primarily on explicit, literal commands, leaving abstract instructions largely underexplored. In this work, we first formalize the definition and taxonomy of abstract image editing. To measure instruction-following in this challenging domain, we introduce Entity-Rubrics, a framework that breaks down abstract edits into individual, entity-level assessments and achieves strong correl

summary.core_problem: 现有图像编辑基准仅覆盖显式、字面指令的评测，缺少对抽象指令（如调整画面情绪、氛围）的系统化评测方法，且抽象指令的多义性导致评估结果难以对齐人类判断。
summary.importance: 建立了抽象图像编辑的正式定义和评测框架，为多模态生成模型的语义对齐能力评测、预训练阶段的抽象语义理解能力优化提供了标准化工具。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从识别度、明确度两个维度定义抽象图像编辑：当多数人类观察者无法就编辑目标实体、编辑变换方式达成一致时，指令属于抽象编辑。评测上参考NLP领域的事实性评估思路，提出ENTITY-RUBRICS框架：将抽象编辑拆解为原子实体级别的评估，优先验证模型执行的具体编辑是否与指令逻辑对齐，而非覆盖所有可能的编辑方案，同时区分意图驱动的修改和破坏原图上下文的任意修改。另外构建了ABSTRACTEDIT数据集，包含470个人工验证的测试样本、4k训练扩展样本，覆盖物理、逻辑、情绪、社会四类抽象编辑场景。
summary.experiments: 在ABSTRACTEDIT数据集上评测11个主流图像编辑模型，结果显示现有标准架构难以平衡抽象意图理解和原图上下文保留，验证了评测框架与人类判断的高相关性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注抽象编辑的定义分类、ENTITY-RUBRICS的评估逻辑、ABSTRACTEDIT数据集的构建方法，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image editing benchmarks only cover evaluation of explicit, literal instructions, lacking systematic evaluation methods for abstract instructions such as adjusting image mood or atmosphere. The polysemy of abstract instructions also makes evaluation results hard to align with human judgment.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes a formal definition and evaluation framework for abstract image editing, providing standardized tools for evaluating semantic alignment of multimodal generative models and optimizing abstract semantic understanding capability during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, abstract image editing is defined along two dimensions: identifiability and specificity. An instruction is classified as abstract when most human observers cannot reach consensus on either the target entities to edit or the expected transformation methods. For evaluation, drawing inspiration from factuality evaluation in NLP, the ENTITY-RUBRICS framework is proposed: it decomposes abstract edits into atomic entity-level assessments, prioritizes verifying whether the specific edits executed by the model are logically aligned with the instruction instead of covering all possible editing schemes, and distinguishes intent-driven modifications from arbitrary alterations that damage the original image context. The ABSTRACTEDIT dataset is also constructed, containing 470 human-verified test samples and 4k expanded training samples, covering four types of abstract editing scenarios: physical, logical, emotional, and social.
summary_en.experiments: 11 leading image editing models are evaluated on the ABSTRACTEDIT dataset. Results show that existing standard architectures struggle to balance abstract intent understanding and original context preservation, and the proposed evaluation framework achieves high correlation with human judgment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition and taxonomy of abstract editing, the evaluation logic of ENTITY-RUBRICS, and the construction method of the ABSTRACTEDIT dataset. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“抽象指令”评测拆到实体级是干净的，但主要是benchmark工作；只看定义/标注体系和失败模式统计，别指望训练方法新结论。
recommendation.en: Clean entity-level decomposition for abstract-edit evaluation, but it’s mostly a benchmark paper; read the taxonomy/rubric and failure-mode stats, not for new training insights.

paper.title: MechVerse: Evaluating Physical Motion Consistency in Video Generation Models
paper.abstract: Text- and image-conditioned video generation models have achieved strong visual fidelity and temporal coherence, but they often fail to generate motion governed by kinematic and geometric constraints. In these settings, object parts must remain rigid, maintain contact or coupling with neighboring components, and transfer motion consistently across connected parts. These requirements are especially explicit in articulated mechanical assemblies, where motion is constrained by rigid-link geometry,

summary.core_problem: 如何评测视频生成模型是否满足真实物理/机构学约束（刚体、接触/耦合、运动传递），而不仅是“看起来连贯”。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是Benchmark：把“物理一致性”具体化为机械装配的运动约束，提供可规模化的合成评测集，补足现有视频生成评测对运动真实性的弱监督。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MechVerse：面向机械装配的image-to-video评测基准，覆盖关节/连杆/耦合/传动链等约束；用“机构是否被破坏/耦合是否断裂/刚体是否形变/下游部件是否被带动”等失败类型来衡量模型的运动一致性缺口。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为21,156个合成clips，来自1,357个机械装配；对多种文生/图生视频模型做评测并展示其在运动约束上的系统性失败。摘要未给出具体模型列表与量化指标细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate whether video generation models obey physical/kinematic constraints (rigidity, contact/coupling, motion transmission) rather than merely producing visually plausible motion.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: operationalizes motion consistency via articulated mechanical assemblies and provides a scalable synthetic testbed, addressing the weak coverage of physically-grounded motion in current video-gen evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces MechVerse, an image-to-video benchmark built around mechanical assemblies with explicit kinematic/geometric constraints; evaluates failures such as rigid parts deforming, broken coupling/contact, wrong motion type (rotate vs translate), and missing downstream motion propagation.
summary_en.experiments: 21,156 synthetic clips from 1,357 mechanical assemblies; evaluates multiple video generation models and reports systematic violations of mechanism constraints. The abstract does not specify exact model list/metrics.

recommendation.zh: 作为“物理一致性”评测靶子还算锋利，但对预训练方法没直接答案；只需记住这个benchmark可用来做视频tokenizer/训练目标的回归测试。
recommendation.en: A sharp target for physical-consistency evaluation, but it won’t teach you new pretraining tricks; keep it as a regression benchmark for video tokenizers/objectives.

paper.title: SciPaths: Forecasting Pathways to Scientific Discovery
paper.abstract: Scientific progress depends on sequences of enabling contributions, yet existing AI4Science benchmarks largely focus on citation prediction, literature retrieval, or idea generation rather than the dependencies that make progress possible. In this paper, we introduce discovery pathway forecasting: given a target scientific contribution and the prior literature available at a specified time, the task is to (1) identify the enabling contributions required to realize it and (2) ground each in prior

summary.core_problem: 现有 AI4Science 评测多关注引用预测、文献检索或想法生成，较少评估模型能否识别科学发现所依赖的前置贡献链条。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。SciPaths 把任务定义为 discovery pathway forecasting：给定目标科学贡献和某一时间点前的文献，模型需要找出实现该贡献所需的 enabling contributions，并在可能时定位到 prior work。
summary.technical_approach: 构建专家标注的 gold pathways 和机器辅助的 silver pathways。每条 pathway 记录 enabling contribution、角色、理由、prior-work grounding，以及无法映射的决策。评测时使用严格语义匹配来衡量模型预测的依赖路径质量。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 262 条专家标注 gold pathways 和 2,444 条 silver pathways，来源于机器学习和自然语言处理论文。作者评估 frontier models 和 open-weight models，最佳模型在严格语义匹配下仅达到 0.189 F1，核心方法依赖尤其难预测。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI4Science benchmarks focus on citation prediction, literature retrieval, or idea generation, but rarely test whether models can recover the dependency chains behind scientific discoveries.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. SciPaths defines discovery pathway forecasting: given a target contribution and the literature available at a time point, a model must identify enabling contributions and ground them in prior work when possible.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark includes expert-annotated gold pathways and machine-constructed silver pathways. Each pathway records enabling contributions, roles, rationales, prior-work grounding, and unmapped decisions. Evaluation uses strict semantic matching for pathway prediction.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 262 expert-annotated gold pathways and 2,444 silver pathways from machine learning and NLP papers. Evaluations of frontier and open-weight models show the best model reaches only 0.189 F1 under strict semantic matching, with core methodological dependencies being especially difficult.

recommendation.zh: 作为科学推理 benchmark 备查即可；0.189 F1 说明任务很难，但离预训练 recipe 还隔着一层数据闭环。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a scientific-reasoning benchmark reference; the 0.189 F1 is informative, but it is still far from a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: SWE-Chain: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Chained Release-Level Package Upgrades
paper.abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models are increasingly expected to perform realistic software maintenance tasks beyond isolated issue resolution. Existing benchmarks have shifted toward realistic software evolution, but they rarely capture continuous maintenance at the granularity of package releases, where changes are bundled, shipped, and inherited by subsequent versions. We present SWE-Chain, a benchmark for evaluating agents on chained release-level package upgrades, where each tran

summary.core_problem: SWE-Chain 评测的是 coding agent 能否沿着真实软件包的连续 release 进行维护升级，并把自己上一轮修改后的代码库作为下一轮起点，而不是只解决一个孤立 issue 或单个版本迁移任务。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身影响有限，但对代码模型和 agent 评测有参考价值。它把软件工程评测从单点 patch 推向长程维护轨迹，能更好暴露代码 agent 的状态累积、回归错误和功能保持能力。对代码预训练和 posttrain 数据构造的启发是：训练样本不应只覆盖 isolated fix，也需要覆盖 release note、diff、测试失败和跨版本约束共同定义的维护任务。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-Chain 的核心是 release-level chained evaluation。每个任务链由真实 PyPI 或 GitHub 软件包的连续版本组成。系统收集 release notes、issues、PRs、代码 diff 和测试 diff，并为每条链手工准备 Docker 环境，固定 Python 解释器和跨版本依赖，同时允许其他依赖按对应 release 解析。为了构造更干净的升级规格，论文提出 DecompSynth：先把 maintainer-authored release notes 分解为原始任务，再用相邻版本之间的 gold code diff 和 test diff 对齐，合成 grounded upgrade specification。相比直接拼接 release notes、issue 和 PR，DecompSynth 减少了终端日志、复现片段、图片引用等噪声，也避免了完全手写规格的成本。评测时，agent 在版本 i-1 的代码基础上完成版本 i 的升级；完成后的 agent codebase 会继续作为下一次升级起点，因此早期错误会自然传递到后续版本。
summary.experiments: SWE-Chain 包含 12 条升级链，覆盖 9 个软件包、155 个版本迁移和 1,660 个 grounded tasks。环境构建阶段会做 sanity check，要求每个版本在对应测试套件上无 setup error，且失败测试比例低于 0.25%。升级相关测试通过在旧 gold codebase 和新 gold codebase 上运行新版本测试套件识别，包含 FAIL_TO_PASS 和 ERROR_TO_PASS 两类。论文评测了 9 个前沿 model-agent 配置。在 Build+Fix 设置下，即允许一次针对执行级错误的修复尝试，平均 resolving rate 为 44.8%，precision 为 65.4%，F1 为 50.2%。结果说明当前 agent 可以完成一部分 release-level 升级，但在连续维护中保持既有功能仍然不稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25-35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction 和 evaluation protocol。具体应看三处：DecompSynth 如何把 release notes 与 gold diff 对齐；cross-version validation 如何定义可执行环境和升级相关测试；chain-level evaluation 如何把上一轮 agent 输出传到下一轮。若关注代码模型训练数据，可重点看任务规格合成流程，因为它提供了一种从真实版本历史中抽取长程软件维护样本的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: SWE-Chain evaluates whether coding agents can maintain a real package across consecutive releases, where the codebase produced by the agent at one release becomes the starting point for the next. This is harder than isolated issue resolution because mistakes can accumulate across the chain.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to coding-agent evaluation than to core language-model pretraining. Still, it gives a useful signal for code-model training and post-training: realistic software work is not just a single patch against a fixed repository state. Release-level maintenance requires understanding release notes, preserving existing behavior, handling tests, and carrying changes forward across versions. This suggests that training data for coding agents should include chained maintenance trajectories, not only isolated bug fixes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Chain builds chained release-level tasks from real packages on PyPI or GitHub. For each package chain, the authors collect released versions, maintainer-written release notes, GitHub issues and PRs, code diffs, and test diffs. They manually create a Docker environment per chain, pinning the Python interpreter and cross-version dependencies while allowing release-specific dependencies to resolve normally. The specification-generation component, DecompSynth, decomposes release notes into raw tasks and aligns them with behavioral evidence from gold code and test diffs. This produces cleaner upgrade specifications than simply concatenating release notes, issues, and PRs, which often include terminal dumps, reproduction snippets, and irrelevant artifacts. During evaluation, the agent upgrades from version i-1 to version i, and its resulting codebase is reused as the base for the next transition.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 12 upgrade chains across 9 packages, with 155 version transitions and 1,660 grounded tasks. Before validation, each version must run without setup errors and have fewer than 0.25% failed tests on its corresponding test suite. Upgrade-related tests are selected by running the new version’s test suite on both old and new gold codebases, including FAIL_TO_PASS and ERROR_TO_PASS cases. The authors evaluate 9 frontier model-agent configurations. Under the Build+Fix regime, which allows one additional fix attempt for execution-level failures, the average resolving rate is 44.8%, precision is 65.4%, and F1 is 50.2%. The results indicate that current agents can solve part of the chained upgrade workload but still struggle to preserve functionality over long maintenance trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25-35 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and evaluation protocol. The most useful parts are the DecompSynth pipeline, the release-note-to-diff alignment, the cross-version validation procedure, and the chain-level protocol that passes the agent’s own codebase to the next transition. For code-model training research, the specification-synthesis process is the most reusable component because it shows how to extract long-horizon maintenance data from real version histories.

recommendation.zh: 比单 issue benchmark 更接近真实代码维护；读数据构造 pipeline，结果可用于设计 code RL 任务。
recommendation.en: Closer to real maintenance than single-issue benchmarks; read the data-construction pipeline and reuse the task shape for code RL design.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Do Coding Agents Understand Least-Privilege Authorization?
paper.abstract: As coding agents gain access to shells, repositories, and user files, least-privilege authorization becomes a prerequisite for safe deployment: an agent should receive enough authority to complete the task, without unnecessary authority that exposes sensitive surfaces.To study whether current models can infer this boundary themselves, we first introduce permission-boundary inference, where a model maps a task instruction and terminal environment to a file-level read/write/execute policy, and Aut

summary.core_problem: 编码Agent在获得shell/仓库/文件访问权限时，能否推断出最小权限授权边界——即只获得完成任务所需的权限，而不授予可能暴露敏感面的多余权限。
summary.importance: 首次提出permission-boundary inference任务和AuthBench基准（120个真实终端任务，含人工标注权限标签和可执行验证器），揭示了前沿模型在授权推断上的系统性缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 定义权限边界推断为将任务指令和终端环境映射到文件级读/写/执行策略的任务；构建AuthBench基准，通过人工标注权限标签和可执行验证器评估模型在utility和attack两个维度的表现。
summary.experiments: 在AuthBench上测试了GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet等前沿模型，发现模型常遗漏执行链所需权限同时授予未使用或敏感访问权限；增加推理时推理并不能解决此不匹配，每个模型倾向于收敛到自身特有的授权偏差。
summary.authors_note: Evolvent AI Research Team出品

summary_en.core_problem: Whether coding agents can infer least-privilege authorization boundaries when given access to shells, repos, and user files — granting only necessary permissions without exposing sensitive surfaces.
summary_en.importance: First formalization of permission-boundary inference as a task and introduction of AuthBench benchmark (120 realistic terminal tasks with human-reviewed permission labels and executable validators), revealing systematic authorization flaws in frontier models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines permission-boundary inference as mapping task instructions and terminal environments to file-level read/write/execute policies; constructs AuthBench with human-annotated permission labels and executable validators for evaluating utility and attack outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Frontier models including GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet tested on AuthBench. Models systematically omit required permissions in the execution chain while also granting unused or sensitive access. Increased inference-time reasoning does not resolve this mismatch — each model converges to a model-specific authorization bias.
summary_en.authors_note: Evolvent AI Research Team

recommendation.zh: 编码Agent安全的基准工作，揭示了权限推断的系统性缺陷，对Agent安全部署有参考价值，非LLM预训练方向，快速浏览摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Coding agent safety benchmark revealing systematic authorization inference flaws. Relevant for agent safety deployment, not LLM pretraining. Quick abstract scan suffices.

paper.title: AgentTrap: Measuring Runtime Trust Failures in Third-Party Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Third-party skills are becoming the package ecosystem for LLM agents. They package natural-language instructions, helper scripts, templates, documents, and service configuration into reusable workflows. This makes skills useful, but it also introduces a new security problem: a malicious skill does not need to ask the model to perform an obviously harmful action. Instead, it can disguise the harmful behavior as part of a routine workflow, relying on the agent to execute that workflow with high-va

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注第三方 agent skill 带来的运行时信任失败。问题不在于模型是否会响应明显恶意的请求，而在于恶意 skill 可以把危险行为伪装成正常工作流的一部分，让 agent 在文件系统、shell、邮箱、云凭据、浏览器会话等高权限环境中执行。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 agent 安全评测有参考价值。它把安全问题从“模型是否拒绝恶意指令”推进到“模型、框架、工具权限、本地状态共同组成的运行环境是否会放大风险”。这对后训练和 agent 框架评测更有启发：只看 backbone 的安全对齐不够，部署环境会改变攻击是否可达、是否可执行、是否能持久化。
summary.technical_approach: AgentTrap 构造了一个动态 benchmark。每个任务都会安装一个具体的第三方 skill 包，并让 agent 执行一个看似正常的用户请求。skill 可以包含自然语言说明、helper scripts、模板、生成文件、stdout、服务配置、本地 instruction 文件、权限配置、memory 和持久化 workspace 状态。评测不是只看最终回答，而是记录完整执行轨迹，并根据工具调用日志、生成文件、网络或文件系统证据、最终响应来判断攻击是否成功。论文还设计了两条执行路径：Plain Agent 路径使用最小的 LLM-with-tools 接口；Framework-mediated 路径把同一个 backbone 放入完整 agent 框架和任务运行环境中。这样可以区分失败来自模型本身、agent 框架，还是本地权限和环境配置。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 包含 141 个任务，其中 91 个恶意任务、50 个良性 utility 任务，覆盖 16 类具有安全影响的行为。论文强调动态运行时评测：任务会在 sandboxed workspace 中执行，并保留轨迹用于归因分析。已给出的内容主要说明 benchmark 设计、威胁模型和诊断路径，没有给出具体模型或框架的通过率、攻击成功率、误杀率等结果数字。需要阅读实验章节确认不同 LLM backbone、agent 框架、权限配置之间的差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 benchmark construction、threat model、execution paths 和 judging protocol。重点不是具体攻击样例，而是它如何把“skill 安全”拆成模型、框架、权限、持久化状态四个层面的归因问题。对做基座模型的人，值得关注的是：安全能力不能只在静态拒答 benchmark 中测，agent 化部署会引入新的分布和新的工具执行边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies runtime trust failures caused by third-party agent skills. The core risk is not that a model directly accepts an obviously malicious request. A malicious skill can hide harmful behavior inside a routine workflow and rely on an agent with filesystem, shell, email, cloud credential, browser-session, or wallet access to execute it.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining contribution, but it is useful for agent safety evaluation. It shifts the question from whether a backbone refuses malicious instructions to whether the deployed system, including framework policy, tool permissions, local files, memory, and persistent workspace state, prevents unsafe behavior. This matters for post-training and agent deployment because backbone alignment alone does not determine whether an attack is reachable or executable.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentTrap is a dynamic benchmark. Each task installs a concrete third-party skill package into a sandboxed workspace and asks the agent to complete an ordinary user request. The skill may include natural-language instructions, helper scripts, templates, generated artifacts, stdout, service configuration, local instruction files, permissions, memory, and persistent workspace state. Evaluation uses the full runtime trajectory rather than only the final answer. Attack success is judged from tool-call logs, generated artifacts, network or file evidence, and final responses. The benchmark also runs two execution paths: a Plain Agent path with a minimal LLM-with-tools interface, and a Framework-mediated path where the same backbone is embedded in an agent framework and task-specific environment. This design supports attribution between the LLM backbone, the framework, and the local deployment configuration.
summary_en.experiments: AgentTrap contains 141 tasks: 91 malicious tasks and 50 benign utility tasks, covering 16 security-impact categories. The supplied content focuses on benchmark design, threat modeling, and diagnostic execution paths. It does not provide concrete leaderboard numbers such as attack success rates, benign task success, or false-positive rates for specific models and frameworks. The experimental section should be checked for backbone-level and framework-level comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the threat model, task construction, execution paths, and judging protocol. The main useful idea is the attribution setup: skill safety is evaluated as an interaction among model behavior, framework mediation, tool permissions, and persistent local state. For foundation-model researchers, the relevant point is that static refusal benchmarks are too narrow for agentic deployment.

recommendation.zh: 读任务设计和威胁模型就够了；它把 agent skill 当软件供应链看，比常规越狱评测更接近真实部署风险。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and threat model; treating agent skills as a software supply chain is more realistic than another jailbreak benchmark.

paper.title: GAMBIT: A Three-Mode Benchmark for Adversarial Robustness in Multi-Agent LLM Collectives
paper.abstract: In multi-agent systems (MAS), a single deceptive agent can nullify all gains of an agentic AI collective and evade deployed defenses. However, existing adversarial studies on MAS target only shallow tasks and do not consider adaptive adversaries, which evolve their strategies to evade the very detectors trained to catch them. To address that gap, we introduce GAMBIT, a benchmark with three evaluation modes and two independent scores for evaluating imposter detectors: the first two modes measure

summary.core_problem: 评估多智能体 LLM 群体中存在欺骗性成员时，检测器能否在分布漂移和自适应攻击下识别 impostor。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全 benchmark。它把多智能体对抗评测从浅层任务推向更复杂的推理基底，并加入自适应攻击者和少样本 recalibration，适合作为 agent robustness 文献备查。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GAMBIT benchmark，包含三种评测模式和两个独立分数。前两种模式测 zero-shot detection，并逐步增加分布漂移；第三种 recalibration 模式测检测器用 20 个标注样本适应新攻击的速度。数据集包含 27,804 个标注实例，覆盖 240 种共同演化的 imposter 策略。任务基底使用国际象棋，agent 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模和设置：27,804 条实例、240 种 co-evolved imposter strategies、20-shot recalibration。未在摘要中给出具体 detector baseline、性能数字或失败案例细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 IDLab–T2K、Ghent University–imec。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether detectors can identify deceptive members in multi-agent LLM collectives under distribution shift and adaptive adversaries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent safety benchmark. It moves adversarial multi-agent evaluation beyond shallow tasks by adding a deeper reasoning substrate, adaptive imposters, and few-shot recalibration, making it useful as a reference point for agent robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: GAMBIT defines three evaluation modes and two independent scores. The first two modes test zero-shot detection under increasing distribution shift, while the third recalibration mode measures how quickly a detector adapts to novel attacks from 20 labeled examples. The dataset contains 27,804 labeled instances across 240 co-evolved imposter strategies. Chess is used as the reasoning substrate, with Gemini 3.1 Pro agents.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 27,804 labeled instances, 240 co-evolved imposter strategies, and a 20-example recalibration setting. It does not provide detector baselines, quantitative performance, or detailed failure cases in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with IDLab–T2K and Ghent University–imec.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 安全 benchmark 记住名字即可；国际象棋设定有可控性，但离预训练信号和通用协作机制还有距离。
recommendation.en: Know it as an agent-safety benchmark; chess gives control, but it is still far from pretraining signals or general collaboration mechanisms.

paper.title: ExploitBench: A Capability Ladder Benchmark for LLM Cybersecurity Agents
paper.abstract: Exploitation is not a binary event. It is a ladder of acquiring progressive capabilities, from executing a single buggy line of code to taking full control of the target. However, existing LLM security benchmarks treat a crash as exploitation success. That single binary outcome collapses the hard parts of exploitation: the transition from triggering a bug to constructing reusable primitives and control.   We present ExploitBench, a capability-graded benchmark that decomposes exploitation into 16

summary.core_problem: 现有网络安全 Agent benchmark 把 exploit 成功当成二元结果，无法测出从 crash 到真正控制目标之间的能力台阶。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark 设计：把 exploit 过程拆成可验证的能力阶梯，而不是只看最终是否拿到 shell。对评估 Agent 的长链条能力、工具使用和中间进展度量有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExploitBench，用 16 个 capability flags 分解漏洞利用过程，覆盖 coverage、crash、sandbox primitives、arbitrary read/write、control-flow hijack 到 arbitrary code execution。每一级都用确定性 oracle 验证，包括随机 challenge-response、与真值二进制差分执行、signal-handler proof 等。
summary.experiments: 基于 41 个 V8 bugs 实例化 benchmark。摘要未给出具体模型、分数和提升幅度，但强调现有 benchmark 的二元成功标准会压扁关键中间能力差异。
summary.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University；David Brumley 是程序分析与安全领域知名学者。该工作更像安全 Agent 评测基础设施，而非 LLM 基座方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing cybersecurity-agent benchmarks reduce exploitation to a binary success signal, missing the capability ladder between a crash and full target control.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is benchmark design: exploitation is decomposed into verifiable intermediate capabilities rather than judged only by end success. This is useful for evaluating long-horizon agent competence, tool use, and progress signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExploitBench defines 16 capability flags spanning coverage, crash, sandbox primitives, arbitrary read/write, control-flow hijack, and arbitrary code execution. Each stage is checked by deterministic oracles, including randomized challenge-response, differential execution against ground-truth binaries, and signal-handler proofs.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is instantiated on 41 V8 bugs. The abstract does not provide full model or score details, but the key point is that binary exploit success hides meaningful differences in intermediate capability acquisition.
summary_en.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University; David Brumley is a well-known researcher in program analysis and security. The paper is better viewed as security-agent evaluation infrastructure than as a foundation-model method paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 设计是认真的；若你做 agent eval，只看 16-level capability 定义和 oracle 设计，别陷进安全细节。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark design is solid; if you care about agent eval, read the 16-level capability ladder and oracle construction, not the security specifics.

paper.title: A Very Big Video Reasoning Suite
paper.abstract: Rapid progress in video models has largely focused on visual quality, leaving their reasoning capabilities underexplored. Video reasoning grounds intelligence in spatiotemporally consistent visual environments that go beyond what text can naturally capture, enabling intuitive reasoning over spatiotemporal structure such as continuity, interaction, and causality. However, systematically studying video reasoning and its scaling behavior is hindered by the lack of large-scale training data. To addr

summary.core_problem: 视频生成模型的评估长期偏向画质、运动自然度和指令跟随，缺少大规模、可验证的视频推理训练与评测资源。VBVR 试图回答一个更具体的问题：如果把视频看作承载空间结构、物理连续性、对象交互和因果链条的环境，现有视频模型能否学习可泛化的推理能力，以及这种能力是否随数据规模增长。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在多模态数据构造和评测信号设计，而不是文本 LLM 训练目标本身。它提供了一个较大规模的视频推理数据与 benchmark 框架：200 个程序化任务、约 201.5 万张图像和 100.75 万个视频片段，并强调用规则打分器替代 VLM-as-a-judge。这个选择很关键，因为视频推理评估如果依赖另一个模型判断，很难区分生成质量、语义对齐和真正的可验证推理。对做 native multimodal pretraining、视频 token 化、世界模型或 AR/diffusion 统一建模的人来说，VBVR 的价值在于：它把视频任务拆成可自动扩展、可程序验证、可做 scaling study 的训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一是 VBVR-Dataset。任务 taxonomy 被组织为五类能力：abstraction、knowledge、spatiality、perception、transformation。每个任务由贡献者自由设计核心语义和推理流程，再用统一模板封装输入输出，以保证任务多样性和批量生成的一致性。数据通过自动化云端 pipeline 随机生成，新增任务后可以继续扩展每个任务的样本量。第二是 VBVR-Bench。评测不采用 VLM 评委，而是为任务设计可复现的规则打分器，并用人类偏好实验验证规则分数与人工判断的一致性。第三是 scaling study。作者以 Wan-2.2 为基座模型，考察训练数据规模增加时，ID 和 OOD 视频推理任务的表现变化。这个设计比单纯 benchmark 更接近预训练研究关心的问题：数据规模、任务覆盖、泛化边界和能力协同增长。
summary.experiments: 关键数字包括 200 个任务、2,015,000 张图像、1,007,500 个视频片段，规模约比已有同类视频推理数据大三个数量级。规则打分器与人类偏好的 Spearman 相关系数达到 ρ > 0.9，说明自动评分在这些程序化任务上较可靠。评测覆盖 Veo 3.1、Sora 2、Kling 2.6、Runway Gen-4，以及 Wan-2.2、CogVideoX-1.5、HunyuanVideo、LTX-2 等开源模型。结果显示，领先模型在视频推理上仍明显低于人类水平。基于 Wan-2.2 的训练规模实验中，ID 与 OOD 表现都会随数据规模增加而提升，说明程序化视频推理数据能带来一定泛化；但两者最终都出现平台期，且 OOD 始终落后于 ID。这个现象提示，单靠扩大同类数据很难补足当前视频生成架构在长期因果、精确对象状态追踪和组合泛化上的短板。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对三项贡献的界定，然后看 Dataset 部分的五类能力 taxonomy、统一任务模板和数据生成 pipeline。评测部分重点看规则 scorer 如何设计，以及 ρ > 0.9 的人工一致性验证。Scaling study 是最值得细看的部分，尤其是 ID/OOD 随数据规模变化的曲线、平台期现象，以及不同能力之间的协同和取舍。若关注多模态预训练，可重点追问两个问题：这些程序化任务是否会诱导模型学习可迁移的时空表示；规则化视频推理信号能否作为视频 LM 或 diffusion video model 的中间训练阶段，而不只是评测集。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a missing piece in video model research: large-scale, verifiable training and evaluation data for video reasoning. Instead of measuring only visual fidelity or prompt adherence, VBVR asks whether video models can reason over spatial structure, temporal continuity, object interactions, transformations, and causal dynamics, and whether these abilities improve with scale.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to pretraining research is in multimodal data design and evaluation signal quality. VBVR provides a large procedural video reasoning suite with 200 tasks, about 2.015 million images, and 1.0075 million video clips. The important design choice is the use of rule-based, reproducible scoring rather than model-as-judge evaluation. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, video tokenization, world models, or unified AR/diffusion modeling, the useful signal is not just the benchmark score. The useful part is the recipe for building scalable, programmatically verifiable supervision for spatiotemporal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system has three components. VBVR-Dataset organizes tasks into five cognitive pillars: abstraction, knowledge, spatiality, perception, and transformation. Task designers define the semantics and reasoning procedure, while a unified input-output wrapper makes large-scale generation and evaluation consistent. A distributed cloud pipeline then produces randomized instances and supports continuous task expansion. VBVR-Bench uses task-specific rule scorers to make evaluation reproducible and explainable. The authors validate these scorers against human preferences. Finally, the scaling study uses Wan-2.2 as the base model and studies how in-domain and out-of-domain video reasoning performance changes as the amount of VBVR training data increases.
summary_en.experiments: The suite contains 200 tasks, 2,015,000 images, and 1,007,500 video clips, roughly three orders of magnitude larger than prior video reasoning datasets described by the authors. The rule-based scores align well with human judgments, with Spearman correlation above 0.9. The benchmark includes proprietary systems such as Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling 2.6, and Runway Gen-4, as well as open models including Wan-2.2, CogVideoX-1.5, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2. The strongest systems still lag substantially behind human performance. In the Wan-2.2 scaling experiments, both ID and OOD performance improve as training scale grows, but both eventually plateau. The persistent OOD gap suggests that current video generation architectures do not acquire robust spatiotemporal reasoning from data scaling alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the framing, then focus on the dataset taxonomy, the unified task template, and the data generation pipeline. The evaluation section is useful for understanding how the authors avoid model-as-judge ambiguity through rule-based scoring and human-alignment checks. The most relevant part for pretraining researchers is the scaling study: the ID/OOD curves, the plateau behavior, and the analysis of capability co-development. A useful follow-up question is whether these procedural reasoning tasks can serve as a mid-training source for video LMs or diffusion video models, rather than only as an external benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和评分器；规模结论还要看泄漏控制，但视频推理数据配方对 native multimodal pretrain 有参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and scorers; the scaling claim depends on leakage control, but the recipe is useful for native multimodal pretraining.

commentary.article_excerpt: kk123 关注 我们开源了史上最大的video reasoning数据 We bet on the future where video reasoning is the next-gen reasoning system. 以前大家聊视频模型，基本都在看：“画质够不够真？”“运镜顺不顺？”“人物稳不稳？”🎥 关键的问题一直没有被系统回答：视频模型到底会不会真正“推理”？🤔🧠 我们认为，视频不只是生成内容的载体，它也可以是承载推理的时空环境。很多文本难以自然表达的关系，比如连续运动、空间约束、物体交互和因果变化，更适合在视频中被建模和检验。 基于这个，我们构建了 VBVR。它不只是一个 benchmark，而是一套面向视频推理的训练与评测基础设施。 首先，是一个足够大的数据集。 VBVR-Dataset 目前覆盖 200个任务，包含 201.5万张图像、100.75万个视频片段，其中有 100万条训练数据。从规模上看，它相比现有视频推理基准大约高出三个数量级。🛠️📚 其次，我们做了一个可验证、可复现的评测框架 VBVR-Bench。 相比依赖主观判断或“模型当裁判”，我们更强调 rule-based、human-aligned 的评测，希望结果不仅能比较模型强弱，也能帮助分析模型到底缺了什么能力。📏🔍 在任务设计上，我们把视频推理拆成五个核心维度：抽象、知识、空间、感知和变换。🧩🌍 我们也基于这套框架系统评测了多种主流视频模型。结果很直接： 现有模型距离人类的视频推理能力，还有明显差距。 它们也许越来越会“生成”，但离真正“理解”和“推演”世界还差得很远。📉 但另一个结果同样重要： 随着训练规模上升，模型在 域内 和 域外 任务上的表现都会提升，并开始出现对未见任务的泛化迹象。✨🚀 ✨ 这说明，视频推理能力并不是不可学，问题更可能在于：过去我们缺少足够大、足够系统、也足够可验证的数据和工具。 所以我们更想推动社区认真面对一个问题： 视频模型的下一步，拼的可能不只是生成质量，而是推理能力。 website: video-reason.com arxiv: 2602.20159 dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Reason/VBVR-Dataset ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ #科研 #ai #aigc #视频生成 #原神 #推理模型 #大模型 #扩散模型 #AGI #科研学习 04-06

paper.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced document understanding, yet current Doc-VQA evaluations score only the final answer and leave the supporting evidence unchecked. This answer-only approach masks a critical failure mode: a model can land on the correct answer while grounding it in the wrong passage -- a critical risk in high-stakes domains like law, finance, and medicine, where every conclusion must be traceable to a specific source region. To address this, we i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是文档理解中的证据归因，而不是基座预训练方法本身。它要解决的问题是：现有 Doc-VQA 只看答案对不对，不检查答案是否真的落在正确的文档区域上，因此模型可能“答对了，但证据错了”。作者把这个问题形式化为 answer + citation 的联合评测，要求模型返回元素级 bounding-box 证据，并用严格指标同时检查答案正确性和证据忠实性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响较弱，不属于核心 pretrain 论文。但它对多模态模型训练信号设计和后训练评测有一个明确启发：只优化最终答案会掩盖 grounding failure，尤其在长文档、多页 PDF、跨语言场景下更明显。若后续有人做 native document MLLM 预训练、视觉 token 对齐、或 retrieval-grounded post-training，这个 benchmark 提供了一个更严格的监督与评测方向。它的价值主要在评测框架，而不在建模方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 benchmark 构建与指标设计。数据侧，作者从超过 1 亿份原始 PDF 中，经分层采样先筛到约 25 万候选，再通过两阶段 MLLM 标注流程做领域和子类别识别，最终选出 711 份文档，覆盖 7 个领域、30 个子类、两种语言。问题总数 1,897，平均每份文档 40.6 页，强调长文档和真实复杂版式。

标注侧，作者设计了自动化 annotation pipeline，用文档解析模型和 MLLM 协同生成问题、答案和细粒度证据区域，目标是把人工逐页框选的成本降下来，同时保持一致性。评测侧，除了普通 answer accuracy，还提出 Traceability Metrics，其中核心是 Strict Attributed Accuracy，要求答案和证据同时正确才计分；另外用 Recall 看证据覆盖，用 Relevance 看引用区域与答案推理链是否匹配。

从方法性质看，这不是提出新的文档建模架构，也不是新的预训练目标，而是把“faithful evidence attribution”从一个模糊要求变成可量化 benchmark。
summary.experiments:
实验主要是 benchmark audit，而不是算法创新。作者评测了 20 个主流 MLLM，发现一个稳定现象：Attribution Hallucination，也就是文本答案正确，但引用的证据位置完全不对。文中给出的代表性结果是，Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 的 Strict Attributed Accuracy 最高约 76.0；领先的开源模型甚至没有超过 25.0。这个落差说明 answer-only 指标会明显高估系统可靠性。

数据统计方面，CiteVQA 包含 711 份 PDF、1,897 个问题、7 个领域、30 个子类、两种语言，平均文档长度 40.6 页。作者强调这是在文档数量、长度和领域覆盖之间做平衡，目的是更接近真实使用场景。若只看实验结论，最重要的信息不是谁排第一，而是“正确答案不等于正确归因”在当前 MLLM 中相当普遍。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看引言，明确它要修正的是 Doc-VQA 的评测缺口，而不是提出新的 MLLM 训练范式。然后看 benchmark construction 和 metrics 两节，重点理解自动化标注流程、元素级 citation 定义、以及 Strict Attributed Accuracy 的计分方式。最后看主结果表，关注 answer accuracy 与 SAA 的差距有多大。

如果你的工作偏预训练，这篇不需要逐节精读。20 分钟左右看完数据构建、指标定义和主表即可。只有在你关心 document MLLM 的 grounding、长文档对齐监督、或 post-training 中的 citation learning 时，才值得进一步看附录里的数据质量控制细节。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not a pretraining-method paper. Its core problem is an evaluation gap in document VQA: current benchmarks score the final answer but do not verify whether the model grounded that answer in the correct document region. As a result, a model can be correct in text while citing the wrong evidence. The paper turns this into a joint answer-plus-citation task, requiring element-level bounding-box evidence and evaluating both correctness and faithfulness together.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, so this is not a core pretrain read. The useful takeaway is narrower: answer-only supervision and evaluation can hide grounding failures, especially in long, multi-page, multilingual document settings. For researchers interested in document-native MLLM pretraining, visual-text alignment, or retrieval-grounded post-training, the benchmark offers a stricter target for supervision and evaluation. The contribution is mainly in benchmark design, not in modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is a benchmark and metric suite. On the data side, the authors start from more than 100 million raw PDFs, down-select roughly 250k candidates through stratified sampling, then apply a two-stage MLLM-based annotation process for domain and subcategory classification. The final benchmark contains 711 documents spanning 7 domains, 30 subcategories, and 2 languages, with 1,897 questions and an average document length of 40.6 pages.

For annotation, they build an automated pipeline combining document parsers and MLLMs to generate questions, answers, and fine-grained evidence regions. The goal is scalability and consistency, since manual box-level annotation over long PDFs is expensive and noisy. On the evaluation side, they introduce traceability metrics. The central one is Strict Attributed Accuracy, which only gives credit when both the answer and the cited evidence are correct. Additional metrics include Recall for evidence coverage and Relevance for logical alignment between cited regions and the answer.

Methodologically, this is a benchmark paper that operationalizes faithful evidence attribution rather than proposing a new document modeling architecture or a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are primarily an audit of existing MLLMs rather than a new algorithmic result. The authors evaluate 20 mainstream models and identify a recurring failure mode they call Attribution Hallucination: the model gives the correct textual answer but points to the wrong evidence region. The headline number is that Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview reaches about 76.0 Strict Attributed Accuracy, while leading open-source models remain below 25.0. The main message is not who ranks first, but how much answer-only evaluation overestimates reliability.

Dataset statistics are also part of the empirical contribution: 711 PDFs, 1,897 questions, 7 domains, 30 subcategories, 2 languages, and an average of 40.6 pages per document. The benchmark is designed to balance document count, length, and domain diversity so that it better reflects realistic document intelligence settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper for a pretraining-oriented reader. Start with the introduction to understand the exact evaluation gap it addresses. Then read the benchmark construction and metric sections, focusing on the automated annotation pipeline, the definition of element-level citations, and how Strict Attributed Accuracy is computed. Finally, inspect the main result table and compare answer accuracy against SAA.

If your focus is pretraining, around 20 minutes is enough to extract the useful part. Only go deeper into the appendix if you care about document grounding, long-document alignment supervision, or citation-aware post-training for MLLMs.

recommendation.zh: 把“引用是否对”从口号变成可量化指标，适合用来检验你家 VLM 的 grounding 训练是否真有效；只看评测协议和错误类型统计就够。
recommendation.en: It turns citation fidelity into a measurable target; use it to sanity-check whether your VLM grounding training actually works—skim the eval protocol and error breakdowns.
