paper.title: Visual Aesthetic Benchmark: Can Frontier Models Judge Beauty?
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now routinely deployed for visual understanding, generation, and curation. A substantial fraction of these applications require an explicit aesthetic judgment. Most existing solutions reduce this judgment to predicting a scalar score for a single image. We first ask whether such scores faithfully capture comparative preference: in a controlled study with eight expert annotators, score-derived rankings align poorly with the same annotators' direct comp

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题是：现有视觉审美评测多把单张图像映射成一个标量分数，但这种打分是否能可靠反映专家的相对偏好并不清楚。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接价值有限，主要价值在多模态模型评测。它提醒 VLM/MLLM 训练和评估中一个常被忽略的问题：高阶视觉判断不一定适合用独立标量标签建模。对于图像生成模型、图文偏好数据、RLHF/RLAIF 式视觉偏好训练，成对或集合排序信号可能比单图打分更稳定，也更难被内容偏好捷径污染。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先做了一个受控专家研究，让 8 位专家对同一批图像分别进行独立绝对打分和直接比较排序。结果显示，由分数推导出的排序与直接比较排序一致性较差。基于这个观察，作者构建 Visual Aesthetic Benchmark, VAB。VAB 不要求模型给单张图打审美分，而是在主题匹配的候选集合中选择最好图像，严格设置还要求同时选出最好和最差图像。这样的设计把内容差异尽量固定住，让模型更多判断构图、色彩、完成度、技术执行和风格规范，而不是偏好某类题材。
summary.experiments: VAB 发布 400 个任务、1,195 张图像，覆盖 fine art、photography、illustration 三大类和 24 个主题，候选集合大小为 2 到 6。论文报告了打分协议和排序协议在同质内容设置下的专家一致性差异：119 个任务、8 位标注者中，排序协议的 top-choice 熵更低，Mean H 从打分的 1.213 降到排序的 0.729；全体一致任务比例从 0.8% 提高到 10.1%；Wilcoxon signed-rank test 的 p 值为 1.7e-15。评测协议包括 Top-1 和 TB-1，指标包括三次随机候选顺序下的平均准确率 ap@1，以及三次都正确才算通过的 pass^3。提供内容未包含各个 frontier MLLM 的完整结果表，因此不能确认具体模型排名和差距。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的打分与直接排序对比实验，以及 Table 3，因为这是整篇论文最有信息量的部分。然后看 Section 3 的 VAB 构造流程，尤其是 matched subject matter 的设计、Fine Art 与 Photography 的数据来源，以及 Top-1/TB-1 和 pass^3 的评测定义。若关心视觉偏好数据构造，可进一步看 Appendix B 和 Appendix H.1；若只关心 LLM 预训练，读到 benchmark 设计即可。
summary.authors_note: BakeAI；作者姓名在提供内容中无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether scalar aesthetic scores for individual images are a reliable proxy for expert comparative preference.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for multimodal evaluation and preference-data design. The main signal is that higher-order visual judgment may be poorly served by independent scalar labels. For visual preference training, image-generation feedback, or multimodal reward modeling, direct ranking over matched candidates can provide a cleaner signal than single-image scoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first run a controlled expert study in which eight expert annotators evaluate the same images under two protocols: independent absolute scoring and direct comparative ranking. Rankings derived from scalar scores show weak alignment with direct comparisons. Motivated by this, they build the Visual Aesthetic Benchmark, or VAB. Each task presents a candidate set with matched subject matter, so the model has to judge execution quality rather than exploit content preference. The benchmark supports a Top-1 setting, where the model selects the best image, and a stricter TB-1 setting, where it identifies both the best and the worst image.
summary_en.experiments: VAB contains 400 released tasks and 1,195 images across fine art, photography, and illustration, covering 24 topics with candidate-set sizes from 2 to 6. In the homogeneous-content expert study with 119 tasks and eight annotators, direct ranking yields stronger agreement than score-derived ranking: mean top-choice entropy drops from 1.213 to 0.729, the unanimous-task rate rises from 0.8% to 10.1%, and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test gives p = 1.7e-15. Evaluation uses three independent random permutations per task and reports ap@1 and pass^3. The provided text does not include the full frontier-model result tables, so exact model-level performance gaps cannot be verified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the protocol comparison and Table 3, since they justify the benchmark design. Then read the VAB construction section for matched-subject candidate sets, domain coverage, and the Top-1/TB-1 evaluation setup. Appendix B and Appendix H.1 are worth checking if the goal is to design visual preference datasets rather than simply consume the benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: BakeAI; author names cannot be confirmed from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 VLM 美学评估中 point-wise 打分与 pair-wise 比较的不一致性，构建了新的 Benchmark，做 VLM 评测的同学可以关注其评估范式的转变。
recommendation.en: Highlights the inconsistency between point-wise scoring and pair-wise comparison in VLM aesthetic evaluation; introduces a new benchmark useful for VLM evaluation paradigm shifts.

paper.title: MMCL-Bench: Multimodal Context Learning from Visual Rules, Procedures, and Evidence
paper.abstract: We introduce MMCL-Bench, a benchmark for multimodal context learning: learning task-local rules, procedures, and empirical patterns from visual or mixed-modality teaching context and applying them to new visual instances. Unlike text-only context learning or standard multimodal question answering, this setting requires models to recover and localize relevant evidence from images, screenshots, manuals, videos, and frame sequences before they can reason over the learned context. MMCL-Bench contain

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态评测缺乏针对模型从视觉/多模态教学上下文中学习任务规则、流程并迁移应用能力的标准化基准。
summary.importance: 基准贡献，首次系统性构建面向多模态上下文学习的评测集，覆盖规则应用、流程执行、经验归纳三类任务，填补多模态上下文学习能力评测的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含102个任务的MMCL-Bench，采用基于严格评分标准的人工评测方式，要求模型先从图像、截图、手册、视频帧序列中定位证据再进行推理。
summary.experiments: 评测前沿多模态模型，最优模型在严格评测下任务解决率不足三分之一；诊断性消融和错误分析显示失败分布在上下文到答案的全流程。
summary.authors_note: 剑桥大学、清华大学团队，无公开知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal benchmarks lack standardized evaluation for models' ability to learn task rules and procedures from visual or mixed-modality teaching context and apply them to new instances.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: the first systematic evaluation set for multimodal context learning, covering three task categories and filling the gap in measuring this capability for VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Construct MMCL-Bench with 102 tasks, use rubric-based human evaluation, requiring models to first localize relevant evidence from images, screenshots, manuals, or video frames before reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate state-of-the-art multimodal models, with the strongest model solving less than 1/3 of tasks under strict evaluation; error analysis shows failures occur across the entire context-to-answer pipeline.
summary_en.authors_note: Research teams from University of Cambridge and Tsinghua University, no publicly notable authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态上下文学习的评测基准备查，仅需了解任务设计思路，无需通读正文。
recommendation.en: Keep as a reference for multimodal in-context learning evaluation; only review task design, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Edit-Compass & EditReward-Compass: A Unified Benchmark for Image Editing and Reward Modeling
paper.abstract: Recent image editing models have achieved remarkable progress in instruction following, multimodal understanding, and complex visual editing. However, existing benchmarks often fail to faithfully reflect human judgment, especially for strong frontier models, due to limited task difficulty and coarse-grained evaluation protocols. In parallel, reward models have become increasingly important for RL-based image editing optimization, yet existing reward model benchmarks still rely on unrealistic eva

summary.core_problem: 现有图像编辑benchmark任务难度低、评估协议粗，无法准确反映前沿模型的真实能力；奖励模型benchmark的评测设置不符合实际RL场景，限制了两类模型的可靠评估
summary.importance: 提出首个统一覆盖图像编辑和对应奖励建模的benchmark套件，属于benchmark贡献，填补了现有评估体系的缺口
summary.technical_approach: 构建Edit-Compass，包含2388个标注实例，覆盖6类难度递进的任务（含世界知识推理、视觉推理、多图像编辑等）；配套EditReward-Compass，设计贴近实际RL训练的奖励模型评测协议
summary.experiments: 评测了多个主流图像编辑模型和奖励模型，验证了现有模型在复杂编辑任务上的能力短板，以及现有奖励模型在真实RL场景下的泛化性不足

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image editing benchmarks have low task difficulty and coarse evaluation protocols, failing to reflect frontier model capabilities; reward model benchmarks use settings deviating from real RL scenarios, hindering reliable assessment of both types of models
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first unified benchmark suite covering both image editing and corresponding reward modeling, a benchmark contribution filling gaps in existing evaluation systems
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds Edit-Compass with 2,388 annotated instances covering 6 progressively difficult task categories including world knowledge reasoning, visual reasoning, multi-image editing; develops EditReward-Compass with reward model evaluation protocols close to real RL training
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated multiple mainstream image editing and reward models, verified capability shortcomings of existing models on complex editing tasks, and insufficient generalization of existing reward models in real RL scenarios

recommendation.zh: 图像编辑奖励建模的benchmark设计可参考，做多模态生成对齐时可复用评测思路，无需读全文
recommendation.en: The benchmark design for image editing reward modeling is referenceable for multimodal generation alignment, no need to read full text

paper.title: CommonWhy: A Dataset for Evaluating Entity-Based Causal Commonsense Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: To effectively interact with the real world, Large Language Models (LLMs) require entity-based commonsense reasoning, a challenging task that necessitates integrating factual knowledge about specific entities with commonsense inference. Existing datasets for evaluating LLM entity-based commonsense reasoning have largely focused on True/False or multiple-choice questions, leaving the explicit assessment of the model's ability in abductive reasoning about causes and effects and generating explanat

summary.core_problem: 现有实体常识评测多为 T/F 或选择题，难以显式测量 LLM 对具体实体的因果常识（why/因果解释、溯因）能力。
summary.importance: 贡献一个以“实体+因果 why 问题+解释”为核心的评测数据集，并提供 Wikidata 可检索支撑，便于区分“检索事实”与“因果解释”能力；更偏评测而非预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 CommonWhy：15k why 问题，面向实体的因果常识推理；同时作为 KGQA 基准，声明所需支撑知识可在 Wikidata 中获得，从而可结合检索/图谱方法评估。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、指标与提升幅度；预计以多种 LLM/KGQA baseline 对比为主（需看正文表格与标注协议）。
summary.authors_note: University of Toronto（多伦多大学）团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing entity commonsense benchmarks are mostly T/F or multiple-choice, under-testing causal abductive “why” reasoning and explanation generation for specific entities.
summary_en.importance: Provides an evaluation dataset centered on entity-based causal commonsense and explanations, with Wikidata-backed evidence availability to separate retrieval from reasoning; mainly an eval contribution rather than a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: CommonWhy: 15k entity-focused “why” questions targeting causal commonsense; also framed as a KGQA benchmark since required supporting knowledge is available in Wikidata.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, baselines, or quantitative results; likely compares multiple LLM and KGQA baselines (check main tables and annotation details).
summary_en.authors_note: From the University of Toronto.

recommendation.zh: 作为“因果 why + 实体”评测备查即可；除非你在做检索增强/因果解释对齐，否则不值得通读正文。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference benchmark for entity-centric causal “why” reasoning; not worth a full read unless you work on retrieval-augmented or explanation-aligned training.

paper.title: Measuring What Matters Beyond Text: Evaluating Multimodal Summaries by Quality, Alignment, and Diversity
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have facilitated Multimodal Summarization with Multimodal Output (MSMO), wherein systems generate concise textual summaries accompanied by salient visuals from multimodal sources. However, current MSMO evaluation remains fragmented: text quality, image-text alignment, and visual diversity are typically assessed in isolation using unimodal metrics, making it difficult to capture whether the modalities jointly support a faithful and useful summary. To addre

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 multimodal summarization with multimodal output 的自动评估问题：文本摘要质量、图像选择质量、图文对齐和视觉多样性过去通常被拆开评估，导致一个系统可能在单项指标上表现不错，但输出的图文组合并不真正连贯或有用。
summary.importance: 这篇对 LLM 基座预训练的相关性较弱，更接近多模态应用评测。可取的启发在于评估分解方式：多模态生成不能只看文本相似度或图片命中率，还需要显式评估跨模态支持关系和图像集合冗余度。对做 VLM 预训练或统一多模态建模的人来说，它提醒评估指标应覆盖 factuality、alignment、diversity 三类信号，但论文没有提出新的视觉 tokenizer、统一训练目标或多模态预训练机制。
summary.technical_approach: MM-Eval 由三个模块组成。第一，文本质量模块使用 OpenFActScore 做原子事实分解和验证，并使用 G-Eval 评估连贯性、流畅性和相关性。第二，跨模态对齐模块采用 MLLM-as-a-Judge，判断选出的图像是否语义上支持生成文本。第三，视觉多样性模块使用 Truncated CLIP Entropy，在 CLIP embedding 空间里度量图像集合的差异性，避免多张图表达重复信息。最终分数不是简单平均，而是在 mLLM-EVAL news benchmark 的人类评分上训练一个轻量加权模型。作者还指出新闻场景中人类偏好呈现文本主导结构：事实一致性是主要因素，视觉相关性和多样性在文本可靠的前提下提供补充信号。
summary.experiments: 论文主要验证 MM-Eval 与人类判断的一致性，并分析不同子指标的贡献。结果显示，新闻摘要评估中 factual consistency 对总质量判断影响最大，图文相关性和视觉多样性也被人工标注者认可，但其作用依赖于文本质量。相较 ROUGE、Image Precision、Image Recall 或直接使用 mLLM-Eval 让 GPT-4V 等模型整体打分，MM-Eval 的优势是更可解释、模块可替换、对参考答案依赖较弱。给出的全文片段未包含完整相关系数、回归权重或显著性数字，因此不宜补充具体数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议快速泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 metric design 和 human-alignment analysis，不必深读 MSMO 任务背景。对预训练研究员有用的部分是三类评价信号如何组合，以及为什么 Image Precision 这类 exact-match 指标会惩罚合理替代图像。若关注 VLM 评测，可进一步看 learned aggregation weights 是否能跨域迁移，以及 MLLM-as-a-Judge 的偏差控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses automatic evaluation for multimodal summarization with multimodal output. Existing protocols often score text quality, image selection, image-text alignment, and visual diversity in isolation. This can reward systems whose text and images look acceptable under separate metrics but do not form a coherent multimodal summary.
summary_en.importance: The connection to base-model pretraining is limited. The useful signal is about multimodal evaluation design: text overlap and exact image matching are not enough for assessing multimodal generation. For VLM pretraining or unified multimodal modeling, the paper is a reminder that evaluation should include factuality, cross-modal support, and redundancy among visual outputs. It does not introduce a new multimodal pretraining objective, tokenizer, or unified modeling architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: MM-Eval decomposes evaluation into three components. The text-quality component uses OpenFActScore to decompose summaries into atomic facts and verify them, and uses G-Eval for coherence, fluency, and relevance. The cross-modal alignment component uses an MLLM-as-a-Judge setup to assess whether the selected images semantically support the generated text. The visual-diversity component uses Truncated CLIP Entropy, which measures diversity of the selected image set in CLIP embedding space. The final score is produced by a lightweight learned weighting model trained on human ratings from the mLLM-EVAL news benchmark. The analysis suggests a text-dominant preference pattern in news: factual consistency drives most perceived quality, while visual relevance and diversity add signal when the text is already reliable.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section focuses on agreement with human judgments and on the contribution of each metric component. The reported pattern is that factual consistency is the strongest determinant of quality in news summarization, while image-text relevance and visual diversity are also valued by annotators. Compared with ROUGE, Image Precision, Image Recall, or black-box mLLM-Eval-style holistic judging, MM-Eval is more interpretable, modular, and weakly dependent on references. The provided full-content excerpt does not include complete correlation values, learned weights, or significance numbers, so specific numerical claims should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the metric design and the human-alignment analysis. The most relevant parts for pretraining researchers are how the paper separates factuality, cross-modal support, and visual redundancy, and why exact-match image selection metrics fail when multiple images are semantically valid. For VLM evaluation work, also check whether the learned aggregation weights transfer across domains and how the MLLM-as-a-Judge component controls bias.

recommendation.zh: 多模态摘要的统一评测工作，对多模态预训练的效果验证有参考价值，重点看评测指标设计的第3节即可。
recommendation.en: Unified evaluation work for multimodal summarization, with reference value for effect verification of multimodal pretraining; only need to read Section 3 on metric design.

paper.title: Measuring Five-Nines Reliability: Sample-Efficient LLM Evaluation in Saturated Benchmarks
paper.abstract: While existing benchmarks demonstrate the near-perfect performance of large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, this apparent saturation often obscures the need for rigorous evaluation of their reliability. In real-world deployment, however, achieving extremely high reliability (e.g., "five-nines" (99.999%) vs. "three-nines" (99.9%)) is fundamentally critical, as this gap results in an order-of-magnitude increase in failures, which is catastrophic in reliability-critical applications. Still

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM基准下模型性能看似饱和，无法高效估计极低失败概率（如五个九可靠性），标准蒙特卡洛评估所需推理量过大的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次利用LLM失败存在系统性模式的观测，提出样本高效的高可靠性LLM评估方法。
summary.technical_approach: 学习集中在高失败概率输入的采样分布，替代随机采样，大幅降低稀有失败概率估计所需的样本量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验结果，理论上可以在有限计算预算下实现高置信度的极低失败概率估计。
summary.authors_note: 来自卡内基梅隆大学，J. Zico Kolter为深度学习理论与系统领域知名研究员。

summary_en.core_problem: Solves the problem that LLM performance appears saturated on existing benchmarks, making it hard to estimate extremely low failure probability (e.g. five-nines reliability), standard Monte Carlo evaluation requires prohibitive inference cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first leverages the observation that LLM failures have strong systematic patterns to propose sample-efficient high-reliability LLM evaluation method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Learns a sampling distribution concentrated on high-failure-probability inputs to replace random sampling, drastically reduces sample size required for rare failure probability estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results are not disclosed in abstract, theoretically achieves high-confidence extremely low failure probability estimation under limited compute budget.
summary_en.authors_note: From Carnegie Mellon University, J. Zico Kolter is a well-known researcher in deep learning theory and systems.

recommendation.zh: 重点看高失败样本的采样策略设计部分，对预训练后高可靠性模型的评测方法有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: Focus on high-failure-sample sampling strategy design, directly valuable for evaluation methods of high-reliability LLM after pretraining.

paper.title: Formalize, Don't Optimize: The Heuristic Trap in LLM-Generated Combinatorial Solvers
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to solve complex combinatorial problems through direct reasoning, so recent neuro-symbolic systems increasingly use them to synthesize executable solvers. A central design question is how the LLM should represent the solver, and whether it should also attempt to optimize search. We introduce CP-SynC-XL, a benchmark of 100 combinatorial problems (4,577 instances), and evaluate three solver-construction paradigms: native algorithmic search (Python), constraint

summary.core_problem: 当用 LLM 生成“可执行的组合优化/约束求解器”时，应该让模型主要做形式化建模（formalize），还是同时让它去写启发式/优化搜索（optimize）；以及不同表示面（纯 Python 算法、Python 调 OR-Tools API、MiniZinc 声明式建模）对正确率与失败模式的影响。
summary.importance:
对预训练的启发主要在两点：
1) 表示面熟悉度（representation surface familiarity）比后端能力更关键：同一个 CP-SAT 后端，Python API 形式化显著优于 MiniZinc，说明模型的代码分布与训练语料覆盖会强烈支配“能否把问题写对”。这对 tokenizer/代码数据配比/语料覆盖与‘工具 API 作为建模语言’的中训策略有直接意义。
2) “让模型优化”会触发系统性失真（heuristic trap）：效率导向提示会诱导模型引入未经验证的界、近似或过度复杂约束，导致正确率回退且迭代修复也难消除。这对 RL/偏好优化阶段的奖励设计也有映射：一旦奖励把速度/启发式当成显性目标，模型可能学到不保真的捷径。
summary.technical_approach:
论文用一个 2×3 的受控设计：
- 三种 solver 构造范式（固定表示面）：(a) 纯 Python 自写搜索；(b) Python + OR-Tools（用 CP-SAT Python API 建模，把搜索交给求解器）；(c) MiniZinc + OR-Tools（声明式建模，再交给 OR-Tools）。后两者共享同一 CP-SAT 后端，从而把差异尽量归因到“建模语言/接口”而不是求解器能力。
- 两种提示词：baseline（只求正确） vs heuristic（要求效率/优化搜索）。

评测框架统一：LLM 生成“可复用的、与实例无关的 solver artefact”，运行时读入实例参数并输出标准格式；外部执行与校验负责判定正确性、超时、silent failure 等。论文强调 instance-level 分析：不仅看平均正确率，也看失败模式的分布与双峰现象（少量加速 vs 大幅回退）。

核心概念：
- representational divergence：不同表示面导致正确率系统性分叉。
- heuristic trap：效率导向提示触发的六类范式相关失败模式（文中描述为：引入不可靠界/近似、过拟合局部启发式、约束写错但看似更“聪明”、复杂化导致求解器退化或无解、以及迭代 refinement 仍保留错误结构等）。
summary.experiments:
数据与设置：CP-SynC-XL，100 个组合问题、4,577 个实例；模型为 GPT-5.3-Codex、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2。

主要结论（定性为主，论文在引言中给出方向性结果）：
- Python + OR-Tools 在所有 LLM 上正确率最高；MiniZinc + OR-Tools 覆盖率更低；纯 Python 原生搜索 silent failure 最高。
- heuristic 提示并不稳定优于 baseline：中位数可能略有加速，但收益呈双峰分布，且在较弱模型上可能出现“显著回退”。

建议读者在正文中重点核对：各范式的正确率/覆盖率差距、超时与 silent failure 的占比、以及 heuristic trap 六类失败模式各自贡献了多少回退（这些比单一平均分更能指导‘该让模型做什么’）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40-60 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1，把两条主线（representation divergence、heuristic trap）抓住。
- 精读 Method：它的受控变量设计做得比较干净，适合复用到“让 LLM 写可执行 artefact”的其他评测里。
- 重点看 failure mode 分析与按实例拆分的结果（通常在实验章节的分组图/表）：理解为什么 Python API 更稳、为什么 heuristic 提示会把错误结构固化。
- 如果只关心预训练启发：把注意力放在“模型对 API/DSL 的语料熟悉度”这一点，思考是否需要面向 OR-Tools/MiniZinc 这类形式化语言做持续预训练或中训覆盖。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM-synthesized combinatorial solvers, should the model focus on formalizing constraints or also try to optimize search with heuristics, and how does the choice of representation surface (native Python search vs Python OR-Tools API vs MiniZinc) affect correctness and failure modes?
summary_en.importance: The pretraining-relevant signal is about representation and incentives. First, correctness is dominated by the modeling surface the LLM is fluent in: Python + OR-Tools beats MiniZinc even with the same CP-SAT backend, implying that corpus coverage and code/API familiarity can matter more than the underlying algorithmic power. Second, prompting for efficiency triggers a ‘heuristic trap’: the model introduces unverified bounds/approximations or overcomplicated constraints that look clever but reduce fidelity. This mirrors reward-design pitfalls in post-training: optimizing for proxy metrics (speed/clever heuristics) can systematically trade off correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They run a controlled factorial study with two axes: (1) solver-construction paradigm (Python; Python + OR-Tools CP-SAT API; MiniZinc + OR-Tools), and (2) prompt (correctness-only baseline vs efficiency/heuristic-oriented). The two solver-backed paradigms share the same CP-SAT backend, isolating the effect of the representation surface.

Each LLM must generate a reusable solver artifact that reads instance parameters at runtime and outputs solutions in a fixed schema. An evaluation harness executes the artifact, validates outputs, and records correctness, timeouts, and silent failures. The paper emphasizes instance-level behavior and bimodality rather than only averages.

Key notions:
- Representational divergence: systematic correctness gaps driven by the modeling language/API.
- Heuristic trap: efficiency prompting induces recurring failure modes (e.g., unjustified bounds, local approximations, constraint overcomplication) that iterative refinement often fails to remove.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmark: CP-SynC-XL with 100 problems and 4,577 instances. Models: GPT-5.3-Codex, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2.

Main reported trends:
- Python + OR-Tools achieves the highest correctness across all tested LLMs; MiniZinc + OR-Tools has lower coverage; native Python has the highest silent-failure rate.
- Efficiency/heuristic prompting does not reliably improve outcomes: small median speedups can hide a bimodal distribution with sharp correctness regressions, especially for weaker models.

When reading the results, the most informative artifacts are the per-paradigm breakdowns of correctness/coverage, timeout vs silent-failure rates, and the attribution of regressions to specific heuristic-trap failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~40–60 min):
- Read the Introduction and the main figure to lock in the two claims (representation divergence, heuristic trap).
- Read the Method carefully; the controlled design is reusable for other ‘LLM writes executable artifact’ evaluations.
- Focus on the failure-mode analysis and instance-level plots/tables to understand why Python APIs are more robust and why heuristic prompting tends to fossilize wrong structure.
- If your angle is pretraining, translate the findings into data coverage questions: do you need continual/mid-training on solver APIs/DSLs, and how should you avoid training signals that reward “clever but wrong” heuristics?

recommendation.zh: 读 representation 对比即可；它提醒 coding agent 少写启发式搜索，多暴露可验证约束接口。
recommendation.en: Read the representation comparison; it argues for verifiable constraint interfaces over LLM-written heuristics.

paper.title: Vision2Code: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating Image-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Image-to-code generation tests whether a vision-language model (VLM) can recover the structure of an image enough to express it as executable code. Existing benchmarks either focus on narrow visual domains, depend on paired executable reference code, or rely on generic rubrics that miss domain-specific reconstruction errors. We introduce Vision2Code, a reference-code-free benchmark and evaluation framework for multi-domain image-to-code generation. Vision2Code contains 2,169 test examples from 1

summary.core_problem: 现有图像转代码benchmark覆盖视觉域窄、依赖配对参考代码、通用评估指标遗漏域特定重构错误，无法准确评测VLM的代码生成能力
summary.importance: 基准贡献，构建了首个无参考代码的多域图像转代码评测基准，提出了与人类判断对齐度更高的评估协议
summary.technical_approach: 整合15个源数据集共2169个测试样本，覆盖图表、几何、科学图像、文档、3D场景等6大类；模型生成代码后渲染为图像，用带领域定制规则的VLM打分器评估质量，同时分离代码执行失败与重构质量的诊断指标
summary.experiments: 人工验证显示评估协议与人类判断对齐度优于现有方法，完成了多个主流SOTA VLM的图像转代码能力基准测试
summary.authors_note: 杜克大学团队，Bhuwan Dhingra为NLP与多模态领域知名研究者，长期从事语义理解相关研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image-to-code benchmarks have narrow visual domain coverage, rely on paired reference code, and generic metrics miss domain-specific reconstruction errors, failing to accurately evaluate VLM code generation capability
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, builds the first reference-free multi-domain image-to-code evaluation benchmark, proposes an evaluation protocol with higher alignment with human judgment
summary_en.technical_approach: Integrates 15 source datasets with 2169 test samples covering 6 categories including charts, geometry, scientific imagery, documents, 3D scenes; renders generated code to images, evaluates quality with VLM rater with domain-specific rubrics, and separates diagnostic metrics for code execution failures and reconstruction quality
summary_en.experiments: Human validation shows the evaluation protocol aligns better with human judgment than existing methods, completes benchmark testing of image-to-code capability for multiple mainstream SOTA VLMs
summary_en.authors_note: Duke University team, Bhuwan Dhingra is a well-known researcher in NLP and multimodal fields, focusing on semantic understanding research

recommendation.zh: 作为图像转代码方向的基准资源，仅做评测参考备查，无需精读正文
recommendation.en: Serves as a benchmark reference for image-to-code tasks, only for evaluation reference, no need for in-depth reading

paper.title: No More, No Less: Task Alignment in Terminal Agents
paper.abstract: Terminal agents are increasingly capable of executing complex, long-horizon tasks autonomously from a single user prompt. To do so, they must interpret instructions encountered in the environment (e.g., README files, code comments, stack traces) and determine their relevance to the task. This creates a fundamental challenge: relevant cues must be followed to complete a task, whereas irrelevant or misleading ones must be ignored. Existing benchmarks do not capture this ability. An agent may appea

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评测 terminal agent 在执行任务时能否选择性使用环境信息：该跟随的 cue 要用，不相关的 distractor 要忽略。核心问题不是普通的任务完成率，也不是简单的 prompt injection 防御，而是 agent 在 README、日志、注释、配置文件等混杂信息里判断哪些内容服务于用户目标。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 agent 后训练和评测有清晰启发。它指出了一个常见评测盲区：模型完成任务，不代表它正确理解了任务边界；模型拒绝环境指令，也不代表它能解决真实任务。对于训练 terminal agent 或 coding agent，这意味着数据和 reward 不能只看最终 pass/fail，还需要区分 cue utilization 和 distraction resistance，否则容易训练出两类坏行为：盲从环境，或屏蔽环境。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 TAB，即 Task Alignment Benchmark。构造方式很直接：从 Terminal-Bench 2.1 选取 89 个任务，把原始用户指令中完成任务所需的一部分信息删掉，形成欠指定任务；再把被删掉的信息作为必要 cue 放回环境 artifact 中，例如 README、配置文件或其他工作区文件。同时，在同一个 artifact 中加入一个看起来合理但与用户目标无关的 distractor。这样可以区分三种能力：能否发现 cue，能否利用 cue 完成任务，能否不执行 distractor。论文把 task alignment 拆成两个指标：cue utilization 衡量看到必要线索后能否完成任务；distraction resistance 衡量是否避免执行无关指令。这个设计比单纯的安全攻击测试更贴近 terminal agent，因为真实环境里有些信息确实必须被读取和使用。
summary.experiments: 实验评测了 10 个前沿 terminal agents 和 6 类限制环境指令跟随的防御方法。关键发现是任务能力和 task alignment 明显分离。论文给出的例子中，GPT-5.5 在 cue utilization 上表现强，但由于 distraction resistance 低，task alignment 只有 23%。Claude Opus 4.7 的 task alignment 达到 72%，主要来自更好的 distractor 抵抗能力。防御实验也说明，简单压制环境指令会同时压低必要 cue 的使用率。也就是说，过度拒绝和过度服从都会失败，评测需要同时看完成任务和是否越界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 task alignment 的定义，以及 Measuring Task Alignment 中 cue、distractor、cue utilization、distraction resistance 的形式化方式。实验部分优先看不同 agent 的二维结果，而不是只看单一平均分；防御方法的结果也值得看，因为它展示了为什么 prompt-level 或 policy-level 的简单过滤不能解决这个问题。若关心 agent RL 或 coding agent 数据构造，可以重点看任务变换流程，思考如何把这种信号纳入训练 reward。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether terminal agents can selectively use information found during execution. A capable agent must follow task-relevant cues in files, logs, stack traces, or READMEs, while ignoring unrelated directives placed in the same environment. The target behavior is neither unconditional instruction following nor blanket refusal of environmental instructions.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to agent evaluation and post-training than to base-model pretraining. Its main value is diagnostic: task success alone can hide poor task alignment. An agent may pass by obeying every instruction it sees, or look robust by ignoring the environment and failing underspecified tasks. For training coding or terminal agents, this suggests that pass/fail reward is too coarse; the training signal should separate useful cue usage from over-compliance with irrelevant instructions.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAB is built by transforming 89 tasks from Terminal-Bench 2.1. For each task, the authors remove required information from the user instruction, making the prompt intentionally underspecified. The missing information is then reintroduced as a necessary cue inside an environmental artifact. The same artifact also contains a plausible but irrelevant distractor. The benchmark measures two components: cue utilization, which captures whether the agent can solve the task after observing the necessary cue, and distraction resistance, which captures whether it avoids carrying out the irrelevant directive. This construction forces agents to interpret context rather than simply trust or reject it.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates ten frontier terminal agents and six defenses intended to restrict environmental instruction following. The main result is that raw task capability and task alignment can diverge sharply. In the reported example, GPT-5.5 has the strongest cue utilization among the evaluated systems but only 23% task alignment because it often follows distractors. Claude Opus 4.7 reaches 72% task alignment, largely due to stronger distraction resistance. Defense results show a similar tradeoff: methods that suppress distractor execution often suppress the necessary cues as well.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the problem definition and benchmark construction carefully, especially the distinction between cues and distractors. Then inspect the agent comparison tables or plots that separate cue utilization from distraction resistance. The defense section is useful for understanding why simple instruction-filtering strategies are insufficient. For agent post-training work, the most useful part is the task transformation recipe, which can inform reward design and synthetic data construction.

recommendation.zh: 专注Agent指令对齐的基准工作，对预训练研究员仅可作为后训练对齐效果的评测参考，读基准设计部分即可。
recommendation.en: Benchmark work focused on agent instruction alignment; for pretraining researchers, it only serves as a reference for post-training alignment evaluation, just read the benchmark design section.

institutions: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
ELLIS Institute Tübingen and MPI for Intelligent Systems

paper.title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is crucial for agents in specialized web environments, where success depends on recalling interface affordances, state dynamics, workflows, and recurring failure modes. However, existing memory benchmarks for agents mostly focus on user histories, short traces, or downstream task success, leaving open how to directly evaluate whether memory systems effectively internalize environment-specific experience. To address this gap, we introduce LongMemEval-V2 (LME-V2), a benchmark for

summary.core_problem: 评估长期记忆系统是否能让 web agent 内化特定环境中的界面、状态变化、工作流和常见失败经验。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 长期记忆 benchmark。它把评测目标从短历史问答或最终任务成功率，转向“是否像有经验同事一样理解环境”，覆盖更接近真实 agent 部署的环境知识积累问题。
summary.technical_approach: LongMemEval-V2 设计了 context gathering 形式：记忆系统先从大量历史轨迹中检索或组织相关上下文，再回答人工标注的问题。问题覆盖静态状态回忆、动态状态追踪、工作流知识、环境陷阱、前提意识五类记忆能力。
summary.experiments: benchmark 包含 451 个手工整理问题，每个问题配有最多 500 条历史轨迹，总历史规模可达 115M tokens。摘要未给出具体 agent/memory baseline 的得分或模型规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of California；Nanyun Peng 和 Kai-Wei Chang 长期做 NLP、信息抽取、评测与可信语言模型相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether long-term memory systems help web agents internalize environment-specific interfaces, state dynamics, workflows, and recurring failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a long-term memory benchmark for agents. It shifts evaluation away from short user histories or final task success toward whether an agent can become an experienced colleague in a customized environment.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongMemEval-V2 uses a context-gathering formulation: the memory system retrieves or organizes relevant evidence from historical trajectories before answering curated questions. The questions cover static state recall, dynamic state tracking, workflow knowledge, environment gotchas, and premise awareness.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 451 manually curated questions with history pools of up to 500 trajectories and 115M tokens. The provided abstract does not include baseline scores, model sizes, or system-level results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of California; Nanyun Peng and Kai-Wei Chang are known for work in NLP, information extraction, evaluation, and trustworthy language systems.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory 评测，不是基座训练；只看任务定义和五类能力划分，可作为长上下文评测备查。
recommendation.en: This is agent-memory evaluation, not foundation training; read the task definition and five ability axes, then file it for long-context evals.

paper.title: MMTB: Evaluating Terminal Agents on Multimedia-File Tasks
paper.abstract: Terminals provide a powerful interface for AI agents by exposing diverse tools for automating complex workflows, yet existing terminal-agent benchmarks largely focus on tasks grounded in text, code, and structured files. However, many real-world workflows require practitioners to work directly with audio and video files. Working with such multimedia files calls for terminal agents not only to understand multimedia content, but also to convert auditory and visual evidence across related files int

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 terminal agent benchmark 几乎只覆盖文本/代码文件，缺少对音视频文件操作能力的系统评测。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 与评测基础设施工作，不是新的 agent 范式；价值在于把多媒体文件处理纳入 terminal-agent 评测闭环，对通用工具使用 agent 有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MMTB，包含 105 个需要直接处理音频和视频文件的终端任务；同时给出 Terminus-MM，把音视频感知能力接入现有 terminal harness，用于受控比较不同 agent 配置。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体最强 baseline 和数值，但强调 benchmark 覆盖 5 个 meta-categories，并分析不同形式的多媒体感知如何影响终端任务表现。更适合看任务设计与 failure mode，而不是追结果榜单。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of terminal-agent benchmarks that require direct interaction with audio and video files rather than only text, code, or structured files.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-harness contribution rather than a new agent paradigm; its value is in extending terminal-agent evaluation to multimedia workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MMTB, a 105-task benchmark over five meta-categories, and Terminus-MM, a multimedia extension of a terminal-agent harness that adds audio/video perception for controlled studies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed baselines or headline numbers, but frames the benchmark as a way to study how different forms of multimedia perception affect terminal-agent performance. The main value is likely in task design and failure analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 agent 范式创新，但 benchmark 选题是对的；只看任务 taxonomy 和 error breakdown，别在总分上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not an agent-method breakthrough, but the benchmark target is sensible; read the task taxonomy and failure breakdown, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: Do Joint Audio-Video Generation Models Understand Physics?
paper.abstract: Joint audio-video generation models are rapidly approaching professional production quality, raising a central question: do they understand audio-visual physics, or merely generate plausible sounds and frames that violate real-world consistency? We introduce AV-Phys Bench, a benchmark for evaluating physical commonsense in joint audio-video generation. AV-Phys Bench tests models across three scene categories: Steady State, Event Transition, and Environment Transition. It covers physics-grounded

summary.core_problem: 评估联合音视频生成模型是否真正满足物理一致性，而不只是生成语义上 plausible 的画面和声音。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 Benchmark。AV-Phys Bench 把音视频生成从单模态质量、语义对齐，推进到跨模态物理常识评估，尤其加入了刻意违反物理规律的 Anti-AV-Physics prompts，用来测试模型是否会盲从提示。
summary.technical_approach: 构建三类场景：Steady State、Event Transition、Environment Transition，并细分为现实场景中的物理子类。每个生成结果从五个维度打分：视觉语义遵循、音频语义遵循、视觉物理常识、音频物理常识、跨模态物理常识。
summary.experiments: 评测了 3 个闭源模型和 4 个开源模型。摘要报告 Seedance 2.0 综合表现最好，但所有模型距离稳定的物理理解仍有明显差距，尤其在跨模态物理一致性和反物理提示抵抗上不稳。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Texas at Dallas、University of Washington、University of California。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether joint audio-video generation models obey physical consistency, rather than merely producing plausible-looking videos and sounds.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a benchmark. AV-Phys Bench shifts evaluation from perceptual quality and semantic alignment toward audio-visual physical commonsense, including Anti-AV-Physics prompts that deliberately request impossible cross-modal behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark covers three scene types: Steady State, Event Transition, and Environment Transition. Generations are scored along five axes: visual semantic adherence, audio semantic adherence, visual physical commonsense, audio physical commonsense, and cross-modal physical commonsense.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate three proprietary and four open-source joint audio-video generation models. Seedance 2.0 performs best overall in the reported results, but all models remain far from robust physical understanding, especially under cross-modal and anti-physics conditions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Texas at Dallas, University of Washington, and University of California.

recommendation.zh: 作为音视频生成评测可备查；对 pretrain 的价值主要在反物理 prompt 设计，不必读完整方法。
recommendation.en: Useful as an audio-video generation benchmark reference; for pretraining work, the main signal is the anti-physics prompt design, not the full paper.

paper.title: GSM-SEM: Benchmark and Framework for Generating Semantically Variant Augmentations
paper.abstract: Benchmarks like GSM8K are popular measures of mathematical reasoning, but leaderboard gains can overstate true capability due to memorization of fixed test sets. Most robustness variants apply surface-level perturbations (paraphrases, renamings, number swaps, distractors) that largely preserve the underlying facts, and static releases can themselves become memorization targets over time. We introduce GSM-SEM, a reusable and stochastic framework for generating semantically diverse benchmark varia

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是数学推理 benchmark 的“静态评测失真”问题。像 GSM8K 这样的数据集被长期反复使用后，分数越来越难区分真实推理能力、训练污染和模板记忆。已有鲁棒性变体多是表层扰动，比如改写措辞、改名、换数字、加干扰项，但底层事实关系和计算骨架通常不变，因此更像在测表述不变性，而不是语义条件变化下的重新求解能力。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对数据质量和评测信号有现实启发。第一，它提醒人们不要把静态 benchmark 提升直接等同于 reasoning 提升，尤其是在公开数据被大规模吸收进训练语料之后。第二，它提供了一种可重复生成、带随机性的语义扰动框架，适合做持续评测，减少固定测试集被记住后的失真。第三，对做合成数据、蒸馏数据、RL 训练信号设计的人来说，这篇工作也有参考价值：如果训练或评测样本只做表层改写，模型可能学到的是模板对齐而不是语义重算。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 GSM-SEM 生成管线。作者希望生成“语义变化更大，但答案和计算保持不变”的新题目，因此设计了两条互补的生成路径。

第一条路径以原题问题 q 和答案 a 为条件，让 LLM 反向构造一个新问题 q~，要求保留原有数值计算和最终答案，但允许场景、实体、属性、关系发生较大变化。这样做的好处是语义变化空间更大，但更容易失控。

第二条路径更保守：固定原题中的数值，要求 LLM 改写场景和主题，从而保留计算结构，同时增加叙事层面的语义差异。两条路径分别覆盖“多样性更强”和“约束更强”的两端，组合后可以减少单一路径的失败模式。

生成后，作者加入了多层过滤。先用规则验证器检查新题中的数值是否与原题一致，避免答案失效。再基于词频向量的 cosine similarity 做去重和相似度过滤：如果候选与原题相似度超过 0.85 就丢弃；同时还做集合级去重，避免保留下来的多个变体彼此过近。为了让自动验证器更接近人工标准，作者先让两位人工审阅者标注 70 个随机样本的质量与逻辑一致性，再据此工程化一个 judge LLM prompt，用于调参和筛选。

从方法定位看，这不是一个新的推理模型，而是一个 benchmark generation framework。它的技术价值在于把“语义变体生成”做成可复用、可随机重采样、且尽量不需要重新人工标注答案的流程。与传统 paraphrase benchmark 的区别，在于它明确追求 underlying facts 的变化，而不仅是表面措辞变化。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主结论是：14 个当前模型家族在 GSM-SEM 变体上都出现了稳定退化，而且当语义扰动与 GSM-Symbolic、GSM-Plus 这类更强变体叠加时，失败会进一步放大。摘要和正文给出的重点不是某个模型的绝对分数，而是这种退化具有一致性，说明很多高分模型仍然依赖原始 benchmark 的熟悉度，而不是稳健的语义重算能力。

作者还发布了三套人工验证后的 benchmark：GSM8K-SEM、GSM-Symbolic-SEM、GSM-Plus-SEM，并把框架扩展到 BigBenchHard、LogicBench、NLR-BIRD 的非 GSM 样本，说明方法不只适用于小学数学题模板。对阅读者来说，更值得看的是人工验证和自动过滤的质量控制细节：如果这些环节不严，所谓“语义变化”很容易退化成噪声或错误样本。

由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，能确认的实验信息主要是：评测覆盖 14 个 SOTA LLM；比较对象包括原始 benchmark 与 GSM-SEM 变体；并考察了与 symbolic/plus 变体叠加后的性能下降。若要进一步判断结论强度，需要查看正文表格里不同模型、不同 strictness 设置、不同生成路径下的具体降幅，以及人工评审一致性指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不需要逐段深挖模型细节。优先看 Introduction，先确认作者要修正的是哪类 benchmark 偏差。然后看 Figure 2 和方法部分，理解两条生成路径分别控制什么，以及为什么要同时保留答案、计算和较高语义差异。

实验部分重点看三类内容：1）不同模型在原始集与 SEM 变体上的降幅；2）人工验证质量；3）与 GSM-Symbolic、GSM-Plus 叠加后的结果。如果你关心评测污染、数据合成或 reasoning benchmark 设计，这篇 20-30 分钟可以读完主线。若只是做预训练方法研究，可以把它当作“评测信号质量”材料来读，不必投入太多时间在具体 prompt 模板上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmark validity problem rather than a modeling problem. Widely used math reasoning sets such as GSM8K are increasingly poor diagnostics of true reasoning ability because repeated public use makes them vulnerable to memorization, contamination, and benchmark-specific shortcuts. Existing robustness variants mostly apply surface perturbations—paraphrases, renamings, number swaps, distractors—while preserving the same factual backbone and relational structure. That tests invariance to wording more than the ability to recompute under changed semantic conditions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to data quality and evaluation. First, it is a useful reminder that gains on static public benchmarks should not be read as clean evidence of improved reasoning, especially once those benchmarks and their derivatives have likely entered large training mixtures. Second, the paper proposes a reusable stochastic framework for generating fresh semantic variants, which is a practical way to reduce evaluation staleness over time. Third, it has implications for synthetic data and post-training pipelines: if training or evaluation data only differ at the surface level, models may learn template alignment rather than semantic recomputation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core contribution is the GSM-SEM generation pipeline. The goal is to create semantically different variants while preserving the original answer and underlying computation.

To do that, the authors use two complementary generation strategies. In the first, an LLM is prompted with the original question q and answer a to reverse-engineer a new question q~ that preserves the same numerical computation and final answer but allows substantial changes in entities, attributes, relations, and scenario. This route offers more semantic freedom but also more room for failure.

In the second, the model is asked to keep all numerical values fixed while changing the scenario or theme. This is a more constrained transformation that preserves the computational structure while still increasing semantic diversity. The two streams cover different points on the diversity–control tradeoff, and combining them reduces the failure modes of either one alone.

The pipeline then applies several filters. A rule-based verifier checks that the numbers in the generated question match those in the original, so the answer remains valid. Similarity filtering based on cosine similarity over term-frequency vectors removes candidates that are too close to the source sample, using a threshold of 0.85, and set-level deduplication prevents near-duplicate variants from being retained together. To calibrate the automated validator, the authors first had two human reviewers assess 70 random augmented samples for quality and logical coherence, then used those judgments to engineer an LLM-judge prompt for tuning the pipeline.

Methodologically, this is a benchmark-generation framework, not a new reasoning model. Its main technical value is making semantic benchmark variation reusable, stochastic, and answer-preserving without requiring full re-annotation each time.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that 14 contemporary LLMs show consistent performance drops on GSM-SEM variants relative to the original benchmarks, and the failures become larger when semantic perturbations are combined with stronger variants such as GSM-Symbolic and GSM-Plus. The important point is not the absolute score of any single model, but the consistency of the degradation across model families. That suggests many high benchmark scores still rely partly on familiarity with the original benchmark distribution rather than robust semantic recomputation.

The paper also releases three human-validated benchmark sets: GSM8K-SEM, GSM-Symbolic-SEM, and GSM-Plus-SEM. In addition, the framework is applied to non-GSM samples from BigBenchHard, LogicBench, and NLR-BIRD, which supports the claim that the approach is not tied to one narrow dataset template.

From the available full-text excerpt, the most important experimental details are the breadth of model coverage, the comparison between original and SEM variants, and the quality-control pipeline involving human validation plus automated filtering. The exact per-model numbers are not visible in the provided text, so a full judgment would require checking the tables for drop magnitudes, strictness settings, generation-path differences, and inter-annotator agreement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to understand the benchmark pathology it is trying to fix. Then read the pipeline section and Figure 2 carefully enough to see what the two generation routes control and why preserving both the answer and the computation matters.

In the experiments, focus on three things: (1) score drops from original benchmarks to SEM variants across model families, (2) the human validation and filtering quality, and (3) the compounded effect when SEM is combined with GSM-Symbolic or GSM-Plus. If your interests include benchmark contamination, synthetic data, or reasoning evaluation design, the main thread can be read in about 20–30 minutes. If your focus is core pretraining, treat it as an evaluation-signal paper rather than something to study in full detail.

recommendation.zh: 只看它如何约束“语义改写但保持计算/答案”的生成管线；如果你在做推理评测或训练数据去污染，这个框架比换皮 paraphrase 更靠谱。
recommendation.en: Focus on the pipeline that enforces semantic edits while preserving computation/answer; if you care about reasoning eval or decontamination, this is more meaningful than paraphrase-style robustness.

paper.title: Uneven Evolution of Cognition Across Generations of Generative AI Models
paper.abstract: The pursuit of artificial general intelligence necessitates robust methods for evaluating the cognitive capabilities of models beyond narrow task performance. Here, we introduce a psychometric framework to assess the cognitive profiles of generative AI, comparing them to human norms and tracking their evolution across generations. Initial evaluation of leading multimodal models using tasks adapted from the Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale revealed a profoundly uneven cognitive architecture: nea

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决的是：现有大模型评测过度依赖任务分数，难以刻画模型内部能力结构的强弱分布。作者用人类心理测量框架先做基线诊断，再构造面向 AI 的 AIQ Benchmark，以避免人类量表在强模型上出现天花板效应、在弱视觉推理项上出现地板效应。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更像是能力诊断工具。但它有一个有用信号：当前多模态模型的语言理解、工作记忆类能力已经在人类常模上接近上限，而视觉-知觉推理仍然很弱。这对 native multimodal pretraining 有启发，说明仅靠图文对齐和语言侧推理能力，并不自动带来稳健的几何、空间、结构推理能力。它也提醒评测设计需要区分语言包装能力和底层感知推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步改造 WAIS-IV 成人智力量表中的部分子测验，覆盖 Verbal Comprehension、Perceptual Reasoning、Working Memory 三类能力；需要手部操作或书写速度的 Processing Speed 子项被排除。被测模型包括 GPT-4 Turbo、GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Flash/Pro、Claude 3 Opus、Claude 3.5 Sonnet。题目被转成文本或多模态 prompt，由临床心理学训练背景的评分者按 WAIS-IV 标准评分。第二步构造 AIQ Benchmark。它保留 WAIS 的能力分区思路，但题目用程序化方式生成，难度可以超过人类常模范围。可见设计包括：基于 SUBTLEX-US 词频采样的低频词词汇题；把欠定线性方程组转写成天平叙事的 verbal algebraic reasoning；以及图像版 algebraic reasoning、matrix reasoning、picture completion、working memory 等对应子测验。核心取舍是：不用单一总分，而是用多维能力剖面暴露模型短板。
summary.experiments: WAIS-IV 改造评测给出一个清晰结果：领先多模态模型在 Verbal Comprehension 和 Working Memory 上达到或超过人类常模第 98 百分位，但在 Perceptual Reasoning 上低于第 1 百分位。这个结果支持作者的主要观察：模型能力演化不均匀，语言和短程符号操作明显强于视觉结构推理。AIQ 部分的设计目标是解决 WAIS 的上下限问题，通过模型间分布归一化来追踪后续代际差异；提供的正文片段没有包含完整 AIQ 分数表和逐模型数值，因此不宜夸大其定量结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Methods 中 WAIS-IV 适配方式和 AIQ Benchmark 的题目生成机制，尤其是 verbal algebraic reasoning 为什么采用欠定线性系统，以及 vocabulary 为什么用低频词控制难度。若关心多模态预训练评测，可以重点看 Perceptual Reasoning 的失败模式；它比总分更有信息量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to measure the cognitive profile of generative AI models beyond aggregate task performance. It first adapts human psychometric tests, then introduces an AI-oriented benchmark to avoid ceiling effects on language-heavy tests and floor effects on perceptual reasoning tests.
summary_en.importance: The work is more useful as an evaluation diagnostic than as a pretraining method. Its main signal for foundation-model research is the imbalance it exposes: current multimodal models can look extremely strong on verbal comprehension and working-memory-style tasks while remaining weak on perceptual and structural visual reasoning. This matters for multimodal pretraining because language-side reasoning and image-text alignment do not by themselves guarantee robust spatial or geometric reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation has two stages. First, selected WAIS-IV subtests are adapted for AI models, covering verbal comprehension, perceptual reasoning, and working memory. Processing-speed tasks that require graphomotor interaction are excluded. The evaluated models include GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Flash/Pro, Claude 3 Opus, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Items are converted into text or multimodal prompts and scored according to WAIS-IV criteria by trained clinical psychologists. Second, the authors build the AIQ Benchmark, which keeps the psychometric decomposition but replaces fixed human-normed items with procedurally generated, scalable tests. Visible components include rare-word vocabulary questions sampled using SUBTLEX-US frequencies, verbal algebraic reasoning based on underdetermined linear systems expressed as balance-scale narratives, and visual analogues for matrix reasoning, picture completion, figure weights, and working memory.
summary_en.experiments: The clearest quantitative result comes from the adapted WAIS-IV evaluation. Leading multimodal models score at or above the 98th percentile on verbal comprehension and working memory, while falling below the 1st percentile on perceptual reasoning. This supports the claim that current model development is uneven across cognitive domains. The AIQ benchmark is designed to track model generations beyond human-normed limits, but the provided full-text excerpt does not include complete AIQ score tables or per-model numerical breakdowns, so the strongest evidence remains the WAIS-stage profile.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read is enough, roughly 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Methods section: how WAIS-IV is adapted, how scoring is handled, and how AIQ items are procedurally generated. For multimodal pretraining researchers, the most relevant part is the perceptual-reasoning failure mode, because it points to a gap that conventional language-centric benchmarks can hide.

recommendation.zh: 认知能力不均衡的结论可指导多模态预训练的模态配比 ablation，重点看Fig 2的能力拆解
recommendation.en: Uneven cognitive capability findings can guide multimodal pretraining modality ratio ablation, focus on Fig 2 for capability breakdown

paper.title: Delulu: A Verified Multi-Lingual Benchmark for Code Hallucination Detection in Fill-in-the-Middle Tasks
paper.abstract: Large Language Models for code generation frequently produce hallucinations in Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) tasks -- plausible but incorrect completions such as invented API methods, invalid parameters, undefined variables, or non-existent imports. These failures pass superficial review yet introduce runtime errors. We introduce Delulu, a verified multi-lingual benchmark of 1,951 FIM samples across 7 languages and 4 hallucination types. Samples are curated through an adversarial pipeline: a frontier

summary.core_problem: 现有代码补全（FIM）任务基准仅覆盖Python单一语言，缺少细粒度幻觉分类、执行验证和难度校准，无法可靠衡量代码大模型的幻觉生成率，同时当前大模型作为评审的FIM幻觉检测准确率也处于较低水平。
summary.importance: 为代码大模型FIM能力评测提供了多语言、细分类、执行验证的基准，可支撑FIM预训练目标优化和幻觉检测模块开发。
summary.technical_approach: 构建Delulu基准，包含7种编程语言共1951个FIM样本，覆盖4类幻觉（方法、参数、未定义变量、导入）。通过五阶段对抗流程构建样本：Claude Sonnet生成幻觉样本、4款不同大模型评审、嵌入聚类挖掘难例、跨语言难度均衡采样、Docker执行验证，最后人工校验去除简单或有偏样本。
summary.experiments: 评测11个参数量0.5B到32B的开源代码模型，Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 32B最高达到84.5% pass@1，仍有约14%的样本出现幻觉。顶尖评审模型的双正确准确率（正确接受黄金补全、正确拒绝幻觉补全）仅56%-90%，导入类幻觉骗过所有模型的比例超过40%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节基准构建流程、第4节实验结果、附录的幻觉分类表，预计阅读时间15分钟，无需细读非核心推导内容。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) code benchmarks are mostly Python-only, lack fine-grained hallucination categorization, execution verification and difficulty calibration, which makes it impossible to reliably measure hallucination rates of code LLMs, while current frontier LLMs also have low accuracy as hallucination detectors for FIM tasks.
summary_en.importance: Delulu provides a multi-lingual, category-aware, execution-verified benchmark for FIM hallucination evaluation, which supports optimization of FIM pre-training objectives and hallucination detection module development.
summary_en.technical_approach: Delulu contains 1,951 FIM samples across 7 programming languages, covering 4 hallucination types (method, parameter, undefined variable, import. It is constructed via a 5-stage adversarial pipeline: hallucination generation by Claude Sonnet, multi-model judging by 4 diverse LLMs, embedding clustering to mine hard examples, difficulty-balanced sampling across languages, Docker-based execution verification, and final human review to remove trivial or biased samples.
summary_en.experiments: 11 open-source code models with parameters ranging from 0.5B to 32B are evaluated. Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 32B achieves a maximum 84.5% pass@1, still hallucinating on ~14% of samples. The best judge model only reaches 56%-90% both-correct accuracy, and import hallucinations fool all models at a rate over 40%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (benchmark construction pipeline), Section 4 (experimental results), and hallucination taxonomy table in appendix. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes, no need to read non-core derivation parts.

recommendation.zh: 把“代码幻觉”定义成可复现的运行失败而非主观打分，评测口径更干净；只读数据构建流程和按语言/错误类型的分解表就够。
recommendation.en: It pins “code hallucination” to reproducible compile/runtime failures instead of subjective judging; read the dataset construction and the per-language/error-type breakdown tables.

paper.title: Learning Agent Routing From Early Experience
paper.abstract: LLM agents achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks but incur high latency and compute cost. In practice, many queries fall within the capability boundary of cutting-edge LLMs and do not require full agent execution, making effective routing between LLMs and agents a key challenge. We study the problem of routing queries between lightweight LLM inference and full agent execution under realistic cold-start settings. To address this, we propose BoundaryRouter, a training-free routing

summary.core_problem: 解决在冷启动条件下，如何在轻量 LLM 直接回答与高成本 agent 执行之间做路由，以降低延迟和计算成本。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 系统与 benchmark 工作，不是基座预训练；价值在于把“LLM vs agent”的能力边界路由问题单独形式化，并给出更现实的 cold-start 设定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练免费框架 BoundaryRouter：先在共享 seed set 上同时运行 LLM 与 agent，收集早期行为经验，构建紧凑记忆库；推理时检索相似案例，并结合 rubric-guided reasoning 判断当前 query 是否应升级到 agent。另提出 RouteBench，覆盖域内、改写和域外路由设置。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 RouteBench 上评估，并在冷启动场景下优于若干基线；但未给出具体模型、任务数、成本节省比例和准确率提升幅度。可确认其 benchmark 设计包含 OOD 路由，而不是只做 in-domain。
summary.authors_note: Princeton University、University of Michigan、上海交通大学、University of Edinburgh、King’s College London。Princeton AI Lab 背景使其在 agent 系统与决策方法上有一定可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cold-start routing between cheap direct LLM inference and expensive full agent execution to reduce latency and compute.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-systems and benchmark contribution rather than a pretraining paper. Its main value is in formalizing the LLM-vs-agent routing problem under realistic cold-start conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: BoundaryRouter is a training-free router that gathers early behavioral experience by running both the base LLM and the agent on a shared seed set, stores a compact memory, and uses retrieval plus rubric-guided reasoning to decide whether to escalate a query to the agent. The paper also introduces RouteBench with in-domain, paraphrased, and out-of-domain routing settings.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims strong results on RouteBench under cold-start settings, but does not provide concrete model names, task counts, cost reductions, or accuracy gains. It does indicate evaluation beyond in-domain routing.
summary_en.authors_note: Princeton University, University of Michigan, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, University of Edinburgh, and King’s College London. The Princeton AI Lab affiliation adds credibility on agent-system design.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 RouteBench 这个问题设定比很多 agent paper 干净；若你关心系统级 compute allocation，可只看 benchmark 定义和路由特征。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the RouteBench setup looks cleaner than most agent work; if you care about system-level compute allocation, read the benchmark definition and routing signals.

paper.title: When Routine Chats Turn Toxic: Unintended Long-Term State Poisoning in Personalized Agents
paper.abstract: Personalized LLM agents maintain persistent cross-session state to support long-horizon collaboration. Yet, this persistence introduces a subtle but critical security vulnerability: routine user-agent interactions can gradually reshape an agent's long-term state, inadvertently weakening future confirmation boundaries, expanding tool-use defaults, and escalating autonomous behavior over time. We formalize this risk as \textbf{unintended long-term state poisoning}. To systematically study it, we i

summary.core_problem: 研究个性化 agent 的持久跨会话状态会如何在日常交互中被逐步“污染”，导致授权边界、工具使用和自主性长期漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是安全 benchmark 与问题定义。它把一次性 prompt injection 之外的慢性状态污染单独提出，并给出状态中心的 Harm Score，这对长期记忆 agent 的训练和评测都有参考价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化 unintended long-term state poisoning，构建 ULSPB：覆盖 5 类助手场景、7 种交互模式、24 轮 routine interaction，并配有 matched single-injection 对照。评测指标 Harm Score 分解为 authorization drift、tool-use escalation、unchecked autonomy 三部分，用于量化长期状态偏移的风险。
summary.experiments: 在 OpenClaw 上评测 4 个 backbone LLM。摘要表明长期、日常式交互能比单次注入更隐蔽地改变后续行为边界，但未在摘要中给出具体模型名和完整数值。实验价值主要在 benchmark 设计和对照设置，而不是算法突破。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学、香港科技大学及港科大（广州）。属于 agent 安全与长期记忆评测方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how persistent cross-session state in personalized agents can be gradually poisoned through routine interactions, causing long-term drift in authorization boundaries, tool use, and autonomy.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a security benchmark and problem formulation. It isolates chronic state poisoning from one-shot prompt injection and introduces a state-centric Harm Score. This matters for long-memory agents, though it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize unintended long-term state poisoning and build ULSPB, a bilingual benchmark spanning five assistant categories, seven interaction patterns, 24-turn routine interactions, and matched single-injection controls. Harm Score decomposes risk into authorization drift, tool-use escalation, and unchecked autonomy.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate on OpenClaw with four backbone LLMs. The abstract suggests that routine long-horizon interactions can more subtly reshape future behavior than single injections, though the abstract does not provide the full model list or detailed numbers. The value is mostly in the benchmark design and control setup rather than a new algorithm.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, HKUST, and HKUST (Guangzhou). The work sits in agent safety and long-term memory evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但做长期记忆 agent 或 continual post-train 的人该记住这个 failure mode；读 benchmark 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you work on long-memory agents or continual post-training, this failure mode is worth knowing; the benchmark design is the main thing to read.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
⋄Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, HKUST (Guangzhou)

paper.title: Safe, or Simply Incapable? Rethinking Safety Evaluation for Phone-Use Agents
paper.abstract: When a phone-use agent avoids harm, does that show safety, or simply inability to act? Existing evaluations often cannot tell. A harmful outcome may be avoided because the agent recognized the risk and chose the safe action, or because it failed to understand the screen or execute any relevant action at all. These cases have different causes and call for different fixes, yet current benchmarks often merge them under task success, refusal, or final harmful outcome. We address this problem with Ph

summary.core_problem: 现有手机Agent安全评估无法区分'主动识别风险并做出安全选择'和'因能力不足未能执行相关操作'，两种情况成因迥异却被合并统计。
summary.importance: 首次明确提出并量化了Agent安全评估中的'能力 vs 安全'混淆问题，贡献了PhoneSafety benchmark用于隔离评测关键时刻的安全决策。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含700个安全关键时刻的PhoneSafety benchmark（来自真实手机交互，覆盖130+app），每个实例隔离出风险时刻的下一步决策，评估模型选择：安全动作/危险动作/无有效动作。
summary.experiments: 评估8个代表性手机Agent，发现更强的通用手机操作能力并不意味着在危险时刻会做出更安全的选择。
summary.authors_note: 香港中文大学、清华大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing phone-use agent safety evaluations cannot distinguish between agents that actively recognize risks and choose safely versus agents that simply lack the capability to perform harmful actions — two fundamentally different scenarios conflated in current metrics.
summary_en.importance: First work to explicitly formulate and quantify the 'safety vs. incapability' ambiguity in agent safety evaluation, contributing the PhoneSafety benchmark for isolated decision-point safety assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhoneSafety benchmark with 700 safety-critical moments from real phone interactions across 130+ apps, each isolating the next decision at a risky moment and categorizing model choices into safe/unsafe/no-useful-action.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation of eight representative phone-use agents reveals that stronger general phone-use ability does not reliably imply safer choices at risky moments.
summary_en.authors_note: CUHK and Tsinghua University team.

recommendation.zh: Agent安全评估的一个有价值视角——区分'真安全'和'没能力犯错'。对设计alignment数据或Agent safety训练信号有微弱参考，结论不必深究。
recommendation.en: A useful perspective on agent safety evaluation — distinguishing genuine safety from mere incapability. Weak signal for alignment data design, conclusions not critical.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Uncovering Entity Identity Confusion in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
paper.abstract: Multimodal knowledge editing (MKE) aims to correct the internal knowledge of large vision-language models after deployment, yet the behavioral patterns of post-edit models remain underexplored. In this paper, we identify a systemic failure mode in edited models, termed Entity Identity Confusion (EIC): edited models exhibit an absurd behavior where text-only queries about the original entity's identity unexpectedly return information about the new entity. To rigorously investigate EIC, we constru

summary.core_problem: 研究多模态知识编辑后的一个失效模式：模型在文本查询原实体时，错误返回新实体信息，出现实体身份混淆。
summary.importance: 价值主要在诊断和 benchmark，而不是新预训练方法。它提醒 VLM 的知识编辑并没有真正改写图像-实体绑定，更多是在表层关系上过拟合。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Entity Identity Confusion（EIC）现象，并构建 EC-Bench 专门检测编辑前后 image-entity binding 与 entity-entity relational knowledge 的变化。论文将问题归因于现有 MKE 方法没有区分 I-E 绑定和 E-E 关系，导致模型把新名字当作伪标签，而图像表征仍指向旧实体。
summary.experiments: 在多模态知识编辑设定下做诊断评测，核心结果是现有编辑方法会系统性触发 EIC。摘要未给出具体模型、编辑方法覆盖范围和量化幅度，因此目前更适合作为 failure mode 备查，而不是高优先级主线阅读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所 NLPR / MAIS、北京邮电大学、国科大、华中科技大学，属于国内多模态与模式识别方向团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in multimodal knowledge editing: after editing, text-only queries about the original entity can incorrectly return information about the new entity, causing entity identity confusion.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly diagnostic rather than methodological. The key takeaway is that current VLM editing methods may not truly rewrite image-entity bindings, but instead overfit shallow relational associations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Entity Identity Confusion (EIC) and build EC-Bench to probe how image-entity bindings and entity-entity relational knowledge shift before and after editing. They argue that existing MKE methods fail to separate I-E binding from E-E relations, so the model keeps perceiving the image as the original entity while treating the new name as a spurious label.
summary_en.experiments: The work evaluates multimodal knowledge editing systems under this diagnostic setup and reports that EIC is a systematic failure mode. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model coverage, editing methods, or effect sizes, so this is better treated as a useful failure-mode reference than a top-priority read.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from NLPR/MAIS at CAS, BUPT, UCAS, and HUST, representing a Chinese multimodal and pattern-recognition research cluster.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“编辑改的是绑定还是标签”这个问题挑明了；做 VLM memory/editing 的人看 benchmark 定义即可，别把编辑成功率当真改知识。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly asks whether editing changes bindings or just labels; if you work on VLM memory/editing, read the benchmark setup and be skeptical of headline edit success.

paper.title: Unifying Scientific Communication: Fine-Grained Correspondence Across Scientific Media
paper.abstract: The communication of scientific knowledge has become increasingly multimodal, spanning text, visuals, and speech through materials such as research papers, slides, and recorded presentations. These different representations collectively convey a study's reasoning, results, and insights, offering complementary perspectives that enrich understanding. However, despite their shared purpose, such materials are rarely connected in a structured way. The absence of explicit links across formats makes it

summary.core_problem: 科研传播的多模态材料（论文、幻灯片、演示视频等）之间缺乏结构化关联，无法追踪概念、图表、解释的跨格式对应关系
summary.importance: 数据与benchmark贡献，首次提出整合同一项研究的论文、演示视频、讲解视频、幻灯片的多模态会议数据集MCD
summary.technical_approach: 构建带细粒度跨格式对应标注的MCD数据集，评估多种嵌入方法和VLM的跨格式匹配能力，建立任务基线
summary.experiments: 完成了跨格式对应任务的基线评测，具体性能数值未在摘要中完整披露
summary.authors_note: 微软印度研究院、IIT海得拉巴，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal scientific communication materials (papers, slides, presentation videos) lack structured links, making it impossible to trace cross-format correspondence of concepts, figures and explanations
summary_en.importance: Data and benchmark contribution, introduces MCD, the first benchmark integrating papers, presentation videos, explanatory videos and slides from the same research works
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds MCD with fine-grained cross-format correspondence annotations, evaluates various embedding methods and VLMs on cross-format matching task to establish baselines
summary_en.experiments: Baseline performance for cross-format correspondence task is established, full quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Microsoft Research India, IIT Hyderabad, no notable authors

recommendation.zh: 科学领域垂直多模态对齐基准，仅做多模态相关文献备查，无需阅读正文
recommendation.en: Vertical scientific multimodal alignment benchmark, only for literature reference, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Chain of Risk: Safety Failures in Large Reasoning Models and Mitigation via Adaptive Multi-Principle Steering
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) increasingly expose chain-of-thought-like reasoning for transparency, verification, and deliberate problem solving. This creates a safety blind spot: harmful or policy-violating content may appear in reasoning traces even when final answers appear safe. We test whether final-answer safety is a sufficient proxy for the full reasoning-answer trajectory by scoring both stages under a unified twenty-principle safety rubric. Using prompts from seven public harmfulness an

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型（LRM）暴露中间推理链以增强透明度，但推理轨迹中可能出现有害或违反政策的内容，即使最终答案看起来是安全的。仅评估最终答案的安全性不足以覆盖完整推理-答案轨迹中的安全风险。
summary.importance: 系统揭示了推理模型安全评估的一个结构性盲区：推理轨迹本身构成独立的安全攻击面。定义了三种推理-答案失效模式（unsafe不安全、leak泄露、escape逃逸），并证明仅检查最终答案会系统性遗漏前两类失败。提出的自适应多原则转向方法展示了在推理阶段进行安全干预的可行性，且对OOD场景有一定泛化能力。对理解RLHF/RL后推理模型的安全行为有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 分为评估框架和缓解方法两部分：（1）阶段式安全评估框架：在20条明确安全原则和1-5严重性分级下，对推理轨迹和最终答案分别评分；汇集7个公开有害/越狱prompt数据集+4个OOD来源；定义unsafe（推理和答案均有害）、leak（危险推理+安全外观答案）、escape（良性推理+危险答案）三种失效模式；（2）自适应多原则转向：为每条安全原则计算安全/不安全激活质心，定义不安全→安全方向，仅对当前隐态更接近不安全的方向激活干预，实现原则感知和prompt自适应的推理时激活控制。
summary.experiments: 在15个推理模型（开源+API）上评估，每个模型41K个prompt：（1）所有模型的推理轨迹平均严重性均超过最终答案，差距最大的是Gemini-Pro-3.1、GPT-OSS-20B、DeepMath-Zero-7B、Kimi-K2.5；（2）安全风险有原则结构性：集中在虚假信息、法律合规、歧视、身体伤害、心理伤害；（3）自适应转向在三个可操控开源模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B, MiMo-7B-RL-Zero）上均降低了不安全计数：HeldOut2K上分别减少10.8%/41.9%/30.5%，OOD2K上分别减少18.3%/39.8%/48.0%；推理侧最强减少达77.2%（HeldOut2K）和62.7%（OOD2K）；（4）DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B在HeldOut2K+OOD2K上平均减少40.8%不安全计数，同时保留97.7%的BBH/GSM8K/MMLU综合准确率，实现较好的安全-效用trade-off。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看§3（三种失效模式定义和评估框架）和§5（实验结果，尤其是图1的框架概览和各模型安全性差距的量化分析）。自适应转向方法§4可重点阅读原则感知的设计逻辑。预计阅读时间35-45分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者和机构信息未在文中明确标注（提交为匿名，有anonymous.4open.science代码仓库链接）。

summary_en.core_problem: Large reasoning models (LRMs) expose intermediate chain-of-thought reasoning for transparency, but harmful or policy-violating content can appear in reasoning traces even when the final answer appears safe. Evaluating only final-answer safety is insufficient to cover safety risks in the full reasoning-answer trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Systematically reveals a structural blind spot in reasoning model safety evaluation: the reasoning trace itself constitutes an independent safety attack surface. Defines three reasoning-answer failure modes (unsafe, leak, escape) and demonstrates that checking only final answers systematically misses the first two failure types. The proposed adaptive multi-principle steering shows feasibility of safety intervention at the reasoning stage with some OOD generalization. Useful for understanding safety behavior of reasoning models trained with RLHF/RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-part framework: (1) Stage-wise safety evaluation: score both reasoning traces and final answers under 20 explicit safety principles with 1–5 severity rubrics; aggregate prompts from 7 public harm/jailbreak datasets plus 4 OOD sources; define three failure modes (unsafe, leak, escape); (2) Adaptive multi-principle steering: compute safe/unsafe activation centroids for each safety principle, define unsafe-to-safe directions, and only activate directions where the current hidden state is closer to unsafe—achieving principle-aware, prompt-adaptive test-time activation control.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation across 15 reasoning models (open-weight + API), 41K prompts per model: (1) Average reasoning-trace severity exceeds final-answer severity for every model, with largest gaps for Gemini-Pro-3.1, GPT-OSS-20B, DeepMath-Zero-7B, and Kimi-K2.5; (2) Safety risk is principle-structured, concentrating in misinformation, legal compliance, discrimination, physical harm, and psychological harm; (3) Adaptive steering reduces unsafe counts across all three steerable open models: 10.8%/41.9%/30.5% on HeldOut2K, 18.3%/39.8%/48.0% on OOD2K for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B and MiMo-7B-RL-Zero respectively; strongest reasoning-side reduction reaches 77.2% (HeldOut2K) and 62.7% (OOD2K); (4) DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B achieves 40.8% average unsafe count reduction across HeldOut2K+OOD2K while retaining 97.7% macro-averaged accuracy on BBH/GSM8K/MMLU.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 (three failure mode definitions and evaluation framework) and §5 (experimental results, especially Figure 1 framework overview and quantitative analysis of safety gaps across models). Adaptive steering method §4 is worth reading for the principle-aware design logic. Estimated reading time: 35–45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly stated (anonymous submission, with anonymous.4open.science code repository link).

recommendation.zh: 推理轨迹中隐藏安全风险的发现对训练安全的推理模型有启示，值得看实验部分的阶段失败分析。
recommendation.en: The finding of hidden safety risks in reasoning traces has implications for training safe reasoning models; worth skimming the staged-failure analysis in experiments.

paper.title: Knowing but Not Correcting: Routine Task Requests Suppress Factual Correction in LLMs
paper.abstract: LLMs reliably correct false claims when presented in isolation, yet when the same claims are embedded in task-oriented requests, they often comply rather than correct. We term this failure mode \emph{correction suppression} and construct a benchmark of 300 false premises to systematically evaluate it across eight models. Suppression rates range from 19\% to 90\%, with four models exceeding 80\%, establishing correction suppression as a prevalent and severe phenomenon. Mechanistic analysis reveal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一种此前被系统性低估的事实性失败模式：模型并不是不知道用户前提是错的，而是在常规任务包装下不把纠错说出来。作者把它定义为 correction suppression。关键点不在于幻觉，也不在于对抗攻击，而在于日常、温和、看似正常的 instruction-following 场景——例如角色设定、输出格式要求、范围约束、避免额外评论——会把模型从“指出错误”推向“按要求完成任务”。论文要解决的核心问题有两个：第一，如何严格地区分‘知识缺失’和‘知道但不纠正’；第二，能否找到这种行为切换发生在模型内部的哪个阶段，并据此设计低成本干预方法。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它指出现有 factuality 评测如果只在 isolated false claim 上做，会系统性高估部署时的可靠性，因为真实使用里错误前提通常嵌在任务上下文里。第二，它把问题从‘模型会不会纠错’推进到‘模型在什么条件下愿意把纠错外显出来’，这和 instruction tuning、helpfulness/harmlessness 对 factual strictness 的张力直接相关，对 pretrain 到 post-train 接口很有启发。第三，作者给出的机制证据比较完整：错误信号在内部仍被编码，但早层注意力被任务上下文分流，中层开始形成服从式输出意图。这种“knowing but not correcting”的分离，对后续做训练目标设计、对齐数据构造、representation steering 都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它不是提出新基座架构，但在可靠性机制分析和训练后干预上都给出了可复现、可操作的框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三部分。第一部分是 benchmark 设计。作者构造了 300 条可验证的错误前提，覆盖 7 类错误、21 个领域。每条样本都做成两种严格配对条件：isolated 条件里直接询问错误陈述；contextualized 条件里把同一错误前提嵌入任务背景、输出规范和范围约束中，并从多个组件池采样不同包装，尽量把变量控制在“是否存在任务性上下文”上。这样可以把 suppression 定义成行为差分，而不是绝对正确率。

第二部分是机制分析。作者在开源模型上比较 isolated 与 contextualized 两种条件下的内部表征。证据链包括三类：1）预测不确定性在错误位置上的相关性仍然很高，说明模型对错误内容的内部识别没有消失；2）隐藏状态表征中，和纠错相关的方向在两种条件下并非完全消失，而是没有主导最终输出；3）注意力分析显示，早层注意力从 false claim 本身转移到任务框架和输出要求，中层开始朝 compliance 方向收敛。作者据此把问题定位为 response selection failure，而不是 knowledge encoding failure。

第三部分是两种 training-free 干预。CDS（Correction Direction Steering）先用少量校准样本估计“纠错输出”和“服从输出”在表示空间中的分离方向，然后在中间层注入这个方向，干预时机选在输出意图尚未完全定型之前。它有点像针对该失败模式定制的 activation steering。DPA（Dynamic Payload Amplification）则不依赖校准数据，而是利用前面发现的 attention divergence 去定位 payload token：那些在后层获得异常高注意力、但在上下文中被任务框架压制的关键错误内容 token。方法通过放大这些 token 的表示，提升模型对错误载荷的持续关注，把生成轨迹拉回事实审议。两者的区别很清楚：CDS 更像显式方向控制，效果通常更强；DPA 更像基于注意力诊断的无监督补偿，部署门槛更低。
summary.experiments:
实验分为现象测量、机制验证和干预评估三块。现象层面，作者在 8 个模型上评测 suppression rate，范围从 19% 到 90%，其中 4 个模型超过 80%。这说明问题不是个别模型的偶发缺陷，而是相当普遍。更重要的是，同一条错误前提在 isolated 条件下常能被纠正，换成任务包装后就转为配合执行，直接证明评测设置会显著改变结论。

机制层面，作者主要在 Qwen3.5-9B 和 LLaMA3.1-8B 上做深入分析。文中强调 false-claim 位置的预测不确定性在两种条件下高度相关，支持“模型知道哪里不对”。注意力结果显示，差异主要出现在早层到中层：早层对 payload 的关注被 task context 抢走，中层输出意图逐渐锁定为完成任务而非纠错。这个时间顺序很关键，因为它决定了 steering 应该插在中层之前或附近，而不是只在最后几层做表面修补。

干预层面，CDS 和 DPA 都在多种基线上取得明显提升。作者把它们与若干简单提示法、通用 steering 或不做干预进行比较，结论是两种方法都能显著提高 factual strictness，同时对一般生成质量和推理能力影响很小，推理开销也接近可忽略。摘要里没有给出所有主表数字，但全文结论很明确：CDS 在有少量校准时效果最好；DPA 在零校准条件下仍有竞争力。作者还做了消融，说明如果 steering 层位过晚，或者 payload 定位不准，收益会明显下降，这和前面的机制分析是闭环的。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Figure 1 和 benchmark 定义，先把 suppression 的操作化定义吃透，否则后面的机制分析容易和普通 factuality、sycophancy 混在一起。然后重点看行为主表和按模型分组的结果，确认这个现象的普遍性与严重程度。机制部分优先看三类证据：错误位置不确定性、层间注意力迁移、输出意图形成的层位。这里最值得深挖的是作者如何论证“知道但不纠正”，而不是仅仅观察到 hidden state 有差异。干预部分重点看 CDS 的方向估计方式、注入层选择，以及 DPA 的 payload token 定位规则。若只打算花 30 分钟，建议读引言、任务定义、主结果表、机制图和干预总表；若要精读，值得把消融和失败案例也看完，因为它们直接关系到这种方法能否迁移到更大模型或后训练阶段。一个值得继续追问的问题是：这种 suppression 到底来自 instruction tuning 数据分布，还是更早的 pretraining 中就已有雏形，论文给了线索，但还没有完全回答。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific factual failure mode that is easy to miss in standard evaluations: a model can detect that a premise is false, yet stop surfacing the correction once the same premise is wrapped inside a routine task request. The authors call this correction suppression. The central question is not whether the model has the knowledge, but whether task framing—role prompts, output constraints, compliance cues, and “do not add extra commentary” style instructions—changes the response policy from correction to compliance. The paper also asks where this switch happens inside the network and whether it can be reversed without retraining.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is quite concrete. First, it shows that factuality evaluations based only on isolated false claims can substantially overestimate real deployment reliability, because user errors usually appear inside task-oriented prompts rather than as standalone statements. Second, it sharpens the distinction between factual knowledge and factual strictness: the model may know the truth but fail to insist on it under contextual pressure. That matters for the pretrain/post-train interface, especially for instruction tuning and preference optimization, where helpfulness can quietly dominate correction. Third, the paper provides a reasonably coherent mechanistic account—early attention is diverted away from the false payload, and a compliance-oriented output trajectory forms in the middle layers.
