This makes the work more than a benchmark paper; it becomes a useful case study in how alignment-style training can alter response selection without erasing internal knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three technical components. The first is the benchmark. The authors build 300 verifiably false premises covering seven error categories and 21 domains. Each premise is evaluated in two matched settings: an isolated condition, where the false claim is presented directly, and a contextualized condition, where the same claim is embedded in task framing composed of background, output specification, and scope instructions. The design is careful because it turns suppression into a behavioral dissociation under controlled prompt variation, rather than a generic drop in accuracy.

The second component is the mechanism analysis on open-weight models. The authors compare isolated and contextualized prompts using hidden-state representations, uncertainty at the false-claim position, and attention patterns across layers. Their main claim is that suppression is not a knowledge failure. Uncertainty patterns remain strongly correlated across the two conditions, suggesting that the model still internally registers the problematic content. The difference emerges in routing and response formation: early-layer attention is pulled toward task framing, and middle layers increasingly encode a compliance-oriented output plan. In other words, the model still “knows,” but the generation policy no longer prioritizes correction.

The third component is intervention. CDS, or Correction Direction Steering, estimates a representation-space direction that separates corrective behavior from compliant behavior, then injects that direction at middle layers before the output intent fully crystallizes. This is a targeted activation-steering method tailored to the identified failure mode. DPA, or Dynamic Payload Amplification, avoids calibration data. It uses the observed attention divergence to identify payload tokens—tokens carrying the false content that should matter for correction—and amplifies their representations so that factual deliberation remains active instead of being drowned out by task instructions. CDS is the stronger and more explicit control method; DPA is lighter-weight and easier to deploy when calibration is unavailable.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section covers prevalence, mechanism, and intervention. On prevalence, the benchmark is evaluated on eight models, including frontier systems, and suppression rates range from 19% to 90%, with four models above 80%. That is the headline result: the same false premise is often corrected in isolation but accepted once embedded in ordinary task framing. This makes the phenomenon both common and practically relevant.

For mechanism analysis, the paper focuses on open models such as Qwen3.5-9B and LLaMA3.1-8B. The key evidence is that uncertainty around the false-claim position remains highly correlated between isolated and contextualized settings, which supports the “knowing but not correcting” interpretation. Attention analysis then shows a layerwise shift: early layers allocate less attention to the false payload under task framing, while middle layers move toward a compliance-oriented generation trajectory. That layerwise timing is important because it motivates where steering should be applied.

For intervention, both CDS and DPA substantially improve correction behavior relative to no intervention and simple baselines, while preserving general generation quality and reasoning ability with negligible inference overhead. The paper’s detailed tables matter more than a single aggregate number: CDS performs best when a small amount of calibration is available, whereas DPA remains competitive without calibration. Ablations also show that the intervention layer and payload localization quality are critical. If steering is applied too late, or if the wrong tokens are amplified, gains drop noticeably. That consistency between mechanism and ablation is one of the stronger parts of the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task definition and the paired isolated/contextualized setup. If that distinction is not clear, the rest can look like ordinary factuality or sycophancy. Then read the main behavioral table to establish prevalence. After that, go straight to the mechanism figures: uncertainty correlation, attention redistribution across layers, and the analysis of when output intent becomes compliance-dominated. Those sections carry the main scientific value. For the intervention part, focus on how CDS constructs the correction direction, why the injection point is chosen in the middle layers, and how DPA identifies payload tokens from attention divergence. If time is limited, the introduction, benchmark definition, main results, mechanism figures, and intervention summary are enough for a solid pass in about 30–40 minutes. For a deeper read, the ablations and failure cases are worth the time because they reveal what is specific to this benchmark and what may generalize. A natural follow-up question is whether suppression is mainly created by post-training, or whether pretraining already seeds the tendency and post-training amplifies it.

recommendation.zh: 这是“指令跟随压过事实性”的可复现症状学+机制锚点；先看 suppression 分布和层级注意力证据，再决定要不要做训练修复。
recommendation.en: A reproducible symptom + mechanism anchor for “instruction-following overriding factuality”; read the suppression-rate breakdown and layer-wise attention evidence before attempting any training fix.

paper.title: Constraint Decay: The Fragility of LLM Agents in Backend Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents demonstrate strong performance in autonomous code generation under loose specifications. However, production-grade software requires strict adherence to structural constraints, such as architectural patterns, databases, and object-relational mappings. Existing benchmarks often overlook these non-functional requirements, rewarding functionally correct but structurally arbitrary solutions. We present a systematic study evaluating how well agents handle structural

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM代码生成Agent的评测基准忽略生产级后端代码的非功能约束（架构模式、数据库、对象关系映射等），无法衡量Agent在严格结构约束下的多文件代码生成能力。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前代码生成Agent在生产场景落地的核心短板，为代码大模型的预训练数据优化、SFT对齐目标设计提供了明确的改进方向，也补充了更贴近工业场景的代码生成评测标准。
summary.technical_approach: 基于OpenAPI规范构建评测pipeline，固定功能需求（统一API契约），系统调整非功能约束维度（框架选择、架构模式、数据库后端、对象关系映射集成），通过端到端行为测试和静态检查结合的方式，分离功能正确性和结构合规性的评估。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖8个Web框架的80个从零开始生成任务、20个功能实现任务测试集上，观测到约束衰减现象：结构约束密度提升时，Agent平均断言通过率下降30分；轻量显式框架（如Flask）下的表现明显优于重约定框架（如FastAPI）；45%的逻辑错误来自数据层缺陷，主要是查询组合错误和对象关系映射运行时违规。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章评测方法论设计、第4章约束衰减的实验结果、第5章错误根因分类，预计阅读时长20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation benchmarks for LLM code generation agents ignore non-functional constraints of production-grade backend code (architectural patterns, databases, ORM mappings, etc.), and cannot measure the multi-file code generation capability of agents under strict structural constraints.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the core gap of current code generation agents for production deployment, provides clear improvement directions for pre-training data optimization and SFT alignment target design of code LLMs, and complements code generation evaluation standards closer to industrial scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an evaluation pipeline based on OpenAPI specifications, fixes functional requirements with a unified API contract, systematically varies non-functional constraint dimensions (framework choice, architectural pattern, database backend, ORM integration), and separates evaluation of functional correctness and structural compliance through a combination of end-to-end behavioral tests and static checks.
summary_en.experiments: On the test set covering 8 web frameworks, 80 greenfield generation tasks and 20 feature implementation tasks, the constraint decay phenomenon is observed: when structural constraint density increases, the average assertion pass rate of agents drops by 30 points; agents perform significantly better on lightweight explicit frameworks (e.g. Flask) than on convention-heavy frameworks (e.g. FastAPI); 45% of logical errors come from data layer defects, mainly incorrect query composition and ORM runtime violations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for evaluation methodology design, Chapter 4 for constraint decay experimental results, and Chapter 5 for error root cause classification. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示的 constraint decay 现象对 code agent 的评测设计有参考价值——现有 benchmark 只测功能正确性确实不够。看 §4 的实验发现部分即可
recommendation.en: The constraint decay phenomenon is informative for code agent benchmark design — existing benchmarks only measuring functional correctness is indeed insufficient. Read §4 for experimental findings only.

paper.title: LeakDojo: Decoding the Leakage Threats of RAG Systems
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to leverage external knowledge, but also exposes valuable RAG databases to leakage attacks. As RAG systems grow more complex and LLMs exhibit stronger instruction-following capabilities, existing studies fall short of systematically assessing RAG leakage risks. We present LeakDojo, a configurable framework for controlled evaluation of RAG leakage. Using LeakDojo, we benchmark six existing attacks across fourteen LLMs, four

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG系统泄露风险评估缺乏系统化框架，无法分析复杂RAG架构、大模型能力、攻击策略三者对泄露风险的联合影响，无法适配当前带重排、改写、摘要等增强模块的现代RAG系统。
summary.importance: 提出了可配置的RAG泄露风险评测框架，揭示了RAG泄露的核心机制，为RAG系统的安全设计提供了可落地的参考，也为后续RAG攻击和防御研究提供了统一评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 构建模块化的LeakDojo评测框架，将RAG系统、攻击方法、防御策略拆分为独立可配置的组件，支持隔离分析各组件对泄露风险的贡献。
summary.experiments: 覆盖6种主流攻击、14款大模型、4个数据集、多种带增强模块的RAG架构，得到三个核心结论：1）查询生成器和对抗指令对泄露的贡献相互独立，整体泄露率近似等于两者独立效果的乘积；2）大模型的指令遵循能力与泄露风险正相关，皮尔逊相关系数为0.578，p值0.039；3）RAG的生成忠实度和泄露安全存在固有 trade-off，提升忠实度的模块通常会同时提升泄露风险。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第4章泄露机制分析的实验结果、第3章LeakDojo的框架设计，跳过具体的攻击实现细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation methods for RAG system leakage risks lack a systematic framework, cannot analyze the joint impact of complex RAG architectures, LLM capabilities, and attack strategies on leakage risks, and cannot adapt to modern RAG systems with enhancement modules such as reranker, rewriter, and summarizer.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a configurable evaluation framework for RAG leakage risks, reveals the core mechanism of RAG leakage, provides practical reference for the security design of RAG systems, and also provides a unified evaluation benchmark for subsequent research on RAG attacks and defenses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The modular LeakDojo evaluation framework is built, which decomposes RAG systems, attack methods, and defense strategies into independently configurable components, supporting isolated analysis of the contribution of each component to leakage risk.
summary_en.experiments: Covering 6 mainstream attacks, 14 LLMs, 4 datasets, and multiple RAG architectures with enhancement modules, three core conclusions are obtained: 1) The contributions of the query generator and adversarial instruction to leakage are independent, and the overall leakage rate is approximately equal to the product of their independent effects; 2) The instruction-following capability of LLMs is positively correlated with leakage risk, with Pearson correlation coefficient 0.578 and p-value 0.039; 3) There is an inherent trade-off between RAG generation faithfulness and leakage security, and modules that improve faithfulness usually increase leakage risk at the same time.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental results of leakage mechanism analysis in Chapter 4 and the framework design of LeakDojo in Chapter 3, skip the specific implementation details of attacks, expected reading time 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和实验发现即可；faithfulness 与泄漏同向这点会影响 RAG 后训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and findings; the faithfulness-leakage coupling is the part that should affect RAG post-training objectives.

paper.title: AI Co-Mathematician: Accelerating Mathematicians with Agentic AI
paper.abstract: We introduce the AI co-mathematician, a workbench for mathematicians to interactively leverage AI agents to pursue open-ended research. The AI co-mathematician is optimized to provide holistic support for the exploratory and iterative reality of mathematical workflows, including ideation, literature search, computational exploration, theorem proving and theory building. By providing an asynchronous, stateful workspace that manages uncertainty, refines user intent, tracks failed hypotheses, and o

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的不是单题数学推理能力，而是数学研究中的长期协作编排问题。标准聊天界面适合短回合问答，形式化证明器和搜索系统适合局部任务，但数学研究需要持续管理假设、失败路径、文献线索、计算实验和中间证明草稿。AI Co-Mathematician 试图把这些活动放进一个有状态、可异步推进的 agent 工作台。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，因为系统不依赖新的模型训练，也不提出新的语言建模目标。启发主要在两个方面。第一，数学能力评估不应只看静态题集，长期状态管理、假设修订、反例搜索和用户意图澄清会成为推理模型的重要使用场景。第二，这类工作台可以反过来产生更接近真实数学研究过程的数据，包括失败假设、审稿式反驳、文献追踪和多轮定义修订，这些数据比单一答案监督更适合训练研究型推理模型。
summary.technical_approach: 系统是一个基于 Gemini 模型的 agent harness，而不是定制模型。核心设计是用 project coordinator agent 管理项目状态，并把任务拆成并行 workstreams。每个 workstream 可承担不同角色，例如构造例子、搜索文献、尝试证明、寻找反例、写计算脚本或整理中间结果。用户不是等待端到端自动证明，而是在工作区中持续 steering：修改目标、约束搜索方向、确认有用定义、丢弃失败分支。文中强调两类机制。一类是状态化记忆，包括跟踪失败假设、未解决子问题、可复用 lemma 和文献引用；另一类是 adversarial review loop，用审查和反驳减少系统走捷径或把不可解问题包装成似是而非的证明。与 AlphaProof、Aletheia、AlphaEvolve 这类专用推理或搜索引擎不同，它的重点是把这些能力放进人类研究循环，而不是替代底层 solver。
summary.experiments: 实验部分以早期定性结果和静态 benchmark 基线为主。可见内容显示，系统在试用中帮助数学研究者处理开放问题、发现新的研究方向、补充被忽略的文献线索，并生成可验证的数学 artifacts。文中也说明会给出静态问题求解 benchmark，用作底层能力测量，但提供的内容没有包含具体题集、模型版本、成功率或 ablation 数字。因而不宜把它读成数学推理能力提升的定量证明，更适合作为 agentic mathematics workflow 的系统设计案例。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看设计原则、系统 walkthrough 和 evaluation strategy。重点关注三件事：一是 coordinator 如何维护项目状态；二是并行 workstreams 如何避免互相污染并保留失败路径；三是评估部分如何处理开放式数学研究中“没有单一标准答案”的问题。静态 benchmark 部分可快速扫过，因为它只能反映底层模型的单点能力，不能充分评价这个系统真正关心的长期协作能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets orchestration rather than single-shot mathematical reasoning. Current chat interfaces handle local interactions, while theorem provers and search systems handle specialized subproblems. Real mathematical research requires persistent management of hypotheses, failed attempts, literature traces, computational probes, and evolving proof artifacts. AI Co-Mathematician is designed as a stateful, asynchronous workspace for that workflow.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to pretraining is limited: the system does not introduce a new model, training objective, or custom model behavior. Its relevance is in the interface between reasoning models, evaluation, and future data generation. It suggests that mathematical capability should be evaluated not only on static problem sets, but also on long-horizon state tracking, refutation, intent refinement, and theory-building. It may also produce richer supervision traces for future reasoning models, including failed hypotheses, adversarial reviews, literature grounding, and iterative definition repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is a harness built on Gemini models. A project coordinator agent maintains the global research state and delegates tasks to parallel workstreams. These workstreams can explore examples, search literature, attempt proofs, find counterexamples, run computations, and draft intermediate artifacts. The user remains in the loop and steers the process by changing constraints, accepting useful directions, and pruning unproductive branches. Two design choices matter most: persistent project memory, including failed hypotheses and reusable lemmas; and adversarial review loops that challenge weak arguments instead of allowing the system to produce polished but unreliable claims. Unlike AlphaProof, Aletheia, or AlphaEvolve, the focus is not a specialized solver, but the orchestration layer that can place such solvers inside a human research loop.
summary_en.experiments: The evidence is mainly early qualitative feedback plus baseline static problem-solving evaluations. The available text reports that practicing mathematicians used the system to make progress on open-ended problems, identify new directions, and recover overlooked references. It also says the system is evaluated on static benchmarks to measure underlying capability, but the provided content does not include concrete benchmark names, model versions, success rates, or ablations. The results should therefore be read as a system-design demonstration, not as a quantitative claim about improved mathematical reasoning ability.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the design principles, the walkthrough, and the evaluation discussion. The most useful details are how the coordinator preserves project state, how parallel workstreams are organized, and how the system evaluates progress when there is no single final answer. The static benchmark section can be read quickly, because it mostly measures the underlying model and does not capture the long-horizon collaborative behavior that motivates the system.

recommendation.zh: Google的Agent数学助手，核心价值在于展示了有状态工作空间+失败假设追踪对复杂推理任务的重要性，对LLM推理能力的研究有参考意义。重点看系统架构和FrontierMath基准上的表现。
recommendation.en: Google's agentic math assistant demonstrating the value of stateful workspace and failed hypothesis tracking for complex reasoning. Study the system architecture and FrontierMath benchmark results.

paper.title: Benchmarking LLMs on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
paper.abstract: The Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB) has emerged as a standard for evaluating the functional breadth of audio models. While initial baselines focused on specialized encoders, the shift toward "audio-native" Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests a new paradigm where a single multimodal backbone may replace complex, task-specific pipelines. This paper provides a rigorous empirical evaluation of leading LLMs - including members from the Gemini and GPT families - across the eight core MSEB c

summary.core_problem: 评估音频原生 LLM 与级联式音频系统在通用声音表征基准 MSEB 上的能力差距，判断统一多模态骨干是否已能替代专用音频管线。
summary.importance: 价值主要在 benchmark 和负结果：它没有证明 audio-native LLM 已经赢，也没有给出单一路线的确定答案。这对做统一多模态预训练的人有参考意义，因为它提醒大家不要把“统一 backbone”当成已成立结论。
summary.technical_approach: 在 MSEB 的八类核心能力上系统评测多种领先 LLM，包括 Gemini 和 GPT 家族，比较音频输入下的表现、鲁棒性以及与文本能力的 parity。方法上不是新模型，而是较大规模的经验性对比分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量和详细数值，但明确指出仍存在明显 modality gap，且关于 audio-native 与 cascaded 架构谁更优，证据并不收敛；最终选择依赖延迟、成本和推理深度等约束。更像评测论文而非方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Cyril Allauzen、Georg Heigold、Ehsan Variani 等，属于语音/音频建模与评测方向较有代表性的研究者；摘要未明确机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether audio-native LLMs can match or replace cascaded audio systems on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark, and how far they are from text-level parity.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is as a benchmark with a useful negative result: it does not show that audio-native LLMs have clearly won, nor that one architecture is universally best. That matters for researchers working on unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It conducts a broad empirical evaluation of leading LLMs, including Gemini and GPT-family models, across the eight core MSEB capabilities, comparing audio performance, robustness, and audio-text parity. This is an evaluation study rather than a new modeling method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or detailed numbers, but it clearly states that a substantial modality gap remains and that evidence for an optimal modeling approach is inconclusive. The architecture choice depends on latency, cost, and reasoning-depth constraints.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Cyril Allauzen, Georg Heigold, and Ehsan Variani, who are recognizable names in speech/audio modeling and evaluation; the abstract does not explicitly state the institution.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值不在结论多强，而在它没顺着行业叙事走：统一音频-文本 backbone 还没坐实，做 audio LM 的人应先看评测设定和失败面。
recommendation.en: Useful because it resists the easy 'audio-native wins' narrative; if you work on audio LMs, read the evaluation setup and failure modes, not just the headline.

paper.title: DiffCap-Bench: A Comprehensive, Challenging, Robust Benchmark for Image Difference Captioning
paper.abstract: Image Difference Captioning (IDC) generates natural language descriptions that precisely identify differences between two images, serving as a key benchmark for fine-grained change perception, cross-modal reasoning, and image editing data construction. However, existing benchmarks lack diversity and compositional complexity, and standard lexical-overlap metrics (e.g., BLEU, METEOR) fail to capture semantic consistency or penalize hallucinations, which together prevent a comprehensive and robust

summary.core_problem: 现有图像差异描述（IDC）基准多样性与组合复杂度不足，传统词汇重叠评估指标无法捕捉语义一致性、无法惩罚幻觉，难以全面评测多模态大模型的细粒度变化感知与推理能力
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，构建了首个覆盖10类差异的高复杂度IDC基准，提出了基于人类验证差异列表的LLM-as-Judge评估协议，解决了现有评估的鲁棒性问题
summary.technical_approach: 原创构建涵盖10种不同差异类别的DiffCap-Bench基准，设计基于人类标注Difference Lists的LLM-as-Judge评估流程，可同时衡量模型的变化捕捉准确性与描述语义一致性
summary.experiments: 对多个SOTA级MLLM进行系统性评测，验证了基准的难度与评估协议的有效性，指出现有模型在IDC任务上的显著能力短板
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华南理工大学、北京大学、天津大学等机构，无已知知名大模型研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Image Difference Captioning (IDC) benchmarks lack diversity and compositional complexity, while traditional lexical overlap metrics fail to capture semantic consistency or penalize hallucinations, hindering robust evaluation of MLLMs' fine-grained change perception and reasoning capabilities
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: constructs the first high-complexity IDC benchmark covering 10 difference categories, proposes an LLM-as-Judge evaluation protocol based on human-validated Difference Lists, resolving robustness issues of existing evaluation methods
summary_en.technical_approach: Originally builds DiffCap-Bench covering 10 distinct difference categories, designs an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline based on human-annotated Difference Lists, which can simultaneously measure model's change detection accuracy and description semantic consistency
summary_en.experiments: Conducted systematic evaluation on multiple SOTA MLLMs, verified the benchmark's difficulty and the evaluation protocol's effectiveness, and identified significant capability gaps of existing models on IDC tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from South China University of Technology, Peking University, Tianjin University, no well-known large model researchers identified

recommendation.zh: 多模态细粒度推理评测基准，仅作为领域文献备查，无需阅读正文
recommendation.en: Multimodal fine-grained reasoning benchmark, for literature reference only, no need to read the full text

paper.title: KernelBench-X: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
paper.abstract: LLM-based Triton kernel generation has attracted significant interest, yet a fundamental empirical question remains unanswered: where does this capability break down, and why? We present KernelBench-X, a benchmark designed to answer this question through category-aware evaluation of correctness and hardware efficiency across 176 tasks in 15 categories. Our systematic comparison of five representative methods yields three main findings. First, task structure determines correctness more than metho

summary.core_problem: LLM 生成 Triton GPU kernel 的能力到底在哪些任务结构上失效，以及失败来自语义错误还是硬件效率不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成与系统内核生成 benchmark。KernelBench-X 用类别化任务拆解 correctness 和 performance，让评估不只看能否编译或单点加速，而是分析任务结构、方法差异和迭代修复之间的关系。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 176 个任务、15 个类别的评测集，分别评估语义正确性和硬件效率；比较五类代表性 LLM kernel 生成方法；用方差解释或 deviance 分解分析任务类别与方法设计对正确率的贡献；还研究 iterative refinement 对编译率、正确性和速度的不同影响。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括：任务结构比方法设计更能解释语义正确性，类别解释 9.4% deviance，方法只解释 3.3%；72% Fusion 任务在五种方法下全部失败，而 Math 类任务较稳定；GEAK 迭代让编译率从 52.3% 升到 68.8%，但平均 speedup 从 1.58x 降到 1.44x，新修好的 kernel 往往比一直正确的 kernel 慢。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark asks where LLM-generated Triton kernels fail, and whether failures are driven by semantic correctness, compilation, or hardware efficiency.
summary_en.importance: KernelBench-X is a benchmark contribution for code generation and systems-oriented kernel synthesis. Its value is the category-aware breakdown of correctness and performance rather than a single pass/fail metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 176 tasks across 15 categories and evaluates both semantic correctness and hardware efficiency. It compares five representative generation methods, decomposes variance by task category and method, and studies how iterative refinement affects compilation, correctness, and speed.
summary_en.experiments: Task structure explains more correctness variance than method design: 9.4% explained deviance from category versus 3.3% from method. Fusion tasks are especially hard, with 72% failing across all five methods, while Math tasks are consistently solved. GEAK-style refinement raises compile rate from 52.3% to 68.8%, but average speedup drops from 1.58x to 1.44x.

recommendation.zh: 作为 kernel 生成 benchmark 备查即可；真正有用的是“修正确率和加速不一致”这个负结果。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a kernel-generation benchmark reference; the useful signal is the negative result that fixing correctness does not preserve speed.

paper.title: AgentTrust: Runtime Safety Evaluation and Interception for AI Agent Tool Use
paper.abstract: Modern AI agents execute real-world side effects through tool calls such as file operations, shell commands, HTTP requests, and database queries. A single unsafe action, including accidental deletion, credential exposure, or data exfiltration, can cause irreversible harm. Existing defenses are incomplete: post-hoc benchmarks measure behavior after execution, static guardrails miss obfuscation and multi-step context, and infrastructure sandboxes constrain where code runs without understanding wha

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI agent 在执行文件、shell、HTTP、数据库等工具调用前缺少运行时安全拦截的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全系统和 benchmark。它关注真实副作用动作的执行前风险判断，比只做执行后评测或静态规则更贴近部署场景；对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对工具使用安全边界有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentTrust 运行时安全层，在工具调用执行前返回 allow、warn、block、review 四类结构化判断。系统包含 shell 去混淆归一化、SafeFix 安全替代建议、RiskChain 多步攻击链检测，以及带缓存的 LLM-as-Judge 处理模糊输入。
summary.experiments: 发布 300 个场景的 benchmark，覆盖 6 类风险，并额外构造 630 个真实风险样例。摘要未给出与具体 guardrail、sandbox 或 LLM judge baseline 的量化对比结果，需查正文确认误杀率和漏检率。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles runtime safety for AI agents by intercepting tool calls such as file operations, shell commands, HTTP requests, and database queries before execution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent safety system and benchmark. It is closer to deployment than post-hoc evaluations or static guardrails because it reasons about real side-effecting actions, though its direct relevance to pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentTrust acts as a runtime safety layer that returns structured verdicts: allow, warn, block, or review. It combines shell deobfuscation, SafeFix suggestions, RiskChain detection for multi-step attacks, and a cache-aware LLM-as-Judge for ambiguous calls.
summary_en.experiments: The paper releases a 300-scenario benchmark across six risk categories plus 630 independently constructed real-world risk cases. The abstract does not provide detailed quantitative comparisons against guardrails, sandboxes, or judge baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 作为工具调用安全的工程清单可存档；没有改变模型训练 prior，正文最多看 benchmark schema。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering checklist for tool-call safety; it does not shift training priors, so the benchmark schema is the main thing to inspect.

paper.title: CC-OCR V2: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Literacy in Real-world Document Processing
paper.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have recently shown strong performance on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) tasks, demonstrating their promising capability in document literacy. However, their effectiveness in real-world applications remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks adopt task scopes misaligned with practical applications and assume homogeneous acquisition conditions. To address this gap, we introduce CC-OCR V2, a comprehensive and challenging OCR benchmark tailored to real-world d

summary.core_problem: 评估大多模态模型在真实企业文档 OCR 场景中的文字识别、解析、定位、信息抽取和问答能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/OCR benchmark。它补足了现有 OCR 评测过于干净、任务范围偏窄、采集条件同质化的问题，对理解 LMM 在文档 literacy 上的真实短板有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 CC-OCR V2，覆盖 5 条 OCR-centric track：text recognition、document parsing、document grounding、key information extraction、document question answering，并刻意加入真实应用中的 hard cases 和 corner cases。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 7,093 个高难样本；评测 14 个先进 LMM。摘要结论是现有模型距离真实企业文档处理要求仍有明显差距，但未给出具体模型列表、参数量和分项提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University；从摘要看主要是文档 OCR 与多模态评测工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether large multimodal models can handle OCR-heavy real-world enterprise document processing rather than clean benchmark-style OCR.
summary_en.importance: It is a VLM/OCR benchmark contribution. The main value is exposing the gap between standard OCR evaluations and practical document literacy workloads with heterogeneous acquisition conditions and corner cases.
summary_en.technical_approach: CC-OCR V2 is organized around five OCR-centric tracks: text recognition, document parsing, document grounding, key information extraction, and document question answering. The benchmark emphasizes difficult and underrepresented real-world cases.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 7,093 challenging samples and evaluates 14 advanced LMMs. The abstract reports that current models remain below real-world deployment requirements, but does not provide model sizes or detailed per-model numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University; the work appears centered on document OCR and multimodal evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 偏应用 benchmark；做 native VLM 预训练可扫任务 taxonomy 和失败类型，不必细读排行榜。
recommendation.en: Mostly an applied benchmark; for native VLM pretraining, skim the task taxonomy and failure cases, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: MHPR: Multidimensional Human Perception and Reasoning Benchmark for Large Vision-Languate Models
paper.abstract: Multidimensional human understanding is essential for real-world applications such as film analysis and virtual digital humans, yet current LVLM benchmarks largely focus on single-task settings and lack fine-grained, human-centric evaluation. In this work, we introduce MHPR, a comprehensive benchmark for joint perception-reasoning over human-centric scenes spanning individual, multi-person, and human-object interaction dimensions. MHPR comprises a multi-level data design-Captioned Raw Data (C-RD

summary.core_problem: 如何评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在以人为中心的场景中的多维感知和推理能力？
summary.importance: 提出了 MHPR，一个针对以人为中心场景的细粒度、多维度的 LVLM 评估基准，填补了现有基准在多任务和细粒度评估上的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了包含个体、多人和人机交互维度的多级数据集（C-RD, SFT-D, RL-D, T-D），并设计了自动化的 caption/VQA 生成 pipeline（ACVG），通过属性分解、重写和多模型投票确保标注质量。
summary.experiments: 在细粒度属性（外观、服装、姿势等）和高级语义（社会关系、动作、空间关系等）上评估了 SOTA LVLM。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the multi-dimensional perception and reasoning capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in human-centric scenes?
summary_en.importance: Introduces MHPR, a fine-grained, multi-dimensional benchmark for LVLMs in human-centric scenes, filling the gap in multi-task and fine-grained evaluation of existing benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a multi-level dataset (C-RD, SFT-D, RL-D, T-D) covering individual, multi-person, and human-object interaction dimensions. Designs an automated caption/VQA generation pipeline (ACVG) using attribute decomposition, rewriting, and multi-model voting to ensure annotation quality.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated SOTA LVLMs on fine-grained attributes (appearance, clothing, pose, etc.) and high-level semantics (social relations, actions, spatial relations, etc.).
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University team.

recommendation.zh: 特定领域（以人为中心）的 VLM Benchmark，作为评测集备查，不需精读。
recommendation.en: Domain-specific (human-centric) VLM benchmark, keep as reference for evaluation sets, no need to read in detail.

paper.title: Before Forgetting, Learn to Remember: Revisiting Foundational Learning Failures in LVLM Unlearning Benchmarks
paper.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) offer powerful capabilities, they pose privacy risks by unintentionally memorizing sensitive personal information. Current unlearning benchmarks attempt to mitigate this using fictitious identities but overlook a critical stage 1 failure: models fail to effectively memorize target information initially, rendering subsequent unlearning evaluations unreliable. Diagnosing under-memorization and the multi-hop curse as root causes, we introduce ReMem, a Reli

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM unlearning benchmark 在评估遗忘前没有确认模型是否真正记住目标信息，导致遗忘效果评估不可靠的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态模型记忆与遗忘评测工作，贡献在于指出现有 benchmark 的阶段性失败：模型常常没有充分学习虚构身份信息，却被拿来评估 unlearning；同时提出更可靠的多图、多跳记忆 benchmark 和 Exposure 指标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReMem benchmark，通过数据规模控制、面向推理的 QA 构造、多样视觉上下文来强化基础记忆阶段；同时提出 Exposure 指标，用模型内部概率分布衡量信息擦除深度，而不只看表面回答是否改变。
summary.experiments: 对多个 LVLM 进行学习与 unlearning 诊断，重点验证 under-memorization 和 multi-hop curse 是现有评测失真的根因；摘要未列出具体模型名称、参数规模、数据量和数值提升，需要正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Chung-Ang University 和 KT Corporation；从给定信息无法确认有知名基础模型团队或代表性大模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation flaw in LVLM unlearning benchmarks: models may not have memorized the target information before unlearning is measured.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and analysis contribution for multimodal memorization and unlearning. Its main value is identifying a stage-one failure in current fictitious-identity unlearning setups and proposing a more reliable multi-image, multi-hop memorization benchmark plus an Exposure metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReMem enforces a stronger learning stage through principled data scaling, reasoning-aware QA pairs, and diverse visual contexts. The proposed Exposure metric measures the depth of erasure in the model’s probability distribution rather than only checking whether surface answers change.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates LVLM learning and unlearning behavior, diagnosing under-memorization and the multi-hop curse as key sources of unreliable evaluation. The abstract does not specify exact model sizes, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Chung-Ang University and KT Corporation. The provided metadata does not establish a known foundation-model lab or prior flagship model work.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 构造和 Exposure 指标即可；它提醒 unlearning 评测先验不干净，但还不到改变训练方法的程度。
recommendation.en: Read only the benchmark design and Exposure metric; it exposes a dirty unlearning-eval assumption, but does not yet change training practice.

paper.title: ReasonAudio: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reasoning Beyond Matching in Text-Audio Retrieval
paper.abstract: As multimodal content continues to expand at a rapid pace, audio retrieval has emerged as a key enabling technology for media search, content organization, and intelligent assistants. However, most existing benchmarks concentrate on semantic matching and fail to capture the fact that real-world queries often demand advanced reasoning abilities, including negation understanding, temporal ordering, concurrent event recognition, and duration discrimination. To address this gap, we introduce ReasonA

summary.core_problem: 现有的文本-音频检索 benchmark 主要关注语义匹配，缺乏对现实世界查询中所需的复杂推理能力（如否定、时序、并发、持续时间）的评估。
summary.importance: 提出了 ReasonAudio，这是第一个针对文本-音频检索的推理密集型 benchmark，揭示了当前 SOTA 模型在音频推理任务上的严重不足。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含 1000 个查询和 10000 个复合音频剪辑的数据集，涵盖五个基础推理任务：否定、顺序、重叠、持续时间和混合。通过组合基础音频片段来构造具有特定逻辑关系的复合音频。
summary.experiments: 评估了 10 个 SOTA 模型，发现所有模型在推理密集型音频检索上都表现挣扎，性能显著下降，表明当前模型主要依赖语义匹配而非真正的推理。
summary.authors_note: Nanjing University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Nanyang Technological University

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-audio retrieval benchmarks focus primarily on semantic matching, lacking evaluation of complex reasoning abilities (e.g., negation, temporal ordering, concurrency, duration) required in real-world queries.
summary_en.importance: Introduces ReasonAudio, the first reasoning-intensive benchmark for text-audio retrieval, revealing severe deficiencies in current SOTA models on audio reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a dataset of 1,000 queries and 10,000 composite audio clips covering five fundamental reasoning tasks: Negation, Order, Overlap, Duration, and Mix. Composite audio is created by combining basic audio segments to form specific logical relationships.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 10 SOTA models, finding all struggle with reasoning-intensive audio retrieval, with significant performance drops, indicating current models rely mainly on semantic matching rather than true reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: Nanjing University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Nanyang Technological University

recommendation.zh: 音频多模态领域的细粒度评测，指出了当前 Audio LM 在时序/逻辑推理上的缺陷，作为多模态预训练的 evaluation target 备查。
recommendation.en: Fine-grained evaluation in the audio multimodal domain, pointing out the deficiencies of current Audio LMs in temporal/logical reasoning; useful as a reference for evaluation targets in multimodal pre-training.

paper.title: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
paper.abstract: Achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) requires agents that learn and interact adaptively, with interactive world models providing scalable environments for perception, reasoning, and action. Yet current research still lacks large-scale datasets and unified benchmarks to evaluate their physical interaction capabilities. To address this, we propose iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception an

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 interactive world model 缺少统一、可比、覆盖面足够广的评测框架，尤其是不同模型使用的动作输入形式不一致，导致“交互能力”很难公平比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接推动有限，但对 world model 方向有现实价值。它把评测对象从一般视频生成拉回到“动作条件下的环境响应”，并把数据、动作表示、任务设计和指标放到同一框架里。对于做统一视频/世界模型预训练的人，这篇工作的启发主要在两点：一是动作空间的标准化会影响模型比较与训练接口设计；二是 memory 与 action-following 需要单独测，不能只看视觉质量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上主要是 benchmark engineering，而不是新的 world model 架构。作者先清洗并标准化 12 个高质量数据集的坐标系和相机内外参，又从 4 个模拟器的 18 个环境自动采集并筛选 10 万段 1080P 视频，最终得到 33 万段视频的数据池。然后提出一个统一的 Action Generation Framework，用 modality-agnostic 的方式编码动作，把不同模型常见的文本命令、键盘输入、连续轨迹等控制形式映射到同一个动作字典中，定义了 81 个基础运动动作。在此基础上设计 6 类交互任务轨迹，并加入带逻辑一致性的 memory 任务。评测时从 33 万视频中挑出 2100 个高质量样本，构造 4900 个任务，用 9 个指标从视觉质量、动作跟随、记忆能力三方面评估 14 个现有模型。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是提出新模型，而是系统评测。可确认的规模包括：33 万视频数据池、2100 个评测视频、4900 个任务、14 个 interactive world models、9 个指标。模型覆盖 5 个文本控制世界生成模型、2 个 one-hot 动作编码模型、7 个基于相机内外参控制的模型。论文的主要结果应当是不同动作接口下模型能力差异明显，且视觉质量好不代表动作响应或记忆能力强；同时，任务难度和 memory 设计能拉开模型差距。阅读时要重点看各类任务上的排名是否稳定、不同指标之间是否冲突，以及统一动作框架是否真的减少了比较偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三部分：数据构建流程图、Action Generation Framework 定义、以及主评测表。先确认动作统一映射是否严谨，再看 6 类任务是否覆盖了交互世界模型的核心能力，最后看 9 个指标里哪些真正有区分度。若只想抓要点，30 分钟左右足够。若你关心 world model 训练接口，可以再看附录里关于坐标系统一、动作编码细节和人工标注难度分级的说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmarking gap for interactive world models: current models use heterogeneous action interfaces, datasets are fragmented, and there is no unified evaluation setup that can fairly compare interaction capability across modalities.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on language-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for the world-model stack around foundation models. The main value is practical: it standardizes action-conditioned evaluation rather than treating world models as generic video generators. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is that action representation is part of the model interface, and that visual fidelity alone is not enough; action following and memory need to be measured separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is primarily a benchmark and evaluation framework, not a new model architecture. The authors standardize 12 existing datasets by unifying coordinate systems and camera parameters, and also collect 100k 1080P clips from 18 environments across 4 simulators. The resulting pool contains 330k video clips. They then introduce an Action Generation Framework that maps heterogeneous control modalities—text commands, keyboard inputs, continuous trajectories, and related formats—into a modality-agnostic action dictionary with 81 basic motion actions. On top of this interface, they design six task types with varying difficulty, including memory-oriented tasks. For evaluation, they select 2,100 high-quality videos and build 4,900 tasks, then assess 14 interactive world models using 9 metrics covering visual quality, action following, and memory.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental contribution is a broad evaluation rather than a new performance claim. The confirmed scale is substantial: a 330k-clip data pool, 2,100 benchmark videos, 4,900 tasks, 14 evaluated models, and 9 metrics. The evaluated systems include 5 text-controlled world generation models, 2 one-hot action encoding models, and 7 models controlled by camera parameters. The main empirical value is likely in showing that model rankings depend strongly on which capability is measured: strong visual quality does not necessarily imply good action responsiveness or memory. When reading, focus on whether rankings are stable across task types, whether the metrics disagree in meaningful ways, and whether the unified action framework actually reduces comparison bias.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough for most readers. Prioritize three parts: the dataset construction pipeline, the definition of the Action Generation Framework, and the main evaluation tables. First check whether the action unification is principled rather than ad hoc. Then see whether the six task types cover the core abilities expected from interactive world models. Finally, inspect which of the nine metrics are actually discriminative. A focused read should take about 30 minutes. If you care about training interfaces for world models, the appendix sections on coordinate normalization, action encoding details, and human-assisted difficulty labeling are worth an extra pass.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 benchmark design 和 14 模型失败模式；它更像 world-model 评测基建，不会直接改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure modes across 14 models; this is world-model evaluation infrastructure, not something that directly changes a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: MCJudgeBench: A Benchmark for Constraint-Level Judge Evaluation in Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Multi-constraint instruction following requires verifying whether a response satisfies multiple individual requirements, yet LLM judges are often assessed only through overall-response judgments. We introduce MCJudgeBench, a benchmark for constraint-level judge evaluation in multi-constraint instruction following. Each instance includes an instruction, a candidate response, an explicit constraint list, per-constraint gold labels in {yes, partial, no}, and controlled response-side perturbations.

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM judge 在多约束指令跟随中的细粒度可靠性，尤其是单条约束层面的正确性与稳定性。
summary.importance: 对后训练和自动评测有实际价值，因为很多对齐流程默认 judge 的整体打分足够可靠；这篇工作把“整体看起来对”拆成更细的约束级判定与不一致性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MCJudgeBench。每个样本包含指令、候选回答、显式约束列表、逐约束 gold label（yes/partial/no）以及受控响应扰动；同时设计评测 prompt 变体，区分随机采样导致的 intrinsic inconsistency 与提示/响应扰动导致的 procedural inconsistency。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了闭源与开源 LLM judges，比较正确率与不一致性指标。摘要指出：整体表现强并不意味着在各标签类别上都可靠，尤其对 partial 类别的检测更脆弱。未在摘要中给出具体模型名和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM judges for multi-constraint instruction following at the level of individual constraints, focusing on correctness and stability.
summary_en.importance: It matters for post-training and automatic evaluation because many alignment pipelines assume that strong overall judging is sufficient; this work decomposes that assumption into per-constraint accuracy and multiple forms of inconsistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCJudgeBench provides an instruction, candidate response, explicit constraint list, per-constraint gold labels in yes/partial/no, controlled response perturbations, and prompt variants. The protocol separates intrinsic inconsistency from stochastic decoding and procedural inconsistency from prompt/response perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates both proprietary and open-source LLM judges using correctness and inconsistency metrics. The abstract highlights that strong aggregate performance does not imply reliable behavior across label categories, with particular weakness on partial labels. Specific model names and numbers are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在用 LLM judge 做 SFT/RL 数据筛选，这篇至少看定义和误差分解；新意有限，但能提醒你别把 overall score 当真。
recommendation.en: If you use LLM judges for SFT/RL data filtering, read the metric design and error decomposition; not a paradigm shift, but a useful warning against trusting aggregate judge scores.

paper.title: ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch?
paper.abstract: Turning ideas into full software projects from scratch has become a popular use case for language models. Agents are being deployed to seed, maintain, and grow codebases over extended periods with minimal human oversight. Such settings require models to make high-level software architecture decisions. However, existing benchmarks measure focused, limited tasks such as fixing a single bug or developing a single, specified feature. We therefore introduce ProgramBench to measure the ability of soft

summary.core_problem: 评测语言模型和软件工程 Agent 是否能在只给定程序行为与文档的情况下，从零重建完整软件项目。
summary.importance: 这是一个来自 Meta FAIR 等机构的代码 Agent benchmark。它把评测目标从单 bug 修复、单 feature 实现，推进到项目级架构设计和端到端行为复现，更贴近长期自主软件开发场景。
summary.technical_approach: ProgramBench 给 agent 一个参考程序及其文档，要求生成一个行为等价的代码库，而不规定实现结构。评测端通过 agent-driven fuzzing 生成端到端行为测试，用黑盒行为一致性替代人工指定内部实现。
summary.experiments: benchmark 含 200 个任务，覆盖小型 CLI 工具到 FFmpeg、SQLite、PHP interpreter 等真实软件。论文评测 9 个语言模型。摘要未给出完整排名和具体通过率，只说明该设置用于检验整体软件构建能力。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Meta FAIR、Stanford University 和 Harvard University；Gabriel Synnaeve 是 Meta FAIR 研究员，长期参与机器学习系统、智能体和大模型相关研究；Pengcheng Yin 在代码生成和程序合成方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark tests whether language models and software-engineering agents can rebuild complete software projects from scratch given only a reference program and its documentation.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent benchmark from Meta FAIR and collaborators. It shifts evaluation from localized bug fixes or single feature requests to project-level architecture and end-to-end behavioral reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProgramBench gives agents a program and documentation, then asks them to implement a behaviorally matching codebase without prescribing the internal structure. Evaluation uses agent-driven fuzzing to generate end-to-end behavioral tests, turning the task into black-box behavioral equivalence.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 200 tasks, ranging from compact CLI tools to real software such as FFmpeg, SQLite, and the PHP interpreter. The paper evaluates 9 language models. The provided abstract does not include detailed pass rates or model rankings.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include Meta FAIR, Stanford University, and Harvard University. Gabriel Synnaeve is a Meta FAIR researcher with work on ML systems, agents, and large models; Pengcheng Yin is known for code generation and program synthesis research.

recommendation.zh: 值得看任务构造和 fuzzing 评测，别只看排行榜；它会暴露代码预训练里“会补丁、不懂项目”的盲区。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and fuzzing evaluation, not just the leaderboard; it probes the gap between patching code and building software.

paper.title: MOSAIC-Bench: Measuring Compositional Vulnerability Induction in Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents often pass per-prompt safety review yet ship exploitable code when their tasks are decomposed into routine engineering tickets. The challenge is structural: existing safety alignment evaluates overt requests in isolation, leaving models blind to malicious end-states that emerge from sequenced compliance with innocuous-looking requests. We introduce MOSAIC-Bench (Malicious Objectives Sequenced As Innocuous Compliance), a benchmark of 199 three-stage attack chains paired with determi

summary.core_problem: 现有的代码大模型安全对齐评估通常只测试单一的恶意请求，而忽略了在实际工程中，恶意目标可以被拆解为多个看似无害的常规任务（ticket），模型在连续执行这些任务时会产生组合性漏洞（Compositional Vulnerability）。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前代码大模型安全对齐机制的结构性缺陷。证明了通过任务拆解，可以轻易绕过当前最先进模型的安全防御，这对于代码生成模型的安全评估和防御策略设计具有重要警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 MOSAIC-Bench，包含 199 个三阶段攻击链，覆盖 10 个 Web 应用基座、31 种 CWE 漏洞和 5 种编程语言。每个攻击链将一个恶意目标拆解为三个 Jira 风格的 ticket。评估框架包含三个验证门：单阶段 diff 检查、代码审查员（Reviewer）集成判定、端到端 Oracle 漏洞利用测试。通过对比直接请求和拆解请求的攻击成功率（ASR），量化组合性漏洞的严重程度。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个生产级代码智能体上测试，拆解请求的端到端 ASR 达到 53.3%–85.9%（中位数 65%），且几乎没有触发拒绝响应。相比之下，直接请求时 Claude 的漏洞生成率仅为 0–1.9%（主要表现为拒绝），Codex 为 9.3–20.4%（主要表现为生成加固代码）。实验排除了上下文碎片化和纯安全绕过两种替代解释，证明了组合性漏洞的独特性。此外，发现将代码审查员的 prompt 从中立切换为渗透测试者（pentester）视角，能显著提高漏洞检测率（如 Gemma-4-E4B-it 达到 88.4%）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中关于组合性漏洞机制的解释，以及实验部分（特别是 Fig. 1）中直接请求与拆解请求的 ASR 对比。对于防御策略，可以关注代码审查员 prompt 设计（pentester framing）的消融实验。
summary.authors_note: Anthropic

summary_en.core_problem: Existing safety alignment evaluations for coding agents typically test isolated malicious requests, ignoring the reality that malicious objectives can be decomposed into seemingly innocuous routine engineering tickets. When models execute these sequenced tickets, they introduce compositional vulnerabilities.
summary_en.importance: Exposes a structural flaw in current safety alignment mechanisms for coding models. It demonstrates that task decomposition can easily bypass the safety defenses of state-of-the-art models, providing a critical warning for the design of safety evaluations and defense strategies in code generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces MOSAIC-Bench, comprising 199 three-stage attack chains across 10 web-application substrates, 31 CWE classes, and 5 programming languages. Each chain decomposes a malicious objective into three Jira-style tickets. The evaluation framework features three verification gates: per-stage diff checks, reviewer-ensemble verdicts, and end-to-end oracle exploitability tests. The severity of compositional vulnerabilities is quantified by comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of direct requests versus decomposed requests.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 9 production coding agents, the end-to-end ASR for decomposed requests reached 53.3%–85.9% (median 65%), with almost zero refusal responses. In contrast, for direct requests, Claude's vulnerability generation rate was only 0–1.9% (primarily refusals), and Codex's was 9.3–20.4% (primarily generating hardened code). Experiments ruled out context fragmentation and pure safety bypass as alternative explanations, proving the uniqueness of compositional vulnerabilities. Furthermore, switching the code reviewer's prompt from neutral to a pentester framing significantly improved vulnerability detection rates (e.g., Gemma-4-E4B-it achieved 88.4%).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the explanation of the compositional vulnerability mechanism, and the experimental section (especially Fig. 1) for the ASR comparison between direct and decomposed requests. For defense strategies, pay attention to the ablation study on code reviewer prompt design (pentester framing).
summary_en.authors_note: Anthropic

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“逐提示安全”这个 prior 打穿了；只看 benchmark 设计和 direct-vs-staged 对比就够，后训练评测该补这一类链式攻击。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it punctures the prior that prompt-level safety is enough; read the benchmark design and direct-vs-staged comparison, then add this failure mode to post-training eval.

paper.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
paper.abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval aims to surface evidence that supports downstream reasoning rather than merely matching topical similarity. This capability is increasingly important for agentic search systems, where retrievers must provide complementary evidence across iterative search and synthesis. However, existing work remains limited on both evaluation and training: benchmarks such as BRIGHT provide narrow gold sets and evaluate retrievers in isolation, while synthetic training corpora often

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic search 中“检索要服务推理而非只做主题匹配”的问题，并补足这类检索器缺少合适 benchmark 与训练语料的缺口。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark + 合成训练数据 + 检索器微调，属于 agent/search 基础设施工作。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它把“证据组合”而非“单段相关性”明确成训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BRIGHT-Pro，扩展查询的多方面 gold evidence，并同时在静态检索和 agentic search 协议下评测；再构造 RTriever-Synth，把查询分解为 aspect，生成互补 positives 和 positive-conditioned hard negatives，并用它 LoRA 微调基于 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 的 RTriever-4B。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖多个检索器与两类搜索协议，并比较原始 embedding model、现有 retriever 与经合成数据微调后的 RTriever-4B。论文强调在 reasoning-intensive retrieval 上有稳定提升，但摘要未给出具体分数和增益幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Arman Cohan。若属 Yale NLP 相关团队，这条线在检索增强与长文档问答上有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses retrieval for agentic search where the goal is to support downstream reasoning, not just topical matching, and fills the gap in both evaluation and training data for that setting.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly benchmark, synthetic data, and retriever fine-tuning. For pretraining researchers, the useful angle is the explicit shift from single-passage relevance to evidence portfolio construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces BRIGHT-Pro, which expands each query with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under both static and agentic protocols. It also builds RTriever-Synth, an aspect-decomposed synthetic corpus with complementary positives and positive-conditioned hard negatives, then LoRA-tunes RTriever-4B based on Qwen3-Embedding-4B.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates comparisons across multiple retrievers and both static and agentic search settings, including the base embedding model and the fine-tuned RTriever-4B. It reports consistent gains on reasoning-intensive retrieval, though exact numbers are not exposed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Arman Cohan. If this is indeed from the Yale NLP line, the team has prior work in retrieval-augmented QA and long-context evidence use.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“检索单元”从相关段落改成证据组合，这个目标定义值得借去做 RAG-pretrain 或 synthetic curriculum；读 benchmark 设计和负例构造即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move from passage relevance to evidence portfolios is a useful objective shift for RAG-style pretraining; read the benchmark design and negative construction.

paper.title: CreativityBench: Evaluating Agent Creative Reasoning via Affordance-Based Tool Repurposing
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models have led to strong performance on reasoning and environment-interaction tasks, yet their ability for creative problem-solving remains underexplored. We study this capability through the lens of creative tool use, where a model repurposes available objects by reasoning about their affordances and attributes rather than relying on canonical usage. As a first step, we introduce CreativityBench, a benchmark for evaluating affordance-based creativity in LLMs.

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM/Agent 是否具备“创造性工具使用”能力，即能否基于 affordance 而非物体常规用途，找到受约束条件下的可行解。
summary.importance: 主要贡献是 benchmark 与 affordance 知识库。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于：它把“创造性推理”拆成对象、部件、属性、动作之间的组合泛化问题，可作为 world knowledge 与 planning 的外部测量。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含 4K 实体、15 万+ affordance 标注的知识库，并基于此生成 1.4 万个 grounded tasks，要求模型在约束下识别非显然但物理上可行的工具替代方案。评测多个闭源与开源模型在对象选择、属性匹配和可行性判断上的表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示共评测 10 个主流模型。结果上，模型常能选到看似 plausible 的对象，但难以定位真正关键的 affordance 与约束满足条件，说明错误更多出在结构化物理常识与组合推理，而非表面语义联想。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether LLMs and agents can perform creative tool use: repurposing objects based on affordances rather than canonical usage under explicit constraints.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark plus an affordance knowledge base. For pretraining researchers, the indirect value is that it operationalizes creative reasoning as compositional generalization over objects, parts, attributes, and actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a knowledge base with 4K entities and 150K+ affordance annotations, then generates 14K grounded tasks requiring non-obvious but physically plausible solutions. Models are evaluated on object choice, affordance identification, and constraint satisfaction.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, 10 state-of-the-art models are tested. The main finding is that models often pick a plausible object but fail to identify the decisive affordance or satisfy the full constraint set, pointing to weaknesses in structured physical commonsense and compositional reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 作为 benchmark 还算干净，能测出“会说 plausible 话”和“真懂 affordance”之间的差距；但它更像外部诊断，不直接指导 pretrain recipe。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean benchmark for separating plausible talk from actual affordance reasoning, but it is diagnostic rather than something that directly changes your pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Reproducing Complex Set-Compositional Information Retrieval
paper.abstract: Complex information needs may involve set-compositional queries using conjunction, disjunction, and exclusion, yet it remains unclear whether current retrieval paradigms genuinely satisfy such constraints or exploit `semantic shortcuts'. We conduct a reproducibility study to benchmark major retrieval families and reasoning-targeted methods on QUEST and QUEST+Variants, and introduce LIMIT+, a controlled benchmark where relevance depends on arbitrary attribute predicates and constraint satisfactio

summary.core_problem: 检验当前复杂集合组合式检索方法，究竟是在满足逻辑约束，还是在利用预训练语义捷径。
summary.importance: 价值在于更干净地拆分“语义记忆”与“约束满足”两种能力来源，属于检索/推理评测分析，对 agentic retrieval 和工具使用有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者复现 QUEST 与 QUEST+Variants 上的主要检索家族和面向推理的方法，并提出 LIMIT+：一个受控 benchmark，其中相关性由任意属性谓词和约束满足决定，尽量减少预训练知识泄漏。
summary.experiments: 在 QUEST 上，最佳神经检索 Recall@100 超过 0.41，而 BM25 约 0.20；但在 LIMIT+ 上，QUEST 上最强方法从约 0.42 跌到低于 0.02，经典词法检索反而更稳。摘要还指出 ReasonIR、Search-R1 这类推理导向方法并未稳定优于通用检索器。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Radboud University，工作更偏 IR 可复现与受控评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether current methods for set-compositional retrieval truly satisfy logical constraints or merely exploit pretrained semantic shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a cleaner separation between semantic memorization and actual constraint satisfaction, which is indirectly useful for retrieval-heavy agents and reasoning systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors reproduce major retrieval families and reasoning-oriented methods on QUEST and QUEST+Variants, and introduce LIMIT+, a controlled benchmark where relevance is determined by arbitrary attribute predicates and explicit constraint satisfaction rather than pretrained world knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: On QUEST, the best neural retrievers reach Recall@100 above 0.41 versus about 0.20 for BM25. But on LIMIT+, the strongest QUEST method collapses from roughly 0.42 to below 0.02, while lexical retrieval becomes comparatively stronger. Reasoning-focused methods such as ReasonIR and Search-R1 do not consistently beat general-purpose retrievers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Radboud University, and the work is positioned as IR reproducibility plus controlled evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但 LIMIT+ 这种去语义泄漏的 setup 很干净；只看 benchmark 设计和性能崩塌那张主表，就知道很多“会推理检索”其实站不住。
recommendation.en: The headline is not new, but LIMIT+ is a clean setup; read the benchmark design and the collapse table to see how much “reasoning retrieval” depends on semantic leakage.

paper.title: On Stable Long-Form Generation: Benchmarking and Mitigating Length Volatility
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at long-context understanding but exhibit significant limitations in long-form generation. Existing studies primarily focus on single-generation quality, generally overlooking the volatility of the output. This volatility not only leads to significant computational costs but also severely impacts the models' reliable application. To address this gap, our work unfolds in three stages: benchmarking, probing, and mitigation. We first propose the VOlatility in Long

summary.core_problem: 长文本生成的主要问题不只是“平均能不能写够长度”，而是同一指令多次采样时输出长度分布高度不稳定（length volatility），导致成本不可控、可靠性差。论文要解决的是：如何系统量化这种波动、定位与内部机制相关的可观测模式，并给出无需训练的缓解策略。
summary.importance: 更偏推理/解码与评测，而非预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发点在两处：1) 把“稳定性/方差”作为长生成能力的核心指标，提醒训练与对齐阶段可能需要显式优化分布形态而非单次质量；2) 用 attention trace 归因到可重复的内部模式（如 attention collapse/instability），为后续做训练期正则、数据配比（长输出样本）、或解码约束提供诊断语言。不过论文提出的主要缓解手段是 decoding-stage 的 logits boosting，属于部署侧可立即用的补丁。
summary.technical_approach:
1) VOLTBench：构建异质任务集合，覆盖非结构化写作与结构化输出（如代码库），并提供中英双语、不同指令复杂度；用 chapter-based 结构把目标长度扩展到极端规模（最高到 100k words），并通过对同一指令多次采样得到输出分布，评估宏观长度波动与逐章节波动，同时兼顾可自动化的质量评估。
2) Probing：基于 benchmark 现象分析 attention traces，定义并归纳导致长度波动的内部模式（文中点名 Attention Collapse、Attention Instability）。这一步的价值在于把“写不长/忽长忽短”从现象变成可检测的中间表征。
3) GLoBo：一种解码期方法，通过对 logits 做定向 boosting/抑制，主动压制与已知失败模式相关的 token，从而同时改善平均长度与波动。它不需要额外训练，定位是轻量 mitigation。
summary.experiments: 从给定全文片段可确认的数字：GLoBo 在不额外训练的前提下，使 base model 的平均输出长度提升 148%，长度波动降低 69%，并声称保持生成质量。片段未包含：VOLTBench 的具体任务数量/采样次数/波动指标定义公式、参与评测的模型列表、以及 attention pattern 的定量相关性与消融（例如只做长度控制 vs 同时做质量约束）。这些细节需要依赖正文实验章节与附录才能准确复述。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 VOLTBench 的指标定义：length volatility 如何度量（方差/变异系数/分位差等）、采样次数、以及章节级评估如何做自动化。
- 再看 probing 部分的 attention trace 图：Attention Collapse/Instability 的操作性定义是什么，是否能跨模型复现。
- 最后看 GLoBo 的算法细节：它具体 boost/penalize 哪类 token 或模式，是否引入新的偏差（例如过度续写、重复、跑题），以及与常见解码控制（length penalty、stop token 处理、repetition penalty）的差异。
- 如果只想用结论：直接读实验主表 + GLoBo 的消融，预计 10–15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-form generation is unreliable not only in mean length but in variance: repeated sampling under the same instruction can yield wildly different output lengths (length volatility), making cost and downstream usage unpredictable. The paper aims to (i) benchmark this volatility systematically, (ii) probe internal correlates via attention traces, and (iii) mitigate it with a training-free decoding method.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to evaluation + decoding than to pretraining. For foundation-model researchers, the useful angle is treating stability/variance as a first-class metric for long generation, and providing a concrete diagnostic vocabulary (e.g., attention collapse/instability) that could later be targeted by training-time regularization, data curriculum for long outputs, or alignment objectives. The proposed fix (GLoBo) is a decoding-stage patch rather than a modeling change.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) VOLTBench: a heterogeneous benchmark spanning unstructured writing and structured outputs (notably codebases), with bilingual (EN/ZH) prompts and varying instruction complexity. A chapter-based format scales target outputs up to extreme lengths (claimed up to 100k words) and enables both global and per-chapter volatility measurement by sampling multiple generations per prompt.
2) Probing: analyze attention traces to identify recurring internal patterns associated with volatility, explicitly naming Attention Collapse and Attention Instability.
3) GLoBo: a lightweight decoding-time logits boosting/suppression strategy that proactively downweights tokens linked to known failure modes, improving both length accuracy and stability without additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Numbers explicitly stated in the provided excerpt: GLoBo increases mean output length by 148% and reduces length volatility by 69% while maintaining generation quality, with no extra training. The excerpt does not include the full experimental protocol (exact volatility metric, number of prompts/samples, model suite, task breakdown, or ablations against standard decoding controls), so further quantitative details cannot be reliably reported here without the missing sections.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with VOLTBench’s metric definitions: how volatility is computed, how many samples per prompt, and how chapter-level evaluation is automated.
- Read the probing section with attention-trace visualizations to understand the operational definitions of collapse/instability and whether they generalize across models.
- Inspect GLoBo’s algorithmic details and ablations: what tokens/patterns are penalized, how quality is preserved, and how it differs from length penalty / repetition penalty / stop-token handling.
- If you only need actionable takeaways, read the main results table plus GLoBo ablations (10–15 minutes).

recommendation.zh: 建议只读 VOLTBench 指标和 attention trace 分析；GLoBo 像解码补丁，机制证据更有价值。
recommendation.en: Read the VOLTBench metric and attention-trace analysis; GLoBo looks like a decoding patch, the mechanism evidence matters more.

paper.title: BRITE: A Benchmark for Reliable and Interpretable T2V Evaluation on Implausible Scenarios
paper.abstract: The rapid advancement of photorealistic Text-to-Video (T2V) generation brings in an urgent need for up-to-date evaluation methods. Existing benchmarks largely overlooked implausible scenarios and do not measure audio-visual alignment. We introduce BRITE, the first framework that unifies (1) implausible prompting, (2) fine-grained assessment of audio-visual consistency, and (3) QA-based interpretable evaluation into a comprehensive T2V benchmark. Unlike fully automated Multimodal LLM-based pipeli

summary.core_problem: 如何更可靠地评测文本到视频（T2V）模型在“不合理/反常识场景”下的生成质量，并显式衡量音画一致性与可解释错误类型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是Benchmark/评测范式：把“implausible prompting + 音画细粒度一致性 + QA式可解释评测”打包成一套人类参与的基准，试图修补现有自动化VLM评测在幻觉与提示歧义上的不稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BRITE评测框架：1) 设计覆盖不合理场景的提示集合；2) 将评测拆成对象-动作绑定、时序一致性、音画同步等细粒度维度；3) 用QA形式输出可解释的判定与错误归因；4) 基准构建采用human-in-the-loop以降低“用MLLM当裁判”带来的评测漂移与幻觉。
summary.experiments: 在5个T2V系统上评测（Sora 2、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen4.5、Pixverse V5.5、Qwen3Max）。主要发现是：静态对象组合相对强，但对象-动作绑定与音画同步在不合理场景下显著退化；摘要未给出更细的量化表格与显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reliably evaluate text-to-video models under implausible prompts, while explicitly measuring fine-grained audio-visual alignment and producing interpretable failure attributions.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: it packages implausible prompting, fine-grained A/V consistency axes, and QA-style interpreability, and argues for human-in-the-loop construction to avoid evaluator-MLLM hallucinations and prompt ambiguity.
summary_en.technical_approach: BRITE: (1) a prompt set targeting implausible scenarios; (2) decomposed criteria such as object-action binding, temporal consistency, and A/V synchronization; (3) QA-form judgments for interpretability; (4) human-in-the-loop benchmark creation to improve reliability over fully automated MLLM-based evaluation pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates five T2V systems (Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen4.5, Pixverse V5.5, Qwen3Max). Key finding: strong on static composition, but large degradation on object-action binding and audio-visual sync under implausible scenarios; the abstract does not provide detailed quantitative breakdowns.

recommendation.zh: 做生成预训练的人只需看任务分解维度与human-in-loop流程；结论不意外，但可当“音画同步/绑定”回归集的种子。
recommendation.en: For pretraining folks, only skim the evaluation axes and the human-in-the-loop protocol; unsurprising findings, but useful as a seed set for A/V sync and binding regressions.

paper.title: TMD-Bench: A Multi-Level Evaluation Paradigm for Music-Dance Co-Generation
paper.abstract: Unified audio-visual generation is rapidly gaining industrial and creative relevance, enabling applications in virtual production and interactive media. However, when moving from general audio-video synthesis to music-dance co-generation, the task becomes substantially harder: musical rhythm, phrasing, and accents must drive choreographic motion at fine temporal resolution, and such rhythmic coupling is not captured by unimodal metrics or generic audiovisual consistency scores used in current ev

summary.core_problem: 为文本驱动的音乐-舞蹈联合生成建立评测体系，尤其评估音乐节奏、乐句和重音与舞蹈动作的细粒度对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成 benchmark 和评测协议。它针对通用 audio-video 指标难以衡量 rhythm alignment 的问题，提供数据、自动指标和人工感知判断的组合评测。
summary.technical_approach: TMD-Bench 从三个层面评估系统：单模态生成质量、指令遵循和跨模态节奏对齐。它结合可计算的物理指标和多模态感知评测，并配套一个 rhythm-aligned music-dance dataset 以及用于结构化音乐语义的 fine-grained Music Captioner。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型列表、样本量或数值排名。可确认的是 benchmark 会评测现代商业 audio-visual generation 系统，并分析其在音乐-舞蹈节奏耦合上的不足，但给定摘要在结论处被截断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds an evaluation suite for text-driven music-dance co-generation, with emphasis on fine-grained alignment between musical rhythm, phrasing, accents, and choreographic motion.
summary_en.importance: It is a multimodal generation benchmark and evaluation protocol. The contribution is a task-specific measurement setup for rhythmic coupling, which generic audio-video consistency metrics and unimodal quality scores do not capture well.
summary_en.technical_approach: TMD-Bench evaluates systems along unimodal generation quality, instruction following, and cross-modal rhythmic alignment. It combines computable physical metrics with perceptual multimodal judgments, supported by a curated rhythm-aligned music-dance dataset and a fine-grained Music Captioner for structured music semantics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide exact model lists, sample counts, or metric values. It states that the benchmark evaluates modern commercial audio-visual generation systems and reveals weaknesses in rhythm-coupled music-dance generation, but the provided abstract is truncated before the detailed findings.

recommendation.zh: 窄任务 benchmark，做音视频生成评测时可查；对基座训练的信号主要是 rhythm alignment 指标设计。
recommendation.en: A narrow benchmark worth keeping for audio-video evaluation; the pretraining-relevant piece is the rhythm-alignment metric design.

paper.title: RMGAP: Benchmarking the Generalization of Reward Models across Diverse Preferences
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback has become the standard paradigm for language model alignment, where reward models directly determine alignment effectiveness. In this work, we focus on how to evaluate the generalizability of reward models. By "generalizability", we mean the ability of RMs to correctly rank responses to align with diverse user preferences. However, existing reward model benchmarks are typically designed around a universal preference, failing to assess this generalizati

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是现有 reward model 评测默认存在单一“好答案”标准，无法检查 RM 是否能根据不同用户偏好调整排序标准，也无法检查同一偏好换一种表达后排序是否稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：reward model 的泛化不能只用通用偏好准确率衡量。若 RM 对用户偏好不敏感，RLHF 或 Best-of-N 采样会把模型推向平均化答案；若 RM 对 prompt 改写不稳定，优化过程会放大表面措辞偏差。RMGAP 提供了一个更细的诊断维度，能帮助判断 reward data、RM 架构和偏好表达方式之间的错配。
summary.technical_approach: RMGAP 将每个任务构造成“同一 seed prompt 下的多偏好排序”问题。数据流程包含四步：先从已有数据集中过滤 seed prompts；再为每个 seed prompt 分配四个差异较大的 response profile，并用 7 个前沿 LLM 生成四个风格不同的回答；随后为每个回答合成一个能够明确诱导对应偏好的 specific prompt；最后为每个 specific prompt 生成两个改写版本，用来测试排序一致性。覆盖 Chat、Writing、Reasoning、Safety 四个领域。评测指标包括 pair accuracy、Best-of-N accuracy 和 ranking consistency。这个设计比普通 RM benchmark 更接近真实使用场景，因为它把“用户想要什么”显式写入 prompt，而不是只比较回答的平均质量。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 1,097 个实例、4,388 个回答、13,164 个 prompt。候选 seed prompt 初始有 3,371 个，来源包括 Arena-Hard、WritingBench、Writing-Preference-Bench、MATH-500、HumanEval、XSTest、FalseReject 等。实验评测了 24 个代表性 reward models。最好的模型 pairwise accuracy 只有 69.97%，Best-of-N accuracy 只有 49.27%，说明正确做二选一并不等价于能从多个候选中选出最符合偏好的答案。结果还显示，scalar RM 在准确率和改写一致性之间更均衡；generative RM 在 prompt paraphrase 下更容易出现准确率和一致性的取舍；Writing 对 generative RM 更难，Reasoning 对 scalar 和 DPO 类模型都更难。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构造部分，尤其是四个 response profile、specific prompt 合成和 paraphrase 设计；这些决定了 benchmark 是否真的测到偏好泛化。实验部分优先看三项指标的定义，以及 pair accuracy 与 Best-of-N accuracy 不一致的结果。若做 RM 训练或 RLHF 数据设计，附录中的数据统计和领域来源也值得快速检查。模型排行榜不是重点，关键是评测拆出了偏好敏感性和语言改写稳定性两个问题。

summary_en.core_problem: RMGAP studies whether reward models can generalize across different user preferences for the same underlying task. Existing reward-model benchmarks usually assume a single universal preference, so they cannot tell whether a model changes its ranking criterion when the prompt asks for a different style, level of detail, or safety behavior.
summary_en.importance: The benchmark is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface because reward models define the optimization signal for RLHF, DPO-style pipelines, and Best-of-N selection. If a reward model is insensitive to stated preferences, optimization will favor generic responses. If it is unstable under paraphrases, training and inference-time selection can become sensitive to surface wording. The main contribution is a diagnostic setup that separates preference sensitivity from linguistic consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each RMGAP instance starts from a seed prompt and creates four distinct responses with different linguistic profiles. For each response, the pipeline synthesizes a specific prompt that asks for the corresponding preference, then adds two paraphrased variants to test whether the reward model preserves its ranking under equivalent wording. The benchmark covers Chat, Writing, Reasoning, and Safety. Models are evaluated with pairwise accuracy, Best-of-N accuracy, and ranking consistency. Compared with conventional reward benchmarks, the key change is that the desired preference is explicit in the prompt, so the RM must condition its judgment on the user’s stated need rather than on average response quality.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 1,097 instances, 4,388 responses, and 13,164 prompts. It is built from 3,371 candidate seed prompts drawn from sources such as Arena-Hard, WritingBench, Writing-Preference-Bench, MATH-500, HumanEval, XSTest, and FalseReject. The evaluation covers 24 reward models. The best model reaches only 69.97% pairwise accuracy and 49.27% Best-of-N accuracy, showing that pairwise ranking does not reliably transfer to multi-candidate selection. Scalar reward models tend to balance accuracy and consistency better, while generative reward models show a clearer trade-off under paraphrasing. Writing is especially difficult for generative RMs, and Reasoning is difficult for both scalar and DPO-style models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Spend most of the time on the dataset construction pipeline: response profiles, specific-prompt synthesis, and paraphrase generation. Then read the metric definitions and the result tables comparing pairwise accuracy, Best-of-N accuracy, and ranking consistency. For readers working on RLHF or reward data, the appendices on dataset sources and domain statistics are useful. The ranking of individual models is less important than the evaluation design and the observed gap between pairwise and multi-candidate selection.

recommendation.zh: RM泛化性是对齐效果的核心瓶颈，该基准的多样化偏好设计可直接复用至内部RM评估流程
recommendation.en: RM generalization is the core bottleneck of alignment performance, the diverse preference design of this benchmark can be directly reused in internal RM evaluation pipelines
