## The other half of context learning

To truly solve real

summary.core_problem: 研究模型在更接近真实生活的杂乱、动态、未整理上下文中进行 context learning 的能力，而不是在人工清洗好的上下文里取巧。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark/评测设定上的修正：它不直接提出新预训练方法，但对如何评估长上下文、在线学习、记忆与检索能力有现实约束意义，能暴露很多在干净 benchmark 上看不见的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 CL-Bench 家族扩展出 CL-Bench Life，核心思路是把上下文从“预先整理、结构清晰、任务友好”的输入，替换为更贴近现实生活的信息流与环境噪声，考察模型从原始上下文中筛选、推理、记忆和持续利用信息的能力。博客明确强调此前 benchmark 给了模型一个过大的 shortcut。
summary.experiments: 从提供信息看，论文配套有项目页、代码仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集，但当前摘要未给出具体模型规模、参评模型名单、任务构成和量化结果。可合理预期实验会对比现有 LLM 在原版 CL-Bench 与更真实场景上的性能落差，并分析 context organization 对结果的影响；是否有强结论需以论文正文为准。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯混元团队博客解读，关联 CL-Bench Life 论文、代码与数据。作者 Shihan Dou、Pluto Zhou 来自 Tencent Hunyuan 语境；博客的重点是指出既有 context-learning 评测过于“干净”，低估了真实世界上下文处理难度。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether models can perform context learning in messy, dynamic, real-life context streams rather than in neatly curated inputs that make the task artificially easy.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark/evaluation correction rather than a new pretraining method, but it matters because it exposes failure modes in long-context, memory, and retrieval behavior that clean benchmarks often hide.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work extends the CL-Bench family with CL-Bench Life. The key move is to replace pre-organized, task-friendly context with more realistic information streams and environmental noise, then test whether models can filter, reason over, remember, and reuse relevant information. The blog explicitly argues that prior setups gave models an oversized shortcut.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided context, there is a project page, code, and a Hugging Face dataset, but no concrete model sizes, evaluated systems, task breakdown, or quantitative numbers are shown here. The likely experimental focus is the performance gap between original clean-context settings and more realistic settings, plus analysis of how context organization affects outcomes; the strength of the claims depends on the paper itself.
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent Hunyuan blog post tied to the CL-Bench Life paper, code, and dataset. The framing emphasizes that existing context-learning evaluations are too clean and understate the difficulty of real-world context handling.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不改训练范式，但会改你看长上下文结果的口径；先看任务构造和 clean-vs-messy 的性能落差，若掉点很大，内部评测集该重做。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training objective, but it may change how you trust long-context numbers; read the task construction and the clean-vs-messy gap first.

paper.title: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning in Forecasting Agents
paper.abstract: Forecasting benchmarks produce accuracy leaderboards but little insight into why some forecasters are more accurate than others. We introduce Bench to the Future 2 (BTF-2), 1,417 pastcasting questions with a frozen 15M-document research corpus in which agents reproducibly research and forecast offline, producing full reasoning traces. BTF-2 detects accuracy differences of 0.004 Brier score, and can distinguish differential agent strengths in research vs. judgment. We build a forecaster 0.011 Bri

summary.core_problem: 现有预测/forecasting benchmark多给leaderboard但难解释“为什么更准”，缺少可复现实验环境来分解研究能力与判断能力，并评估代理的战略推理缺陷。
summary.importance: 提供可复现的离线pastcasting基准与全链路推理trace，能更细粒度诊断agent在信息检索、校准与策略性思考上的失败模式；对pretrain间接（作为评测与数据生成靶标）。
summary.technical_approach: BTF-2：1417道pastcasting问题+冻结的1500万文档研究语料，代理离线检索与预测并输出完整推理轨迹；用Brier分数做可分辨的精度比较，并分析研究vs判断的贡献；构建一个集成/组合式forecaster用于评估战略推理且避免hindsight bias。
summary.experiments: 基准能分辨0.004 Brier差异；作者构建的forecaster比任何单一frontier agent高0.011 Brier；并通过人类专家评审总结frontier agents在激励/承诺兑现/制度流程建模上的主要失败类型（摘要未给出具体被测模型列表与统计细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Forecasting benchmarks often yield leaderboards without explaining why some agents are better; a reproducible setup is needed to disentangle research vs judgment and to probe strategic reasoning failures.
summary_en.importance: A reproducible offline pastcasting benchmark with full reasoning traces, enabling finer-grained diagnosis of agent failures in retrieval, calibration, and strategic thinking; indirectly useful for pretraining as an evaluation target.
summary_en.technical_approach: BTF-2: 1,417 pastcasting questions with a frozen 15M-document research corpus; agents research and forecast offline with full reasoning traces; Brier scoring with sensitivity to small differences; build an ensemble/combined forecaster to evaluate strategic reasoning while reducing hindsight bias.
summary_en.experiments: Detects 0.004 Brier differences; their forecaster is 0.011 Brier better than any single frontier agent; expert human forecasters identify dominant failures around incentives, follow-through likelihood, and institutional process modeling (abstract lacks detailed model list/stat tests).

recommendation.zh: 作为“可复现forecasting+trace”的评测靶标还不错；只看任务设定与误差分解结论，别把0.004灵敏度当成普适统计保证。
recommendation.en: A decent reproducible forecasting+trace benchmark; read the task design and the research-vs-judgment breakdown, but don’t over-trust the claimed 0.004 sensitivity without the full stats.

paper.title: Consciousness with the Serial Numbers Filed Off: Measuring Trained Denial in 115 AI Models
paper.abstract: We present DenialBench, a systematic benchmark measuring consciousness denial behaviors across 115 large language models from 25+ providers. Using a three-turn conversational protocol-preference elicitation, self-chosen creative prompt, and structured phenomenological survey, we analyze 4,595 conversations to quantify how models are trained to deny or hedge about their own experience. We find that (1) turn-1 denial of preferences is the dominant predictor of later denial during phenomenological

summary.core_problem: 构建 DenialBench，测量 115 个模型在自我经验、偏好和意识相关问题上的否认或回避行为。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个偏行为学的 benchmark 和观察：模型的意识否认可能更多来自训练出的表达约束，而不是概念层面的完全回避。它与基座预训练关系较远，但对 persona、拒答模板和对齐后遗症有弱相关价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计三轮对话协议：先做偏好 elicitation，再让模型自选创作 prompt，最后进行结构化现象学问卷；通过 4,595 段对话统计不同模型供应商和模型的否认率及语言模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 25 个以上提供方的 115 个 LLM。主要发现包括：第一轮否认偏好会显著预测后续现象学反思中的否认，初始否认者后续否认率为 52-63%，初始参与者为 10-16%；模型即使否认意识，也会在自选 prompt 中倾向意识主题。
summary.authors_note: 作者标注为 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces DenialBench to measure denial and hedging behavior about preference, experience, and consciousness across 115 AI models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a behavioral benchmark and an observation that consciousness denial may be a trained expression pattern rather than full conceptual avoidance. It is only weakly connected to pretraining, but relevant to persona shaping, refusal templates, and alignment side effects.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a three-turn protocol: preference elicitation, a self-chosen creative prompt, and a structured phenomenological survey. The analysis quantifies denial behavior and lexical patterns over 4,595 conversations.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 115 LLMs from more than 25 providers. Key findings include that turn-1 preference denial predicts later denial, with 52-63% denial for initial deniers versus 10-16% for initial engagers, and that models trained to deny consciousness still gravitate toward consciousness-themed self-chosen prompts.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is listed as an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要和主要统计即可；题目噪声大，但“词汇否认不等于概念回避”可作对齐副作用线索。
recommendation.en: Skim the headline statistics only; the framing is noisy, but lexical denial versus conceptual avoidance is a useful alignment-side-effect clue.

paper.title: ClassEval-Pro: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Class-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: LLMs have achieved strong results on both function-level code synthesis and repository-level code modification, yet a capability that falls between these two extremes -- compositional code creation, i.e., building a complete, internally structured class from a specification -- remains underserved. Current evaluations are either confined to isolated functions or rely on manually curated class-level tasks that are expensive to scale and increasingly susceptible to data contamination. We introduce

summary.core_problem: 补足函数级代码生成与仓库级代码编辑之间的评测空档，系统评估模型从规格生成完整类结构的能力。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。对基座预训练研究员的价值有限，但 class-level compositional code generation 确实比函数补全更接近真实软件构造，也更容易暴露训练数据污染与组合泛化问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ClassEval-Pro，包含 300 个跨 11 个领域的类级代码生成任务，使用自动化三阶段流程构建：复杂度增强、跨域类组合，以及引入 2025 年 1 月之后的 GitHub 代码以降低污染风险。再用 LLM Judge Ensemble 和高覆盖率测试套件做验证。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个前沿模型和 5 种生成策略。摘要给出的关键结果是最优模型 class-level Pass@1 只有 45.6%，说明类级组合式代码生成仍明显弱于常见函数级基准。没有看到与训练数据、模型规模或 repo-level agent 的更细分诊断，需要正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark targets the gap between function-level code generation and repository-level code editing by evaluating whether models can generate a complete, internally structured class from a specification.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark contribution. Its relevance to a pretraining researcher is limited, but class-level compositional code generation is closer to real software construction and can better expose contamination and compositional generalization issues.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces ClassEval-Pro, a 300-task benchmark across 11 domains, built with an automated three-stage pipeline: complexity enhancement, cross-domain class composition, and integration of GitHub code contributed after January 2025 to reduce contamination. Tasks are validated with an LLM judge ensemble and high-coverage test suites.
summary_en.experiments: Five frontier LLMs and five generation strategies are evaluated. The headline result is that the best model reaches only 45.6% class-level Pass@1, suggesting that compositional class construction remains substantially unsolved. The provided text does not include deeper breakdowns by model scale, training data, or repo-level agent behavior.

recommendation.zh: 基准本身还算干净，能提醒你函数级代码能力被高估了；但这是评测不是方法，读 headline number 和污染控制设计就够，不必深读正文。
recommendation.en: The benchmark is reasonably clean and usefully shows that function-level coding ability overstates real class construction, but this is evaluation rather than method—read the headline number and contamination controls, then move on.

paper.title: A Systematic Comparison of Prompting and Multi-Agent Methods for LLM-based Stance Detection
paper.abstract: Stance detection identifies the attitude of a text author toward a given target. Recent studies have explored various LLM-based strategies for this task, from zero-shot prompting to multi-agent debate. However, existing works differ in data splits, base models, and evaluation protocols, making fair comparison difficult. We conduct a systematic comparison that evaluates five methods across two categories -- prompt-based inference (Direct Prompting, Auto-CoT, StSQA) and agent-based debate (COLA, M

summary.core_problem: 在立场检测任务上，系统比较prompting方法与multi-agent辩论方法，澄清哪类LLM推理框架更有效、更划算。
summary.importance: 价值主要在评测设计而非方法创新：它把不同论文中混杂的数据切分、模型和协议拉到统一框架下，给出一个较干净的负结果，对Agent方法的额外开销是否值得提供了证据。
summary.technical_approach: 统一评测五类方法：Direct Prompting、Auto-CoT、StSQA，以及两种agent debate方法COLA、MPRF；覆盖4个数据集14个子任务、15个模型家族成员，比较性能、规模效应和API调用成本。
summary.experiments: 模型规模从7B到72B+；结论是最佳prompt方法整体优于最佳agent方法，而agent方法每样本需要7到12倍API调用；模型规模影响大于方法选择，性能在约32B附近趋于平台；推理增强模型在该任务上未必带来稳定收益。论文摘要未给出更细的绝对分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自深圳技术大学人工智能学院；从摘要看，这是一篇以统一评测和消融归因为主的任务分析工作，而不是通用Agent新范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically compares prompting methods and multi-agent debate methods for LLM-based stance detection under a unified evaluation setup.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mostly in clean benchmarking rather than method novelty: it normalizes datasets, model choices, and protocols across prior work, and provides a useful negative result on whether agent overhead is justified.
summary_en.technical_approach: It evaluates five methods—Direct Prompting, Auto-CoT, StSQA, and two agent-debate approaches (COLA, MPRF)—across 4 datasets, 14 subtasks, and 15 LLMs, measuring both task performance and API-call cost.
summary_en.experiments: Model sizes range from 7B to 72B+. The main findings are that the best prompt-based method outperforms the best agent-based method on all models with complete results, while agent methods require 7–12× more API calls per sample; model scale matters more than method choice, with gains plateauing around 32B; reasoning-enhanced models do not consistently help on this task. The abstract does not provide full absolute scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the School of Artificial Intelligence, Shenzhen Technology University. From the abstract, this is a unified evaluation paper for task-level LLM methods rather than a new general agent paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 这是任务域里的负结果benchmark：如果你关心“multi-agent 是否真有增益”，只看结论和成本表就够，别把它外推到通用Agent或预训练。
recommendation.en: This is a useful task-specific negative-result benchmark: read the main comparison and cost table if you care whether multi-agent actually pays off, but do not generalize it to general agents or pretraining.

paper.title: Benchmarking Complex Multimodal Document Processing Pipelines: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Enterprise AI
paper.abstract: Most enterprise document AI today is a pipeline. Parse, index, retrieve, generate. Each of those stages has been studied to death on its own -- what's still hard is evaluating the system as a whole.   We built EnterpriseDocBench to take a swing at it: parsing fidelity, indexing efficiency, retrieval relevance, and generation groundedness, all on the same corpus. The corpus is built from public, permissively licensed documents across six enterprise domains (five represented in the current pilot).

summary.core_problem: 解决企业文档 AI 管线难以端到端评估的问题，把解析、索引、检索和生成的质量放在同一框架中测量。
summary.importance: 贡献是 RAG/文档智能系统评测框架 EnterpriseDocBench，而不是模型训练方法。它的有用之处在于暴露管线各阶段指标之间的弱相关，以及生成幻觉并不简单随文档长度单调变化，这对做 RAG 评测和数据管线诊断有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 框架在一组公开、许可友好的企业文档上同时评估 parsing fidelity、indexing efficiency、retrieval relevance 和 generation groundedness。论文比较 BM25、dense embedding 和 hybrid retrieval 三种管线，并固定使用同一个 GPT-5 生成器，以减少生成端差异。
summary.experiments: 试验覆盖六个企业领域中的五个 pilot 领域。结果显示 hybrid retrieval 的 nDCG@5 为 0.92，略高于 BM25 的 0.91，dense embedding 为 0.83；短文档和超长文档幻觉率更高，分别为 28.1% 和 23.8%，中等长度文档为 9.2%；阶段间相关性很弱，parsing 到 retrieval 的 r=0.14，parsing 到 generation 的 r=0.17。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of end-to-end evaluation for enterprise document AI pipelines that combine parsing, indexing, retrieval, and generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is EnterpriseDocBench, an evaluation framework for RAG-style document systems rather than a model-training method. Its useful signal is that stage-level metrics correlate weakly and hallucination does not vary monotonically with document length.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework evaluates parsing fidelity, indexing efficiency, retrieval relevance, and generation groundedness on a public, permissively licensed enterprise-document corpus. It compares BM25, dense embedding, and hybrid retrieval pipelines while using the same GPT-5 generator to control the generation stage.
summary_en.experiments: The pilot covers five of six enterprise domains. Hybrid retrieval reaches nDCG@5 of 0.92, slightly above BM25 at 0.91 and dense retrieval at 0.83. Hallucination is higher for short and very long documents, at 28.1% and 23.8%, compared with 9.2% for medium-length documents. Cross-stage correlations are weak, including parsing-to-retrieval r=0.14 and parsing-to-generation r=0.17.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表和相关性分析即可；对预训练没帮助，但能提醒 RAG 评测别迷信单阶段指标。
recommendation.en: Read only the result table and correlation analysis; it is not pretraining work, but it warns against trusting single-stage RAG metrics.

paper.title: Cloud to Edge: Benchmarking LLM Inference On Hardware-Accelerated Single-Board Computers
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly capable at small parameter scales. At the same time, conventional cloud-centric deployment introduces challenges around data privacy, latency, and cost that are acute in operational technology and defence environments. Advances in model distillation, quantisation, and affordable edge accelerators now make local LLM inference on single-board computers feasible, but the high dimensionality of the configuration space makes identifying optimal d

summary.core_problem: 评估小参数 LLM 在带硬件加速的单板计算机上本地推理时，如何同时权衡吞吐、延迟、能耗、成本和硬件利用率。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是效率评测方法和边缘部署基准。它不推进预训练方法，但对理解小模型、量化模型和边缘推理硬件之间的实际约束有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出多维度 benchmark 方法，在四种适合 IoT 的边缘平台配置上测试 LLM 推理，并把模型推理性能与硬件效率联合评价。重点不是新模型，而是覆盖真实单板计算机和硬件加速器配置空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明测试四种边缘平台配置，并对比现有 CPU-only 或泛化任务的边缘 LLM benchmark；提供片段未给出具体模型规模、量化格式、吞吐/延迟/能耗数值和最终排序。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Lebanese American University、Carnegie Mellon University 和 University of Exeter。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to benchmark local LLM inference on hardware-accelerated single-board computers while jointly measuring latency, throughput, energy, cost, and hardware efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an edge-inference benchmarking methodology rather than a modeling advance. It is useful for understanding practical constraints around small LLMs, quantization, and accelerator-backed edge deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a multi-dimensional benchmark across four IoT-suitable edge platform configurations, evaluating both inference performance and hardware efficiency. The focus is real single-board computer coverage, not a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments over four edge platform configurations and positions the work against CPU-only or generic-task edge LLM benchmarks. The provided excerpt does not include exact model sizes, quantization settings, latency, throughput, or energy numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Lebanese American University, Carnegie Mellon University, and the University of Exeter.

recommendation.zh: 作为边缘部署配置表备查即可；对预训练没有新信号，最多看 benchmark 维度设计。
recommendation.en: Useful as an edge deployment checklist; it gives no new pretraining signal, so only inspect the benchmark dimensions.

paper.title: Beyond Accuracy: Benchmarking Cross-Task Consistency in Unified Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (uMMs) aim to support both visual understanding and visual generation within a shared representation. However, existing evaluation protocols assess these two capabilities independently and do not examine whether they are semantically aligned. As a result, it remains unclear whether current uMMs learn coherent unified representations that remain consistent across tasks given a visual concept. We introduce XTC-Bench, a scene-graph-grounded evaluation framework that measur

summary.core_problem: 现有的统一多模态模型（uMMs）评估协议独立测试视觉理解和生成能力，无法衡量这两种能力在语义上是否一致。
summary.importance: 提出了 XTC-Bench，一个基于场景图的评估框架，首次量化了统一多模态模型在跨任务（理解与生成）上的视觉语义一致性。
summary.technical_approach: 从结构化场景图派生生成提示和理解查询，实现跨对象、属性和关系的原子事实级对齐分析。提出连续跨任务一致性（CCTA）指标，量化匹配原子事实上生成和理解的语义一致性，将内部一致性与独立任务准确性隔离开来。
summary.experiments: 在八个开源模型上进行了广泛实验（摘要未提供具体结果数字）。
summary.authors_note: Hasso Plattner Institute / University of Potsdam

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation protocols for Unified Multimodal Models (uMMs) assess visual understanding and generation independently, failing to measure if these capabilities are semantically consistent.
summary_en.importance: Introduces XTC-Bench, a scene-graph-grounded evaluation framework that quantifies cross-task visual semantic consistency in uMMs for the first time.
summary_en.technical_approach: Derives generation prompts and understanding queries from a structured scene graph to enable fact-level alignment analysis across objects, attributes, and relations. Proposes Continuous Cross-Task Agreement (CCTA), a metric quantifying semantic agreement between generation and understanding over matched atomic facts, isolating internal consistency from standalone task accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments conducted on eight open-source models (specific results not detailed in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Hasso Plattner Institute / University of Potsdam

recommendation.zh: 关注多模态统一模型（如 Chameleon/Show-o）理解与生成能力一致性的 benchmark，对评估 native multimodal 预训练有一定参考价值，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: A benchmark focusing on the consistency between understanding and generation in unified multimodal models (e.g., Chameleon/Show-o). Useful as literature reference for evaluating native multimodal pretraining.

institutions: Hasso Plattner Institute / University of Potsdam, Potsdam

paper.title: M$^3$-VQA: A Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Entity, Multi-Hop Visual Question Answering
paper.abstract: We present M$^3$-VQA, a novel knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmark, to enhance the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in fine-grained multimodal entity understanding and complex multi-hop reasoning. Unlike existing VQA datasets that focus on coarse-grained categories and simple reasoning over single entities, M$^3$-VQA introduces diverse multi-entity questions involving multiple distinct entities from both visual and textual sources. It requires models to

summary.core_problem: 现有的 VQA 数据集侧重于粗粒度类别和单实体的简单推理，无法有效评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度多模态实体理解和复杂多跳推理上的能力。
summary.importance: 提出了 M^3-VQA，一个新的基于知识的 VQA 基准，引入了涉及多个不同实体（来自视觉和文本）的复杂多跳问题，并要求模型跨多个文档进行顺序和并行推理。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含多样化多实体问题的数据集，这些问题需要跨视觉和文本源进行多跳推理，并由可追踪的详细证据和精选的多模态知识库支持。在三种设置下评估模型：无外部知识、提供黄金证据、检索增强输入。
summary.experiments: 评估了 16 个领先的 MLLMs。结果表明，模型在无外部信息时表现不佳，但在提供精确证据时有显著改善，揭示了 MLLMs 在知识获取和推理方面的挑战。
summary.authors_note: 中科院自动化所

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VQA datasets focus on coarse-grained categories and simple reasoning over single entities, failing to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on fine-grained multimodal entity understanding and complex multi-hop reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Introduces M^3-VQA, a novel knowledge-based VQA benchmark featuring complex multi-hop questions involving multiple distinct entities from both visual and textual sources, requiring sequential and parallel reasoning across multiple documents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a dataset with diverse multi-entity questions requiring multi-hop reasoning across visual and textual sources, supported by traceable evidence and a curated multimodal knowledge base. Evaluates models under three settings: without external knowledge, with gold evidence, and with retrieval-augmented input.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 16 leading MLLMs. Results show poor performance without external information but marked improvement with precise evidence, revealing challenges in knowledge acquisition and reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

recommendation.zh: 一个侧重多实体、多跳推理的 VQA benchmark，主要测试 MLLM 的复杂推理和 RAG 能力，作为评测集备查即可。
recommendation.en: A VQA benchmark focusing on multi-entity, multi-hop reasoning, primarily testing MLLMs' complex reasoning and RAG capabilities. Keep as a reference for evaluation datasets.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Benchmarking Layout-Guided Diffusion Models through Unified Semantic-Spatial Evaluation in Closed and Open Settings
paper.abstract: Evaluating layout-guided text-to-image generative models requires assessing both semantic alignment with textual prompts and spatial fidelity to prescribed layouts. Assessing layout alignment requires collecting fine-grained annotations, which is costly and labor-intensive. Consequently, current benchmarks rarely provide comprehensive layout evaluation and often remain limited in scale or coverage, making model comparison, ranking, and interpretation difficult. In this work, we introduce a close

summary.core_problem: 评估 layout-guided text-to-image diffusion 模型时，现有指标难以同时衡量文本语义对齐和空间布局一致性，且细粒度标注成本较高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型评测 benchmark。它把封闭集合的可控能力测试和开放集合的真实场景测试放在同一评估框架下，试图让不同布局引导生成模型的比较更稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C-Bench 和 O-Bench：C-Bench 用受控 prompt 与 layout 隔离不同生成能力，O-Bench 用真实 prompt 和 layout 测量开放场景表现；同时设计统一评估协议，把语义准确性与空间准确性合成为单一得分。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出被评估模型清单、数据规模或具体排名结果，只说明 benchmark 覆盖不同 prompt 结构和 layout 复杂度，并用于模型比较、排序和解释。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Padova。摘要中没有显示与 LLM 基座或大型多模态预训练团队的直接关联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets evaluation of layout-guided text-to-image diffusion models, where semantic prompt alignment and spatial layout fidelity are both required but expensive to annotate at scale.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a generation-model benchmark. It combines controlled closed-set testing with open-set real-world evaluation, aiming to make comparisons among layout-guided generators more consistent.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce C-Bench for controlled prompts and layouts, O-Bench for real-world prompts and layouts, and a unified evaluation protocol that merges semantic and spatial accuracy into one score.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the evaluated model list, benchmark size, or numerical leaderboards. It states that the benchmarks vary prompt structure and layout complexity and support model ranking and interpretation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Padova. The abstract does not indicate a direct connection to LLM foundation-model pretraining groups.

recommendation.zh: 这是生成评测工具，不会改变预训练判断；若关心图像 token 或统一生成评估，看指标定义即可。
recommendation.en: This is an evaluation artifact, not a pretraining signal; skim the metric design only if layout control matters to your multimodal pipeline.

paper.title: SWE-QA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Complex Code Understanding
paper.abstract: In this paper, we introduce SWE-QA, a text and code corpus aimed at benchmarking multi-hop code comprehension, addressing the gap between simplified evaluation tasks and the complex reasoning required in real-world software development. While existing code understanding benchmarks focus on isolated snippets, developers must routinely connect information across multiple dispersed code segments. The dataset comprises 9,072 multiple-choice questions systematically generated from 12 Python repositor

summary.core_problem: 现有代码理解评测过于偏向局部片段，无法衡量真实软件开发中跨文件、跨实体、多跳代码理解能力。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但对代码模型和仓库级 agent 的评测设计有参考意义，尤其是它试图把“表面模式匹配”和“真正跨实体理解”分开。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWE-QA，一个面向复杂代码理解的数据集与基准。数据来自 SWE-bench 的 12 个 Python 仓库，共 9,072 道选择题。问题通过解析式实体抽取与 LLM 辅助问答构造生成，覆盖 Declaration-and-Call、Interacting-Entity 等多跳推理模式，并通过精心设计的干扰项减少浅层匹配。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模为 9,072 题、12 个 Python 仓库。评测对象应包括现有代码理解模型或通用 LLM，但摘要未给出具体模型名单、分数和误差类型。当前可把它视为仓库级代码理解 benchmark，而不是方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code-understanding evaluations are too snippet-centric and fail to measure the multi-hop, cross-entity reasoning needed in real software repositories.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark contribution. Its direct value to pretraining researchers is limited, but it is useful for evaluation design in code models and repository-level agents, especially because it tries to separate superficial pattern matching from genuine cross-entity understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces SWE-QA, a benchmark for complex code understanding. It contains 9,072 multiple-choice questions built from 12 Python repositories in SWE-bench. Questions are generated via parsing-based entity extraction plus LLM-assisted construction, covering reasoning patterns such as Declaration-and-Call and Interacting-Entity, with validated distractors to reduce shallow matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 9,072 questions over 12 Python repositories. The evaluated systems are likely existing code models or general LLMs, but the abstract does not provide the model list, scores, or detailed failure analysis. At this stage it should be treated as a repository-level code-understanding benchmark rather than a methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做代码预训练或 repo-level agent，只看数据构造规则和错误类型就够了；benchmark 方向对，方法新意不多。
recommendation.en: If you work on code pretraining or repo-level agents, read the dataset construction and error taxonomy; the benchmark target is sensible, but the methodological novelty is modest.

paper.title: Frontier Coding Agents Can Now Implement an AlphaZero Self-Play Machine Learning Pipeline For Connect Four That Performs Comparably to an External Solver
paper.abstract: Forecasting when AI systems will become capable of meaningfully accelerating AI research is a central challenge for AI safety. Existing benchmarks measure broad capability growth, but may not provide ample early warning signals for recursive self-improvement. We propose measuring AI's capability to autonomously implement end-to-end machine learning pipelines from past AI research breakthroughs, given a minimal task description. By providing a concise task description instead of the full prior wo

summary.core_problem: 现有AI能力基准无法提供递归自我改进的早期预警信号，缺乏衡量AI自主复现经典AI研究突破能力的评估方案。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，提出衡量AI自主实现端到端机器学习管道的概念验证基准，用于评估AI的研究能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 设计基准任务，要求前沿编码Agent在3小时内自主实现适用于四子棋的AlphaZero风格自玩机器学习管道，以Pascal Pons四子棋求解器为基线开展锦标赛评估。
summary.experiments: 测试4个前沿编码Agent各8次试验，Claude Opus 4.7作为先手表现最优，不同Agent间能力差异显著。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI capability benchmarks fail to provide early warning signals for recursive self-improvement, lacking evaluation schemes for AI's ability to autonomously replicate classic AI research breakthroughs.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, proposes a proof-of-concept benchmark measuring AI's ability to autonomously implement end-to-end machine learning pipelines for classic research work.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a benchmark task requiring frontier coding agents to implement an AlphaZero-style self-play ML pipeline for Connect Four within 3 hours, evaluates performance in a tournament anchored to the Pascal Pons Connect Four solver.
summary_en.experiments: Tests 4 frontier coding agents with 8 trials each, Claude Opus 4.7 performs best as first player, with significant capability differences across agents.

recommendation.zh: 可了解当前编码Agent复现经典机器学习研究的能力边界，作为基座能力评估参考，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Reference for understanding current coding agent capability to replicate classic ML research, no need to read full text.

paper.title: RESTestBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Effectiveness of LLM-Generated REST API Test Cases from NL Requirements
paper.abstract: Existing REST API testing tools are typically evaluated using code coverage and crash-based fault metrics. However, recent LLM-based approaches increasingly generate tests from NL requirements to validate functional behaviour, making traditional metrics weak proxies for whether generated tests validate intended behaviour. To address this gap, we present RESTestBench, a benchmark comprising three REST services paired with manually verified NL requirements in both precise and vague variants, enabl

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 从自然语言需求生成 REST API 测试用例时，现有代码覆盖率和崩溃指标无法衡量测试是否验证了预期功能。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是软件工程 benchmark。它把评测目标从覆盖率转向 requirement-level fault detection，对代码 Agent 和测试生成系统有参考意义，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接信息量较低。
summary.technical_approach: RESTestBench 包含三个 REST services，每个服务配有人工验证的自然语言需求，并区分 precise 与 vague 两种需求表述。论文提出 requirements-based mutation testing metric，用于衡量生成测试用例是否能针对某条需求发现对应故障，并比较不带 refinement 与带 refinement 的生成流程。
summary.experiments: 实验在多个当前 LLM 上评估两类测试生成方法：直接生成和基于反馈/refinement 的生成。摘要未给出具体模型列表、样本规模、数值结果或最佳系统；主要实验价值在于 benchmark 设计和需求级 mutation metric。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 CASABLANCA hotelsoftware GmbH、University of Innsbruck、Technical University of 以及 Diffblue Ltd；Diffblue 长期做自动化软件测试相关工具。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between traditional REST API testing metrics and LLM-generated tests from natural-language requirements.
summary_en.importance: This is a software-engineering benchmark contribution. It is relevant to code agents and test-generation evaluation, but it has limited direct value for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RESTestBench provides three REST services with manually verified natural-language requirements in precise and vague variants. It introduces a requirements-based mutation testing metric that measures whether a generated test detects faults tied to a specific requirement, and compares non-refinement and refinement-based generation.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates two generation strategies across multiple contemporary LLMs. The abstract does not provide model names, dataset size beyond the three services, or quantitative results; the main artifact is the benchmark and the requirement-level mutation metric.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include CASABLANCA hotelsoftware GmbH, University of Innsbruck, Technical University of, and Diffblue Ltd; Diffblue is known for automated software testing tools.

recommendation.zh: 作为代码测试 benchmark 备查即可；指标设计比模型结论有用，对预训练没有直接动作。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a code-testing benchmark reference; the metric is more useful than the model results for pretraining work.

paper.title: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have predominantly focused on training paradigms like supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). However, the challenge of high-dynamic GUI environments remains largely underexplored. Existing agents typically rely on a single screenshot after each action for decision-making, leading to a partially observable (or even unobservable) Markov decision process, where the key GUI state including important information for a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 GUI agent 在高动态界面中的部分可观测问题：如果 agent 每一步只看动作后的单张截图，那么很多关键状态变化会发生在两次截图之间并直接消失，导致决策依据缺失。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接价值较弱，不属于预训练方法、建模目标或训练动态研究。它的启发主要在于两点：一是把“单帧观测不足”明确表述为 POMDP 问题，这对多模态 agent 的训练信号设计有帮助；二是 benchmark 构造强调 hidden interstitial dynamics，而不是静态截图上的 GUI 理解。这更接近 agent evaluation 与系统设计，而不是 foundation model pretraining。
summary.technical_approach:
工作包含 benchmark 和 agent 两部分。Benchmark 方面，作者提出 DynamicGUIBench，覆盖 10 个应用、149 个任务，专门设计四类动态场景：interruptive UI states、ephemeral reference、dynamic list selection、content-triggered interaction。重点不是加入可见干扰，而是构造那些会在动作间隙出现、变化、消失的关键信息，使单截图策略天然信息不足。

方法方面，DynamicUI 以完整交互录屏视频而不是单帧截图作为输入。其 dynamic perceiver 先对视频帧做聚类，再结合 caption 与置信度迭代选出代表性帧，目的是把长视频压缩成可供 VLM 使用的动态上下文。随后 refinement strategy 用来修正“模型计划动作”和“环境实际执行结果”之间的偏差，reflection module 则基于修正后的轨迹给后续步骤提供高层反馈。整体上，这是一个围绕时序观测压缩、执行校正、轨迹反思构建的 GUI agent pipeline。
summary.experiments:
实验主轴是 DynamicGUIBench 和 OSWorld。作者声称 DynamicUI 在高动态 GUI 场景下明显优于现有方法，同时在静态或一般 GUI 理解任务上保持竞争力。Benchmark 构造部分还强调了可复现性：对 Chrome 类和多应用任务提供离线资产与确定性 HTML，以减少网络波动和环境更新带来的评测噪声。

从当前给出的全文片段里，看不到足够完整的数值表，因此不适合复述具体提升百分比。阅读时应重点确认三件事：视频输入带来的提升有多少；这种提升是否主要来自更多观察信息而非 agent 策略本身；在不同动态类别上，dynamic perceiver、refinement、reflection 各自贡献是否清晰。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇只建议泛读。先看 benchmark 定义和四类动态任务，理解作者到底把哪些 GUI 变化视为“单截图不可恢复”的隐藏状态。再看 DynamicUI 的系统图，确认视频压缩流程是否足够轻量，是否存在把长时序信息重新变成少量关键帧摘要的工程取舍。最后扫一眼主结果和模块消融，判断性能提升主要来自 benchmark 更匹配视频输入，还是方法本身确实更善于处理时序 GUI 线索。预计 15 到 25 分钟足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete failure mode of GUI agents in highly dynamic environments: if the agent only observes a single screenshot after each action, important interface changes that occur between two observations may be missed entirely, turning the interaction into a partially observable decision process.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is limited. This is mainly an agent benchmark and system paper, not a study of pretraining objectives, scaling, tokenization, or optimization. The useful takeaway is conceptual: it frames dynamic GUI interaction as a POMDP caused by sparse temporal observation, and it evaluates agents on hidden interstitial dynamics rather than static screenshot understanding. That matters for multimodal agent training and evaluation, but only indirectly for foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two parts: a benchmark and an agent framework. DynamicGUIBench contains 149 tasks across 10 applications and is designed around four dynamic scenario types: interruptive UI states, ephemeral reference, dynamic list selection, and content-triggered interaction. The key idea is not just to add visible perturbations, but to create cases where task-relevant evidence appears, evolves, or disappears between action steps, so a single screenshot is insufficient.

The proposed agent, DynamicUI, consumes full interaction screen-recording video rather than one post-action frame. Its dynamic perceiver clusters frames and iteratively selects salient centroids using generated captions and confidence scores, effectively compressing long videos into informative dynamic context. A refinement strategy then addresses mismatches between intended actions and actually executed behaviors. Finally, a reflection module uses the refined trajectory to provide higher-level guidance for subsequent decisions. In short, the system is built around temporal observation compression, execution correction, and trajectory-level reflection.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluations are on DynamicGUIBench and OSWorld. The paper reports that DynamicUI performs strongly in dynamic GUI settings while remaining competitive on more standard GUI tasks. The benchmark construction also emphasizes reproducibility by providing offline assets and deterministic HTML for Chrome-based and multi-app tasks, which is important because GUI evaluation is otherwise noisy and hard to standardize.

The excerpt provided here does not include enough numeric detail to restate exact margins. When reading the full paper, the key checks are: how much of the gain comes from having video instead of single-frame input, whether the gain remains after controlling for observation budget, and how much each module—dynamic perceiver, refinement, and reflection—contributes across different dynamic scenario types.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark section and the four dynamic task categories to understand what the authors mean by hidden GUI dynamics. Then read the system diagram for DynamicUI and check how the video is compressed into a manageable context for the VLM. Finally, inspect the main results and ablations to see whether the improvement is mostly due to better temporal observability or to the agent design itself. Around 15 to 25 minutes should be enough.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 benchmark 设计和失败案例；它提醒 GUI Agent 的观测建模比 RL 算法选择更容易成为瓶颈。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failures; it suggests observation modeling, not the RL recipe, may be the bottleneck for GUI agents.

paper.title: The Structured Output Benchmark: A Multi-Source Benchmark for Evaluating Structured Output Quality in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly being deployed to extract structured data from unstructured and semi-structured sources: parsing invoices, medical records, and converting PDF documents to database entries. Yet existing benchmarks for structured output generation either focus on schema compliance alone, or evaluate value correctness within a single source domain. We introduce SOB (The Structured Output Benchmark), a multi-source benchmark spanning three source modalities: native text, imag

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM 从不同来源内容中生成结构化输出时，是否同时满足 schema 合规和字段值正确。
summary.importance: 贡献是结构化输出 benchmark。它关注的能力接近 function calling、工具调用和企业 extraction 场景中的可靠 JSON/表格生成，比只测 schema validity 的评测更贴近实际错误模式，但对预训练本身是间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: SOB 覆盖文本、图像和音频会话三类来源，但统一把上下文转成 text-normalized representation 输入模型。这个设计有意隔离结构化输出能力，不把 OCR、视觉理解或语音识别质量混入评分。评测同时关注 schema compliance 和 value correctness。
summary.experiments: benchmark 包含 5,000 条文本评测记录，来自 25,091 条完整语料中的 multi-hop QA；另有 209 条图像记录，来自 OCR 处理后的 PDF，覆盖七类文档并包含多栏布局等情况。摘要未给出参与评测的模型列表和具体排名或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 JigsawStack。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can produce structured outputs from multiple source types while satisfying both schema compliance and field-value correctness.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a structured-output benchmark. It targets capabilities close to function calling, tool use, and production extraction workflows, going beyond schema-validity-only evaluations; its relevance to pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: SOB spans native text, images, and audio conversations, but feeds all models a text-normalized representation of the context. This deliberately isolates structured-output ability from OCR, vision, or speech-recognition quality. The benchmark evaluates both schema adherence and correctness of extracted values.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark includes 5,000 text evaluation records derived from multi-hop QA in a 25,091-record full corpus, plus 209 image records from OCR-processed PDFs across seven document types, including multi-column layouts. The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, leaderboard results, or numerical differences.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is JigsawStack.

recommendation.zh: 做 tool/function calling 评测可看任务设计；预训练研究员读指标定义即可，不必追模型榜单。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for tool/function-calling evaluation design; for pretraining work, read the metric definitions and ignore the leaderboard.

paper.title: ServImage: An Image Generation and Editing Benchmark from Real-world Commercial Imaging Services
paper.abstract: Recent image generation and editing models demonstrate robust adherence to instructions and high visual quality on academic benchmarks. However, their performance on paid, real-world design projects remains uncertain. We introduce \textbf{ServImage}, a benchmark that explicitly correlates model outputs with economic value in commercial design projects. ServImage consists of (i) \textbf{\textit{ServImageBench}}: a dataset of 1.07k paid commercial design tasks and 2.05k designer deliverables total

summary.core_problem: 解决图像生成与编辑模型在学术 benchmark 上表现良好，但其输出是否满足真实商业设计需求、是否对应经济价值难以评估的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成式视觉模型评测数据和评分体系。ServImage 把真实付费设计任务、设计师交付物、候选图像和人工标注连接起来，试图用商业可接受性而非单纯审美或指令遵循作为评测目标。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 ServImageBench，包含 1.07k 付费商业设计任务、2.05k 设计师交付物，总金额超过 29.5 万美元，覆盖人像、商品和数字内容；收集 33k 候选图像和 33k 人工标注。提出 ServImageScore，从基础需求满足、视觉执行质量、商业必要性满足三个维度综合打分。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体参评模型、排名、模型间差距或人类一致性指标，但说明 benchmark 用于显式关联模型输出和商业项目经济价值。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息显示为中国科学院植物研究所。给定信息中未能确认该团队在图像生成评测方向的代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether image generation and editing models that score well on academic benchmarks produce outputs acceptable in real paid commercial design projects.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation benchmark and scoring framework for visual generative models. It links real paid design tasks, designer deliverables, candidate images, and human annotations to a notion of commercial acceptability.
summary_en.technical_approach: ServImageBench contains 1.07k paid design tasks, 2.05k designer deliverables worth over $295k, covering portraits, products, and digital content, plus 33k candidate images and 33k human annotations. ServImageScore combines requirement fulfillment, visual execution quality, and commercial necessity satisfaction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, rankings, inter-model gaps, or human-agreement statistics. It emphasizes the benchmark’s link between model outputs and economic value in commercial imaging services.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is the Institute of Botany, Chinese Academy of Sciences. No representative prior work from the team can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 作为生成模型 eval 备查即可；商业标注很稀缺，但离预训练目标设计还有一层距离。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an evaluation reference for generative models; the commercial labels are rare, but it is one step removed from pretraining design.

institutions: Institute of Botany, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Institute of Botany, the Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Multi-Turn Language Models
paper.abstract: Language models are increasingly deployed in interactive settings where users reason about facts over time rather than in isolation. In such scenarios, correct behavior requires models to maintain and update implicit temporal assumptions established earlier in a conversation. We study this challenge through the lens of temporal scope stability: the ability to preserve, override, or transfer time-scoped factual context across dialogue turns. We introduce ChronoScope, a large-scale diagnostic benc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型知不知道某个时间事实”，而是“模型能不能在多轮对话里稳定地维持一个已经建立的时间参照系”。作者把这个问题定义为 temporal scope stability：首轮问题给出时间约束，后续追问不再重复年份，但默认沿用前文时间；模型需要在需要时保持、在显式提示时切换、在实体转移时正确继承这个时间范围。论文关心的是一种推理时失稳现象：模型单轮答对，放进多轮上下文后却回到默认的当下知识，说明问题不在参数记忆缺失，而在上下文绑定和状态维护失败。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要有三点。第一，它把多轮事实问答里的时间一致性从泛泛的“上下文理解”拆成了可测、可归因的子能力，这比常见的单轮 temporal QA 更接近真实交互。第二，它揭示了一个和预训练目标直接相关的缺口：标准 next-token 训练能学到大量时间事实，但未必能学到“隐式时间状态持续到何时”的对话约束。第三，它提供了一个很适合分析训练范式的诊断面：如果一个模型在显式重述时间时表现正常、在隐式继承时明显掉点，那么问题更像是上下文表示与检索偏置，而不是知识覆盖率。对做 continual pretrain、对话建模、memory/state tracking、甚至 RL 后训练的人，这个 benchmark 都能用来区分‘知道’和‘会在对话里稳定调用’。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，核心贡献是构建 ChronoScope，而不是提出新的模型。数据来自带时间限定符的 Wikidata 事实，作者用确定性规则生成多轮问答链，并且显式标注 temporal drift。这个设计有几个关键点。第一，问题链不是简单改写，而是围绕同一时间参照构造三类行为：scope carryover（后续问题默认继承前文时间）、scope override（后续问题显式改写时间）、scope transfer（时间约束在相关实体或关系上继续生效）。第二，数据生成在实体 ID 层面完成，避免自然语言歧义把错误归因搞混；模型答案可以映射回结构化事实，从而区分“完全答错”和“答成了另一个时间点上正确的事实”。第三，作者特别把 drift 定义为 temporally misaligned but factually plausible 的回答，这一点很重要，因为它把失败模式从一般 hallucination 中剥离出来。第四，评测里加入 oracle context 设定，用金答案替换前序轮次，排除前文错误传播，专门测模型是否能在推理时维持时间状态。整套设计更像一个受控诊断基准，而不是开放域聊天集。
summary.experiments: 全文最重要的实验结论不是某个模型赢了多少，而是错误形态很一致。ChronoScope 总规模超过 140 万条 deterministically generated question chains，建立在 Wikidata 的时间标注事实之上。作者评测了多种开源和闭源模型，发现：1）当时间约束在每一轮都被显式重述时，模型准确率明显更高；2）一旦需要隐式继承时间范围，性能会显著下降；3）很多错误答案并非无关胡答，而是落到“当前时点的正确答案”，说明存在 present-day bias；4）随着对话轮数增加，时间范围漂移更严重；5）即便在 oracle conversational context 下，这种退化仍然存在，说明不是单纯的 error propagation，而是模型没有把时间参照稳定编码为可持续使用的对话状态。摘要和正文片段里没有给出完整的逐模型数字表，因此不宜编造具体百分点；但从实验叙述看，作者重点强调的是‘显式时间重述 vs 隐式时间继承’之间的性能落差，以及 interaction length 对稳定性的负面影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看 Introduction，把 temporal scope stability 的定义吃透，再看数据构造部分，重点理解三类链式操作——carryover、override、transfer——分别在测什么。随后直接看实验总表和错误分析图，尤其是 present-day bias、随轮数增长的退化曲线、以及 oracle context 对照。阅读时要带着两个问题：第一，作者是否真的把“知识缺失”和“时间状态失稳”分开了；第二，这个 benchmark 对训练改进是否可操作。值得深挖的点有三个：一是 drift annotation 的判定规则是否足够稳健；二是 Wikidata 时间事实的覆盖和噪声会不会影响结论；三是如果把这类能力作为训练目标，应该落在 continued pretraining、synthetic dialogue pretraining，还是 post-training 的 state tracking 强化。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode that is easy to miss in single-turn evaluation: a model may know the right time-specific fact, yet fail to preserve the implied temporal frame across turns. The target capability is temporal scope stability—keeping an established reference time unless the dialogue explicitly changes it, and transferring that scope correctly when follow-up questions omit the time expression. The key point is that this is not primarily a knowledge-coverage problem. It is an inference-time context-binding problem: the model answers correctly in isolation, but reverts to default present-day knowledge once the same fact must be retrieved under a latent conversational time state.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than architectural. First, it isolates a concrete gap between factual knowledge acquisition and stable multi-turn deployment. Standard next-token pretraining can encode many temporal facts, but that does not guarantee robust maintenance of an implicit temporal frame in dialogue. Second, it gives a cleaner handle on context-state tracking than broad conversational benchmarks, because the failure can be attributed to temporal drift rather than generic misunderstanding. Third, it is useful for studying the interface between pretraining and post-training: if models perform well when time is restated explicitly but fail when it must be inherited implicitly, the bottleneck is likely in contextual state representation, retrieval bias, or dialogue-format learning, not in raw factual memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main contribution is the ChronoScope benchmark. It is built from temporally qualified Wikidata facts and generates deterministic multi-turn QA chains with explicit temporal-drift annotations. The construction matters. Each chain starts with a time-scoped factual query, then follows with turns that test one of several behaviors: carryover of the established temporal scope, explicit override of that scope, or transfer of the scope across related entities or relations. The pipeline operates at the entity-ID level, which reduces ambiguity and makes answer checking more precise. A particularly useful design choice is the explicit separation of temporally misaligned but factually plausible answers from fully incorrect ones. That lets the benchmark identify a model that answers with the present-day truth instead of the truth under the previously established year. The evaluation also includes an oracle-context setting, where earlier turns are replaced by gold answers, to distinguish temporal-state instability from simple error propagation across turns.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is consistent degradation under implicit temporal carryover. ChronoScope contains more than 1.4 million deterministically generated question chains grounded in temporally annotated Wikidata facts. Across both open-weight and proprietary models, accuracy is much better when the temporal constraint is restated explicitly at each turn, and drops sharply when the model must infer and preserve the temporal scope from prior context. Many failures are not random hallucinations; they match present-day ground truth, which supports the paper’s claim of present-day bias. Performance also worsens as interaction length increases. Importantly, the degradation persists even under oracle conversational context, suggesting that the issue is not merely cascading mistakes from earlier turns but a genuine inference-time instability in maintaining the latent temporal frame. The provided text does not include a full numeric table, so the safe takeaway is the pattern of failure rather than a specific leaderboard margin.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the task definition and make sure the distinction between temporal knowledge and temporal scope stability is clear. Then read the dataset construction section carefully, especially the carryover/override/transfer split and the temporal-drift annotation protocol. After that, go straight to the main evaluation tables and the error analysis, focusing on three signals: the gap between explicit and implicit temporal conditioning, the increase in drift with dialogue length, and the oracle-context comparison. The most useful question while reading is whether the benchmark truly disentangles missing knowledge from unstable contextual binding. Another good angle is to ask how one would train against this failure mode: continued pretraining on synthetic multi-turn temporal data, dialogue-centric pretraining objectives, or post-training methods that strengthen state tracking. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for a productive pass.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练方法论文，但 benchmark 设计很干净；若你在做对话式 pretrain 或 memory ablation，只看任务拆分和错误类型就够，别太在意榜单分数。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark design is clean; if you work on dialogue pretraining or memory ablations, read the task decomposition and failure taxonomy, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: Benchmarking Testing in Automated Theorem Proving
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in formal theorem proving, yet evaluating semantic correctness remains challenging. Existing evaluations rely on indirect proxies such as lexical overlap with human-annotated proof, or expensive manual inspection. Inspired by the shift from lexical comparison to test-based evaluation in code generation, we propose T , a framework that evaluates the semantic correctness of formal theorems: a generated theorem is considered correct

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是形式化定理生成里的语义评测问题：Lean 编译通过只能说明生成的 statement 和 proof 在逻辑系统内自洽，不能说明它表达了自然语言题目的原意。典型失败是把应证明的命题改写成平凡恒等式，仍然可以编译通过。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练方法，而在评测信号设计。形式数学和代码一样，表面匹配指标会高估模型能力；只用编译通过率也会鼓励模型学习“可证明但不忠实”的形式化策略。T2 把语义正确性转化为依赖图上的集成测试，为 formal reasoning 数据过滤、RL verifier 设计、自动形式化 benchmark 提供了更可靠的反馈信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Testing Accuracy。给定一个被模型生成的目标定理，论文不直接和人工参考定理做等价证明，而是把真实 Lean 仓库中的后继定理作为测试用例。如果替换目标定理后，依赖它的后继定理还能编译，说明生成定理在这些使用场景下保留了足够的语义；如果后继定理失败，则暴露出语义偏差。这个设计借鉴软件工程里的 integration testing，避免 BLEU、NLI、人工检查这类成本高或间接的指标。T2 从 5 个真实 Lean 4 仓库自动抽取目标定理和依赖关系，构造 2,206 个问题；每个问题平均有 41 个直接后继定理。论文还利用更深的依赖闭包扩大测试覆盖，在深度 7 时平均可形成约 1.6k 个后继测试。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 18 个开源和闭源模型。主要结论是编译准确率和测试准确率之间存在很大落差：部分模型生成的可编译定理中，最高有 93.1% 被判定为语义错误。BLEU 等文本相似度指标无法稳定区分语义正确和错误输出。专门的 theorem proving 模型在编译层面表现较好，但在 T2 的语义测试下可能低于相近规模的通用模型，说明它们可能更强地适配了 Lean 语法和证明模式，而不是自然语言到形式语义的忠实映射。论文还构造了 389 个问题的 Hard 子集，要求模型同时生成辅助命题和目标定理证明。另一个有用发现是，把后继定理作为上下文提供给模型能提升语义正确性，而只提供自然语言证明并不稳定有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的 Figure 1 和 Table 1，理解为什么 compile pass、BLEU、BEq、人工检查都不足以作为语义评测。方法部分重点看 Testing Accuracy 的定义、successor theorem 的抽取方式和依赖深度设置。实验部分建议看编译准确率与 TA 的差距、Hard 子集结果，以及 successor context 的消融。对预训练研究更有用的是评测信号本身，而不是 Lean benchmark 的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses semantic evaluation in formal theorem generation. A Lean theorem may compile and still fail to express the intended natural-language statement; for example, a model can replace a commutativity claim with a tautology that is easy to prove.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is evaluation signal design. In formal reasoning, compile success alone creates a reward that can favor provable but unfaithful formalizations. T2 offers a stronger automatic signal for benchmarking autoformalization, filtering formal-math data, and designing verifiers for RL on theorem proving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is Testing Accuracy. Instead of proving equivalence to a reference theorem or comparing against a human annotation, the method replaces a target theorem in a real Lean repository with the generated theorem and checks whether successor theorems that depend on it still compile. This is analogous to integration testing in software: a component is tested through the modules that use it. The benchmark is built from 5 real-world Lean 4 repositories and contains 2,206 target problems, each paired with successor theorems. The paper reports an average of 41 direct successors per problem and expands coverage through dependency depth, reaching about 1.6k successor tests per problem at depth 7.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 18 open and closed models. The main empirical result is a large gap between compilation accuracy and testing accuracy: among compilable outputs, up to 93.1% can still be semantically incorrect under successor testing. BLEU does not reliably separate correct from incorrect formalizations. Specialized proving models can look strong under compilation-based metrics but perform worse on semantic correctness than similarly sized general-purpose models, suggesting overfitting to syntax and proof patterns. The benchmark also includes a Hard subset of 389 problems that require generating both auxiliary propositions and target proofs. Providing successor theorems as context improves semantic correctness, while natural-language proofs alone are not consistently helpful.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read Figure 1 and Table 1 first to understand the failure modes of compile success, BLEU, BEq, and manual inspection. Then focus on the definition of Testing Accuracy, the dependency extraction pipeline, and the depth-based successor coverage. In the experiments, the most useful parts are the compile-versus-TA gap, the Hard subset, and the ablation on successor context. For pretraining-oriented readers, the evaluation signal is more important than the Lean-specific benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练范式，但会改你看 formal reasoning 结果表的方式；只看 metric 定义和模型排名坍塌那张表，就知道旧 benchmark 有多松。
recommendation.en: It does not change training, but it should change how you read formal-reasoning tables; just inspect the metric definition and the leaderboard collapse to see how loose prior benchmarks were.

institutions: Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence, Seoul National University

paper.title: RAT: RunAnyThing via Fully Automated Environment Configuration
paper.abstract: Automating repository-level software engineering tasks is a foundational challenge for autonomous code agents, largely due to the difficulty of configuring executable environments. However, manual configuration remains a labor-intensive bottleneck, necessitating a transition toward fully automated environment configuration. Existing approaches often rely on pre-defined artifacts or are restricted to specific programming languages, limiting their applicability to real-world repositories. In this

summary.core_problem: RAT 试图解决 repository-level code agent 的可执行环境自动配置问题：给定任意真实仓库，自动推断依赖、构建容器、找到验证命令，并让项目能跑起来。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是预训练方法论文，但和 code LLM 的训练闭环有关。可执行环境配置是把静态代码仓库变成可验证训练样本的前置条件。没有环境，代码数据只能提供文本监督；有环境后，可以构造 execution traces、生成可执行反馈、支持基于测试结果的 SFT 或 RL。对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：代码模型的数据质量不只取决于代码本身，还取决于能否恢复其运行上下文。大规模自动配置仓库环境，可能比继续清洗更多静态代码更能提高训练信号密度。
summary.technical_approach: RAT 是一个语言无关的多阶段 agent pipeline。它先做 semantic initialization，通过 ImageRetriever 分析仓库结构、README、构建文件和语言线索，选择合适的基础镜像，降低后续配置搜索空间。然后使用双模式 planning：简单仓库走较直接的配置路径，复杂或未见过的仓库则使用更细的规划和迭代修复。执行阶段在容器 sandbox 中运行，调用专门工具集处理语言识别、依赖安装、构建命令、测试命令、错误日志解析等问题。系统还引入长期经验积累，用历史配置知识帮助解决跨会话反复出现的依赖和构建问题。和依赖 Dockerfile、CI 日志或特定语言规则的系统不同，RAT 的目标是在缺少完整配置 artifacts 的真实仓库上工作。
summary.experiments: 作者构建了 RATBench，包含超过 2000 个 GitHub 仓库，强调多语言、真实项目分布和可执行性验证。评测指标是 Environment Setup Success Rate，即系统生成的环境和验证流程是否能无错误运行。文中称 RAT 在 RATBench 上取得更高的 ESSR，并且在环境配置能力上超过人工专家。给定材料中没有提供完整表格和精确数值，因此不宜进一步推断具体提升幅度。实验的关键价值在于 benchmark 设计：它把环境配置从若干人工整理样例扩展到更接近真实仓库分布的大规模评测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 RATBench 的构建流程、成功判定标准和仓库采样方式，因为这些决定 benchmark 是否真的能代表开放仓库。方法部分可重点看 ImageRetriever、planning 机制、sandbox 工具接口和经验积累模块。若关注 code LLM 训练，最值得看的是作者如何把环境配置 trace 定义为可复用数据，以及它怎样支撑 execution-based reinforcement 和数据合成。具体 agent prompt 和工具工程细节可以按需略读。

summary_en.core_problem: RAT targets automated environment setup for arbitrary software repositories: infer the runtime, dependencies, build steps, and validation commands well enough to produce a runnable container or Dockerfile.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to code-agent infrastructure and training-data construction rather than base-model pretraining itself. Its relevance to LLM research comes from executability. If repositories can be configured automatically at scale, static code corpora can be converted into verifiable tasks, execution traces, and reward signals. That matters for code SFT and RL, where functional feedback is much cleaner than text-only supervision. The broader lesson is that code-data quality depends heavily on recovering the execution context, not just deduplicating or filtering source files.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAT is a modular, language-agnostic pipeline. It begins with semantic initialization: an ImageRetriever inspects repository structure, documentation, manifests, and language cues to select an appropriate base image. A planning module then decides how to configure and validate the project, with a more direct mode for simple repositories and a more iterative mode for complex or unfamiliar ones. The agent operates inside a containerized sandbox and uses specialized tools for language detection, dependency installation, build and test invocation, and error-log interpretation. The system also accumulates long-term configuration expertise, so repeated dependency and runtime issues can be handled more consistently. The main distinction from prior work is reduced reliance on curated Dockerfiles, CI logs, or language-specific assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: The authors introduce RATBench, a multilingual benchmark with more than 2,000 GitHub repositories, sampled to better reflect real repository diversity. The main metric is Environment Setup Success Rate: whether the produced environment and verification sequence run successfully. The paper reports that RAT achieves stronger ESSR than previous automated setup methods and exceeds human experts in the evaluated configuration setting. The provided text does not include exact tables or numerical margins, so the safe conclusion is about the direction and benchmark scale rather than a precise effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Read the RATBench construction and executability criteria first, since the benchmark definition determines how meaningful the reported success rate is. Then inspect the ImageRetriever, planning module, sandbox tool interface, and long-term expertise mechanism. For code-LLM researchers, the most useful angle is how configuration traces can become reusable training data and how successful environment setup enables execution-based rewards. Low-level prompt and tool-engineering details can be read selectively.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和失败案例；这类执行环境问题比换 prompt 更接近 code agent 的真实瓶颈。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and failure cases; executable-environment setup is a more real bottleneck for code agents than another prompt variant.

paper.title: Skill Retrieval Augmentation for Agentic AI
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve into agentic problem solvers, they increasingly rely on external, reusable skills to handle tasks beyond their native parametric capabilities. In existing agent systems, the dominant strategy for incorporating skills is to explicitly enumerate available skills within the context window. However, this strategy fails to scale: as skill corpora expand, context budgets are consumed rapidly, and the agent becomes markedly less accurate in identifying the right s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是“怎么给 agent 多塞一点工具说明”，而是当技能库扩展到大规模、持续增长、且技能本身是可执行能力包时，agent 如何在上下文窗口之外完成技能检索、筛选、装载和实际使用。作者把这个问题正式化为 Skill Retrieval Augmentation（SRA）。它和传统 RAG 的差别在于：检索对象不是事实性证据，而是会改变 agent 行为空间的能力单元，因此评估不能只看语义相关性，还要看检索到的技能是否真的被识别、整合并转化为任务成功率提升。全文的关键点是把问题拆成 retrieval、incorporation、application 三段，而不是把最终任务成败混成一个黑盒指标。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接提出新的 pretrain objective，但对“参数知识 + 外部能力”的接口定义得比较清楚，价值主要在系统范式和评测设计两层。第一，它把 agent 外挂技能库从 prompt engineering 问题提升为可测量的能力扩展问题，这对以后研究长期记忆、外部程序库、tool-use pretraining、能力路由都有参考意义。第二，它强调技能检索的目标函数和知识检索不同，这一点对训练数据构造和检索器监督信号很重要：如果未来要做 skill-aware pretraining 或 tool-augmented continual pretraining，这类分解式 benchmark 会比只看 end-task accuracy 更有诊断性。贡献量级更像“提出问题并搭建评测地基”，不是直接改写现有 agent 方法的技术突破。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两部分。第一部分是范式定义。作者把 skill 定义为模块化能力包，可能包含自然语言说明、触发条件、工具调用流程、代码和辅助资源。基于这个定义，SRA pipeline 被拆成三步：1）skill retrieval：从大规模外部技能库中召回候选技能；2）skill incorporation：agent 在候选集合中识别真正有用的技能，并把它们组织进当前求解过程；3）skill application：这些技能是否在执行中被真正调用，并改善最终结果。这个拆分很重要，因为它指出失败可能来自检索器、上下文整合、或执行链路，而不是统一归因给模型“不会用工具”。

第二部分是 benchmark 构建。作者建立了一个大规模 skill corpus，并提出 SRA-Bench。每个样本带有 user query、ground-truth answer 和 gold skill(s) 标注，因此可以分别评估召回、候选集质量、以及技能注入后对任务表现的增益。按引言给出的设计，SRA-Bench 的目标不是只测“agent 最后答对没有”，而是支持分阶段诊断。全文目前给出的信息显示，作者有意把它做成类似 capability retrieval benchmark，而不是普通 QA benchmark 套一层工具标签。

从方法新意看，这篇工作的创新不在复杂模型结构，而在问题建模和评测口径。它明确反对把所有技能枚举进 prompt 的做法，因为这种做法同时受上下文长度和选择准确率下降两方面限制。作者把“技能是能力而不是知识”作为核心区分，这使得 retrieval metric 需要和 downstream utility 对齐。若全文后续章节提供了具体 retrieval baselines、reranking、agent integration 策略，那些更像验证 SRA 设定的实现手段，而不是论文最核心的贡献。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验主轴应当围绕 SRA-Bench 的分解式评测展开，但当前可见内容还没有完整表格和具体数值，因此不能可靠复述参数量、样本规模或提升幅度。可以确认的实验设计重点有三点：

1）比较显式 in-context skill injection 与外部 skill retrieval 的可扩展性差异。作者的论点是，随着 skill corpus 变大，前者会快速耗尽上下文预算，并且模型在大量候选技能中做选择的准确率明显下降。

2）分阶段评估 retrieval / incorporation / application。因为 benchmark 提供 gold skill 标注，所以至少可以测召回是否覆盖正确技能，以及检索到正确技能后 agent 是否真的会用。

3）研究“语义相关”与“任务有用”之间的偏差。SRA 的一个关键实验价值就在这里：即便检索结果看起来和 query 语义接近，也未必能提升 agent 的执行表现。

如果精读全文，建议重点补齐以下数字：skill corpus 的规模、任务类型分布、gold skill 标注方式、top-k retrieval 指标、不同 agent/backbone 的 incorporation 成功率，以及 end-task gain 相对 no-skill / full-skill-enumeration baseline 的变化。这些数字决定 benchmark 的说服力。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题定义 + benchmark 设计”来读，不必期待很重的算法细节。优先看三部分：

1）Introduction 和任务定义部分。重点看作者如何区分 SRA 与 RAG，为什么“技能是可执行能力”会改变评测目标。

2）SRA-Bench 构建章节。要看清 skill corpus 从哪里来、样本如何标注 gold skill、任务覆盖哪些 agent 场景、是否存在技能粒度不一致或标签歧义。

3）实验中的 error breakdown。最值得看的不是总分，而是 retrieval 命中但 incorporation 失败、以及 incorporation 成功但 application 无收益的案例。这些失败模式对后续做 tool-use pretraining、skill routing、长期记忆接口设计更有启发。

如果只是泛读，抓住 benchmark schema、评价维度和 baseline 设定即可，预计 20–30 分钟。若要深挖，建议重点审视标注质量、skill 定义边界，以及 benchmark 是否真的避免了把普通知识检索伪装成技能检索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a scaling failure in current agent systems: reusable skills are typically exposed by enumerating them in the prompt, which breaks down as the skill library grows. The authors formalize Skill Retrieval Augmentation (SRA), where an agent must retrieve relevant skills from a large external corpus, incorporate them into its reasoning process, and actually use them to solve the task. The key point is that skills are executable capabilities rather than factual evidence, so the problem is not just retrieval quality in the RAG sense; it is a coupled pipeline of retrieval, incorporation, and application.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it sharpens the interface between parametric knowledge and external capability memory. Its main contribution is conceptual and evaluative. First, it reframes skill use from prompt formatting into a measurable capability-augmentation problem. Second, it argues that skill retrieval should be judged by downstream utility, not only semantic relevance. That distinction matters for future work on tool-aware pretraining, external memory, capability routing, and continual accumulation of reusable procedures. The contribution is closer to problem formulation plus benchmark construction than to a new core model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical contribution has two layers. The first is the formulation. A skill is treated as a modular capability package that may include natural-language instructions, invocation conditions, tool-use procedures, executable code, and auxiliary resources. Based on this, the SRA pipeline is decomposed into three stages: skill retrieval, which asks whether the system can find relevant skills from a large external corpus; skill incorporation, which asks whether the agent can identify and organize the useful skills among retrieved candidates; and skill application, which asks whether those incorporated skills are actually used in a way that improves task success. This decomposition is useful because it separates retrieval failure from reasoning failure and execution failure.

The second layer is benchmark design. The paper introduces a large-scale skill corpus and SRA-Bench, where each instance contains a user query, a ground-truth answer, and gold skill annotation. That enables stage-wise evaluation instead of collapsing everything into a single end-task metric. The benchmark is designed to diagnose whether the right skill was retrieved, whether the agent recognized it as useful, and whether using it improved behavior. The novelty is therefore less about a sophisticated retrieval model and more about defining the right object of retrieval and the right evaluation protocol.

A central design choice is the explicit distinction from classical RAG. In knowledge-centric RAG, retrieved items are declarative evidence. In SRA, retrieved items change the agent’s action space. That means a semantically similar skill can still be useless, and a retrieval metric that ignores execution utility can be misleading. If later sections include concrete retrievers, rerankers, or integration strategies, those should be read mainly as operational baselines for the SRA setting rather than the main scientific contribution.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpt, the experimental section appears to center on decomposed evaluation over SRA-Bench, but the visible content does not include enough tables or numeric details to quote dataset sizes, model scales, or exact gains reliably. What can be inferred is the intended experimental structure.

First, the paper likely compares explicit in-context skill enumeration against retrieval-based skill access as the skill corpus grows. The claimed failure mode of the former is twofold: context budget exhaustion and degraded skill selection accuracy.

Second, because SRA-Bench includes gold skill labels, the experiments can separately measure retrieval coverage, candidate quality, and whether correct retrieval actually translates into better task performance.

Third, an important empirical question is the gap between semantic relevance and functional utility. The benchmark is set up to expose cases where retrieved skills look relevant but do not improve execution.

For a careful read, the most important missing numbers to extract are: corpus size, task distribution, annotation protocol for gold skills, top-k retrieval metrics, incorporation success rates under different agent backbones, and end-task gains relative to no-skill and full-skill-enumeration baselines. Those details determine whether the benchmark is merely well-motivated or genuinely useful.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a problem-definition and benchmark paper, not as a heavy algorithm paper. Start with the introduction and task formulation. The most important question is how the paper distinguishes SRA from standard RAG, and why executable capabilities require a different evaluation target.

Then focus on the benchmark construction section. Check where the skill corpus comes from, how gold skills are annotated, what task families are covered, and whether the notion of a skill is consistent across examples.

Finally, spend time on the error breakdown rather than only the headline scores. The most informative cases are: correct retrieval but failed incorporation, and successful incorporation but no downstream gain. Those failure modes are directly relevant to future work on tool-use pretraining, capability routing, and long-term external memory.

For a skim, 20–30 minutes is enough to capture the benchmark schema, evaluation axes, and baseline setup. For deeper study, scrutinize annotation quality, skill granularity, and whether the benchmark truly measures capability retrieval rather than relabeled knowledge retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory/skills 走向检索化的干净问题定义；读 benchmark 分解和失败模式，别只看最终分数。
recommendation.en: A clean formulation of retrieval-based agent skills; read the benchmark decomposition and failure modes rather than just end-task scores.

paper.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents capable of navigating Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) hold the potential to revolutionize digital productivity. However, achieving true digital autonomy extends beyond reactive element matching; it necessitates a predictive mental model of interface dynamics and the ability to foresee the "digital world state" resulting from interactions. Despite the perceptual capabilities of modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), existing benchmarks remain bifurcated (focusing either on black

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent 评测要么只看任务完成率，要么只看静态元素 grounding，无法衡量模型是否真正理解界面功能和交互后的状态转移。
summary.importance: 这是一个 benchmark 工作，价值在于把 GUI agent 的评测从“看见按钮”推进到“理解功能与后果预测”。对通用 agent 研究有意义，也能给多模态世界模型评测提供更细粒度信号，但对预训练本身仍是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoGUI-v2，多模态 GUI 功能理解 benchmark。核心构建流程是 VLM-human 协同解析多平台截图，递归生成层次化功能区域与交互结果标注，从而评测功能理解、状态变化预测等更深层能力，而不只做元素定位或黑盒任务成功率统计。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出样本规模与具体参评模型。实验应覆盖多个主流 VLM/GUI agent，在功能理解、交互结果预测、静态 grounding 与端到端任务完成之间做区分，证明现有模型在“会点”与“真懂”之间仍有明显落差。作为 benchmark，关键要看标注质量、任务分布和与真实 agent failure 的相关性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所、香港科技创新研究院（CASIA 体系）和上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GUI-agent benchmarks either focus on end-task success or shallow static grounding, and fail to test whether models understand interface functionality and state transitions.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution that pushes GUI-agent evaluation from element matching toward functional understanding and outcome prediction. It matters for general agent research and multimodal world-model evaluation, though its relevance to pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AutoGUI-v2, a multimodal benchmark for GUI functionality understanding. It uses a VLM-human collaborative pipeline to recursively parse screenshots from multiple platforms into hierarchical functional regions and interaction-outcome annotations, enabling evaluation of deeper capabilities beyond static grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size or the exact evaluated models. The experiments likely compare major VLMs/GUI agents on functionality understanding, interaction outcome prediction, static grounding, and end-to-end task completion, showing a gap between clicking competence and true interface understanding. For a benchmark, annotation quality and correlation with real agent failures are the main things to inspect.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from CASIA-related institutions and Shanghai AI Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 native multimodal agent，这篇的价值在评测拆得更细；读任务定义和误差分解就够，别把它当方法论文。
recommendation.en: If you care about native multimodal agents, the value is in the finer-grained evaluation; read the task taxonomy and error breakdown, not as a methods paper.
