summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution + method innovation, first propose Hard Mode ATP setting, release two expert-reannotated Hard Mode benchmarks, and propose the first agent framework DAP adapted to this mode
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Discover and Prove (DAP) framework: first discover answers through LLM natural language reasoning with explicit self-reflection, rewrite Hard Mode statements into Easy Mode, then connect to existing ATP provers to complete the proof
summary_en.experiments: On CombiBench, Pass@16 increases from 7 (previous SOTA) to 10; on PutnamBench, it is the first system to formally prove 36 theorems in Hard Mode
summary_en.authors_note: The author team includes Lifeng Shang, a senior researcher at ByteDance AI Lab, whose team has long been engaged in large model reasoning and agent research

recommendation.zh: 定理证明Agent领域的增量工作，仅需了解新提出的Hard Mode基准设定即可，无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental work in the field of theorem proving agents, only need to understand the newly proposed Hard Mode benchmark setting, no in-depth reading required

paper.title: MERRIN: A Benchmark for Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的核心问题是：如何在更贴近真实开放网络（open web）的条件下评测“搜索增强（search-augmented）多模态智能体”的证据检索与多跳推理能力，尤其是在查询不显式提示模态、证据跨文本/图像/视频/音频且存在噪声与冲突的场景中，现有 benchmark 覆盖不足、错误归因不清。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身（数据/目标/优化）不是直接方法贡献，但对“多模态统一预训练 + agentic RAG/工具使用”的评测与数据科学有启发：1）把模态选择错误（Modality Error）、检索错误（Retrieval Error）、推理落地错误（Reasoning Error）显式区分，有助于训练/后训练时做针对性数据合成与损失设计；2）引入视频/音频等更难对齐的证据形态，提示多模态预训练在时序模态 grounding 上的短板；3）实证显示即便给 gold evidence，提升也有限，暗示瓶颈更偏“证据内推理/定位/对齐”而非纯检索，这对后续考虑过程监督、可验证引用、以及跨模态定位目标（timestamp/region grounding）很关键。
summary.technical_approach:
MERRIN 是一个人工标注 benchmark，设计点集中在“真实 web 噪声 + 多模态 + 多跳 + 无模态提示”：
1）查询：自然语言问题，不包含‘看图/看视频’等显式模态线索，迫使 agent 自主判断需要的模态。
2）证据模态：覆盖 Text/Image/Video/Audio（并提到表格等），强调视频与音频是以往基准较少覆盖的难点。
3）噪声机制：每个问题在开放搜索时会诱发不完整、冲突或误导性结果（distractors），更接近真实检索分布。
4）错误类型框架：用示意路径区分 Modality / Retrieval / Reasoning 三类错误，并在实验中用“提供 gold evidence”来部分剥离检索因素，从而估计推理瓶颈。
5）评测设置：对比 No Search、Native Search、Agentic Multimodal Search 三种设置，并评估多种闭源/开源模型驱动的 agent。
summary.experiments:
全文片段中给出了关键数字：
- 总体难度高：所有运行平均准确率 22.3%。
- 最强设置：Gemini-3.1-Pro + Agentic Multimodal Search 达到 40.1%。
- 三种搜索设置（在 6 个模型上可比）：No Search 17.3%，Native Search 23.1%，Agentic Multimodal Search 33.7%。
- 增加 search queries 或 visited pages 并不稳定提升准确率，说明“更多搜索 ≠ 更好结果”。
- 更强的 agent 反而更容易在噪声环境中过度探索（重复 query/tool call 不收敛）。
- 给定人工标注 gold evidence 后，准确率仅小幅提升 7.6 个点（40.1%→47.7%），作者据此判断推理/grounding 是更主要瓶颈。
片段末尾提到 50 例的人类评测，但具体人类准确率与对比数字在截断处未给出。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–40 分钟）：
1）先看 Table 1（与 BrowseComp/MMSearch/SealQA 等对比）快速理解 MERRIN 的差异维度：无模态提示、T/I/V/A、web noise、多跳、人标注、开放搜索。
2）读数据构建与标注规范：尤其是如何保证“单一无歧义答案”、以及噪声/冲突证据如何被系统性引入。
3）看三种 search setting 的对比实验与 error analysis：重点理解为什么 agentic search 提升有限、以及 over-exploration 的行为模式。
4）精看 gold evidence 实验：这是区分“检索 vs 推理”瓶颈的关键证据，对后续做训练数据合成/对齐目标设计最有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: MERRIN targets a realistic evaluation gap: measuring multimodal evidence retrieval and multi-hop reasoning for search-augmented agents on the noisy open web, where queries do not explicitly specify the required modality and evidence may be heterogeneous (text/image/video/audio) and conflicting.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but valuable for multimodal foundation-model research and agentic RAG evaluation: (1) it disentangles modality selection errors, retrieval errors, and reasoning/grounding errors—useful for designing targeted training data and objectives; (2) it stresses under-covered modalities (video/audio), highlighting grounding and localization weaknesses that pretraining may not fix with text-image data alone; (3) the modest gain from gold evidence suggests the dominant bottleneck is reasoning/grounding over retrieved multimodal content, motivating process supervision, citation/attribution training, and finer-grained cross-modal localization objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A human-annotated benchmark with three key design choices:
- Natural-language queries without modality cues, forcing agents to infer which modalities are needed.
- Broad evidence modalities including video and audio (beyond the common text+image focus).
- Noisy open-web retrieval with misleading/incomplete/conflicting distractors.
It also proposes an error taxonomy (Modality vs Retrieval vs Reasoning errors) and evaluates agents under three settings: No Search, Native Search, and Agentic Multimodal Search, plus a gold-evidence condition to partially factor out retrieval quality.
summary_en.experiments:
Key numbers reported in the provided text:
- Overall average accuracy across runs: 22.3%.
- Best system: Gemini-3.1-Pro with Agentic Multimodal Search at 40.1%.
- Comparable setting averages (6 models): No Search 17.3%, Native Search 23.1%, Agentic Multimodal Search 33.7%.
- More queries/pages do not reliably improve accuracy; stronger agents can over-explore (excessive repeated tool calls).
- With annotated gold evidence, accuracy improves only by 7.6 points (40.1% → 47.7%), indicating reasoning/grounding remains the main bottleneck.
The excerpt mentions a 50-example human evaluation but is truncated before the exact human score is shown.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in 30–40 minutes:
1) Start with Table 1 to position MERRIN vs prior web/multimodal search benchmarks.
2) Read dataset construction/annotation to understand how they ensure unambiguous answers and inject realistic web noise.
3) Focus on the three search-setting comparisons and the over-exploration analysis.
4) Read the gold-evidence experiment carefully—this is the cleanest evidence for separating retrieval limitations from reasoning/grounding limitations and is most actionable for future training-objective design.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误分解定义：把模态选择/检索/推理错误拆开，能直接指导你做针对性合成数据与损失；benchmark本身不必细读全文。
recommendation.en: Just read the error taxonomy: separating modality-choice vs retrieval vs reasoning errors directly informs targeted synthetic data and losses; the rest is mostly benchmark plumbing.

paper.title: SLQ: Bridging Modalities via Shared Latent Queries for Retrieval with Frozen MLLMs

summary.core_problem: 在不破坏多模态大模型（MLLM）预训练语义空间、且避免对比学习大batch带来的高成本前提下，如何把“冻结的生成式MLLM”高效改造成可用的多模态检索嵌入模型，并且让检索真正利用模型的知识与推理能力（而非仅做表层caption匹配）。
summary.importance: 对“预训练表征如何被下游检索任务正确抽取/读出（elicitation）”给出一个很直接的工程化答案：与其用LoRA/全参微调去重塑表征，不如用极少量可学习的查询向量作为信息汇聚接口，尽量保持预训练空间不被对比目标扭曲。对基座研究的启发在于：1）检索适配的瓶颈可能更多是表征聚合与读出，而非缺少对齐；2）冻结骨干+小参数读出在“避免语义退化/遗忘”上可能更稳；3）提出KARR-Bench把检索评测从“描述性匹配”推进到“知识/逻辑驱动的检索”，更贴近MLLM的优势能力边界。
summary.technical_approach:
SLQ（Shared Latent Queries）的关键是把一组可学习的“共享潜在查询”追加到文本token序列末尾与图像token序列末尾，并利用MLLM原生的causal attention让这些query作为全局聚合器读取上下文信息，最终用query对应的隐藏状态作为embedding。与常见做法差异：
1）参数更新范围：仅训练少量query参数，骨干完全冻结，避免生成式目标→判别式对比目标的强迁移导致语义空间形变。
2）跨模态统一：query在图像与文本两侧共享，使两种输入通过同一“读出头”投射到统一向量空间（而不是分别训练两个投影头或双塔）。
3）信息瓶颈视角：论文用诊断实验强调last-token（如EOS）作为单点汇聚会在知识/推理型查询上出现可分性不足；query token提供更灵活的聚合通道，能把隐式推理链条压缩进embedding。
4）评测驱动：构建KARR-Bench专门测“隐式知识表达→视觉可验证目标”的检索，而不是COCO caption式的显式词匹配。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的关键可核对数字/设置主要集中在：
- KARR-Bench构建：从COCO test 5,000张图出发，GPT-5-mini生成知识增强查询得到4,500候选，经4名标注者交叉验证，60–70%通过率，最终得到2,915对高质量图文检索样本。
- 诊断性pilot：对比last token聚合 vs 追加单个零初始化query聚合；在“模式匹配/知识联想/逻辑推理”三档难度中，query方法在知识与逻辑推理检索上显著更可分，能处理如“2+7 lives→cat”这类隐式推理链，而last-token会失败。
- 论文声称：SLQ以极小参数开销在多模态检索上优于LoRA（并在图3(b)展示“性能-开销”优势）。但在你提供的全文片段中，尚未出现具体的Recall@K、NDCG或各基线的明确数值表；精读时需要去实验章节/附录核对：训练的query数量/维度、对比损失细节、batch size、以及相对LoRA/全参/双塔的具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
1）Introduction里关于“objective mismatch导致语义退化/遗忘”的论证，以及Figure 1的三档难度诊断实验：这是SLQ动机最关键的证据链。
2）方法部分重点看：query如何插入序列、是否共享同一组query、最终embedding取哪些位置（所有query平均/拼接/取最后一个）、训练时的对比目标与温度/归一化。
3）KARR-Bench章节：三阶段数据管线与人工过滤标准，尤其是如何保证“严格视觉可验证”与避免LLM幻觉。
4）实验章节优先核对：与LoRA/全参/双塔的公平对比设置（batch、负样本、是否in-batch negatives）、以及消融（query数量、是否共享、插入位置、冻结/不冻结不同模块）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn a frozen generative MLLM into a strong multimodal retriever without invasive fine-tuning (full/LoRA) that can distort the pretrained semantic space, and without the heavy compute burden of contrastive training with huge batches—while actually leveraging the model’s latent knowledge and reasoning for retrieval rather than shallow caption matching.
summary_en.importance: The paper reframes retrieval adaptation as representation elicitation/reading-out rather than representation rewriting. For foundation-model pretraining research, the key takeaway is that a large part of “retrieval capability” may be bottlenecked by aggregation/readout (e.g., last-token pooling) instead of missing alignment. The frozen-backbone + tiny learnable interface approach is also a concrete recipe to reduce catastrophic forgetting when switching from generative objectives to discriminative contrastive ones. KARR-Bench is additionally valuable as it pushes retrieval evaluation toward knowledge- and logic-dependent queries, closer to what MLLMs are uniquely good at.
summary_en.technical_approach: SLQ introduces a small set of learnable latent query tokens appended to the end of both text and image token sequences. These queries are shared across modalities and use the model’s native causal attention as a global aggregation interface; the resulting query hidden states are used as embeddings for contrastive retrieval training. Distinctions vs prior work: (1) only the query parameters are trained while the MLLM is fully frozen, aiming to preserve the pretrained semantic geometry; (2) a shared query set serves as a unified cross-modal projection/readout mechanism rather than separate towers or heavy adapters; (3) the method is motivated by an explicit diagnosis that last-token pooling becomes an information bottleneck for knowledge/logic-heavy queries, whereas query tokens provide a more expressive readout channel.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text portion, the most concrete reported numbers are for the benchmark construction: starting from 5,000 COCO test images, GPT-5-mini generates knowledge-enhanced implicit queries yielding 4,500 candidates; after 4-annotator verification with a 60–70% acceptance rate, KARR-Bench ends with 2,915 grounded image-text pairs. The paper also includes a diagnostic pilot showing query-token aggregation succeeds on knowledge and logical reasoning retrieval cases where last-token pooling fails (e.g., arithmetic-to-entity reasoning like “2+7 lives” → cat). It further claims SLQ outperforms LoRA with minimal parameter overhead (Figure 3(b)), but the excerpt does not include the exact retrieval metrics (e.g., Recall@K) or training scales; those must be verified in the main experiments/appendix for precise deltas, batch sizes, and ablations (query count, sharing, insertion position).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (~30–45 min): (1) Read the Introduction + Figure 1 carefully—the three-tier diagnostic is the core motivation. (2) In the method section, focus on how queries are inserted, how embeddings are formed from query states, and the exact contrastive objective/normalization. (3) Read the KARR-Bench pipeline and the human verification criteria to understand grounding and hallucination filtering. (4) In experiments, prioritize fairness details vs LoRA/full finetune/dual-tower (batch size, negatives) and ablations on query design (number/shared vs separate/position/frozen components).

recommendation.zh: 看共享latent query的读出设计：冻结MLLM不动，用少量查询向量做检索聚合，避免对比学习扭曲语义；KARR-Bench可当评测补丁。
recommendation.en: Focus on the shared latent-query readout: keep the MLLM frozen and learn a tiny query set to aggregate retrieval embeddings, avoiding contrastive-induced semantic drift; KARR-Bench is a handy eval add-on.

paper.title: KMMMU: Evaluation of Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding in Korean Language and Context

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态评测多为英文/翻译集，难以衡量模型在韩语语境与本土制度/文化约定下的多学科多模态理解能力；如何构建原生韩语的高信息密度评测？
summary.importance: 提供语言与文化/制度约定强相关的多模态理解benchmark，可用于诊断“从约定到标签映射”(convention-to-label mapping)与符号归纳等能力缺口；对多语种/本土化多模态预训练数据与评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建KMMMU：3,466道原生韩语试题式多模态问题，覆盖9学科与9类视觉模态；额外提供300题韩语特有子集与627题hard子集；并做分学科/子集评测与错误分析以定位失败模式。
summary.experiments: 在KMMMU全量与hard子集上评测开源与闭源模型：最强开源约42.05%（全量），最佳闭源在hard子集约52.42%；韩语特有子集存在最高约13.43%的性能差距；错误分析指出主要瓶颈更偏“约定/格式到标签映射”与少样本符号归纳，而非纯推理深度。摘要未给出具体模型名称与配置细节。

summary_en.core_problem: English-centric or translated multimodal benchmarks fail to measure multimodal understanding under Korean language, cultural, and institutional conventions; how to build a native Korean, information-dense evaluation?
summary_en.importance: Introduces a culturally grounded multimodal benchmark to diagnose gaps in convention-to-label mapping and few-shot symbolic induction, informing multilingual/localized multimodal pretraining and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds KMMMU with 3,466 native Korean exam-style multimodal questions across 9 disciplines and 9 visual modality categories, plus a 300-item Korean-specific subset and a 627-item hard subset; includes per-discipline evaluation and error analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks open and proprietary models: best open-source reaches ~42.05% on the full set; best proprietary gets ~52.42% on the hard subset; Korean-specific subset shows gaps up to ~13.43%. Error analysis points to convention-to-label mapping and few-shot symbolic induction as key bottlenecks. Specific model details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为韩语本土语境的多模态“约定→标签”压力测试很有用，但对预训练机制没新东西；当作多语种评测备查，扫题型分布与错误案例即可。
recommendation.en: Handy Korean-native stress test for convention-to-label mapping, but it won’t move pretraining priors; keep it as multilingual eval reference and just skim task taxonomy + failure cases.

paper.title: Seek-and-Solve: Benchmarking MLLMs for Visual Clue-Driven Reasoning in Daily Scenarios

summary.core_problem: 评测MLLM在日常场景中“从视觉噪声中定位关键线索并据此推理”的能力缺口，构建更偏推理而非识别/常识的基准。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：将评测重心从知识/感知转向“线索驱动推理”，对多模态预训练与后训练的数据构造、评测诊断有一定价值，但属于常规基准工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DailyClue基准：强调真实日常活动强 grounding，并设计需要主动寻找视觉线索、再进行后续推理的挑战性问题；覆盖4大日常域、16个子任务，并对多种MLLM与agentic模型进行系统评测。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据规模、具体模型列表与分数差距；结论是现有MLLM/agentic模型在该基准上表现仍具挑战性。

summary_en.core_problem: Fill the evaluation gap for MLLMs on visual clue-driven reasoning in daily scenarios, beyond recognition or prior-knowledge probing.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution shifting evaluation toward clue localization + reasoning; useful for diagnosing multimodal pre/post-training data needs, though largely a standard benchmark paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: DailyClue is built with strict grounding in authentic daily activities and queries that require actively identifying decisive visual clues before reasoning; spans 4 domains and 16 subtasks with evaluations across MLLMs and agentic models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits dataset size, model roster, and exact score gaps; it reports that the benchmark remains challenging for current MLLMs/agentic systems.

recommendation.zh: 又一个benchmark，但把重点放在“先找线索再推理”而非识别，适合用来做数据合成/后训练诊断；不必细读，扫任务定义与难例就行。
recommendation.en: Another benchmark, but the ‘seek clue then reason’ framing is useful for diagnosing data/finetune gaps; no need to deep read—skim task definitions and hard examples.

paper.title: CANVAS: Continuity-Aware Narratives via Visual Agentic Storyboarding

summary.core_problem: 如何在长篇多镜头视觉叙事生成中保持跨镜头连续性（角色一致、背景稳定、场景过渡平滑），避免逐帧生成导致的身份漂移与场景跳变。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为方法+Benchmark：提出面向“连续性”的多智能体故事板规划框架，并补充一个更难的长程一致性评测集HardContinuityBench；对多模态生成/视频叙事一致性有启发，但对纯文本LLM基座预训练相关性一般。
summary.technical_approach: CANVAS多智能体框架：显式规划连续性约束（角色连续性、持久背景锚点、位置/地点感知的场景规划），通过“先规划后生成/分镜”来约束多镜头叙事的全局一致性；并在既有基准上系统评测。
summary.experiments: 在ST-BENCH与ViStoryBench上评测，并引入HardContinuityBench；相对最强基线在背景连续性上提升21.6%（摘要给出），并报告角色一致性等指标提升（其余数值需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to maintain long-range continuity in multi-shot visual storytelling (consistent characters, stable environments, smooth transitions) rather than generating strong but inconsistent individual frames.
summary_en.importance: Method + benchmark contribution: proposes a continuity-aware multi-agent storyboarding framework and introduces HardContinuityBench for harder long-range consistency evaluation. More relevant to multimodal generation than to core text LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CANVAS uses explicit continuity planning constraints (character continuity, persistent background anchors, location-aware scene planning) in a multi-agent storyboard pipeline to enforce global coherence across shots.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ST-BENCH and ViStoryBench and introduces HardContinuityBench; reports +21.6% improvement in background continuity over the strongest baseline (other metrics/details in the paper).

recommendation.zh: 当作长程一致性评测与任务设定备查即可，方法偏多代理编排；只看HardContinuityBench定义和失败案例图。
recommendation.en: Main value is the long-horizon continuity eval/task framing; the multi-agent storyboard method is secondary—read the benchmark spec and failure-case figures only.

paper.title: ReConText3D: Replay-based Continual Text-to-3D Generation

summary.core_problem: 如何在“文本到3D生成”场景下实现持续学习：增量学习新类别的同时，避免对已学类别的灾难性遗忘。
summary.importance: 将持续学习（replay/记忆库）系统性引入 text-to-3D 生成，并提出对应benchmark（Toys4K-CL）。对“生成模型的持续学习/记忆机制”有一定启发，但与LLM基座预训练主线关联偏间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReConText3D：不改动底层 text-to-3D 架构，通过构建紧凑多样的回放记忆库来做 rehearsal。记忆样本选择使用文本嵌入空间的 k-Center 选择，以覆盖语义多样性并控制存储规模。
summary.experiments: 在 Toys4K-CL（由 Toys4K 派生的类增量划分）上评估持续学习下的遗忘与保留能力；对比“直接增量训练”展示灾难性遗忘，并验证 replay 记忆库带来的保留提升（摘要未给出具体数值与模型规模细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Enabling continual learning for text-to-3D generation: learning new 3D categories incrementally while mitigating catastrophic forgetting on previously learned ones.
summary_en.importance: Introduces replay-based continual learning into text-to-3D generation and releases a dedicated benchmark (Toys4K-CL). Potentially insightful for memory/replay in generative models, but only indirectly relevant to core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReConText3D keeps the underlying text-to-3D architecture unchanged and relies on rehearsal via a compact replay buffer. The buffer is built with k-Center selection in the text-embedding space to maximize semantic coverage under a memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Toys4K-CL with class-incremental splits; shows severe forgetting under naive incremental training and improved retention with replay (no concrete model/data scale numbers provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把replay式持续学习搬到text-to-3D，更多是基准+系统化实现；了解Toys4K-CL设定即可，不必细抠算法。
recommendation.en: Replay-based continual learning applied to text-to-3D is mostly benchmark + systemization; worth knowing the Toys4K-CL setup, not worth deep algorithm reading.

paper.title: Correct Chains, Wrong Answers: Dissociating Reasoning from Output in LLM Logic

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的核心问题是：在逻辑推理任务中，“链式思维（CoT）每一步都正确”并不必然推出“最终答案正确”。作者希望把“真正按定义执行运算并逐步组合（operator logic）”与“凭运算符名字/常见模式检索（operator name / pattern retrieval）”严格解耦，并进一步定位：当出现“推理正确但答案错”时，错误究竟发生在推理过程、还是发生在最终输出生成阶段（autoregressive decoding 的末端决策）。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的启发主要在三点：
1) 评测层面：提出一种能系统性暴露“推理—输出解耦（reasoning–output dissociation）”的构造范式（Novel Operator Test），它能绕开传统逻辑基准被语料记忆/模板检索污染的问题；这对研究“模型是否学到可组合的算法性语义”很关键。
2) 机制层面：把错误分成“策略失败（strategy failure，模型不进入推理模式）”与“内容失败（content failure，进入推理模式但末端答案仍错）”，并用长度/脚手架干预把两者分离，为研究训练动态（何时触发显式推理）、以及解码/对齐导致的末端不稳定提供了可操作的实验抓手。
3) 数据与对齐层面：结果暗示仅靠 CoT 监督或让模型‘写出正确步骤’不足以保证可执行性与最终决策一致；对后续的 RL pretrain / 过程监督（process supervision）/ 末端校准（answer calibration）都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Novel Operator Test 基准设计与一组诊断性干预。
- 基准构造：从 16 个二元布尔函数中去掉 6 个“平凡函数”（常量、投影及其取反），保留 10 个非平凡算子；实验选 9 个（为平衡分组与结构覆盖，省略 NAND 与一个与 BLIF 镜像的算子）。
- 分组思想：
  * Group A（标准名）：AND/OR/XOR/IF-THEN，预训练语料中高频。
  * Group B（新名字但给出真值表定义）：BLIF(A∧¬B)、TARN(NOR)、QUEX(B→A)、DREM(XNOR)。这些在结构上覆盖对称性、稀疏性（真值表 True 行数）等维度，用于区分“结构难度”与“名字熟悉度”。
  * Group C（Trojan）：ZENT 的真值表与 XOR 完全相同但名字陌生，用来隔离“仅名字变化”对性能的影响：若 XOR≈ZENT，则模型主要按定义执行而非按名字联想。
- 任务形式：每题给出相关算子的真值表、变量赋值，要求计算左结合链式表达式；深度定义为链长（1–10）。同质链（同一算子重复）与混合算子链（额外 600 题）都测。
- 关键诊断：
  * 用“完成 token 数”作为行为代理，判断模型是在做“简短检索式回答”还是进入“显式 CoT 组合”。
  * 引入 Explicit Truth-Table Tracing (ETT) 提示：强制每一步按真值表查表并写出中间结果，作为结构化脚手架干预，用于检验：性能问题来自没进入正确策略，还是来自更深层的生成/一致性问题。
  * 自我纠错探针（self-correction probe）：对出现“推理正确但答案错”的样本，追问/要求核对以定位失败点；作者据此将深度 7 的核心失败归因到“自回归生成末端的答案声明”而非推理步骤本身。
- 与既有工作的区别：不同于 Turpin et al. 2024 所讨论的 CoT unfaithfulness（写出来的推理不等于真实过程），本文展示的是“写出来的推理在可验证意义上是正确的，但最终输出标签仍错”，属于另一类一致性断裂。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个模型：GPT-4o-2024-11-20、Claude Sonnet 4、Llama 3.1 70B Instruct、o3-mini-2025-01-31、QwQ-32B；每模型最多约 8,100 题（含扩展深度、表示形式、ETT、混合链等；推理模型 o3-mini/QwQ-32B 不做部分干预）。
关键结果（文中给出的核心数字/现象）：
- 低深度：所有模型在 depth 1 均 ≥96%。
- depth 5：GPT-4o 与 Claude Sonnet 4 在所有组别均 ≥96%；Llama 有明显 novelty gap。
- novelty gap（Group A − Group B）：GPT-4o 在 depth 5 为 0pp，Claude 为 -1pp；Llama 在 depth 5 为 11pp（Welch t-test p<0.01）；QwQ-32B 约 6pp。Llama 的差距集中在 QUEX(78%)、DREM(86%)，说明困难更多来自算子结构而非名字。
- Trojan 检验：depth 5 时 XOR 与 ZENT 无显著差异（所有模型 Fisher exact p≥0.49），支持“按真值表定义执行”而非“按名字联想”。但在 depth 2 出现反直觉：GPT-4o 的 ZENT(82%) 反而高于 XOR(62%)，提示“熟悉名字”可能诱发错误的检索式策略。
- 深度—策略转变：GPT-4o 在多数算子上呈非单调：depth1 近 100%，depth2 明显下跌，depth3–5 恢复。行为证据来自输出长度：
  * depth1：所有算子几乎都 1 token 作答。
  * depth2：仍倾向短答导致失败，尤其 XOR：50/50 样本全部 1 token 作答但仅 62% 准确。
  * depth3：开始进入长 CoT，TARN 平均 321 tokens、DREM 272 tokens，准确率均跃升到 98%。
- 处理成本差异：depth 5 时 GPT-4o 对 Group A 平均 141 tokens，对 Group B 平均 343 tokens（2.4×），在准确率相当情况下显示“新算子需要更重的显式处理”。
- 论文标题现象（推理正确但答案错）：Claude Sonnet 4 在 depth 7 出现 31 个错误样本，作者逐步核验后认为每一步 CoT 都正确但最终声明答案错误；混合算子链中 19 个错误里有 17 个同样模式。自我纠错探针显示失败点集中在自回归生成末端的答案输出。
- ETT 干预：作者区分两类失败：
  * depth2 的“策略失败”可被 ETT 大幅修复（文中给出 +62pp 的提升量级）。
  * depth7 的“内容失败/末端失败”ETT 仅带来 +8–30pp 的提升区间，且作者报告在某些后续干预下出现“0/300 post-intervention”的现象（表明并非简单脚手架即可根治，更多像生成一致性/决策头问题）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看基准定义部分：Novel Operator Test 的三组设计（标准/新名/Trojan）与“去平凡函数”的动机，理解它如何隔离语料记忆与组合推理。
2) 重点看 depth2 的“模式切换”证据：Figure 2（长度作为策略代理）+ XOR 在 depth2 的 1-token 行为，这是全文最关键的机制线索之一。
3) 精看 Table 3/4（或对应主结果表）：XOR vs ZENT 的无差异、以及 GroupA vs GroupB 的 token 成本差异。
4) 看 ETT 章节：作者如何用脚手架把 strategy failure 与 content failure 分开；并结合 depth7 的 31 个 dissociation 样本理解“错误发生在末端输出”。
5) 若你关注预训练/对齐：建议把本文现象与 process supervision、RLHF 对“最终答案 token”的偏置联系起来思考：为什么中间状态正确但最后一步会翻车？是否与解码温度、答案格式、或 reward model 对简短答案的偏好有关？

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in logical reasoning with CoT: an LLM can produce a fully correct, verifiable chain of intermediate steps yet still output an incorrect final answer. The goal is to (i) disentangle genuine operator execution from name-based pattern retrieval by using unfamiliar operator names defined via truth tables, and (ii) localize where the failure happens—during reasoning steps vs. at the final autoregressive answer emission.
summary_en.importance:
Key implications for foundation-model pretraining research:
1) Evaluation design: the Novel Operator Test is a clean construction to reduce contamination from memorized operator semantics and to probe compositional, definition-following behavior.
2) Mechanistic diagnosis: the paper separates “strategy failures” (model never enters an explicit reasoning mode) from “content/decoding failures” (explicit reasoning is correct but the final answer token is wrong), offering a practical handle to study training dynamics and decoding stability.
3) Alignment/process supervision: it suggests that supervising or eliciting CoT is not sufficient to guarantee executable correctness at the decision point; the final-answer channel can be miscalibrated even when intermediate computation is correct—relevant to RL pretraining, process rewards, and answer calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach combines a benchmark construction with targeted prompting/diagnostic probes.
- Benchmark: Boolean operator evaluation where each operator is defined by an explicit truth table, but operator names vary in familiarity.
  * Group A: standard names (AND/OR/XOR/IF-THEN).
  * Group B: unfamiliar names mapped to non-trivial Boolean functions (e.g., A∧¬B, NOR, converse implication, XNOR), chosen to span structural properties like symmetry and sparsity.
  * Group C (Trojan): ZENT has the exact XOR truth table under a novel name; this isolates name familiarity from operator logic.
- Task: left-associated homogeneous chains at depths 1–10, plus mixed-operator chains.
- Behavioral proxy: completion length is used to infer whether the model is doing terse retrieval vs. explicit multi-step reasoning.
- Intervention: Explicit Truth-Table Tracing (ETT) forces step-by-step truth-table lookup to test whether failures are due to missing strategy vs. deeper inconsistencies.
- Localization: a self-correction probe on dissociation cases is used to argue the error is concentrated at the final autoregressive answer declaration rather than in the intermediate reasoning steps.
- Distinction from prior work: unlike CoT unfaithfulness (where written reasoning diverges from the true internal process), here the written reasoning is itself correct but the final output label is wrong.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: GPT-4o-2024-11-20, Claude Sonnet 4, Llama 3.1 70B Instruct, o3-mini-2025-01-31, QwQ-32B; up to ~8,100 problems/model depending on interventions.
Main findings with concrete reported numbers:
- Depth 1: all models achieve ≥96%.
- Depth 5: GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4 achieve ≥96% across all operator groups; Llama shows a novelty gap.
- Novelty gap (Group A − Group B) at depth 5: GPT-4o 0pp, Claude -1pp, Llama 11pp (Welch t-test p<0.01), QwQ-32B ~6pp. For Llama, the gap concentrates on QUEX (78%) and DREM (86%), indicating structural difficulty beyond name familiarity.
- Trojan test: no significant XOR–ZENT gap at depth 5 for any model (Fisher exact p≥0.49), supporting definition-based execution. However at depth 2 GPT-4o shows ZENT 82% vs XOR 62%, suggesting familiar names can trigger a wrong “retrieval” strategy.
- Depth-2 mode transition: GPT-4o exhibits a sharp dip at depth 2 then recovers by depth 3–5. Length evidence: depth 1 answers are ~1 token; at depth 2 XOR is answered in exactly 1 token for all 50 instances yet only 62% correct; by depth 3 the model produces long CoT (e.g., TARN ~321 tokens, DREM ~272 tokens) with ~98% accuracy.
- Processing cost: at depth 5 GPT-4o uses 141 mean tokens for Group A vs 343 for Group B (2.4×) at similar accuracy.
- Core dissociation: Claude Sonnet 4 at depth 7 has 31 errors where every CoT step is verified correct but the declared final answer is wrong; in mixed-operator chains 17/19 errors show the same pattern. Self-correction probes attribute the failure to the final autoregressive answer emission.
- ETT: large gains for depth-2 strategy failures (reported +62pp), but limited gains for depth-7 dissociation/content failures (reported +8–30pp range), with some post-intervention settings yielding 0/300 success—suggesting the issue is not fixed by scaffolding alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
1) Read the benchmark construction carefully (operator grouping + Trojan logic) to understand how it isolates memorization vs compositional execution.
2) Focus on the depth-2 “mode switch” evidence: the response-length analysis (Figure 2) and the XOR 1-token behavior at depth 2.
3) Inspect the main tables for XOR vs ZENT and Group A vs Group B token-cost differences.
4) Read the ETT intervention section to see how the paper separates strategy vs content/decoding failures.
5) For pretraining/alignment researchers: reflect on why correct intermediate computation can still produce a wrong final token—possible interactions with decoding, formatting, or reward-model biases.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Novel Operator Test 和“策略失败 vs 内容失败”的分解：它提醒 CoT 正确不等于决策正确，适合用来评估你过程监督/RL 是否只在教模型写漂亮步骤。
recommendation.en: Skim the Novel Operator Test and the strategy-vs-content failure split: it shows correct CoT doesn’t guarantee correct decisions, a good probe for whether your process supervision/RL just trains fluent steps.

paper.title: InfiniteScienceGym: An Unbounded, Procedurally-Generated Benchmark for Scientific Analysis

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖真实论文/人工标注的前提下，评测“科学助手型LLM/Agent”是否能基于给定仓库中的经验数据进行证据推理、在证据不足时正确拒答（abstention），并且在工具调用与文件交互上采取有效策略；同时避免真实数据评测固有的发表偏差、已知知识污染（parametric priors/known-knowledge bias）、标注噪声与数据分发成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是提出新训练法，而是提供一种更“可控、可扩展、可验证”的评测范式：用程序化生成的科学仓库+特权生成器给出可证明的ground truth（含不可回答问题），从而把模型的“参数记忆”与“基于证据的推理/工具使用”更干净地解耦。对基座模型而言，它能作为数据与训练目标设计的诊断工具：1）量化模型在证据不足时的过度自信与幻觉倾向；2）揭示长上下文/工具使用下，token用量并不等价于证据处理量；3）为后续的pretrain/RL-pretrain/持续学习提供可无限采样的合成评测分布，用于做训练动态对比（例如不同数据配比、不同tool-use pretraining对“可拒答性”的影响）。
summary.technical_approach:
InfiniteScienceGym的核心是“三段式生成管线”并强调可复现与可验证：
1）Simulator（仓库模拟器）：输入随机seed，确定性生成一个“自包含”的科学研究仓库（目录结构+文件+表格数据+元信息+笔记等），尽量贴近真实科研项目的artifact形态。seed→repo是确定函数，因此可复现、可索引；同时按需生成避免存储/版权问题。
2）Privileged QA generator（特权问答生成器）：它访问模拟器的底层生成过程（而不是仅看表面文件），用模板化方式生成问题，并给出精确ground truth。关键点是能系统地产生“可回答/不可回答”两类问题：不可回答并非主观标注，而是由生成过程保证仓库中缺失必要证据（例如缺测、定义不匹配等），因此具备“可证明的不可回答性”。
3）Paraphrase module（释义模块）：把模板问答改写成更自然的研究者提问表述，用于测试对表面形式扰动的鲁棒性，同时保持可验证性。
评测设置强调agentic行为：模型可浏览仓库、选择加载文件或调用工具（如代码/分析）来得出结论。论文还把“交互/工具调用次数”与“token消耗”区分开，主张用前者更好刻画证据处理策略：强模型往往避免把大文件直接塞进上下文，而是用程序化方式处理。
summary.experiments:
论文在tool-enabled设置下评测多种闭源与开源模型，结论集中在三点：
1）总体性能低：所有模型在InfiniteScienceGym上都不理想，最强模型总体准确率仅44.8%，说明“基于仓库证据的科学推理+拒答”远未解决。
2）不可回答识别薄弱：大量系统在证据不足时仍给出自信答案（过度断言/幻觉），暴露出abstention能力与不确定性校准问题。
3）交互与工具调用与准确率正相关：更高的tool call/交互通常带来更高准确率；相反，token使用量不是可靠的努力/严谨度代理变量——强系统可能token更省但通过代码分析更有效地处理大文件。
（给定全文片段未包含更细的分任务指标、题型分解或具体模型列表/方差；若论文后文有表格，建议补充按“可回答/不可回答”、按仓库规模、按工具预算的分层结果。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
1）重点读Introduction与“The Case for Procedurally Generated Scientific Evaluation”：理解它要解决的评测偏差（发表偏差、known-knowledge bias、标注噪声、存储/版权）以及为何程序化生成能提供“可证明不可回答”。
2）精看生成管线描述（simulator→QA generator→paraphrase）：这是方法核心，尤其关注“特权访问”如何保证ground truth与unanswerable的构造逻辑。
3）看实验结论部分关于“工具调用次数 vs token用量”的对比论点：这对设计pretrain数据（tool-use traces）、以及评测指标（effort proxy）很有启发。
4）如果你做预训练/持续学习：思考如何把该环境当作可无限采样的合成分布，用于RL-pretrain或课程学习（先可回答再不可回答、先小仓库再大仓库），以及如何定义奖励（正确+引用证据+正确拒答+成本约束）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate whether LLM-based scientific assistants/agents can (i) reason from empirical evidence contained in a project-like repository, (ii) correctly abstain when the repository lacks sufficient evidence, and (iii) use tools/files efficiently—without relying on real published studies or human labels that introduce publication bias, known-knowledge contamination, annotation noise, and heavy storage/legal burdens.
summary_en.importance: The paper is primarily an evaluation/benchmark contribution rather than a new pretraining algorithm, but it matters for foundation-model research because it offers a controllable, infinitely scalable, and verifiable testbed that better separates parametric knowledge from evidence-grounded reasoning. It exposes two pretraining-relevant failure modes: systematic overclaiming on unanswerable queries (calibration/abstention) and the mismatch between token-based “effort” and actual evidence processing under tool use. As a result, it can serve as a diagnostic target for data/recipe changes (e.g., tool-use pretraining, RL-pretrain for abstention, continual learning of scientific workflows) with reproducible seeds and ground truth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
InfiniteScienceGym is built around a deterministic, seed-indexed procedural generation pipeline:
1) A simulator maps a random seed to a self-contained “scientific repository” (realistic directory structure, files, tabular datasets, metadata, notes). Because generation is deterministic, instances are reproducible; because they are generated on demand, distribution avoids storing large corpora.
2) A privileged QA generator uses access to the simulator’s latent generation process (not just surface files) to produce templated questions with exact ground truth, including provably unanswerable questions constructed by ensuring missing/mismatched evidence.
3) A paraphrasing module rewrites templated QAs into more natural research queries while preserving verifiability.
Evaluation is agentic/tool-enabled: models can inspect repository contents and invoke analysis tools. The paper emphasizes that effective agents often avoid stuffing large files into context and instead analyze them programmatically, motivating metrics beyond token count.
summary_en.experiments: Across a mix of proprietary and open-weight models in a tool-enabled setting, no model performs well overall; the best reported accuracy is 44.8%. Unanswerable-question handling is a major weakness: many systems still answer confidently despite insufficient evidence. Strategy analysis shows accuracy increases with interaction/tool calls, whereas token usage is a poor proxy for diligence—stronger agents may use fewer tokens by operating on files via code/tools rather than loading them verbatim. (The provided full-text excerpt does not include finer-grained breakdown tables; consult the main results section for per-condition splits if available.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the benchmark motivation and the specific confounders it targets (publication bias, known-knowledge bias, label noise, storage/legal constraints).
- Focus on the generator pipeline description (simulator → privileged QA → paraphrase). The key novelty is the “privileged” construction of exact ground truth and provable unanswerability.
- In the results, prioritize the analysis contrasting tool-call count vs token usage as effort proxies; this is the most actionable insight for pretraining/RL-pretrain and evaluation design.
- If you work on pretraining/continual learning, consider how to use the seed-indexed environment for scalable RL-style curricula and for training abstention/calibration with cost-aware rewards.

recommendation.zh: 当作可无限采样的诊断基准看：重点读“可拒答问题+特权生成器 ground truth”的设计，能用来区分参数记忆与证据推理；正文细节不必逐页啃。
recommendation.en: Use it as an endlessly-samplable diagnostic benchmark: focus on the unanswerable-question + privileged-generator ground-truth design to separate parametric recall from evidence reasoning; no need to read every detail.

paper.title: LongCoT: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 如何可控、可验证地评测前沿模型在“超长推理链”(长时程CoT)上的规划与错误累积问题。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：把长时程推理失败从“单步能力不足”中剥离出来，直接测量跨数万到数十万推理token的长链依赖与状态管理能力，为长上下文训练、推理时计算分配、以及后训练/自我纠错研究提供靶标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LongCoT基准：2500道专家设计题，覆盖化学/数学/计算机/国际象棋/逻辑；题目输入短且答案可验证，但解题需要在“相互依赖步骤图”中推进，链长可达数十到数十万推理token；设计使得每个局部步骤对前沿模型都可解，从而将失败归因于长时程组织与累积误差。
summary.experiments: 报告发布时前沿模型在该基准上准确率<10%（如GPT 5.2: 9.8%，Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%）；其余训练规模/提示策略/对比设置摘要未展开。

summary_en.core_problem: How to rigorously and verifiably evaluate frontier models’ long-horizon chain-of-thought planning and error accumulation over extremely long reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: isolates long-horizon reasoning failures from single-step capability limits, providing a target for long-context training, inference-time compute allocation, and post-training/self-correction research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces LongCoT: 2,500 expert-designed problems across chemistry, math, CS, chess, and logic. Inputs are short with verifiable answers, but solving requires traversing a dependency graph of steps spanning tens to hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens. Each local step is intended to be tractable for frontier models, attributing failures to long-horizon limitations.
summary_en.experiments: At release, best models achieve <10% accuracy (e.g., GPT 5.2: 9.8%; Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%). The abstract does not detail training scale, prompting protocols, or broader baselines.

recommendation.zh: 当benchmark备查即可：重点看任务如何可验证+错误累积统计，能把长上下文训练/推理算力分配的改动落到可测靶标上。
recommendation.en: Use it as a benchmark reference: focus on the verifiability design and error-accumulation stats—it gives a concrete target for long-context training and inference compute-allocation tweaks.

paper.title: Hessian-Enhanced Token Attribution (HETA): Interpreting Autoregressive LLMs

summary.core_problem: 如何为decoder-only自回归LLM生成结果提供更“因果可信、语义一致”的token级归因解释，并系统评测归因质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为解释性方法+评测数据集：尝试把二阶敏感性（Hessian）引入token attribution以超越线性近似，并提出一个用于生成式归因质量评估的基准数据集；对理解LLM内部决策与调试有一定启发，但对预训练方法论的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HETA框架，组合三部分：(1) semantic transition vector刻画跨层token-to-token影响；(2) 基于Hessian的二阶敏感性分数建模非线性/二阶效应；(3) 通过mask token后的KL散度衡量信息损失，将“遮蔽影响”与敏感性信号融合，输出上下文相关且更具因果一致性的归因。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、对比方法清单与定量提升幅度；仅说明引入“curated benchmark dataset”用于系统评测生成式归因质量，缺少可据以判断SOTA/显著性的关键细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to produce causally faithful and semantically grounded token-level attributions for decoder-only autoregressive LLM generations, and evaluate attribution quality systematically.
summary_en.importance: Method + benchmark contribution: introduces Hessian-based (second-order) sensitivity into token attribution beyond linear approximations, plus a curated benchmark for generative attribution evaluation. Useful for interpretability/debugging, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: HETA combines (1) a semantic transition vector to capture token-to-token influence across layers, (2) Hessian-based sensitivity scores for second-order effects, and (3) KL divergence under token masking to quantify information loss, yielding context-aware attributions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains; it only mentions a curated benchmark dataset for evaluating attribution quality, so SOTA/significance cannot be assessed from the provided info.

recommendation.zh: 二阶归因很可能算力/噪声都不友好，别细读方法推导；只看他们的归因评测协议与失败案例，能帮你挑更靠谱的debug工具。
recommendation.en: Hessian attribution is likely compute-heavy and brittle; skip the math and focus on their evaluation protocol + failure cases to sanity-check attribution tools for debugging.

paper.title: Beyond Static Personas: Situational Personality Steering for Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有人格/Persona控制多为静态设定，难以随情境变化而稳定、可控地调整LLM的“情境化人格表现”。
summary.importance: 从“persona neurons”角度分析情境依赖，并提出训练-free的神经元检索与steering框架；对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对可控生成/表征可解释性与steering方法有一定启发，并引入情境人格benchmark（SPBench）。
summary.technical_approach: IRIS：Identify-Retrieve-Steer。先识别情境相关persona神经元，再进行情境感知的神经元检索，并用相似度加权进行steering，实现无需再训练的情境人格控制。
summary.experiments: 在PersonalityBench与新提出的SPBench上验证；摘要未给出所用具体模型规模、提升幅度与关键对比细节（如与prompt persona/LoRA等方法对比）。

summary_en.core_problem: Most persona control for LLMs is static and struggles to adapt behavior reliably across different situations (situational personality).
summary_en.importance: Provides a neuron-level analysis of situation dependency and proposes a training-free neuron retrieval/steering method. While not directly advancing pretraining, it is relevant to controllability and mechanistic steering, and introduces a situational personality benchmark (SPBench).
summary_en.technical_approach: IRIS (Identify-Retrieve-Steer): identify situational persona neurons, retrieve situation-aware neurons, and apply similarity-weighted steering to modulate behavior without additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on PersonalityBench and the newly introduced SPBench; the abstract does not specify model sizes, exact gains, or key baselines in detail.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free 的 persona neuron 检索更像工程小技巧：只看 steering 稳定性对比和 SPBench 设定，别把“可控”外推成表征因果。
recommendation.en: The training-free persona-neuron retrieval reads like a practical trick: skim the steering stability comparisons and SPBench setup, but don’t over-interpret it as causal representation control.

paper.title: Exploration and Exploitation Errors Are Measurable for Language Model Agents

summary.core_problem: 在无法访问LM agent内部策略/价值函数的情况下，仅从外显动作轨迹中，如何可操作地区分并量化“探索不足/探索冗余”与“利用不足/利用冗余”的错误，并构造可控环境系统性地调节探索/利用难度以评测不同agent的失败模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线（数据/Tokenizer/Scaling/训练动态）关联较弱，更偏agent评测与行为度量。但对RL pretrain/持续学习方向有启发：作者尝试用“策略无关（policy-agnostic）”的结构性冗余度量来诊断行为错误，避免把评测绑定到某个最优策略或语义先验；同时通过去语义化（DAG节点用符号表示）减少模型利用预训练知识投机取巧。这类评测设计可用于检验RL式训练是否真正改善探索/利用，而不是提升语义猜测能力。
summary.technical_approach:
框架由两部分：
1）可控任务环境：部分可观测2D grid map + 未知任务DAG。agent通过移动逐步揭示局部地图与任务节点位置；任务由DAG先决条件约束，最终达成唯一goal节点。关键设计是把DAG语义信息替换为符号表示，迫使agent依赖环境交互而非预训练语义。
2）策略无关错误度量：不定义最优策略，而是在“无进展片段”中基于图论的冗余/重复概念检测“任何合理策略都不应产生”的结构性冗余动作，并根据当时地图状态把错误归因到探索、利用或两者。并通过程序化生成地图拓扑与DAG复杂度来分别增强探索难度（更宽、更稀疏节点等）或利用难度（更密依赖、更浅路径等）。
summary.experiments: 作者在多种地图配置下评测多个前沿LM agent，报告不同模型呈现不同探索/利用失败模式；并做prompt类型与显式agent harness的消融，结论是“少量harness工程即可同时改善探索与利用”。但在当前提供的正文片段中未出现具体模型名单、分数、误差率等数字，无法可靠复述定量结果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30-40分钟）：
- 先读Task Formulation把环境状态定义（observed/unobserved/unknown）与DAG节点状态（undiscovered/discovered/achieved）搞清楚。
- 重点看错误度量的正式定义（正文后半与Appendix B/相关附录），理解“无进展片段”如何切分、冗余如何判定、以及探索/利用归因规则。
- 实验部分主要看：不同地图生成参数如何对应探索/利用难度；harness/prompt消融带来的变化是否一致、是否存在过拟合评测指标的风险。

summary_en.core_problem: How to disentangle and quantify exploration vs. exploitation failures of LM agents using only observed action trajectories (no access to internal policies/values), and how to build controllable environments that can systematically dial exploration difficulty and exploitation difficulty to reveal distinct failure modes.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining/scaling/tokenizer paper; it is primarily an agent evaluation + metric design contribution. The relevance to RL-pretrain / continual learning is methodological: (i) a policy-agnostic behavioral error metric that does not assume an optimal policy, and (ii) a de-semanticized task construction (symbolic DAG nodes) that reduces leakage from pretrained world knowledge. Such setups can be useful to test whether RL-style training genuinely improves exploration/exploitation rather than exploiting semantic priors.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two key components:
1) Environment: partially observable 2D grid navigation coupled with an unknown task DAG. Moving reveals local map structure and whether a cell contains a task node; DAG prerequisites constrain which nodes can be achieved before the goal. Node semantics are replaced with symbols to prevent semantic shortcutting.
2) Policy-agnostic error metric: instead of measuring deviation from an optimal policy, the metric flags structurally redundant actions within trajectory segments where the agent makes no progress toward task completion, inspired by graph-theoretic redundancy/reuse notions. Each flagged error is attributed to exploration, exploitation, or both based on the map/task state. Map topology and DAG complexity are programmatically varied to emphasize exploration vs. exploitation demands.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates multiple frontier LM agents across diverse generated maps, reporting distinct exploration/exploitation failure modes. It also ablates prompt styles and explicit agent harness components, concluding that minimal harness engineering can improve both exploration and exploitation. The provided excerpt does not include concrete model lists or quantitative scores, so exact numbers cannot be cited here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–40 minutes):
- Read Task Formulation to internalize the state definitions (observed/unobserved/unknown cells; undiscovered/discovered/achieved DAG nodes).
- Focus on the formal definition of the error metric (main text + Appendix B): how “no-progress segments” are detected, what constitutes redundancy, and how attribution to exploration vs. exploitation is decided.
- In experiments, prioritize the map/DAG generation knobs and the harness/prompt ablations; assess whether improvements reflect real capability gains or metric-specific gaming.

recommendation.zh: 读它的度量定义即可：用 policy-agnostic 的结构冗余把探索/利用错误从轨迹里拆出来，适合拿来做 RL-pretrain 前后诊断而非追分。
recommendation.en: Read for the metrics: policy-agnostic structural redundancy teases apart exploration vs exploitation errors from trajectories, useful as a before/after diagnostic for RL-pretraining rather than leaderboard chasing.

paper.title: HINTBench: Horizon-agent Intrinsic Non-attack Trajectory Benchmark

summary.core_problem: 在“无外部攻击/无污染工具/无对抗环境”的良性条件下，长时序LLM Agent仍可能因自身内在失误进入高后果风险轨迹；论文要解决的是：如何系统化定义并评测这种“intrinsic risk”，并把评测从轨迹级二分类推进到风险步骤定位与失误类型诊断。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对“面向Agent的后训练/对齐数据与评测”有启发：它把风险从结果判定扩展到过程审计（trajectory auditing），并提供细粒度监督（risk-step + taxonomy），可用于训练更强的安全审计器/过程监督模型。对基座研究的间接价值在于：为长上下文过程建模、步骤级信用分配（credit assignment）、以及“安全相关错误模式”的数据构造提供了可操作的标注框架。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是提出评测设定与数据集而非新训练算法。论文形式化了轨迹τ=(s_t,a_t,o_t)的审计输出：轨迹级风险标签y∈{0,1}，以及带类型的风险元组集合R_τ（用于步骤定位与类型识别）。关键创新是统一的“五约束”分类法（Goal/Factual/Capability/Procedural/State），对应Agent每步决策必须满足的五个维度：目标是否偏离、事实是否错误、能力边界是否被误判、流程是否违规、状态更新/记忆是否出错；并在此之上进一步细分为更细粒度的风险模式（文中提到粗粒度5类、细粒度11种模式）。数据集HINTBench包含629条完整执行轨迹（523 risky/106 safe），平均33步，显著长于既有轨迹安全基准（文中对比ATBench 8.9步、R-Judge 5.4步）。评测任务分三层：风险检测→粗粒度风险步定位→细粒度风险步定位+失误诊断；并对通用LLM审计与专用guard模型迁移能力做系统对比。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见的关键结论是“轨迹级检测”与“步骤级审计”存在显著能力鸿沟：强LLM在判断整条轨迹是否含风险相对更可行，但在risk-step localization与细粒度failure diagnosis上仍明显困难；同时现有guard模型对该“非攻击、内生风险”分布迁移较差。论文在引言中给出数据规模与长度统计（629条、平均33步、risky占比高），并强调Q：长时序导致风险起点与后果显现之间存在延迟，使定位与归因更难。由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数值（如各模型F1/Acc、各任务指标、各象限/类别混淆矩阵），此处无法可靠复述具体分数；建议以论文实验章节的主表为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议（约20–30分钟）：1）Introduction：把握“intrinsic vs extrinsic risk”的定义边界与为何长时序使风险潜伏传播；2）Methodology：看审计输出形式（轨迹级+步骤级typed tuples）与三类任务定义；3）Taxonomy相关表格/图（文中提到Table/Figure组织五约束与11模式）：这是数据可复用的核心；4）Experiments主表：重点看LLM vs guard在“检测→定位→诊断”三层任务上的性能落差与错误类型分布。若你关心预训练/持续学习，可额外思考：该taxonomy能否转化为过程监督信号（step-level reward/penalty）或用于合成“安全过程数据”。

summary_en.core_problem: Even under benign conditions (no prompt injection, no poisoned tools, no adversarial environment), long-horizon LLM agents can drift into high-stakes unsafe trajectories due to intrinsic failures. The paper targets how to define and benchmark such intrinsic risk, moving beyond trajectory-level labels to step-level risk localization and failure-type diagnosis.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining algorithms, but meaningful for post-training/alignment and data-centric safety research: it reframes safety evaluation as process auditing over long trajectories and provides fine-grained supervision (risky steps + typed failure taxonomy). For foundation-model researchers, the main value is a reusable annotation schema for long-context process modeling, step-level credit assignment, and constructing training data for safety auditors or process-supervised models.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is primarily a benchmark/taxonomy contribution rather than a new training method. The auditor is defined to output (i) a trajectory-level risk label and (ii) a set of typed risk tuples for step localization and diagnosis. The key design is a unified five-constraint taxonomy—Goal, Factual, Capability, Procedural, and State constraints—intended to cover what an agent must satisfy at each step (objective alignment, truthfulness, capability awareness, correct procedure, and state/updates). The benchmark, HINTBench, contains 629 full agent trajectories (523 risky, 106 safe) with an average length of 33 steps, explicitly longer than prior trajectory safety benchmarks cited in the paper. It supports three tasks: risk detection, coarse-grained risk-step localization (5 categories), and fine-grained localization/diagnosis (11 patterns). The paper evaluates both general-purpose LLMs as auditors and specialized guard models, focusing on transfer to intrinsic-risk settings.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical takeaway is a large gap between trajectory-level detection and step-level auditing: even strong LLMs struggle with risk-step localization and fine-grained failure diagnosis, and existing guard models transfer poorly to this non-attack intrinsic-risk distribution. From the provided full-text excerpt we can reliably cite dataset statistics (629 trajectories, 33 steps avg; comparisons to ATBench/R-Judge on length), but not the exact metric values (e.g., F1/accuracy per model/task) because the experimental tables are not included in the excerpt; refer to the paper’s main results tables for precise numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (20–30 min): (1) Introduction for the intrinsic-vs-extrinsic framing and the “latent risk propagation” argument in long horizons; (2) Methodology for the formal task definitions and the typed risk tuple output; (3) the taxonomy table/figure (5 constraints + 11 patterns), which is the most reusable artifact; (4) the main experiment tables contrasting LLM auditors vs guard models across detection vs localization vs diagnosis. If your focus is pretraining/continual learning, consider how the taxonomy could be converted into step-level supervision signals or used for synthetic data generation.

recommendation.zh: 把风险评测从“结果”拉到“过程审计+风险步定位”这点可直接用来做对齐数据；只需看 taxonomy 与标注协议，别指望预训练层面结论。
recommendation.en: Its value is shifting safety eval from outcomes to trajectory auditing with risk-step localization—actionable for alignment data; skim the taxonomy/annotation protocol, not for pretraining claims.

paper.title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents

summary.core_problem: 多模态游戏/浏览器环境中的通用 Agent 评测缺乏标准化动作接口与可验证的自动评估，导致不同工作难以可比、结果难复现。
summary.importance: Benchmark/评测基础设施贡献：提供标准化接口与“状态可验证”指标，降低评测噪声与主观性；对通用多模态 Agent（computer-use、长程规划、闭环交互）研究很关键，间接推动多模态预训练与后训练目标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GameWorld：在浏览器游戏环境中统一两类接口——(i) 直接键鼠控制的 computer-use agents；(ii) 语义动作空间的通用多模态 agents，并用确定性的 Semantic Action Parsing 将语义动作映射到环境执行；为每个任务配套可验证的 outcome/state 指标以便自动判分。
summary.experiments: 包含 34 个游戏、170 个任务；摘要未给出具体参评模型列表、胜率/完成率对比、以及与既有基准（如 Web/GUI agent 基准）的系统性对照结果细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluation of multimodal game/browser agents lacks standardized action interfaces and verifiable automated metrics, making results hard to compare and reproduce.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark/infrastructure contribution: standardized interfaces plus state-verifiable metrics reduce evaluation noise and subjectivity. Important for generalist multimodal agents (computer-use, long-horizon planning, closed-loop interaction) and indirectly informs pretraining/post-training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: GameWorld unifies two agent interfaces: (i) low-level keyboard/mouse control for computer-use agents; (ii) a semantic action space for generalist multimodal agents, executed via deterministic Semantic Action Parsing. Each task includes verifiable outcome/state metrics for automatic scoring.
summary_en.experiments: 34 games and 170 tasks. The abstract does not specify evaluated model suites, quantitative comparisons, or detailed baselines against existing web/GUI agent benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 当评测基础设施看：标准化动作接口+可验证指标能显著降噪，适合用来做多模态agent训练回归测试；正文细节不必深挖。
recommendation.en: Treat it as eval infrastructure: standardized action APIs plus verifiable metrics reduce noise and make good regression tests for multimodal agents; no need to deep-read beyond the interface/metrics.

paper.title: TREX: Automating LLM Fine-tuning via Agent-Driven Tree-based Exploration

summary.core_problem: 如何用多智能体把LLM微调/训练的端到端流程（需求分析、数据与文献检索、配方设计、训练与评测、迭代试验管理）自动化，并能在多轮实验中高效探索与复用经验。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“系统+benchmark”：提出面向LLM训练生命周期的多智能体工作流编排，并用树搜索式实验管理来提升迭代效率；同时构建FT-Bench用于评测“自动化微调”能力。对提升实验吞吐与自动化有启发，但对基座预训练方法论本身的直接推进有限。
summary.technical_approach: TREX包含Researcher与Executor两模块：前者负责需求拆解、文献/数据调研与训练策略生成；后者负责数据准备、训练执行与评测。将多轮实验过程显式建模为搜索树：规划探索路径、复用历史节点结果、从迭代试验中蒸馏高层策略（类似AutoML/实验管理+agent化）。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模与关键SOTA幅度信息；主要评测载体为作者提出的FT-Bench（10个真实场景任务，覆盖基础能力优化等），对比对象预计为人工调参/单agent/无树搜索的自动化流程等（需读正文确认）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to automate the end-to-end LLM fine-tuning/training lifecycle (requirement analysis, literature/data research, recipe design, training/evaluation, iterative experiment management) with multi-agent systems while enabling efficient exploration and reuse across rounds.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a system + benchmark contribution: an agentic orchestration framework for the LLM training lifecycle with tree-structured exploration, plus FT-Bench to evaluate automated fine-tuning. Useful for improving experimentation throughput, but less directly impactful on foundation-model pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: TREX uses two modules (Researcher and Executor). The process is modeled as a search tree over multi-round experiments to plan exploration, reuse historical results, and distill high-level insights from iterative trials—akin to agentified AutoML/experiment management.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scales or headline gains. Evaluation is conducted on FT-Bench (10 real-world tasks). Baselines likely include human tuning and simpler agentic pipelines (verify in the paper).

recommendation.zh: 当作自动化训练流水线的系统参考：只看树搜索式实验管理和 FT-Bench 设定，结论更像吞吐工具而非方法论增量。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an automation-systems reference: skim the tree-based experiment manager and FT-Bench; it’s more throughput tooling than methodological gain.

paper.title: [COMP25] The Automated Negotiating Agents Competition (ANAC) 2025 Challenges and Results

summary.core_problem: 如何评测与推动自动谈判智能体在更复杂设置下的能力：多协议/多交易谈判，以及供应链场景中的并发谈判。
summary.importance: Benchmark/竞赛报告：提供任务设定、挑战点与结果分析，可作为多智能体协商/博弈式交互的评测参考；但与LLM基座预训练不直接相关，更多偏Agent评测生态。
summary.technical_approach: 总结ANAC 2025两大赛道：1) multi-deal negotiations；2) 复杂供应链管理环境中的concurrent negotiation agents；报告参赛系统总体表现并讨论未来方向（方法本身以参赛方案为主，论文侧重竞赛组织与分析）。
summary.experiments: 以竞赛结果为核心实验：对不同agent在上述赛道的表现进行排名与分析；摘要未给出具体指标定义、参赛agent数量、统计显著性等细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate and advance automated negotiating agents in harder settings: multi-deal negotiation and concurrent negotiation in supply-chain environments.
summary_en.importance: A competition/benchmark report (ANAC 2025) that defines tasks and analyzes results; useful as an evaluation reference for negotiation/multi-agent interaction, but not directly tied to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Summarizes two ANAC 2025 tracks—multi-deal negotiations and concurrent negotiation in complex supply-chain management—reporting outcomes and future directions; the paper focuses on competition setup and analysis rather than a single new algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: Competition-based evaluation with rankings and analyses; the abstract does not include metric definitions, participant counts, or detailed statistics.

recommendation.zh: 竞赛报告性质：扫任务设定与排行榜就够了，更多是谈判评测生态信息，对预训练研究只提供弱外部信号。
recommendation.en: Competition report: skim the task specs and leaderboard; it’s mostly ecosystem signal for negotiation evals, weakly connected to pretraining.

paper.title: Mobile GUI Agents under Real-world Threats: Are We There Yet?
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed a rapid development of mobile GUI agents powered by large language models (LLMs), which can autonomously execute diverse device-control tasks based on natural language instructions. The increasing accuracy of these agents on standard benchmarks has raised expectations for large-scale real-world deployment, and there are already several commercial agents released and used by early adopters. However, are we really ready for GUI agents integrated into our daily devices a

summary.core_problem: 评估移动 GUI agent 在真实世界威胁下是否仍能稳定完成任务，尤其是面对广告、用户生成内容等不可信界面元素时的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 Agent benchmark/robustness 评测，不是新代理范式，但问题设定是现实部署前必须补的一环：现有静态 benchmark 高分未必能转化为真实设备可用性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文指出现有 GUI agent 测试环境为追求可复现，通常使用内容静态、干净的 app 页面，遗漏了现实中最常见的第三方噪声与诱导内容。作者因此构造贴近真实威胁的评测设定，考察 agent 在受污染界面上的任务表现与安全性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和指标数字，但实验主线应是比较标准 benchmark 与威胁场景下的性能落差。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于提醒：下游 agent 能力测量容易被干净环境高估。
summary.authors_note: 从作者名单与题目看，团队来自人机交互/系统方向，聚焦移动端 GUI agent 的真实部署风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether mobile GUI agents remain reliable under real-world threats, especially untrusted interface content such as ads, emails, and user-generated media.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent robustness/benchmark contribution rather than a new agent paradigm, but it targets a missing pre-deployment validation step: strong results on static benchmarks may not translate to real-device usability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that existing GUI-agent benchmarks rely on static and sanitized app content for reproducibility, thereby missing realistic third-party noise and malicious distractions. It then introduces threat-oriented evaluation settings to measure robustness and safety under contaminated interfaces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names or exact metrics, but the central experiment is likely the gap between standard benchmark performance and performance under threat scenarios. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is about measurement bias rather than method design.
summary_en.authors_note: Based on the author list and topic, the team appears to come from HCI/systems research with a focus on real-world deployment risks of mobile GUI agents.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但 benchmark 设定很对：很多 GUI agent 分数是被干净环境抬出来的，只看威胁模型和性能掉点即可。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the benchmark premise is right: many GUI-agent scores are inflated by sanitized environments; read the threat model and the drop tables only.

paper.title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM评测常把错误混在一起：到底是“看错了”（perception error）还是“语义/规则映射错了”（rule-mapping error）难以区分。本文提出并刻画一种更纯粹的失败模式——semantic fixation：即在视觉状态完全相同的情况下，模型仍固守预训练中更常见的语义解释（标准规则），无法按提示完成等价但相反的规则映射（逆规则/misère-style）。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的启发主要是机制与后训练交互：1）它提供了一个控制变量极强的诊断基准VLM-Fix，把“语义先验压倒指令”的现象从感知因素中剥离出来，可用于分析预训练语料分布偏置如何在推理时表现为语义锚定；2）它显示SFT/RLVR等后训练会产生强规则对齐但带来跨规则负迁移，提示后训练可能加剧某些语义通道的‘单一读出’；3）late-layer steering能部分修复，暗示错误更多发生在后层语义读出而非视觉表征本身，这对研究‘预训练表征 vs 对齐读出层’的分工很有价值。
summary.technical_approach:
1）VLM-Fix基准：选四个抽象棋类（井字棋、四子棋、黑白棋、点格棋），生成终局盘面；对同一终局盘面构造标准规则与逆规则两种语义解释，并分别询问winner/loser，从而在“视觉证据完全一致”下只改变语义映射。
2）三种渲染控制感知：Base/Checkerboard/Glyph（把棋子符号替换为随机字母glyph）用于降低模型对熟悉外观的捷径。
3）提示词干预验证机制：用neutral alias（中性标签）替换winner/loser等带强语义价的词，能显著缩小逆规则差距；再用带语义价的别名又会重新拉开差距，支持‘语义框架触发固着’的解释。
4）后训练分析：比较SFT与RLVR在单规则训练 vs 联合规则训练下的同规则提升与跨规则迁移；并用后层激活steering在推理时纠偏，定位问题更偏后层读出。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖14个开源与闭源VLM，在VLM-Fix上普遍出现：标准规则准确率显著高于逆规则（semantic-fixation gap），且该差距在不同游戏、不同渲染风格下保持一致趋势。提示词实验显示：neutral alias能显著缩小gap，语义化alias会恢复gap。后训练实验显示：只在一种规则上做SFT/RLVR会提升同规则但损害对立规则（负迁移）；联合规则训练能改善双规则泛化。late-layer activation steering可部分恢复逆规则性能。另在VLMBias的counterfactual counting任务上观察到相似定性趋势。
注：你提供的全文片段未包含各模型的具体准确率数字、gap幅度、训练样本量与steering强度等表格，因此无法给出精确数值复盘。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约25-35分钟）：
- 先读Dataset/Evaluation设置：理解“同一终局盘面+规则翻转”的控制变量设计，这是论文最核心贡献。
- 再看Prompt families与alias干预实验（通常配Figure 1）：这是证明semantic fixation机制的关键证据链。
- 最后看后训练与steering部分：关注‘单规则对齐→跨规则负迁移’这一结论，以及作者如何据此推断问题在late semantic readout。
如果你的目标是预训练数据/分布研究：建议把标准规则更常见这一点视作“预训练频次先验”，思考如何用数据再加权/反事实数据合成在预训练阶段缓解。

summary_en.core_problem: Many VLM failures conflate perception mistakes with semantic/rule-mapping mistakes. This paper isolates a distinct failure mode—semantic fixation—where a model sticks to a default, familiar interpretation (standard rules) even when the prompt specifies an alternative but equally valid mapping (inverse rules), under identical visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the value is diagnostic and mechanistic: VLM-Fix cleanly factors out perception by holding terminal board states constant while flipping semantics, making it a sharp probe of pretraining priors and instruction-overriding biases. It also shows post-training tradeoffs: SFT/RLVR can be strongly rule-aligned yet induce negative transfer across rules, while joint training improves generalization. Late-layer activation steering partially fixes inverse-rule errors, suggesting the issue is often in late semantic readout rather than visual recognition—useful for separating representation vs alignment/readout effects.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces VLM-Fix across four abstract games (Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, Reversi, Dots and Boxes). For each terminal board state, it evaluates paired prompts under standard vs inverse (misère-style) rules, and asks both winner and loser queries. Visual confounds are controlled via three render styles (Base, Checkerboard, Glyph with randomized symbols). Mechanism tests use prompt interventions: replacing winner/loser with neutral aliases reduces the inverse-rule gap; reintroducing semantic valence reopens it. Post-training analysis compares single-rule vs joint-rule SFT and RLVR, and uses late-layer activation steering to recover some inverse-rule performance, localizing the failure to late semantic decoding.
summary_en.experiments:
Across 14 open and closed VLMs, accuracy is consistently higher for standard rules than inverse rules on identical visual states, yielding a robust semantic-fixation gap across games and render styles. Neutral-alias prompting narrows the gap; semantically loaded aliases restore it. Post-training on one rule improves same-rule performance but hurts cross-rule transfer; joint rule training improves performance on both. Late-layer steering partially recovers degraded inverse-rule accuracy. Similar qualitative behavior is reported on VLMBias (counterfactual counting), supporting external validity.
Caveat: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (exact accuracies/gap sizes, training set sizes, steering parameters), so precise figures cannot be quoted from the given content.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 min):
1) Read the dataset/evaluation section to internalize the controlled paired-design (same terminal state, flipped semantics).
2) Focus on the prompt-family and alias intervention results (often centered around Fig. 1) as the main causal evidence for semantic fixation.
3) Then read the post-training and activation-steering sections for the negative-transfer finding and the late-readout hypothesis.
If your interest is pretraining/data priors, treat “standard rules are more frequent in web data” as an explicit frequency-prior hypothesis and consider how counterfactual data mixing or reweighting might mitigate fixation.

recommendation.zh: VLM-Fix 控变量很干净，把错误从感知里剥离成“语义锚定”，还能看到后训练的负迁移；只看基准构造与 late-layer steering 结果。
recommendation.en: VLM-Fix is unusually clean in isolating “semantic fixation” from perception, and it exposes post-training negative transfer; skim benchmark construction and late-layer steering results.

paper.title: EgoEsportsQA: An Egocentric Video Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in Esports

summary.core_problem: 构建一个能真实检验Video-LLM在“高速度、信息密集、强规则约束”的虚拟对抗环境（FPS电竞第一视角）中的感知与战术推理能力的基准，并通过严格去除文本捷径与时间锚点对齐，确保评测依赖视频理解而非语言猜测。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限（更偏benchmark），但对多模态预训练/数据构建有两点启发：1）在高UI密度、快节奏场景下，现有Video-LLM从感知到推理的断层被放大，可作为训练数据与建模改进的诊断工具；2）其“时间锚点对齐 + 去文本捷径”的标注与评测设计，能反向指导更高质量的视频指令/偏好数据合成与评测集构建。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EgoEsportsQA：来自3款FPS职业比赛的第一视角视频片段，构建364 clips、1,745 QA对。数据通过可扩展六阶段流水线生产，并由具备领域知识的标注者编写问题。任务分类为二维解耦taxonomy：认知能力维度11个子任务（覆盖感知与推理层级）+ 电竞知识维度6个子任务（宏观进程macro-progression与微观操作micro-operation）。引入time anchor alignment减少长视频歧义；并通过neutralize textual shortcuts使text-only接近随机猜测，强制模型依赖视觉/音频证据。
summary.experiments: 评测9个Video-LLM（含闭源与开源），最强模型准确率为71.58%。总体趋势：战术推理显著弱于基础感知；微观操作理解弱于宏观进程。消融显示视觉与音频输入、合适的帧采样率与分辨率对性能关键，并揭示长视频建模困难。另有探索性实验表明virtual-to-real具备一定迁移性。由于给定全文片段未包含各模型逐项分数表与消融具体数值，需以论文实验表格为准补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30分钟）：
- 重点看数据构建与评测设计：time anchor alignment、去文本捷径策略、taxonomy定义（这决定benchmark是否“卡住”模型能力）。
- 再看实验分析部分：感知vs推理、macro vs micro的分解结果，以及帧率/分辨率/音频消融结论，用于反推训练数据与模型输入设计。
- 若你做预训练数据科学，可快速扫六阶段流水线，关注如何规模化产出高质量、低捷径的QA。

summary_en.core_problem: Designing a video QA benchmark that genuinely stresses Video-LLMs on high-tempo, UI-dense, rule-governed, adversarial virtual environments (egocentric FPS esports), while preventing language-only shortcuts and reducing temporal ambiguity via time-anchor alignment.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark paper (not a pretraining-method contribution), but it is useful for multimodal pretraining in two ways: (i) it exposes a widened gap between perception and tactical reasoning under fast dynamics, serving as a diagnostic target for data/model scaling; (ii) its evaluation hygiene—time anchoring and shortcut neutralization—provides concrete design patterns for building higher-fidelity video instruction/eval sets that better correlate with real capability rather than prompt artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: EgoEsportsQA: 364 egocentric clips from professional tournaments across 3 FPS titles, annotated into 1,745 QA pairs via a scalable six-stage pipeline with domain-expert annotators. Questions are organized with a decoupled 2D taxonomy: 11 cognitive capability subtasks (perception→reasoning) and 6 esports-knowledge subtasks (macro-progression vs micro-operation). The benchmark introduces time-anchor alignment for precise temporal grounding and explicitly neutralizes textual shortcuts so text-only baselines are near random, enforcing visual (and audio) dependence.
summary_en.experiments: Nine Video-LLMs (proprietary + open) are evaluated; the best reported accuracy is 71.58%. Models degrade more on tactical reasoning than on basic perception, and struggle more with micro-operation than macro-progression. Ablations highlight the necessity of visual/audio inputs and appropriate frame sampling rates and resolutions, and reveal challenges in long-video modeling. The provided excerpt does not include per-model breakdown tables or exact ablation deltas; consult the experiment section for the full numeric matrix.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (20–30 min):
- Read dataset construction + evaluation design first (time anchors, shortcut neutralization, taxonomy).
- Then jump to the error breakdowns (perception vs reasoning; macro vs micro) and the input ablations (fps/resolution/audio) to extract actionable implications for multimodal pretraining.
- Only skim the model list; the main value is the benchmark design and the diagnostic slices.

recommendation.zh: 更像数据/基准工作但去捷径做得认真，能当你检验视频模型在高 UI 密度场景的压力测试；只看去文本捷径与时间对齐设计。
recommendation.en: Primarily a benchmark, but the anti-shortcut design is solid—use it as a stress test for high-UI-density video understanding; read only the shortcut removal and temporal alignment setup.

paper.title: SpotSound: Enhancing Large Audio-Language Models with Fine-Grained Temporal Grounding

summary.core_problem: 现有大型音频-语言模型（ALM）在“长音频中的事件时间定位（temporal grounding）”上不可靠：一方面训练数据以clip级弱标注为主导致模型倾向把事件“铺满全段”；另一方面评测集多为事件清晰、间隔有静音的简单场景，无法检验真实世界“短事件埋在密集背景里”的needle-in-a-haystack定位能力。论文要解决的是：在开放词表自然语言查询下，让ALM既能判断事件是否存在，又能在长音频中给出精确起止时间，并显式抑制对不存在事件的“时间戳幻觉”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值主要体现在“对齐/后训练数据与目标函数如何塑造时序定位能力与可靠性”的范式：用带负例的判别式结构把“是否存在”与“定位区间”拆开，并把“抑制不存在事件的时间戳输出”写进训练目标。这对多模态预训练/持续学习里常见的幻觉与证据校验问题有启发（尤其是从弱标注走向细粒度对齐时）。但从严格的LLM基座预训练角度，它更偏多模态后训练与评测基建，而非新的通用预训练范式或scaling机制，因此归为skim更合适。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三块组成：
1) 两阶段任务分解：先做二分类存在性回答（yes/no），若存在再输出所有匹配区间的(start,end)集合。该分解把“证据判别”与“边界回归/生成”解耦，便于对不存在事件施加强约束。
2) 时间信息注入：将时间戳token与音频token交错（timestamp-interleaved sequence）。音频侧采用Whisper-large-v3作为编码器，mel谱经编码后时间步对应约40ms（因stride=2池化压缩）。交错时间戳token的核心作用是把连续时间轴离散化为可被LLM直接建模的符号序列，使模型能在生成端直接“指向”边界。
3) 抑制时间戳幻觉的训练目标：把每个训练样本重构为判别式四元组（audio, 正查询=存在事件描述, GT时间戳, 负查询=不存在事件描述）。训练时要求模型对负查询学会拒答/输出no（或不输出时间戳），从目标层面惩罚“无证据也给时间”的行为。论文还构建了时序感知指令数据：自建10k指令样本，并从既有音频-语言数据集中额外收集67.6k，总计77.6k用于端到端训练。
架构上以现成ALM为骨干（Qwen2-Audio、Audio Flamingo 3），属于在强backbone上通过序列化时间与判别式目标做能力补齐。
summary.experiments:
从给定全文片段可确认的实验要点包括：
- 评测基准：提出SpotSound-Bench，专门针对“短窗口事件嵌入长音频、目标占比<10%”的困难设定，强调真实密集背景下的定位。
- 结果结论（定性）：作者声称在多个时间定位基准上达到SOTA，同时在标准SED任务上保持强性能，表明泛化未明显牺牲。
- 规模信息（定量）：训练数据77.6k（10k新建+67.6k收集）；音频编码器Whisper-large-v3；编码后时间分辨率约40ms。
由于你提供的“全文内容”在Methods后被截断，缺少结果表格/指标定义（如mAP、IoU阈值、定位F1等）与具体提升数字、消融（如无负例/无时间戳交错/不同时间粒度）等关键细节，无法基于全文给出可靠的具体性能数值与增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约20–35分钟）：
- 重点看Introduction里对两类失败根因的拆解（弱标注导致的时间铺满、基准过易导致的虚假进展），以及SpotSound-Bench的“目标<10%占比”设定，这决定了任务难度分布。
- Methods里抓两点：①timestamp-interleaving如何把连续时间映射到token序列（时间粒度/编码方式/输出格式）；②四元组训练目标如何定义loss与负例采样（负查询从何而来、是否同音频内hard negative）。
- 若拿到完整PDF，建议精读实验章节的三类消融：无负例时的幻觉率、不同时间token粒度对定位精度/长度外推的影响、两阶段存在性门控对误报/漏报的贡献；并关注SpotSound-Bench与传统基准的差距是否主要来自“背景密度”而非音频长度本身。

summary_en.core_problem: Large audio-language models are strong at holistic audio understanding (captioning/summarization) but unreliable at temporal grounding: given a free-form query, they often fail to precisely localize when an event occurs in long-form audio, and may even hallucinate timestamps for events that are absent. The paper targets this reliability gap under realistic conditions where short target events are embedded in dense background audio, a regime underrepresented by clip-level supervision and by existing, overly easy benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is a concrete recipe for improving evidence-grounded outputs in multimodal settings: (i) explicitly separating existence verification from span localization, and (ii) training with structured negatives so the model learns to abstain rather than fabricate temporal spans. This is more of a post-training/objective-and-data design contribution plus a harder benchmark, rather than a new general pretraining paradigm or scaling-law result—still useful as a pattern for reducing hallucinations when moving from weak to fine-grained supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SpotSound builds on strong ALM backbones (Qwen2-Audio, Audio Flamingo 3) with Whisper-large-v3 as the audio encoder. The method has three pillars:
1) Two-stage formulation: first predict event existence (yes/no) for a query; only if yes, generate all matching (start,end) intervals. This gating isolates verification from localization.
2) Timestamp-interleaved encoding: inject temporal information by interleaving discrete timestamp tokens with audio embeddings, turning continuous time into a token sequence the LLM can attend to and generate against. With the encoder’s temporal compression, each audio timestep corresponds to ~40 ms.
3) Hallucination-suppressing objective via discriminative quadruplets: each instance is restructured as (audio, positive query, ground-truth timestamps, negative query for an absent event). Training enforces correct localization for positives while teaching the model to reject negatives (no timestamps), directly penalizing “timestamp hallucinations.” The authors also assemble a temporally-aware instruction-tuning set totaling 77.6k samples (10k newly curated + 67.6k collected from existing datasets).
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the experimentally grounded facts are:
- A new benchmark, SpotSound-Bench, designed as a needle-in-a-haystack setting where target events occupy <10% of long audio duration, aiming to reflect dense real-world backgrounds.
- The paper claims SOTA across multiple temporal grounding benchmarks while retaining strong performance on standard sound event detection (SED), suggesting limited regression.
- Concrete scale details available here: 77.6k training samples; Whisper-large-v3 encoder; ~40 ms temporal resolution after encoding.
However, the excerpt does not include the results section/tables, metric definitions, or ablations, so specific numeric gains (e.g., localization mAP/F1 at IoU thresholds) cannot be faithfully reported based on the supplied content.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–35 min):
- Read the Introduction for the problem diagnosis (weak clip-level supervision + unrealistic benchmarks) and the design intent of SpotSound-Bench (<10% target occupancy).
- In Methods, focus on (a) how timestamp tokens are defined/interleaved (granularity, formatting, decoding) and (b) the quadruplet objective details (loss, negative-query construction, whether negatives are hard/semantically close).
- If you have the complete PDF, prioritize the ablations that quantify hallucination reduction, the effect of timestamp granularity, and the benefit of the two-stage existence gate on false positives vs misses—these are the most transferable insights to multimodal pretraining/post-training.

recommendation.zh: 把“是否存在”与“定位区间”拆开并显式惩罚不存在事件的时间戳幻觉，这个目标函数很可迁移；只需看训练目标与负例构造，模型细节可略。
recommendation.en: Skim for the objective design: decouple existence from temporal span and explicitly penalize timestamp hallucinations via negatives; the loss/negative construction is the transferable part, architecture details less so.

paper.title: GlotOCR Bench: OCR Models Still Struggle Beyond a Handful of Unicode Scripts

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM/OCR系统在多Unicode文字体系上的泛化评测缺失，导致“看似能OCR”但实际只覆盖少数脚本的问题难以被系统性暴露与量化。
summary.importance: 贡献了覆盖100+ Unicode脚本的OCR泛化benchmark，并用系统评测揭示：多数模型只在少数脚本上可靠，性能与预训练覆盖强相关；对多语种/多脚本数据配比与多模态预训练覆盖具有直接诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建GlotOCR Bench：从真实多语文本渲染生成图像，使用Google Fonts字体、HarfBuzz排版、FreeType栅格化，包含干净/退化两种图像变体；抽样人工核验渲染正确性；评测开源与闭源VLM/OCR模型在不同脚本上的识别能力，并分析与脚本级预训练覆盖的相关性。
summary.experiments: 评测对象包含多种开源权重与专有前沿VLM；主要结论是：多数模型在少于10种脚本上表现好，最强模型也难超过30种脚本的可靠泛化；退化图像进一步放大差距；并观察到性能随脚本预训练覆盖度变化的趋势（摘要未给出具体模型规模与绝对指标细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: OCR evaluation for modern VLM-based systems is heavily biased toward a small set of scripts, making cross-script generalization failures hard to measure and diagnose.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a 100+ Unicode-script OCR generalization benchmark and shows that most models only work reliably on a handful of scripts; performance correlates with script-level pretraining coverage, providing actionable signals for multilingual/multiscript multimodal pretraining and data mixing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds GlotOCR Bench by rendering images from real multilingual texts using Google Fonts, HarfBuzz shaping, and FreeType rasterization, with both clean and degraded variants; manually validates rendering on sampled images; evaluates a range of open and proprietary VLM/OCR models and analyzes script coverage effects.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates multiple open-weight and closed models; finds most perform well on <10 scripts and even frontier models fail to generalize beyond ~30 scripts; degraded images worsen gaps; the abstract does not specify model sizes or full metric tables.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 benchmark 就够：它会让你在多脚本 OCR 上不再自欺；对预训练的直接 action 是回头查语料脚本覆盖与采样权重，正文无需细读。
recommendation.en: Glance-worthy as a benchmark sanity check: it prevents self-deception on multi-script OCR; the actionable takeaway is auditing script coverage and sampling weights in pretraining—no need to read deeply.

paper.title: LARY: A Latent Action Representation Yielding Benchmark for Generalizable Vision-to-Action Alignment
paper.abstract: While the shortage of explicit action data limits Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, human action videos offer a scalable yet unlabeled data source. A critical challenge in utilizing large-scale human video datasets lies in transforming visual signals into ontology-independent representations, known as latent actions. However, the capacity of latent action representation to derive robust control from visual observations has yet to be rigorously evaluated. We introduce the Latent Action Represe

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型缺乏显式动作数据的问题，评估从人类视频中提取的隐式动作表示的有效性。
summary.importance: 构建了一个大规模基准测试（LARY），用于评估隐式动作表示在高级语义动作和低级机器人控制上的泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 收集并整理了包含 100 万个视频（1000 小时）、151 个动作类别的大规模数据集，统一评估视觉信号到本体无关表示的转换质量。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 62 万图像对和 59.5 万运动轨迹，跨越多种具身环境，揭示了通用视觉基础模型在动作对齐上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the scarcity of explicit action data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by evaluating latent action representations extracted from human videos.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a large-scale benchmark (LARY) to evaluate the generalization of latent action representations on both semantic actions and low-level robotic control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Curates a dataset of 1M videos (1,000 hours) across 151 action categories to uniformly evaluate the transformation of visual signals into ontology-independent representations.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset includes 620K image pairs and 595K motion trajectories across diverse embodiments, revealing the performance of general visual foundation models on action alignment.

recommendation.zh: 具身 VLM 领域的优质数据基准，对 vision-to-action 对齐有参考价值，不涉足机器人控制的预训练研究员可跳过。
recommendation.en: Solid benchmark for VLA alignment; useful for embodied AI data curation, but can be skipped if not working on robotics.

paper.title: T2I-BiasBench: A Multi-Metric Framework for Auditing Demographic and Cultural Bias in Text-to-Image Models

summary.core_problem: 系统审计文本到图像模型中的人口统计与文化偏见，并同时覆盖偏见、元素遗漏与“文化坍缩”三类现象的评测需求。
summary.importance: Benchmark/评测贡献：提出多指标框架把偏见与生成缺失/坍缩问题统一量化；对多模态生成模型的数据配比、对齐与安全评测有参考价值，但对文本LLM预训练方法论是间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: T2I-BiasBench：13个互补指标（6个已有+7个新增/改造），新增如Composite Bias Score、Grounded/Implicit Missing Rate、Cultural Accuracy Ratio，并引入Hallucination/Vendi/CLIP proxy等适配指标；以结构化prompt集生成图像并汇总多维度评分。
summary.experiments: 评测Stable Diffusion v1.5、BK-SDM Base、Koala Lightning，并以Gemini 2.5 Flash（RLHF对齐）作参考；基准共1,574张生成图像、5类结构化prompt；摘要未给出完整量化结论细节（仅描述发现）。

summary_en.core_problem: Audit demographic and cultural bias in text-to-image models with a unified evaluation that also captures omission and cultural collapse.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/evaluation contribution: a multi-metric framework that jointly quantifies bias and generation failures (missing elements/cultural collapse), useful for multimodal generative model data, alignment, and safety evaluation; only indirectly informative for text-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: T2I-BiasBench with 13 complementary metrics (6 existing + 7 new/adapted), including Composite Bias Score, Grounded/Implicit Missing Rate, Cultural Accuracy Ratio, and adapted hallucination/Vendi/CLIP-proxy measures; uses structured prompts to generate images and aggregates scores across dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates Stable Diffusion v1.5, BK-SDM Base, Koala Lightning, with Gemini 2.5 Flash (RLHF-aligned) as a reference; 1,574 generated images across five prompt categories; the abstract lacks detailed quantitative results beyond high-level findings.

recommendation.zh: 当作评测备查即可：指标把“偏见/遗漏/文化坍缩”拆开量化，适合拿来补你们 T2I 安全评测表，但不必细读方法细节。
recommendation.en: Keep as a benchmarking reference: it separates bias vs omission vs cultural collapse with multiple metrics—useful to plug into a T2I audit checklist, not worth deep reading.

paper.title: Evaluating Relational Reasoning in LLMs with REL

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 推理评测往往混杂了输入长度、模板变化、知识检索、实体数量等因素，难以单独刻画“高元关系绑定（higher-arity binding）”带来的推理瓶颈。论文要解决的是：给出一个任务无关、可控的难度维度来衡量关系推理，并构建能系统调节该维度的生成式基准，从而定位模型在科学推理中何时、为何随关系复杂度上升而崩溃。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个更“机制导向”的评测坐标轴：Relational Complexity（RC，关系复杂度/关系元数）与 Operand Complexity（OC，操作数/实体表征难度）解耦后，可以更清晰地诊断模型失败是否来自“同时绑定多个独立变量”的能力不足，而非上下文变长或实体变多。这对数据配比与合成数据设计（例如系统性提升高 RC 组合约束样本）、以及训练动态分析（模型随规模/数据变化在 RC 维度上的 scaling）都有直接启发：你可以把 RC 当作一条未饱和的能力曲线来做 scaling/ablation，而不是只看传统 benchmark 平均分。
summary.technical_approach:
论文引入并形式化 Relational Complexity（RC）：完成某一步推理所需同时绑定的独立变元/操作数的最小数量，本质对应关系的 arity（元数）。同时定义 Operand Complexity（OC）：在固定 RC 下，识别/表示/推断各 argument role 的 filler 的难度。基于该框架构建 REL：跨数学、生物、化学三域的一组生成式任务族，使 RC 可参数化上调，并通过控制/边缘化其他混杂因素来尽量隔离 RC 的影响。全文的关键方法点是：
1) 用认知科学中的 RC 概念作为统一难度刻度，而不是用 prompt 长度/实体数等 proxy；
2) 任务设计强调“同一表征/相近长度下提升关系元数”，从而把性能下降归因到绑定与组合；
3) 生成式基准：可持续生成新题，避免静态题库被记忆或过拟合，便于跨模型代际对比与 scaling 分析。
summary.experiments:
论文报告了随 RC 增加的显著退化，并给出跨域数字：
- REL-A（Raven 矩阵/张量类）：RC 从 3 提升到 9，性能下降 45%。
- REL-B1（进化历史推理）：RC 从 5 提升到 20，准确率下降 93%。
- 化学任务（SMILES 表征）：从 REL-C1 到 REL-C3，任务完成率下降 39.7%。
